zh.desc: 铺设铁路，操控股权、卖空和贷款，在收购与清算中积累财富。
zh.rules:
目标:
你以投资人的身份持有铁路公司股份，同时担任所控制公司的总裁。个人现金与公司资金分别记账。游戏结束时，个人财富等于现金加持股市值，再减去空头市值；公司资产与私人公司不计分。财富最高者获胜。若只剩一位未破产的投资人，该投资人立即获胜。
准备:
· 基础版支持 3 至 7 人。3、4、5、6、7 人分别获得 420、315、252、210、180 美元，证书上限分别为 21、16、13、11、9 张。总统证代表两股，但只算一张证书；私人公司与空头不计入证书上限。
· 随机决定首位投资人。11 家私人公司公开拍卖，公共补贴池共有 200 美元。私人公司随后只能作为新公司首次发行的出资，不能转售。
初始拍卖:
当前投资人选择一家私人公司发起拍卖，也可以跳过。起拍价加剩余补贴不得低于面值，所有出价均为 5 美元的整数倍，且不得超过面值或自己持有的现金。参与者依次加价或退出，同一场拍卖中退出后不能重新加入。
只剩一位竞买者时，该竞买者支付出价，补贴池支付面值与出价的差额。由发起拍卖者左侧的投资人继续选择下一场拍卖。所有人连续跳过后，移除剩余私人公司，开始股票轮。
股票轮:
每轮从优先交易权持有者开始，依次行动，直到所有未破产的投资人连续跳过。行动过的投资人仍会获得后续回合；优先交易权交给最后行动者左侧的投资人。
· 个人行动依次为：卖出任意数量的持股；最多卖空一股；购买一张证书，或发起一家新公司的首次发行。可以省略其中任意步骤，但必须遵守先后次序。购买或首次发行结束本次行动。
· 公司行动替代整次个人行动：为一家由自己担任总裁、且不在收购区或清算区的公司取得贷款，然后可以从市场回购本公司任意数量的股份。至少执行其中一项。
· 买入的价格为当前每股股价，钱支付给股份来源方。卖股与卖空均从银行领取当前股价，卖出不会直接降低股价。本股票轮卖过或卖空过的公司，本轮不得买入。
· 2 股公司不能买卖普通股份或卖空。新公司首次发行所在的股票轮不能卖出或卖空其股票。收购区公司的股票不能交易。总统证不得进入市场；卖股导致另一位至少持有两股的投资人持股更多时，总统身份转移。同量时原总裁优先，否则从原总裁左侧依次比较。
· 5 股公司的个人持股上限为 3 股，10 股公司为 6 股。超过证书上限时，须尽可能卖股后才可结束股票行动。购买股票平掉空头不受证书和持股上限限制。
· 卖空会产生一股市场流通股和一股个人空头，同时收到股价。每家公司最多存在 5 股空头。个人不能同时持有同一家公司的多头与空头，取得匹配股份时立即抵消。第 8 阶段禁止新增卖空，既有空头仍须结算。
首次发行:
选择尚未使用的公司及一处空闲城市站位；不能选择多伦多。总统证以 100 至 400 美元、按 5 美元递增拍卖。中标者选择当前阶段允许的股本，并以现金和私人公司的面值恰好支付出价。私人公司归新公司所有，只有现金部分进入公司金库。初始股价为出价的一半，向下取股价表上的价格。
2 股、5 股、10 股公司分别拥有 1、2、4 枚基础站标。首次发行的首枚免费；5 股与 10 股公司须在股票轮结束前分别支付 50 或 150 美元购买其余站标，可以在后续公司行动中贷款筹款。未能支付的公司进入清算。
股票轮结束时，投资人合计持有至少全部股本的 5 股或 10 股公司，股价先右移一格；随后每一股市场股票使股价左移一格。股价最高 600 美元，向左最低停在最左收购格。
贷款与轮次:
股票轮后依次进行运营轮、合并收购轮、第二运营轮和第二合并收购轮，然后返回股票轮。每笔贷款获得 100 美元，并使股价左移一格；每还一笔贷款支付 100 美元，并使股价右移一格。公司最多持有等于股本股数的贷款，全局共 70 笔。
每个运营轮开始时，按已借贷款每五笔一档设定每笔利息，每档为 5 美元，最低为 5 美元。本运营轮内利率固定。拥有火车的公司先领取其邮政合同收入。公司按股价从高到低运营，同价时先进入该价位的公司优先。
公司运营:
· 铺轨：可以铺设或升级最多两块不同格的板块，其中最多一次升级。第二次操作另行支付 20 美元。黄色、绿色、棕色、灰色板块分别在第 2、3、5、7 阶段开放；必须逐色升级并保留既有轨道和站标。普通城市升棕时须尽量使用出口更多的板块。
· 新轨道须与公司的合法网络相连，未铺轨的起始城市可以先铺城市板块。轨道不能出界、跨越不可通行边界或进入红灰格没有接口的一侧。首次铺轨支付地形费用，底特律和纽约升绿另行支付 20 美元；矿场格不能升级。
· 放置站标：每次运营最多从公司库存放置一枚站标，目的城市必须有空位且与公司网络相连。本公司在同格不能重复放置，不能在多伦多放置。放置时不再付费。
· 运行火车：每条路线至少含一枚本公司站标，两端为城市或红色外部地点。不能重复城市或轨段，纽约两个城区视作同一个城市。其他公司填满的城市可作终点但不能穿过，红区只可作端点。火车数字限制经过的城市和外部地点数量；矿场不占停靠次数且不能作端点。各列火车不能共用轨段，须采用合计收入最高的合法路线。界面会提供最高收入路线。
· 分红：可以全额分红、半额分红或保留全部收入。分红按股本股数分配，金库股份的分红给公司，市场股份的分红由银行保留。空头持有人向银行支付相同的每股分红。10 股公司半额分红时，分给股东的部分向上取至 10 美元，留存部分向下取至 10 美元。
· 总分红为零时股价左移一格；达到当前股价时右移一格，达到两倍时右移两格。收购区股价在此计算中按 40 美元处理。
· 买车：未达火车上限时，可以从银行按标价买车，也可以经卖方总裁同意、以至少 1 美元从其他未清算公司买车。总裁不能以个人现金补贴买车。银行新车依次出售；公开市场上的弃车按原价出售。
· 利息：买车结束后，公司必须支付全部利息，并在需要时尽量贷款，新增贷款本轮也计息。仍付不起时，公司进入清算，公司现金交给总裁，由总裁支付利息；不足时进入现金危机。
· 还贷与结束：利息付清后可偿还任意数量的贷款。完成还贷步骤后可再次贷款；利息结算后至还贷步骤完成前不得贷款。公司结束运营时没有火车就进入清算。每个运营轮末出口下一列新车，可能触发阶段变化。
火车与阶段:
· 银行依次提供：2 型 100 美元，2+ 型 100 美元，3 型 250 美元，4 型 400 美元，5 型 600 美元，6 型 750 美元，7 型 900 美元，8 型 1100 美元。2+、3、4、5、6、7 型数量分别为 4、12、8、5、4、3 列。2 型仅首个运营轮无限供应，首轮出口后撤下全部余车；8 型无限供应。
· 第 2、3 阶段公司最多持有 4 列车，第 4、5 阶段最多 3 列，第 6 阶段起最多 2 列。超限时立即由总裁选择弃车至公开市场。
· 首列 4 型使所有 2 型淘汰；2+ 型可以再运行一次，随后移除，期间不能转卖。首列 6 型淘汰所有 3 型，首列 8 型淘汰所有 4 型。
· 新公司允许的股本依次为：第 2 阶段只能 2 股；第 3 阶段可选 2 或 5 股；第 4 阶段只能 5 股；第 5 阶段可选 5 或 10 股；第 6 阶段起只能 10 股。已有公司不必强制扩股。
私人公司:
· 匹兹堡钢厂，面值 40 美元：可在匹兹堡铺专用黄色城市板块，不要求连通，仍占一次铺轨。
· 山地工程师，面值 40 美元：每次在山地首次铺黄轨，先支付费用，再让公司获得 20 美元。
· 俄亥俄桥梁与联合桥梁，面值分别为 40、80 美元：首次铺河流格免地形费，并分别提供一枚、两枚桥梁。可在公司运营期间把桥放在路易维尔、辛辛那提或查尔斯顿，不要求连通；每城最多一枚，所有路线经过时均加 10 美元。
· 车站，面值 80 美元：向公司额外提供一枚站标。
· 小型、普通与大型煤矿，面值分别为 30、60、90 美元：分别提供一枚、两枚、三枚矿场。首次在紧邻城市或红色地点的山地铺黄轨时，可放矿场并免山地费；轨道必须能直接连接该地点，允许相邻城市未来升级后接通。矿场使路线增加 10 美元，此格不能升级。
· 小型、普通与大型邮政合同，面值分别为 60、90、120 美元：公司在每个运营轮开始时有火车，分别获得 10、15、20 美元。
合并与扩股:
合并收购轮先按开始时的运营顺序，处理不在收购区或清算区的公司。每家公司每轮最多扩股或合并一次；本次跳过仍可接受后续公司的合并提议。合并须经双方总裁同意，不要求铁路相连。
· 2 股公司可扩至 5 股，金库新增三股；之后须购买一枚站标，费用 50 美元。5 股公司可扩至 10 股，新增五股，并购买两枚站标，费用 100 美元。站标最多八枚，只购买未超过上限的数量；付不起则清算。
· 两家 2 股公司可合为一家 5 股公司，各原始两股折为一股，新股价为两公司原股价之和，向下取股价表价格。金库新增三股。不同总裁时，发起方总裁必须再买一股成为新总裁，另一方得到一股。
· 两家 5 股公司可合为一家 10 股公司，按一比一合并多头、空头及金库股份，新股价为原股价平均值向下取值。持股最多者成为总裁；并列时发起方总裁优先。匹配的多头与空头立即抵消。
· 扩股或合并后，原总裁先可从金库购买任意数量的股份，再由其左侧起其余投资人各获得一次买一股金库股份、卖任意持股或跳过的机会。不可卖空。随后公司可以贷款，并支付扩股所需站标费用。
收购与清算:
完成扩股合并后，依次处理最近进入清算区的公司、按倒运营顺序的收购区公司，再按倒运营顺序让正常公司选择是否自愿出售。在本轮转换或收购中刚进入收购区的公司，不加入本轮收购拍卖，也不能继续收购。
· 清算拍卖由银行以零美元起标，只出售火车、站标与私人公司。收购拍卖最低 10 美元。自愿出售最低为股价乘股本股数，成交后目标公司的金库股份先按股价卖给银行，增加目标现金。
· 从目标总裁左侧起，以 10 美元的整数倍竞价。目标总裁为自己的其他公司竞买时，每次只能比前价多出 10 美元。退出后不得重入。中标者才指定自己的哪家正常公司购买；须能承担出价及继承的全部贷款，可以利用目标现金、取得新贷款，并偿还继承贷款。
· 正常收购继承目标的现金与贷款；每笔未偿还的继承贷款使买方股价左移一格。成交价除股本股数向下取整，逐股支付给多头，并向空头收取。目标公司随后可重新发行。
· 清算时，公司原现金加拍卖款先偿还全部贷款。不足由总裁承担；有盈余才按股数向多头分配并向空头收取。无人竞买时移除资产。没有未破产总裁的公司，其不足由银行承担。
· 合并与收购继承全部站标。同格重复站标退回金库；总数超过八枚时，总裁须优先选择保留至多八个不同格的已放置站标，其余可用站标补足至八枚。超限火车立即弃置。
现金危机与结束:
个人现金不足以支付空头分红、清算债务或公司利息时，必须逐股出售可以合法出售的持股，且不能导致总统身份转移。没有可售股份且仍不足时破产退出；持股、空头及私人公司进入市场，所担任总裁的公司进入清算。银行立即抵消匹配多空，并在每个股票轮开始时从金库购买股份，继续平掉银行空头。
首列 8 型火车购入或出口后，再完成三个运营轮及中间的合并收购轮。如果触发时是本组第一个运营轮，先完成本组，再进行股票轮和最后两个运营轮；若触发时是第二个运营轮，下一股票轮后最后一组包含三个运营轮，期间不插入额外股票轮。
可选规则:
· 增加卖空：10 股公司的空头上限改为十股。
· 轧空：股票轮结束时，投资人合计持股超过 100% 的公司股价右移两格。
· 现代火车：7 型、8 型火车的路线每经过一枚本公司站标，分别增加 10 或 20 美元。
本实现采用基础版 v1.0 规则，不包含 Volatility 或其他地图变体。

en.desc: Build railroads and manage shares, shorts, and debt through mergers and liquidations.
en.rules:
Goal:
You invest in railroad companies and act as president of companies you control. Personal cash and company treasuries are separate. Final wealth is personal cash plus the market value of shares, minus the market value of shorts. Private companies and company assets do not count. The wealthiest investor wins. If only one investor remains solvent, that investor wins immediately.
Setup:
· The base game supports 3–7 investors. Starting cash for 3, 4, 5, 6, and 7 investors is $420, $315, $252, $210, and $180; certificate limits are 21, 16, 13, 11, and 9. A president's certificate represents two shares but counts as one certificate. Privates and shorts do not count toward the certificate limit.
· The first investor is chosen randomly. Eleven private companies are auctioned with a shared $200 subsidy pool. Privates may subsequently be contributed to an IPO at face value but cannot be resold.
Initial auction:
The active investor nominates a private or passes. The opening bid plus the remaining subsidy must cover its face value. All bids must be multiples of $5, no greater than face value or the bidder's cash. Investors raise or pass in order. Passing withdraws permanently from that auction.
The last bidder pays the bid; the subsidy pool pays the difference from face value. Play resumes to the left of the auction initiator. When everyone passes consecutively, unsold privates are removed and a stock round begins.
Stock rounds:
Investors act clockwise from the priority deal holder until all solvent investors pass consecutively. Anyone who acts is guaranteed another turn. Priority passes to the left of the last investor who acted.
· A personal turn permits, in order: selling any number of shares; shorting at most one share; then buying one certificate or initiating an IPO. Any steps may be omitted, but their order is fixed. Buying or completing an IPO ends the turn.
· Alternatively, act for one company you preside over outside acquisition or liquidation: take loans, then optionally buy back any number of its own market shares. At least one of these actions is required.
· Purchases cost the current share price and pay the source of the share. Sales and shorts receive the current share price from the bank. Selling does not directly move the price. After selling or shorting a company's stock, you cannot buy it again in that stock round.
· A 2-share company cannot trade ordinary shares or be shorted. Shares cannot be sold or shorted in the stock round of the company's IPO. Shares in acquisition cannot trade. A president's certificate cannot enter the market. If a sale leaves another investor with at least two shares and a larger holding, the presidency changes. Ties favor the incumbent, otherwise the nearest eligible investor to the outgoing president's left.
· Personal holding limits are three shares in a 5-share company and six in a 10-share company. Excess certificates must be sold before ending a stock turn whenever legally possible. Buying to close a short is exempt from certificate and share limits.
· Shorting creates a market share and a personal short, and pays the seller the share price. At most five shorts may exist per company. Matching long and short shares held by one investor cancel immediately. No new shorts may be opened in phase 8; existing shorts remain liable.
IPOs:
Choose an unused company and an open city station location other than Toronto. Auction its president's certificate for $100–$400 in multiples of $5. The winner chooses a company size permitted in the current phase and pays the bid exactly using cash and privates at face value. Contributed privates belong to the company; only cash enters its treasury. Initial share price is half the bid rounded down to a market price.
The basic station allotment is one, two, or four tokens for 2-, 5-, or 10-share companies. The home token is free. A 5-share company must pay $50, or a 10-share company $150, for the remaining tokens before the stock round ends. A later company turn may take loans to pay this cost. Failure to pay causes liquidation.
At the end of a stock round, a 5- or 10-share company with at least 100% held by investors moves right once. Its price then moves left once for every share in the market. Prices stop at $600 to the right and at the leftmost acquisition space to the left.
Loans and round sequence:
After a stock round, play an operating round, a merger/acquisition round, a second operating round, and a second merger/acquisition round, then another stock round. Each $100 loan moves the share price left once. Repaying $100 moves it right once. A company may hold no more loans than its share size; only 70 loans exist.
At the start of each operating round, interest per loan is set to $5 for each group of five outstanding loans, rounded up, with a minimum of $5. It remains fixed throughout that operating round. Companies with trains first receive mail income. Companies operate in descending share price order; ties favor the first company to enter that price space.
Company operation:
· Track: lay or upgrade up to two different hexes, with at most one upgrade. A second tile operation costs an extra $20. Yellow, green, brown, and gray become available in phases 2, 3, 5, and 7. Upgrade one color at a time, preserving track and tokens. Normal cities upgraded to brown must use as many exits as fit.
· New track must connect to the company's legal network; an untracked home city may receive its first city tile. Track cannot leave the map, cross impassable boundaries, or enter a red or gray hex without a matching connection. Pay terrain costs for the initial lay. Detroit and New York cost an additional $20 to upgrade to green. Mine hexes cannot be upgraded.
· Station: place at most one available company token in a connected open city location. A company cannot place two tokens in one hex or place a token in Toronto. Placement itself is free.
· Routes: each route must include a company token and have cities or red offboard locations at both ends. A route cannot repeat a city or track segment; New York's two city groups count as one city. A city filled by other companies may be an endpoint but cannot be traversed. Red locations must be endpoints. The train number limits cities and offboard locations visited. Mines do not count as stops and cannot be endpoints. Different trains cannot share track. The company must use the highest combined legal revenue; the interface supplies optimal routes.
· Dividends: pay full, pay half, or withhold. Divide the paid portion by the company's share size. Treasury shares pay the company, market shares pay the bank, and shorts pay the same per-share dividend to the bank. A 10-share half dividend rounds the distributed half up to $10 and the retained half down to $10.
· A zero payout moves left once. A payout at least the share price moves right once; at least twice the price moves right twice. Treat an acquisition share price as $40 for this comparison.
· Trains: below its train limit, a company may buy from the bank at face value or, with the seller's president's consent, from a company outside liquidation at any agreed price of at least $1. Presidents cannot contribute personal cash. New bank trains sell in order; discarded market trains sell at face value.
· Interest: after train purchases, pay interest on every loan. Take additional loans if necessary and possible; these loans also accrue interest immediately. If payment remains impossible, liquidate the company, transfer its cash to the president, and require the president to pay the interest. Insufficient personal cash causes a cash crisis.
· Repayment and completion: after interest, repay any number of loans. Loans cannot be taken between paying interest and completing repayment. After repayment, loans may be taken again. A company with no train at the end of its operation liquidates. Export the next new train at each operating round's end, potentially changing phase.
Trains and phases:
· Bank trains are 2/$100, 2+/$100, 3/$250, 4/$400, 5/$600, 6/$750, 7/$900, and 8/$1100. Quantities for 2+, 3, 4, 5, 6, and 7 are 4, 12, 8, 5, 4, and 3. Unlimited 2-trains are available only in the first operating round; all remaining 2-trains are withdrawn after its export. 8-trains are unlimited.
· Train limits are four in phases 2–3, three in phases 4–5, and two from phase 6 onward. Presidents immediately discard excess trains to the open market.
· The first 4-train rusts all 2-trains. 2+ trains run once more and are then removed; they cannot be traded while obsolete. The first 6-train rusts all 3-trains; the first 8-train rusts all 4-trains.
· IPO sizes are: only 2 in phase 2; 2 or 5 in phase 3; only 5 in phase 4; 5 or 10 in phase 5; only 10 from phase 6 onward. Existing companies need not grow.
Private companies:
· Pittsburgh Steel Mill, $40: permits the special yellow Pittsburgh tile without a connectivity requirement, using one track lay.
· Mountain Engineers, $40: earn $20 for the company after paying any required cost for an initial yellow lay in mountains.
· Ohio Bridge and Union Bridge, $40 and $80: waive initial river terrain fees and provide one and two bridge tokens. During company operation, bridges may be placed in Louisville, Cincinnati, or Charleston without connectivity. At most one bridge per city; all routes visiting it earn an extra $10.
· Train Station, $80: gives the company one extra station token.
· Minor, regular, and Major Coal Mines, $30, $60, and $90: supply one, two, and three mines. When laying yellow in mountains next to a city or red location, place a mine to waive the mountain cost. Track must connect directly to that location, allowing a future upgrade of the adjacent city. A mine adds $10 to a route and prevents upgrades of its hex.
· Minor, regular, and Major Mail Contracts, $60, $90, and $120: pay $10, $15, and $20 at the start of each operating round if the company owns a train.
Conversions and mergers:
In the operating order fixed at the start of M&A, companies outside acquisition and liquidation may convert or merge at most once. Passing does not prevent accepting a later merger. Both presidents must consent; no rail connection is required.
· A 2-share company converts to 5 with three new treasury shares and must buy one token for $50. A 5-share company converts to 10 with five new treasury shares and must buy two tokens for $100. Buy only the tokens that fit within eight. Inability to pay causes liquidation.
· Two 2-share companies merge into a 5-share company, exchanging each pair of old shares for one new share. The new price is the sum of old prices rounded down to a market value. Three shares enter treasury. With different presidents, the initiating president must buy another share to become president; the other president receives one share.
· Two 5-share companies merge into a 10-share company. Combine long, short, market, and treasury shares one for one. The new price is the old prices' average rounded down. The largest holding determines presidency, with ties favoring the initiating president. Matching long and short shares cancel immediately.
· After conversion or merger, the original president may buy any number of treasury shares. Each other investor, clockwise from that president's left, then has one opportunity to buy one treasury share, sell any number of shares, or pass. No shorting is allowed. The company may then take loans and must pay conversion token costs.
Acquisitions and liquidations:
After conversions and mergers, sell liquidations most recently entered first, acquisition companies in reverse operating order, and then allow normal companies to offer friendly sales in reverse operating order. A company newly entering acquisition during conversion or purchase is excluded from acquisition sale and further purchases in this M&A round.
· Liquidation starts with a $0 bank bid and sells only trains, station tokens, and privates. Acquisition bids start at $10. Friendly sale minimum is share price times company size. A friendly seller's treasury shares are sold to the bank at market value, adding cash to the acquired treasury.
· Bid clockwise from the target president's left in multiples of $10. The target president, bidding for another company, may increase the previous bid by only $10. Passing is final. The winning investor then names an eligible company that can pay the bid and handle all inherited debt. Target cash and additional loans may finance the purchase; inherited loans may be repaid.
· A normal acquisition inherits target cash and loans. Each retained inherited loan moves the buyer's price left once. Divide the bid by company size and round down: pay that amount per long share and charge it per short share. Return the target charter for future IPOs.
· In liquidation, combine target cash and the bid to repay all loans. The president pays any deficit. Only a surplus is distributed per share to longs and charged to shorts. Without a bidder, remove the assets. The bank covers deficits for companies without a solvent president.
· All tokens transfer in mergers and acquisitions. Return duplicate tokens in one hex to treasury. If the total exceeds eight, the president chooses up to eight distinct occupied hexes first; remaining unused tokens fill the allotment to eight. Discard excess trains immediately.
Cash crises and ending:
When personal cash cannot cover short dividends, liquidation debt, or company interest, sell legally available shares one at a time without changing any presidency. If no legal sale remains and the debt is unpaid, the investor goes bankrupt. Transfer shares, shorts, and privates to the market and liquidate companies they preside over. The bank cancels matching longs and shorts immediately, and buys treasury shares at the start of each stock round to close remaining bank shorts.
After the first 8-train is bought or exported, complete three more operating rounds and intervening M&A rounds. If triggered in the first operating round of a set, finish that set, play a stock round, then a final two operating rounds. If triggered in the second, play a stock round and then a final set of three operating rounds without an extra stock round inside it.
Variants:
· Increased shorts: allow ten shorts in a 10-share company.
· Short squeeze: at stock round end, more than 100% held by investors moves the price right twice.
· Modern trains: a 7- or 8-train earns an additional $10 or $20 per company station token on its route.
This implementation uses base v1.0 rules and excludes Volatility and other map variants.

zh.name: 黑桃大牌客
zh.desc: 以扑克组合迎战西部亡灵，积累能力，单人或双人合作闯过十二场决斗。
zh.rules:
目标：
连续击败12名敌人，最终战胜50点生命的屠戮领主。单人独自挑战，双人共同胜败。
准备：
将52张扑克牌洗混，组成牌堆，并将Joker暂时放在一旁。每组敌人随机抽1张，最终领主按难度选定。单人游戏抽取8张起始手牌；双人游戏中，每人各持5张私有牌，桌面另有3张公共牌，随机决定先手。
流程：
每回合可以先换牌、重整牌堆或使用已获得的一次性能力，然后打出一手牌。正常必须提交5张物理牌，选择其中的计分组合；其余牌不增加伤害。可以主动申报较低牌型，例如将两对中的一对计分。每次出牌消耗1次出牌机会。
基础伤害按所申报的计分牌型确定：
· 对子造成1点基础伤害。
· 两对造成2点基础伤害。
· 三条造成3点基础伤害。
· 顺子造成4点基础伤害。
· 同花造成5点基础伤害。
· 葫芦造成6点基础伤害。
· 四条造成8点基础伤害。
· 同花顺造成10点基础伤害。
· 五条造成12点基础伤害。

计分组合中，每张J、Q或K额外造成1点伤害，每张A额外造成3点伤害。只有计分牌享受加成。顺子允许A2345或10JQKA，不允许从K接A再接2；计算改点数效果时A为1、J为11、Q为12、K为13。

出过的牌进入弃牌堆，单人手牌补到8张；双人将出牌者的手牌补到5张，公共牌补到3张。牌堆不足时只抽剩余牌，不自动洗牌。
换牌与重整：
花费1次换牌机会，弃掉自己手牌及公共牌中的任意张牌，再补足相应区域；手牌不足时也可以不弃牌直接补牌。也可以花费1次换牌，将弃牌与剩余牌堆混洗；重整不包括手牌，也不会立即补牌。
没有换牌机会且所有可用牌无法组成任何计分组合时，可以提交5张牌进行一次零伤害的卡壳出牌，仍消耗出牌机会并补牌。无法继续时可以认输。
敌人与能力：
击败随从后获得其一次性能力，使用后移除；击败场景头目后获得永久能力。能力可以组合使用。修改点数或花色的效果只持续到下一次出牌，弃牌后恢复原状。点击能力牌查看当前效果并选择目标；特殊弃抽能力只作用于自己的手牌。
头目的禁用点数或花色限制适用于全部提交牌；牌型免疫使该次伤害为0。永久牌型加成只适用于指定牌型，不会叠加到包含它的较高组合。地狱牛仔提供一张虚拟复制牌，用它和提交的物理牌组成计分组合，虚拟牌不进入牌堆。
约翰的Joker必须在对新敌人打出第一手之前取得，用过后移出游戏；手牌已满时，选择自己的一张牌放到牌堆底，为Joker留出位置。其他Joker能力按卡牌说明将它放入弃牌堆或洗入牌堆；莎伦还要消耗另一张一次性能力，加里还要花费1次换牌。
场景：
每3名敌人构成一个场景。每名新敌人重置出牌和换牌次数；各场景中，每名敌人对应的出牌和换牌次数如下：
· 第一场景：2次出牌机会和2次换牌机会。
· 第二场景：3次出牌机会和2次换牌机会。
· 第三场景：3次出牌机会和3次换牌机会。
· 第四场景：4次出牌机会和4次换牌机会。
击败场景头目后，所有手牌、公共牌、剩余牌堆及弃牌重新混洗、发牌；能力保留。
双人合作：
双方严格轮流出一手牌，无论是否击败敌人。换牌与出牌次数共享，能力也共享。可以使用公共牌，但不能将公共牌换到自己手中。不能透露具体手牌、牌型或伤害数值，可以模糊沟通并讨论公共牌。
难度与领主：
· 简单：只需打出组成计分牌型所需的牌，不必补足5张；领主没有额外条件。
· 普通：领主战中至少一手计分组合必须含黑桃A，该牌随后留在领主处，不进入弃牌。可以用Joker或能力组成黑桃A。
· 困难：不能浏览弃牌堆；击杀领主的最后一手计分组合必须含黑桃A，可以使用Joker或改牌。
· 噩梦：不能浏览弃牌堆，每个敌人的换牌次数额外减少1；击杀领主的最后一手必须使用原生黑桃A，不能用其他牌变成黑桃A代替。
绞刑者能力允许在取回弃牌的当下，临时查看弃牌；选完后重新隐藏。领主条件尚未满足时，攻击和直接伤害最多将其生命降到1。
结束与成就：
敌人仍然存活且出牌机会耗尽时，全队失败；战胜领主则全队获胜。终局列出本局达成的规则书成就。原规则另有发布游玩照片、在现实歌曲结束前击败领主的线下挑战，由玩家自行记录。

en.name: Ace of Spades
en.desc: Fight twelve undead duels with poker hands and earned powers, solo or in two-player co-op.
en.rules:
Goal:
Defeat all 12 enemies and the final 50-life Lord Overkill. In co-op, both players win or lose together.
Setup:
Shuffle 52 poker cards; set the Joker aside. Randomly select one enemy from each group and the Lord matching your difficulty. Solo: draw 8 cards. Co-op: deal 5 private cards each and 3 shared face-up cards; choose the starting player randomly.
Your turn:
You may discard, renew the deck, and use earned one-use powers before playing a hand. Normally submit 5 physical cards and choose which cards form the scoring combination. Fillers add no damage. You may declare a lower combination, such as a single pair from two pair. Each hand spends one Hand.
The declared scoring combination determines the base damage:
· A pair deals 1 base damage.
· Two pair deals 2 base damage.
· Three of a kind deals 3 base damage.
· A straight deals 4 base damage.
· A flush deals 5 base damage.
· A full house deals 6 base damage.
· Four of a kind deals 8 base damage.
· A straight flush deals 10 base damage.
· Five of a kind deals 12 base damage.

Each scoring J, Q, or K adds 1 damage; each scoring Ace adds 3. Only scoring cards receive bonuses. Straights may use A2345 or 10JQKA, but cannot wrap K-A-2. For rank changes, Ace is 1, Jack 11, Queen 12, King 13.

Discard played cards and refill your hand to 8 in solo. In co-op refill the acting player's hand to 5 and shared cards to 3. Draw only the remaining cards if the deck runs out; never shuffle automatically.
Discard and renew:
Spend one Discard to discard any number of your own or shared cards, then refill those areas. With an undersized hand you may discard zero cards to refill. Alternatively, spend one Discard to shuffle the discard pile into the remaining deck. Renewing excludes held cards and does not immediately draw cards.
With no Discards and no scoring combination available, you may submit 5 cards for a zero-damage jammed-gun hand, still spending a Hand and drawing replacements. You may concede when you cannot continue.
Enemies and powers:
Defeated Goons grant one-use powers; defeated scene Villains grant permanent bonuses. Powers may combine. Rank and suit changes last until your next played hand; discarded cards revert to their printed identity. Select a power card and its targets. Special discard-and-draw powers affect only your private hand.
A Villain's banned ranks or suits apply to every submitted card. An immune combination deals zero damage. Permanent combination bonuses apply only to the named combination, not higher combinations containing it. Cowboy from Hell adds a virtual duplicate for scoring alongside submitted physical cards; the duplicate never enters the deck.
John adds the Joker before the first hand against a new enemy and removes it from the game after use. If your hand is full, return one private card to the bottom of the deck to make room. Other Joker powers place it in the discard pile or shuffle it into the deck; Sharon consumes another one-use power and Gary spends a Discard.
Scenes:
Each scene has 3 enemies. Hands and Discards reset for every new enemy. The allowance per enemy is:
· Scene one: 2 Hands and 2 Discards.
· Scene two: 3 Hands and 2 Discards.
· Scene three: 3 Hands and 3 Discards.
· Scene four: 4 Hands and 4 Discards.
After a scene Villain, shuffle all private hands, shared cards, remaining deck, and discards together and redeal. Keep earned powers.
Cooperative play:
Alternate exactly one played hand, even after a kill. Share Hand and Discard counters and all powers. You may use shared cards but cannot exchange them with private cards. Do not reveal specific private cards, combinations, or damage numbers; vague discussion and discussion of shared cards are allowed.
Difficulty and Lord Overkill:
· Easy: submit only the cards required for the scoring combination; do not fill to 5. The Lord has no extra requirement.
· Normal: at least one scoring hand against the Lord must contain the Ace of Spades. Leave that card on the Lord instead of discarding it. The Joker or a power may represent it.
· Hard: do not inspect the discard pile. Your killing scoring hand against the Lord must contain the Ace of Spades; the Joker and powers are allowed.
· Nightmare: do not inspect discards and subtract 1 Discard for every enemy. The killing hand must contain the original Ace of Spades; another card cannot replace it.
Hangman temporarily allows the acting player to inspect discards only while retrieving a card. If the Lord's requirement is unmet, attacks and direct damage can reduce him only to 1 life.
End and achievements:
If an enemy survives when Hands reach zero, the team loses. Defeat the Lord to win. The result shows achievements earned in this match. The original photo-sharing and real-song speed challenges are tracked by players offline.

zh.name: 并购
zh.desc: 建设酒店集团，争夺股权，在并购中积累财富
zh.rules:
目标：
终局时，现金最多的玩家获胜；现金数量相同时，共享胜利。
准备：
使用经典九行、十二列版图、108 块地块与七家酒店集团，每家公司有 25 股。每人获得 $6,000 和六块私有地块。每人先抽一块地块放在对应坐标，字母优先、数字次之，最靠近 1A 的玩家先手，其余按座位顺序行动。初始相连地块仍为独立地块，直到后续放置将其纳入集团。开局可选择资产公开或隐藏，地块手牌始终私有。
流程：
每回合先放置一块手牌地块，处理成立、扩张或并购，再合计购买至多三股，最后补一块地块。即使没有现金，仍然可以放置地块。股票只能向银行购买，不得向玩家交易、借款或随时卖出。
放置与成立：
地块必须放在自身坐标，只有上下左右相邻才相连。连接至少两块独立地块时，选择一家未在场的集团成立，并领取一股创始奖励。该公司股票售罄时没有创始奖励。地块连接一家集团时，连通的独立地块一并加入该集团。七家集团均在场时，不能放置会成立第八家集团的地块；这种暂时不可用的地块不能替换。
安全集团与废块：
集团达到 11 格后成为安全集团，不能被吞并。会连接两家或更多安全集团的地块永久不可用。正常补牌后，可以选择丢弃任意数量的永久废块，并从剩余牌库补回等量地块；每回合只能替换一次，新抽到的废块须等下回合。牌库不足时仅补现有地块。全部手牌均不可放置时可以跳过放置，仍可购股与替换永久废块。
并购：
连接两家以上集团时，并购前规模最大的集团存续；触发并购的地块不计入规模，同规模由发起者选择。被并购集团按并购前规模从大到小逐家处理，同规模顺序由发起者选择。每家先公开所有玩家对该公司的持股并发放奖金，再从发起者开始按座位顺序处置股票。
股东奖金：
第一大股东奖金为并购前股价的十倍，第二大股东奖金为五倍。根据持股情况分配奖金：
· 只有一名股东时，该股东领取两份奖金。
· 第一大股东并列时，将两份奖金合并，由并列者均分；不再发放第二大股东奖金。
· 第二大股东并列时，由并列者均分第二大股东奖金。
分得的奖金向上取整到 $100，无股票者不参与。存续集团不发并购奖金。
处置股票：
被并购股票可以组合选择保留、按并购前股价卖回银行，或每两股换一股存续集团的股票。换股受银行库存限制，先行动者先获得股票。保留的股票可在同名集团重新成立后恢复价值；不能出售其他在场公司的股票。
购股与价格：
每回合合计可以购买零至三股股票；只能购买当前在版图上的公司的股票，且购买数量不得超过银行库存和自己的支付能力。公司按以下价格档位分类：
· 高塔和卢克索属于低价档。
· 美国、环球和庆典属于中价档。
· 帝国和大陆属于高价档。
低价档公司的每股价格取决于集团规模，具体如下：
· 规模为2格时，每股价格为$200。
· 规模为3格时，每股价格为$300。
· 规模为4格时，每股价格为$400。
· 规模为5格时，每股价格为$500。
· 规模为6至10格时，每股价格为$600。
· 规模为11至20格时，每股价格为$700。
· 规模为21至30格时，每股价格为$800。
· 规模为31至40格时，每股价格为$900。
· 规模达到41格或更多时，每股价格为$1,000。
同等规模下，中价档的每股价格在上述价格基础上增加$100，高价档增加$200。界面直接显示现价、规模、库存和本人持股。
结束：
任一集团达到 41 格，或至少一家集团在场且所有在场集团均安全时，当前玩家可在放置前、购股时或废块替换时宣布结束，也可继续游戏。宣布后照常完成本回合，再为每家在场集团发放第一、第二股东奖金，按现价出售所有在场集团股票。不在场公司的股票价值为零。现金最多者获胜。

en.name: Acquire
en.desc: Build hotel chains, compete for shares, and profit from mergers
en.rules:
Goal: finish with the most cash. Tied players share the victory.
Setup: use the classic 9×12 board, 108 tiles and seven hotel chains with 25 shares each. Each player starts with $6,000 and six private tiles. Each player first draws and places a starting tile. Compare letters first, then numbers; the tile closest to 1A determines the first player. Play continues in seating order. Connected starting tiles remain independent until a later placement incorporates them. Assets may be open or hidden; tile hands are always private.
Turn: place one tile, resolve founding, expansion or mergers, buy a total of up to three shares, then draw one replacement tile. A player without cash still places tiles. Shares are bought only from the bank. Player trades, loans and selling active shares during normal play are not allowed.
Placement and founding: place a tile only at its matching coordinate. Only orthogonal adjacency counts. Joining at least two independent tiles founds an available chain and awards one free founder share. If no shares remain, there is no founder reward. Connecting one chain incorporates all connected independent tiles. If all seven chains are active, a tile that would found an eighth cannot be played or exchanged as a permanently unplayable tile.
Safe chains and replacement: chains of at least 11 tiles are safe and cannot be acquired. A tile joining two or more safe chains is permanently unplayable. After the normal draw, you may discard any of your permanently unplayable tiles and draw the same number, limited by the remaining pool. This exchange is allowed only once per turn; newly drawn unplayable tiles must wait. If no hand tile can be played, skip placement but still buy shares and optionally replace permanently unplayable tiles.
Mergers: the largest chain before placement survives; the merging tile does not count toward chain size. The mergemaker chooses between tied largest chains. Acquired chains are resolved individually from largest to smallest, with ties ordered by the mergemaker. For each acquired chain, reveal everyone's holdings and pay bonuses, then dispose of shares starting with the mergemaker and proceeding in seating order.
Bonuses: the primary bonus is ten times the acquired chain's pre-merger stock price; the secondary bonus is five times that price. Distribute them according to the holdings:
· A sole stockholder receives both bonuses.
· Tied primary stockholders split both bonuses. No secondary bonus is paid separately.
· Tied secondary stockholders split the secondary bonus.
Round each split payment up to the next $100. Zero shares never qualify. The surviving chain pays no merger bonus.
Disposal: combine keeping acquired shares, selling them at their pre-merger price, and trading two for one share of the surviving chain. Exchanges are limited by bank supply and resolved in turn order. Kept shares may regain value if the same chain is founded again. Shares of other active chains cannot be sold.
Buying and prices: buy zero to three shares in total from active chains, within your cash and the bank's supply. The chains fall into these price tiers:
· Tower and Luxor are low tier.
· American, Worldwide and Festival are middle tier.
· Imperial and Continental are high tier.
For a low-tier chain, the price per share depends on its size:
· At 2 tiles, each share costs $200.
· At 3 tiles, each share costs $300.
· At 4 tiles, each share costs $400.
· At 5 tiles, each share costs $500.
· At 6–10 tiles, each share costs $600.
· At 11–20 tiles, each share costs $700.
· At 21–30 tiles, each share costs $800.
· At 31–40 tiles, each share costs $900.
· At 41 or more tiles, each share costs $1,000.
For the same chain size, add $100 per share for middle tier and $200 for high tier. The bank shows each chain's current size, price, supply and your holdings.
End: when any chain reaches 41 tiles, or at least one chain is active and all active chains are safe, the current player may declare the game over before placement, while buying, or while replacing tiles. Declaring is optional. Finish that turn normally, pay primary and secondary bonuses for every active chain, then sell all active shares at current prices. Inactive shares are worthless. Most cash wins.

zh.name: 农场主
zh.desc: 14 回合经营你的农庄:派家人干活、建房围牧场、犁田播种、养牲畜、生养孩子,别让全家挨饿
zh.rules:
目标:14 回合后,农场经营得分最高者获胜。
准备:
· 每人获得2间木屋、2名家人，以及职业卡和发展卡各7张。起始玩家获得2份[icon:food|食物]，其他玩家各获得3份。
· 14 张阶段卡按阶段洗混,每回合开始翻开一张新行动格。
流程:
· 每回合轮流向空行动格放置 1 名家人并执行该格,直到所有人放完;所有家人在下一回合才返回个人供应区。
· 累积格上的资源（如[icon:wood|木头]）每回合增加。选择该行动格时，拿取其中的全部资源，将该格清空。
· 通过扩建房屋、建造畜棚、围建牧场饲养动物，以及犁田、播种和收获，发展自己的农场。
收获(第 4/7/9/11/13/14 回合末):
· 从每块田收获1份作物，放入个人供给。每种至少拥有2只的动物繁殖1只。
· 每名家人需要消耗2份[icon:food|食物](当轮新生儿只需消耗1份);无法获得足够食物的家人须领取乞讨牌,每张扣 3 分。
计分:
· 田地、牧场、[icon:grain|谷物]、[icon:veg|蔬菜]、三种牲畜([icon:sheep|绵羊]、[icon:boar|野猪]、[icon:cattle|牛])按数量阶梯计分,某项数量为0时，该项扣除1分。
· 每间黏土房获得1分，每间石房获得2分，每名家人获得3分；每个未使用的农场格扣除1分。
· 加上发展卡与职业卡面分值,总分相同时，剩余建材总量较多的玩家获胜。
单人：起始不获得[icon:food|食物]，按两人规则进行。
· 每名成年家人在每次收获时需要消耗3份[icon:food|食物]。
· 森林每回合只增加2份[icon:wood|木头]。
· 流动卡打出后，移出游戏。

en.name: Agricola
en.desc: Run your farm over 14 rounds: send workers out, build rooms and pastures, plow and sow, breed animals — and keep everyone fed
en.rules:
Goal: after 14 rounds, the most valuable farm wins.
Setup:
· Each player starts with 2 wooden rooms, 2 workers, and 7 each of Occupation and Minor Improvement cards; the starting player receives 2 [icon:food|food], and every other player receives 3 [icon:food|food].
· The 14 stage cards are shuffled within their stages; one new action space is revealed each round.
Flow:
· Take turns placing 1 worker on an empty action space and resolving it, until everyone is out of workers.
· Goods ([icon:wood|wood] and the like) accumulate on their spaces each round; taking them empties the space.
· Extend your farm with rooms and stables, fence pastures for animals, plow fields, sow and harvest.
Harvest (end of rounds 4/7/9/11/13/14):
· Collect 1 crop from each field. Each animal type with at least 2 animals produces 1 offspring.
· Feed 2 [icon:food|food] per worker (1 per newborn); unfed workers take begging cards, losing 3 points each.
Scoring:
· Fields, pastures, [icon:grain|grain], [icon:veg|vegetables] and the three animals ([icon:sheep|sheep], [icon:boar|boars], [icon:cattle|cattle]) score on tiered tables; a category at zero loses 1 point.
· 1 point per clay room, 2 per stone room, 3 per person; each unused farm space loses 1 point.
· Add card points. The player with the most points wins; break ties by remaining building resources.
Solo: start with 0 [icon:food|food] and play by the 2-player rules.
· Adults eat 3 food per harvest, the Forest accumulates only 2 [icon:wood|wood] per round; traveling cards are removed from play after use.

zh.name: 鹅膏菌
zh.desc: 推断六种蘑菇的秘密属性,采对蘑菇、避开毒菇
zh.rules:
目标:三轮结束后,凭收集的圆片获得最多胜利分;毒菇太多会被淘汰。
准备:
· 六种颜色的蘑菇各秘密对应一个属性,开局无人知道对应关系。
· 每人从起始牌三种颜色对应的牌叠各抽一张线索牌,洗混后查看。
· 本局使用六个属性,毒菇与解药必定入选。
· 森林板块数量比玩家人数多一块。
流程:
· 每轮开始:每块森林板块放圆片,第一至三轮分别放 4、5、6 个。
· 进入森林：从先手开始轮流放置米宝,共两轮;在空板块上须放在左侧位置；板块已有一名玩家时，须放在右侧位置。
· 放到右格时,立即把该板块的圆片分成两堆,两堆各至少一个。
· 同一玩家的两个米宝不能放在同一块板块。
· 采集：从最左侧的森林板块开始，逐块结算。板块上有两名玩家时，左侧位置的玩家先选择一堆圆片，右侧位置的玩家获得另一堆。
· 只有一人时,该玩家自选两个圆片拿走,其余圆片放回袋中；没有玩家的板块上的圆片全部放回袋中。
· 领取线索：第一、二轮结束后,从回合顺序中的末位玩家开始，每名玩家依次把笔记标记放到一张蘑菇卡上,抽一张线索牌。
· 两人局每张蘑菇卡只有一个笔记格。
· 第三轮结束后直接结算,不再领取线索。
猪:每收集一个猪圆片,立即从自己已收集的圆片中弃掉一个蘑菇圆片。
结算:
· 毒菇数量多于解药加灵药之和,或梯度菇达到四个,立即淘汰。
· 毒菇与解药或灵药配对,每对获得5分;解药与灵药自动成对,每对扣除3分。
其余属性按卡面计分：
· 对子菇：恰好有两个时，获得8分。
· 多数菇：数量最多的玩家获得10分，数量次多的玩家获得4分。
· 每个猪圆片获得3分;平分时蘑菇圆片总数最少者获胜,若仍然相同，则共享胜利。

en.name: Amanite
en.desc: Deduce the secret attribute of each mushroom color and gather the right ones
en.rules:
Goal: after three rounds, score the most victory points from collected tokens; too many Poison mushrooms means elimination.
Setup:
· Each of the six mushroom colors secretly matches one attribute; nobody knows the mapping.
· Each player draws one hint card from each deck of the three colors on their Start card, shuffles them, then looks.
· Six attributes are used; Poison and Antidote are always included.
· There is one more Forest tile than players.
Play:
· At the start of each round, place tokens on every Forest tile: 4, 5, then 6 in rounds 1-3.
· Venture: take turns placing meeples for two passes; an empty tile takes the left space, an occupied tile the right.
· Placing on the right space immediately splits that tile's tokens into two piles of at least one.
· Your two meeples can never share the same tile.
· Gathering: resolve Forest tiles from left to right. With two meeples on a tile, the player on the left chooses one pile, and the player on the right takes the other.
· With one meeple, that player takes exactly two tokens of their choice and the rest return to the bag.
· Hints: after rounds one and two, from last in turn order each player places a Notebook token on a Mushroom card and draws a hint.
· With two players, each Mushroom card has only one Notebook space.
· No hints are collected after round three; the game ends instead.
Pigs: for each Pig token collected, immediately discard one Mushroom token from your collection.
Scoring:
· More Poison than Antidote plus Elixir, or four of the gradient mushroom, means elimination.
· Each Poison paired with an Antidote or Elixir scores 5; each Antidote-Elixir pair costs 3.
Score remaining attributes as printed:
· The pair mushroom scores 8 points if you have exactly two.
· For the majority mushroom, the player with the most scores 10 points, and the player with the second-most scores 4 points.
· Each Pig token scores 3; ties go to the fewest Mushroom tokens, further ties share the win.

zh.name: 我的书香地
zh.desc: 整理书堆，补充社交电量，再去村庄寻找更多好书。
zh.rules:
你喜欢好书，也珍惜在家整理藏书的安静时光。你要在公寓中完成小项目，补充社交电量，再去村庄带回书籍与物品。终局分数最高者获胜。

准备：
每位玩家获得一间公寓、12 本初始书和 5 张小项目，并选择保留 3 张项目。按座次分别以 3、4、5、6 点社交电量开始。书店的三层书架分别有 3、2、1 本随机书及一张公开项目；商店展示两件物品，另有三张公共大成就。

公寓与书堆：
公寓共有四行四列，分为卧室、书房、浴室和厨房。卧室上方靠右的一格是床头柜。每格最多放 6 本书；一格仅有一本书时称为独本，至少有 3 本时称为高堆。书堆里的颜色顺序有意义。台灯和书挡不算书，不占高度；它们位于书堆上方，不妨碍拿取下方顶书。

回合：
轮到你时，必须移动到一个不同的行动位置并执行其行动。在公寓中获得电量，在村庄中支付电量；电量最多储存 20 点。行动及附带选择结束后，你可以使用尚未翻面的物品、领取满足条件的大成就，然后结束回合。你不能进入别人的公寓。

家中行动：
· 集中：获得 1 点电量。从最多 6 个不同书堆中各拿一本顶书，以任意顺序叠放到同一格，最终不得超过 6 本。台灯与书挡也可以一并移动。
· 整理：获得 1 点电量。拿起整堆书，以任意顺序逐本放到任意格，包括原格。每个落点最多放入两本书，最终每堆不超过 6 本；台灯和书挡不占两本额度。
· 阅读：获得 2 点电量。从任意一堆的任意深度拿一本书，放到床头柜顶端，仍遵守高度上限。
· 休息：获得 2 点电量，并摸 2 张项目；若手中超过 5 张项目，弃至 5 张。其他行动获得项目不会自动触发这个手牌上限。
· 欣赏：先检查角色偏爱的颜色。若该颜色在家中的数量最多，包含并列最多，获得 3 点电量。然后展示当前布局已经完成的小项目并逐张领取奖励：每张通常获得 3 点电量，或盲抽一张物品。完成的项目放入计分堆，每张终局计 2 分；书籍不消耗。项目所说的书只计算公寓中的书，不含背包。紫色万能书在每次欣赏时分别指定颜色，回合结束后恢复为紫色。
· 出门：支付 5 点电量，太阳前进一格，立即在同一回合执行一次村庄行动，并支付该行动的费用。

村庄行动：
村庄的位置由所有人共享。你可以选择别人所在的位置，将对方挤到公园，对方获得 2 点电量。你不能主动前往公园。
· 二手书店：按三层书架当前书量从少到多，分别支付 1、3 或 6 点电量，获得该架全部书和项目。随后补一张项目，并给每个书架各加一本随机书。书量相同时按书架从左到右定价。四人局有左右两个独立位置，左边只能拿左架或中架，右边只能拿右架或中架；不能在连续回合从一个书店位置移到另一个。
· 图书馆：一至三人局支付 1 点电量，随机摸 4 本书并保留 1 本；四人局支付 2 点，摸 5 本并保留 2 本。其余三本打乱后，分别放到三个书架上。
· 村庄商店：支付 4 点电量购买一件展示物品，或支付 9 点购买两件；也可以支付 3 点盲抽一件。购买展示物品后，将剩余展示物品弃掉，再展示两件；盲抽不会刷新展示。物品立即归你所有，并执行获得时能力。
· 换书处：支付 1 点电量。将床头柜中任意数量的普通书退回袋中，包括零本；再取回退还数量加一本的自选颜色书，放进背包。紫色万能书不能换出。

背包与回家：
新获得的一批书可以任意排序，分放在背包的两个书堆顶端；每堆最多 6 本，满溢的书退回袋中。放好后不能重新排列，后续得到的书只能加在顶端。
若在村庄开始回合，可以选择回家。先将背包的两堆书各自完整放到公寓中的格子上；不能拆堆或改变顺序，每处仍不得超过 6 本。然后立即执行一个家中行动。若没有合法卸载位置，就不能回家。

物品与大成就：
点击物品可以查看完整能力。标明翻面使用的物品整局限用一次；翻面后仍计分。小项目以当前布局判定，不消耗书。大成就一旦满足便可领取，不消耗行动；首位完成者获得较高分，其后完成者获得较低分，资源奖励相同，每位玩家每张成就只能领取一次。书挡在每次欣赏中至多提供一次奖励，且须有完成项目使用它所在的书堆。仅要求无书或没有某色的项目不触发书挡。

结束与计分：
太阳轨道有八格。单人及两人局从第三格、三人局从第一格、四人局从起点出发；到达第八格后完成当前轮，确保每人行动次数相同，然后每人再进行最后一个回合。
· 公寓和背包中的每本书计 1 分。
· 计分堆中的每张项目计 2 分。
· 按物品卡和已领取大成就计分。
· 每剩余 4 点电量计 1 分。
分数相同时，藏书更多者获胜；仍相同则共同获胜。

单人模式：Penelope
选择难度一至五，分别使用 A–J、B–K、C–L、D–M、E–N 的十张对手牌。你先手并以 3 点电量开始，太阳使用两人起点。每次你的回合结束后，Penelope 抽一张对手牌加入队列，按新牌上对应队列张数的区间行动：1–3、4–5、6–7 或至少 8 张。
· 她在图书馆获得一本随机书，并给每架补一本；在书店获得指定书架的全部书和项目，再正常补架；商店按牌说明拿取或弃掉物品；咖啡馆没有基础收益。
· 她到公园时，再将一张对手牌加入队列，但不执行新牌。你把她挤到公园时也如此。她可以将你挤到公园，你照常获得奖励。
· 你完成项目时，将队列中带有该项目所提及任一颜色的对手牌移回牌库并洗混；无色项目对应无色牌。角色偏好奖励与拼图直接计分不会移除对手牌。
· 每完成一个大成就，你选择一种颜色或无色，移回对应牌。
· 她每本书计 1 分，每张项目计 2 分，物品只计印分，问号一律按 3 分计算，不执行能力。
当她必须抽牌但牌库已空时，你立即落败。正常终局时，你的分数不少于她便获胜。

可选官方附加内容：
收藏徽章与感谢信默认关闭。开启收藏徽章后，加入六张徽章；拥有 1、2、3、4 张以上时整组分别计 2、6、12、20 分。开启感谢信后，加入该物品：你领取大成就时，你获得 3 点电量，其他每位玩家各获得 1 点；终局每个已完成大成就额外计 1 分。桌游物品也按 1、2、3、4 张以上整组计 2、6、12、20 分。

en.name: A Place for All My Books
en.desc: Arrange your books, recharge your social battery, and visit the village for more.
en.rules:
Collect, arrange, and admire good books in your apartment. Complete little projects to recharge your social battery, then visit the village for books and useful items. The highest final score wins.

Setup:
Each player receives an apartment, 12 starting books, and 5 projects, keeping 3 projects. Starting battery is 3, 4, 5, and 6 in turn order. The bookstore shelves begin with 3, 2, and 1 random books and one project each. Display two shop items and three major accomplishments.

Your apartment:
The 4×4 apartment is divided into the bedroom, den, bath, and kitchen. The upper-right bedroom space is the nightstand. Each space holds at most 6 books. A single book alone is lonesome; a stack of at least 3 books is tall. The order of colors matters. The lamp and bookends are not books, do not count toward height, and do not obstruct gathering the top book beneath them.

Your turn:
Move to a different action space and resolve its action. Apartment actions restore battery; village actions cost battery. You can store at most 20 battery. After resolving the action and its choices, you may use unflipped items and claim achieved accomplishments, then end your turn. You cannot enter another player’s apartment.

Apartment actions:
· Gather: Gain 1 battery. Take one top book from up to 6 different stacks and put them onto a single space in any order, respecting the height limit. You may also move the lamp and bookends.
· Sort: Gain 1 battery. Pick up one entire stack and distribute its books in any order onto any spaces, including the original space. Add at most 2 books to each destination; each finished stack may contain at most 6 books. The lamp and bookends do not count against the two-book allowance.
· Read: Gain 2 battery. Move one book from any depth in any stack onto the nightstand, respecting its height limit.
· Rest: Gain 2 battery and draw 2 projects. If you then hold more than 5 projects, discard down to 5. Gaining projects through other actions does not automatically impose this hand limit.
· Admire: First gain 3 battery if your character’s preferred color is the most common in your home, including a tie. Reveal achieved projects and resolve their rewards one at a time: usually 3 battery, or a blind-drawn item. Score each completed project for 2 points at game end; books are not spent. Projects count apartment books, excluding the backpack. Choose each wild book’s color for this Admire action; it returns to purple at the end of your turn.
· Leave the house: Pay 5 battery, advance the sun one space, then immediately take a village action in the same turn, paying its cost too.

Village actions:
Village spaces are shared. Entering an occupied space nudges its occupant to the park, granting that player 2 battery. You cannot visit the park voluntarily.
· Used bookstore: Pay 1, 3, or 6 battery for the smallest, middle, or largest shelf respectively. Take all books and the project from that shelf. Replace its project and add one random book to each shelf. Break equal-size shelf ties from left to right. With four players, the left bookstore space accesses the left or middle shelf, and the right space accesses the right or middle shelf. You cannot move between bookstore spaces on consecutive turns.
· Library: With one to three players, pay 1 battery, draw 4 random books, and keep 1. With four players, pay 2 battery, draw 5, and keep 2. Shuffle the remaining three and add one to each shelf.
· Village shops: Pay 4 battery for one displayed item, 9 for both, or 3 for one blind draw. After purchasing displayed items, discard the remaining display and reveal two new items. Blind draws do not refresh the display. Items and their acquisition effects apply immediately.
· Exchange: Pay 1 battery. Return any number of ordinary books from the nightstand to the bag, including zero, then take that many books plus one in colors of your choice. Put the new books in your backpack. Purple wild books cannot be exchanged.

Backpack and coming home:
Arrange a newly acquired batch of books in any order across the tops of your two backpack stacks. Each stack holds at most 6 books; return excess books to the bag. Once placed, they cannot be rearranged, and later books go on top.
If you begin your turn in the village, you may return home. First unload each entire backpack stack onto an apartment space, without dividing or reordering it and without exceeding the height limit. Then immediately take an apartment action. You cannot return if there is no legal way to unload.

Items and accomplishments:
Select an item to read its full ability. Flip abilities may be used once per game; flipped items still score. Projects use the current arrangement and do not spend books. Claim an achieved major accomplishment without spending an action. The first claimant earns its larger score; later claimants earn the smaller score, with the same resource reward. Each player may claim each card once. Bookends grant at most one bonus per Admire action when a completed project uses their stack. Pure absence conditions do not trigger them.

Game end and scoring:
The sun track has eight spaces. Start at space three with one or two players, space one with three players, or the starting position with four players. When the sun reaches space eight, finish the current round so everyone has equal turns, then play one additional final turn each.
· Score 1 point for every book in your apartment and backpack.
· Score 2 points for each project in your scoring pile.
· Score your items and claimed major accomplishments.
· Score 1 point per 4 remaining battery.
Break tied scores by most books. Share victory if still tied.

Solo: Penelope
Difficulty levels one through five use A–J, B–K, C–L, D–M, or E–N respectively, shuffling the ten cards. You start with 3 battery and the two-player sun position. After each of your turns, Penelope draws a Rival card into her queue. Resolve the newly drawn card using the queue-size band: 1–3, 4–5, 6–7, or 8+.
· At the library, she gains a random book and adds one to each shelf. At the bookstore, she takes all books and the project from the indicated shelf, then restocks normally. Shops follow the card’s instruction; the café has no base effect.
· At the park, add one more Rival card to the queue without resolving it. This also happens when you nudge her there. If she nudges you, gain the usual park reward.
· When you complete a project, remove all queued Rival cards showing any color mentioned by that project and shuffle them into her deck. Colorless projects remove colorless Rivals. Character bonuses and projects scored with the jigsaw puzzle do not remove Rivals.
· Each major accomplishment lets you choose a color, or colorless, to remove matching Rivals.
· She scores 1 point per book, 2 per project, and printed item points. A question mark is always 3 points. She ignores item abilities and project rewards.
You lose immediately if she must draw a Rival card but her deck is empty. At a normal ending, match or exceed her score to win.

Optional official extras:
Collectible Pin Cards and Thank You Notes are off by default. Pins add six cards; a set of 1/2/3/4 or more scores 2/6/12/20 points in total. Thank You Notes adds its item: when you claim an accomplishment, gain 3 battery and give every other player 1 battery, and score 1 extra point per accomplishment claimed. Board-game items likewise score 2/6/12/20 for a set of 1/2/3/4 or more.

zh.name: Apocalypse
zh.desc: 翻转灾厄封印，避开罚分；三轮吃墩，最低分获胜
zh.rules:
目标：
进行三轮，累计分最低者获胜；最低分并列者共享胜利。
准备：
· 骑士牌分五种花色，每色各有1、2、3、4、6、7、8、9、10。三或四人使用四色，五或六人使用五色，对应的灾厄标记均从彩色面开始。
· 3人游戏每人发10张骑士牌，4人或5人游戏每人发8张，6人游戏每人发7张；每人另获得1张混沌牌和1张宁静牌；余牌本轮不用。首轮默认随机领出，可在设置中改为主机领出。
出牌：
· 从领出者开始顺时针出牌。第一张骑士牌决定本墩花色；有该花色时必须跟色，也可以出特殊牌；没有该花色时可出任意牌。
· 同一墩最多出现一张混沌和一张宁静。没有合法牌时必须跳过，不能自愿跳过。
· 骑士牌将本花色灾厄标记翻至黑面，已经翻黑的不变。混沌必须选择一个仍为彩色面的标记翻黑；全部已黑时不再翻标记。宁静不翻标记。
· 混沌始终视为本墩花色、数值为5；宁静无花色、无数值，不能赢墩。
结算：
· 普通墩：本墩花色中数值最大的牌获胜，赢家只收取自己打出的牌，其余弃置。
· 当所有灾厄标记都翻黑时，当前墩立即变为灾厄墩。本墩花色中数值最小的牌获胜，并收取所有已出的牌。该墩结算后，所有标记翻回彩色面。
· 每墩赢家指定下一墩领出者，可以指定自己。极端情况下，整墩仅有宁静和跳过，没有赢家；所有牌弃置，由本墩领出者指定下一位。
轮末：
· 当前墩结算后，若有人没有手牌，本轮立即结束。收取的骑士牌按面值计分，混沌计5分，宁静计0分；每张未打出的特殊牌另罚20分。
· 每轮之间重新洗混并发放手牌，但不重置灾厄标记。累计分最高者指定下一轮领出者；最高分并列时由最后实际赢墩者指定。若本轮尚无实际赢墩者，则由本轮最初的领出者指定。
双人变体：
· 使用三色共27张骑士牌，加混沌、宁静各3张，全部混洗，各发13张，余牌不用。相同特殊牌仍须遵守每墩各类型最多一张。
· 每轮分别计算得分和未打特殊牌罚分后，若一人的本轮分严格超过对手的两倍，两人互换本轮分再加入累计分；恰好两倍不交换。其他规则相同。

en.name: Apocalypse
en.desc: Turn the seals, avoid the points. Three rounds of perilous trick-taking.
en.rules:
Objective:
Play three rounds. The lowest total wins; tied players share victory.
Setup:
· Five Horseman suits each contain 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8, 9 and 10. Use four suits with three or four players, and five suits with five or six. Matching Apocalypse tokens start coloured side up.
· Deal 10 Horseman cards per player with three players, 8 per player with four or five players, or 7 per player with six players. Each player also receives one Chaos and one Tranquility. Set unused cards aside. The first leader is random by default; host lead is available in settings.
Playing:
· Starting with the leader, play clockwise. The first Horseman card determines the leading suit. Follow that suit if possible, or play a Special card. If void in the suit, play any card.
· At most one Chaos and one Tranquility may appear in a trick. Pass only if you have no legal card.
· A Horseman turns its matching token black. A token already black stays black. Chaos must turn one remaining coloured token black; if all are black, it turns none. Tranquility turns no token.
· Chaos always belongs to the leading suit and has value 5. Tranquility has no suit or value and cannot win.
Resolution:
· Regular trick: the highest card of the leading suit wins. The winner keeps only their own played card; discard all others.
· When all tokens are black, the current trick immediately becomes an Apocalypse: the lowest card of the leading suit wins and takes every played card. Reset all tokens to coloured after resolving it.
· The winner chooses who leads next and may choose themselves. In the rare case where only Tranquility and passes appear, nobody wins; discard the cards and let the previous leader choose the next leader.
Scoring:
· End the round after resolving a trick if any hand is empty. Captured Horsemen score face value, Chaos scores 5, Tranquility scores 0. Each unplayed Special card adds 20 points.
· Redeal between rounds but do not reset tokens. The highest cumulative scorer chooses the next round leader; if tied, the last actual trick winner chooses. If none exists, use the previous round leader.
Duel variant:
· Shuffle three suits (27 Horsemen), three Chaos and three Tranquility. Deal 13 cards each and set the rest aside. The one-per-type limit still applies.
· After adding captured points and unplayed-Special penalties, if one player scored strictly more than twice the other, swap their round scores before adding them to totals. Exactly twice does not swap. All other rules apply.

zh.name: 镜中解
zh.desc: 转动观测仪，推理失落城市的建筑布局。
zh.rules:
目标：
推理5行5列城市地图中六块建筑的位置和朝向。建筑只能旋转，不能翻面；共占22格，剩余3格为空地。

准备：
选择基础版28张题卡之一或随机题卡。普通模式提供3、4或5条陷阱坐标；单人固定3条。专家模式为每张题卡提供12套起始条件。所有玩家获得相同起始信息，各自保留私有地图与问答记录。

回合：
时间轨最落后的玩家行动，可能连续行动。每次前进时跳过其他仍在游戏中的玩家占据的格子，不消耗步数。

提问：
每次先将观测标记顺时针免费移动1步；额外移动1步需要支付1点时间，移到任意其他轴需要支付2点时间。顺时针顺序为1、E、4、C、2、A、5、D、3、B。选择一个观测轴和一种问题后，支付相应的时间费用：
· 询问空地数量或不同建筑的数量，需要支付1点时间。
· 询问陷阱符号或三格建筑的符号，需要支付2点时间。
· 询问四格建筑的符号，需要支付3点时间。
问题公开，答案仅提问者可见；答案只提供符号及各自数量，不透露沿轴的位置。历史答案可免费查看。

摆放：
选择建筑，再选择合法落点；旋转工具位于所选建筑旁。可在等待他人行动时整理自己的地图和笔记。

宣布解谜：
在自己回合开始时，完整摆放六块建筑后支付4点时间，冻结提交地图。不移动观测标记，也不提问。等时间轨再次轮到自己时验证。正确则立即获胜。App规则下，错误建筑会被标明，玩家立即再行动一次；实体规则下，猜错者退出，其余玩家继续。所有人退出则无人获胜。

单人：
从时间0开始，可在设置中选择初始观测轴。每次答案含有一个火焰或尖刺符号，观测标记额外顺时针移动1步。完成时按官方App的题目时间标准获得大师、熟练或学徒评价。

en.name: ArcheOlogic
en.desc: Turn the Archeoscope and deduce the lost city.
en.rules:
Goal: Discover the positions and orientations of six buildings on a 5×5 map. Buildings may rotate but never flip. They occupy 22 cells, leaving 3 empty zones.
Setup: Choose one of 28 base-game cards or a random card. Normal mode provides 3,4 or 5 trap coordinates; solo always uses 3. Expert mode offers 12 clue sets per card. Everyone receives the same starting information and keeps a private map and answer history.
Turns: The player furthest behind on the time track acts, sometimes repeatedly. Skip spaces occupied by other active players without spending movement.
Questions: First move the viewfinder one step clockwise for free. One further step costs 1 time; any other axis costs 2. The clockwise order is 1,E,4,C,2,A,5,D,3,B. Choose an axis and a question, then pay its time cost:
· Asking about empty zones or the number of distinct buildings costs 1 time.
· Asking about trap symbols or the symbols of a three-cell building costs 2 time.
· Asking about the symbols of a four-cell building costs 3 time.
 The question is public and the answer private. Symbols and their counts do not reveal positions along the axis. Revisit previous answers for free.
Placement: Select a building, then a legal origin cell. Its rotation tool stays beside it. Rearrange your map and notes while other players act.
Declare: At the start of your turn, place all six buildings and spend 4 time to submit and freeze your map. Do not move the viewfinder or ask a question. Check when the time track next reaches you. A correct map wins immediately. Under app rules, incorrect buildings are marked and you immediately take another turn. Under physical rules, an incorrect guess eliminates you; others continue. If everyone is eliminated, nobody wins.
Solo: Start at time 0 and choose the starting axis in settings. For each fire or sharp trap symbol in an answer, move the viewfinder one extra step clockwise. Finish within the official app thresholds to become a Master, Seasoned or Apprentice Archaeologist.

zh.name: 西国建筑师
zh.desc: 集结工人、雇佣学徒，在美德与利益之间建造王国。
zh.rules:
游戏目标：
你们是九世纪西国的皇家建筑师。通过建造建筑、推进大教堂和保持美德来获得分数。游戏结束时总分最高者获胜；平分时依次比较美德和剩余银币，仍相同则共享胜利。
准备：
· 每人获得二十名工人，并从 7 点美德开始。随机起始玩家获得 3 枚银币，后续玩家依次多获得 1 枚。
· 每人获得四张建筑牌。所有人各保留一张，其余传给左手玩家。重复选择三轮，最后一张放回牌堆底；手牌始终保密。
· 展示两行、每行四张学徒牌；税务所放入 4 枚银币。奖励牌数量为玩家数的两倍再加一张。
回合与工人：
轮到你时，将供应区的一名工人放入一个地点，执行该地点的行动。通常，同一地点自己的工人越多，行动越强；其他人的工人不影响你的行动强度。若回合开始时没有可用工人，整个回合只能从普通地点收回自己的一名工人；不能从行会、黑市、监狱或其他玩家的扣押区收回。
· 森林每名己方工人获得 1 份木材；采石场每名己方工人获得 1 份石料。
· 矿场选择获得己方工人数加一份黏土，或每两名己方工人获得 1 份黄金。不能同时选择两种资源。
· 银匠铺获得己方工人数加一枚银币。
· 国王仓库每名己方工人提供一次交易。每次可将任意两份木材、石料或黏土换为 1 点美德，或将任意三份木材、石料换为 1 份大理石。相关学徒提供额外交易选项。
· 工坊可以雇佣一名学徒，或抽取建筑牌。雇佣基础费用为 4 枚银币，其中 2 枚为税。己方工人数决定能选择的列数；每多跨越一列，必须从该行最左边开始，在一张被跳过的学徒上放置 1 枚银币。雇佣时一并获得该牌上的银币，随后该行向左补齐。每人最多五名学徒，可以在自己的行动中解雇学徒。选择建筑图纸时，抽取一张牌，并且每两名己方工人额外抽取一张。回合结束时最多保留六张建筑手牌，超出的牌自行选择，放回牌堆底。
抓捕、监狱与税收：
· 市镇中心每名己方工人可以抓捕一个普通地点中的一组同色工人，每组支付 1 枚银币，第一次抓捕的费用为税。二至三人及单人对局最多涉及两个地点，四至五人对局只能涉及一个地点。可以抓捕包括新放工人在内的己方工人，这些工人直接回到自己的供应区；其他人的工人则留在自己的扣押区。不能抓捕行会、黑市、监狱或扣押区的工人。
· 前往税务所可以拿走其中全部银币，并失去 2 点美德；没有税银时不能前往。
卫所每名己方工人提供一次行动。你可以按任意顺序重复选择以下四种行动：
· 将自己扣押的全部工人送入监狱，每送入一名工人，获得 1 枚银币。
· 释放自己的全部在押工人，让他们回到自己的供应区。
· 支付 5 枚银币，其中 2 枚为税，赎回自己全部被其他玩家扣押的工人，并放回自己的供应区。你也可以改为承担一笔债务并失去 1 点美德。至少有一名工人被其他玩家扣押时，才可以选择此行动。
· 支付 6 枚银币，其中 3 枚为税，偿还一笔债务。保留已偿债务牌，并获得 1 点美德。
红色银币为税，支付到税务所，其余银币回到供应区。美德为 2 或 3 点时，每笔费用少缴纳 1 枚税银；美德为 0 或 1 点时少缴纳 2 枚税银。
建造与美德：
· 前往行会大厅后，选择建造一张手牌，或推进大教堂。放入行会的工人永久留在那里。
· 建造建筑时支付牌上的全部资源，并拥有每种所需技能的至少一名学徒。学徒不会消耗。执行建筑的即时美德和能力；标为终局的能力在游戏结束时结算。
· 大教堂每次推进一层，并弃置一张建筑手牌。五层费用依次为：1 份黄金；任意四份木材和石料；1 份大理石；任意八份木材和石料；2 份黄金和 2 份大理石。各层容量从低到高为三人、两人、两人、两人、一人。美德不高于 4 点时不能推进。每次推进获得一张奖励牌；奖励用尽时改为获得 1 点美德。五层终局分依次为 2、4、7、12、20 分。
· 美德最高为 14 点；超出的每点美德可以销毁一笔未偿债务，销毁不视为偿还。美德最低为 0 点；每少于 0 的一点，获得一笔未偿债务。美德达到 10 点时不能进入黑市。
黑市与清查：
黑市三个位置各只能容纳一名工人。支付费用并失去 1 点美德后，小黑市花费 1 枚银币，获得展示的小批资源；中黑市花费 2 枚银币，免费雇佣任意公开学徒，或抽五张建筑牌保留一张；大黑市花费 3 枚银币，获得展示的大批资源。
当三个黑市位置都被占据，或行会第三、第四行的首个位置被占据时，在当前行动完成后依次清查：
· 将全部黑市工人送入监狱。
· 将小黑市顶牌翻到大黑市上，更新两边资源。小牌堆用尽时，将可回收的黑市牌重新洗混。
· 玩家按自己选择的顺序结算清查类学徒能力。
· 至少有三名工人在押的玩家各失去 1 点美德。
· 在押工人最多的玩家各获得一笔未偿债务；并列者全部获得，没有人在押时不获得债务。
游戏结束与计分：
二至五人分别完成 12、16、20、24 项行会建设后触发结束。触发者完成回合后，每个人，包括触发者，再进行最后一个回合；仍可以继续在行会建设。先自行安排各建筑的终局效果，再合计：
· 建筑印刷分和附加分，以及大教堂分数。
· 美德 0 至 14 点分别计为 −9、−8、−7、−5、−3、−1、0、0、0、0、1、2、3、5、7 分。
· 每笔未偿债务扣除 2 分，除非建筑修改该值。
· 每份黄金和大理石各获得 1 分，每持有十枚银币，计为 1 分；每两名在押工人扣除 1 分。
角色与单人对局：
角色能力选项随机分配基础版五名角色，改变初始资源和能力；由初始美德最高者先行动。角色详情可点击自己的角色查看。基础版的完整建筑与学徒效果可以在牌面详情中查看。
单人对局自动加入君士坦丁或海伦娜，使用二人行会与五张奖励牌。移除四张资源市场建筑，自己从五张牌中保留三张，之后总是先行动。对手通过二十张起始谋略牌行动，并逐步加入十张未来谋略牌；不使用银币、普通资源、学徒和建筑，建造大教堂无需支付费用，其余行动按谋略牌处理。对手可以不受美德限制进入黑市和推进大教堂。对手用完工人时，收回除行会和黑市以外的所有工人，并将弃置谋略牌洗回抽牌堆。本人的计分不变；对手计算大教堂、美德、大理石、债务和监狱分数，君士坦丁每名行会工人额外获得 1 分，海伦娜每名行会工人额外获得 3 分。

en.name: Architects of the West Kingdom
en.desc: Gather workers and hire apprentices to build a kingdom while balancing virtue and ambition.
en.rules:
Objective:
As royal architects in the ninth century, construct buildings, advance the Cathedral and manage your Virtue. The highest final score wins. Break ties by higher Virtue, then remaining Silver; otherwise share victory.
Setup:
· Each player starts with twenty workers and 7 Virtue. Randomly choose a starting player, who receives 3 Silver; each subsequent player receives one more Silver.
· Deal four buildings to each player. Everyone keeps one and passes the rest left. Repeat for three selections, returning the last card to the bottom of the deck. Building hands remain private.
· Reveal eight apprentices in two rows of four. Place 4 Silver in the Tax Stand. Use two reward cards per player, plus one.
Turns and workers:
On your turn, place one available worker at a location and take its action. Your own workers at that location determine its strength; opponents’ workers do not. If you start with no available workers, spend the entire turn recovering one worker from a normal location. You cannot recover from the Guildhall, Black Market, Prison or an opponent’s board this way.
· The Forest grants 1 Wood per own worker. The Quarry grants 1 Stone per own worker.
· At the Mines, gain Clay equal to your worker count plus one, or 1 Gold per two workers. You cannot split the action between both resources.
· The Silversmith grants Silver equal to your worker count plus one.
· At the King’s Storehouse, take one trade per own worker. Trade any two Wood, Stone or Clay for 1 Virtue, or any three Wood or Stone for 1 Marble. Apprentices can provide additional trades.
· At the Workshop, hire one apprentice or draw building plans. Hiring costs 4 Silver, including 2 Tax. Your worker count determines how many columns you can reach. To reach one additional column, place 1 Silver on a skipped apprentice, beginning at the left of its row. Collect any Silver on the hired card, then slide that row left and refill it. You may have five apprentices and can dismiss them during your actions. Drawing plans grants one building card, plus another per two own workers. At the end of your turn, choose buildings to discard to the bottom of the deck until you hold at most six.
Captures, Prison and Tax:
· At the Town Centre, each own worker allows you to capture one group of a single colour from a normal location for 1 Silver. The first capture is taxed. In solo and two- or three-player games, use up to two locations; with four or five players, use only one. You may capture your own workers, including the one just placed, returning them to your supply. Opponents’ workers stay captured on your board. Never capture from the Guildhall, Black Market, Prison or another player’s board.
· At the Tax Stand, take all its Silver and lose 2 Virtue. You cannot visit when it is empty.
At the Guardhouse, take one action per own worker. You may repeat the following four actions in any order:
· Send all workers you have captured to Prison. Gain 1 Silver for each worker sent.
· Release all your imprisoned workers to your supply.
· Pay 5 Silver, including 2 Tax, to return all your workers captured by opponents to your supply. Instead of paying Silver, you may take one debt and lose 1 Virtue. You may choose this action only if an opponent holds at least one of your workers.
· Pay 6 Silver, including 3 Tax, to pay one debt. Retain the paid debt card and gain 1 Virtue.
Red coins are Tax and go to the Tax Stand. Other Silver returns to the supply. At 2 or 3 Virtue, ignore 1 Tax per cost. At 0 or 1 Virtue, ignore 2 Tax.
Construction and Virtue:
· At the Guildhall, construct a building from your hand or advance the Cathedral. Workers placed here remain for the rest of the game.
· Pay the building’s resources and have at least one apprentice matching each required skill. Apprentices are not spent. Resolve immediate Virtue and effects now; end-game abilities resolve before final scoring.
· Advancing the Cathedral requires discarding one building card and paying for the next level. The five costs are: 1 Gold; any four Wood and Stone; 1 Marble; any eight Wood and Stone; 2 Gold and 2 Marble. Level capacities from bottom to top are three, two, two, two and one players. You need at least 5 Virtue. Gain a reward card on each advancement, or 1 Virtue if none remain. Levels score 2, 4, 7, 12 and 20 VP.
· Virtue ranges from 0 to 14. Each Virtue gained above 14 may destroy an unpaid debt; destroying is not paying. Each Virtue lost below 0 adds an unpaid debt. At 10 or more Virtue, you cannot visit the Black Market.
Black Market and resets:
Each of the three Black Market spaces holds one worker. Lose 1 Virtue and pay the indicated cost: the Small Market costs 1 Silver for the displayed small resources; the Middle Market costs 2 Silver to hire any face-up apprentice for free, or draw five buildings and keep one; the Large Market costs 3 Silver for its displayed resources.
After all three spaces become occupied, or a worker occupies the first space of the third or fourth Guildhall row, finish the current action and resolve a Black Market Reset:
· Send every Black Market worker to Prison.
· Flip the top Small Market card onto the Large Market to update both offers. Reshuffle recyclable market cards when needed.
· Resolve each player’s reset apprentices in their chosen order.
· Every player with at least three imprisoned workers loses 1 Virtue.
· Every player tied for the most imprisoned workers takes one debt. If no workers are imprisoned, nobody takes a debt.
End and scoring:
The Guildhall holds 12, 16, 20 or 24 constructions with two, three, four or five players. When it fills, finish the current turn, then everyone, including the triggering player, takes one final turn. More Guildhall constructions are still allowed. Resolve end-game building effects in your chosen order, then score:
· Printed building VP and bonuses, plus Cathedral VP.
· Virtue levels 0 through 14 score −9, −8, −7, −5, −3, −1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 2, 3, 5 and 7 VP.
· Lose 2 VP per unpaid debt, unless a building changes this penalty.
· Score 1 VP per Gold and per Marble, 1 VP per ten Silver, and lose 1 VP per two imprisoned workers.
Variable boards and solo:
The variable option randomly assigns the five base-game player boards, changing starting resources and abilities. The player with the highest initial Virtue starts. Inspect your role for its full ability. Building and apprentice details show their full effects.
A solo game automatically adds Constantine or Helena, using the two-player Guildhall and five rewards. Remove the four resource-market buildings. Keep three of five starting buildings and always take the first turn. The opponent follows twenty starting schemes and gradually adds ten future schemes. It does not use Silver, normal resources, apprentices or buildings, and builds the Cathedral for free. Other actions follow its schemes. It can visit the Black Market and Cathedral regardless of Virtue. When it runs out of workers, it recovers all workers except those in the Guildhall and Black Market, and shuffles discarded schemes into its draw pile. Score yourself normally. The opponent scores Cathedral, Virtue, Marble, debts and Prison, plus 1 VP per Guildhall worker for Constantine, or 3 VP for Helena.

zh.name: 星弧航记 · Arcs
zh.desc: 驾驭手牌、争夺星域，以野心塑造银河。可选领袖与传说，以及三幕战役《荒芜星域》。
zh.rules:
胜利与章节：
基础版至多进行5章，章末为已宣布的野心计分。任意玩家达到对应人数的权势门槛，或完成第5章后，游戏结束：
· 两人对局的权势门槛为33。
· 三人对局的权势门槛为30。
· 四人对局的权势门槛为27。
权势最高的玩家获胜；平局按当前回合顺序决定。

行动牌与先手：
每章每人抽 6 张行动牌。两人局的非先手玩家每章可以重抽一次；战役重抽保留事件牌，只更换其他牌。先手领出一张牌，按该牌花色执行其行动点数允许的行动。随后每人依次出牌，并选择下列一种方式：
· 超越须打同花色且强度更高的牌，获得所出牌的全部行动点。
· 转向打不同花色的正面牌，只获得所出花色的 1 行动点。
· 模仿将任意牌背面打出，只获得领出花色的 1 行动点。
已获得的行动点可以不用。

轮末，以最高强度超越的玩家获得下轮先手；无人超越则原先手保留。出牌时可以额外将一张牌背面弃出，夺取先手；以强度 7 超越也可夺取。每轮只有第一次夺取有效，已有先手者不能夺取。没有行动牌或选择不出牌时放弃先手。全部玩家耗尽行动牌，或所有仍有行动牌的玩家连续放弃先手后结束本章。

宣布野心：
先手可以在任何行动，包括序幕行动之前，宣布所出牌强度对应的野心：2 富豪、3 暴君、4 军阀、5 守藏者、6 共感者。放置最高的可用野心标记，并将领出牌强度视为 0。强度 7 可以宣布任意野心，强度 1 不能宣布。能力可能修改这些限制。

花色与行动：
· 建设：建造、修复。
· 行政：征税、修复、影响。
· 动员：移动、影响。
· 侵略：战斗、移动、掌控。
建造：在己方星港建造 1 艘飞船，每座星港每回合只能建造 1 艘；在有己方棋件且有空建筑槽的星系建造城市或星港。对手控制的星系中，建造的棋件受损。城市来自玩家面板，腾出资源槽并可能增加野心计分奖励。修复：修复地图上任意 1 个受损的己方棋件。
移动：将一个星系的任意数量己方飞船移到相邻星系；从完好己方星港出发可连续弹射，须在星球或对手控制的星系停下。星门与本星区的 3 个星球及相邻星门连接；星球之间只有实际共有细边界时相邻。完整飞船数量严格多于每一名对手时控制该星系，受损飞船不提供控制。
征税：向一座己方城市或你控制的对手城市征税，获得 1 个该星球类型的资源；向对手城市征税另俘获其 1 名代理人。同一城市每回合通常只能征税一次。影响：从供应放置 1 名代理人在一张宫廷牌上。掌控：若你在该宫廷牌上的代理人严格最多，获得该牌；归还己方代理人并俘获其对手代理人。

序幕与资源：
出牌后、使用行动点前，可以支付资源或使用公会牌的序幕能力。
· 物资用于建造或修复。
· 燃料用于移动。
· 武器允许本回合战斗。
· 遗物用于掌控。
· 灵能用于复制领出牌花色的一次行动。
可以支付任意数量和组合的资源；支付武器只允许行动牌的行动点改为战斗，不能把其他资源的行动改为战斗。支付的资源在序幕结束时才归还供应，期间不能重新获得。资源须放在已开放的资源槽中，溢出时选择保留内容；钥匙数表示突袭窃取所需费用。激愤会使相应类型公会牌被弃置，并限制对应资源的序幕行动。

战斗：
选择有己方飞船的星系及一名防守者。按进攻飞船数量收集散兵、突击、突袭骰；突袭骰通常需要对方有建筑，你通常至少收集 1 颗散兵或突击骰。掷骰后按顺序处理自伤、一次拦截、飞船命中、建筑命中、突袭钥匙。完好棋件首次命中受损，再次命中被摧毁并成为战利品。拦截按完好的防守飞船对进攻者造成伤害。突袭钥匙用于窃取资源和公会牌。摧毁城市引发其类型的激愤；摧毁对手城市还可洗劫宫廷。所有伤害处理完毕后再结算激愤与洗劫。

野心计分：
· 富豪比较物资与燃料图标。
· 暴君比较俘虏。
· 军阀比较战利品。
· 守藏者比较遗物图标。
· 共感者比较灵能图标。
按各已宣布标记为第一、第二名结算权势。第一名并列时各得第二名权势；第二名并列不计分。独占第一名可按玩家面板已露出的奖励获得城市权势。两人局移出的 6 个资源构成虚拟第三家：物资和燃料计入富豪、武器计入军阀、遗物计入守藏者、灵能计入共感者。

领袖与传说：
此扩展默认关闭。开局公开比玩家多 1 张的领袖与传说，按官方蛇形顺序选择。领袖同时具有优势与限制；传说提供持续能力或新的行动。可在物件详情中查看完整效果。

荒芜星域战役：
此扩展默认关闭，与独立的领袖与传说模式互斥。战役连续进行三幕：第一、二幕各 3 章，第三幕最多 4 章；忽略基础版权势门槛。每幕暗选命运，全部选定后公开并布置。包含全部 24 个官方命运。目标进度降至 0 代表完成；第一、二幕失败时扣除剩余进度的权势，可为负值。间幕保留或更换命运、抽取下一组命运并按卡牌处理继承、移除和地图变化。
帝国棋件、摄政与首席摄政改变控制、移动和停战限制。掌控帝国议会后，轮末可以召开峰会，并处理危机或敕令。峰会可归还恩惠、请愿、退出或复兴帝国，也可拟定交换资源、棋件、代理人、俘虏、战利品、恩惠及其他允许条款的协议；只有必要参与者批准后执行。危机骰及命运规则可能生成荒芜、改变星球或触发特殊事件。法律、敕令、能力和目标的完整说明均可点开查看。
第三幕 A／B 命运按章节获得其宏图野心的额外计分；C 命运完成终极目标且至少有 1 权势时优先获胜。否则第三幕按权势决定胜者，平局先比较命运组 A、B、C，再按回合顺序。多个终极目标获胜者之间先比较权势，再按回合顺序。两人战役使用对应虚拟第三家资源及公会使节离去敕令。

en.name: Arcs
en.desc: Command your hand, contest the Reach, and pursue ambitions. Includes optional Leaders & Lore and the three-act Blighted Reach campaign.
en.rules:
Victory and chapters:
Play up to five chapters in the base game. Score declared ambitions at each chapter end. The game ends after chapter five or when a player reaches the Power threshold for the player count:
· With two players, the threshold is 33 Power.
· With three players, the threshold is 30 Power.
· With four players, the threshold is 27 Power.
The player with the most Power wins; break ties in current turn order.

Action cards and initiative:
Deal six action cards to each player each chapter. In a two-player game, the player without initiative may redraw once per chapter; in the campaign, keep Events and replace only other cards. The initiative holder leads a card and may take its number of action pips in its suit. Each other player then plays a card using one of these options:
· Surpass with a higher number in the lead suit to use all pips on your card.
· Pivot with another suit face up to take one action in that suit.
· Copy with any card face down to take one action in the lead suit.
You may leave pips unused.

At round end, the highest Surpass takes initiative; if nobody Surpassed, its holder keeps it. Before taking actions, you may play an extra card face down to seize initiative. Surpassing with a 7 also seizes it. Only the first seizure each round applies; the initiative holder cannot seize. Pass initiative if you cannot or choose not to lead. End the chapter when all hands are empty or all players with cards pass consecutively.

Declare an ambition:
Before taking any actions, including Prelude actions, the leader may declare the ambition matching the lead card: 2 Tycoon, 3 Tyrant, 4 Warlord, 5 Keeper, 6 Empath. Place the highest available ambition marker there and cover the lead number with zero. A 7 may declare any ambition; a 1 cannot declare. Abilities may change these rules.

Suits and actions:
· Construction: Build or Repair.
· Administration: Tax, Repair or Influence.
· Mobilization: Move or Influence.
· Aggression: Battle, Move or Secure.

Build one ship at a Loyal starport, limited to one ship per starport per turn; or place a city or starport in an empty building slot in a system with a Loyal piece. Pieces built in a Rival-controlled system are damaged. Take cities from the left of your player board, opening resource slots and possibly city Power bonuses. Repair one damaged Loyal piece anywhere on the map.

Move any number of Loyal ships from one system to an adjacent one. Moving from a fresh Loyal starport permits Catapult moves until entering a planet or a Rival-controlled system. Gates connect to their three planets and neighboring gates; planets connect only across a shared thin border. You control a system with strictly more fresh ships than every Rival; damaged ships do not contribute.

Tax a Loyal city or a Rival city you control for one resource of its type; taxing a Rival city also captures one of its agents. Normally a city can be taxed only once per turn. Influence places one agent from supply on a Court card. Secure a Court card with strictly more Loyal agents than each Rival; return Loyal agents and capture Rival agents there.

Prelude and resources:
After playing a card and before spending pips, spend resources or use Guild Prelude actions.
· Material gives Build or Repair.
· Fuel gives Move.
· Weapons let pips from this card play take Battle actions.
· Relics give Secure.
· Psionic gives an action listed on the lead card.
Spend any number and mix of resources. Weapons do not convert other resource actions into Battle. Spent resources return to supply only after the Prelude, so cannot be regained during it. Resources occupy open slots; choose what to keep if over capacity. Keys show raid cost. Outrage discards the relevant Guild cards and restricts normal Prelude spending of the relevant resource.

Battle:
Choose a system with Loyal ships and a defender. Collect skirmish, assault and raid dice up to your attacking ships. Raid dice normally require defending buildings; normally at least one die must be skirmish or assault. Resolve self-hits, one interception, ship hits, building hits, then raid keys. A fresh piece becomes damaged on its first hit and is destroyed on the next, becoming a Trophy. Interception hits the attacker for fresh defending ships. Raid keys steal resources and Guild cards. Destroying a city provokes its type of Outrage; destroying a Rival city also allows Ransacking the Court. Finish all hits before Outrage and Ransacking.

Ambition scoring:
· Tycoon counts Material and Fuel icons.
· Tyrant counts Captives.
· Warlord counts Trophies.
· Keeper counts Relic icons.
· Empath counts Psionic icons.
Each declared marker awards first- and second-place Power. Tied first places each receive second-place Power; tied second places receive none. A sole first place may gain exposed city bonuses. In two-player games, six resources removed from supply form a virtual third player: Material/Fuel count for Tycoon, Weapons for Warlord, Relics for Keeper, Psionic for Empath.

Leaders & Lore:
Off by default. Reveal one more Leader and Lore card than players and draft in the official snake order. Leaders have advantages and restrictions; Lore gives modifiers and new actions. Open each object to read its full effect.

The Blighted Reach:
Off by default and mutually exclusive with the standalone Leaders & Lore mode. Play three consecutive acts: three chapters each in Acts I–II and up to four in Act III, ignoring base-game Power thresholds. Choose Fates privately, then reveal together and set up. All 24 official Fates are included. Reach zero remaining progress to complete an objective. Failing in Acts I–II loses Power equal to remaining progress, potentially below zero. Intermissions keep or replace Fates, deal the next group, and resolve inheritance, removal and map changes as specified by the cards.

Imperial pieces, Regents and the First Regent modify control, movement and truce rules. After securing the Imperial Council, the round end may call a Summit and resolve Crises or Edicts. Summits allow calling in Favors, petitioning, leaving or reviving the Empire, and negotiating resources, pieces, agents, Captives, Trophies, Favors and other allowed terms. Required parties must approve a deal before execution. Crisis dice and Fate rules can spawn Blight, change planets or trigger events. Open Laws, Edicts, Abilities and Objectives for complete text.

In Act III, A/B Fates gain extra scoring through their grand ambitions by chapter. A C Fate that completes its objective with at least one Power wins ahead of ordinary victory. Otherwise most Power wins; break ties by Fate group A, then B, then C, then turn order. Between multiple ultimate-objective winners, compare Power then turn order. Two-player campaigns use the relevant virtual-third-player resources and Guild Envoys Depart Edict.
