zh.name: 方舟动物园
zh.desc: 规划动物园、引入动物并支持保育项目，包含海洋世界扩展
zh.rules:
游戏目标：
通过引入动物提高吸引力，通过支持保育项目提高保育分数。两条轨道相遇后，其他玩家各进行最后一个回合，再加上终局卡和赞助商的奖励计分。平分时，支持保育项目次数较多者获胜。
行动：
每回合使用一张行动卡，其位置决定强度。可以在开始行动前支付 X 标记，每枚增加 1 强度；使用后将行动卡移到位置 1。也可以选择任意行动卡，改为获得 1 枚 X 标记。X 标记最多保留 5 枚。
· 建造：支付每格 2 金钱，放置围栏、特殊饲养区、贩售亭或休憩亭。首次建筑须位于边界，其后须连接已有建筑。贩售亭之间至少相距 3 格。升级后允许一次建造多种不同建筑，并开放大型鸟舍、爬行馆及指定格。
· 动物：支付费用、满足条件并安排合适的围栏，随后获得动物的吸引力、图标与能力。升级后可直接打出声望范围内的市场动物，另付其文件夹编号的费用。
· 卡牌：先推进休息标记 2 格，然后依强度抽牌并按表弃牌，或在足够强度下从市场抓取一张牌。升级后抽牌可以从声望范围内的市场选择。市场在回合结束后补齐。
· 协会：派出协会工作人员，完成提升声望、取得合作动物园、取得大学或支持保育项目的工作。再次执行同一工作须使用两名工作人员；休息时全部召回。升级后可组合不同工作，并额外捐赠一次。
· 赞助商：依强度打出赞助商卡，或推进休息标记并取得金钱。升级后可以组合打出多张卡，也能直接打出声望范围内的市场赞助商卡。
休息：
休息标记到达终点时，完成整个回合后开始休息。先弃牌至手牌上限，移除行动卡上的标记，召回工作人员并补齐协会供应，弃置市场最左两张后补齐，再领取吸引力、贩售亭和其他收入。一般手牌上限为 3；指定大学将其提高至 5。
海洋世界：
海洋扩展开启时使用替换版卡牌及新增卡牌。海洋馆须连接水域。海洋动物可按其容量标记分配到一个或多个符合地形条件的海洋馆。珊瑚生物入园时，自己所有珊瑚生物的珊瑚能力均触发一次。补市场时每揭示一个波浪，额外弃置最左一张并补牌；开局忽略波浪。开局轮抽替代行动卡，每人使用两种不同的替代行动。新大学提供一种动物图标与研究图标，并寻找一张匹配的卡牌。
效果顺序：
同时获得的效果可以依允许的顺序结算。“行动完成后”的效果在行动卡移到位置 1 后处理。最终回合在休息期间触发时，所有玩家各再行动一次。

en.name: Ark Nova
en.desc: Build a zoo, introduce animals and support conservation, including Marine Worlds
en.rules:
Objective:
Increase appeal by introducing animals and gain conservation points by supporting projects. When the two tracks meet, the other players take one final turn. Add Final Scoring cards and sponsor bonuses. Most supported conservation projects breaks ties.
Actions:
Choose an action card; its slot determines its strength. Before starting, spend X-tokens to add 1 strength each. Move the used card to slot 1 after completing the action. Alternatively, use any card to gain 1 X-token. You may hold at most 5 X-tokens.
· Build: Pay 2 per hex for enclosures, special enclosures, kiosks or pavilions. Your first building must touch the border; later buildings must touch an existing building. Kiosks must be at least 3 hexes apart. Upgrading allows several different buildings per action, Large Bird Aviaries, Reptile Houses and marked spaces.
· Animals: Pay the price, meet conditions and choose a suitable enclosure. Gain appeal, icons and abilities. When upgraded, you may play animals from within reputation range, paying the folder number in addition.
· Cards: Advance the break token 2 spaces, then draw and discard as shown on the card, or snap from the display at sufficient strength. When upgraded, draws may come from within reputation range. Replenish the display after the entire turn.
· Association: Assign workers to gain reputation, partner zoos, universities or support conservation projects. Repeating a task requires 2 workers; recall workers during a break. Upgrading permits different tasks in one action and one additional donation.
· Sponsors: Play sponsors within your strength budget, or advance the break token and gain money. Upgrading permits multiple sponsors and play from within reputation range.
Breaks:
When the token reaches the end, finish the entire turn before taking a break. Discard to your hand limit, remove action-card tokens, recall workers and replenish the Association board, discard the first two display cards and refill, then take appeal, kiosk and other income. The normal hand limit is 3; the indicated university increases it to 5.
Marine Worlds:
Use replacement and additional cards when enabled. Aquariums must touch water. Sea-animal markers may be split among suitable aquariums, each meeting terrain requirements. Playing a Reef Dweller triggers all your Reef Dweller effects once. Each wave revealed when refilling the display discards the lowest card and causes another refill; ignore waves during setup. Draft two different variant actions at setup. New universities provide a research and an animal icon and find one matching card.
Effect order:
Resolve simultaneous effects in a permitted order of your choice. After-finishing effects resolve after moving the action card to slot 1. If the game end is triggered during a break, every player takes one final turn.

zh.name: 阿纳克遗迹
zh.desc: 探索失落岛屿，构筑考察牌库，揭开古文明的秘密
zh.rules:
目标：
带领考察队探索阿纳克，在五轮后获得最多分数。基础版包含鸟神庙、蛇神庙和单人对手。
准备：
每人有两名考古学家，起始牌库为两张资助、两张探索和两张恐惧。首轮每人抽取五张牌。按照行动顺序，各座位获得以下起始物资：
· 第一位获得两枚金币。
· 第二位获得一枚金币和一枚罗盘。
· 第三位获得两枚金币和一枚罗盘。
· 第四位获得一枚金币和两枚罗盘。
单人玩家使用第二位的起始物资，对手始终先行动。
回合：
每回合选择一项主行动：派遣考古学家、发现遗址、克服守护者、购买卡牌、打出一张有效果的牌、推进研究，或结束本轮行动。免费效果可在主行动前后及其中使用；主行动完成后点击结束回合。结束本轮后不再获得回合。
旅行与探索：
从手牌支付旅行符号；汽车和船只可代替步行，飞机可代替任何符号，汽车与船只不能互换。可以支付2枚金币购买一个飞机符号。同一张牌的剩余旅行符号仅在本回合有效。派遣考古学家到空位并激活地点；发现一级或二级遗址另外支付3枚或6枚罗盘。发现后获得神像、结算正面神像收益、激活遗址并放置守护者。遗址和神像收益可选择结算顺序。
守护者与神像：
克服自己考古学家所在遗址的守护者需要支付其费用。守护者值五分，恩赐一局可使用一次。轮末从仍有守护者的地点收回每名考古学家时各获得一张恐惧。神像各值三分；可将储备中的神像放入最左空槽作为免费行动，选择下列一种效果：
· 支付1枚金币，换取1颗宝石。
· 获得1枚箭头。
· 获得2块石板。
· 抽取1张牌。
· 升级1件资源。
空槽依次值一、二、三、四分。
卡牌与助手：
市场共六张牌，神器数量等于轮数。物品支付金币，购入后放自己牌堆底；神器支付罗盘，购入后放打出区并立即使用效果。以后从手牌打出神器需要另付一石板。市场在回合结束补满。恐惧不能打出效果，每张扣一分；恐惧牌供应耗尽时获得扣两分的恐惧板块。放逐可从手牌或打出区选择。付费箭头左侧必须支付，才能领取右侧收益。升级资源可将石板换为箭头，或箭头换为宝石。助手招募后可使用一次，轮末刷新；升级助手也会刷新。商人的购牌效果使用主行动，其他助手效果为免费行动。
研究：
支付连接路径上的费用，将放大镜或笔记本上移一层，结算对应行收益及尚存的抢先奖励。笔记本不能高于放大镜，不能进入失落神庙。放大镜抵达神庙依顺序获得二十三、二十一、二十、十九分，并私下从隐藏奖励堆选一枚；以后研究可改买神庙板块。蛇神庙跨桥需要移除一个未入槽神像；救助助手时可私下查看整堆并选一名，新助手为已使用状态。
轮末与结束：
全部玩家结束本轮后，先收回人物并获得恐惧，再选择保留或弃置剩余手牌。将打出区洗好放现有牌堆底，刷新助手，将月杖两侧各一张牌放逐，准备下一轮并补手牌至五张。轮中不会洗牌。第五轮只收回人物并结算恐惧，随后计分。
计分：
合计研究、神庙板块、神像、空神像槽、守护者和卡牌分数，再扣恐惧。总分相同则先抵达神庙者胜；无人抵达时比较研究分，仍同分则并列。
单人对手：
按难度零至五随机选择对应数量的红色行动牌，其余使用绿色。对手每轮执行十张行动牌，与你交替；它不收支资源、不获得恐惧。它会占位、发现、研究、克服和购买卡牌，并按行动堆箭头选择左右。绿色发现、研究、克服在第五轮不执行。对手的重复或背面神像各值两分。

en.name: Lost Ruins of Arnak
en.desc: Explore a lost island, build your expedition deck and uncover an ancient civilization
en.rules:
Goal:
Lead an expedition over five rounds and score the most points. The base game includes the Bird Temple, Snake Temple and solo rival.
Setup:
Each player has two archaeologists and a deck of two Funding, two Exploration and two Fear cards. Each player draws five cards. Starting supplies follow turn order:
· The first seat receives 2 coins.
· The second seat receives 1 coin and 1 compass.
· The third seat receives 2 coins and 1 compass.
· The fourth seat receives 1 coin and 2 compasses.
In solo play, use the second seat’s supplies; the rival always starts.
Turns:
Take one main action: deploy an archaeologist, discover a site, overcome a guardian, buy a card, play a card for its effect, research, or pass for the round. Free effects may be used before, during and after your main action. End your turn when finished. After passing, you take no more turns that round.
Travel and discovery:
Pay travel icons using cards from your hand. Cars and boats replace boots; airplanes replace any icon. Cars and boats cannot replace each other. You may pay 2 coins for an airplane. Unspent icons from the same card last only for this turn. Deploy to a vacant space and activate its site. Discovering a level I or II site also costs 3 or 6 compasses. Gain its idols, resolve the face-up idol benefit, activate the site and add a guardian. You may choose the order of the site and idol benefits.
Guardians and idols:
Pay the printed cost to overcome a guardian at a site with your archaeologist. Each is worth 5 VP and has a boon usable once per game. At round end, each archaeologist returning from a site with a guardian gains a Fear card. Each idol is worth 3 VP. As a free action, place a supply idol in your leftmost empty slot and choose one effect:
· Pay 1 coin to gain 1 jewel.
· Gain 1 arrowhead.
· Gain 2 tablets.
· Draw 1 card.
· Upgrade a resource.

Empty slots are worth 1, 2, 3 and 4 VP.
Cards and assistants:
The six-card market contains as many artifacts as the round number. Buy items with coins and put them on the bottom of your deck. Buy artifacts with compasses, put them in your play area and immediately use their effects. Playing an artifact from your hand later costs 1 tablet. Refill the market at turn end. Fear cannot be played for an effect and costs 1 VP; when the Fear supply is empty, gain a fear tile worth −2 VP. Exile from your hand or play area. Costs to the left of an arrow must be paid to gain its benefit. Upgrade a tablet to an arrowhead, or an arrowhead to a jewel. Recruited assistants are ready and exhaust after use. They refresh at round end and on promotion. The Trader uses a main action; other assistants are free actions.
Research:
Pay a connected path’s cost to move your magnifying glass or notebook up one row. Resolve that token’s row benefit and any remaining first-arrival bonus. Your notebook cannot pass your magnifying glass or enter the Lost Temple. Arrival at the temple scores 23, 21, 20 or 19 VP in order, and lets you privately choose one hidden bonus. Later research can buy temple tiles. On the Snake Temple bridge, remove an idol from your supply. When rescuing, privately inspect the stack and choose an exhausted assistant.
Round end:
After everyone passes, return archaeologists and gain Fear, then choose whether to keep or discard remaining hand cards. Shuffle your play area onto the bottom of your existing deck, refresh assistants, exile the cards beside the moon staff and draw back to five for the next round. Never shuffle during a round. After round V, only return archaeologists and gain Fear before scoring.
Scoring:
Add research, temple tiles, idols, empty idol slots, guardians and card VP; subtract Fear. Ties favor earlier temple arrival; if no one arrived, compare research scores. Remaining ties are shared.
Solo rival:
Difficulty 0–5 randomly selects that many red action tiles; use green for the others. The rival resolves ten tiles each round, alternating with you. It never gains or spends resources or takes Fear. It blocks sites, discovers, researches, overcomes and buys, using the stack’s decision arrow for left/right choices. Green discovery, research and guardian actions do nothing in round V. Duplicate and face-down rival idols score 2 VP each.

zh.name: 汽车
zh.desc: 构筑方块袋，规划赛车路线，管理车辆磨损
zh.rules:
目标:
· 完成指定圈数后，越过终点最远的车手获胜；同距时内侧车道优先。
准备:
· 随机决定首位车手，之后按固定座次行动。
· 每人获得 5 个三挡、2 个四挡和 5 个车库方块。
· 按起跑位置获得 10 至 14 元补贴，依次购买方块并放入袋中，然后每人抽取7个方块。
· 五种能力各选择1张能力卡，全体车手使用同一套能力与有限的公共库存。
流程:
· 行动阶段逐个使用可用方块，按能力选择目标，在赛道上标记路线。
· 挡位方块前进到对应颜色的相邻区块；允许向前斜行，不得穿过车辆。
· 双色区块允许对应的两种挡位进入，按较高颜色获得磨损。
· 粗线围成一个移动区块，内部小段用于车辆占位。
· 购买阶段将剩余可用方块的支付价值合计，购买的新方块放入已用区。
· 未使用的资金不保留；购买价格与支付价值分别以能力卡为准。
· 车辆阶段沿已标记的路线移动，再按经过的最高颜色区块获得磨损。
· 白、浅灰、深灰、黑色分别产生 1、2、3、4 个行驶磨损。
· 结束时直接跟在另一辆车后，可免除行驶磨损，能力产生的磨损仍保留。
· 回合结束，将可用区与已用区方块弃置，再抽取7个方块，作为下回合的可用方块。
· 需要抽取方块且袋中已经没有方块时，将弃置区的全部方块放回袋中；袋内方块不展示。
· 同一区块内的车辆会自动向前补齐空位。
进站:
· 尚未开始行动时，可以放弃本回合行驶与购买，移除可用区中的全部磨损方块。
· 移除的方块返回公共库存；进站后仍进行回合结束与抽取。
结束:
· 每次越过终点推进圈数标记；有人完成比赛后，打完当前轮再排名。
· 可用区、已用区与弃置区均为公开信息；能力详情见本局能力卡。

en.name: Automobiles
en.desc: Build your cube bag, plan racing lines, and manage wear
en.rules:
Goal:
· After the required laps, the car farthest beyond the line wins; ties favor the inside lane.
Setup:
· Randomly choose the first driver, then keep the same seat order.
· Each player starts with five 3rd Gear, two 4th Gear, and five Garage cubes.
· In grid order, spend a starting allowance of $10–14 on cubes, then draw seven each.
· Select one card for each ability color. All players share these abilities and limited stock.
Play:
· Use active cubes individually, resolve their abilities, and mark movement on the track.
· Gear cubes enter an adjacent space of their color. Forward diagonals are legal; cars block passage.
· Two-color spaces accept either matching gear and cause wear for the higher color.
· Bold lines enclose a movement space; smaller segments hold cars within that space.
· During Buy, total the value of remaining active cubes. Purchases go to the used pile.
· Unspent money expires. Purchase cost and spending value are separate amounts.
· During Car, follow the marked route, then gain wear for the highest track color used.
· White, light gray, dark gray, and black cause one, two, three, and four wear respectively.
· Finishing directly behind another car avoids driving wear, but not wear from abilities.
· End your turn by discarding active and used cubes, then drawing seven for your next turn.
· Refill an empty bag from discards only when a draw is required. Bag contents remain hidden.
· Cars automatically advance into vacant segments within their current space.
Pit Stop:
· Before taking actions, you may skip driving and buying to remove all active wear.
· Removed cubes return to stock. Still complete the End phase and draw cubes.
Finish:
· Advance the lap marker whenever you cross the line. Complete the round once someone finishes.
· Active, used, and discard piles are public. Consult the selected cards for ability details.

zh.name: 花砖物语
zh.desc: 工厂挑彩砖、砌花纹、铺宫墙,横竖连锁得分
zh.rules:
目标:有人在自己的墙上铺出一整行 5 块时游戏结束,总分最高者获胜。
流程(轮到你):
· 从一个工厂盘或中央区拿走某一色的全部砖;工厂盘里剩下的砖推到中央区。
· 每轮第一个从中央区拿砖的人,还须把先手标记放到地板上(占 1 格罚分),下轮由你先行动。
· 将拿到的瓷砖放入一条花纹行：该行必须为空，或已有瓷砖均为所选颜色；放入的数量不得超过容量，且对应墙面横行中不能已有该颜色。
· 放不下的瓷砖全部放入地板线。地板线从左至右的七个格子依次扣除1、1、2、2、2、3、3分。
铺墙:
· 所有工厂盘和中央区被拿空后,进入铺墙:每条摆满的花纹行移一块砖到墙上对应花色格,该花纹行剩余的瓷砖放回盒中。
· 新铺的砖按横、竖两个方向的连续砖数计分,两个方向都有就两份相加。
· 横竖都不挨其他砖的孤立砖计 1 分;地板按格子罚分,分数最多扣到 0,不会变负。
· 随后补满工厂盘开始下一轮;砖袋用尽后，将弃置的瓷砖混合后放回袋中。
终局计分：
· 每条完整的横行获得2分。
· 每条完整的纵列获得7分。
· 每种集齐5块的颜色获得10分。
总分相同时，完整横行数量较多的玩家获胜。若仍然相同，则共享胜利。

en.name: Azul
en.desc: Draft tiles, fill pattern lines, tile the wall — chain rows and columns
en.rules:
Goal: the game ends when someone completes a full row of 5 on their wall; the highest score wins.
On your turn:
· Take all tiles of one color from one factory display or the center; leftovers on a display are pushed to the center.
· The first player to take from the center each round must also place the starting-player marker onto their floor line (it costs a penalty slot) and goes first next round.
· Place the taken tiles on one pattern line: the line must be empty or hold only that color, have room, and its wall row must not already show that color.
· Place overflow tiles on the floor line. Its seven slots deduct 1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 3 and 3 points respectively, from left to right.
Wall-tiling:
· When every display and the center are empty, each full pattern line moves one tile onto its matching wall space; the rest are boxed.
· A new tile scores its horizontal and vertical runs (both count when both apply).
· A lone tile touching no other tile scores 1; floor tiles cost points, and scores stop at 0 and never go negative.
· Refill the displays and start a new round; when the bag runs out, shuffle the discards back into it.
Final scoring:
· Score 2 points for each full row.
· Score 7 points for each full column.
· Score 10 points for each completed color.
Ties go to the player with more full rows. If the tie remains, share victory.

zh.name: 熊熊公園
zh.desc: 拼接熊类栖地与绿地，争夺雕像，建设得分最高的熊公园。
zh.rules:
目标：建设得分最高的熊公园。每人从一张入口园区与一块绿地开始。每张园区有4行4列格子，并留有一个深坑。
回合流程：
· 从个人库存放置一块拼板。可旋转、翻转或跨越园区边界，不能出界、重叠或覆盖深坑。除第一块外，新拼板必须与已放置拼板正交相邻。
以任意顺序结算刚覆盖的图标，每个图标领取一次对应奖励：
· 独轮车：领取任意一块绿地。
· 搅拌车：领取任意一叠顶端的动物馆，或一块绿地。
· 挖掘机：领取任意一块围场、任意一叠顶端的动物馆，或一块绿地。
· 施工队：拿取两叠园区中任意一叠的顶牌，立即扩建。
· 每张刚铺满的园区（深坑除外）获得供应中分值最高的熊雕像，放在深坑内。同时完成多张园区时，每张各得一个。
· 若启用成就，领取所有本回合达成的成就的最高分牌。每人每种最多一张。最后结束回合。
扩建与供应：
新园区必须整边贴合已有园区、图标保持朝向，不能低于入口所在的一排。基础游戏最多4张园区。达到上限时施工队不再提供奖励。园区堆只公开顶牌。动物馆各类最高值在顶；围场全部可选。
开局绿地按照行动顺序发放：
· 2人时为厕所、游乐场。
· 3人时为厕所、游乐场、餐饮街。
· 4人时为厕所、游乐场、游乐场、餐饮街。
绿地供应包括10块厕所、10块游乐场，以及按每位玩家各4块准备的河流和餐饮街。
动物馆和雕像的供应分值根据人数调整：
· 两人对局：动物馆的分值为2、4、6分；雕像使用2至16分的偶数分值。
· 三人对局：动物馆的分值为2至6分；雕像的分值为3至14分。
· 四人对局：动物馆的分值为1至7分；雕像的分值为1至16分。
每种熊各有3块不同形状的五格围场，分值分别为6、7、8分。
无法放置：
只有个人库存没有任何可合法放置的拼板时，才必须跳过放置，并免费领取一块绿地。新领绿地只能下回合放置。库存数量没有上限。
终局与计分：
首位完成4张园区的玩家触发终局，其他人各进行最后一个回合。只计算公园内动物馆、围场、雕像和成就的分值。平分时比较库存拼板分值，仍平分则共同获胜。
成就（可选，默认关闭）：
随机选择3种成就，每叠最高分先领取；下列每组分值均按领取顺序由高到低列出。2人移除各叠最低分牌。
· 北极熊、戈壁熊、考拉、熊猫：放置该类熊的3块拼板时，达成该目标；奖励分值依次为8、5、2分。
· 动物馆：放置四种形状的动物馆各一块时，达成该目标；奖励分值依次为8、5、2分。
· 绿地：将6块绿地正交连接成一片时，达成该目标；奖励分值依次为9、6、3分。
· 围场：将3块围场正交连接成一片时，达成该目标；奖励分值依次为9、6、3分。
· 长餐饮街：将3块餐饮街沿同一直线首尾相接时，达成该目标；奖励分值依次为9、6、3分。
· 长河流：将3块河流的水道端点连续接通时，达成该目标；奖励分值依次为10、7、4分。
· 双喜临门：在同一回合获得至少2个雕像时，达成该目标；奖励分值依次为10、7、4分。
灰熊模块（默认关闭）：
公园扩大为5张园区。获取第5张时，从可见出口园区中选择，不能改拿普通园区，出口不能直接位于任何园区的下面。每回合开始或结束时，可进行一次交换：从库存永久移出一块绿地和一块动物馆，换取一块七格灰熊栖地。回合开始换来的灰熊可立即放置。灰熊共12块，分值7至10，每值3种不同形状。动物馆增加一层：2人增加8分；3人增加7分；4人增加8分。雕像的分值供应根据人数调整：
· 2人时，使用2至20分的偶数分值雕像。
· 3人时，雕像分值延伸至17分。
· 4人时，使用1至20分的雕像。
首位完成5张园区触发终局；无人能再推进时提前结束。
单轨模块（默认关闭）：
每放置一块绿地，可以立即在这块绿地的一格上放一座塔；放弃后不能补放。第一座塔的位置可以自由选择；此后的塔必须连接现有线路的端点，两塔同一行或列、坐标相距3格，中间正好2格。中间可跨空地或深坑。新塔必须立即连接供应中分值最高的列车；每名玩家各有10、8、6、5、4、3分的列车各一辆。每塔最多连接两车，且必须转90度；只能一条线路，不能闭环，每回合最多一塔一车。塔不计分，列车计分。两模块可组合，按灰熊模块终局。
新成就（可选，默认关闭）：
与基础成就混合随机选3种，不要求启用灰熊或单轨。
· 停工：放置围场且未覆盖任何图标时，达成该目标；奖励分值依次为8、5、2分。
· 围场规划：在同一回合实际领取至少2块围场时，达成该目标；奖励分值依次为8、5、2分。
· 遥远厕所：两块厕所之间的最短正交路径包含至少11个中间格时，达成该目标；奖励分值依次为8、5、2分。
· 餐饮街连接：餐饮街跨越至少3对不同相邻园区的公共边时，达成该目标；奖励分值依次为9、6、3分。
· 角落河流：至少3张园区各有一块河流同时覆盖角格及其相邻两格时，达成该目标；奖励分值依次为9、6、3分。
· 雕像游乐场：至少3个雕像分别与游乐场正交相邻时，达成该目标；奖励分值依次为9、6、3分。
启用任一扩展内容时，额外加入6块厕所，合计16块。
深坑变体（可选，默认关闭）：
终局触发后，其他玩家在自己的最后回合可以覆盖未放雕像的深坑；该园区完成后不再获得雕像。

en.name: Bärenpark
en.desc: Fit bear habitats and green areas into your park, race for statues, and score the most points.
en.rules:
Goal: build the highest-scoring bear park. Each player starts with an entrance area and one green tile. Every area has four rows and four columns, including a pit.
On your turn:
· Place one tile from your personal supply. Rotate or flip it freely. It may cross area boundaries, but cannot overlap tiles, leave the park, or cover a pit. Except for your first tile, it must touch a previously placed tile orthogonally.
Resolve all newly covered symbols in any order, gaining one matching reward per symbol:
· Wheelbarrow: take any green area.
· Cement truck: take a top animal house or any green area.
· Excavator: take any enclosure, a top animal house, or any green area.
· Construction crew: take the top park area from either stack and immediately add it to your park.
· Each newly completed area (all spaces except its pit covered) receives the highest remaining bear statue on its pit. Completing several areas grants one statue for each.
· With achievements enabled, claim the highest tile for each achievement met this turn. Each player may claim each type once. End your turn.
Expansion and supply:
New areas must share a complete edge with an existing area, remain upright, and cannot be below the entrance row. The base-game limit is four areas. Construction crews have no effect at the limit. Only the tops of park stacks are visible. Animal houses are taken highest value first; all enclosures are available.
Starting green tiles are dealt in turn order:
· 2 players: Toilet, Playground.
· 3 players: Toilet, Playground, Food Street.
· 4 players: Toilet, Playground, Playground, Food Street.
Supply: 10 Toilets, 10 Playgrounds, and four Rivers and Food Streets per player.
Animal-house and statue values depend on the player count:
· With two players, animal houses are worth 2, 4 and 6 points, and statues use even values from 2 to 16 points.
· With three players, animal houses are worth 2–6 points, and statues are worth 3–14 points.
· With four players, animal houses are worth 1–7 points, and statues are worth 1–16 points.
Each bear species has three different five-space enclosures worth 6, 7 and 8 points respectively.
Passing:
You must pass only when no tile in your supply can legally fit. Take one free green area and end your placement; you may place it next turn. Personal supply is unlimited.
Game end and scoring:
The first player to complete four areas triggers the end. Every other player takes one final turn. Score placed animal houses, enclosures, statues and achievements. Ties are broken by total points on unplaced supply tiles, then shared.
Achievements (optional, off by default):
Choose three types at random. Take the highest remaining value first. The values below are listed in claim order, from highest to lowest; remove the lowest tile in each stack for two players.
· Polar/Gobi/Koala/Panda: place three tiles of that species to qualify. The rewards are 8, 5 and 2 points in claim order.
· Animal Houses: place one animal house of each shape to qualify. The rewards are 8, 5 and 2 points in claim order.
· Green Areas: connect six green tiles orthogonally to qualify. The rewards are 9, 6 and 3 points in claim order.
· Enclosures: connect three enclosures orthogonally to qualify. The rewards are 9, 6 and 3 points in claim order.
· Long Food Street: join three Food Streets in one straight line to qualify. The rewards are 9, 6 and 3 points in claim order.
· Long River: join three rivers at their watercourse ends to qualify. The rewards are 10, 7 and 4 points in claim order.
· Twice Is Nice: gain at least two statues in one turn to qualify. The rewards are 10, 7 and 4 points in claim order.
Grizzlies module (off by default):
Build five areas. Your fifth must be one of the visible exit areas, never a normal area. It cannot be directly below any other area. Once per turn, before or after placing/passing, permanently discard one green area and one animal house from your personal supply to gain an available seven-space grizzly habitat. A habitat gained at the start may be placed immediately. There are twelve habitats: three different shapes at each value 7–10. Add value-8 houses for 2/4 players, value-7 houses for 3. Statues extend to even values 2–20 for 2 players, 3–17 for 3, and 1–20 for 4. Complete five areas to trigger the end. End early if nobody can make progress.
Monorails module (off by default):
Immediately after placing a green area, you may put a tower on one of its spaces; you cannot add one later. The first tower is unrestricted. Every later tower must extend an end of your single line, horizontally or vertically exactly three spaces from the old tower (two spaces in between). Empty spaces and pits may lie underneath. Immediately connect the highest-value remaining car. Each player has one car worth each of 10, 8, 6, 5, 4 and 3 points. At most two cars may meet at a tower, always making a 90° turn. No separate lines, intersections or loops; at most one tower and car per turn. Towers score nothing; cars score their value. Combine both modules using the Grizzlies ending.
New achievements (optional, off by default):
Mix the six new types with the base types and select three. Neither module is required.
· Construction Freeze: place an enclosure covering no symbols to qualify. The rewards are 8, 5 and 2 points in claim order.
· Enclosure Planning: actually gain at least two enclosures in one turn to qualify. The rewards are 8, 5 and 2 points in claim order.
· Toilets Apart: have two toilets with at least eleven intervening spaces along the shortest orthogonal path to qualify. The rewards are 8, 5 and 2 points in claim order.
· Food Street Connections: have Food Streets cross three different pairs of adjacent areas to qualify. The rewards are 9, 6 and 3 points in claim order.
· Rivers in Corners: have three areas each with a river covering a corner and its two neighboring spaces to qualify. The rewards are 9, 6 and 3 points in claim order.
· Playgrounds with Statues: have three statues each orthogonally touching a playground to qualify. The rewards are 9, 6 and 3 points in claim order.
Any expansion content adds six Toilets, bringing the total to sixteen.
Pit variant (optional, off by default):
After the end is triggered, each other player may cover unoccupied pits on their final turn. An area whose pit is covered receives no statue.

zh.name: Bear Necessities
zh.desc: 轮抽照片，构建熊族的日常生活；通过相邻激活与蜜蜂连成得分引擎。
zh.rules:
目标：
经过12轮，组成4列3行的牌阵。通过激活卡牌获得分数，并在终局用蜜蜂与蜂巢获得额外分数；总分最高者获胜，并列共享胜利。
准备：
2至4人游玩。将94张牌洗混，每人发5张。四种颜色分别代表城市、水域、山地与沙漠；卡牌可具有动物、熊族、建筑、物品、植物中的一种或两种类别。
每轮流程：
每人秘密选择不同的两张手牌，一张用于本轮放置，另一张作为保留牌。全部选好后同时公开本轮放置牌，各自选择位置。第一张牌的位置自由；后续牌须与已有牌正交相邻。阵列可向上下左右扩展，但不能超过4列或3行，已经放置的牌不能移动。
先激活刚放置的牌，再按自己选择的顺序激活其每张正交邻牌。激活旧牌不会自动激活它的邻牌。望远镜、潜水员、向导等效果允许选择额外激活的牌；同一条连锁中不允许重复激活已经经过的牌，其他独立激活仍可再次激活同一张牌。没有可选目标时结束该条效果。
目标牌每次被激活时检查条件：满足时只获得横线下的分数，不满足时只获得横线上分数。仅仅满足条件不会自动激活目标牌。统计自己阵列时通常包含本牌；演员明确排除自身。蛇按照卡牌英文原名的首字母S计数；符合条件的牌面标有S，英文原名可在卡牌详情查看。眼镜属性包含单片眼镜、潜水镜和太阳镜，可在牌面详情查看。
间谍由玩家指定一名对手。各人的本轮放置全部完成后才开始激活；间谍读取所有人的本轮牌阵与放置秘密蜂蜜储藏室后持有的蜜蜂数量，不受点击先后影响。天气预报读取自己本轮的保留牌。
每轮全部激活结束后，本轮获得分数最少的玩家获得1只蜜蜂，并列最低者各获得1只。其余手牌传给左侧玩家，再将自己的保留牌加入收到的手牌，进入下一轮。
第4、8轮结束后，先决定保留或弃置当前保留牌，再从牌堆补至5张；其他轮次不补牌。
终局：
第12轮仍结算本轮最低分的蜜蜂。将自己持有的蜜蜂数乘以阵列上蜂巢符号总数，所得分数加到累计分数。橡皮鸭具有2个蜂巢。分数最高者获胜。

en.name: Bear Necessities
en.desc: Draft photographs and build a Bearfolk tableau, chaining adjacent cards into a scoring engine.
en.rules:
Objective:
Over 12 rounds, build a tableau of four columns and three rows. Score by activating cards, then multiply bees by hive symbols at the end. Highest total wins; tied players share victory.
Setup:
For 2–4 players. Shuffle all 94 cards and deal five to each player. The four colors represent city, water, mountain and desert. A card has one or two types: animal, Bearfolk, building, item or plant.
Each round:
Secretly choose two different cards: one to place and one to keep in reserve. When everyone is ready, reveal the chosen placement cards and choose their positions. The first card is free; subsequent cards must be orthogonally adjacent to an existing card. Expand in any direction without exceeding four columns or three rows. Placed cards cannot move.
Activate the newly placed card first, then each of its orthogonal neighbors in the order you choose. Activating an old card does not automatically activate its neighbors. Binoculars, Diver and Guide let you select an additional card. A card cannot repeat within the same activation chain; separate activations may activate it again. If there is no eligible target, that effect ends.
Check a goal card whenever it activates. If complete, use only the score below the line; otherwise use only the score above it. Completing a goal does not activate its card. Counts in your tableau normally include the card itself; Actor explicitly excludes itself. Snake counts cards whose original English names start with S. These cards carry an S mark; their English names are in card details. Glasses include a monocle, diving goggles and sunglasses; card details show this attribute.
For a Spy, choose one opponent. All placements finish before activations begin. Spies use this round’s complete tableaux and bee counts after placing Secret Honey Stash, independent of click order. Weather Forecast checks your current reserve card.
After all activations, the player scoring the fewest points this round gains one bee. Tied last players each gain one. Pass your remaining hand to the player on your left, and add your reserve card to the hand you receive.
After rounds four and eight, choose whether to keep or discard your reserve card, then draw up to five cards. Do not draw in other rounds.
End:
Award the round-12 bee as usual. Multiply your bee count by the total hive symbols in your tableau and add this bonus to your activation score. Rubber Duck has two hives. Highest total wins.

zh.name: 野兽酒吧
zh.desc: 十二种动物排队挤酒吧,打出、挤压、驱逐,把高分动物送进酒吧
zh.rules:
目标：
所有玩家打出全部12张动物牌后，酒吧内动物的分值总和最高者获胜。
流程：
· 每人拥有相同的12张动物牌，从狮子到臭鼬各1张。玩家轮流打出1张动物牌，将其排到队尾。
· 动物入队时，立即发动自身能力。各种动物的能力见下方图鉴。
· 此后，从队首到队尾检查河马、鳄鱼和长颈鹿，并分别再发动1次它们的能力。
· 队伍达到5只动物时，最前方的2只动物进入酒吧，面朝下放置并留待计分；队尾的1只动物被淘汰。

en.name: Beasty Bar
en.desc: Animals queue for the bar — shove, eat and bounce your high-value animals into the bar
en.rules:
Goal: after everyone has played all 12 cards, the animals in your bar score — the highest total wins.
Play:
· Everyone has the same 12 animal cards (lion through skunk); on your turn, play one to the back of the line.
· The animal’s ability triggers at once (each ability is listed in the gallery below).
· Afterwards, hippos, crocodiles and giraffes act once more, from front to back.
· Whenever the line reaches 5: the front 2 squeeze into the bar (face down, worth points), and the last one is out.

zh.name: 山中小屋：第三版
zh.desc: 探索宅邸，直到作祟揭开每个人的命运
zh.rules:
准备与目标：
选择一个场景。基础版五个场景使用基础组件；“月下嚎叫”“节日宅邸”“归家见恶”分别使用对应扩展，不混合三个扩展。每人选择不同颜色的一名人物。“月下嚎叫”必须有莎拉；“节日宅邸”必须有精灵或铃爪。按生日决定先手，然后依座位顺序轮流行动。
游戏先共同探索宅邸，再按触发的作祟剧本分配阵营和胜负目标。通常是英雄合作对抗叛徒，也可能有隐藏叛徒、全员合作或各自争胜。作祟后的目标和特殊规则优先于基本规则。
人物属性：
力量、速度属于身体属性；神志、知识属于精神属性。轨道位置决定当前数值，提升或降低属性指移动轨道格数，不是直接加减显示数值。绿色起始位置是治疗基准；治疗将低于起始位置的属性恢复到起始位置，不降低较高属性。最左端的数值位置称为危急值，再降低一格就是骷髅。
回合与移动：
回合开始时，获得等于当时速度数值的移动力。本回合速度改变不会重算移动力。每经过一扇相连的门通常消耗1点；离开有对手或障碍的房间额外消耗1点，多个对手和障碍不累加。可以在移动前后使用允许的物品、交易或执行剧本动作，也可以提前结束回合。
楼梯与其他特殊通路按房间说明连接。通常只能穿过相接的门，不能穿墙，不能从地下平台直接爬回地面楼梯；物品、房间或剧本的特例除外。特殊通路、房间能力和危急属性可在人物档案及房间详情中查看。
发现房间：
穿过尚未探索的门，抽取适用楼层的新房间，选择朝向，使来路门口连接。其他相邻房间的门不必相接。将人物移入新房间，结算发现、进入效果和房间图标，然后结束回合。物品、预兆、事件图标分别对应各自牌堆；有2个图标时，分别从对应牌堆各抽取1张牌。房间能力仅在写明的时机生效；普通进入旧房间不会再次抽牌。
物品与预兆：
物品和预兆通常由获得者公开持有，能力持续生效或按牌面使用；事件按牌面结算。每张牌的主动特殊动作每回合只能用一次，除非牌面另有说明。“埋掉”指将卡牌放到对应牌堆底部。刚获得的牌本回合不能执行主动特殊动作，也不能用作武器；持续能力仍适用。
交易与尸体：
在自己的回合中，可以与同一房间内的1名探险者交易1次，交换任意数量的物品、预兆及允许交易的标记，单方赠送也属于交易，须对方同意。可在同房尸体上拿取物品、预兆及允许搜取的标记，每回合只能从每具尸体拿取一件。剧本另有限制时按剧本执行。
掷骰与伤害：
属性检定按当前数值掷骰，每颗骰子有0、1、2点，将点数相加并应用修正。牌面允许的替代属性、额外骰子及重掷会在相应时机供选择。掷出的伤害骰表示点数总和的伤害，不是骰子颗数。
受伤者逐点分配伤害：身体伤害降低力量或速度，精神伤害降低神志或知识，一般伤害可降低任意属性。作祟前不能降到骷髅，仍有可降低的非危急属性时，不得把伤害分配给危急属性。直接降低属性与承受伤害不同，不触发护甲等减伤能力。
作祟检定：
作祟前，每次抽到预兆后，掷等于所有探险者持有预兆总数的骰子，5点以上开始作祟；抽完最后一张预兆自动开始。触发者称为揭幕者，场景与刚抽到的预兆决定剧本。事件也可能直接触发指定剧本。“归家见恶”在作祟前以遭遇代替房间预兆抽牌，并按已翻开的遭遇张数掷作祟骰。
作祟开始后：
按剧本完成设置，分别阅读自己的阵营目标及秘密信息。通常从叛徒左侧的探险者开始新一轮。已公开的叛徒可以选择忽略不利的房间效果，也可以在发现事件房间时不抽事件。隐藏叛徒仍遵守相应剧本的身份规则。探索仍可继续，普通预兆不再进行作祟检定。
战斗：
作祟后，每个回合通常可以攻击一次。徒手攻击同房的对手，双方用力量检定；高点数者获胜，败方承受等于差值的身体伤害，平手无伤害。武器可能改用其他属性、增加骰子或允许远程攻击；精神属性攻击造成精神伤害。防御也会掷骰，正常近战中攻击者失败会受伤。
枪以速度对抗速度，能攻击视线内目标；视线沿同一行或列穿过相连门口，不能穿墙或转弯。弩能攻击同房或相邻相连房间，使用速度属性进行检定，并额外投掷1颗骰子。枪与弩攻击失败时不承受反击伤害。武器的详细能力及消耗见牌面说明。
怪物、死亡与胜负：
怪物通常在叛徒回合后行动。同种怪物掷一次速度骰决定各自移动力，至少为1；每个怪物独立移动和攻击，不能探索。普通怪物受伤后被击晕，跳过下次回合；有些剧本允许杀死怪物或使其免疫。具体属性、行动及死亡例外以剧本为准。
作祟后，任一属性降到骷髅时人物死亡，除非物品或剧本提供替代。死亡后不能再行动，持有物留在尸体处，仍可能按阵营目标共同获胜。满足剧本胜利条件时立即结束；调查报告显示实际胜者并允许回看宅邸。

en.name: Betrayal at House on the Hill: Third Edition
en.desc: Explore the house until a haunt reveals your fate
en.rules:
Setup and objective:
Choose one Scenario. The five base Scenarios use the base components. Howl at the Moon, The Holiday House, and Come Home to Evil each use their matching expansion; the three expansions are not mixed. Each player chooses a different character color. Howl at the Moon requires Sara; The Holiday House requires the Elf or Jingleklaws. Choose the explorer whose birthday comes next as first player, then follow seat order.
First explore together. The haunt then assigns teams and objectives: usually heroes against a traitor, but some haunts have a hidden traitor, cooperation, or individual winners. Haunt rules and objectives take precedence over the basic rules.
Character traits:
Might and Speed are Physical traits; Sanity and Knowledge are Mental traits. A marker position determines the trait value. Gaining or losing a trait moves the marker by spaces, rather than adding to or subtracting from its printed value. Healing raises a trait below its green starting position to that position, leaving higher traits unchanged. The leftmost numbered space is critical; one space below it is the skull.
Turns and movement:
Start your turn with movement equal to your current Speed value. Later Speed changes do not recalculate it. Moving through a connected doorway normally costs 1. Leaving a room containing an opponent or Obstacle costs 1 extra; multiple opponents and Obstacles do not stack. You may move before or after legal Item, trade, or haunt actions, or end your turn early.
Stairs and special routes connect as their room rules describe. Normally you must use matching doors, cannot pass through walls, and cannot climb directly from the Basement Landing to the Ground Staircase. Items, rooms, and haunts may provide exceptions. Inspect rooms and character dossiers for abilities, routes, and critical traits.
Discovering rooms:
Move through an unexplored door and draw a tile for that floor. Choose an orientation connecting the entrance door; its other doors need not match adjacent rooms. Enter it, resolve discovery and entry effects and its symbols, then end your turn. Item, Omen, and Event symbols draw their respective cards; a double symbol draws two. Abilities apply only at their stated times. Reentering an existing room does not normally draw another card.
Items and Omens:
Items and Omens are normally held faceup; resolve Events as instructed. Cards provide ongoing abilities or actions. Each card’s special action is normally usable once per turn. Bury means place at the bottom of the matching deck. A card received during this turn cannot be used for its special action or as a weapon until a later turn; ongoing abilities still apply.
Trading and corpses:
Once on your turn, trade with one explorer in your room. Exchange any number of Items, Omens, and tradable tokens, including a one-sided gift, with the other player’s agreement. You may take cards or lootable tokens from corpses in your room, but only one piece from each corpse per turn. Follow any haunt-specific restrictions.
Dice and damage:
Roll dice equal to the named trait value. Each die shows 0, 1, or 2; sum them and apply modifiers. Legal substitutions, extra dice, and rerolls are offered at the appropriate time. Dice of damage deal their total pips, not their number of dice.
The damaged player allocates damage one point at a time: Physical damage lowers Might or Speed, Mental damage lowers Sanity or Knowledge, and General damage can lower any trait. Before the haunt, traits cannot drop to the skull, and while an eligible noncritical trait remains, do not allocate damage to a critical trait. Losing a trait directly is different from damage and does not trigger Armor or other damage reduction.
Haunt rolls:
Before the haunt, after drawing an Omen, roll dice equal to all Omens held by explorers. A total of 5 or more starts the haunt; drawing the last Omen starts it automatically. The drawer is the haunt revealer; the Scenario and triggering Omen determine the haunt. Some Events directly start a named haunt. Before the haunt in Come Home to Evil, Omen room symbols draw Encounters instead, and haunt dice equal the faceup Encounter count.
After the haunt starts:
Complete the haunt setup and read your own team objective and secret information. Play normally resumes with the explorer to the traitor’s left. A revealed traitor may ignore harmful room effects and decline an Event when discovering an Event room. Hidden traitors follow their haunt’s identity rules. Exploration continues, but ordinary Omen draws no longer cause haunt rolls.
Combat:
After the haunt, you can normally attack once per turn. An unarmed attack targets an opponent in your room; both roll Might. The higher total wins, and the loser takes Physical damage equal to the difference. Ties cause no damage. Weapons may change the trait, add dice, or allow ranged attacks. Mental trait attacks deal Mental damage. The defender also rolls, and a failed normal melee attack can hurt the attacker.
The Gun uses Speed against Speed and attacks within line of sight: a straight row or column through connected doors, without crossing walls or turning. The Crossbow uses Speed with 1 extra die and targets the same or an adjacent connected room. Failed Gun and Crossbow attacks cause no counterattack damage. See each card for costs and detailed abilities.
Monsters, death, and victory:
Monsters normally act after the traitor. Roll movement once per monster type; each monster receives that many moves, with a minimum of 1. Each moves and attacks independently and cannot discover rooms. Ordinary monsters are stunned when damaged and skip their next turn; some haunts instead allow them to die or make them immune. Follow the haunt’s traits, actions, and death exceptions.
After the haunt, reaching the skull in any trait kills an explorer unless an Item or haunt replaces death. Dead explorers cannot act; their belongings remain with their corpse, and they may still share their team’s victory. The game ends immediately when a haunt victory condition is met. The investigation report shows the actual winners and allows you to review the house.

zh.name: 黑色奏鸣曲
zh.desc: 单人隐匿推理:在雾都伦敦追踪莎士比亚笔下的黑夫人
zh.rules:
目标:推断黑夫人的三个特征,与她同处一地时搜索命中,完成指认。
准备:按所选难度暗抽一条隐匿路线组成牌堆并随机切牌;随机指定黑夫人;点选起点落子。
流程:每回合黑夫人先移动,牌堆顶牌背面的地标暴露她当前所在地点的特征。
随后从四个行动中选择一个:
· 移动:棋子走到相邻地点;首次进入取走该地点的钥匙。
· 搜索：从雾牌堆提供一张牌，将它滑入牌堆顶牌下方；黑夫人位于此地时，你获得一张线索卡。无论搜索是否命中，将该顶牌移出游戏，黑夫人按照你持有的线索卡数量逃逸。

· 雾卡:牌堆顶牌为雾卡时，可以提供一张雾卡，翻开并执行其效果，然后将其放到雾牌堆底。
· 跳过:本回合不行动。
线索卡:左侧是卡面人物的三个特征;右侧按黑夫人花色给出她命中的特征数。
其中 0/2 表示零个或两个,需要结合多张线索卡排除歧义。
对质:用演绎标记确定三个特征后,搜索命中时可改为指认;三个特征全部正确则获胜，任何一个特征错误则落败。
失败条件：发生以下任一情况时，游戏失败：
· 倒计时卡第三次到达牌堆顶；简单模式改为第四次。
· 雾牌堆无法提供所需的牌。
· 无法执行雾卡效果。
· 指认的特征有误。
计分：将倒计时卡上方的卡牌数量、倒计时值与路线卡数量的乘积、雾牌堆剩余卡牌数量的两倍，以及难度修正相加，得到最终分数。训练难度的最终分数减半。

en.name: Black Sonata
en.desc: A solo hidden-movement deduction: track Shakespeare’s Dark Lady through foggy London
en.rules:
Goal: deduce the Dark Lady’s three traits, catch her with a search at her location, and confront her.
Setup: a hidden route is drawn for the chosen difficulty and cut; the Dark Lady is assigned; pick a starting location.
Play: each round the Lady moves first; the landmark on the top card’s back marks a feature of her location.
Then choose one of four actions:
· Move: move your pawn to an adjoining location; first entry claims that location’s key.
· Search: slide a fog card under the top card; if the Lady is here you gain a clue card. Hit or miss, that top card leaves the game and the Lady flees one card per clue you hold.

· Fog: when a fog card is on top, slide one in, resolve its effect, then place it under the fog deck.
· Pass: do nothing this turn.
Clues: the left side lists the pictured lady’s three traits; the right side gives, keyed by the Dark Lady’s suit, how many she shares.
A 0/2 entry means zero or two; combine several clues to resolve the ambiguity.
Confront: with three traits pinned by deduction tokens, a successful search may accuse her; all correct wins, any error loses.
Defeat: you lose when any of the following occurs:
· The countdown card surfaces for the third time, or the fourth time on Easy.
· The fog deck cannot provide a required card.
· A fog effect cannot be resolved.
· Your accusation includes an incorrect trait.
Score: add the number of cards above the countdown, its value multiplied by the route length, twice the number of cards remaining in the fog deck, and the difficulty modifier. Halve the final score on Training.

zh.name: 血色狂怒
zh.desc: 在诸神黄昏前率领维京氏族，轮抽神赐、争夺九省，赢取荣耀。
zh.rules:
【目标与准备】：
经过三个时代，总荣耀最高的氏族获胜，同分共同获胜。每族初始有8名战士、1名领袖和1艘龙船；怒气、战斧和号角的初始属性值分别为6、3和4。开局随机毁灭的外省数量根据人数决定：
· 两人对局毁灭3个外省。
· 三人对局毁灭2个外省。
· 四人对局毁灭1个外省。
· 五人对局不预先毁灭外省。
版图标出三个时代的诸神黄昏目标。外省随机分配3枚怒气、2枚战斧、2枚号角和1枚提供5点荣耀的掠夺奖励标记；世界树奖励提升全部属性。
【轮抽】：
每时代发8张牌。3至5人每轮选1张，其余传给左邻，选满6张后弃掉余牌。2人每轮选2张，共选三次。上一时代保留的牌不参与轮抽。
【行动】：
从起始氏族依次行动，每次选择一项：入侵、行军、升级、承诺任务或掠夺。结束行动会将剩余怒气归零。怒气为0时不能主动行动，仍能增援、参战或发动允许的效果；恢复怒气后可以再次行动。所有人怒气为0，或全部未毁省份都已被掠夺，立即结束时代。
【入侵与行军】：
入侵需要支付与单位战力相等的怒气；领袖可以免费入侵，战士通常需要支付1点怒气，船需要支付2点怒气。不能超过号角的版图单位上限，非船单位必须占据空村庄，通常不能直接入侵世界树。船只能入侵峡湾，并支援两侧省份。行军需要支付1点怒气，将同一省份任意数量的己方非船单位移至任意另一未毁省份，不要求相邻，目的地必须容纳所有单位。
【升级与任务】：
升级需要支付牌面所示的怒气，将升级牌放入对应槽位，并替换原有卡牌。氏族升级共有3个槽位，怪物共有2个槽位，战士、领袖和船各有1个槽位。打出单位升级后，可立即让一个对应单位免费入侵。任务不消耗怒气，秘密放置，直到时代末才检查；同名任务可分别完成。牌面详细效果优先于通则。
【掠夺与增援】：
选择有己方单位或己方支援船、未被掠夺的省份，掠夺本身不消耗怒气。从掠夺者左邻起，各氏族轮流可将一个相邻陆地单位移入战场，或放弃。直到村庄已满，或所有氏族连续放弃；之前放弃的氏族仍可在后来再次增援。只有一个氏族参战时直接获得掠夺奖励。
【战斗】：
各参战氏族同时暗选一张手牌，无手牌时不出牌；非战斗牌通常提供0点战力。揭牌后可以轮流追加海姆达尔之视、之眼、凝视，直到所有人连续放弃。先处理索尔的威权，再处理海姆达尔的守望，再处理其他牌。单位与卡牌战力之和最高且唯一的氏族获胜；最高同分则全部失败。输家单位被摧毁，卡牌收回；赢家弃掉揭示牌并获得当前战斧数的荣耀。只有掠夺者获胜才获得掠夺奖励，先提升奖励属性，再计算战斗荣耀。被卡牌提前消灭全部单位的氏族仍使用卡牌战力参战。船和海蛇计入支援省份战力，世界树没有支援峡湾。
【时代末】：
前两时代弃至最多1张手牌，第三时代弃掉全部。逐张检查秘密任务：完成则获得牌面荣耀并任选一项氏族属性提升1格。控制要求在相应省份独占最高战力，平局不算控制；光荣赴死要求英灵殿中至少4个己方单位。随后诸神黄昏摧毁目标省份及支援峡湾中的单位，每个死亡单位在第一、第二和第三时代分别带来2、3和4点荣耀。英灵殿所有单位回到预备区，版图幸存单位留下；起始标记传左，重置掠夺标记，并开始下一时代。
【终局】：
第三时代结算后，三项氏族属性各按最终位置奖励荣耀：第4或第5格获得10点荣耀，第6格获得20点荣耀，每项只奖励一次。加上适用卡牌终局奖励后比较总荣耀。
【可选扩展】：
第五人扩展增加各时代9张牌并允许5人。秘术师升级增加1名具有2点战力且可以免费入侵的秘术师，最多拥有2名，且仍计入号角规定的单位上限；同名选民能力不重复生效。诸神扩展开局随机两位神，每时代重新放置；影响所在省份及支援峡湾，掠夺后由掠夺者移动至不同、未毁、未掠夺且无神的省份。
· 索尔增加杀敌荣耀。
· 弗丽嘉禁止战中死亡。
· 提尔令单位战力为0。
· 奥丁令掠夺奖励翻倍。
· 洛基令输家获得战斗荣耀。
· 海姆达尔要求依次明牌、掠夺者最后。
追加怪物可独立开启，效果见牌面。弗丽嘉的选民秘术师参战时禁止打出洛基的背刺。

en.name: Blood Rage
en.desc: Draft the gifts of the gods, invade the nine provinces, and earn glory before Ragnarök.
en.rules:
【Goal and setup】：
The clan with the most Glory after three ages wins. Ties share victory. Each clan has 8 Warriors, 1 Leader, and 1 Ship, with initial Rage of 6, Axes of 3, and Horns of 4. Randomly destroy outer provinces at setup according to the player count:
· With two players, destroy 3 outer provinces.
· With three players, destroy 2 outer provinces.
· With four players, destroy 1 outer province.
· With five players, destroy no outer provinces.
Three future Ragnarök targets are shown. Randomly assign the outer pillage rewards: 3 Rage, 2 Axes, 2 Horns, and one 5-Glory token. Yggdrasil raises all stats.
【Draft】：
Deal 8 cards per age. With 3–5 players, keep 1 and pass left each round until you have kept 6; discard the rest. With 2 players, keep 2 each round, three times. A card kept from the previous age is not drafted.
【Actions】：
In turn, invade, march, upgrade, commit a quest, or pillage. Passing reduces remaining Rage to zero. At zero Rage you cannot take regular actions, but may reinforce, fight, or use eligible effects. Gaining Rage lets you act again. The age ends immediately when everyone has zero Rage, or every surviving province has been pillaged.
【Invade and march】：
Invasion costs a figure’s Strength; Leaders are free, Warriors normally cost 1, Ships 2. Horns limits your figures on the board. Land figures require empty villages and normally cannot invade Yggdrasil directly. Ships invade fjords and support both adjacent provinces. Pay 1 Rage to march any number of your land figures from one province to any other surviving province with enough room. Marching does not require adjacency.
【Upgrades and quests】：
Pay an upgrade’s Rage cost and equip its matching slot, replacing the old card. You have 3 Clan slots, 2 Monster slots, and one each for Warriors, Leader, and Ship. A figure upgrade allows one corresponding figure to invade immediately for free. Committing a quest costs no Rage and keeps it secret until the end of the age. Identical quests may each score. Card text overrides general rules.
【Pillage and reinforcement】：
Pillage an unpillaged province containing your figure or supported by your Ship, at no Rage cost. Beginning left of the pillager, each clan may move one adjacent land figure into the battlefield or pass. Continue until all villages are full or every clan passes consecutively. A previous pass does not prevent later reinforcement. If only one clan participates, it receives the reward without battle.
【Battle】：
Each participant secretly chooses one hand card, or none if empty-handed. Non-Battle cards normally add zero Strength. Reveal together, then take turns adding Heimdall’s Sight, Eye, or Gaze until everyone passes consecutively. Resolve Thor’s Primacy before Heimdall’s Watch, then other effects. The unique highest total of figure and card Strength wins; a tie makes everyone lose. Losing figures are destroyed and losing cards return to hand. The winner discards revealed cards and gains Glory equal to current Axes. Only a winning pillager receives the pillage reward; raise reward stats before awarding battle Glory. A clan whose figures were all destroyed by cards still fights with card Strength. Ships and the Sea Serpent support adjacent provinces. Yggdrasil has no supporting fjord.
【End of an age】：
In Ages 1–2, discard down to at most one hand card. In Age 3, discard all. Check secret quests individually: each success earns printed Glory and raises one clan stat. Control requires unique highest figure Strength; ties do not control. Glorious Death needs at least 4 of your figures in Valhalla. Then Ragnarök destroys the doomed province and figures in its supporting fjord, awarding 2/3/4 Glory per figure in Ages 1/2/3. All Valhalla figures return to reserve; surviving board figures remain. Pass first player left, reset pillage markers, and begin the next age.
【Final scoring】：
After Age 3, each clan stat at its fourth or fifth position grants 10 Glory, or 20 at its sixth position. Each stat scores once. Add applicable endgame card rewards and compare total Glory.
【Optional expansions】：
5th Player adds 9 cards per age and allows 5 players. Mystic upgrades add one free-to-invade, Strength-2 Mystic, up to two; they count against Horns. Identical Chosen abilities do not stack. Gods of Asgard uses two random gods, repositioned each age. They affect their province and supporting fjord. After a pillage, the pillager moves its god to a different surviving, unpillaged, god-free province.
· Thor adds Glory for destroyed enemies.
· Frigga prevents battle deaths.
· Tyr makes figure Strength zero.
· Odin doubles pillage rewards.
· Loki awards battle Glory to losers.
· Heimdall requires sequential face-up cards, with the pillager last.
Bonus monsters can be enabled separately; see their cards. A clan fighting with a Frigga’s Chosen Mystic cannot play Loki’s Backstab.

zh.name: 炸弹克星
zh.desc: 合作拆弹:报编号指认队友的导线,剪错蓝黄导线起爆器逼近骷髅,剪到红色导线当场爆炸
zh.rules:
目标:全队合作,在起爆器走到骷髅前剪完全部蓝色导线与黄色导线;剪到红色导线或起爆器到底,炸弹爆炸。
准备:
· 蓝色导线 1-12 各 4 根,红色黄色导线按任务牌数量随机混入;各自升序放上板块底座,只看得见自己的导线。
· 从任务3开始，抽取与玩家人数相同数量的装备牌。某编号的导线剪出2根后，解锁对应的装备牌；每张装备牌只能使用一次。
· 从队长开始,每人放 1 个信息指示物在自己一根蓝色导线前方。
流程:
· 轮到你时三选一:双人剪线、单人剪线、展示红色导线。
· 双人剪线:报一个编号(1-12 或「黄」),指定队友一根导线。 猜对:两根导线各翻明剪出;猜错:起爆器前进一格,队友在导线前方放真实编号的信息指示物;指到红色导线立刻爆炸。

· 单人剪线:某编号剩余未剪的导线全在你手里(2 或 4 根),可独自全部剪出;黄色导线须握有全部在局的黄色导线。
· 展示红色导线:自己剩余未剪的导线全部为红色时，将它们全部展示，随后你完成剪线。
· 某编号 4 根全剪出,数字轨放验证指示物。
· 每人拥有一件只能使用一次的个人装备“双重探测器”。使用它进行双人剪线时，可以指定队友的2根导线，其中任意一根符合所报编号即为成功。
任务:66 个任务各有不同特殊规则(顺序牌、限制牌、氧气、纳米机器人等),开局前在任务列表查看。
结束:
· 所有人板块底座清空:任务成功。
· 剪到红色导线或起爆器走到骷髅:爆炸,任务失败。

en.name: Bomb Busters
en.desc: Co-op bomb defusal: call a value and point at a teammate’s wire — a wrong blue or yellow advances the dial, a red one explodes
en.rules:
Goal: as a team, cut every blue and yellow wire before the detonator dial reaches the skull; cutting a red wire or maxing the dial explodes the bomb.
Setup:
· Prepare four blue wires of each value from 1 to 12, then mix in red and yellow wires as shown on the mission card. Each player sorts their own rack in ascending order and can see only their own wires.
· From mission 3 on, draw as many equipment cards as players; each unlocks once 2 wires of its value are cut, and can be used once.
· Starting with the Captain, each player places 1 info token in front of one of their blue wires.
Play:
· On your turn, choose one of: Dual Cut, Solo Cut, or Reveal Red Wires.
· Dual Cut: call a value (1-12 or "yellow") and point at one of a teammate’s wires. If right, both wires are cut face-up; if wrong, the dial advances and the teammate places a true-value token on that wire; pointing at a red wire explodes the bomb.

· Solo Cut: if every remaining uncut wire of a value is in your hand (2 or 4), cut them all alone; for yellow you must hold every yellow wire in play.
· Reveal Red Wires: when every uncut wire in your hand is red, reveal them all — you are done.
· When all 4 wires of a value are cut, place a validation token on the number track.
· Each player has a once-per-game personal gadget, the Double Detector: a Dual Cut may point at 2 of a teammate’s wires and succeeds if either matches.
Missions: 66 missions each add their own special rules (sequence cards, constraint cards, oxygen, the Nano robot and more) — check the mission list before starting.
End:
· Every rack empty: mission accomplished.
· A red wire cut or the dial reaching the skull: the bomb explodes — mission failed.

zh.name: 乌托邦里的赏金猎人
zh.desc: 双人赏金对决:搜捕通缉犯关进监狱,招募搭档帮手连击,把握时机喊停结算
zh.rules:
目标:将通缉犯关进监狱以积累赏金，并在适当时机喊停。总分较高的玩家获胜。
准备:双方各将自己的23张通缉犯牌洗混，组成牌库，再抽取5张牌；将12张帮手牌正面朝上展示在公共区。
先后手:后手先禁用公共区 2 张帮手,到自己首个回合时自动解禁。
流程(每回合 2 个行动,可重复选同一种):
· 搜捕:从自己或对方的牌库顶抽取1张牌，加入自己的手牌。
· 出击:将 1 张手牌中的通缉犯关进我方监狱;打出前手牌总数须大于其赏金。
· 封锁:我方监狱某组赏金合计达到 10 时,花费 1 个行动获得 1 枚黄金令牌锁住该组。
· 招募:从公共区获得 1 张帮手;船长搭档需消耗整回合 2 个行动。
· 派遣:打出 1 对搭档帮手发动效果(点牌面可见效果)。
· 驱逐:把 1 张手牌通缉犯放到对方牌库顶。
回合结束:手牌上限 7 张,帮手至多 4 张,超出须弃置。
集齐 4 张帮手时手牌上限增加 1 张;然后从牌库补到 5 张。
搭档效果(派遣一对触发):
· 船长:跳过对方下个回合;招募需消耗整回合 2 个行动。
· 厨师:同回合内招募并派遣,下个回合增加 1 个行动。
· 猎人:翻开我方牌库顶的3张通缉犯牌，并将其关进我方监狱；其中赏金为7或8的通缉犯改为加入我方手牌。
· 狱长：将对方监狱中的1张通缉犯牌移至我方监狱。
· 旅人:从双方牌库、对方手牌、公共区、双方监狱逐张补牌,直到手牌达 5 张。
· 侦探:从对方的手牌中随机抽取3张，不预先查看其牌面。
喊停:手牌和牌库中都没有通缉犯牌时，可以宣布停止,立即结算。
计分：将监狱中的赏金、手中帮手的分值，以及黄金令牌的数量相加，得到总分。总分相同时，黄金令牌较多的玩家获胜；令牌数量也相同时，监狱中的通缉犯牌较少的玩家获胜。

en.name: Wanted and Recruit
en.desc: A two-player bounty duel: jail wanted criminals, recruit partner helpers, and call stop at the perfect moment
en.rules:
Goal: jail wanted criminals for bounty, call stop at the right moment, and outscore your rival.
Setup: each player shuffles a 23-card criminal deck and draws 5; 12 helpers form the public area.
Turn order: the second player bans 2 helpers first; they return automatically on their first turn.
Play (2 actions per turn, the same action may repeat):
· Search: draw the top card of either deck into your hand.
· Attack: jail 1 criminal from your hand; your hand size must exceed its bounty before playing.
· Lock: when a prison group totals 10 bounty, spend 1 action to take a gold token and lock it.
· Recruit: take 1 helper from the public area; the captain pair costs both actions of the turn.
· Dispatch: play a partner pair of helpers to trigger their effect (tap a card to read it).
· Exile: put a criminal from your hand on top of the rival’s deck.
Turn end: your hand limit is 7 cards, and you may hold at most 4 helpers. Discard any excess cards.
With 4 helpers the hand limit increases by 1; then draw up to 5 from your deck.
Partner pairs (dispatch both to trigger):
· Captain: skip the rival’s next turn; recruiting costs both actions.
· Chefs: recruit and dispatch in the same turn to gain 1 extra action next turn.
· Hunters: put the top 3 cards of your deck into your prison. Put criminals with a bounty of 7 or 8 into your hand instead.
· Wardens: move 1 criminal from the rival’s prison to yours.
· Travelers: refill your hand one card at a time from either deck, the rival’s hand, the public area, or either prison, until you hold 5.
· Detectives: draw 3 random cards from the rival’s hand.
Stop: with no criminals in hand and deck, you may call stop and settle at once.
Scoring: add the bounty in your prison, the values of helpers in your hand, and the number of gold tokens you hold. If totals are tied, the player with more gold tokens wins. If token counts are also tied, the player with fewer criminal cards in prison wins.

zh.name: 交织苍穹
zh.desc: 驾驶飞船深入云海，采集汲石，建设旅游公司并发现北方奇观。
zh.rules:
目标与准备：
经营飞船旅游公司，获得最多声望。每人拥有三艘飞船、一张随机玩家板、一张起始奇观、2点毅力、三色汲石各1枚及1张公开遭遇牌。三种颜色的奇观牌各有9张，另有36张设备牌和25张遭遇牌。云层与前哨位置随机设置。中文名称采用社区译名《交织苍穹》，卡牌名称为本地译名；规则依据官方2026年基础版r12与单人规则r5。
回合：
轮到你时，派遣一艘仍在玩家板上的飞船，或回收所有已派遣飞船。三艘均在外时必须回收。上层采集港与所有奇观、专门港口不限飞船数量；中层及深层每个采集港只容一艘。采集港只接收旗帜匹配的飞船，其他港口接收任意飞船。
采集与探索：
派遣到采集港时，若飞船已有船员或采集器，移除该港口正下方相邻的一块云板并执行事件；新出现的前哨位置随机补板。上层港只能揭开相邻中层，中层港可依次移除盖住深层的大小云板。然后依次获得港口本身与遗留资源、采集器奖励、自有前哨奖励。资源全部放入该飞船货舱；从货舱转移到同行设备免费，跨行每枚支付1点毅力。不能覆盖已有物资或船员。未装入设备的货物全部留在出发港口，供后续来访者收取。资源供应有限，每种20枚。
奇观港：
支付牌面费用，资源可从玩家板任意位置取用。有船员的飞船先获得港口的跨轨奖励，再领取遗留声望，取得顶牌并执行即时推进。将新奇观放在行程末端，起始奇观与最新奇观的能力有效，其余只保留顶部符号。只有标有船长动作的能力需要在回收时使用船长；持续能力始终生效。每次采集骰可按有效重掷能力重掷一次。
专门港口：
· 汤汤节支付4名游客，获得9点声望，三条轨道各推进1格；采集器额外任选轨道推进1格，船员按美食符号数获得声望。
· 地下市场支付任意2份资源、同类2份资源或任意3份资源，分别获得2、3、4点声望；采集器获得2点毅力，船员任选轨道推进1格。
· 自由飞行者公会支付1点毅力及1枚黄色汲石，取得一张市场设备；选牌前，可以弃置市场第4张设备牌，并补充1张新牌；每次到访最多执行1次，船员额外抽取1张遭遇牌。
· 雷霆工坊支付1点毅力及1枚蓝色汲石，为任意一艘飞船安装采集器；来访飞船原有船员时任选轨道推进1格。
· 破旗酒馆支付1点毅力及1枚红色汲石，安装船员；来访飞船原有采集器时获得2点毅力。
新装升级不追溯本次来访奖励。
设备与回收：
新增设备放在任意一行最左空位，获得被覆盖位置的轨道推进，放入该行第3张设备时再获得1点毅力。每行最多3张，含印刷设备。回收时自行决定飞船次序；每回收一艘，任意次序激活该行已填满槽位的设备，每张至多一次，并支付相应毅力。激活时资源不消耗。回收期间新获得的资源必须立即放入任意空槽，跨行免费，无法放置则不获得。每名船员在本行空槽代替一个资源或船员要求，船长可放在任意行空槽或一个有效奇观动作上；每枚每次回收只能用一次。全部回收结束后取回船长与船员。毅力上限为8点。
遭遇与前哨：
遭遇牌全部公开，本人回合任意决策时可打出，包括刚获得的牌，每回合最多2张。选择A或B，满足B的港口条件并支付毅力后获得其奖励；资源立即用于当前付款或放入空槽。建造前哨时选择一个已揭开的采集港，每人每港最多一个，共6个；多人可共建。前哨奖励按牌面获得资源、遭遇，或按行程符号、船员数获得声望。
奇观轨道：
到达奖励格立即获得奖励。
· 文化：到达第3格时，抽取一张设备牌；到达第4及第9格时，各抽取一张遭遇牌；到达第6格时，获得4点声望，若文化、风景、冒险和美食符号各至少有一个，再获得5点声望；到达第11格时，获得6点声望，再按美食符号数量获得等量声望。
· 风景：到达第3格时，安装一个采集器；到达第4及第9格时，各建造一个前哨；到达第6格时，获得4点声望，再按船员与采集器的总数量获得等量声望；到达第11格时，获得6点声望，再按已建前哨数量获得等量声望。
· 冒险：到达第1及第4格时，各获得1点毅力；到达第3格时，安装一名船员；到达第6格时，获得6点声望，若此时至少有6点毅力，再获得5点声望；到达第9格时，获得2点毅力；到达第11格时，获得6点声望，若已收集三种普通奇观，再获得5点声望。
三条轨道的第13格各提供4点声望；到达顶端后不能继续推进。
结束与计分：
任一玩家达到60点声望、行程达到7张奇观，或三条轨道均有人到达第11格，触发游戏结束。完成当前轮后再完整进行一轮。遗产符号数量前三名获得16、10、6点声望；并列时相关名次奖励相加平分，向下取整，没有遗产不得分。文化轨按风景符号、风景轨按冒险符号、冒险轨按文化符号计分：轨道第0至3格每枚1分，第4至7格2分，第8至11格3分，第12至13格4分。合计游戏中声望及终局奖励。平分依次比较剩余汲石数量（不含游客）、奇观数量、毅力，仍同则并列。
单人Automa：
一人游戏中，加入官方自动对手Automa，由玩家先行动，随后双方交替行动。Automa拥有独立的起始奇观和1张固定奇观，并使用12张行动牌决定飞船、港口、轨道与额外奖励。
· Automa通常不须支付费用。采集时，没有升级则获得1份资源并推进1格轨道；已有任一升级则获得2份资源并推进2格轨道。
· 到访奇观港时，若资源不足4枚，则获得3点声望并推进1格轨道；每名船员和每个采集器各使其额外推进1格。若资源至少有4枚，则支付4枚资源，取得奇观并执行即时推进。
· Automa不领取轨道上的即时奖励。她会收取到访港口和行动牌指定额外港口上的遗留资源与声望，并可以免费安装对应升级。到访自由飞行者公会时，弃置市场第3张和第4张设备牌。
· Automa探索时，忽略云板左侧的内容，改为获得3点声望；她不参与“所有玩家可以”执行的交换。
· 三艘飞船均已部署时，Automa必须回收；行动牌也可能要求她回收两艘飞船。回收时，执行起始奇观的回收能力。
· 终局按通常规则计分，此外，每个美食符号获得2分，每枚剩余资源获得1分。
· 最容易难度中，Automa不获得遗留声望。较易难度中，她的固定奇观只有遗产符号。普通及以上难度使用五种符号各1个的工厂游览。随着难度提高，依次增加3点起始声望、1名起始船员或2名起始船员。
· 平分时，Automa在第一项比较中计入全部资源，毅力视为0点。

en.name: Braided Skies
en.desc: Pilot drop ships into the clouds, harvest tapstones and build a tourism company in the Northlands.
en.rules:
Goal and setup:
Earn the most fame. Each player has 3 drop ships, a random player mat, a starting wonder, 2 grit, one tapstone of each color and 1 face-up encounter. There are 9 wonders of each type, 36 outfittings and 25 encounters. Cloud tiles and outposts are randomized. This implementation follows the official 2026 base game rulebook r12 and Automa r5.
Turns:
Deploy one ship from your mat or recall all deployed ships. With all three deployed you must recall. Top-level collection ports and all wonder and specialized ports have unlimited capacity. Middle and deep collection ports hold only one ship. Collection ports require their matching ship; other ports accept any ship.
Collection and exploration:
If your deployed ship already has a crewmate or harvester, remove one vertically adjacent cloud tile below that port and resolve the event. Add a random outpost tile to a newly revealed location. A top port reveals the adjacent middle port; a middle port successively removes the large and small tiles over the deep port. Resolve core benefits and leftovers, harvester benefits, then your outpost. Put all gained resources in the deployed ship’s cargo hold. Transfer them into empty outfitting slots: the same row is free, each resource transferred to another row costs 1 grit. Existing tokens cannot be replaced. Leave all unplaced cargo at the visited port. Supplies are limited to 20 of each resource.
Wonder ports:
Pay the top card’s cost from anywhere on your mat. First gain the ship’s crewmate cross-track benefit, then leftover fame, acquire the card and resolve its instant advances. Only your starting and latest wonder abilities are active; symbols on all wonders remain. Abilities marked with a captain action require your captain during recall. Unmarked abilities are ongoing. A reroll ability allows each harvest die to be rerolled once.
Specialized ports:
· Tomtom Festival costs 4 tourists and awards 9 fame plus one advance on each track; a harvester adds one advance on any track and a crewmate scores your culinary symbols.
· The Underground Market exchanges any 2 resources, 2 matching resources or any 3 resources for 2, 3 or 4 fame; a harvester adds 2 grit, a crewmate one advance on any track.
· Free Flyer’s Guild costs 1 grit and 1 yellow tapstone to take a market outfitting; optionally cycle card 4 once before selecting; a crewmate draws an encounter.
· Thunder’s Workshop costs 1 grit and 1 blue tapstone to install a harvester on any ship; an existing crewmate on the visiting ship advances any track.
· Cracked Flagon costs 1 grit and 1 red tapstone to install a crewmate; an existing harvester on the visiting ship gains 2 grit.
Newly installed upgrades do not grant retroactive arrival bonuses.
Outfittings and recall:
Install an outfitting in the leftmost empty space of any row and gain the covered track advancement; the third outfitting in a row also gives 1 grit. Each row holds at most 3, including the printed outfitting. Recall ships in any order. On recalling each ship, activate that row’s fully filled outfittings in any order, at most once each, paying any grit cost. Resources are not consumed. Resources gained during recall must immediately fill an empty slot in any row for free, or are not gained. Each crewmate may fill one empty resource or crewmate slot in its own row; your captain may fill any row’s empty slot or visit one active wonder action. Each pawn is used once per recall. Return all pawns after completing the recall. Grit is capped at 8.
Encounters and outposts:
Encounters are public. Play up to 2 on your turn at any decision, including cards just gained. Choose A or B, meeting B’s port condition and grit cost. Gained resources immediately cover a payment or fill empty slots. Build up to 6 outposts at revealed collection ports, at most one of your own at each; different players may share locations. Resolve their printed resource, encounter, itinerary-symbol or crewmate fame reward.
Wonder tracks:
Gain bonuses immediately.
· Culture: at space 3, draw an outfitting. At spaces 4 and 9, draw an encounter. At space 6, score 4 fame, plus 5 fame if you have at least one culture, scenic, adventure and culinary symbol. At space 11, score 6 fame plus fame equal to your culinary-symbol count.
· Scenic: at space 3, install a harvester. At spaces 4 and 9, build an outpost. At space 6, score 4 fame plus fame equal to your total crewmates and harvesters. At space 11, score 6 fame plus fame equal to your built outposts.
· Adventure: at spaces 1 and 4, gain 1 grit. At space 3, install a crewmate. At space 6, score 6 fame, plus 5 fame if you have at least 6 grit. At space 9, gain 2 grit. At space 11, score 6 fame, plus 5 fame if you have acquired all three ordinary wonder types.
Space 13 on each track scores 4 fame. Further advancement at the top has no effect.
Game end and scoring:
Trigger the end when anyone reaches 60 fame or 7 itinerary wonders, or when each track has at least one token at space 11. Finish the current round and play one more full round. Heritage leaders score 16, 10 and 6; tied players share the sum of occupied awards, rounded down. No heritage means no award. Culture scores scenic symbols, scenic scores adventure symbols and adventure scores culture symbols. Multiply by 1 at spaces 0–3, 2 at 4–7, 3 at 8–11 or 4 at 12–13. Add these awards to earned fame. Ties favor more tapstones (excluding tourists), then more wonders, then more grit; otherwise share victory.
Solo Automa:
With one human, add the official Automa and alternate turns, human first. Automa has a starting wonder and a fixed wonder. Her 12 action cards select the ship, port, track and bonus port. She pays no usual deployment costs. Collection gains 1 resource and 1 advance without upgrades, or 2 of each with either upgrade. At a wonder port, with fewer than 4 resources gain 3 fame and advance once plus once per installed upgrade; otherwise pay 4 resources to acquire the wonder and resolve its instant advances. She never gains immediate track bonuses. Collect leftovers at the deployed and bonus ports; gain the indicated free upgrade or discard market cards 3 and 4 at the Guild. Exploration replaces the cloud’s left reward with 3 fame; she ignores “all players may” trades. Recall all three deployed ships, or two when the card says so, and resolve her starting wonder’s recall benefit. Score normally, plus 2 per culinary symbol and 1 per remaining resource. Easiest ignores leftover fame. Easier uses the Workshop Visit with only a heritage symbol. Normal and harder use Factory Tour with one of each symbol. Harder levels successively add 3 starting fame and one or two starting crewmates. Her first tiebreaker counts all resources; she has no grit.

zh.name: 思路:和风庭园
zh.desc: 单人解谜:旋转摆放庭园板块,让每条小径都完成它的任务
zh.rules:
目标:用庭园板块填满谜题纸上的所有格子,让每个任务标记都满足。
准备:每题给出一个空格阵,格阵边缘标有小径出入口和任务标记;共用 7 块各不相同的庭园板块,每块每题至多用一次,可任意旋转。
流程:相邻格子的小径会自动对接。
· 点按托盘板块旋转,拖到空格放置。
· 已放板块点按旋转,拖到其他空格移动,拖出棋盘撤回。所有格子放满且全部任务标记同时满足即过关。
任务标记(挂在某个出入口上,约束从该口出发的那条小径):
· 宝塔:这条小径必须经过宝塔脚边的那一段。
· 阴阳:这条小径必须通到阴阳标志并在那里终结。
· 棕色数字:这条小径必须恰好跨过该数目的木桥。
· 绿色数字:这条小径必须恰好经过该数目的格子(重复穿过同一格要重复计数)。
· 彩色对子:相同颜色的两个出入口必须由同一条小径连通。
遇到困难时，可以点击“提示”，自动正确放置一块庭园板块。计时与最佳成绩仅用于自我挑战，并保存在本机。

en.name: Brains: Japanese Garden
en.desc: Solo puzzle: rotate garden tiles so every path fulfills its task
en.rules:
Goal: fill every cell of the puzzle sheet with garden tiles so that all task markers are satisfied.
Setup: each puzzle shows a grid of empty cells, with path entrances and task markers on its edges; you share a set of 7 distinct garden tiles, each usable at most once per puzzle, freely rotatable.
Play: paths connect automatically across adjacent cells.
· Tap a tray tile to rotate it, then drag it onto an empty cell.
· Tap a placed tile to rotate it; drag it to another empty cell to move it, or beyond the board to return it. You solve the puzzle when every cell is filled and all markers are satisfied at once.
Task markers (each hangs on an entrance and constrains the path leaving it):
· Pagoda: the path must run along the stretch right beside the pagoda.
· Yin-yang: the path must reach the yin-yang symbol and end there.
· Brown number: the path must cross exactly that many bridges.
· Green number: the path must pass through exactly that many cells (re-entering a cell counts again).
· Colored pair: the two entrances of the same color must be joined by one single path.
Stuck? Use a hint to place one tile correctly; the timer and best times are just a personal challenge, stored on this device.
