zh.name: 伯明翰
zh.desc: 工业革命英格兰:建厂、铺路、卖货,两个时代的经济博弈
zh.rules:
目标:运河与铁路两个时代,翻面产业与连接在时代末计分,总分最高者胜。
回合:每轮每人 2 个行动(运河时代首轮仅 1 个),每执行1个行动，须弃置1张手牌。
六个行动:
· 建造——弃置1张位置牌，在该城市建造任意产业，不要求该城市已接入自己的网络；也可以弃置1张产业牌，在自己网络内的城市建造对应产业。 取出自己该产业等级最低的板块，并支付所需金钱、煤炭和铁；存在只印有该产业图标的空槽时，必须使用该空槽。

· 网络——运河时代支付£3，建造1条运河；铁路时代支付£5，建造1条铁路。 也可支付 £15 加 1 份啤酒建 2 条铁路(啤酒须来自酒厂);每条铁路消耗 1 份煤。

· 研发——移除自己板上 1-2 块最低级板块,每块消耗 1 份铁;灯泡陶器不可研发。
· 出售——翻面你的棉纺厂/制造商/陶器厂:须连通收购该产业的商人,消耗板块所示数量的啤酒。 一次出售行动可以出售多块产业板块;使用商人旁的啤酒还额外获得该商人的奖励。

· 贷款——获得£30，并将收入等级降低3级。
· 侦察——弃置3张手牌，获得2张百搭牌。
资源:
· 煤从最近的连通煤矿免费获取,煤矿没煤了才向市场购买(须连通商人)。
· 铁从任意铁厂免费获取,铁厂没铁了才购买。
· 啤酒可任意使用自家酒厂的,使用对手酒厂的啤酒须与其连通。
时代:牌堆与手牌全空时时代结束;翻面产业和连接计分,运河时代末移除全部 1 级板块后进入铁路时代。
回合末:本轮花费金钱最少的玩家，在下一轮首先行动;按照收入等级领取金钱(收入为负时要支付差额,钱不够就变卖板块)。

en.name: Brass: Birmingham
en.desc: Industrial revolution England: build, connect, and sell across two eras
en.rules:
Goal: across the Canal and Rail eras, flipped industries and links score at the end of each era; most VP wins.
Turns: each round every player takes 2 actions (only 1 in the first Canal round); every action discards 1 card.
The six actions:
· Build — discard a location card to build any industry in that city (no network needed), or an industry card to build in your network. Take your lowest-level tile of that industry and pay its cost in money and coal/iron; if a slot showing only that industry is free, you must use it.

· Network — in the Canal Era, pay £3 to build 1 canal link. In the Rail Era, pay £5 to build 1 rail link, or pay £15 and consume 1 beer to build 2 rail links. This beer must come from a brewery, and each rail link also consumes 1 coal.

· Develop — remove 1 or 2 of your lowest-level industry tiles, consuming 1 iron for each tile removed. Potteries marked with a lightbulb cannot be developed.
· Sell — flip your Cotton Mills, Manufacturers and Potteries: each must connect to a merchant buying that industry and consume the beer shown. You may sell several tiles in one action; beer taken from beside a merchant also earns that merchant’s bonus.

· Loan — take £30 and drop 3 income levels.
· Scout — discard 3 cards for 2 wild cards.
Resources:
· Coal is taken free from the closest connected mine; only when mines run out do you buy from the market (needs a merchant connection).
· Iron is taken free from any iron works; only when they run out do you buy it.
· Beer from your own breweries is used freely; opponents' breweries must be connected.
Eras: an era ends when the deck and all hands are empty; flipped industries and links score, and after the Canal Era all level 1 tiles are removed.
End of round: whoever spent least goes first next round; collect income (when income is negative you must pay the difference — sell tiles if short).

zh.name: Brave & Bold: Bag Building Combat Game
zh.desc: 操纵英雄与反派的筹码袋，在危机边缘构筑连招。
zh.rules:
目标：
击败对方队伍的全部角色，便赢得游戏。角色的生命值首次降至零时，该角色负伤；如果负伤后的恢复失败，或恢复后生命值再次降至零，该角色被击败。
挑战牌堆用尽时，比较双方队伍的生命值总和，较高的一方获胜；总和相同时，由持有先手标记的一方获胜。
游戏准备：
每位玩家选择一名角色。多人对局中，英雄与反派分别组成队伍。神奇女侠需要选择两张升级牌。公共军械库共有 60 枚筹码，其中展示 6 枚；每名角色向挑战牌堆提供 5 张挑战牌。
角色的生命值上限根据对局人数确定：
· 双人对局中，每名角色的生命值上限为 60 点。
· 四人对局中，每名角色的生命值上限为 40 点。
· 六人对局中，每名角色的生命值上限为 35 点。
每轮流程：
每轮依次进行瞭望塔、准备、战斗和强化阶段，随后进行再平衡。首轮跳过瞭望塔阶段。
从第二轮开始，由生命值最低的角色取得先手；如果生命值相同，则保留原先的先手标记。揭示一张挑战牌，然后进行角色恢复。
准备阶段：
从袋中逐枚抽取筹码，每次抽取后都可以停止。抽出第三枚危机筹码时，你陷入危机，本轮不能正常使用能力，伤害和购买需要延后处理。
每次抽取后的响应全部完成后，才能继续抽取。逆转筹码可以撤回刚刚抽出的筹码。抽取奖励根据本轮实际抽到的非危机筹码数量计算；移除已抽出的筹码不会扣回奖励。直接加入当前抽区的筹码，以及此前储存的筹码，不产生抽取奖励。
战斗阶段：
先为准备使用的全部能力分配费用，再按你选择的顺序激活能力。双倍筹码提供的两个符号可以分别支付。同一项能力的基础模式和加号模式，每轮只能选择其中一种。
· 能力造成的伤害、未使用的战斗筹码及战斗奖励共同形成伤害池；终结技单独结算。
· 普通伤害可以防御。不可防御伤害不能通过防御抵消，但仍受针对整个伤害池的效果影响。
· 泥脸登场时，改为逐次攻击和回应，不形成伤害池；同一项能力可以再次使用。
强化阶段：
未陷入危机的玩家先完成强化，陷入危机的玩家随后完成。通常可以购买至多 3 种不同的筹码；陷入危机时，至多购买 2 种。每枚资源强化筹码允许额外购买一次，并使该次购买的费用减少 1 点资源。
各类筹码的购买费用如下：
· 基础筹码的费用为 2 点资源。
· 徽记筹码和特殊筹码的费用为 3 点资源。
· 双倍筹码的费用为 3 点资源。
· 强化筹码的费用为 4 点资源。
· 万能筹码和逆转筹码的费用为 5 点资源。
购买或激活临界质量，需要支付 10 个同类的战斗符号或敏捷符号。
再平衡：
先处理临时筹码，再根据袋中非危机筹码的总数，将危机筹码补至以下数量：
· 非危机筹码少于 17 枚时，补至 3 枚危机筹码。
· 非危机筹码为 17 至 20 枚时，补至 4 枚危机筹码。
· 非危机筹码为 21 至 24 枚时，补至 5 枚危机筹码。
· 非危机筹码为 25 至 31 枚时，补至 6 枚危机筹码。
· 非危机筹码为 32 至 39 枚时，补至 7 枚危机筹码。
· 非危机筹码为 40 枚及以上时，补至 8 枚危机筹码。
最后，将弃置区和当前抽区的筹码装回袋中。
团队规则：
队伍可以将伤害池中的伤害及恢复效果分配给多个目标，也可以共同支付购买所需的资源，并为队友防御。终结技只能指定一名对手。各角色的特殊能力详见角色说明及官方常见问题解答。

en.name: Brave & Bold: Bag Building Combat Game
en.desc: Build a bag of powers, push your luck, and battle as DC heroes and villains.
en.rules:
Goal:
Defeat every character on the opposing team to win. A character becomes injured when their health first reaches zero. If their next recovery fails, or their health reaches zero again after recovery, that character is defeated.
When the challenge deck runs out, the team with the higher total health wins. If totals are tied, the team holding the first-player marker wins.
Setup:
Each player chooses a character. In team games, heroes and villains form opposing teams. Wonder Woman chooses two upgrades. The Armoury contains 60 tokens, with six revealed. Each character contributes five challenge cards.
Each character's health limit depends on the player count:
· In a duel, the health limit is 60.
· With four players, the health limit is 40.
· With six players, the health limit is 35.
Round sequence:
Resolve Watchtower, Preparation, Combat and Power-Up in that order, followed by Rebalance. Skip Watchtower in the first round.
From the second round onward, the character with the lowest health takes the first-player marker; a tie leaves the marker with its current holder. Reveal a challenge, then resolve character recovery.
Preparation:
Draw one token at a time from your bag. You may stop after any draw. Drawing a third Crisis token triggers a crisis: normal ability use is skipped, and damage and purchases are delayed.
Resolve all responses to a draw before drawing again. Reverse may undo the token just drawn. Draw bonuses depend on the non-Crisis tokens actually drawn this round; removing a drawn token does not remove its bonus. Stored tokens and tokens added directly to the current draw do not earn draw bonuses.
Combat:
Allocate all ability costs before activating abilities in your chosen order. The two symbols on a Double token may be allocated separately. For each ability, choose either its base or plus mode for the round.
· Ability damage, unused Combat tokens and combat bonuses form the damage pool. Finishing moves resolve separately.
· Normal damage may be defended. Indefensible damage cannot be prevented through defense, but effects that modify the entire damage pool still apply to it.
· When Clayface is in play, resolve separate attacks and responses instead of forming a damage pool. The same ability may then be used again.
Power-Up:
Players without a crisis finish Power-Up before players in crisis. Normally, you may buy up to three distinct token types; in a crisis, you may buy up to two. Each Resource Power-Up token allows one extra purchase and reduces that purchase's cost by 1 resource.
Token costs are as follows:
· A Basic token costs 2 resources.
· A Crest or Special token costs 3 resources.
· A Double token costs 3 resources.
· A Power-Up token costs 4 resources.
· A Utility or Reverse token costs 5 resources.
Purchasing or activating Critical Mass requires ten matching Combat symbols or ten matching Agility symbols.
Rebalance:
Return temporary tokens first. Then bring the number of Crisis tokens up to the amount determined by your non-Crisis token count:
· Fewer than 17 non-Crisis tokens require 3 Crisis tokens.
· Between 17 and 20 non-Crisis tokens require 4 Crisis tokens.
· Between 21 and 24 non-Crisis tokens require 5 Crisis tokens.
· Between 25 and 31 non-Crisis tokens require 6 Crisis tokens.
· Between 32 and 39 non-Crisis tokens require 7 Crisis tokens.
· At least 40 non-Crisis tokens require 8 Crisis tokens.
Finally, return the tokens in your discard and current draw to your bag.
Team rules:
Teams may split damage from their pool and recovery effects among multiple targets, share purchase resources and defend teammates. A finishing move targets only one opponent. Consult the character instructions and official FAQ for special abilities.

zh.name: Bravo!
zh.desc: 《再来一次》续作骰写:连通涂格,抢行列与颜色奖励
zh.rules:
目标:在计分纸上涂格,填满行、列与同色区域得分,总分最高者获胜。
准备:每人一张计分纸,15 列(A-O)、7 行(P-V),起始列为 H 列。
流程:
· 主动玩家掷全部 7 颗骰子(3 颜色、3 数字、1 特殊),先选 1 颗颜色骰和 1 颗数字骰,或选特殊骰。
· 其他玩家从剩余的骰子中选择。前三次掷骰中，所有玩家均可从全部骰子中选择；主动玩家放弃选择时，其他玩家也可从全部骰子中选择。
· 普通组合:按数字骰点数涂该颜色恰好数量的格子;这些格必须同色同块、横竖连通,且至少一格在 H 列或与已有涂格相邻。
· 颜色骰的黑 X 与数字骰的 ? 是百搭:每用 1 个百搭划掉 1 个「!」(共 6 个)。
· 选特殊骰则执行其骰面效果,并消耗 1 个已圈的特殊骰(开局已圈 1 个,涂到金色骰子格可再圈 1 个)。
特殊骰:
· 炸弹:在任意 2 行 2 列的方块区域内涂至多 4 格,无需与已有涂格相邻。
· 爱心:圈 1 颗爱心;之后每完成一列,额外获得当时已圈爱心数的加分。
· 双星:涂至多 2 个星标格,须与已有涂格相邻或在 H 列。
· 同行三格:涂同一行至多 3 格,每格须与已有涂格相邻。
· 整块:涂满一个与已有涂格相邻的同色块。
计分:
· 列:首先完成该列的玩家获得该列上方标示的分值，其他完成该列的玩家获得下方标示的分值;完成列时额外获得等于当时已圈爱心数量的分数。
· 行:每行 5 分;首个完成该行的玩家获得行奖励(特殊骰/炸弹/爱心)。
· 颜色:首个涂满某色的玩家获得 5 分,其余涂满的玩家获得 3 分。
· 同一掷内多人同时先完成同一行、列或颜色,共享先手待遇。
结束:有玩家涂满第 2 种颜色时,该掷结束后游戏结束。
结算:颜色分、列分、行分、爱心分相加;每个剩余「!」加 1 分。
· 每个已圈未用的特殊骰加 2 分,每个未涂星标格扣 2 分;总分相同时，剩余“!”标记较多的玩家获胜。

en.name: Bravo!
en.desc: Roll-and-write sequel to Encore!: cross connected blocks, race for row, column and color bonuses
en.rules:
Goal: Cross off boxes on your sheet to complete rows, columns and same-color regions. Highest total score wins.
Setup: Each player gets a sheet: 15 columns (A-O) by 7 rows (P-V). Column H is the starting column.
Play:
· The active player rolls all 7 dice (3 color, 3 number, 1 special), then takes 1 color die and 1 number die, or the special die.
· Everyone else picks from the remaining dice; in the first 3 throws everyone picks from all dice, and if the active player passes, the others also pick from all dice.
· Color + number combo: cross exactly that many boxes of that color. They must form one connected group inside a single color block, with at least one box in column H or orthogonally adjacent to an existing cross.
· The black X on color dice and the ? on number dice are jokers: each joker used crosses out one "!" (you have 6).
· Choosing the special die applies its face effect and spends one circled special die (you start with one circled; crossing a golden die box circles another).
Special die:
· Bomb: cross up to 4 boxes inside any single 2-by-2 area, no adjacency required.
· Heart: circle a heart; whenever you complete a column later, gain bonus points equal to your circled hearts at that moment.
· Two stars: cross up to 2 star boxes, adjacent to an existing cross or in column H.
· Three in a row: cross up to 3 boxes in one row, each adjacent to an existing cross.
· Color block: cross an entire color block adjacent to an existing cross.
Scoring:
· Columns: the first player(s) to complete a column get the upper value, later players the lower value; completing a column also adds your current circled-heart count.
· Rows: each completed row is worth 5 points; the first player(s) to complete a row also gain its bonus (special die / bomb / heart).
· Colors: the first player(s) to finish a color get 5 points, everyone else who finishes it gets 3.
· Players completing the same row, column or color on the same throw all share the first finisher bonus.
End: the game ends after the throw in which a player completes their second color.
Final score: add color, column, row and heart points; gain 1 point per unused "!".
· Gain 2 per circled unused special die and lose 2 per uncrossed star box; ties are broken by remaining "!".

zh.name: 魔女快递
zh.desc: 秘密选择角色，争夺勇敢行动，骑着扫帚运送魔药。
zh.rules:
目标:
七轮后胜利点最多者获胜。同分时，剩余资源总数较多者获胜，再同则并列。
准备:
每人获得10张角色牌、两枚棋子、10胜利点和绿、紫、橙药水各1瓶。两枚棋子分别从两座城堡出发。起始玩家及其右侧玩家各获得1根魔杖，其余玩家各获得2根。两人局双方各获得1根。药水与魔杖统称资源，供给不限。
正面地图随机放置18片云，背面放置19片。重云共24片：消耗1、2、3根魔杖且带1道闪电的各7片，消耗3根且带2道闪电的2片，消耗6根且带3道闪电的1片。随机使用10张事件中的7张，每轮翻开一张。2至4人局每轮分别公开3、2、1张被诅咒角色；打出这些角色立即失去3点，无论勇敢、胆怯或最终能否执行。
流程:
每轮所有人秘密选择4张不同的角色牌，全部确认后开始。轮次中从起始玩家开始领出一个角色，并选择勇敢或胆怯。依顺时针轮到各玩家；持有同一角色时必须跟牌，没有该角色时跳过。轮到自己前不得透露是否持有。已公开的角色和剩余手牌张数始终可见。
胆怯行动立即执行；勇敢者等待其他人宣告。后来的勇敢者夺走先前勇敢者的行动，最后一位勇敢者执行并成为下次领出者。全员胆怯时，原领出者继续；领出者没有手牌时，顺时针交给仍有牌者。所有人用完手牌后处理轮末事件。下一轮由最后一位勇敢者开始；最后一个角色全员胆怯时，仍由该角色的领出者开始。
可以全部或部分放弃行动。即使不执行，最后勇敢者仍取得下次领出权。
角色:
· 森林、草原、丘陵、高山女巫：胆怯时将任一棋子移至相邻的对应地形，勇敢时移动后还可在到达地形送1瓶药水。不能进入或跨越水域、有云的区域。可以只移动不送货，不能不移动就送货。
· 草药采集者：胆怯获得1瓶绿色药水；勇敢获得2瓶绿色药水和1根魔杖。
· 水果采集者：胆怯获得1瓶紫色药水；勇敢获得2瓶紫色药水，再选择任意颜色药水1瓶。
· 根茎采集者：胆怯获得1瓶橙色药水或1根魔杖；勇敢获得1瓶橙色药水和2根魔杖。
· 山峰德鲁伊：在本人棋子所在的丘陵或高山送1瓶药水。
· 山谷德鲁伊：在本人棋子所在的森林或草原送1瓶药水。
勇敢德鲁伊成功送货时额外获得3点。
· 天气仙子：选择本人任一棋子相邻的一片云，支付星形数字所示魔杖，收下该云。勇敢成功时额外获得3点。云上的闪电在终局计分。
送货:
塔基接触的区域都可送货，药水颜色必须与塔顶相符。圆塔只能接收一次，药水留在塔上；带旗的方塔可重复接收，药水交回供给。每次送货获得塔上胜利点及标明的魔杖。每位玩家每个角色向方塔至多送货1瓶，额外送货效果也计入。所有人共用塔的占用状态。
事件:
· 两手空空：轮末资源总数不超过5时获得3点。
· 安全之地：轮末每枚棋子在草原获得2点、丘陵获得1点、高山失去1点。
· 危险之地：轮末每枚棋子在草原失去3点、丘陵失去2点、森林失去1点。
· 黑市：每次胆怯可用获得3点替代角色行动。
· 秘密蒸馏：每次胆怯可用获得任意1份资源替代角色行动。
· 多一点，少一点：改为秘密选择1至5张角色，全部确认后同时公开张数，分别获得10、6、3、0、−3点。森林板块增加的额外牌不影响这项计分。
· 全套齐备：轮末可支付每种资源各1份，获得9点，至多一次。
· 结伴同行：轮末两枚棋子地形相同则获得4点，不必在同一区域。
· 占得上风：轮末同时秘密出价，资源种类任意；最高出价的所有玩家支付所出资源，各获得8点，其他人不支付。
· 勇敢之心：每个角色的领出者必须勇敢；整轮起始玩家获得1根魔杖。
盒内变体:
默认使用正面基础地图且关闭风暴云与山地板块。风暴云混入重云后随机放置：2片常驻云让相邻棋子每次送货额外获得2点；2片移除后允许一次相邻移动；1片移除后允许送货；另外3片移除时，持有至少3瓶橙药、4瓶绿药、4瓶紫药分别获得7、8、9点，药水不消耗。
山地板块随机选3种放在指定山地；仅被板块遮住的塔失去功能。每位玩家首次到达该山地时领取自己的护符，可当场完整执行板块效果：三色药水各1瓶、2根魔杖、任一棋子送货、最多两次移动、移除1片云。后续到访不能再次执行。可任意安排板块效果与勇敢高山女巫在此处的送货顺序；若先移走该棋子，便不能用这次女巫行动在别处送货。
背面地图必须同时使用山地、森林、丘陵板块。森林首次到达者领取板块，在后续行动使用：胆怯执行勇敢效果但不争夺勇敢权、轮初增加1张角色、胆怯替代行动获得5点，各2张，每个角色至多使用1张。额外牌可在初选张数公开后决定；不能避开勇敢之心的领出限制。丘陵板块中5张要求立即传送至标示两个石环之一，另1张提供可重复接收橙药的7点方塔。勇敢丘陵女巫在最终位置送货。石环D所在岛屿无法离开。
结束:
七轮后，按持有的闪电数量获得终局胜利点：
· 没有闪电时，获得0点。
· 有1道闪电时，获得3点。
· 有2道闪电时，获得6点。
· 有3道闪电时，获得10点。
· 有4道闪电时，获得14点。
· 有5道闪电时，获得19点。
· 有6道闪电时，获得24点。
· 有至少7道闪电时，获得30点。
剩余资源每套四种获得4点，每套三种获得2点，每份只能使用一次，取最大组合。1、2、3枚护符分别获得4、9、15点。加上对局胜利点确定胜者。

en.name: Broom Service
en.desc: Choose roles in secret, risk brave actions, and deliver magical potions.
en.rules:
Goal:
After seven rounds, the most victory points wins. Break ties by total remaining resources, then share the win.
Setup:
Each player receives 10 role cards, two pawns, 10 VP, and one green, purple and orange potion. Place one pawn at each castle. The first player and the player to their right receive one wand; everyone else receives two. In a two-player game, both receive one. Potions and wands are resources; supplies are unlimited.
Randomly place 18 clouds on the front or 19 on the back. The 24 heavy clouds comprise seven each costing 1, 2 or 3 wands with one lightning bolt, two costing 3 with two bolts, and one costing 6 with three bolts. Shuffle ten events and use seven, revealing one each round. With 2/3/4 players, reveal 3/2/1 bewitched roles each round. Playing one immediately costs 3 VP, regardless of courage or whether the action happens.
Play:
Everyone secretly chooses four different roles. Once everyone commits, the leader plays a role bravely or cowardly. Proceed clockwise: anyone holding that role must follow; anyone without it passes. Do not reveal whether you hold a role before your turn. Played roles and remaining hand sizes are public.
Cowardly actions happen immediately. Brave players wait: a later brave player steals the action from the previous one. The last brave player acts and leads next. If all are cowardly, the original leader leads again. If the leader has no cards, pass clockwise to someone who does. When all hands are empty, resolve the round-end event. The last brave player leads the next round; if the final trick had no brave player, that trick’s original leader leads.
Any action may be partly or wholly declined. The last brave player still leads even after declining the action.
Roles:
· Forest, prairie, hill and mountain witches: cowardly, move one pawn to an adjacent area of the matching terrain. Brave, move and optionally deliver one potion there. Water and areas containing clouds cannot be entered or crossed. You may move without delivering, but cannot deliver without moving.
· Herb gatherer: acting cowardly gains one green potion; acting bravely gains two green potions and one wand.
· Fruit gatherer: acting cowardly gains one purple potion; acting bravely gains two purple potions and one potion of any color.
· Root gatherer: acting cowardly gains one orange potion or one wand; acting bravely gains one orange potion and two wands.
· Peak druid: deliver one potion from a pawn on a hill or mountain.
· Valley druid: deliver from a pawn in a forest or prairie.
A successful brave druid delivery scores 3 extra VP.
· Weather fairy: pay a cloud's star cost in wands to charm it away from an area adjacent to either pawn. Keep its lightning. Brave scores 3 extra VP only if a cloud is removed.
Delivery:
A tower is accessible from every area touching its base. Match the potion to its roof color. Round towers accept one delivery in the entire game; leave the potion there. Flagged square towers accept repeat deliveries; return the potion to supply. Gain the printed VP and wands. Each player may deliver only one potion to square towers per role, including extra delivery effects. Occupancy is shared by everyone.
Events:
· Empty Handed: at round end, gain 3 VP with at most five resources.
· Protected Places: each pawn scores prairie +2, hill +1, mountain −1, forest 0.
· Perilous Places: each pawn scores prairie −3, hill −2, forest −1, mountain 0.
· Black Market: replace any cowardly role action with 3 VP.
· Black Distillery: replace any cowardly action with any one resource.
· More or Less: secretly choose between one and five roles, then reveal the counts together. Choosing one, two, three, four or five roles scores 10, 6, 3, 0 or −3 VP respectively. A forest tile's extra card does not affect this score.
· The Works: at round end, optionally pay one of each resource for 9 VP, once.
· Flock Together: gain 4 VP if both pawns end the round in the same terrain type, even in different areas.
· The Upper Hand: bid resources of any types simultaneously and secretly. Every highest bidder pays their bid and gains 8 VP; other players pay nothing.
· Brave Heart: the first player of every role must be brave. The first player of the round gains one wand.
Box Variations:
The default is the front board with storm clouds and mountain tiles disabled. Storm clouds are shuffled with heavy clouds: two grant +2 VP on each delivery from an adjacent pawn while they remain; two grant an adjacent movement when removed; one grants a delivery; three grant 7/8/9 VP when removed if you hold at least 3 orange/4 green/4 purple potions, without spending them.
Place three random mountain tiles on their designated areas, only towers actually covered lose their function. On a player's first arrival at each, claim their amulet and optionally use the complete tile effect immediately: one potion of each color, two wands, a delivery with either pawn, up to two movements, or one cloud removal. Later visits do not repeat the effect. Choose the order of the tile effect and a brave mountain witch’s delivery here. If that pawn moves away first, the witch cannot deliver at a different destination.
The back board requires mountain, forest and hill tiles. First arrivals claim forest tiles for later use: act cowardly but use the brave effect without stealing brave priority; add one role at round start; or replace a cowardly action with 5 VP. There are two of each. Use at most one tile per role; decide an extra card after initial counts are revealed if desired. Tiles cannot avoid Brave Heart's obligation. Five hill tiles immediately teleport to one of their two marked stone circles; one supplies a repeatable orange tower worth 7 VP. A brave hill witch may deliver at the final destination. The island with circle D cannot be left.
End:
Score your lightning bolts as follows:
· No lightning bolts score 0 VP.
· One lightning bolt scores 3 VP.
· Two lightning bolts score 6 VP.
· Three lightning bolts score 10 VP.
· Four lightning bolts score 14 VP.
· Five lightning bolts score 19 VP.
· Six lightning bolts score 24 VP.
· Seven or more lightning bolts score 30 VP. Each set of four different remaining resources scores 4 VP; each set of three scores 2 VP. Use each resource only once and maximize the combination. 1/2/3 amulets score 4/9/15 VP. Add these to the points earned during play.

zh.name: 布魯日
zh.desc: 在运河古城招募人物、修建房屋与运河，争取声望。
zh.rules:
目标：游戏结束时总分最高者获胜，同分时持有钱币较多的玩家获胜。
准备：每名玩家获得5分、5枚钱币，以及五种颜色的工人各1名。每张人物牌有颜色、钱币费用、阶层与能力。
每轮：依先手顺序补至 5 张手牌。逐张选择牌堆，只能看牌背颜色，补牌完毕后查看牌面。掷五色骰子：5 或 6 使每人获得同色威胁。将所有 1、2 点骰子相加，每人可支付与该总和相等数量的钱币前进 1 格声望；没有 1、2 点则不能购买。
行动：依次轮转四次。轮到你时，必须使用 1 张手牌进行以下一种行动，并可在此前后激活自己尚未使用的主动人物：
· 获得2名与该牌颜色相同的工人。
· 获得与该牌颜色的骰子点数相等数量的钱币。
· 移除 1 枚该牌颜色的威胁，获得 1 分。
· 支付1名与该牌颜色相同的工人，将牌背面建成空房屋。
· 选择一侧未完成运河，打出匹配下一段颜色的牌，并支付该段所示的1至5枚钱币。
· 支付人物的钱币费用，将其放进自己任意空房屋。
人物能力：
· 一次性能力在招募时执行。
· 工人能力需要支付1名标示颜色的工人，每轮最多使用1次。
· 免费主动能力每轮最多使用1次。
· 持续能力在场时生效。
· 终局能力在计分时生效。
房屋颜色与其中人物颜色可以不同。
灾难：同色威胁达到 3 枚时，弃回全部该色威胁并承受灾难。
· 蓝色失去全部工人。
· 黄色使你失去全部钱币。
· 紫色失去 3 分，最低 0 分。
· 棕色弃置自己一个人物，房屋保留。
· 红色失去自己一座房屋或一侧末段运河。
失去房屋时，其人物返回手牌。多项灾难自行选择次序。
轮末：分别比较声望、人物数、运河总段数。某项数值独自最高且大于0的玩家，将自己的该项多数标记翻面；每枚已翻面的多数标记在终局获得4分；已翻面标记不会失去。先手顺延。
运河与声望：一侧运河至少完成3段时，该侧运河在终局获得3分；完成 5 段时拿取最高剩余雕像，按雕像数字计分，失去运河不退雕像，重新完成同侧不再领取。声望轨终局分为 0、1、2、3、4、5、7、9、12。
结束：首次牌堆耗尽时使用预留牌。若发生在补牌阶段，本轮为最后一轮；若发生在行动阶段，下一轮为最后一轮。最终得分为现有分数、人物牌钱币费用的三分之一、每座房屋 1 分、终局能力、多数标记、运河、雕像与声望。
可选扩展：新人加入 39 张人物与旅人阶层；第五玩家包含新人，支持 5 人。船只在同色骰子为 3 或 4 时到港；只有使用牌建渠后，可支付任意一艘到港船同色的1名工人使用该船一次。船只的效果如下：
· 获得任意颜色的工人共3名。
· 获得6枚钱币。
· 移除至多2枚威胁。
· 再次执行一名人物的一次性能力。
· 抽取1张牌并立即使用。
· 免费前进声望。
下一艘船公开，色堆用尽重洗。市场在补牌后、掷骰前揭示一张。对应的打牌行动可选择使用市场改良，也可按普通行动执行；只有使用改良才消耗一次，先到先用，轮末弃置；12 张用尽不重洗。
牌面详情可点开查看。部分外文版存在歧义：演员、市场免费激活不消耗正常次数；瑞典人只复制主动或一次性能力；弄臣自动选择最优的两种额外阶层。

en.name: Bruges
en.desc: Recruit people, build houses and canals, and gain prestige in medieval Bruges.
en.rules:
Goal: score the most points at game end. Ties favor more guilders.
Start with 5 points, 5 guilders and 1 worker of each of the five colors. Each card has a color, cost, group and ability.
Each round: refill to 5 cards in turn order. Choose a stack for each draw by its visible back color; see the drawn faces only when refill finishes. Roll all five dice. Each 5 or 6 gives everyone a matching threat. Add all dice showing 1 or 2; each player may pay that total to advance 1 prestige space. With no 1 or 2, prestige cannot normally be bought.
Actions: take four turns each, rotating in order. On your turn use 1 hand card for one of six actions, activating any unused active people before or after it:
· Take 2 workers matching the card.
· Take guilders equal to its die.
· Remove 1 matching threat and gain 1 point.
· Pay 1 matching worker and build the card face down as an empty house.
· Extend either canal using a card matching its next section and pay that section’s cost of 1–5 guilders.
· Pay the person’s cost and recruit it into any empty house.
Abilities:
· Immediate abilities resolve upon recruitment.
· Worker abilities cost 1 worker of the shown color, once per round.
· Free active abilities are once per round.
· Passive abilities work while the person remains in play.
· Endgame abilities score at the end.
House and occupant colors need not match.
Disasters: reaching 3 threats of a color returns all threats of that color and causes its disaster.
· Blue: lose all workers.
· Yellow: lose all guilders.
· Purple: lose 3 points, to a minimum of 0.
· Brown: discard one person of your choice, keeping the house.
· Red: lose one house or an end section of either canal.
A person in a lost house returns to your hand. Choose the order of simultaneous disasters.
Round end: compare prestige, number of people, and total canal sections separately. The sole leader with more than zero flips their marker for that category, worth 4 points at game end. Claimed markers are never lost. Pass first player clockwise.
Canals and prestige: each side with at least 3 sections scores 3 points at game end. Completing 5 takes the highest remaining statue. Keep statues even if a section is lost; completing that same side again gives no further statue. Prestige spaces score 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 9, 12.
End: the first depleted stack brings in the reserve. If depleted during refill, this is the final round; during actions, the following round is final. Score current points, one third of each recruited person’s printed cost, 1 per house, endgame abilities, majority markers, canals, statues and prestige.
Optional modules: New Citizens adds 39 people and the travelers group. Fifth Player includes New Citizens and allows five players. Ships enter port when their die shows 3 or 4. After a card canal action, you may pay 1 worker matching any active ship to use that ship once. Ship effects are:
· Gain 3 workers in any colors.
· Gain 6 guilders.
· Remove up to 2 threats.
· Reactivate one immediate person.
· Draw and immediately use 1 card.
· Advance prestige for free.
The next ship is public; reshuffle exhausted color decks. Market reveals one card after refill and before rolling each round. For matching card actions, choose either the ordinary action or the market improvement. Only using the improvement consumes one of its limited uses. Discard the market at round end. Its 12 cards are not reshuffled.
Open a card for its details. Ambiguous edition details: Actor and market bonus activations do not consume normal uses; Swede copies active or immediate abilities only; Jester selects the best two extra groups automatically.

zh.name: 弹丸甜心
zh.desc: 在弹幕中拼图清场,把子弹轰给左手边的对手
zh.rules:
目标:在弹幕中存活到最后。将视野中清除的子弹送给左侧对手。
准备:
· 每人选一名女主角,获得她的行动、星行动、独有技能与专属图案牌堆,并抽 3 张图案作手牌。
· 视野是 5 列、6 行的网格。中央弹袋共 140 颗子弹,开局每人从中央随机抽 10 颗放入自己的弹袋。
· 强度轨从 4 起步,随回合攀升。
流程:每回合所有人同时自由行动,顺序与次数不限——
· 放置子弹:从弹袋抽一颗,放进颜色对应的列,落在该列第「数字」个空格(跳过已占的格子)。落出视野底边即被命中,扣 1 点生命。
· 使用行动:消耗行动点(AP)移动子弹、抽图案等,行动写在各自的行动板上。
· 使用图案:图案网格与视野中的排列完全一致(不可旋转/镜像)时可打出,清除 X 格上的子弹,送入左手边对手的来袭区。
· 清除带星子弹时(任何方式),触发你行动板上所有星行动。
· 弹袋用尽后，才能结束本轮行动；所有玩家都结束行动后，进入结束阶段：从中央选择并拿取一个道具、补抽图案至手牌上限、再按强度从中央抽弹放入弹袋。
· 随后强度上升 1(本回合每有一人失去生命再上升 1),来袭区的子弹倒入弹袋,将行动点恢复至上限,开始新回合。
结束:
· 只剩一名女主角存活时她获胜;同一回合全员倒下时,弹袋余弹最少者获胜,若仍然相同，则进入死亡加赛。
· 中央弹袋被抽空时,全员力竭,平局。
单人冲分:没有道具;清除的子弹放上强度轨,每颗使当回合强度上升 1;成绩等于存活的回合数。

en.name: Bullet♥
en.desc: Clear patterns in your bullet-riddled sight and bury your left neighbor in lead
en.rules:
Goal: Be the last heroine standing. Clear bullets from your sight and send them to the player on your left.
Setup:
· Each player picks a heroine with her own actions, star actions, unique ability and pattern deck, then draws 3 patterns.
· Your sight has 5 columns and 6 rows. The center holds 140 bullets; each player draws 10 at random into their own bag.
· The intensity track starts at 4 and climbs every round.
Play: Each round, everyone acts simultaneously, in any order, as often as they can —
· Place bullets: draw from your bag, drop it into the column matching its color, landing on the Nth open space down (N = its number), skipping occupied spaces. Falling off the bottom means a hit: lose 1 life.
· Use actions: spend AP to move bullets, draw patterns, and more, as listed on your board.
· Use patterns: if a pattern grid exactly matches an arrangement in your sight (no rotating or mirroring), play it to clear the bullets on its X spaces, sending them to the incoming area of the player on your left.
· Clearing a starred bullet (by any means) triggers all of your star actions.
· You may only finish once your bag is empty. When everyone is done, the End Phase begins: take one powerup from the middle, redraw patterns up to your hand size, then draw bullets from the center equal to the intensity.
· Then intensity rises by 1 (plus 1 per heroine who lost life this round), incoming bullets pour into your bag, AP refills, and a new round begins.
Game end:
· The last heroine standing wins. If everyone falls in the same round, whoever has the fewest bullets left in their bag wins; still tied, sudden death decides.
· If the center runs out of bullets, everyone is exhausted — the game is a tie.
Score Attack (solo): no powerups; cleared bullets go onto the intensity track, each raising this round's intensity by 1; your score is the number of rounds you survive.

zh.name: 神偷拍档
zh.desc: 合作潜入大楼:躲开巡逻守卫,撬开所有保险箱,带着战利品从屋顶逃脱
zh.rules:
目标:合作撬开所有保险箱并集齐战利品,全员从顶层楼梯登上屋顶;任何人隐身耗尽被抓,全队立即失败。
回合:每回合有四点行动,自由组合下列动作——
· 侦察(一点):翻开一个相邻房间,全员可见。
· 移动(一点):走进相邻房间;走进未翻开的房间会当场翻开。
· 黑客(一点):在电脑房放置一枚黑客标记,可抵消同类型警报。
· 加骰(两点):为所在的保险箱增加一颗骰子。
· 撬箱(一点):掷出保险箱上的全部骰子,盖住组合数字。
门槛:进入没有其他玩家的死门房需要花费3点行动；进入激光房需要花费2点行动,否则触发警报;密码盘房要掷出六才能进入。
破解:保险箱的整行整列全部翻开后才可知组合;覆盖全部组合数字后，保险箱才算破解。
收获:每破解一个保险箱抽一张工具卡和一张战利品卡;本层与下层的守卫从此永久加速。
事件:本回合花费不超过两点行动时,回合结束抽一张事件卡。
守卫:回合结束时所在层的守卫朝目的地移动,步数等于掷出的骰子点数加上响着的警报数;与守卫位于同一格时，交出1枚隐身标记。
特殊:楼梯通往上一层;两条通风管都翻开后可以互通。
坠落:走进未翻开的天台走道会坠落一层;在热感房结束回合会触发警报。
提示:点击当前不可选择的房间可查看它的说明。

en.name: Burgle Bros
en.desc: Co-op heist: dodge the patrols, crack every safe, and escape from the roof with the loot
en.rules:
Goal: crack every safe, collect all the loot, and get the whole crew out via the top-floor stairs; if anyone runs out of stealth and gets caught, the team fails at once.
Turn: each turn you have four actions, spent freely among——
· Peek (one): reveal an adjacent room to everyone.
· Move (one): step into an adjacent room; entering an unrevealed room reveals it.
· Hack (one): place a hack token in a computer room; tokens cancel alarms of their type.
· Add die (two): add one die to the safe you stand on.
· Crack (one): roll all dice on the safe to cover the combination numbers.
Thresholds: an empty Deadbolt room costs three actions to enter; a Laser room costs two, or it triggers an alarm; a Keypad room requires rolling a six.
Cracking: the combination is known only once the safe's whole row and column are revealed; covering every number cracks the safe.
Reward: each cracked safe draws one tool card and one loot card; guards on that floor and below permanently speed up.
Events: if you spent at most two actions this turn, draw an event card when the turn ends.
Guard: at the end of your turn, the guard on your floor moves toward his destination by the rolled die plus the number of ringing alarms; sharing his tile costs one stealth.
Special: stairs lead one floor up; the two service ducts link once both are revealed.
Falling: stepping into an unrevealed walkway drops you one floor; ending your turn on a thermo room triggers an alarm.
Tip: tap a room that is not a legal choice to see what it does.

zh.name: 同谋 Cahoots
zh.desc: 合作出牌:轮流往四个牌堆放牌,凑出目标牌要求的牌面,全程不许透露手牌
zh.rules:
目标:全队合作完成所有目标牌,即共同获胜。
组件:
· 数字牌 56 张:4 种颜色 × 数字 1~7,各两张。
· 目标牌 50 张,按难度取出一部分组成本局目标牌堆。
流程:
· 每人 4 张手牌,彼此保密;桌面有 4 个明置牌堆与 4 张公开目标牌。
· 轮到你:将一张手牌放到任一牌堆顶,须与堆顶牌同色或同号,然后将手牌补回 4 张。
· 打出的牌使某张公开目标成立时(只检查四个堆顶),该目标立即完成,并补翻一张新目标。
失败:
· 抽牌堆抽空且全员手牌打完,或轮到的玩家没有任何合法出牌。
沟通限制:
· 不得透露自己手牌的颜色或数字;只能表达想往哪堆放、建议完成哪张目标。
· 目标判定严格按字面执行:例如「三堆粉色」必须恰好三堆。

en.name: Cahoots
en.desc: Co-op card play: match color or number onto four piles and meet every goal — without revealing your hand
en.rules:
Goal: complete all goal cards together to win as a team.
Contents:
· 56 number cards: 4 colors × numbers 1–7, two of each.
· 50 goal cards; a subset forms this game's goal deck depending on difficulty.
How to play:
· Everyone holds 4 secret cards; the table has 4 face-up piles and 4 visible goal cards.
· On your turn: play one card from your hand onto a pile — it must match the top card in color or number — then draw back up to 4.
· If your card makes any visible goal true (judged on the four pile tops), that goal is completed at once and a new one is revealed.
You lose:
· If the draw pile runs out with all hands empty, or a player cannot legally play.
Table talk:
· Never reveal the colors or numbers in your hand; you may only say which pile you want to play on or suggest which goal to finish.
· Goals are judged exactly as written: “three pink piles” means exactly three.

zh.name: 狂野骆驼
zh.desc: 骆驼赛跑下注:赛段拿票赚快钱,总冠垫底押大牌,小心逆行的疯狂骆驼
zh.rules:
目标:比赛结束时,持有埃及镑最多的玩家获胜;平局则共享胜利。
准备:
· 5 只竞赛骆驼各自掷骰,放在第 1 至 3 格。
· 疯狂模式下,2 只疯狂骆驼(黑色、白色)放在第 16 至 14 格,朝相反方向行进。
· 每名玩家起始持有 3 埃及镑、五种颜色的终点卡各 1 张、观众板块 1 块。
流程:
· 顺时针轮流行动,每回合从以下四种行动中选择一种。
· 拿取任意一叠顶部的下注票,表示你押注该颜色的骆驼在本赛段领先。
· 放置或移动自己的观众板块:只能放在没有骆驼的空格,不得与已有板块相邻,不能放在第 1 格。
· 拿取 1 张金字塔票并摇骰:摇出某色骰子,该色骆驼前进 1 至 3 格。
· 灰色骰子按骰面颜色移动对应的黑色或白色疯狂骆驼,前进掷出的点数格。
· 将 1 张终点卡面朝下押到最终第一名或最终最后一名牌堆,押出后不可收回。
移动:
· 骆驼移动时会驮走位于其上方的所有骆驼;落在已有骆驼的格子时,跳到该栈顶部。
· 停在观众板块上时,板块主人获得 1 埃及镑;板块对疯狂骆驼的作用方向相反。
· 欢呼面使骆驼再前进 1 格,嘘声面使骆驼后退 1 格(落格时塞到栈底)。
· 同一栈内位置靠上的骆驼视为领先;疯狂骆驼不参与任何名次。
赛段结算:
· 5 张金字塔票全部被拿走后,本赛段结束,结算下注票:
· 领先骆驼的票按票面价值(5、3、2)获得埃及镑,第二名的每张获得 1 埃及镑。
· 其余票每张失去 1 埃及镑,金字塔票每张获得 1 埃及镑。
· 观众板块归还、下注票重置、骰子放回金字塔,由下一位玩家开始新赛段。
终局:
· 任何骆驼(包括逆行的疯狂骆驼)越过终点线时,比赛立即结束,并追加一次赛段结算。
· 终点卡结算:每堆按押注先后依次翻开。
· 押中者第 1、2、3、4 张分别获得 8、5、3、2 埃及镑,之后每张获得 1 埃及镑;押错每张失去 1 埃及镑。
· 最终最后一名为最落后的竞赛骆驼;被疯狂骆驼逆行驮过终点线的骆驼视为最落后。
· 金钱不会低于 0。
说明:6 人以上的「投注伙伴」规则未收录。

en.name: Camel Up
en.desc: Bet on the camel race: leg tickets for quick cash, long-shot cards for glory — and beware the crazy camels
en.rules:
Goal: when the race ends, the player with the most Egyptian Pounds wins; tied players share the victory.
Setup:
· The 5 racing camels each roll a die and start on spaces 1 to 3.
· In crazy mode, the 2 crazy camels (black and white) start on spaces 16 to 14, running in the opposite direction.
· Each player starts with 3 Egyptian Pounds, one finish card of each color, and 1 spectator tile.
Play:
· Players take turns clockwise, choosing one of the following four actions each turn.
· Take the top betting ticket of any stack, backing that camel to lead the leg.
· Place or move your spectator tile: only on a space without camels, never adjacent to another tile, and never on space 1.
· Take 1 pyramid ticket and roll: the camel of the rolled color moves 1 to 3 spaces.
· The grey die shows a black or white face: the matching crazy camel moves forward the rolled number of spaces.
· Place 1 finish card face down onto the overall winner or overall loser pile; once placed, it cannot be taken back.
Movement:
· A moving camel carries every camel stacked on top of it; when landing on an occupied space, it jumps on top of that stack.
· When a unit stops on a spectator tile, the tile’s owner gains 1 Egyptian Pound; tiles affect crazy camels in the opposite direction.
· The cheering side moves the unit 1 space forward, and the booing side moves it 1 space back (sliding under any stack there).
· Within a stack, the higher camel is considered ahead; crazy camels never count for any ranking.
Leg scoring:
· Once all 5 pyramid tickets have been taken, the leg ends and betting tickets are scored:
· The leading camel’s tickets pay their printed value (5, 3, 2); each ticket of the runner-up pays 1 Egyptian Pound.
· Every other ticket loses 1 Egyptian Pound, and each pyramid ticket pays 1 Egyptian Pound.
· Spectator tiles are returned, betting tickets are restocked, the dice go back into the pyramid, and the next player opens the new leg.
Game end:
· The race ends the instant any camel (including a crazy camel running backwards) crosses the finish line, followed by one final leg scoring.
· Finish cards: each pile is revealed in the order the cards were placed.
· Correct backers earn 8, 5, 3, and 2 Egyptian Pounds for their 1st, 2nd, 3rd, and 4th correct cards, then 1 Egyptian Pound each; every wrong card loses 1 Egyptian Pound.
· The overall loser is the least advanced racing camel; racing camels carried backwards across the finish line count as least advanced.
· Your money can never drop below 0.
Note: the “betting partnership” rule for 6 or more players is not included.

zh.name: 欲罢不能·极速版
zh.desc: 五骰齐掷全员同划:凑对赚分,第 5 骰是你的出局倒计时
zh.rules:
目标:在和值行上划记得分,终局总分最高者获胜。
流程:
· 每回合掷 5 颗公共骰,所有人用同一组点数同时行动。
· 从5颗骰子中选择4颗，分成两组，每组2颗。将每组的点数相加，并在对应和值行中各划记1格；剩余的1颗骰子作为第5骰。
第 5 骰:
· 第 5 骰记入专属轨道,最多开辟 3 条,每条对应一个点数、各 8 格。
· 已经开辟3条轨道后，第5骰的点数与其中一条轨道相符时，必须在该轨道划记1格；如果与3条轨道均不相符，则本回合无须在第5骰轨道中划记。
· 任一轨道划满 8 格,你立即出局。
结束:
· 玩家各自出局,全员出局后对局结束。
结算:
· 和值行划 1-4 格:每行扣 200 分(可在开局选项降为 150 或 100);划 0 或恰好 5 格:0 分。
· 划到第 6 格起,每格获得该和值行对应的分数：和值为2或12的行，每格获得100分；从两端向中间递减，和值为7的行每格获得30分。
· 一行已经划满10格后，仍可以选择该和值行，但不再获得分数;总分最高者胜,平分共同获胜。

en.name: Can't Stop Express
en.desc: One roll for everyone: pair up for points, the 5th die is your countdown
en.rules:
Goal: Score by checking off sum rows; highest total wins.
Play:
· Each turn 5 shared dice are rolled; everyone acts on the same roll at the same time.
· Pick 4 of the 5 dice to form two pairs, and check one box for each pair's sum; the leftover die is your 5th die.
The 5th die:
· The 5th die goes to its own tracks: at most 3 tracks, one per die value, 8 boxes each.
· Once all 3 tracks are open, a 5th die matching one of them must be checked; if it matches none, the turn is free and nothing is marked.
· As soon as any track reaches 8 checks, you are out.
End:
· Players go out individually; the game ends once everyone is out.
Scoring:
· A row checked 1-4 times loses 200 points (reducible to 150 or 100 in the game options); 0 or exactly 5 checks score 0.
· From the 6th check on, each box earns the row value: 100 for 2 and 12, decreasing toward 30 for 7.
· You may keep checking a full row beyond 10 boxes but earn nothing more; highest total wins, ties share the win.

zh.name: 扬翻夺宝
zh.desc: 招募海盗船员，翻面赌运，满载金币扬帆归航。
zh.rules:
目标：
你是海盗船长。轮流抽取双面角色板块，把船员放入冒险板，争取获得最多金币。所有人使用同一种冒险板。基础版适合2–5人；Kraken的官方单人规则适用于A–E板。
准备：
基础版使用A–D冒险板、72枚双面角色板块和基础藏宝图。九种角色在板块两面各出现16次，同一板块两面不同。每对角色有两枚板块。随机决定起始船长，之后按座位顺序行动。所有金币和已露出的板块公开，未翻开的背面不得查看。
流程：
抽取一枚板块，只看朝上的角色。可以保留，或者翻面一次；翻面后必须接受新角色。把它放入任一列最低的空格，不能越过本列空格。角色效果先结算，再结算该位置的板面奖励。缺格两边不相邻，斜角也不相邻。每个普通回合结束时，依次结算自己拥有的藏宝图。
· 制图师：取得一张藏宝图。
· 领航员：你的冒险板上每有一位制图师，获得2枚金币。
· 厨师：此厨师所在行中每有一名角色，获得1枚金币，包括此厨师自己。
· 炮手：立即获得5枚金币。终局时，你有至少3枚炸弹便被淘汰。
· 猴子：获得1枚金币，然后翻转一枚与此猴子正交相邻的板块，并结算新角色的效果。没有相邻板块时，只获得金币。
· 鹦鹉：立即再抽取并放置一枚船员板块，仍可选择翻面。终局时，每只鹦鹉扣除1枚金币。追加招募属于当前回合。追加招募不额外结算藏宝图。
· 瞭望员：终局时，若此瞭望员在本列上方没有其他角色，获得4枚金币。
· 木匠：终局时，若此木匠所在行和列均无炮手，获得3枚金币。爆弹岛上尚未被覆盖的板面炸弹也按炮手处理；其他额外炸弹不影响木匠。
· 水手：终局时，统计至少有一名水手的列数，将该列数的平方作为金币奖励。此项按所有水手统一计分，不逐枚水手计分。
· 翻转已放置板块只结算角色效果，不重新触发已领取的板面奖励；角色效果引发的额外招募和翻面先完成，再继续原板面奖励。
冒险板：
· A海盗船：完成第二列时，取得一张藏宝图；完成第三列时，获得5枚金币；完成第五列时，获得3枚金币。
· B克拉肯：从左至右，最先完成第一至第五列的玩家，分别获得1、2、6、0、4枚金币；之后完成对应列的玩家，分别获得0、1、3、2、2枚金币。
· C木筏：完成第一列时，取得一张藏宝图。终局时，若第二列已填满且所有角色相同，获得6枚金币；若第四列已填满且所有角色均不同，获得4枚金币。
· D荒岛：完成第一列时，获得3枚金币。完成第二列时，冒险板上每有1列已经完成，就获得2枚金币；刚完成的第二列也计入。完成第三列时，按该列中每种不同角色获得1枚金币。在第五列放置板块前，须支付1枚金币；没有金币时，不能在该列放置板块。
· E巨口之中（Kraken）：完成第一列和第五列时，分别获得4枚和3枚金币。完成第二列时，若该列角色全相同，取得一张藏宝图。完成第三列时，若该列角色全不同，翻转自己冒险板上的任一角色。完成第四列时，若该列角色全相同，追加招募一名船员。单人游戏中，再次取得已经持有的藏宝图时，将它放回中央；使用B板时，前两次完成列领取最先完成者的奖励，其余完成列领取后来完成者的奖励。
Isla Bomba扩展：
F–I板、五种新藏宝图及事件可分别组合，默认关闭。所有板面效果均在角色效果之后结算。
· F潜艇：底行的3名角色全相同时，获得5枚金币。其上一行的5格最先填满时，获得5枚金币；后来填满时，获得2枚金币。完成第二列时，取得一张藏宝图。完成第三列时，按该格周围7格中每种不同角色获得1枚金币。完成第四列时，若该列4名角色全不同，追加招募一名船员。完成第五列时，获得3枚金币。
· G监狱：准备阶段，每人抽取2枚板块放入牢房，不结算角色效果，也不查看背面。完成第一列时，可以翻转一枚牢房板块，不结算角色效果。完成第二列时，取得一张藏宝图。最先完成第三列的玩家获得5枚金币，后来完成者获得2枚金币。完成第四列或第五列时，释放一枚牢房板块，必须按当前朝向放入冒险板并结算角色效果。
· H天文台：使用两张藏宝图。取得藏宝图时，优先拿取中央的图；中央没有图时，从其他玩家处取得一张。玩家可以持有多张图。未被覆盖的六分仪视为额外一位制图师。完成第一列时，取得一张藏宝图。完成第二列时，获得3枚金币并取得一张藏宝图。完成第三列时，决定将所有图向左或向右传递。最先完成第四列的玩家，可以翻转自己冒险板上的任一角色；后来完成者获得2枚金币。完成第五列时，获得3枚金币。填满五格所在行时，按每张持有的藏宝图获得2枚金币。
· I爆弹岛：未被覆盖的两个六分仪视为额外制图师；未被覆盖的板面炸弹计入爆炸判定，也影响同行或同列木匠的计分。完成第二列时，取得一张藏宝图。完成第三列时，获得3枚金币。完成第四列时，按每枚可见炸弹获得2枚金币。完成第五列时，取得一张藏宝图，并永久增加一枚炸弹。两个眼窝位置分别从左侧和右侧邻座处偷取金币，数量等于对方冒险板上与本次所放角色相同的角色数量，最多取至对方金币用尽。藏宝图和第五列带来的额外炸弹不影响木匠。
· 基础藏宝图：在你的回合结束时，获得1枚金币。
· 诅咒图：持有此图时，不能翻转任何板块。在你的回合结束时，获得2枚金币。
· 燃烧图：持有此图时，增加1枚炸弹。在你的回合结束时，获得1枚金币；终局时，额外获得5枚金币。此图的炸弹不影响木匠。
· 赌徒图：在你的回合结束时，若你本回合尚未获得金币，获得2枚金币。
· 克拉肯图：在你的回合结束时，从最富有的其他船长处偷取1枚金币。有多人并列最富有时，由你选择其中一人；若你严格比其他所有人都富有，则不偷取金币。
· 四风图：在你的回合结束时，按此图当前朝向获得金币，然后将它顺时针旋转四分之一圈。四个朝向依次奖励1、2、1、3枚金币；取得此图时，将朝向重置为第一项。持有多张藏宝图时，可以选择它们的结算顺序。
· 海豚事件：抽到后，从抽到者起，每人翻转自己一枚板块并结算效果；随后移除海豚，原抽取者继续招募。其他玩家此时不结算藏宝图。
· 瓶中信：抽到者随机取得一张尚未使用的官方扩展藏宝图，移除瓶子，然后继续招募。空白自定义图不使用。诅咒图禁止的翻面效果跳过，其他效果照常。
结束：
有人完成至少4列时，完成本轮，使所有船长得到相同普通回合数；追加招募和角色效果仍结算完毕。终局按金币、船员、板面和藏宝图计算总分。至少3枚炸弹者淘汰，其余最高分者获胜；同分时持有藏宝图者优先，否则共享胜利。所有人均爆炸时，无人获胜。单人游戏根据最终金币数量确定评级：
· 不超过30枚金币时，评级为见习船长。
· 获得31至40枚金币时，评级为水手。
· 获得41至50枚金币时，评级为老练水手。
· 获得51至55枚金币时，评级为军官。
· 获得56至60枚金币时，评级为海军上将。
· 获得至少61枚金币时，评级为海上传奇。

en.name: Captain Flip
en.desc: Recruit a pirate crew, flip your luck, and sail home with a hold full of gold.
en.rules:
Goal:
Recruit a pirate crew and collect the most coins. Everyone uses the same Adventure board. The base game supports 2–5 players; the official Kraken solo rules apply to boards A–E.
Setup:
Use boards A–D, 72 double-sided Character tiles, and the basic Treasure Map. Each of the nine Characters appears 16 times, with different Characters on the two sides of each tile. Each pair appears twice. Choose a random first Captain, then play in seat order. Coins and exposed faces are public; unseen reverse sides remain hidden.
Turn:
Draw a tile and look at its face. Keep it or flip it once; after flipping, you must use the new Character. Place it on the lowest empty space of a column. Resolve its Character effect before the board bonus. Gaps and diagonals are not adjacent. At the end of an ordinary turn, resolve your Treasure Maps in your chosen order.
· Cartographer: Take a Treasure Map.
· Navigator: Gain 2 coins for each Cartographer on your Adventure board.
· Cook: Gain 1 coin for each Character in this Cook’s row, including the Cook itself.
· Gunner: Immediately gain 5 coins. At game end, you are eliminated if you have at least 3 Bombs.
· Monkey: Gain 1 coin, then flip a tile orthogonally adjacent to this Monkey and resolve the revealed Character’s effect. If there is no adjacent tile, gain only the coin.
· Parrot: Immediately draw and play another Character tile, which may still be flipped. At game end, lose 1 coin for each Parrot. The extra recruitment remains part of the current turn. Extra recruitment does not trigger additional Map income.
· Lookout: At game end, gain 4 coins if there is no Character above this Lookout in its column.
· Carpenter: At game end, gain 3 coins if no Gunner shares this Carpenter’s row or column. On Isla Bomba, an uncovered printed board Bomb also counts as a Gunner; other extra Bombs do not affect Carpenters.
· Swabby: At game end, count the columns containing at least one Swabby and gain that number squared in coins. Score all Swabbies together rather than scoring each tile separately.
· Flipping a placed tile only applies its Character effect, never a previously earned board bonus. Complete nested recruitment and flips before returning to the original board bonus.
Adventure boards:
· A, Pirate Ship: completing column 2 grants a Map; columns 3 and 5 grant 5 and 3 coins.
· B, Kraken: from left to right, the first Captain to complete each column gains 1, 2, 6, 0 or 4 coins respectively. Later Captains completing those columns gain 0, 1, 3, 2 or 2 coins respectively.
· C, Raft: Completing column 1 grants a Treasure Map. At game end, gain 6 coins if column 2 is full and all its Characters match; gain 4 coins if column 4 is full and all its Characters differ.
· D, Desert Island: Completing column 1 grants 3 coins. When you complete column 2, gain 2 coins for each completed column, including column 2 itself. When you complete column 3, gain 1 coin for each different Character in that column. Pay 1 coin before placing a tile in column 5; if you have no coins, you cannot place a tile there.
· E, In the Jaws of the Kraken: Completing columns 1 and 5 grants 4 and 3 coins respectively. Completing column 2 grants a Treasure Map if all its Characters match. Completing column 3 allows you to flip any tile on your board if all its Characters differ. Completing column 4 grants extra recruitment if all its Characters match. In solo play, taking a Map you already hold returns it to the center. On board B, your first two completed columns receive the first-completer reward; later completed columns receive the later-completer reward.
Isla Bomba expansion:
Boards F–I, the five new Maps, and events can be combined independently and are off by default. Resolve board effects after Character effects.
· F, Submarine: Filling the bottom row with 3 identical Characters grants 5 coins. Filling the next row of 5 spaces grants 5 coins to the first completer and 2 coins to later completers. Completing column 2 grants a Treasure Map. Completing column 3 grants 1 coin for each different Character in the 7 surrounding spaces, excluding the bonus space itself. Completing column 4 grants extra recruitment if its 4 Characters differ. Completing column 5 grants 3 coins.
· G, Prison: During preparation, each Captain draws 2 tiles into Cells without resolving their effects or looking at their reverse sides. Completing column 1 allows you to flip a Cell tile without resolving its effect. Completing column 2 grants a Treasure Map. The first Captain to complete column 3 gains 5 coins; later completers gain 2 coins. Completing column 4 or 5 releases a Cell tile; place it without flipping and resolve its effect.
· H, Observatory: Use two Treasure Maps. When taking a Map, take one from the center if possible; otherwise, take one from another Captain. You may hold multiple Maps. The uncovered Sextant counts as an additional Cartographer. Completing column 1 grants a Map. Completing column 2 grants 3 coins and a Map. Completing column 3 passes all Maps left or right, as you choose. The first Captain to complete column 4 may flip any tile on their board; later completers gain 2 coins. Completing column 5 grants 3 coins. Completing the row of 5 spaces grants 2 coins for each Map you hold.
· I, Isla Bomba: The two uncovered Sextants count as additional Cartographers. The uncovered printed board Bomb counts toward elimination and affects Carpenter scoring in its row or column. Completing column 2 grants a Map. Completing column 3 grants 3 coins. Completing column 4 grants 2 coins for each visible Bomb. Completing column 5 grants a Map and a permanent Bomb. The eye spaces steal coins from the left and right neighbors respectively, equal to the number of Characters on that neighbor’s board matching the Character just placed, up to the coins that neighbor holds. Bombs from Maps and column 5 do not affect Carpenters.
· Basic Map: At the end of your turn, gain 1 coin.
· Cursed Map: While you hold this Map, you cannot flip any tile. At the end of your turn, gain 2 coins.
· Burning Map: While you hold this Map, add 1 Bomb. Gain 1 coin at the end of your turn and 5 additional coins at game end. This Map’s Bomb does not affect Carpenters.
· Gambler's Map: At the end of your turn, gain 2 coins if you have gained no coins during this turn.
· Kraken's Map: At the end of your turn, steal 1 coin from the richest other Captain. Choose among Captains tied for richest. If you are strictly richer than every other Captain, steal no coins.
· 4 Winds Map: At the end of your turn, gain the coins shown by this Map’s current orientation, then rotate it a quarter turn clockwise. The four orientations award 1, 2, 1 and 3 coins in order. Reset it to the first orientation when you acquire the Map. If you hold multiple Maps, choose the order in which they resolve.
· Dolphin event: starting with the drawer, each Captain flips a tile on their board and resolves its effect. Remove the Dolphin, then the drawer recruits again. Other Captains do not receive end-turn Map income.
· Message in a Bottle: randomly gain an unused official expansion Map, remove the Bottle, and recruit again. The custom blank Map is excluded. The Cursed Map skips prohibited flips while other effects still apply.
End:
When anyone completes at least 4 columns, finish the round so all Captains receive the same number of ordinary turns. Finish all extra recruitment and Character effects. Add coins, Characters, board, and Map rewards. Captains with at least 3 Bombs are eliminated; the highest remaining total wins. Map holders win score ties over non-holders; otherwise share victory. If all Captains explode, nobody wins. In solo play, your final coin total determines your rank:
· With 30 coins or fewer, your rank is Landlubber.
· With 31–40 coins, your rank is Deckhand.
· With 41–50 coins, your rank is Sailor.
· With 51–55 coins, your rank is Lieutenant.
· With 56–60 coins, your rank is Admiral.
· With at least 61 coins, your rank is Legend of the Sea.

zh.name: 卡卡颂
zh.desc: 拼放板块、派遣米宝,建设中世纪领地
zh.rules:
目标:拼放板块建设中世纪领地,派遣米宝占领道路、城堡、修道院与田地,终局得分最高者获胜。
准备:起始板块置于中央,其余 71 块洗混成牌堆;每人 7 个米宝与 1 个方丈。
流程(每回合):
· 自动抽出 1 块板块并亮出;把它拼到版图上——至少与 1 块已有板块相邻,且所有相邻边类型一致(城接城、路接路、田接田)。
· 抽到的板块无处可放时自动弃置并补抽。
· 放置板块后，可以在该板块上派遣1个米宝。放在城市中的米宝成为骑士，放在道路上成为强盗，放在修道院中成为修士，放在田地中成为农夫；农夫在终局前不会被收回。
· 方丈只能进修道院;也可改为召回自己在修道院的方丈,立即按当前大小计分。
· 一片连通的区域里已有米宝时,不能再往该区域派米宝。
结算:
· 道路两端封闭后，该道路每块板块获得1分，并收回米宝。
· 城市的城墙合拢后，该城市每块板块获得2分，每枚徽章额外获得2分，并收回米宝。
· 修道院周围8格全部放满板块后，获得9分，并收回米宝。
· 同一区域中，拥有最多米宝的玩家获得该区域的分数；米宝数量并列最多时，并列玩家各获得全部分数。
终局计分：
牌堆耗尽且最后一块板块放置完毕后，游戏结束。未完成的区域按以下方式计分：
· 未完成的道路，每块板块获得1分。
· 未完成的城市，每块板块获得1分，每枚徽章额外获得1分。
· 未完成的修道院，自身及周围每块已放置的板块各获得1分；仍在版图上的方丈不得分。
· 每个农夫按田地相连的每座已完成城获得 3 分。
· 总分最高的玩家获胜,并列共享胜利。

en.name: Carcassonne
en.desc: Lay tiles, send out meeples, build a medieval realm
en.rules:
Goal: lay tiles to build a medieval realm and send meeples to claim roads, cities, monasteries, and fields — the highest score after final scoring wins.
Setup: the start tile sits in the middle; the other 71 tiles are shuffled into a face-down stack; everyone gets 7 meeples plus 1 abbot.
Each turn:
· The top tile is revealed automatically; place it so it touches at least one existing tile, with every touching edge matching in type (city to city, road to road, field to field).
· If the drawn tile fits nowhere, it is discarded and a new one is drawn.
· Then you may place one meeple on the tile you just placed: knight in a city, robber on a road, monk in a monastery, or farmer in a field (farmers stay until the end).
· The abbot can only enter a monastery; instead of placing, you may recall your abbot from a monastery to score its current value immediately.
· You cannot place a meeple on a connected feature that already has one.
Scoring:
· Completed road (both ends closed): 1 point per tile; the meeple returns.
· Completed city (walls closed): 2 points per tile plus 2 per pennant; the meeples return.
· Monastery surrounded by 8 tiles: 9 points; the meeple returns.
· Whoever has the most meeples on a feature scores it; tied leaders all score.
Final scoring:
After the last tile is placed, score incomplete features as follows:
· Incomplete roads score 1 point per tile.
· Incomplete cities score 1 point per tile plus 1 point per pennant.
· Incomplete monasteries score 1 point for themselves plus each surrounding tile; an abbot still on the board scores nothing.
· Each farmer scores 3 points per completed city bordering the field.
· Highest score wins; ties share the victory.

zh.name: 王国制图师
zh.desc: 依照王国敕令绘制地图，规划村庄、林地与田园，提防邻座绘下的怪物。
zh.rules:
目标：在四季中依照敕令绘制地图，争取最高总分。开局所有人使用同一面 11 行、11 列的地图，从森林、农田水域、村庄、几何四组各随机选一张计分牌，随机排列为敕令 A、B、C、D。每季的计分敕令与时限如下：
· 春季：敕令A和B，时限为8。
· 夏季：敕令B和C，时限为8。
· 秋季：敕令C和D，时限为7。
· 冬季：敕令D和A，时限为6。

每轮同时探索与绘制。探索牌提供地形和形状，可独立选择；形状可以旋转、翻转，可放在任意空位，不要求邻接已有地形，但不能重叠或超出地图。带金币的较小形状使你获得1枚金币。任意山地的四个正交相邻格全部填满时，永久获得1枚金币，同一座山只奖励一次。山地、荒地、怪物都属于已填格；未填入地形的遗迹仍为空格。

翻出遗迹牌时继续翻牌，下张普通探索所绘形状必须覆盖至少一个空遗迹。若没有任何可放置的原形状，或没有可覆盖的遗迹，改为在任意空格绘制一格，可选森林、村庄、农田、水域或怪物。裂隙之地本来就是任意一种上述地形的一格。没有空格时跳过绘制。

伏击：按牌上箭头将地图传给左邻或右邻，由收到地图的玩家绘制所示怪物形状，可旋转翻转。原形无法放置时，改画一格怪物；地图填满则跳过。画完后地图归还原主，伏击牌永久移除。遗迹后遇到伏击时，先正常处理伏击，遗迹限制保留至下一张普通探索。界面会切换到需要你绘制的邻居地图。

探索牌时间累计达到或超过时限后，先完成本轮，再进行季末确认和计分。每季依次计两张当季敕令、当前金币数，并扣除怪物罚分：每个正交邻接怪物的空格扣 1 分，同一空格只扣一次。区域与邻接均按正交方向。新季重洗全部 13 张探索牌和没有翻出的伏击，再随机加入一张新伏击。冬季计分后总分最高者获胜；平分时比较四季累计怪物罚分，较少者获胜，仍相同则并列。

单人模式：伏击自动依卡牌指定角与箭头方向逐层向内寻找落位，保持卡面朝向，不旋转翻转；完全无法放置则弃牌，不改画单格。终局从总分减去四张敕令的单人基准，按达到的最高分数门槛授予称号：
· 达到30分：传奇制图师。
· 达到20分：制图大师。
· 达到10分：地形专家。
· 达到0分：测绘学徒。
· 达到−5分：业余勘测员。
· 达到−10分：生疏绘图者。
· 达到−20分：迟钝制图者。
· 低于−20分：糊涂制图者。

可选推广：伏击推广 1 将四张新伏击混入备用伏击。技能推广 1 从八张技能中随机公开三张，每人每季最多发动其中一张，支付的金币永久减少。额外形状不要求覆盖遗迹；外交格同时参与农田和村庄计分。专注的第二个形状不重复奖励金币。各技能说明及本局敕令的完整计分条件见下列图例。两项推广默认关闭。

操作：点选探索牌上的形状及地形，使用形状旁的旋转、翻转控件，点地图预览，确认后绘制。技能额外形状同样需要预览和确认；完成本轮后等待其他玩家。点击敕令或技能可查看详细说明。

en.name: Cartographers
en.desc: Map the kingdom under royal edicts, plan thriving settlements, and watch for monsters drawn by your neighbors.
en.rules:
Goal: map the kingdom across four seasons and earn the highest total. Everyone uses the same side of an 11×11 map. Randomly choose one scoring card from each of four groups (forest, farm/water, village, geometry), then randomly assign them to edicts A–D. The scoring edicts and time limits are:
· Spring: score A and B, with a time limit of 8.
· Summer: score B and C, with a time limit of 8.
· Fall: score C and D, with a time limit of 7.
· Winter: score D and A, with a time limit of 6.

Explore and draw simultaneously. Independently choose an available terrain and shape. Rotate or flip the shape and place it anywhere on empty squares; adjacency is not required. Do not overlap filled squares or extend beyond the map. A smaller shape marked with a coin earns 1 coin. Surround a mountain on all four orthogonal sides to permanently gain 1 coin, once per mountain. Mountains, wasteland and monsters are filled; unfilled ruins are empty.

When a ruin is revealed, continue revealing cards. The next normal exploration shape must cover at least one empty ruin. If none of the printed shapes can legally fit, or no empty ruin can be covered, draw one square anywhere with forest, village, farm, water or monster terrain. Rift Lands normally offers this same one-square choice. If the map is full, skip drawing.

Ambush: pass your map in the arrow direction. The receiving player draws the depicted monster shape, with rotation and flipping allowed. If it cannot fit, draw one monster square instead; skip on a full map. Return maps to their owners and permanently discard the ambush. An ambush after a ruin is resolved normally; retain the ruin requirement for the next normal exploration. The interface switches to the neighbor’s map you must draw on.

After completing the round that reaches or exceeds the season time limit, confirm the season and score its two edicts, plus 1 point per current coin, minus 1 per empty square orthogonally adjacent to monsters. Count each such empty square only once. All adjacency and clusters are orthogonal. For the next season, reshuffle all 13 exploration cards with unrevealed ambushes and add one new random ambush. After winter, the highest total wins. Ties favor fewer monster penalty points across all seasons; further ties share victory.

Solo: ambushes are placed automatically from the indicated corner, following the arrow around concentric layers. Retain the printed orientation without rotation or flipping. If the shape cannot fit anywhere, discard it; do not substitute a single square. Subtract the four scoring cards’ solo baselines from your total for your rating. Use the highest threshold you reach:
· 30 points: Legendary Cartographer.
· 20 points: Master Mapsmith.
· 10 points: Journeyman Topographer.
· 0 points: Apprentice Surveyor.
· −5 points: Amateur Assessor.
· −10 points: Inept Assistant.
· −20 points: Dimwitted Doodler.
· Below −20 points: Oblivious Inkdrinker.

Optional mini-expansions: Ambush 1 mixes four additional ambushes into the reserve. Skills 1 reveals three random skills out of eight. Each player may activate one of these skills per season by permanently spending its coin cost. Additional shapes do not need to cover ruins. Diplomacy squares count as both farm and village. Concentrate never duplicates a shape coin. Full edict and skill effects appear in the illustrated reference below. Both expansions are off by default.

Controls: choose a shape and terrain on the exploration card. Rotate or flip with the tools beside the shape, click the map to preview and confirm to draw. Preview and confirm additional skill shapes too. Finish the round to wait for other players. Select an edict or skill to read its effect.

zh.name: 卡斯卡迪亚之旅
zh.desc: 拼六边形栖息地,安顿五种野生动物
zh.rules:
目标:每人固定 20 回合;终局按 5 张动物计分卡、5 种地形走廊和自然标记计分,总分最高者获胜。
流程(每回合):
· 从中央 4 对「板块 + 标记」中选一对。
· 板块放进自己的版图,必须挨着已有板块。
· 将动物标记放到印有该动物、且没有动物或地标的板块上；无法放置或不愿放置时，将该标记放回袋中。
自然标记:
· 把动物标记放到只印一种动物的关键板块上（关键板块可以包含多种地形）,获得 1 个自然标记。
· 花 1 个自然标记可以混选任意板块与标记,或移除任意数量的展示标记，并重新抽取相同数量的标记。
· 展示标记有 3 个相同时,每回合可以免费更换这3个标记一次；4个标记相同时，自动更换这些标记。
终局计分:
· 根据5张动物计分卡、每种地形的最长走廊及剩余自然标记计算得分。每种地形的最大走廊另有加分。
· 总分相同时，剩余自然标记较多的玩家获胜；若仍然相同，则共享胜利。
地标扩展（可选）：
· 开局按逆序选择并放置一块额外关键板块。每种地形公开的地标卡数量等于人数。
· 刚放的板块所在的连续栖息地至少五块时，可以在该板块上放对应地标。
· 放置地标后，领取该地形的一张公开卡；也可以跳过。每人每类地标最多一个。
· 地标占位后不能再放动物，放地标不奖励自然标记。本回合选取的动物仍可放在其他合法板块上。
· 按地标卡条件计分。I/J 卡调整走廊大小，同时影响走廊得分和多数奖励。
扩展选项：
· 扩展板块支持二至六人，可独立使用。
· 随机动物卡可分别混入 E–G、Kickstarter 和 Ecosystem Connections。
· 地标宣传卡包含森林 P2、P3 及湿地 P1 三张。

en.name: Cascadia
en.desc: Build hex habitats, house five kinds of wildlife
en.rules:
Goal: everyone takes exactly 20 turns; final scoring covers the 5 wildlife cards, the longest corridor of each of the 5 habitats, and leftover nature tokens — the highest total wins.
Each turn:
· Draft one of the 4 tile + token pairs from the middle.
· Add the tile to your environment; it must touch an existing tile.
· Place the token on a tile printed with that animal that holds neither wildlife nor a landmark; if you cannot or do not want to, return it to the bag.
Nature tokens:
· Placing a token on a keystone tile printed with just one wildlife type (which may contain multiple habitats) earns 1 nature token.
· Spending 1 nature token lets you mix any tile with any token, or wipe any number of displayed tokens for redraws.
· When 3 displayed tokens match, you may wipe them free once per turn; 4 matching tokens are wiped automatically.
Final scoring:
· Score the 5 wildlife scoring cards, the longest corridor of each habitat, and leftover nature tokens. The largest corridor of each habitat earns an additional bonus.
· Ties break on nature tokens; a further tie shares the victory.
Landmarks (optional):
· Before play, choose and place an extra keystone tile in reverse player order. Each habitat has public landmark cards equal to player count.
· If the tile you just placed belongs to a corridor of at least five tiles, you may place a matching landmark on it.
· Claim a matching public card when placing a landmark, or skip the landmark. Each player may claim each type once.
· Landmark tiles cannot hold wildlife. Placing a landmark earns no nature token. Your drafted wildlife may still go on another legal tile.
· Score each landmark card as described. Cards I/J alter habitat corridor points and majority bonuses.
Expansion options:
· Expansion tiles work independently and support two to six players.
· Random wildlife cards may include E–G, Kickstarter and Ecosystem Connections separately.
· The landmark promo option contains Forest P2/P3 and Wetland P1.

zh.name: 卡斯卡迪亚之旅：高山湖泊
zh.desc: 叠起高山地形，让五种野生动物栖居湖泊之间。
zh.rules:
目标：每人完成20回合后，总分最高者获胜；平分时剩余自然标记较多者获胜，仍相同则并列。
准备：每人获得一块四格起始板块。供应区展示四组双六角地形板块与动物。三种地形各使用一张计分卡；进阶模式可增加动物、地形、空间三类环境计分卡，每类至多一张。
回合：
· 选取一组地形板块与动物。可以先放动物，也可以先放板块，二者都完成后结束回合。
· 板块可以旋转，放在地面时至少一条边与原有地形相邻；叠放时下方两格必须等高，新板块还必须至少邻接一格高度只比它低一级或更高的地形。
· 覆盖已有动物时，新格必须允许该动物；动物升到新高度，不能移动或移除。
· 动物放在印有对应动物且尚无动物的格子。也可以将本回合选取的动物放回袋中。基本湖泊不能放动物。
· 将动物放到只有一种动物图案的关键栖息地，获得一个自然标记。叠放使已有动物升到关键栖息地时也获得标记；同一回合可能多次获得。
· 花一个自然标记可任意搭配一块板块与一只动物，或更换供应区任意数量动物；可以多次支付进行更换。标记回到公共供应，数量有限。
· 四只动物相同时自动更换；恰好三只相同时，每回合可免费更换这三只一次。更换过程中先将旧动物放在一旁，全部更换结束后才放回袋中。
· 多人局补充原空位，不移动其他供应。单人局取走后，再分别丢弃最远端剩余的一块板块和一只动物，将余下两项向远端滑动，在近端补两项；丢弃物移出游戏。
计分：
· 同类地形沿边相连形成地形走廊，相邻关系不受高度影响。根据三张地形卡分别计分，卡片详情列出准确要求与分值。
· 基本湖泊每格获得等于高度的分数；六边均被地形包围则翻倍。
每只位于三级或更高处的动物获得2分。每种动物另比较各玩家从高到低排列的高度；逐只比较至分出高低。该动物的排名奖励如下：
· 两人对局：领先者获得2分；平手时各获得1分。
· 三至四人对局：第一名获得3分，第二名获得1分。两人并列第一时，各获得2分；三至四人并列第一时，各获得1分；并列第二名不得分。
没有该动物者不获奖励。单人局每种动物在四级有至少一只，或三级有至少两只时获得2分奖励。
· 每个剩余自然标记获得1分，加上已选环境卡得分。家庭卡与中级卡按同地形中相连的同种动物群计分，可选择关闭最高动物奖励。
挑战：情景使用指定计分卡与额外目标，达到门槛并满足目标获得铜、银或金牌。普通成就每局只能记录一项尚未完成的成就。完成使用规则修改的对局后可记录该项。进度保存在当前设备的本游戏记录中。
Pristine Peaks（默认关闭）：增加每地形E、F卡及每类环境P1至P3。可改用阶叠湖泊或荒野湖泊。阶叠湖泊按相连湖泊涵盖的不同高度数量计分：涵盖1、2、3、4种及以上高度时，分别获得1、4、9、15分；除最高处外，每格必须邻接高一级湖泊。荒野湖泊不计湖泊分，但允许任意动物。
五种规则修改：

· 新板块至少有一格与同高度或更高的外侧同类地形相邻；叠放后若无此高度的邻格则不限制地形；补充裁定：若整组供给都无法合法放置，本回合豁免地形匹配，其余放置规则照常适用。
· 供应区仅三组。
· 每地形展示两张卡，终局各选得分较高的一张。
· 四级及以上动物改为获得4分。
· 每回合可花一个自然标记支撑板块较低的一半，允许下方相差一级。

en.name: Cascadia: Alpine Lakes
en.desc: Layer alpine habitats and settle five wildlife species around mountain lakes.
en.rules:
Goal: After 20 turns each, the highest total wins. Ties go to the most unused Nature Tokens, then are shared.
Setup: Each player starts with a four-hex starter. Display four pairs of double-hex Habitat Tiles and Wildlife Tokens. Use one scoring card per habitat. Advanced games may add up to one Environment Card from each of Wildlife, Habitat and Spatial.
Turn:
· Draft a tile and a token. Place them in either order. Finish both before the next turn.
· Rotate the tile freely. At ground level it must share an edge with your environment. To stack it, both hexagons below must be at the same level. The new tile must also have at least one outside neighbor no more than one level below it.
· Covered wildlife rises onto the new tile, which must permit that species. Placed wildlife cannot otherwise move or be removed.
· Place the token on an empty hexagon showing its species, or return the drafted token to the bag. Standard lakes cannot hold wildlife.
· Placing wildlife on a single-species Keystone hexagon earns a Nature Token. Raising existing wildlife onto a Keystone also earns one. Multiple tokens may be earned in one turn, subject to the finite supply.
· Spend one Nature Token to draft any tile with any token, or to replace any number of displayed tokens. Replacements may be purchased repeatedly. Spent Nature Tokens return to the supply.
· Four identical displayed tokens are automatically replaced. Three identical tokens may be replaced for free once per turn. Set replaced tokens aside until all replacements are resolved, then return them to the bag.
· In multiplayer, refill the original empty slots without sliding the display. In solo play, after drafting, separately discard the remaining tile and token furthest from the stacks, slide the other two away from the stacks, then refill two slots at the near end. Discarded pieces leave the game.
Scoring:
· Edge-connected hexagons of the same habitat form a corridor, regardless of elevation. Score each habitat using its card; exact requirements and values are available in Card Details.
· Each standard lake scores its elevation, doubled if all six sides are surrounded by tiles.
Each animal at level 3+ scores 2 points. Compare each species’ descending list of animal elevations, continuing until ties break. Ranking bonuses for that species are:
· With two players, the leader scores 2 points, or tied leaders score 1 point each.
· With three or four players, first place scores 3 points and second place 1 point. Two tied for first score 2 points each; three or four tied for first score 1 point each. Tied second place scores nothing.
Players without the species receive no bonus. In solo play, score a 2-point bonus for each species with at least one animal at level 4 or higher, or at least two animals at level 3.
· Each unused Nature Token scores 1, plus selected Environment Cards. Family and Intermediate cards score connected same-species groups within one habitat. Highest-wildlife bonuses may be disabled for these variants.
Challenges: Scenarios set the scoring cards and extra goals. Meet every goal and the score threshold for bronze, silver or gold. Choose at most one new Normal Achievement per game. Complete a game with a Rules Modification to record it. Progress is saved for this game on the current device.
Pristine Peaks (off by default): Adds habitat E/F and environment P1–P3 cards. Cascading Lakes score each connected lake group according to its number of distinct levels: one level scores 1 point, two levels score 4 points, three levels score 9 points, and four or more levels score 15 points; each non-highest lake must touch a lake exactly one level higher. Wild Lands lakes score no lake points but accept any wildlife.
Rules Modifications:

· Each new tile must match at least one outside habitat edge at the same or a higher level. A layered tile with no neighbor at that height may use any habitat. Additional ruling: if no supplied tile can be placed legally, habitat matching is waived for that turn; all other placement rules still apply.
· Display only three pairs.
· Use two cards per habitat and score the better one at game end.
· Animals at level 4+ score 4 points instead of 2 points.
· Once per turn, spend a Nature Token to support the lower half of a tile when the hexagons below differ by one level.

zh.name: 城堡嘉年华
zh.desc: 跟使者逛市集买卡,拼出 3×3 王国:钱包存金、盾牌成套,九卡落定比分
zh.rules:
目标:从使者所在的市集购买卡牌,拼出自己 3 行 3 列的王国,9张卡牌全部放置后总分最高者获胜。
流程(你的回合):
· 可先花 1 把钥匙(每回合至多一次):把使者移到另一市集,或弃置当前市集的全部正面朝上的卡牌，并补充新牌。

· 将卡牌正面朝上放入版图时，须与已有卡牌正交相邻，整个王国不得超过3行3列；背面朝上放置时，立即获得6枚金币和2把钥匙。

· 终局逐卡结算底部分数(盾牌、位置、旗帜、钥匙等条件)。

en.name: Castle Combo
en.desc: Shop the messenger's market and build a 3×3 realm: purses, shield sets, clever placements
en.rules:
Goal: buy cards from the market the messenger stands at, build your 3×3 realm, and have the most points once everyone has 9 cards.
On your turn:
· You may spend 1 key first (once per turn): move the messenger to the other market, or discard its 3 face-up cards and refill.
· Then buy 1 card from the messenger's market: pay gold to place it face-up, or place it face-down for free.
· A face-up card must be orthogonally adjacent within 3 rows by 3 columns; a face-down card gains you 6 gold and 2 keys.
· Cards with 📯 move the messenger to the other market when bought face-up.
· Abilities resolve immediately: gain gold/keys, store gold on purse cards, discard from a river for its cost, etc.
Scoring:
· At the end, each card scores its bottom-line condition (shields, positions, banners, keys…).
· Automatically put leftover gold into purse cards until the purses are full or no gold remains. Each stored gold scores 2 points, and each unused key scores 1 point.
· A market whose deck and discards are both exhausted leaves the game.

zh.name: 夜莺城
zh.desc: 忍者循影盗宝，武士循声追踪的双人非对称对决。
zh.rules:
目标：
忍者需要盗得5个含有神像的花瓶；武士需要捕获全部3名忍者。8 个花瓶中有 6 尊神像、2 个空瓶，内容保密。双方胜利条件在轮末检查。
准备：
四块地板围绕不可通行的花园组成城堡。可选 A／B 面及随机排列。武士先封闭 2 处暗门，再放置在没有花瓶或暗门的地板格。双方各有 10 张行动牌、7 件一次性装备，起手各 3 张牌和 1 件装备。
流程：
武士先秘密选择行动牌与 1 枚夜莺板块，忍者随后选择行动牌。上轮的夜莺板块本轮不能选择。忍者先亮牌执行附加行动，再完成全部移动；武士随后亮牌，先完成移动，再执行附加行动。只要能够执行牌上的行动，就必须执行。
忍者：
场上没有忍者与脚步时，从任一未封闭暗门进入；只有脚步时，任选脚步作为起点并清除旧脚步；忍者已现身则从原格出发。每步正交走 1 格，不重复经过格子，不经过武士或花园。在开启暗门上可用 1 步到另一开启暗门。踏上花瓶立即盗取并查看，须与此前轮次盗取的花瓶分开。
踏上本轮夜莺颜色的地板或暗门时，立即停止、现身并清除脚步。未触发则移除忍者，保留全部脚步，下轮可从其中任一处重新出发。每轮可以将1件装备背面朝下弃置，跳过正交相邻的 1 格。
武士：
每步进入相邻的不同色区，并可停在该区任一格；相连同色格组成一整区，每个暗门单独算 1 区。进入开启暗门立即封闭。每轮可以将1件装备背面朝下弃置，将移动总数增加或减少 1。
进入已现身忍者所在色区，或封闭全部 8 处暗门，便捕获忍者。只没收本轮盗取的花瓶，放到武士所在板块的空地板格；此前轮次盗取的花瓶保留。因全门封闭捕获时，各板块开启一门，不开启武士脚下的门；该板块无其他门则从别板块多开一门。移动结束时移除脚下脚步，查看并移动脚下花瓶到同板块空格。
装备与轮末：
装备在注明的时机使用并永久弃置。
· 望远镜查看未选颜色。
· 手里剑取消武士牌上的附加行动。
· 撒菱取消武士牌上的移动。
· 蟋蟀移动武士 2 区。
· 攀爬爪连接不同色外缘。
· 烟雾弹允许被发现后走完且留在末格。
· 碎瓶随机移除已盗花瓶。
· 钥匙可穿越但不停在花园。
· 军事战术取回上轮颜色。
· 捕网捕获同板块可见忍者。
· 夜莺成双改选 2 色。
· 提灯只保留一处脚步。
双方城堡地图可在补牌时改取回弃牌。
双方弃置本轮行动牌并各抽 1 张，牌堆用尽时，将弃牌堆洗混，组成新的牌堆。检查五尊神像或三次捕获，未结束便开始下一轮。

en.name: Castle Nightingale
en.desc: A duel of stealth and anticipation between treasure-seeking ninjas and a vigilant samurai.
en.rules:
Goal:
The ninjas win with 5 vases containing relics. The samurai wins by capturing all 3 ninjas. Of the 8 vases, 6 contain relics and 2 are empty. Contents stay secret. Victory is checked at the end of a turn.
Setup:
Arrange four floor boards around the inaccessible garden. Choose side A or B and optionally randomize their order and rotation. The samurai closes 2 passages and starts on a floor space without a vase or passage. Each side has 10 action cards, 7 single-use equipment tokens, and starts with 3 cards and 1 equipment token.
Turn:
The samurai secretly programs a card and 1 nightingale tile, then the ninja programs a card. Last turn’s nightingale tile is unavailable this turn. The ninja reveals and performs the card’s action before completing all movement. The samurai then reveals, completes movement, and performs the card’s action. You must perform the card’s action whenever you can legally do so.
Ninja:
With no ninja or footprints, enter at any open passage. With only footprints, replace any footprint with the ninja and remove all old footprints. A visible ninja starts from its current space. Move orthogonally one space at a time, without revisiting spaces or crossing the samurai or garden. From an open passage, one move may lead to any other open passage. Immediately steal and inspect a vase entered; keep this turn’s loot separate.
Stepping onto this turn’s nightingale color or selected passage tile stops movement, reveals the ninja, and clears footprints. Otherwise remove the ninja and keep all footprints; any of them may be next turn’s starting point. Once per turn, secretly discard equipment to jump over one orthogonally adjacent space.
Samurai:
Each move enters an adjacent different colored zone, ending on any space in it. Connected matching floor spaces form one zone; every passage is its own zone. Immediately close any open passage entered. Once per turn, secretly discard equipment to adjust total movement by +1 or −1.
Entering the zone of a visible ninja, or closing all 8 passages, captures a ninja. Confiscate only vases stolen this turn and place them on free floor spaces on the samurai’s board. Earlier loot remains stolen. After an all-passages capture, open one passage per board, never under the samurai; if a board has no other passage, open an additional one elsewhere. At movement’s end remove a footprint under the samurai and inspect and relocate a vase there to a free floor space on the same board.
Equipment and turn end:
Use equipment at its stated time, then permanently discard it.
· Telescope reveals unused tiles.
· Shuriken cancels the action on the samurai’s card.
· Makibishi cancels the movement on the samurai’s card.
· Cricket moves the samurai 2 zones.
· Climbing Claws connect differently colored outer edges.
· Smoke Bombs finish interrupted movement and leave the ninja visible at its final space.
· Broken Vase randomly removes stolen loot.
· Keys cross the garden but cannot stop there.
· Military Tactics recovers the previous tile.
· Net captures a visible ninja on the same board.
· Nightingale Pair programs 2 colors.
· Lantern leaves only one footprint.
Either Castle Map reclaims a discarded card instead of drawing.
Discard the played cards and draw 1 card each, shuffling the discard pile when needed. Check for five relics or three captures; otherwise begin another turn.

zh.name: 勃艮第城堡：特别版
zh.desc: 投掷骰子，建设领地，经营货物与葡萄园；自由组合特别版扩展。
zh.rules:
目标：
五个阶段结束后，得分最高者获胜。平分时比较已填格数，再比较顺序轨较后的位置。团队模式平分时，空格较多的团队获胜。
准备与流程：
每位玩家选择起始城堡。游戏分五个阶段，每阶段五轮；每轮所有玩家同时掷两枚骰子，再按顺序轨轮流完成自己的回合。白骰决定本轮货物放入哪个仓库。每次使用一枚骰子执行一个动作，可以在两次动作之间使用黑市和其他能力。用完骰子后结束回合。
骰子与工人：
一名工人可将骰点增加或减少一，1与6循环相接；可以花多名工人。取工人动作不受骰点限制。
四种基本动作：
· 取板块：从骰点对应的公共仓库取一块，放入自己的三格仓库。满仓时先弃掉旧板块。
· 放板块：使用骰点对应的领地格，颜色须匹配，并与已放板块相邻。放置后立即执行板块效果。同一城镇不得放同类建筑，起重机除外。
· 卖货：卖出骰点对应的一整种货物，每片获得与人数对应的2、3或4分，本次卖货另外获得1枚银币。个人货物仓最多容纳三种货物。
· 取工人：使用任意骰子，取得两名工人。
黑市：
每回合最多支付2枚银币，购买1块黑市板块，放入自己的仓库；可在使用骰子之前、之间或之后购买。旅馆与葡萄园商店共享该购买次数。
板块效果：
城堡给予一次任意骰点动作。船只从任选公共仓库取走自己能存放的货物，并将顺序标记前进一格，同格后来者压在上面，下一轮才采用新顺序。每座矿在每个阶段结束时产生1枚银币。修道院提供持续能力或终局得分。
牲畜按原版连续牧场计分：放下时，计算该牧场内同种牲畜的总数量。鹅获得2分并再计该牧场一种牲畜的数量；之后任何牲畜计分都包含鹅。
· 市场让你取得1块船只或牲畜板块。
· 工坊让你取得1块建筑板块。
· 教堂让你取得1块城堡、矿山或修道院板块。
· 仓库让你免费执行1次卖货动作。
· 旅舍获得4名工人。
· 银行获得2枚银币。
· 市政厅让你免费放置1块存放在自己仓库中的其他板块。
· 瞭望塔获得4分。
建筑允许放置，即使其效果当前无法执行。
完成区域：
填满一个同色连续区域，获得区域大小的三角数分值（1、3、6、10、15、21、28、36），再加当前阶段10、8、6、4或2分。起始城堡不触发效果或完成分。填满领地内全部同色格，前两名获得颜色奖励：首名5、6或7分，次名2、3或4分。
终局：
每枚银币获得1分，每片未出售的货物获得1分，每两名工人获得1分，再结算修道院、盾牌与葡萄园的分数。
扩展：
额外板块加入修道院27、28、起重机与鹅。
· 起重机触发任意建筑能力，并在终局可视为任意一种计分建筑。
· 白色城堡给予白骰当前点数的一次动作，允许花工人调整。
· 旅馆可放任意颜色区域，每区域最多一个，完成该区域时大小加一。
· 贸易路线按从左至右逐片填入已卖货物，数字吻合便获得奖励；可在开局调整路线片顺序。
边境哨所：用连续的板块连接两个哨所，获得阶段分；连接第三个再获得一次阶段分，并争夺哨所奖励。城堡连接变体只用于11至18号图：新板块还必须直接邻接城堡，或经同色已放板块连到城堡；城堡仍按通常规则放置。可花两枚骰子和5分取回之前阶段移出的城堡。
盾牌：花两枚同点骰子从对应仓库取一面盾牌，工人可调整点数。盾牌必须贴在已放的城堡上，可替换旧盾；阶段结束时，先为每面盾牌支付1枚银币作为贡金，再领取矿山收入。无法或不愿付款的盾牌弃掉。
葡萄园：双六角占两个仓储格；用相应骰点取得或放置，可翻转两色方向。首片只可放在底层点数1或4的位置，之后需与已放双六角相邻。依自选顺序执行覆盖的两项奖励；填满一层取得一枚自选葡萄奖励。终局，每枚奖励可计一个对应颜色的连续葡萄区，按该区大小的三角数得分，每区和每枚奖励均只计一次。
团队：
四人分为相邻两人一队，共用领地、货物、工人和银币。每人有两格私人仓库，团队另有两格共享仓库；不能使用队友私人板块或骰子。双方可建设整张团队领地。
原版单人挑战：
25轮内填满37格即获胜。每轮白骰放货后，按仓库从上至下移除一块板块，空仓则顺时针寻找。只能经河流扩张到其他地区。放船取货后移除其他仓库的货物，可用自选五片货物换黑市板块，背面向上存放；背面板块可放任意色，不触发效果。修道院计分能力立即结算。完成整色改为免费从黑市取一块直接放置。每次获得分数时，可以支付银币购买额外分数；达到目标分数后清零，目标减少5（最低5），并获得一次任意动作。
Châteauma：
官方自动对手占一个玩家名额，使用郡卡取得板块、连锁效果、完成卡片和争夺颜色奖励。白骰1至4选择左卡，5至6选择右卡。三个难度决定郡卡完成分；修正A、B预填领地，C让其先手，D启用额外动作格。它不使用工人，不执行修道院能力，终局每修道院4分。平分时自动对手获胜。该模式不支持旅馆、团队图和原版单人图，移除2号盾牌。

en.name: The Castles of Burgundy: Special Edition
en.desc: Roll dice, develop a duchy, trade goods and grow vineyards with modular Special Edition expansions.
en.rules:
Goal:
After five phases, the highest score wins. Ties favor more filled spaces, then the later position on the turn track. Team ties favor more empty spaces.
Setup and play:
Choose a starting castle. Each of five phases has five rounds. Everyone rolls two dice; players then take turns in track order. The white die assigns the round’s goods tile to a depot. Each die pays for one action. Finish your turn after using both dice and any desired purchases.
Workers:
A worker changes a die by one, with 1 and 6 adjacent. Spend several workers if needed. Taking workers ignores the die value.
Four basic actions:
· Take a tile from the numbered depot matching your die and store it on one of your three key spaces. Discard stored tiles first if necessary.
· Place a stored tile on a matching-color duchy space with the die’s number, adjacent to a previously placed tile, and trigger its effect. A town cannot contain duplicate buildings, except cranes.
· Sell all goods of the die’s number for 2/3/4 points per tile in a 2/3/4-player game and one silver per sale. Store at most three different goods types.
· Take two workers using any die.
Black depot:
Once per turn, spend two silver for one tile, before, between or after die actions. Inns and the vineyard store share this purchase limit.
Tile effects:
A castle grants one action with any die value. A ship takes all goods you can store from one chosen depot and moves your turn marker one step forward, on top of other markers there. The new order applies next round. A mine produces one silver after each phase. Monasteries grant ongoing abilities or scoring.
Livestock scores all animals of its type in the same printed contiguous pasture. Geese score two plus one chosen animal type there; later livestock scoring includes geese.
· Market: take a ship or livestock.
· Workshop: take a building.
· Church: take a castle, mine or monastery.
· Warehouse: sell a goods type.
· Boarding house: gain four workers.
· Bank: gain two silver.
· Town hall: place another stored tile.
· Watchtower: gain four points.
You may place a building even if its effect cannot be used.
Completed areas:
Fill a contiguous printed color area to score its triangular size value (1, 3, 6, 10, 15, 21, 28, 36), plus 10/8/6/4/2 points in phases A–E. Your starting castle grants no effect or area score. The first two players to fill every space of one color gain 5/6/7 and 2/3/4 points, respectively.
Final scoring:
One point per silver and unsold goods tile, one per two workers, plus monasteries, shields and vineyards.
Expansions:
Extra tiles add monasteries 27–28, the crane and geese.
· A crane triggers any building effect and can count as any scoring building at the end.
· White castles grant an action using the white die, adjustable with workers.
· Inns fit any color, at most one per area, and increase its scoring size by one.
· Sold goods fill trade routes from left to right; matching numbers grant rewards. You may arrange route pieces during setup if enabled.
Border posts: connecting two posts scores the phase bonus; connecting the third scores another phase bonus and competes for the border bonus tile. Castle connections apply only to boards 11–18: a new tile must also touch a castle or connect to one through placed tiles of its color. Castles follow normal placement. Both dice and five points retrieve an unclaimed castle removed in an earlier phase.
Shields: spend two equal dice, adjusting with workers, to claim a shield from that depot. Attach it to a placed castle, replacing a previous shield if desired. At phase end, pay one silver per shield before mine income or discard it.
Vineyards: double hexes occupy two storage spaces. Take or place one using the matching die; flip to exchange its colors. The first tile must occupy a bottom-layer space numbered 1 or 4; later tiles must touch existing vines. Resolve both covered rewards in your chosen order. Complete a layer to choose a vine bonus. At the end, each bonus scores one matching connected color area using triangular scoring. Each area and bonus scores once.
Teams:
Four players form two adjacent pairs. Share a duchy, goods, workers and silver. Each player has two private storage spaces; the team has two shared spaces. You cannot use your partner’s dice or private tiles. Both players may build anywhere on the team duchy.
Original solo challenge:
Fill all 37 spaces within 25 rounds. After placing goods with the white die, remove the top tile from that depot, continuing clockwise if empty. Expand between regions only via rivers. After a ship takes goods, discard goods in other depots. You may exchange any five owned goods for a black-depot tile, stored face down; it fits any color but grants no effect. Scoring monasteries score immediately. Completing a color grants a black-depot tile to place directly instead of bonus points. Whenever scoring points, you may buy extra points with silver. Reaching the target resets your score, lowers the target by five to a minimum of five, and grants a free action.
Châteauma:
The official automa occupies one player slot and uses county cards to acquire tiles, trigger effects, complete cards and claim bonuses. White die 1–4 selects its left card, 5–6 its right. Three difficulty tiers set county scores. Modifiers A/B prefill its duchy, C gives it the first turn, and D enables extra-action spaces. It uses no workers and ignores monastery abilities; each monastery scores four at the end. The automa wins ties. Inns, team boards and original solo boards are incompatible; shield 2 is removed.
