zh.name: 勃艮第城堡：骰子版
zh.desc: 共用五颗骰子，在四款领地上扩建城市、牧场与城堡，争夺颜色奖励
zh.rules:
目标：
在三阶段内扩建领地，获得最高总分。所有人使用相同的 A、B、C 或 D 领地。
开局：同时秘密选择一个绿色城堡作为起点，获得其标示的奖励和 1 分。起点没有数字。可选变体为依次选择不同城堡（最多四人），或由首位玩家指定相同城堡。
每轮：首位玩家掷两颗数字骰、两颗颜色骰和一颗计时骰，整局不轮换。计时骰有四面单沙漏、两面双沙漏。每阶段填满十个时间格后，完成本轮再进入下一阶段；多余沙漏不带入下一阶段。
双沙漏：在填格前，每人可出售全部现有货物，每份货物获得1枚银币和 2 分；也可全部保留。出售货物不占本轮使用奖励的次数。
填格：每人从共用骰中选择一颗数字骰和一颗颜色骰，在相应颜色且与已填格相邻的空格写入数字。骰子不会被取走。
· 紫色修道院只能填 1 或 2。
· 灰色矿山只能填 3 或 4。
· 蓝色河流只能填 5 或 6。
· 同一橙色城市的数字必须互不相同。
· 同一黄色牧场中填写的数字必须全部相同。
· 绿色城堡必须填入邻接已填格中的一个数字，起点的叉号不算数字。
也可放弃填格，改为获得1名工人。
奖励：每轮最多使用一个奖励。
· 修士将一颗颜色骰视为任意颜色。
· 工人可以将1颗数字骰的点数视为1至6中的任意数字。
· 银币可在正常填格后再填一格，第二次必须至少换用一颗骰子（即使两骰相同点数或颜色，也视为不同骰子）。
使用修士或工人后不能再使用银币。刚获得的奖励当轮可以使用。
区域：填满一个相连的同色区域后，按格数和当前阶段得分：下列分值依次对应第一、第二和第三阶段：
· 1格区域分别获得1、1、1分。
· 2格区域分别获得4、3、2分。
· 3格区域分别获得8、6、4分。
· 4格区域分别获得13、10、7分。
黄色牧场的区域得分翻倍。完成区域时，还会获得以下奖励：
· 完成修道院，获得1名修士。
· 完成矿山，获得1枚银币。
· 完成河流，获得1份货物。
· 完成城市，获得1名工人。
· 完成城堡，获得图示奖励。
颜色竞赛：一轮结束时，填满某颜色全部格子的玩家获得额外分。同轮完成者均获得相同档位奖励。各颜色第一档和第二档的奖励分别为：
· 修道院：4分和2分。
· 矿山：3分和1分。
· 河流：4分和2分。
· 城市：6分和3分。
· 城堡：3分和1分。
· 牧场：4分和2分。
两档都被领取后不再奖励。
终局：第三阶段最后一轮完成后，总分最高者获胜。同分比较剩余奖励总数（包含货物），仍同分则共同获胜。
单人：每阶段固定八轮，共二十四轮。计时骰仍决定是否能出售货物。前两阶段完成颜色获得第一档奖励，第三阶段获得第二档；目标是挑战自己的得分，超过 50 分、超过 60 分与达到 70 分分别获得更高评价。

en.name: The Castles of Burgundy: The Dice Game
en.desc: Share five dice to expand four different duchies and race to complete each color
en.rules:
Goal: Score the most points over three phases. Everyone uses the same duchy A, B, C or D.
Setup: Secretly choose a green starting castle simultaneously. Gain its bonus and 1 point. The starting cross has no number. Optional variants: choose different castles in seat order (up to four players), or let the first player choose one castle for everyone.
Each round: The same first player rolls two pip dice, two color dice and the hourglass die. The hourglass die has four single and two double faces. Fill the current phase's ten time spaces, then play the round before advancing. Excess hourglasses never carry over.
Double hourglass: Before marking, each player may sell all existing commodities, gaining 1 silver and 2 points per commodity, or keep them all. Selling does not use your one bonus for the round.
Marking: Choose one pip die and one color die. Enter that number in an empty hex of that color next to any marked hex. Dice remain available to everyone.
· Purple monasteries need 1 or 2.
· Gray mines need 3 or 4.
· Blue rivers need 5 or 6.
· Numbers in each orange city must all differ.
· Numbers in each yellow pasture must all match.
· A green castle must match a number already entered in an adjacent hex; the starting cross is not a number.
You may forgo marking and gain 1 worker instead.
Bonuses: Use at most one bonus per complete round.
· A monk changes one color die to any color.
· A worker changes one pip die to any number from 1 to 6.
· Silver allows a second mark after a normal first mark, using at least one different die. Identical faces on separate dice still count as different dice.
After using a monk or worker, you cannot use silver. Newly gained bonuses are immediately available.
Areas: Complete a connected area of one color to score according to its size and phase: The following values correspond to phases one, two, and three, in that order:
· One hex scores 1, 1, or 1 point.
· Two hexes score 4, 3, or 2 points.
· Three hexes score 8, 6, or 4 points.
· Four hexes score 13, 10, or 7 points.
Pastures score double. A monastery also gives 1 monk, a mine 1 silver, a river 1 commodity, a city 1 worker, and a castle its pictured bonus.
Color races: Resolve at the end of each round. All players completing a color in the same round gain the currently available tier. The first-tier and second-tier rewards are:
· Monastery: 4 and 2 points.
· Mine: 3 and 1 point.
· River: 4 and 2 points.
· City: 6 and 3 points.
· Castle: 3 and 1 point.
· Pasture: 4 and 2 points.
No further points are awarded after both tiers have been claimed.
End: Finish the last round of phase three. Highest total wins. Ties go to the most remaining bonuses, including commodities; a further tie is a shared victory.
Solo: Play exactly eight rounds per phase, twenty-four total. Still roll the hourglass die to trigger sales. Complete a color in phases one or two for its higher reward, or phase three for its lower reward. Challenge your own score: more than 50, more than 60, and 70 or more earn increasing accolades.

zh.name: 卡坦岛
zh.desc: 拓荒、修路、交易,在卡坦岛上建起你的势力
zh.rules:
目标:自己回合内率先达到 10 分者立即获胜。
准备:
· 版图随机生成:19 块地形按螺旋摆数字碟,红色高产的 6 与 8 永不相邻;沙漠上放强盗。
· 蛇形开局:先按正序，每人放置1座村庄和1条道路；再按逆序，每人放置第2座村庄和1条道路;第二座村庄立即收获相邻地形的资源。
· 任何建筑之间至少隔 2 条边(全程生效)。
流程(每回合):
· 可先打 1 张骑士,再掷 2 颗骰子;对应数字的地形产出资源,相邻村庄获得 1 张、城市获得 2 张。
· 掷出 7:不产出;手牌超过 7 张者弃一半(向下取整),随后移动强盗到新地形,并从该地块有建筑的一名玩家手中随机抽取1张资源卡。
· 行动阶段(任意顺序、不限次数):建造、与银行兑换、向其他玩家发报价,或打出 1 张发展卡(当回合买的不能打)。
· 建造费用：建造1条道路需要支付1张木材和1张砖块；建造1座村庄需要支付木材、砖块、羊毛和小麦各1张。
· 将村庄升级为城市需要支付2张小麦和3张矿石；购买1张发展卡需要支付羊毛、小麦和矿石各1张。
· 与银行按 4:1 兑换;建有港口建筑可 3:1,专属港口 2:1。
· 新路必须接自家路网,不可穿过对手建筑;新村必须连着自家路。
交易:
· 报价是一口价:其他人只能接受或拒绝,不接受还价;不能同种资源互换。
发展卡:
· 骑士:移动强盗并从目标玩家手中随机抽取1张资源卡;累计打出 3 张获得「最大军队」2 分,被超过则易主。
· 修路:免费修 2 条路。
· 丰收:从银行任取 2 张资源。
· 垄断:收取其他所有玩家手中全部的该种资源。
· 胜利点:提供1点隐藏胜利点，获胜时展示。
计分:
· 村庄 1 分、城市 2 分;最长连续道路达到 5 条获得 2 分(被对手建筑打断可能失去,平手持有者优先)。
· 银行每种资源 19 张;某次产出若不足以分配给所有应领取者，该种资源本次不向任何人发放；若只有一名玩家应领取，则由该玩家获得剩余的全部资源卡。

en.name: CATAN
en.desc: Settle, build roads, and trade your way across the island
en.rules:
Goal: reach 10 victory points on your own turn to win immediately.
Setup:
· The island is generated at random: number discs are placed in a spiral over 19 terrain hexes, and the red high-yield 6s and 8s are never adjacent; the robber starts on the desert.
· Snake draft: in seat order each player places 1 settlement + 1 road, then in reverse order a second pair; your second settlement immediately yields the resources of its adjacent hexes.
· Buildings must always be at least two edges apart.
Each turn:
· You may play 1 Knight, then roll both dice; hexes with the matching number produce: 1 card per adjacent settlement, 2 per city.
· On a 7: nothing produces; anyone holding more than 7 cards discards half (rounded down), then you move the robber to a new hex and steal 1 random card from a player with a building there.
· Action phase (any order, any number of times): build, trade with the supply, make trade offers, or play 1 development card (not one bought this turn).
· Building costs: a road takes 1 wood and 1 brick; a settlement takes 1 wood, 1 brick, 1 wool and 1 wheat.
· A city takes 2 wheat and 3 ore (upgrading a settlement); a development card takes 1 wool, 1 wheat and 1 ore.
· Trade with the supply at 4:1; a generic port gives 3:1, a matching port 2:1.
· New roads must connect to your network and may not pass through an opponent’s building; new settlements must touch your own road.
Trading:
· Offers are take-it-or-leave-it: others may only accept or decline, no counteroffers; trading a resource for itself is not allowed.
Development cards:
· Knight: move the robber and steal 1 card; 3 played Knights earn Largest Army (2 VP), lost if surpassed.
· Road Building: build 2 roads free.
· Invention: take any 2 resources from the supply.
· Monopoly: take every card of one resource from all other players.
· Victory Point: kept hidden, revealed when you win.
Scoring:
· Settlement 1 VP, city 2 VP; the longest continuous route of at least 5 roads earns 2 VP (it can be lost when an opponent’s building cuts it; ties favor the holder).
· The supply holds 19 of each resource; if a production roll cannot pay everyone, that resource pays nobody (a lone recipient takes what remains).

zh.name: 卡坦岛：骰子版
zh.desc: 掷出资源，在自己的卡坦岛图上修路、建造村庄与城市。两张岛图带来十五回合计分与十分竞速。
zh.rules:
目标：
岛屿一供 1–4 人游玩，每人进行 15 回合，总分最高者获胜，同分者共享胜利。岛屿二供 2–4 人游玩，最先达到 10 分者立即获胜。
准备：
每人持有独立岛图，紫色起始道路已经建成。岛屿一每回合使用六颗骰子。岛屿二的首个回合使用三颗骰子，之后每个连续回合增加一颗，达到六颗后保持六颗。
回合流程：
每回合最多掷骰三次。每次掷骰后，可保留任意骰子；此前保留的骰子也可取消保留后重掷。至少掷一次后可开始建造，进入建造后不能再掷骰。资源用完或决定停止时结束回合，未使用的资源不保留到下一回合。
· 建造1段道路需要1份砖块和1份木材。
· 招募1名骑士需要1份羊毛、1份谷物和1份矿石。
· 建造1座村庄需要1份砖块、1份木材、1份羊毛和1份谷物。
· 建造1座城市需要2份谷物和3份矿石。
可在同回合建造多次。道路必须连接已建道路，村庄与城市必须与已建道路相邻。未建造的村庄或城市不会阻断修路。骑士不需要道路连接。岛屿一的村庄、城市、骑士分别按印刷点值从低到高建造；岛屿二可以任意顺序建造。
金与资源百搭：
完成掷骰后，可将两颗金骰换成一颗任意非金资源骰，另一颗金骰视为已使用。只剩一颗金骰时不能交易；资源足够时可多次交易。
建造骑士后，其下方的资源百搭每局可以使用一次：选择一颗未使用的骰子，将其转为百搭所示资源。沙漠的问号可转为任意资源，包括金。岛屿一的第六名骑士解锁问号百搭；岛屿二每个沙漠必须建造两名骑士才解锁对应问号百搭。可在建造骑士的同回合使用百搭，同回合也可使用多个百搭。
计分与结束：
岛屿一：本回合新建建筑的印刷点值相加，记入一个回合格。
· 每建造1段道路，获得1分。
· 依次招募的6名骑士，分别获得1、2、3、4、5、6分。
· 依次建造的6座村庄，分别获得3、4、5、7、9、11分。
· 城市依次获得7、12、20、30分。
本回合没有建造任何建筑时，记为−2分。每人完成15回合后比较总分。
岛屿二：村庄每座 1 分，城市每座 2 分，道路与骑士本身不计分。
· 第一位拥有至少五段连续道路的玩家获得最长道路及 2 分，免费起始路计入长度，分支不能相加；他人的连续道路严格更长时转移奖励。
· 第一位建成至少三名骑士的玩家获得最大骑士团及 2 分，他人的骑士数量严格更多时转移奖励；使用百搭不减少骑士数量。
平手时奖励保留在原持有者处。任何玩家达到 10 分时立即结束。

en.name: Catan Dice Game
en.desc: Roll resources and build roads, settlements and cities on your own Catan island. Play for fifteen turns or race to ten points.
en.rules:
Goal:
Island One is for 1–4 players. Each player takes 15 turns; the highest total wins, with tied players sharing victory. Island Two is for 2–4 players; the first player to reach 10 points wins immediately.
Preparation:
Each player has a separate island sheet. The purple starting road is already built. Island One uses six dice every turn. In Island Two the first turn uses three dice, then each consecutive turn adds one die until six dice are used for every turn.
Taking a turn:
Roll up to three times. After each roll, keep any dice you want. Previously kept dice can be released and rolled again. After at least one roll you may start building; you cannot roll again after doing so. End your turn when you finish building. Unspent resources are lost.
· Building a road costs 1 brick and 1 lumber.
· Building a knight costs 1 wool, 1 grain and 1 ore.
· Building a settlement costs 1 brick, 1 lumber, 1 wool and 1 grain.
· Building a city costs 2 grain and 3 ore.
You may build several times in one turn. Roads must connect to built roads; settlements and cities must be adjacent to a built road. Unbuilt settlements and cities do not block road construction. Knights do not need a road connection. In Island One, build each type of settlement, city and knight in ascending printed point order. In Island Two they may be built in any order.
Gold and resource jokers:
After rolling, trade two gold dice for one die showing any non-gold resource; the other gold die is spent. One gold cannot be traded alone. You may make multiple trades if you have enough gold.
After building a knight, its resource joker can be used once per game: choose an unspent die and turn it to the shown resource. A desert question mark allows any resource, including gold. Island One unlocks this joker with the sixth knight. Each desert in Island Two needs both of its knights before its question-mark joker is unlocked. You may use a joker on the turn you build its knight, and use several jokers in one turn.
Scoring and game end:
Island One: add the printed points of everything built this turn and record the total in one turn box.
· Roads are worth 1 point each.
· Knights are worth 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6 points in building order.
· Settlements are worth 3, 4, 5, 7, 9 and 11 points in building order.
· Cities are worth 7, 12, 20 and 30 points in building order.
A turn in which you build nothing scores −2 points. Compare totals after everyone finishes 15 turns.
Island Two: settlements are worth 1 point and cities 2. Roads and knights score no basic points.
· The first player with at least five connected roads gains Longest Road and 2 points. Include the free starting road; do not add branches together. A strictly longer road takes the award.
· The first player with at least three knights gains Largest Army and 2 points; a strictly larger army takes it. Using jokers does not reduce the army size.
Ties leave awards with their current holders. The game ends immediately when a player reaches 10 points.

zh.name: 盒中猫
zh.desc: 量子吃墩:颜色打出时才宣告,别把自己逼进悖论
zh.rules:
目标:预报每轮要赢的墩数并精准命中,几轮后总分最高者获胜。
准备:
卡牌只有数字，没有预设颜色。每个数字各有5张牌，使用的数字范围取决于对局人数：
· 三人对局使用数字1至6。
· 四人对局使用数字1至8。
· 五人对局使用数字1至9。
· 每人起手 10 张(5 人局 9 张),各自扣置 1 张移出本轮。
· 从起始玩家开始顺时针预报赢墩数:3 人局只能报 1、3 或 4;4~5 人局报 1、2 或 3。
流程:
· 轮到你时打出一张牌并宣告它的颜色;研究板上同色同数字的格子只能被占一次。
· 宣告与领出色不同的颜色,须公开标记「没有领出色」;已标记没有的颜色不能再宣告。
· 领出者原则上不能领红(王牌);红已被观测过、或整手牌都无法宣告其他颜色时除外。
· 墩的归属:本墩有红色牌时，由红色牌中数字最大的牌赢墩；没有红色牌时，由领出花色中数字最大的牌赢墩;赢家领出下一墩。
· 手牌剩 1 张时本轮结束(共 8 墩,5 人局 7 墩);若轮到你时没有任何合法宣告,悖论发生,本轮立即中止、当前墩作废。
结算:
· 每赢 1 墩获得 1 分;预报命中再加奖励分,等于研究板上你的标记最大连通片(横竖相邻)的格数。
· 引发悖论者改为每赢 1 墩扣 1 分,且不获得预报奖励分。
· 轮数等于人数,起始玩家每轮左移;总分最高者获胜,平分比较最后一轮得分,若仍然相同，则共享胜利。

en.name: Cat in the Box
en.desc: Quantum trick-taking: a card's color is declared only as you play it — don't paradox yourself
en.rules:
Goal: predict how many tricks you will win each round and hit it exactly; highest total score after all rounds wins.
Setup:
Cards have numbers but no fixed color. Use five copies of each number in the range for the player count:
· Three-player games use numbers 1–6.
· Four-player games use numbers 1–8.
· Five-player games use numbers 1–9.
· Each player is dealt 10 cards (9 with 5 players), then sets 1 card face down out of the round.
· Starting from the round start player and going clockwise, predict your tricks: with 3 players only 1, 3 or 4 is allowed; with 4-5 players choose 1, 2 or 3.
Play:
· On your turn, play a card and declare its color; on the research board, each color-number space can be claimed only once.
· Declaring a color different from the led color publicly marks that you have none of the led color; a color you have marked as none can never be declared again.
· The trick leader may not lead red (trump), unless red has already been observed or no card in hand can be declared any other color.
· If any red cards are played to the trick, the highest-numbered red card wins. Otherwise, the highest-numbered card in the led color wins. The winner leads the next trick.
· The round ends when 1 card remains in hand (8 tricks, 7 with 5 players); if you have no legal declaration on your turn, a paradox occurs and the round stops immediately with the current trick voided.
Scoring:
· 1 point per trick won; a successful prediction adds a bonus equal to the largest connected group (orthogonally adjacent) of your tokens on the research board.
· The player who caused the paradox scores -1 per trick won instead and gets no bonus.
· Rounds equal the player count, with the start player rotating left; highest total wins, ties break on the final round score, and further ties share the victory.

zh.name: 洞穴农夫
zh.desc: 12 回合经营矮人家园:坑道挖矿、森林放牧、锻造武器去远征,别忘了喂饱全家
zh.rules:
目标:12 回合后,家园经营得分最高者获胜。
准备:
· 每人获得一块家园版图、2名矮人和入门居所。版图的山体与森林各为3行4列；按行动顺序，前四个座位分别获得1、1、2、3份起始食物。
· 阶段卡分四阶段洗混,每回合开始翻开一张新行动格。
流程:
· 每回合轮流向空行动格放置 1 名矮人并执行该格;必须先放徒手矮人,再按武器强度升序放武装矮人(可以支付1颗红宝石，改变该矮人的放置顺序)。
· 累积格上的物资每回合增加。选择该行动格时，拿取其中的全部物资，将该格清空。
· 通过挖掘隧道和洞穴、建造家具、铺设草原、开垦田地并播种、围建牧场饲养动物，以及锻造武器后远征获取战利品，发展自己的家园。每名矮人都需要一个居所空位。
· 红宝石可以用来兑换物资、取得单块板块，或调整矮人的放置顺序。兑换物资的比例为1颗红宝石换取1份物资；兑换牛时，还需要额外支付1份食物。
收获(按回合与标记):
· 田地各收 1 份作物。
· 每名矮人需要消耗2份食物，当轮新生矮人只需消耗1份。食物不足时领取乞讨牌，每张扣除3分。
· 每类农场动物不少于 2 只时繁殖 1 只。
计分:分别计算动物、谷物、蔬菜、红宝石、矮人与金币的分数。其中，谷物每2份计1分，向上取整；牧场、矿场与家具按其面值计分。
· 缺一类农场动物扣 2 分,未开发格扣 1 分,乞讨牌扣 3 分;黄底家具另有奖励分。平局共享胜利。
单人:阶段卡采用固定顺序,第 5 回合起每轮收获;累积格超过 6 份物资会清空(可付红宝石保留)。

en.name: Caverna
en.desc: Develop your dwarf homestead over 12 rounds: mine tunnels, farm the forest, forge weapons for expeditions — and keep everyone fed
en.rules:
Goal: after 12 rounds, the most valuable homestead wins.
Setup:
· Each player gets a home board (3 rows by 4 columns of mountain, plus 3 rows by 4 columns of forest), 2 dwarfs and an entry-level dwelling; the first four seats receive 1, 1, 2 and 3 food respectively in turn order.
· Stage cards are shuffled within four stages; one new action space is revealed each round.
Flow:
· Take turns placing 1 dwarf on an empty action space and resolving it. Unarmed dwarfs must be placed first, then armed ones in ascending weapon strength (pay 1 ruby to skip the order).
· Goods accumulate on accumulation spaces each round; taking them empties the space.
· Dig tunnels and caverns, furnish rooms (every dwarf needs dwelling space), lay meadows and fields, fence pastures, forge weapons and go on expeditions for loot.
· Rubies are wild: exchange 1:1 for goods (cattle costs 1 extra food), exchange for single tiles, or skip the dwarf play order.
Harvest (by round and token):
· Collect 1 crop per field.
· Feed 2 food per dwarf (1 per newborn); unfed dwarfs take begging markers (each costs 3 points).
· Each farm-animal type with at least 2 animals produces 1 offspring.
Scoring: animals, grain (every 2 score 1 point, rounded up), vegetables, rubies, dwarfs and gold all score; pastures, mines and furnishings score their printed value.
· Each missing farm animal type costs 2 points, each undeveloped space costs 1, each begging marker costs 3; yellow furnishing tiles grant bonus points. Ties are shared wins.
Solo: fixed stage order, harvest every round from round 5; accumulation spaces holding more than 6 goods are cleared (pay 1 ruby per space to keep).

zh.name: 冠军挑战者!
zh.desc: 组建梦幻战队打七轮夺旗巡回赛,攒粉丝进决赛,捧起冠军杯
zh.rules:
目标:7 轮巡回赛后,粉丝总数前两名进入决赛,决赛胜者夺冠。
流程(每轮两段):
· 组牌:从指定牌堆抽 5 张展示,留下至多 1~2 张(可以一张不留),可整手重抽一次。
· 选牌结束后，可以从自己的卡组中移除卡牌。
· 比赛:与本轮对手夺旗。双方轮流翻牌比力量,攻方总力量达到持旗方即夺旗。
· 失旗的卡进替补席(6 格,同名叠放);牌堆翻空或替补席无法容纳新卡牌的一方输掉本场比赛。
· 胜者捧走本轮奖杯,奖杯的粉丝值保密。
· 需要抉择的卡效果会暂停比赛,等当事人操作完再继续。
牌堆配置:
· 第1至2轮：从A级牌堆选择至多2张牌。
· 第3至4轮：从A级牌堆选择至多2张牌，或从B级牌堆选择至多1张牌。
· 第5至7轮：从B级牌堆选择至多2张牌，或从C级牌堆选择至多1张牌。
决赛:
· 7 轮后粉丝前两名进决赛,赛前只能撤卡整备;决赛胜者捧起冠军杯。

en.name: Challengers!
en.desc: Draft your dream team, fight seven capture-the-flag rounds, and lift the cup in the final
en.rules:
Goal: after 7 tournament rounds, the two players with the most fans meet in the final, and the finalist who wins it lifts the cup.
Each round has two parts:
· Deck phase: draw 5 cards from this round’s pile and keep up to 1–2 (you may keep none); one full redraw is allowed.
· Afterwards you may trim weak cards from your deck — a thinner deck cycles your best cards more often.
· Match phase: a flag duel against this round’s opponent. Take turns flipping cards and comparing power; the attacker captures the flag by matching the holder’s total power.
· Beaten cards go to a 6-slot bench (same names stack); running out of deck cards or bench space loses the match.
· The winner takes the round’s trophy, whose fan value stays secret.
· Card effects that need a decision pause the match until that player answers.
Pile schedule:
· In rounds 1–2, keep up to 2 cards from pile A.
· In rounds 3–4, keep up to 2 cards from pile A or 1 card from pile B.
· In rounds 5–7, keep up to 2 cards from pile B or 1 card from pile C.
The final:
· After 7 rounds the top two in fans advance; only trimming is allowed before the final. The winner of the final is the champion.

zh.name: 三国杀：承天之弈
zh.desc: 以武将构筑军营，在双人对弈中运筹制胜。包含布将为子与可选的逆命天澜。
zh.rules:
目标：
使对手在濒死结算中无法回复至正体力，或使被将的对手进入其回合结束。

构筑：
选择主帅和与其同名的起始武将，构筑含起始武将在内的40张武将卡组。同名称与称号最多3张，执行现行禁限。单势力卡组体力上限5；双势力卡组体力上限4，副势力最多10张。

开局：
起始武将正面朝上置于战场，其余武将洗为军营。双方各摸4张游戏牌，各可使用一次手气卡。

回合：
重置己方武将并选择翻正，然后依次进行准备、判定、摸牌、出牌、弃牌和结束阶段。通常摸2张牌，出牌阶段结束时上阵2名武将；先手首回合分别为1张和1名。弃牌阶段先休整战场至5名，再弃手牌至当前体力值。

技能：
具备行动权且满足条件时可以发动。必须先锁定并能够支付全部费用，再依文字顺序支付。支付费用休整发动者自身时，可以额外摸1张牌。每名武将在同一时机只能发动一次技能，结算后保留原行动权。

助阵：
符合类别或势力的非临时武将从战场进入休整区时，可改为进入己方尚未满员的助阵区。技能生效时满足条件则界限突破；助阵武将不在战场上。

将军：
濒死中每局可倒置主帅一次，休整任意数量己方武将并摸等量牌。被将的玩家在自己的回合结束时落败。

流放：
背面朝上的流放牌仅本方可看，普通效果不影响流放区。

en.name: Sanguosha: Chengtian Zhiyi
en.desc: Build an army of generals for a tactical duel. Includes Bu Jiang Wei Zi and the optional Ni Ming Tian Lan set.
en.rules:
Goal:
defeat an opponent who cannot recover above zero health during a dying resolution, or reach the end of their turn while their commander is checked.

Deck:
choose a commander and a starting general with the same name. Build exactly 40 general cards, including the starting general. Use at most three copies of the same name and title, subject to current bans and restrictions. A single-faction deck starts at 5 maximum health. A two-faction deck starts at 4, with at most 10 generals from its secondary faction.

Setup:
place the starting general face up on the battlefield and shuffle the remaining generals into the army. Each player draws four game cards and may take one mulligan.

Turn:
reset your generals and optionally reveal any of them. Proceed through preparation, judgement, draw, play, discard and end phases. Normally draw two cards and deploy two generals after the play phase. The first player draws and deploys only one on their first turn. In the discard phase, first rest generals down to five, then discard hand cards down to current health.

Skills:
you need priority and must meet every requirement. Reserve and be able to pay the complete cost, then pay it in printed order. If you rest the activating general as a cost, you may draw one extra card. A general may activate only once per timing. You retain priority after its skill resolves.

Support:
an eligible non-temporary general leaving your battlefield for rest may instead support one of your generals whose support area is not full. Meet its printed requirements when the skill takes effect to break through. Support generals are outside the battlefield.

Check:
once per game while dying, invert your commander, rest any number of your generals and draw that many cards. A checked player loses at the end of their own turn.

Exile:
only the owner can inspect face-down exiled cards. Ordinary effects cannot affect exile.

search.py: san guo sha cheng tian zhi yi bu jiang wei zi ni ming tian lan

zh.name: 推理事件簿
zh.desc: 独自调查伦敦、黑幕与红景镇案件，询问人物、观察现场并揭开真相。
zh.rules:
目标：
· 调查案件，收集线索并回答结案问题。
准备：
· 选择伦敦基础版、黑幕或红景镇系列，再选择案件。
· 每局由一人操作；红景镇开局另选一名少年角色。
· 从结案页继续下一章，会保留相应结果和角色。
· 直接选章使用默认开局；案件中的编号对应下方卡片。
调查：
· 点选卡片，再点击底部行动按钮执行；选择不消耗时间。
· 地点用于前往，人物用于交谈，物品和证据类别用于检查。
· 询问时选择其他人物或物品，向当前人物提问。
· 基础版可联系专家，再选择分析对象并执行行动。
· 再点选中卡可取消选择；结束询问后可与其他人物交谈。
· 通常移动消耗20分钟，询问和检查消耗5分钟。
· 个别案件或行动的耗时不同，以案件内时间变化为准。
· 允许搜证的地点才可现场搜证，每次消耗5分钟。
· 观察持续40秒；结束后选择看到的证据类别并检查。
· 人物、地点和特殊物品随正文揭示加入卡区。
· 线索和人物会随调查进展与游戏内时间改变。
· 轻点正文或卡区翻页；右下角三角表示还有下一段。
· 普通末页可直接选卡行动；观察、选择和结案另行确认。
· 选中人物或物品，可查看关联案卷与已知人物资料。
· 案卷可查看带时间与对象的记录、编辑笔记。
· 对局进度由本机自动保存。
黑幕：
· 使用跟踪、恫吓、擅闯和贿赂行动卡调查。
· 行动针对当前地点或正在询问的人物。
· 贿赂需要至少20美元；实际收支随剧情自动结算。
红景镇：
· 使用体能、头脑、沟通行动卡；提示卡用于索取线索。
· 可进行的检定和提示随当前地点、人物及剧情改变。
· 检定掷一枚六面骰，加上角色对应能力与难度修正。
· 简单增加1点，普通不变，困难减少1点。
· 合计5至6获得1个成功，7或以上获得2个成功。
· 当前单角色模式累计至少1个成功便通过检定。
· 未通过时可消耗1点体力追加掷骰，成功数累加。
· 也可接受失败并继续剧情；通过后无需追加掷骰。
· 少数剧情直接询问行动结果，按提示选择成功或失败。
· 回总部睡觉可恢复体力；特殊剧情可能限制恢复或能力。
结算：
· 按剧情指引提交结案报告；部分剧情自动进入结案。
· 逐题选择卡片并提交；选答题可以跳过。
· 必答题答错会扣分并返回调查。
· 得分包含答案、调查结果、耗时和累计奖惩。

en.name: Chronicles of Crime
en.desc: Investigate London, Noir and Redview cases. Interview witnesses, search scenes and uncover the truth.
en.rules:
Goal:
· Investigate the case, gather clues and answer the closing questions.
Setup:
· Choose London, Noir or Redview, then select a case.
· One player investigates; Redview also requires a teenager role.
· Continue from the closing report to retain relevant results and your role.
· Direct chapter selection uses the default start. References match the cards below.
Investigation:
· Select a card, then press its action button. Selection costs no time.
· Travel to locations, talk to people, and examine items or evidence categories.
· During an interview, select another person or item to ask about them.
· In the base game, contact an expert, then select a subject to analyze.
· Tap a selected card again to deselect it. End an interview before starting another.
· Travel usually costs 20 minutes; questions and item checks cost 5 minutes.
· Some cases and actions use different costs, reflected in the game clock.
· Eligible locations allow scene searches, each costing 5 game minutes.
· Observe for 40 seconds, then select the evidence categories you noticed and examine them.
· People, locations and special items appear as the story reveals them.
· Clues and characters can change with progress and game time.
· Tap the story or card area to read on; a triangle marks the next passage.
· Act directly on the last passage; observation, choices and closing use explicit buttons.
· Select a person or item to read related records and known profiles.
· Case file contains timed investigation records and notes.
· Progress is saved automatically on this device.
Noir:
· Use Follow, Intimidate, Break In and Bribe action cards.
· Actions target your current location or the person you are interviewing.
· Bribery requires at least $20. The story applies all income and spending.
Redview:
· Use Fitness, Mind and Speech action cards, or the Hint card for leads.
· Available tests and hints depend on your location, interview and progress.
· Roll one six-sided die and add the matching ability and difficulty modifier.
· Easy adds +1, Normal adds 0 and Hard adds −1.
· A total of 5–6 gives 1 success; a total of 7 or more gives 2.
· This single-character mode requires at least 1 accumulated success to pass.
· If you fail, you may spend 1 energy to roll an extra die. Successes accumulate.
· You may accept failure and continue. Once you pass, no extra roll is needed.
· A few story prompts ask for an action result directly; select success or failure as prompted.
· Sleep at HQ to recover energy. Special events can restrict recovery or abilities.
Scoring:
· Follow the story to submit the closing report. Some events start it automatically.
· Select and submit a card for each question; optional questions may be skipped.
· A wrong mandatory answer costs points and returns you to the investigation.
· Scoring includes answers, investigation results, time and accumulated penalties.

zh.name: 荣耀之城：对决
zh.desc: 两人秘密招募角色，共建城市，争夺城区与议会。
zh.rules:
目标：
双方共同建设一座城市，并争夺城区控制权。城市建满16个城区时立即结束，得分最高者获胜。
准备：
· 随机放置两个正交相邻的起始城区，双方各控制一个。每人从三个独特城区中秘密保留两个，其余退出本局。
· 16个基础城区洗成四叠，每叠四个，只有顶端城区可供建设。九个议会席位随机分成五席与四席；五席者获得2枚金币，四席者获得4枚金币。
· 金币总量为25枚。获得金币时从公共供应领取，支付时归还供应；供应不足时只获得剩余数量。守卫起始位于议会，尚不保护城区。
每轮流程：
· 招募：九张角色牌洗牌后各发四张，余下一张暗弃。双方同时保留两张，把另外两张交给对手，再从手中四张牌里暗弃一张。每人最终持有三张角色。
· 角色行动：依编号1至9逐个叫号。持有该角色的人亮牌并执行能力；无人持有则跳过。所有能力步骤均可跳过；同一角色的多项能力依所列顺序执行，二选一能力只能选一项。
· 扩张：议会多数者先获得3枚金币，再可以建设一个城区；另一人随后选择获得2枚金币或建设一个城区。之后开始下一轮。
建设与保护：
选择一叠顶部的基础城区或本人保留的独特城区，支付印刷费用，把它放到城市的正交相邻空位，并取得控制权。整个城市的横向、纵向跨度各不得超过四格，可以从起始城区向任何方向发展。所有费用折扣最低减至0枚金币。
· 新建城区每与一个同色城区正交相邻，就在新城区上放置1枚供应金币；对手的同色城区也计算在内。
· 守卫保护其所在城区及正交相邻的所有城区，不区分归属。受保护城区不能被盗贼、外交官或军阀针对。
角色能力：
· 刺客（1）：叫出一个角色。若对手手中持有该角色，对手立即亮出并弃置它，本轮不能执行其能力。
· 盗贼（2）：叫出一个角色。若对手手中持有该角色，你可以从对手的钱包和任意未受保护城区上合计取走至多3枚金币。可以混合来源，城区可以属于任意一方。
· 国王（3）：获得1个议会席位，并按本人控制的每个黄色贵族城区再获得1席；然后可以把守卫移动到另一个城区，并可以在新位置放置1枚供应金币。
· 修道院长（4）：若你的钱包金币少于对手，对手交给你1枚金币；然后你可以建设一个城区，每控制一个蓝色宗教城区，费用减少1枚金币。
· 商人（5）：获得3枚金币；然后可以选择至多两个不同的、由你控制的绿色商业城区，分别放置1枚供应金币。
· 建筑师（6）：可以建设至多两个城区，其中一次建设费用减少1枚金币。可以把折扣留给第二次建设。
· 外交官（7）：选择获得2个议会席位，或失去与一个未受保护的敌方城区价值相等的席位，取得该城区控制权。价值为印刷费用加城区上的金币数，原有金币保留。
· 军阀（8）：选择移动守卫，或支付一个未受保护敌方城区的价值，取得其控制权。每控制一个红色军事城区，支付费用减少1枚金币，最低为0枚金币。
· 王后（9）：按你控制的城区中不同颜色的数量获得议会席位，最多获得5席。新增席位从对手的九个共同席位中翻转，不能超过九席。
独特城区：
· 军械库：建成后，可以把守卫移动到本城区。
· 国会大厦：建成后，可以获得2个议会席位。
· 帝国金库：建成后，在本城区上额外放置2枚供应金币。
· 象牙塔：不能被盗贼、外交官或军阀针对。
· 图书馆：控制它时，建设奖励对每个同色相邻城区改放2枚金币；图书馆自身建成时也适用。
· 公共酒馆：建成后，钱包不足3枚金币的双方各获得2枚供应金币。供应不足时建造者先领取。
· 魔法学校：在每张角色开始时，可以为本次角色能力把它视为一种颜色；整个角色期间沿用该选择。建设奖励仍按紫色计算。
· 雕像：若建在本人控制、印刷费用为4枚金币的城区旁，本次建设免费。
· 盗贼巢穴：建成后，可以把一个未受守卫保护的城区上的全部金币移入自己的钱包；该城区可以属于任意一方。
· 许愿井：建成后，可以支付1枚金币，再额外建设一个城区。额外建设不继承角色折扣。
结束与计分：
放置第16个城区并结算其建设奖励后，游戏立即结束，不再执行该城区的建成后能力。
· 每个受你控制的城区，获得与印刷费用相等的分数。
· 受你控制的城区上每枚金币获得1分。
· 每控制两个议会席位获得1分，余下一席不计分。
总分较高者获胜。若同分，钱包金币较多者获胜；若仍相同，议会席位较多者获胜。以上均相同则并列获胜。

en.name: Citadels Duel
en.desc: Draft secret characters, build a shared city, and contest districts and the council.
en.rules:
Goal:
Build a shared city while competing for district control. The game ends immediately when its 16th district is placed. The highest score wins.
Setup:
· Place two random starting districts orthogonally adjacent, one controlled by each player. Each player secretly keeps two of three random unique districts; the others leave this game.
· Shuffle the 16 basic districts into four stacks of four. Only each top tile is available. Randomly divide nine council seats five to four. The player with five seats starts with 2 gold; the other starts with 4 gold.
· There are 25 gold coins in total. Gains come from the supply and payments return to it. If the supply runs short, take only what remains. The Guard starts at the council and protects no districts.
Each round:
· Draft: shuffle nine characters, deal four to each player, and discard one face down. Simultaneously keep two and pass the other two. Then secretly discard one of your four characters, leaving three each.
· Resolve: call characters in order from 1 to 9. Whoever holds each character reveals it and resolves its abilities. Skip an absent character. Every ability step is optional. Resolve multiple steps in order; an either/or ability allows just one option.
· Expansion: the player with a council majority gains 3 gold and may build one district. Then the other player chooses to gain 2 gold or build one district. Begin another round afterward.
Building and protection:
Choose a top basic district or one of your reserved unique districts, pay its printed cost, and place it orthogonally adjacent to the city under your control. The city's width and height may each span at most four spaces. It may grow in any direction from the starting districts. Discounts never reduce a cost below zero.
· Place 1 supply gold on a new district for every orthogonally adjacent district of the same printed color, including your opponent's districts.
· The Guard protects its own district and all orthogonally adjacent districts, regardless of owner. Protected districts cannot be targeted by the Thief, Diplomat, or Warlord.
Characters:
· Assassin (1): name a character. If it is in your opponent's hand, they reveal and discard it without resolving it this round.
· Thief (2): name a character. If it is in your opponent's hand, take up to 3 gold in total from their wallet and/or any unprotected districts, regardless of owner.
· King (3): gain 1 council seat plus 1 per Noble district you control. Then you may move the Guard to a different district and place 1 supply gold on its new district.
· Abbot (4): if your wallet has less gold than your opponent's, take 1 gold from them. Then you may build one district with a discount of 1 gold per Religious district you control.
· Merchant (5): gain 3 gold. Then place 1 supply gold on each of up to two different Commercial districts you control.
· Architect (6): build up to two districts. Reduce one build's cost by 1 gold; you may save this discount for the second build.
· Diplomat (7): gain 2 council seats, or lose seats equal to the value of an unprotected opposing district to take control of it. Value is printed cost plus gold on the district. Its coins remain.
· Warlord (8): move the Guard, or take an unprotected opposing district by paying its value less 1 gold per Military district you control, to a minimum of zero.
· Queen (9): gain 1 council seat for each different district color you control, up to five. Seats flip from the opponent within the shared total of nine.
Unique districts:
· Armory: after building, you may move the Guard onto this district.
· Capitol: after building, you may gain 2 council seats.
· Imperial Treasury: after building, place 2 additional supply gold on this district.
· Ivory Tower: the Thief, Diplomat, and Warlord cannot target it.
· Library: while you control it, each matching adjacent district grants 2 build-bonus gold instead of 1. This applies when building the Library itself.
· Public House: after building, each player with fewer than 3 wallet gold gains 2 supply gold. If supply is short, the builder takes gold first.
· School of Magic: choose one color for its use throughout each character's abilities. It remains purple for build bonuses.
· Statue: building it is free when adjacent to a district you control with a printed cost of 4 gold.
· Thieves’ Den: after building, you may take all gold from one district unprotected by the Guard, regardless of owner.
· Wishing Well: after building, you may pay 1 gold to build one additional district. This extra build does not inherit character discounts.
End and scoring:
After placing the 16th district and resolving its build bonus, end immediately without resolving its after-built ability.
· Score each controlled district's printed cost.
· Score 1 point for every gold coin on your controlled districts.
· Score 1 point per two council seats you control, rounding down.
The highest score wins. Break ties by wallet gold, then by council seats. If all are tied, share victory.

zh.name: 噤声寻宝记
zh.desc: 深入龙穴构筑牌库，夺取神器并在巨龙追击前撤离。
zh.rules:
游戏目标：
深入地下城取得神器，返回入口撤离。游戏结束时，在有计分资格的玩家中，总分最高者获胜。
开局准备：
每人有 10 点生命和 10 张初始牌，洗牌后抽取 5 张。启用的扩展卡牌加入地下城牌库，专属组件按所选地图布置。
回合行动：
出牌、移动、获取卡牌、战斗和购买物品可以交错进行。打出手牌后，获得牌面所示的技能、战斗力、移动力及其他效果。
· 支付技能获取地下城公共牌或常备牌，新获得的卡牌放入弃牌堆。
· 支付战斗力击败怪物，立即获得奖励；怪物牌不加入个人牌库。
· 支付技能使用装置牌，立即结算效果；装置牌不加入个人牌库。
· 在市场房间中，每件市场物品的价格为 7 枚金币。
结束回合前必须打出全部手牌，并用完已获得的魔法泉销毁机会。回合结束时弃置打出区的牌，再抽取 5 张牌。未使用的技能、战斗力和移动力不会保留到下回合，金币保留。
需要抽牌但牌库为空时，将弃牌堆洗混，组成新的牌库。
移动与房间：
沿通道进入相邻房间，通常消耗 1 点移动力，脚印表示所需数量。通道每有一个怪物图标，需要支付 1 点战斗力，否则受到 1 点伤害。通过带锁的通道需要万能钥匙，通过升降梯需要支付 1 枚金币。
进入水晶洞穴后，本回合不能继续使用移动力，除非卡牌效果允许。传送不消耗移动力，可以越过通道限制，但目的地仍须是相邻房间。
进入房间时可以领取秘密或神像，神器需要在所在房间主动拾取。通常只能携带一件神器，每个背包将携带上限增加一件。携带神器返回入口即成功撤离，没有神器不能返回入口。
巨龙袭击：
每制造 1 点噪音，将个人供给区的 1 个方块放入噪音区。移除噪音时收回噪音区的方块；不足的部分抵消本回合之后的噪音。袭击开始时，将所有玩家噪音区的方块放入龙袋。
回合末补齐地下城公共牌列，并结算新牌的到来效果。本次补牌中只要出现巨龙袭击标记，补牌结束后触发一次袭击，不因同时出现多个标记重复触发。
按怒气等级抽取方块，公共牌列中每张危险牌使抽取数量增加一个。每抽到自己的一个方块，受到 1 点伤害；黑色方块不会造成伤害。抽出的方块离开龙袋。拾取神器或龙蛋会提高怒气。
撤离与计分：
生命降至零，或承受通道等伤害时供给方块不足，玩家倒下。首位撤离或倒下的玩家触发撤离倒计时。此后每轮轮到该玩家时触发袭击，前三次依次多抽 1、2、3 个方块；第四次轮到该玩家，所有仍在探索的玩家倒下。地下城牌库耗尽也会使所有仍在探索的玩家倒下。
全部玩家撤离或倒下后，游戏结束。没有神器，或在地下城深处倒下，均不能计分；携带神器在地表倒下，仍可计分。
· 神器、卡牌、市场物品和收藏按各自分值计分，每枚金币计 1 分。
· 成功撤离额外获得 20 分，每个诅咒扣除 2 分。
总分相同，最高分神器较高者获胜；仍相同则并列。
沉没宝藏：
在两个水域房间之间移动，通常至少消耗 2 点移动力。如果在水域开始回合，且整回合未进入有空气的房间，回合末受到 1 点伤害。潜水装备免除缺氧伤害及水域移动的额外费用。
木乃伊的诅咒：
与木乃伊处于同一区域时，可以选择以下一种方式与它战斗。
· 支付 2 点战斗力，获得 4 枚金币和 1 个诅咒。
· 支付 3 点战斗力，移除一半诅咒，移除数量向上取整。
每次战斗后投掷金字塔骰。木乃伊移入新区域时，该区域玩家获得 1 个诅咒。
黄金与蛛丝：
清除通道蛛网需要额外支付 1 点移动力或战斗力，并收集该蛛网。领取被蛛网覆盖的房间奖励，需要支付 1 点战斗力。蛛网按标示分值计分。
在矿脉相邻房间中，支付 2 点技能和 1 个个人供给区的方块采矿，获得所示金币。每条矿脉整局只能开采一次，采矿后本回合不能再使用移动力。
有计分资格的采矿者按矿脉数量排名，前三名额外获得 20、10、5 分。矿脉数量相同，开采过的最深矿脉较深者优先。
猿王神庙：
经过器具所在通道时收集器具，器具分为齿轮、猴子扳手和香蕉。在丛林地图中，每类器具分别按数量的平方计分，三类分数相加；例如，两个齿轮和一个香蕉共计 5 分。支付 3 点战斗力击败青铜守卫，可以取得其剩余器具中的一件。
在神庙地图中，在齿轮连接的房间消耗同符号器具，可以改变齿轮方向。器具不直接计分；怒气提高至特定等级时，也可能引发齿轮旋转。
双局战役：
先进行丛林对局，再进行神庙对局，第二局保留第一局收集的器具。第一局有计分资格的前三名，分别获得 20、10、5 分战役奖励。最终胜负按第二局得分及战役奖励决定，不累加第一局总分。
蛛后宝库奖励：
每次支付 8 点技能，并放置 1 个个人供给区的方块。每项奖励整局只能领取一次。
· 奖励 1：获得 5 枚金币。
· 奖励 2：获得 3 枚金币和 1 点战斗力。
· 奖励 3：获得 3 枚金币和 1 点移动力。
· 奖励 4：获得 3 枚金币，恢复 1 点生命。
· 奖励 5：获得 1 张“秘密典籍”，恢复 1 点生命。
· 奖励 6：获得 1 张“秘密典籍”和 1 枚金币。
· 奖励 7：获得 1 张“秘密典籍”和 1 枚金币。
· 奖励 8：获得 1 张“秘密典籍”和 2 枚金币。

en.name: Clank!
en.desc: Build your deck, steal an artifact, and escape the dragon.
en.rules:
Goal:
Take an artifact from the dungeon and escape through the entrance. At the end of the game, the eligible player with the highest score wins.
Setup:
Each player starts with 10 health and a shuffled deck of 10 cards. Draw 5 cards. Shuffle enabled expansion cards into the Dungeon Deck and use the components for the chosen map.
Turn actions:
Play cards, move, acquire cards, fight and buy items in any order. Playing a card gives you its skill, combat, movement and other effects.
· Spend skill to acquire Dungeon Row or reserve cards. Put acquired cards in your discard pile.
· Spend combat to defeat monsters and receive their rewards. Monster cards do not enter your deck.
· Spend skill to use a Device and resolve its effect immediately. Device cards do not enter your deck.
· In a market room, each Market item costs 7 gold.
Before ending your turn, play every hand card and use any available Magic Spring trash effects. Then discard your played cards and draw 5 cards. Unused skill, combat and movement expire; keep your gold.
When you need to draw from an empty deck, shuffle your discard pile to form a new deck.
Movement and rooms:
Follow a tunnel to an adjacent room, usually for 1 movement; footprints show the cost. For each monster symbol, spend 1 combat or take 1 damage. A locked tunnel requires a Master Key, and an elevator requires 1 gold.
After entering a Crystal Cave, you cannot spend movement again this turn unless an effect allows it. Teleporting costs no movement and ignores tunnel restrictions, but the destination must be adjacent.
On entry, you may collect a secret or monkey idol; take an artifact as a separate action in its room. You may carry one artifact, plus one per Backpack. Return to the entrance with an artifact to escape. You cannot return without one.
Dragon attacks:
For each Clank! you make, move 1 cube from your personal supply to the Clank! area. Removing Clank! returns your cubes; any excess cancels later Clank! this turn. At the start of an attack, move every player’s Clank! cubes into the Dragon Bag.
At turn end, refill the Dungeon Row and resolve the new cards’ Arrive effects. If any refill card has a dragon attack symbol, trigger one attack after refilling. Multiple symbols in the same refill do not cause multiple attacks.
Rage determines how many cubes are drawn, plus one for each Danger card in the row. Each of your cubes drawn deals 1 damage to you; black cubes deal none. Drawn cubes leave the bag. Taking an artifact or Dragon Egg increases rage.
Escape and scoring:
You are knocked out at zero health, or if you lack supply cubes to take damage outside the bag. The first player to escape or be knocked out starts the countdown. Each time their turn returns, attack with 1, then 2, then 3 extra cubes. On their fourth return, all remaining explorers are knocked out. An empty Dungeon Deck also knocks out all remaining explorers.
The game ends when everyone has escaped or been knocked out. A player without an artifact, or knocked out in the Depths, cannot score. A player knocked out above the Depths can still score with an artifact.
· Score artifacts, cards, Market items and collectibles at their values. Each gold is worth 1 point.
· Escaping awards 20 extra points. Each Curse token loses 2 points.
Break score ties using each player’s highest-value artifact. Remaining ties share victory.
Sunken Treasures:
Moving between two water rooms normally costs at least 2 movement. If you start in water and never enter a room with air, take 1 damage at turn end. Diving Gear prevents air damage and removes the extra underwater movement cost.
The Mummy’s Curse:
While in the Mummy’s zone, choose one of these ways to fight it.
· Spend 2 combat to gain 4 gold and 1 Curse token.
· Spend 3 combat to remove half your Curse tokens, rounded up.
Roll the pyramid die after each fight. When the Mummy enters a new zone, players there gain 1 Curse token.
Gold and Silk:
To clear a tunnel web, spend 1 extra movement or combat and collect the web. Collecting rewards in a webbed room costs 1 combat. Collected webs score their printed values.
In a room beside a mine, spend 2 skill and 1 cube from your personal supply to claim its gold. Each mine can be claimed once per game. After mining, you cannot spend movement again this turn.
Eligible miners rank by mines claimed. The top three gain 20, 10 and 5 extra points. Break ties using each player’s deepest claimed mine.
Temple of the Ape Lords:
Collect ape-aratus when passing through its tunnel. Types are Cog, Monkey Wrench and Banana. In the Jungle, square the count of each type and add the three scores: two Cogs and one Banana score 5 points. Spend 3 combat to defeat the Bronze Guardian and take one remaining ape-aratus.
In the Temple, spend a matching ape-aratus in a room connected to a gear to change its orientation. Ape-aratus does not score directly. Rage increases at certain levels can also rotate gears.
Two-game campaign:
Play the Jungle game, then the Temple game, carrying your collected ape-aratus into the second game. The top three eligible players in the first game receive campaign bonuses of 20, 10 and 5 points. The final result uses the second-game score plus this bonus, without adding the first-game total.
Spider Queen’s Cache:
Spend 8 skill and place 1 cube from your personal supply per claim. Each reward can be claimed once per game.
· Reward 1: Gain 5 gold.
· Reward 2: Gain 3 gold and 1 combat.
· Reward 3: Gain 3 gold and 1 movement.
· Reward 4: Gain 3 gold and recover 1 health.
· Reward 5: Gain 1 Secret Tome and recover 1 health.
· Reward 6: Gain 1 Secret Tome and 1 gold.
· Reward 7: Gain 1 Secret Tome and 1 gold.
· Reward 8: Gain 1 Secret Tome and 2 gold.

zh.name: 噤声寻宝记：地下墓穴
zh.desc: 探索不断拼接的地下城，构筑牌库，夺取神器并逃出龙穴。
zh.rules:
在不断扩展的地下墓穴中构筑牌库、寻找神器，再返回墓穴出口。所有玩家逃出或昏迷后，得分最高者获胜；平分时比较最贵神器的价值。

你的回合:
自由安排打牌、移动、购牌、使用装置、战斗、开锁和购买市场物品。蓝色技能用于购牌与装置，剑用于战斗，靴用于移动。获得的牌通常进入弃牌堆，怪物和装置的文字立即执行。回合结束前须打完手牌，未花费的资源不会保留。清理打出区，抽五张牌，再补齐六张地下城牌。

地图与探索:
每次移动到下一间房通常花一靴。通道上的额外脚印、锁、怪物和冥币另行支付；可用剑抵消怪物伤害。自愿承受的伤害不能使你昏迷，且必须有个人方块标记。锁一旦打开，所有人都可通过。进入水晶洞穴或跌入陷坑后，本回合不能继续花靴，传送仍然可用。
沿地图边缘的通道探索时，先揭示新板块，再选择朝向并完成原移动。可以中断移动打牌或获得资源。传送忽略通道图标和单向箭头，仍然触发房间效果。传送门连接其他传送门，完整的一次移动仍须支付两端通道的图标。

宝藏与房间:
每回合首次进入一间房可获得该房间奖励；下回合须重新进入才可再获奖励。开锁器还可打开宝箱、图书室或监牢，分别获得大秘密、秘密典籍或释放囚犯。每处神龛每人只能标记一次，放置个人方块并获得等同已标神龛数的金币。一个背包增加一件神器容量。拿取神器会增加巨龙怒气。

龙袭与逃生:
补入的新牌带龙袭图标时，巨龙袭击一次。把全部噪音方块放入龙袋，再按怒气及危险图标抽取方块。黑色方块移至银行，玩家色方块造成对应玩家伤害；每个白色幽灵方块使仍在探险的所有玩家受伤，随后回到噪音区。
携带神器返回墓穴出口后，可完成本回合，再退出并获得 20 分逃脱奖励。昏迷时没有神器，或身处深处或冥界，通常得零分；安全区中携带神器昏迷仍可计分。计分包括神器、金币、卡牌、秘密、囚犯、市场物品和其他奖励。已离场玩家的席次改为固定四方块龙袭，两人局为六方块，没有倒计时。牌库不足以补齐牌列或袭击结束时龙袋为空，所有在场玩家立刻昏迷并结算。

可选扩展:
巢穴与失落密室加入陷坑、魔法屏障、特殊神龛和房间怪物。战利品放在个人供应区，提供持续能力或分数。冥界为独立地图，通过梯子或单向滑道进入；回合从冥界开始时支付一枚冥币，无法支付则制造两点噪音。冥界有专用市场、命运牌、鹰身女妖、神器增强器和小恶魔助手。
冒险派对加入可选反应：对手满足条件时，可把对应手牌置于反应区并补抽一张，直到自己的下一回合才执行该牌。六角色各有不同的起始牌和能力。五至六人局使用额外神器、补给和隐形斗篷；同一玩家不得从同一房间拿取第二件神器。三个扩展可以独立开关。

en.name: Clank! Catacombs
en.desc: Explore a changing dungeon, build your deck, steal an artifact, and escape the dragon.
en.rules:
Build your deck, explore the changing Catacombs, recover an artifact, and return to the Crypt. When everyone has escaped or been knocked out, the highest eligible score wins. Break ties with the most valuable artifact.

Your turn:
Play cards, move, buy cards, use devices, fight, pick locks, and visit the Market in any order. Skill buys cards and devices; Swords defeat monsters; Boots move you. Acquired cards normally enter your discard pile. Devices and defeated monsters resolve immediately. Play every card in hand before ending your turn. Unspent resources expire. Discard your played cards, draw five, and refill the six-card Dungeon Row.

Movement and discovery:
Moving to the next room normally costs one Boot. Pay for extra footprints, locks, monsters, and Undercoin tolls along the whole tunnel. Swords prevent tunnel monster damage. You cannot voluntarily take damage that would knock you out or that you cannot mark with cubes from your supply. Opened locks stay open for everyone. Entering a Crystal Cave or falling into a Pit Trap stops further Boot movement for the turn, but not teleportation.
To explore, reveal the next tile, choose its orientation, and complete your original move. You may pause to play cards or gain resources. Teleportation ignores tunnel icons and arrows but still triggers rooms. Portals connect to other portals; a full move still pays icons at both ends.

Treasure and rooms:
Collect each room’s entry reward only on your first entry each turn. You must re-enter on a later turn to collect again. A Lockpick opens a chest for a major secret, a library for a Secret Tome, or a prison to free prisoners. Mark each Wayshrine at most once per player, placing a supply cube and taking Gold equal to your marked Wayshrines. A Backpack adds one artifact slot. Taking an artifact increases rage.

Dragon attacks and escape:
A dragon icon on a newly refilled card triggers one attack. Move all Clank! cubes into the bag and draw according to rage plus Danger. Black cubes go to the Bank. Colored cubes damage their player. Each white Ghost damages every active player, then returns to the Clank! area.
Return to the Crypt with an artifact, finish your turn, then escape with a 20-point Mastery token. Knocked-out players normally score zero without an artifact or in the Depths or Underworld. An artifact carrier knocked out in safety still scores. Add artifacts, Gold, cards, secrets, prisoners, market items, and other rewards. An eliminated seat causes a fixed four-cube attack on each of its turns, or six cubes in a two-player game. There is no countdown. If the row cannot be refilled, or the bag is empty after an attack, all remaining players are knocked out immediately and the game ends.

Optional expansions:
Lairs & Lost Chambers adds Pit Traps, Magic Barriers, special chambers, and room monsters. Trophies remain in your supply and provide abilities or points. The Underworld is a separate map reached by ladders or one-way chutes. Starting a turn there costs one Undercoin; if you cannot pay, make two Clank! instead. It has its own Market, Fate cards, harpies, artifact enhancers, and Imp Assistants.
Adventuring Party adds optional reactions: when an opponent meets a condition, place the matching card in your reaction area and draw a replacement. Resolve it on your next turn. Six unique characters have distinct starting decks and abilities. Five- and six-player games add artifacts, reserve cards, and Invisibility Cloaks; a player cannot take two artifacts from the same room. Each expansion can be enabled separately.

zh.name: 绝顶聪明
zh.desc: 六骰三选填表,连锁奖励滚雪球
zh.rules:
目标:用六颗骰子在计分表五个色区填格,终局总分最高者获胜。
准备:每人一张计分表;4 人打 4 轮、3 人 5 轮、2 人 6 轮。
流程:
· 主动玩家掷全部 6 颗骰子,从中选一颗填入色区,点数比它低的骰子进入托盘;再掷再选,至多选三颗,之后其余骰子也进托盘。
· 其他玩家从托盘各选择1颗骰子，并在计分表中记录其点数;托盘里没有能用的,才可从主动玩家留下的骰位挑一颗。
· 白色骰子为百搭骰，可以选择任意色区;选择蓝区时，填写蓝色骰子与白色骰子的点数之和。使用蓝色骰子时，必须将其与白色骰子的点数相加，并在蓝色区域记录结果。
色区:
· 黄区：在印有对应点数的格子中打叉。完成一列时，获得该列星标所示的分数，四列分别为10、14、16、20分。
· 蓝区：在印有蓝色骰子与白色骰子点数之和的格子中打叉。根据已打叉的格子总数查表计分，最多获得56分。
· 绿区：填入的点数不得低于该格的最低要求。分数随填写的格子数量递增，最多获得66分。
· 橙区：直接填写骰子点数。印有倍数标记的格子，按所示的2倍或3倍计分。
· 紫区：从左至右依次填写，每个数字必须大于前一个数字；前一个数字为6时，下一个数字不受大小限制。
奖励：打叉或填写格子会触发计分表上的奖励，包括在任意色区打叉、在紫区或橙区填写6、获得狐狸、获得重掷机会，以及获得额外骰行动。奖励可以连锁触发。
行动：重掷和额外骰各有7个行动格，通过轮次奖励及色区奖励解锁。
· 重掷：主动玩家重新投掷全部待选骰子。
· 额外骰：额外使用一颗骰子；每颗骰子在同一回合的额外骰行动中只能使用一次。
轮次奖励：第一轮和第三轮开始时，各解锁一次重掷；第二轮开始时，解锁一次额外骰行动。第四轮开始时，所有玩家各选择在任意色区打一次叉，或在紫区或橙区填写一个6。
结算:五区各自计分;每只狐狸获得的分数等于自己得分最低区域的分数。最后一轮结束后，每名玩家仍可使用剩余的额外骰行动。
总分最高的玩家获胜。总分相同时，单个区域最高得分较高的玩家获胜；若仍然相同，则共享胜利。
单人：共进行6轮。每轮先进行主动玩家回合，再进行被动玩家回合。被动玩家回合开始时，重新投掷全部6颗骰子，将点数最低的3颗骰子放入托盘；并列时，由你选择放入的骰子。
从托盘中选择1颗骰子，并在计分表中记录其点数；此时不能使用重掷行动。终局根据评级表评价本局得分。

en.name: That's Pretty Clever!
en.desc: Pick dice, mark your sheet, chain the bonuses
en.rules:
Goal: fill the five colored areas of your scoresheet with six dice; highest total at the end wins.
Setup: one sheet per player; 4 rounds with 4 players, 5 with 3, 6 with 2.
Play:
· The active player rolls all 6 dice, picks one and marks its area; every lower-valued die goes to the silver platter. Roll and pick again, up to three picks, then the rest go to the platter too.
· Each other player then takes one die from the platter; only if none there is usable may they take one of the dice the active player left behind.
· The white die is a joker: pick any area; for blue it scores as blue + white. The blue die only scores in blue, also as blue + white.
Areas:
· Yellow: cross off the printed number; complete a column for its star points (10/14/16/20).
· Blue: cross off the blue+white sum; score by total crosses (up to 56).
· Green: each entry must meet the cell minimum; points grow per cell (up to 66).
· Orange: write the value as-is; cells with a multiplier mark score double or triple.
· Purple: each entry must top the previous one; after a 6, anything goes.
Bonuses: marking cells triggers printed bonuses — a free cross, a 6 in purple/orange, foxes, rerolls and extra dice — and bonuses can chain.
Actions: rerolls (active player rerolls all remaining dice) and extra dice (use one more die, each die at most once per turn) have 7 slots each, unlocked by rounds and bonuses.
Round bonuses: at the start of rounds 1 and 3, unlock one reroll. At the start of round 2, unlock one extra-die action. At the start of round 4, each player chooses either a free cross in any area or a 6 in purple or orange.
Scoring: each area scores separately; each fox scores your lowest area. After the last round everyone may spend leftover extra dice.
Highest total wins; ties break on the best single area, then shared victory.
Solo: 6 rounds; each round you play the active player first, then the passive player — reroll all 6 dice, the 3 lowest go to the platter (you break ties), take one of them, no rerolls.
Your final score is rated on a scale.

zh.name: 立方聪明
zh.desc: 双骰定蓝区,连击叉满绿松石
zh.rules:
目标:在五个色区中尽量多地得分;终局每只狐狸奖励等于你最低分区的分数,总分最高者获胜。
流程:
· 2 人玩 6 轮,3 人 5 轮,4 人 4 轮;每轮每人当一次主动玩家。
· 单人游戏进行6轮。每轮先作为主动玩家行动，再作为被动玩家行动：重新投掷全部6颗骰子，将点数最低的3颗放至银盘，再从中选择1颗，在对应色区记录其点数。
· 每轮开始所有人领取轮次奖励:重掷(第 1 轮)、额外骰(第 2 轮)、数字百搭(第 3 轮)。
· 第四轮获得黑色问号奖励：选择任意色区及1至6中的一个点数，立即按该区规则记录。
· 主动玩家投掷全部6颗骰子，选择1颗放至骰位，并在对应色区记录。将点数小于所选骰子的全部骰子放至银盘。
· 可以重新投掷剩余骰子；每回合至多投掷3次，并放置3颗骰子。没有想要选择的骰子时，可以放弃本次投掷。
· 随后，其他玩家同时从银盘中各选择1颗骰子，在对应色区记录；所选骰子留在原处。只有银盘上的全部骰子均无法使用时，才可以选择主动玩家骰位上的骰子。
· 回合结束时，每名玩家可以使用额外骰行动：选择任意一颗骰子，包括本回合已使用的骰子，再记录一次。每颗骰子在同一回合的额外骰行动中只能使用一次。
色区:
· 黄区:按照本次为第几次投掷，在对应行中与骰子点数相同的格子打叉；被动玩家只能在灰色格子中打叉。同列上下两个格子均已打叉时,触发两格之间印出的奖励。
· 绿松石区：在与骰子点数相同的格子中打叉。自己的骰位上每有一颗同点数骰子，可以多打叉1格；被动玩家改为计算银盘上的同点数骰子。某行或某列的全部深色格均已打叉时，触发对应奖励。
· 蓝区:填蓝骰与白骰点数之和,从中央 7 向两侧逐格延伸,相邻两格必须差 1;填 7 可重置数列(两个 7 不相邻)。
· 棕区：在与骰子点数相同的格子中打叉，只能从左向右推进；可以跳过格子，但不能返回先前跳过的格子。相邻两格均已打叉时，触发两格之间印出的奖励。
· 粉区:从左向右依次填,每格二选一——填写骰子点数的一半并向上取整，获得格子下方的奖励；或者填写骰子点数乘以星标倍数的结果，并放弃该奖励。
· 白骰是颜色百搭,可当任意色使用;蓝区填数恒为蓝骰加白骰之和。
行动:
· 重掷：仅主动玩家可以使用，重新投掷全部刚刚投掷的骰子。
· 数字百搭：将所选骰子视为另一点数，并在对应色区记录；印有数字的格子必须使用该格要求的点数。
· 额外骰：在回合结束时使用。
· 行动格从左至右依次解锁，解锁时圈出，使用时划掉。任一行动轨的全部行动格均已圈出时，获得该轨末端的奖励。
· 问号奖励必须立即使用：选择1至6中的一个点数，按对应色区的规则记录，并可连锁触发新奖励。黑色问号允许选择任意色区。
结算:
· 黄区与绿松石区根据各行已打叉的格子数量查表计分。
· 蓝区按最左侧与最右侧已填格印出的分值计分,每个不大于 4 或不小于 10 的已填数再加 4 分。
· 棕区根据已打叉的格子总数查表计分。
· 粉区将所有已填数字相加计分。
· 每只狐狸获得的分数等于自己得分最低区域的分数；有区域为0分时，每只狐狸获得0分。
· 总分最高的玩家获胜。总分相同时，单个区域最高得分较高的玩家获胜；若仍然相同，则共享胜利。

en.name: Clever Cubed
en.desc: Two dice feed the blue row, combos cross the turquoise
en.rules:
Goal: Score across five colored areas; at the end each fox scores your lowest area, highest total wins.
Play:
· 6 rounds with 2 players, 5 with 3, 4 with 4; each player is the active player once per round.
· Solo plays 6 rounds: each round you act as the active player, then as the passive player — reroll all 6 dice, the 3 lowest go to the silver platter, and you record one of them.
· At the start of each round everyone collects its bonus: reroll (round 1), extra die (round 2), number joker (round 3).
· Round 4 grants a black ?: pick any area and record a value of 1-6 immediately.
· The active player rolls all 6 dice, places one on a dice slot and records it in its area; all lower dice go to the silver platter.
· The rest may be rerolled, at most 3 rolls and 3 placed dice; you may forfeit a roll instead.
· Then every other player simultaneously records one die from the silver platter (dice stay put); only if no platter die is usable may they use a die from the active player's slots.
· At the end of the turn, anyone may spend extra-die actions: pick any die (even used ones) and record it once more; each die once per turn.
Areas:
· Yellow: cross the matching number in the row of your current roll; passive players may only cross the grey cells. Crossing both cells of a column triggers the bonus printed between them.
· Turquoise: cross cells of the die's number; each matching die on your slots (platter, when passive) adds one more cross. Filling every dark cell of a row or column triggers its bonus.
· Blue: enter the sum of the blue and white dice, extending from the central 7 to either side; neighbors must differ by exactly 1. A 7 resets the sequence (two 7s never touch).
· Brown: cross the matching number, left to right only; you may skip cells but never go back. Crossing both cells around a gap triggers the bonus printed between them.
· Pink: fill cells from left to right. For each cell, either write half the die value, rounded up, and take the bonus below it, or write the die value multiplied by the starred multiplier and forgo that bonus.
· The white die is wild for any color; blue entries always sum the blue and white dice.
Actions:
· Reroll: only the active player may use this action. Reroll all dice just rolled.
· Number joker: record the chosen die as another value; a cell with a printed number requires that value.
· Extra die: use this action at turn end.
· Action boxes unlock left to right (circle) and are spent by crossing; filling a full track grants its end bonus.
· ? bonuses must be used immediately: pick a value 1-6 and record it under that area's rules, possibly chaining into more bonuses; the black ? works in any area.
Scoring:
· Yellow and turquoise score per row by crosses.
· Blue scores the values printed at the leftmost and rightmost filled cells, plus 4 per filled entry of 4 or less / 10 or more.
· Brown scores by total crosses.
· Pink scores the sum of its entries.
· Each fox scores the same number of points as your lowest-scoring area. If any area scores 0, each fox scores 0.
· Ties go to the highest single area, then shared victory.

zh.name: 行动代号
zh.desc: 红蓝对抗:队长一句话,队员猜词板
zh.rules:
目标:按身份翻开词语,先找齐己方全部词的一队获胜。
准备:
· 全员分红蓝两队,每队至少 2 人,并各选一名队长。
· 词板共 25 个词:先手队 9 个、后手队 8 个、中立 7 个、刺客 1 个;归属只有两名队长能看到。
流程:
· 两队轮流行动。轮到的一方由队长给出线索:一个词加一个数字,数字表示该线索指向几个己方的词。
· 线索不能是词板上尚未翻开的词,也不能把它包含在内。
· 队员在词板上点词:点一下提出候选,再点一下确认翻开;每回合最多翻「线索数字加 1」个,可随时主动结束回合。
翻牌结果:
· 己方词:可以继续猜。
· 对方词:等于替对方翻开,回合结束。
· 中立词:回合结束。
· 刺客:本队立即落败。

en.name: Codenames
en.desc: Red vs blue: one-word clues, team guesses
en.rules:
Goal: reveal words by identity; the first team to find all of its words wins.
Setup:
· Split into red and blue teams of at least 2 players each, with one captain per team.
· The board holds 25 words: 9 for the starting team, 8 for the other team, 7 neutral, 1 assassin. Only the two captains can see the assignments.
Play:
· Teams alternate. On your team’s turn the captain gives a clue: one word plus a number — the number is how many of your team’s words the clue points to.
· The clue may not be a word still hidden on the board, nor contain one.
· Teammates guess on the board: tap a word to propose it, tap again to confirm the reveal. At most the clue number plus one words may be revealed per turn, and the turn may be ended at any time.
Reveal results:
· Your team’s word: keep guessing.
· A rival word: revealed for their benefit; the turn ends.
· A neutral word: the turn ends.
· The assassin: your team loses immediately.

zh.name: 行动代号二重奏
zh.desc: 两位特工交换线索，在时间耗尽前联络全部 15 名同伴，并避开藏在双方地图中的刺客。
zh.rules:
游戏目标：
这是两人合作游戏。双方轮流提供线索，合作联络 15 名特工；只要有人误认刺客，双方立即失败。本作使用与《行动代号》相同的中文词库。

准备与秘密地图：
桌面随机摆出 25 张词牌，组成每行五张、每列五张的方阵。双方各有一面秘密地图，每面标有 9 名特工、3 名刺客和 13 名路人。你的地图表示同伴猜词时的结果；你自己猜词时，要以同伴的地图为准。界面中两面地图都与词牌使用相同的方向，无须旋转。
· 两面地图有 3 名共同特工，因此只需要联络 15 名不同的特工。已经联络的特工会盖住词牌，双方都不能再猜。
· 每面地图上的 3 张刺客词牌中，恰有 1 张在另一面是特工、1 张在另一面是路人、1 张在双方地图上都是刺客。这个固定关系可以帮助双方推理，但不要把自己地图上的颜色直接当作自己猜词时的结果。
· 标准任务使用 9 枚时间标记。开局也可选择使用 10 枚或 11 枚进行练习。

提供线索：
首回合由先想到线索的人出题，此后通常轮流出题。线索必须包含一个词语和一个 0 至 9 的数字，数字表示这个线索与几张词牌有关。请根据词义建立联系，不得利用词牌的位置、字数、字形、口音或手势传递信息。
· 线索不得使用尚未盖住的词牌本身、其中一部分或其词形变化。系统会拦截明显的文字重合；其他是否合法，由双方按照上述原则共同判断。
· 数字 0 表示不要猜与该线索有关的词牌。同伴仍须根据以前的线索或排除后的判断至少猜一次。
· 出题后不能补充说明、暗示答案、建议何时停止，或告知还剩几张特工词牌。只有自己地图上的 9 名特工全部被联络后，才可以宣布已经全部完成。
· 若双方发现当前线索违规，可在记录面板中确认一次违规罚时，额外弃掉 1 枚时间标记，然后继续当前回合。每条线索最多罚时一次；没有剩余标记时不能再罚时。

猜测词牌：
收到线索后，点击一张词牌选中，再次点击同一张牌确认猜测。你可以先换选其他词牌；出题者不能替同伴确认。
· 猜中特工时，该词牌由绿色特工标记覆盖，双方共享这个成果。你可以继续猜测，次数不限，也可以尝试找出以前线索中遗漏的词牌；不使用经典版的“数字加一次”限制。
· 猜中路人时，在词牌上放置朝向猜词者的时间标记，并立即结束回合。这个人以后不能再猜同一张牌，但同伴仍可猜，因为同伴猜测时使用另一面地图。
· 猜中刺客时，双方立即失败，即使这张牌在你自己的地图上是特工也一样。
· 每回合至少猜一次。猜中过至少一名特工后，你可以点击“结束猜测”，取走 1 枚时间标记并结束回合。
正常回合无论主动停止还是猜中路人，都只消耗 1 枚时间标记；违规罚时另外计算。回合结束后，猜词者成为下一位出题者。若一方已经没有可供同伴猜的特工词牌，余下回合都由另一方出题。

永久放弃出题：
轮到你出题时，可以确认“此后不再出题”。此操作不消耗时间标记，但本局不能撤销；本回合及余下回合都改由同伴出题。如果同伴也已经放弃出题，或已经没有特工词牌可以出题，立即进入突然死亡，即使仍有时间标记也一样。

胜利与突然死亡：
联络全部 15 名特工时，双方立即获胜。若最后一枚时间标记用完时尚未获胜，则进入突然死亡：不能再提供新线索，只能根据此前线索猜测。双方可以任意顺序逐张猜词，不必轮流；只能商量由谁先猜，不能讨论策略或泄露剩余词牌数量。只要猜中路人或刺客，双方立即失败；猜完全部特工则获胜。

任务评分：
标准 9 枚标记任务获胜后，每枚用于主动结束回合的标记得 1 分，每枚未使用的标记得 3 分，用作路人或违规罚时的标记不得分。若进入过突然死亡，再扣 1 分。使用 10 枚或 11 枚标记的练习任务只记录胜负与任务过程，不套用标准任务评分。
本作按 CGE 2025 年实体基础版制作。任务地图属于其配套 App 内容，不包含在本版中。规则机器人仅用于测试流程，不能理解词义联想。

en.name: Codenames: Duet
en.desc: Exchange clues with a fellow operative, contact all 15 agents before time runs out, and avoid the assassins on both secret keys.
en.rules:
Objective:
This is a cooperative game for two players. Take turns giving clues and contact all 15 agents together. If either player guesses an assassin, you both lose immediately. This implementation uses the same Chinese word bank as Codenames.

Setup and secret keys:
Twenty-five random word cards form a 5×5 grid. Each player sees one secret key with 9 agents, 3 assassins, and 13 bystanders. Your key shows the result when your partner guesses; when you guess, your partner's key determines the result. Both digital keys align with the word grid in the same orientation and need no rotation.
· Three agents are green on both keys, so there are 15 distinct agents to contact. A contacted agent covers the card and cannot be guessed by either player again.
· Of the 3 assassin cards on each key, exactly 1 is an agent on the other key, 1 is a bystander on the other key, and 1 is an assassin on both keys. This fixed relationship can help deduction, but the color on your own key does not determine the result of your own guess.
· A standard mission uses 9 timer tokens. You may select 10 or 11 tokens for practice.

Giving clues:
Either player may give the first clue. After that, players normally alternate. Give one word and a number from 0 to 9 indicating how many cards relate to your clue. Clues must concern meaning, not position, letter count, spelling, accents, or gestures.
· Do not use an uncovered word, any part of it, or a form of it as a clue. The game rejects obvious text overlap; players judge the remaining cases according to these principles.
· A zero clue warns your partner not to guess related cards. Your partner must still make at least one guess, using earlier clues or deduction.
· Do not explain a clue, hint at answers, advise when to stop, or disclose how many agents remain. Announce completion only when all 9 agents on your key have been contacted.
· If both players identify an invalid current clue, confirm an invalid-clue penalty in the record panel: discard 1 extra timer token, then continue the turn. Each clue may receive one penalty. No penalty can be taken without a remaining token.

Guessing:
Select a word card, then tap it again to confirm. You may change your selection first. The clue-giver cannot confirm a guess for their partner.
· An agent is covered in green and counts for both players. You may keep guessing with no limit, including words missed from earlier clues. Duet does not use the classic number-plus-one limit.
· A bystander receives a timer token facing the guesser and ends the turn immediately. That player cannot guess it again, but their partner may because the other key applies.
· An assassin makes both players lose immediately, even if that word is an agent on the guesser's own key.
· You must guess at least once per turn. After contacting at least one agent, you may choose End guessing and take 1 timer token to end the turn.
Each normal turn uses exactly 1 timer token, whether ended voluntarily or by a bystander. An invalid-clue penalty is additional. The guesser becomes the next clue-giver. If all agents on one player's key have been contacted, the other player gives all remaining clues.

Passing permanently:
On your clue-giving turn, you may confirm Give no more clues. This costs no timer token and cannot be reversed during the mission. Your partner gives this clue and every remaining clue. If your partner has also passed or has no remaining agents to give clues for, sudden death begins immediately, even with tokens left.

Winning and sudden death:
Contact all 15 agents to win immediately. If the last timer token is used before you win, enter sudden death. No new clues are allowed; use previous clues only. Players may guess one card at a time in any order without alternating. Discuss only who will guess, not strategy or the number of remaining cards. A bystander or assassin makes you both lose immediately; finding all remaining agents wins.

Mission score:
After winning a standard 9-token mission, score 1 point per token taken to end a turn, 3 points per unused token, and 0 points for bystanders or invalid-clue penalties. Subtract 1 point if you entered sudden death. Practice missions with 10 or 11 tokens record the outcome and mission details without the standard score.
This implementation follows the CGE 2025 physical base edition. Its mission map belongs to the companion app and is outside this version. The rule bot is a flow-testing placeholder and does not understand word associations.
