zh.name: 诡影寻踪
zh.desc: 每人一条秘密线索,推理神秘生物的唯一栖息地
zh.rules:
目标:率先综合所有人的线索,找到神秘生物唯一的栖息地。
准备:版图由 6 块板块随机拼成;每位玩家秘密获得一条关于栖息地的线索(仅自己可见),所有人线索的交集只有 1 格。
初始放置:
· 从起始玩家开始顺时针,每人轮流把自己的 2 个方块放到「按自己线索不可能是栖息地」的格子,每次 1 个,共 2 轮。
流程(每回合二选一):
· 询问：任选1个没有方块的格子，指定1名其他玩家。对方根据自己的线索回答：该格可能是栖息地时，放置对方的圆片；不可能时，放置对方的方块。对方放置方块时，你还必须将自己的1个方块放到根据自己线索不可能是栖息地的格子。


· 搜索:选 1 个按你线索可能是栖息地且没有方块的格子,先放上自己的圆片。 其余玩家从你左手边开始依次根据自己的线索作答:全部放圆片则你直接获胜;一旦有人放方块,搜索中止,你同样须再放 1 个自己的方块。

约束:
· 有方块的格子不能再放任何标记,也不能再问人或搜索。
· 同一格子不能放自己的第二个标记;圆片可以多人叠放。
· 任何时刻都可给格子做私人笔记(✓/✗/?),仅自己可见。
结束:有人搜索成功即获胜,终局揭示所有人的线索与栖息地。
线索一览(距离均含所在格本身):
· 在两种地形之一上(如「在森林或沼泽上」)。
· 距某种地形 1 格以内;距熊或狮的领地 1 格以内。
· 距立石或棚屋 2 格以内;距熊或狮的领地 2 格以内。
· 距某种颜色的结构物 3 格以内。
· 进阶模式另含以上全部线索的否定式。

en.name: Cryptid
en.desc: One secret clue each — deduce the creature’s only habitat
en.rules:
Goal: be the first to locate the creature’s only possible habitat by combining everyone’s clues.
Setup: the board is assembled from 6 random map tiles; each player secretly receives one clue about the habitat (visible only to you). The intersection of all clues is exactly one space.
Opening:
· Starting with the first player and going clockwise, each player takes turns placing their 2 cubes on spaces that CANNOT be the habitat according to their own clue, one at a time, for 2 rounds.
Play (each turn, choose one):
· Question: pick any space without a cube and name another player. They answer according to their clue: place their disc if the habitat could be there, or their cube if it could not. If they place a cube, you must also place one of your cubes on a space ruled out by your own clue.


· Search: pick a space that could be the habitat by your clue and has no cube; place your disc there first. Every other player answers clockwise from your left: if everyone places a disc, you win; as soon as anyone places a cube the search stops, and you must place one of your cubes too.

Constraints:
· A space with a cube cannot take any more pieces and cannot be questioned or searched.
· You can never have two of your own pieces on one space; discs of different players may stack.
· At any time you may mark spaces with private notes (✓/✗/?), visible only to you.
End: a successful search wins the game; all clues and the habitat are then revealed.
Clue list (distances include the element’s own space):
· On one of two terrain types (e.g. “on forest or swamp”).
· Within 1 space of a terrain type; within 1 space of bear or cougar territory.
· Within 2 spaces of a standing stone or a shack; within 2 spaces of bear or cougar territory.
· Within 3 spaces of a structure of one colour.
· Advanced mode adds the negation of every clue above.

zh.name: 方块欧陆
zh.desc: 用两颗骰子拓展十九格领地，连锁方块效果并建立永久能力。
zh.rules:
目标：
用方块填满同色相邻领地，争取最高分。基础版为单人游戏，取得30分获胜。启用官方Rivals扩展后支持1–4人；多人比较总分，同分者中空格最多的玩家获胜，仍相同则共享胜利。
准备：
基础版使用A–I共9张双面牌。洗牌后先移一张至副牌堆，再取一张作为个人领地，其余形成主牌堆。每人有两颗骰子、黄色方块3个，以及红、白、蓝、绿方块各4个。选择一个黄色格放置起始方块，不触发效果。持有区最多容纳3个方块，工人上限为6。
启用Rivals时使用全部17张牌。多人先留出4张领地牌，余下牌堆顶牌移至副牌堆；每人从留出的牌中获得一张，未用领地牌移出。单人扩展变体先移除4张，再按单人方式设置。先手获得1名工人，其后依次获得2、3、4名。
流程：
每回合掷两颗骰子，各使用一次，以任意组合执行以下行动。
· 获得方块：把一颗骰子放到市场中点数相同的位置，从个人供应获得该处颜色的方块，放入持有区。市场只使用两堆交界处的六个骰位。2人局每位限一颗骰；单人及3–4人局每位可叠两颗。供应耗尽仍可占位，但不获得方块。持有区已满时，先选一个方块退回供应。
· 放置方块：从持有区把一个方块放到颜色相同、点数与骰子相同的空格，且该格须与已占格相邻。
· 获得工人：使用任意点数的骰子获得1名工人，超过6名的部分失去。
每支付1名工人，可将一颗尚未使用的骰子增加或减少1点；1和6可循环调整，允许多次支付。
颜色效果：
· 放置红色方块后，可立即从持有区再放置一个方块；忽略骰子限制，仍须满足颜色与相邻要求。
· 放置白色方块后，可从当前市场任意颜色获得一个方块，忽略骰子和占位限制。
· 放置蓝色方块后，可获得1名工人。
红白效果可继续触发连锁。所有颜色及永久效果均可跳过。
本轮每放置一个新的黄色方块，轮末可从副牌堆顶取得一张永久效果牌；按先手顺序逐张取得，副牌堆空则停止。起始黄色方块不计。绿色方块每个在终局获得1分。
轮末与结束：
所有玩家用完两骰及效果后收回骰子，依次取得黄色奖励，再把主牌堆顶牌移到副牌堆顶刷新市场。多人若主牌堆空，游戏结束；否则先手移交下一位。基础单人第一次主牌堆空时，洗副牌堆作为新主牌堆，再按个人领地尚空的黄色格数量刷新市场；第二次用完主牌堆结束。Rivals单人变体第一次用完主牌堆即结束。
计分：
· 完整同色相邻领地按大小计分：1格1分，2格3分，3格6分，4格10分；未填满的领地不计分。
· 每种颜色全部填满获得1分。
· 每2名剩余工人获得1分，向下取整。
· 每个绿色方块获得1分，再加永久牌提供的额外分。
单人0–21分为初晋贵族，22–25分为男爵，26–29分为伯爵，30–33分为侯爵，34分以上为公爵。达到侯爵或更高爵位获得胜利。
永久效果：
· A：每放置一个方块后，可以将一颗可用骰子的点数调整1点。
· B：每获得工人后，可以额外获得1名工人；本效果不触发自身。
· C：每获得一个方块后，可以将一颗可用骰子的点数调整1点。
· D：终局获得1分，每2名工人额外获得1分。
· E：终局每个红色方块额外获得1分。
· F：每种完成的颜色额外获得1分。
· G：终局每个绿色方块额外获得1分。
· H：终局每个蓝色方块额外获得1分。
· I：终局每个白色方块额外获得1分。
Rivals永久效果：
· J：终局获得1分，每2个已完成且至少有2格的领地额外获得1分。
· K：支付工人调整骰子后，可以将同一颗骰子的点数再调整1点。
· L：每2个已完成的单格领地获得1分。
· M：放置绿色方块后，可以支付1名工人，执行红色或白色方块的效果。
· N：放置红色方块后，可以支付1名工人，再执行一次红色方块的效果。
· P：放置白色方块后，可以支付1名工人，再执行一次白色方块的效果。
· Q：回合开始掷骰后、使用骰子前，可以支付2名工人，执行红色或白色方块的效果。
· O：复制自己另一张永久牌；没有可复制牌时终局获得2分。数字版在取得O时先复制已有第一张牌，之后可在自己掷骰前改选已拥有的牌，回合内保持不变。

en.name: The Cubes of Europe
en.desc: Build a nineteen-hex estate with two dice, chain cube effects and earn permanent abilities.
en.rules:
Goal:
Complete connected territories of matching colors to score. The base game is for one player; 30 points wins. The official Rivals expansion supports 1–4 players. In multiplayer, highest score wins; ties favor the player with more empty hexes, then share the win.
Setup:
The base game uses nine double-sided cards A–I. Shuffle, move the top card to the side pile, then take the next card as your land. The rest is the main deck. Each player has two dice, three yellow cubes and four each of red, white, blue and green. Place a starting cube on any yellow hex without triggering its effect. Your holding area has three spaces and your worker limit is six.
Rivals uses all 17 cards. In multiplayer set aside four land cards, then move the next card to the side pile. Deal each player one of the four lands and remove unused lands. For the solo variant remove four cards first, then follow solo setup. The first player starts with one worker; following players receive two, three or four.
Turn:
Roll two dice and spend each once, in any combination of these actions.
· Gain a cube: claim a matching die symbol in the market and take that color from your own supply into your holding area. Only the six symbols along the join of the two piles are available. In two-player games each symbol holds one die; solo and 3–4 players allow a stack of two. An exhausted supply still lets you claim a symbol without gaining a cube. If your holding area is full, return one cube to your supply first.
· Place a cube: move a held cube onto an empty hex of the same color and matching die value, adjacent to an occupied hex.
· Gain a worker: spend a die of any value for one worker. Workers beyond six are lost.
Spend one worker to modify an unused die by one, wrapping between one and six. You may spend multiple workers.
Color effects:
· After placing red, you may place another held cube, ignoring dice rules but respecting color and adjacency.
· After placing white, you may gain any color in the current market, ignoring dice and occupancy.
· After placing blue, you may gain one worker.
Red and white can chain. All color and permanent effects are optional.
Each new yellow cube placed this round lets you take one card from the top of the side pile at round end as a permanent effect, in first-player order. Stop when the pile is empty. The starting yellow cube does not count. Each placed green cube scores one point at game end.
Round end and game end:
After everyone spends both dice and resolves effects, retrieve dice, take yellow rewards, then move the top main-deck card to the side pile to refresh the market. Multiplayer ends when the main deck is empty; otherwise pass first player clockwise. In base solo, when it empties the first time, shuffle the side pile into a new main deck, then refresh the market once for each empty yellow hex. End after the second pass. The Rivals solo variant ends after the first pass.
Scoring:
· Each completed connected territory scores by size: 1 hex = 1 point, 2 = 3, 3 = 6, 4 = 10. Incomplete territories score nothing.
· One point for every color completely filled.
· One point per two remaining workers, rounded down.
· One point per placed green cube, plus permanent-card bonuses.
Solo titles: 0–21 Newly Ennobled, 22–25 Baron, 26–29 Count, 30–33 Marquis, 34+ Duke. Marquis or higher wins.
Permanent effects:
· A: after placing any cube, modify an unused die by one.
· B: after gaining a worker, gain one more. This effect never triggers itself.
· C: after gaining any cube, modify an unused die by one.
· D: score one point plus one per two workers.
· E: score one extra point per red cube.
· F: score one extra point per completed color.
· G: score one extra point per green cube.
· H: score one extra point per blue cube.
· I: score one extra point per white cube.
Rivals permanent effects:
· J: score one point plus one per two completed territories of at least two hexes.
· K: after modifying a die with a worker, modify that die by one again.
· L: score one point per two completed single-hex territories.
· M: after placing green, pay one worker to use a red or white effect.
· N: after placing red, pay one worker to repeat the red effect.
· P: after placing white, pay one worker to repeat the white effect.
· Q: after rolling at turn start and before spending dice, pay two workers to use a red or white effect.
· O: copy another permanent card of yours, or scores two points if there is none. The digital edition initially copies your first eligible card, then lets you change the copy to another owned card before rolling on your turn. The copy remains fixed during the turn.

zh.name: 百变英雄
zh.desc: 叠加装备改变英雄，抢先出完手牌
zh.rules:
目标：先拥有至少 10点胜利点数，再成为某轮第一个出完手牌的人。该轮第一名奖励不能用于立即获胜。
准备：
每个点数 1–10 取与人数相等的角色卡；双人改用每值 3 张。每人获得1点胜利点数和2点能量、1 张升华、1 张科多拉和 1 张随机升级；双人随机升级为 3 张。每轮洗匀全部角色卡，每人发 10 张，双人发 15 张；卡上的升级永久保留。
准备阶段可以安装科多拉，支付2点胜利点数，将该角色置于手牌外押注，本轮不能打出。每张科多拉可单独押注。准备后开始出牌。
出牌：
领出者打出任意张同值牌。其余玩家依次打出张数相同、点数相等或更大的同值牌组，或过牌。原双人局必须严格大于。过牌后仍可再次参与；多人局同值接牌跳过下一位尚未出完的玩家。被跳过者之后仍可参与。
当连续过牌或跳过使行动回到最后出牌者时，牌墩结束，由其领出新牌墩；若其已出完，则由左侧下一位未出完者领出。只剩一人有手牌时，本轮结束。
升级：
自己回合出牌前，可免费把任意库存升级永久装入手牌。每张卡最多容纳光环、左手、右手、伙伴各一张。光环重设基础点数，左右手修正点数，最终可以为零或负数。升级不能移除；下轮重新发牌，可能换人持有。
伙伴能力：
· 燃火兔（Burny）：支付1点能量，该卡计为两张。
· 利刃兽（Edge）：支付1点能量，作为同组其他牌点数的百搭；必须至少有一张固定点数牌，不能全是百搭。
· 恶灵球（Spector）：支付1点能量，若这组牌最终赢得牌墩，每张已发动的恶灵球获得 1点胜利点数；被压过则无奖励。
· 小魅灵（Charmy）：支付1点能量，合法打出后反转当前牌墩的大小比较方向；双人仍不允许同值接牌。牌墩结束后恢复递增。
· 升华（Ascended Form）：支付2点能量，必须单张打出，可以压任何普通牌组；之后只能接另一张已发动的升华。多人局升华接升华仍跳过下家，原双人局不跳过。
· 科多拉（Kodora）：准备阶段押注。若第一出完，收回押注的 2点胜利点数并额外获得 2点胜利点数，再检查获胜门槛；否则押注丢失。押注牌下轮重新洗回。
带伙伴能力的卡不发动能力打出时，每张获得1点能量；这些能量不能用于同一组其他牌的发动费用。自己回合可用 4点能量兑换1点胜利点数；回合末或名次结算后超过6点能量时，选择兑换若干次后将剩余能量减至 6。
名次奖励：
2人对局的名次奖励：
· 第1名获得4点胜利点数，获得0点能量及2张随机升级牌。
· 第2名失去1点胜利点数，获得1点能量及2张随机升级牌。
3人对局的名次奖励：
· 第1名获得5点胜利点数，获得0点能量及1张随机升级牌。
· 第2名获得2点胜利点数，获得1点能量及2张随机升级牌。
· 第3名失去1点胜利点数，获得2点能量及3张随机升级牌。
4人对局的名次奖励：
· 第1名获得5点胜利点数，获得0点能量及1张随机升级牌。
· 第2名获得3点胜利点数，获得1点能量及2张随机升级牌。
· 第3名获得1点胜利点数，获得2点能量及2张随机升级牌。
· 第4名失去1点胜利点数，获得2点能量及3张随机升级牌。
5人对局的名次奖励：
· 第1名获得5点胜利点数，获得0点能量及1张随机升级牌。
· 第2名获得3点胜利点数，获得1点能量及2张随机升级牌。
· 第3名获得2点胜利点数，获得1点能量及2张随机升级牌。
· 第4名获得1点胜利点数，获得2点能量及2张随机升级牌。
· 第5名失去1点胜利点数，获得2点能量及3张随机升级牌。
6人对局的名次奖励：
· 第1名获得5点胜利点数，获得0点能量及1张随机升级牌。
· 第2名获得4点胜利点数，获得1点能量及1张随机升级牌。
· 第3名获得3点胜利点数，获得1点能量及2张随机升级牌。
· 第4名获得2点胜利点数，获得2点能量及2张随机升级牌。
· 第5名获得1点胜利点数，获得2点能量及3张随机升级牌。
· 第6名失去1点胜利点数，获得3点能量及3张随机升级牌。
出完时立即领取名次奖励；积分最低为零。末名结算后若仍有至少 10点胜利点数，降至 9。升级袋耗尽时只抽剩余卡。下一轮由本轮末名先手。
结束：
六轮后仍无人正常获胜，若第六轮第一名的积分独占最高，其立即获胜。否则第六轮第一名与所有积分最高者进入第七轮决赛，由这些人中第六轮名次最差者先手。洗匀全部牌库，原双人每人发 15 张，原多人发 10 张，余牌不公开；仍使用原游戏人数对应的同值规则。决赛第一位出完者获胜，不要求积分门槛。

en.name: Custom Heroes
en.desc: Craft evolving heroes and race to empty your hand
en.rules:
Goal: Have at least 10 victory points, then be the first to empty your hand in a round. That round’s placement reward cannot satisfy this requirement.
Setup:
Use one set of values 1–10 per player; with two players use three sets. Each player starts with 1 VP, 2 power, an Ascended Form, a Kodora and one random advancement (three random advancements with two players). Shuffle all character cards each round, keeping all sleeved advancements attached. Deal ten cards each, or fifteen in an originally two-player game.
During upkeep, you may sleeve Kodora and wager 2 VP per Kodora, setting those characters aside for the round. Then everyone confirms readiness.
Play:
The leader plays any number of cards of one value. Each following player plays the same number of matching cards with an equal or higher value, or passes. Originally two-player games require a strictly higher value. Passing does not prevent playing later. In multiplayer games, matching the previous value skips the next unfinished player; they may participate later.
When consecutive passes or skips return to the last player who played, that player wins the trick and leads again. If they have finished, the next unfinished player to their left leads. The round ends when only one player has cards.
Crafting:
At the start of your turn, before playing, freely sleeve advancements from your inventory into cards in your hand. Each card may have one aura, left-hand item, right-hand item and buddy. An aura replaces the base value; items modify it. Values can be zero or negative. Advancements cannot be removed, and the card may be dealt to someone else next round.
Abilities:
· Burny: Pay 1 power for this card to count as two cards.
· Edge: Pay 1 power to match another fixed-value card in the set. At least one card must have a fixed value; an entirely wild set is illegal.
· Spector: Pay 1 power; if this play wins the trick, gain 1 VP per activated Spector. Being beaten gives no reward.
· Charmy: Pay 1 power. After a legal play, reverse the comparison direction for this trick. Two-player games still require unequal values. The next trick returns to ascending.
· Ascended Form: Pay 2 power and play it alone to beat any ordinary set. Only another activated Ascended Form can follow. Ascended-on-Ascended skips in multiplayer, but not in an originally two-player game.
· Kodora: Wager 2 VP during upkeep and set the card aside. If you finish first, recover the wager and gain 2 additional VP before checking victory. Otherwise lose the wager. The card returns to the deck next round.
Playing a card with an unused ability gains 1 power per card, after paying all activation costs. This new power cannot pay for other abilities in the same play. On your turn, trade 4 power for 1 VP. At the end of a turn or placement scoring, if you exceed 6 power, choose exchanges and discard any remaining excess down to 6.
Placement:
Placement rewards with 2 players:
· Place 1: gain 4 VP, gain 0 power, and draw 2 random advancements.
· Place 2: lose 1 VP, gain 1 power, and draw 2 random advancements.
Placement rewards with 3 players:
· Place 1: gain 5 VP, gain 0 power, and draw 1 random advancements.
· Place 2: gain 2 VP, gain 1 power, and draw 2 random advancements.
· Place 3: lose 1 VP, gain 2 power, and draw 3 random advancements.
Placement rewards with 4 players:
· Place 1: gain 5 VP, gain 0 power, and draw 1 random advancements.
· Place 2: gain 3 VP, gain 1 power, and draw 2 random advancements.
· Place 3: gain 1 VP, gain 2 power, and draw 2 random advancements.
· Place 4: lose 1 VP, gain 2 power, and draw 3 random advancements.
Placement rewards with 5 players:
· Place 1: gain 5 VP, gain 0 power, and draw 1 random advancements.
· Place 2: gain 3 VP, gain 1 power, and draw 2 random advancements.
· Place 3: gain 2 VP, gain 1 power, and draw 2 random advancements.
· Place 4: gain 1 VP, gain 2 power, and draw 2 random advancements.
· Place 5: lose 1 VP, gain 2 power, and draw 3 random advancements.
Placement rewards with 6 players:
· Place 1: gain 5 VP, gain 0 power, and draw 1 random advancements.
· Place 2: gain 4 VP, gain 1 power, and draw 1 random advancements.
· Place 3: gain 3 VP, gain 1 power, and draw 2 random advancements.
· Place 4: gain 2 VP, gain 2 power, and draw 2 random advancements.
· Place 5: gain 1 VP, gain 2 power, and draw 3 random advancements.
· Place 6: lose 1 VP, gain 3 power, and draw 3 random advancements.
Claim your reward immediately on finishing. VP cannot fall below zero. If last place still has at least 10 VP after scoring, reset to 9. Draw only the advancements remaining if the bag runs out. Last place leads the next round.
Ending:
If nobody wins normally after six rounds and the sixth-round winner has uniquely the most VP, they win. Otherwise that winner and everyone tied for most VP enter a seventh-round final, led by the qualifier who placed worst in round six. Shuffle the entire deck; deal fifteen each in an originally two-player game, otherwise ten. Keep unused cards hidden and retain the original game’s equal-value rule. The first player to empty their hand wins, regardless of VP.

zh.name: 骇客潜行
zh.desc: 合作潜入网络，以指令、程序与装置对抗系统防御。
zh.rules:
目标：
合作完成最终金色目标；必须放置的火花或守卫供应不足时立即失败。
准备：
选择系统主控与角色，拼接五块服务器板块。每位角色拥有十五张基础牌，洗牌抽五张，在本人服务器 6 号入口放初始程序；按系统主控布置防御，并自由补放规定数量的蓝色程序。
周期：
先查看目标并选择首位骇客。每人每周期行动三个回合，顺序自由选择。回合开始结算效果并生成火花，使用手牌行动，结束时前两回合可保留一张牌（凯莉三张）并抽五张；第三回合不能保留。全体完成后进行系统反击、检查目标、按箭头移动火花，最后准备下一周期。整局首回合跳过生成。
指令：
一张手牌可支付其全部指令，或改用其能力；同一次行动可组合多张牌，多余指令作废。紫色可代替任意颜色，任意三枚指令可换一枚紫色。高级牌按标记执行、揭示或中断；揭示牌不弃置且每回合一次。
行动：
· 上传：支付三枚同色指令，在行动格放一枚同色程序；有红／黄装置时可按一枚同色指令一枚程序上传对应颜色。
· 安装：支付一枚同色指令，移除行动格三枚同色程序，放一枚同色装置。普通上传与安装不能在有防御棋件的格进行；红／黄装置提供的改良上传允许该格存在防御棋件。
· 移动：每枚蓝色指令提供1点移动力。移动至相邻格消耗1点移动力；从蓝色程序或装置到蓝色程序或装置免费。从蓝色装置可直接前往任意格。可携带至多三枚同色基础程序，或一枚紫色程序。不可进入白色守卫格。
· 推移：每枚绿色指令可将一个程序或火花移至相邻格；来源须为行动格，或存在绿色程序／装置的格。
· 改写：支付1枚黄色指令和1枚目标颜色的指令，移除行动格一枚火花与一枚黄色程序，放一枚目标颜色程序。该格黄色程序数须大于火花数；相等时该服务器须有黄色装置。
· 感染：所在格须有红色程序，并至少支付1枚红色指令。感染值为红骰加支付数、红色程序数、同格红色装置四点及每枚相邻红色装置一点。抵抗值为黑骰加火花数、同格每枚守卫四点及每枚相邻守卫一点。严格大于时移除该格全部防御，否则移除一枚红色程序。
· 升级：支付公开高级牌标明的费用，将该牌加入手牌，并牺牲一张支付牌；高级牺牲牌进入公开升级区，基础牺牲牌退出游戏。
程序与装置：
· 蓝色程序和装置提供免费的移动通路；蓝色装置还允许传送。
· 绿色程序和装置提供推移的来源位置；绿色装置还允许在同一服务器上执行幽灵行动。
· 黄色程序用于满足改写条件；黄色装置还提供黄色改良上传。
· 红色程序和装置增强感染；红色装置还提供红色改良上传。
幽灵行动的当前格与服务器以幽灵位置计算，明确写实体分身的效果仍指实体。
防御：
三枚火花转化为守卫，有白色火花则转为白色。火花进入守卫格时爆炸，在相邻格各放同色火花。白色火花捕获同格程序，白色守卫移除同格其他棋件并随机传送实体分身。每格每种基础程序最多三枚、紫色一枚、装置一枚；程序与装置供应不足则跳过放置，捕获的程序仍占用供应。
系统反击：
红色程序与防御同格时反复进行不支付指令的感染，直至一方清空。随后火花移除同格程序，守卫移除同格程序与装置。系统主控、目标及数据包的特殊规则优先，详情可在对局中查看。

en.name: Deckers
en.desc: Infiltrate a network together using commands, programs and installations.
en.rules:
Goal:
Work together to complete the final Gold objective. The team loses immediately if a required Spark or Guardian cannot be placed from supply.
Cycle:
Choose the first Decker. Each Decker takes three turns per cycle in any chosen order. Resolve start effects and Spawn, perform actions, then keep up to one card (Kelly three) and draw five; no cards are kept after the third turn. After all Deckers finish, resolve the SMC Attack, objective, Spark arrows, and Refresh. The first turn of the whole game skips Spawn.
Commands:
Combine cards for one action; excess commands are lost. Purple is wild, and any three commands exchange for one purple. Advanced cards may instead Execute, Reveal once per turn without discarding, or Interrupt at their printed timing.
Actions:
· Upload: pay three matching commands for one program at your space. A red/yellow installation improves the matching Upload to one command per program.
· Install: pay one matching command and remove three matching programs to place an installation. Normal Upload and Install require no defense at that space. Improved Upload through a red or yellow Installation is allowed even with defense present.
· Move: blue commands give movement points; adjacent movement costs one, blue pathways are free, and a blue installation allows teleporting to any space. Carry up to three programs of one basic color or one purple program. White Guardians block avatar entry.
· Shift: each green command moves a program or Spark one adjacent space, from your space or any space with green software.
· Modify: pay one yellow command and one command of the desired color, remove a Spark and a yellow program, and place a program of the desired color; yellow programs must outnumber Sparks, or tie with a yellow installation on that server.
· Infect: requires a red program and at least one red command; compare red die plus paid commands, red programs, four per local red installation, one per adjacent red installation, against black die plus Sparks, four per local Guardian, one per adjacent Guardian. Strictly greater removes all defense; otherwise lose one red program.
· Upgrade: pay a market card’s cost, add it to your hand, and sacrifice one paid card; an advanced sacrifice enters the market, a basic sacrifice leaves play.
Network:
Green installations allow Ghost actions on their server. Ghosts define your acting space/server, while explicit avatar effects still affect the actual avatar. Three Sparks transform into a Guardian; any white Spark makes it white. A Spark entering a Guardian explodes to adjacent spaces. White Sparks capture programs; white Guardians clear other pieces and randomly relocate avatars. Each space holds up to three programs per basic color, one purple, and one installation. Captured programs still occupy physical supply.
SMC Attack:
Red programs repeatedly Infect defense without paid commands until one side is clear. Then Sparks remove programs and Guardians remove programs and installations. SMC, objective and Packet rules override these defaults; inspect their details during play.

zh.name: DECKO
zh.desc: 扑克×卡组构筑:下注抢底池,买牌改牌组,王牌各显神通
zh.rules:
目标:十二轮结束后,持有筹码最多的玩家获胜。
· 若有玩家率先达到 60 枚筹码(五人局为 70 枚),游戏立即结束。
准备:
· 每名玩家获得 20 枚筹码、十四张相同的起始牌,以及两次借贷额度。
· 每次借贷立即获得 10 枚筹码,终局结算时每次扣除 5 枚。
流程:每一轮按顺序进行以下阶段
· 起始注:奖池放入本轮的最小注,担任盲位的玩家同时下最小注。
· 发牌:从自己的抽牌堆抽取五张牌;抽牌堆抽空时,将弃牌堆洗回作为新的抽牌堆。
· 下注:从盲位左手边的玩家开始轮流行动,选择加注、跟注或弃牌。
· 每轮首次行动前,可以烧毁一张手牌并补抽一张。
· 摊牌:未弃牌的玩家必须用手牌组成所能达到的最高牌型,牌型最大者赢走全部下注与奖池。
· 购买:本轮未获胜也未弃牌的玩家按牌型获得 $0 至 $9 的资金。
· 资金可用于购买市场牌、特殊行动与王牌。
牌型:从大到小依次为皇家同花顺、同花顺、四条、同花、顺子、葫芦、三条、两对、一对、高牌。
· 葫芦在同花和顺子之下;比较牌型时不使用踢脚,完全相同的牌型平分底池。
· 弃牌的玩家可以免费拿取一张市场牌;手牌上限为七张,牌组下限为七张。
特殊规则:
· 第四轮和第八轮是万能牌回合,当轮启用一张影响全场的规则变体。
· 市场牌和王牌各带有特殊能力;王牌分为六种,只能在对应的行动时机使用。
终局结算:先偿还全部借贷,之后筹码最多的玩家获胜;筹码相同时抽牌比较大小。

en.name: DECKO
en.desc: Poker hands meet deck-building: bet, buy, and bend the rules with jokers
en.rules:
Goal: after 12 rounds, the player with the most chips wins.
· If any player reaches 60 chips (70 in a 5-player game), the game ends immediately.
Setup:
· Each player receives 20 chips, an identical 14-card starting deck, and two loan markers.
· Each loan grants 10 chips immediately and costs 5 chips at the end of the game.
Play: each round proceeds through the following phases in order
· Ante: the house pot receives the minimum bet, and the blind player bets the same amount.
· Deal: draw five cards from your own deck; when it runs out, shuffle your discard pile to form a new deck.
· Betting: starting with the player to the left of the blind, take turns raising, calling, or folding.
· Before your first action each round, you may burn one card from your hand to draw one.
· Showdown: players who have not folded must form the highest set their hand allows; the highest set wins all bets and the pot.
· Buy: players who neither won nor folded receive $0 to $9 according to their set rank.
· The money can be spent on market cards, special actions, and jokers.
Sets: from strongest to weakest — royal flush, straight flush, four of a kind, flush, straight, full house, three of a kind, two pair, one pair, high card.
· A full house ranks below a flush and a straight; there are no kickers, and identical sets split the pot.
· A player who folds takes one market card for free; the hand limit is seven cards and the deck minimum is seven.
Special rules:
· Rounds 4 and 8 are wildcard rounds, each activating a table-wide rules twist.
· Market cards and jokers carry their own abilities; jokers come in six types, each usable only at its matching timing.
Final scoring: repay all loans first, then the player with the most chips wins; ties are broken by drawing cards.

zh.name: 同房异梦
zh.desc: 藏起自己的装修条件，在有限交流中共同布置一个让所有人满意的家。
zh.rules:
目标：
共同布置四个房间，满足每位玩家的所有私有条件。基础版包含双人20关战役及三、四人10个独立场景。每条条件按卡面完整的一项计算，其中的多个要求必须同时满足。
准备：
按所选场景布置墙色、物件、礼物、宠物与室友位置。两人使用双人战役，三至四人使用多人场景。三人局将第四位玩家的三条条件依次分给前三位玩家。自己的条件不能向其他人透露，定期交流时除外。
流程：
从第一位玩家开始，每回合进行一次行动：向对应空槽添加一件物件、移除一件物件、把一件物件换成同类型的另一种，或重漆一个房间。不能直接交换两个房间的物件或墙色。只有自己的所有条件已经满足时才能跳过。
物件只有十二种固定组合，每种最多四件。
· 台灯：现代蓝、古典黄、复古红、奇异绿。
· 壁饰：现代红、古典绿、复古蓝、奇异黄。
· 摆件：现代绿、古典蓝、复古黄、奇异红。
红、黄为暖色，绿、蓝为冷色。墙面有颜色但没有类型或风格。
行动后检查满足情况，其他玩家用积极、消极或中立回应。回应可以表示妥协，不要求与条件变化完全一致；不能解释自己的条件或给出额外提示。多人局可以选择中立作为不发表意见。所有人满意时共同获胜。
交流：
双人局在第15、20、25轮结束后各交流一次，每人向对方公开自己的一条条件。多人局每5轮交流一次，共5次；每人选择自己的一条条件私下分享给另一人。以后交流可以收回已经分享的条件并交给别人，不能转分享他人的条件。第一次交流前，全体可以一致同意提前交流，但会失去跳过的轮数。
特殊场景：
· 礼物占用任意一类物件槽，计为物件，但没有颜色、类型或风格。礼物不能增加或移除；一次行动可以把一份礼物移到任意空槽。
· 宠物不占物件槽，分大猫、小猫、大狗、小狗，每种最多八只；一次行动可以添加、移除或移动一只宠物，也可以换成同种不同大小或同大小不同种的宠物。
· 有室友标记的场景中，一次行动可以将自己移到另一间卧室。另一间已有两人时必须选择一人换到原房；只有一人时可以选择换人或直接入住。第20关中，Spencer不能增减或更换台灯，Blake不能增减或更换摆件；违反时撤销变动但消耗行动，跳过回应。
位置与计分：
保留各房间三个物件槽的左右顺序。“最左、最右”忽略空槽；“紧邻”不忽略空槽。礼物参与物件和占用槽位数量，宠物不计为物件。所有人在任意一次行动后满足全部条件即获胜，否则最多30轮后结束。每条满足的条件获得3分；全员条件全部满足时，每个剩余交流爱心获得2分。

en.name: Décorum
en.desc: Keep your decorating conditions secret and build a home that makes every housemate happy.
en.rules:
Goal:
Decorate four rooms to fulfill every player's secret conditions. The base game includes a 20-scenario two-player campaign and 10 standalone scenarios for three or four players. Every complete bullet on a condition card is one condition, including all its clauses.
Setup:
Use the selected scenario's walls, objects, gifts, pets and roommate positions. Two players use the campaign; three or four use the standalone scenarios. With three players, give player four's three conditions to players one, two and three respectively. Keep conditions secret except during scheduled sharing.
Turns:
Starting with player one, make one change: add an object to its matching empty slot, remove an object, swap it for a different object of the same type, or repaint one room. Objects and wall colors may not be exchanged directly between rooms. You may pass only when all your own conditions are fulfilled.
There are twelve fixed object combinations, four copies of each.
· Lamps: modern blue, antique yellow, retro red, unusual green.
· Wall hangings: modern red, antique green, retro blue, unusual yellow.
· Curios: modern green, antique blue, retro yellow, unusual red.
Red and yellow are warm; green and blue are cool. Walls have color but no type or style.
After an action, check fulfillment. Other players give a positive, negative or neutral response. A response may express compromise; it need not mechanically reflect a condition change. Do not explain conditions or give additional hints. In multiplayer, neutral can stand for not commenting. Everyone wins when all conditions are fulfilled.
Sharing:
With two players, hold a heart-to-heart after rounds 15, 20 and 25. Each player reveals one of their own conditions. With three or four players, hold a house meeting every five rounds, five times in total. Each player privately shares one own condition with one housemate. At later meetings you may recall cards and share them with someone else. Never pass on another player's conditions. Before the first meeting, all players may agree to meet early, losing the skipped rounds.
Special scenarios:
· Gifts occupy any object slot and count as objects, but have no color, type or style. They cannot be added or removed. Moving one gift to an empty slot takes one action.
· Pets use no object slots. There are small cats, big cats, small dogs and big dogs, up to eight of each. One action adds, removes or moves one pet, or swaps one for the same species in another size or the same size in another species.
· In roommate scenarios, one action moves your own token to the other bedroom. If it already holds two people, choose one to move back to your old bedroom. With one occupant, you may either swap with them or join them. In scenario 20, Spencer may not add, remove or swap lamps; Blake may not add, remove or swap curios. Breaking a ban undoes the change, consumes the action and skips comments.
Position and scoring:
The left-to-right order of slots matters. Leftmost and rightmost ignore empty slots; directly adjacent does not. Gifts count as objects and filled slots; pets are not objects. All players win as soon as every condition is fulfilled after an action. Otherwise play ends after at most 30 rounds. Score three points per fulfilled condition, plus two points per remaining heart if every condition is fulfilled.

zh.name: 谍报风云
zh.desc: 两队密码战:给队友加密,破译截对手
zh.rules:
目标:先集齐 2 个拦截指示物的队伍获胜;集齐 2 个错误传讯指示物的队伍落败。
准备:
· 全员分成白队与黑队,每队至少 2 人。
· 每队各持有 4 个关键词(编号 ①-④),只有本队成员能看到。
流程:
· 每轮两队各由一名加密者(按队内顺序轮换)秘密抽取一个三位密码:1-4 中 3 个不重复数字的排列,并依次写下 3 条提示。
· 白队提示先公布:白队解读自家密码,黑队同时尝试拦截;双方锁定答案后揭晓。
· 随后公布黑队提示,黑队解读、白队拦截,同样结算。
· 第一轮双方不能拦截,但仍要解读自家密码。
· 一轮结束检查胜负;未分胜负则进入下一轮,最多 8 轮。
计分:
· 本队解读错误:本队获得 1 个错误传讯指示物。
· 拦截对方成功:本队获得 1 个拦截指示物;两者可在同一半场同时发生。
提示规范:
· 提示必须与关键词含义相关;不能包含关键词本身,不能与已公布过的提示重复。
· 不能借发音、字数、位置等游戏外信息提示;提示公布后不能修改。
平局:
· 双方同时达成胜负条件,或 8 轮结束未分胜负:将本队拦截指示物数量减去错误传讯指示物数量，结果较高的队伍获胜。
· 若仍然平手，双方分别猜测对方的4个关键词，猜中数量较多的队伍获胜；若仍然相同，则共享胜利。

en.name: Decrypto
en.desc: Team code war: clue your side, crack theirs
en.rules:
Goal: the first team to collect 2 Interception tokens wins; a team with 2 Miscommunication tokens loses.
Setup:
· Split into White and Black teams, at least 2 players each.
· Each team holds 4 keywords (①-④), visible only to teammates.
Play:
· Each round, one Encryptor per team (rotating in seat order) secretly draws a 3-digit code — a permutation of 1-4 — and writes 3 clues in order.
· White clues are revealed first: White decodes their own code while Black tries to intercept; both lock in answers, then the code is revealed.
· Then Black clues are revealed; Black decodes and White intercepts.
· In round 1 neither team may intercept, but you still decode your own code.
· Win/loss is checked at the end of each round; at most 8 rounds.
Scoring:
· Decode your own code wrong: your team takes 1 Miscommunication token.
· Intercept the enemy code: your team takes 1 Interception token; both can happen in the same half-round.
Clue rules:
· Clues must relate to the keyword's meaning; never contain the keyword itself, never repeat a clue already given.
· No hints via sounds, word length or positions; clues cannot be changed once revealed.
Tiebreak:
· If both teams trigger a win/loss condition at once, or 8 rounds pass: subtract each team’s Miscommunication tokens from its Interception tokens. The team with the higher result wins.
· Still tied: each team guesses the enemy's 4 keywords; most hits wins; still tied, the victory is shared.

zh.name: 深海任务
zh.desc: 协力吃墩:各自领任务,沉默配合完成全船目标
zh.rules:
目标:全队合作,每人认领自己的任务卡并在牌墩进行过程中完成它;任何一张任务失败,全船失败。
牌:
· 四种花色各 1~9,另有潜艇(将牌)1~4。
· 必须跟花色;潜艇大于所有花色牌,潜艇之间数字大者胜。
准备:
· 持有潜艇 4 的人是船长:率先认领任务，并领出第一墩。
· 按任务卡背面的点数抽取任务，直到达到本关要求的总点数，再从船长开始依次认领。需要与船长比较赢墩数的任务，船长不能认领。
声呐沟通:
· 每两墩之间,每人可用一次声呐:亮出一张花色牌,并标注「最高 / 唯一 / 最低」,表明它在你手中该花色里的地位。
· 打出该牌后,展示撤下。
电子版公开信息:
· 每人已吃的牌全程展示,按花色与点数排序;未出的手牌仍保密。
胜负:
· 全员任务完成即过关,可挑战下一难度(任务点数加 1)。
· 失败可带同一批任务重试,或换一批重抽。

en.name: The Crew: Deep Sea
en.desc: Co-op trick-taking: claim tasks and fulfil them together in silence
en.rules:
Goal: cooperate — everyone claims task cards and fulfils them during tricks; a single failed task sinks the whole crew.
Cards:
· Four suits of 1–9, plus submarines (trump) 1–4.
· You must follow suit; submarines outrank every suited card, and among submarines the higher number wins.
Setup:
· The holder of submarine 4 is the captain: claims a task first and leads the first trick.
· Tasks are dealt until their point values reach the mission total, then claimed in order starting from the captain; the captain cannot take a task that compares against the captain.
Radio (sonar):
· Once between tricks, each player may radio: reveal a suit card and tag it “highest / only / lowest” for that suit in your hand.
· The reveal clears once that card is played.
Digital edition:
· Everyone’s captured cards stay visible, sorted by suit and number; unplayed hands remain secret.
Result:
· When all tasks are completed, the mission succeeds and you may attempt the next difficulty (task points increase by 1).
· On failure, retry with the same tasks or redraw a new set.

zh.name: 王权骰铸
zh.desc: 七位英雄，以专属骰子、技能和战术手牌展开双人决斗。
zh.rules:
目标：
将对手的生命降至0；同一结算双方均降至0时平局。
准备：
每人选择一名英雄，镜像对局各自拥有独立牌组与伙伴。起始拥有50点生命、2点战斗点数（CP）和4张手牌。CP上限为15点，治疗后生命值最多为60点。采用已核对的官方英雄规则；默认使用标准牌组，选人时可加入该英雄的官方赠卡。
回合流程：
· 维护：处理燃烧、中毒、火焰精通、装填与伙伴。
· 收入：获得1点CP并抽取1张牌；先手第一回合跳过收入。
· 第一主阶段：可打出主阶段牌、升级技能或出售手牌。每出售1张手牌，获得1点CP。升级永久生效；从II级升级至III级时，支付差额费用；从I级直接升级至III级时，支付全部费用。
· 进攻：至多掷3次，每次可保留或重新选择任意骰。选择满足骰面组合的一个技能并宣告；对手可响应改骰。骰面被改变后，攻击方可重新宣告合法技能或使用剩余掷骰次数。
· 技能激活后先结算其非伤害效果；掷骰产生的效果允许合法改骰。对手受到至少1点可防御攻击时可使用一个防御技能；伤害与防御反伤累计并同时结算。
· 第二主阶段后进入弃牌阶段，出售到手牌不超过6张，再结束回合。
时机与伤害：
主阶段牌和技能可在合法时机被即时行动响应；即时牌、掷骰阶段牌和状态消耗本身不可被打断。响应按当前回合玩家优先；双方确认后继续。
· 普通伤害可防御、减免与增伤。
· 不可防御伤害只禁止防御掷骰。
· 纯粹伤害不可增伤。
· 溅射不算攻击且不可增伤。
固定减伤先计算，再从同一小计计算各次减半，向上取整。
终极技能可在激活前通过改骰阻止。成功激活后，对手不能行动、防御、使用状态或伙伴；终极伤害不能减免，攻击方可增伤。
状态与伙伴：
· 武僧本玩家回合新获得的气不能用于增伤；伤害后获得的暴击不能用于本次攻击。
· 神佑不能被一般效果移除或转移，生命降至 0 时改为 1，终极伤害也适用。
· 树精的精灵是伙伴，每种每个玩家回合仅能花费一次；移除或丢弃精灵不获得其花费效果。
状态的上限和效果可点击对应标记查看；技能板列出基础与升级的完整效果。
· 眩晕期间不能行动，攻击结束后移除，并让攻击方立即追加进攻。
· 暗影持续至携带它开始并结束自己的完整回合，免除对手进攻阶段伤害，终极除外。
Raveness的伙伴可以移动到任意1名玩家处。位于对手处时，激活伙伴会使该对手失去1点生命，并储存1点生命，最多储存3点。伙伴返回主人处时，使主人恢复与储存值相等的生命，然后清空储存值。对手维护时，掷出伙伴骰，并按骰面结算：
· 1点：持有者获得六之诅咒。
· 2点：伙伴的主人激活伙伴2次。
· 3点：伙伴的主人激活伙伴1次。
· 4点：持有者弃置1张牌。
· 5点：持有者失去1点CP，伙伴的主人获得1点CP。
· 6点：清空储存的生命，并将伙伴返回主人处。
羽毛可调整任意伙伴骰。持有六之诅咒时，自己掷出的6点骰面失去数字和符号；在自己的回合结束时移除此状态。
结束与牌堆：
伤害结算后检查胜负；需要抽牌且牌库为空时，先将弃牌堆洗混，组成新的牌库。已升级的牌不在弃牌中。

锻造大师的护甲制作：
· 制作黄金护甲，需要支付锻造区中的2张黄金矿石牌。
· 将护甲升级为钻石护甲，需要已有同类黄金护甲，并支付2张钻石矿石牌。
· 将护甲升级为究极护甲，需要已有同类钻石护甲，并支付1张究极矿石牌。

锻造大师的护甲效果：
头盔和护盾各只能持有1件。受到普通攻击时，可以使用以下护甲效果：
· 黄金头盔对攻击者造成1点反击伤害。
· 钻石头盔对攻击者造成2点反击伤害。
· 究极头盔对攻击者造成3点反击伤害。
· 黄金护盾防止1点伤害。
· 钻石护盾防止2点伤害。
· 究极护盾防止2点伤害，也可以用于不可防御或纯粹攻击，但不能抵挡终极攻击。
普通效果不能移除或转移护甲。

死灵法师的尸骸与召唤：
维护阶段，将“掘墓”移至另一个非终极进攻技能栏，并获得该栏标示数量的尸骸；被覆盖技能栏中的所有技能均不能发动。最多持有10个尸骸。在主阶段中，可以选择以下一种方式花费尸骸：
· 支付2个尸骸，召唤1名骷髅战士。
· 支付3个尸骸，召唤1名骷髅法师。
· 支付6个尸骸，召唤1名白骨魔像。
· 支付10个尸骸，获得复活状态。

死灵法师的亡灵：
每名亡灵在每个玩家回合中最多激活1次。
· 骷髅战士：最多持有3名。每激活1名，使本次攻击的伤害增加1点。
· 骷髅法师：最多持有1名。激活时，选择施加衰败；如果本回合已经激活3名骷髅战士，也可以改为偷取1点生命。
· 白骨魔像：最多持有1名。激活时，使本次攻击的伤害增加2点；或者，在受到非终极攻击时移除它，对攻击者造成2点反击伤害，并防止2点伤害。
掷骰阶段结束时，为本次已激活的所有亡灵同时掷骰；每掷出1个白骨符号，移除任意1名亡灵。移除亡灵不会取消已经激活的效果。

Deadpool的Shoot组件：
开局时，Shoot处于启用面。Deadpool在剪刀石头布中失败时，可以将Shoot翻至未启用面，改为赢得该次猜拳；对手使用被转移的剪刀石头布标记时，同样适用。本游戏采用官方扫兴硬币选项，自动获得原本需要口头表演才能获得的奖励。

Gambit的王牌：
4张王牌开局时均正面朝上。王牌充满充能后，通常每个玩家回合合计至多引爆1张，效果如下：
· 梅花：具有2个充能格。引爆时，使本次攻击的伤害增加1点；本次进攻技能实际使用黑色花色时，再投掷1颗骰子，使伤害额外增加骰子点数的一半，向上取整。
· 方块：具有3个充能格。引爆时，使本次攻击的伤害增加2点，并取回至多2张其他王牌。
· 红桃：具有4个充能格。引爆时，使本次攻击的伤害增加2点，再投掷1颗骰子，恢复等于骰子点数一半的生命，向上取整。
· 黑桃：具有4个充能格。引爆时，使本次攻击的伤害增加3点；本次进攻技能使用超充时，额外增加2点伤害。
引爆后，将该王牌翻至背面，并清空其充能。从攻击激活后到伤害结算前，都可以引爆王牌，包括终极攻击期间；纯粹伤害不能使用王牌增伤。

进攻技能实际使用红色或黑色花色时，可在其他效果前为一张对应花色的王牌加速一次，即便使用了两种花色也仅一次；顺子也适用。一次获得多次加速时，必须整批分配完毕，不能穿插引爆或取回。

en.name: Dice Throne
en.desc: Seven heroes clash with unique dice, abilities and tactical cards.
en.rules:
Goal:
Reduce the opponent to 0 health. If both reach 0 in the same resolution, the game is a draw.
Setup:
Choose a hero. Mirror matches have independent decks and companions. Start with 50 health, 2 Combat Points (CP) and 4 cards. CP limit is 15; healing limit is 60. Use the verified official Hero rules. Standard decks are the default; an official promo can be included at Hero selection.
Turn sequence:
· Upkeep: resolve Burn, Poison, Fire Mastery, Reload and companions.
· Income: gain 1 CP and draw 1 card. The starting player skips their first Income.
· Main Phase 1: play Main Phase cards, permanently upgrade abilities, or sell cards for 1 CP each. Level II to III costs the difference; I to III costs the full III price.
· Offense: up to 3 Roll Attempts, keeping or rerolling any dice. Declare one ability whose requirements are met. The opponent may alter dice. After a change, the attacker may redeclare a legal ability or use remaining attempts.
· After activation, resolve non-damage effects first. Effect rolls may be altered by legal cards. A defender facing at least 1 defendable Attack damage may use one Defensive Ability. Damage and defensive damage accumulate and resolve simultaneously.
· Main Phase 2, then Discard: sell down to at most 6 cards and end the turn.
Timing and damage:
Main Phase cards and abilities allow legal Instant responses. Instant cards, Roll Phase cards and token spending cannot themselves be interrupted. The Active Player has priority for simultaneous actions; continue after both confirm.
· Normal damage allows defense, prevention and modifiers.
· Undefendable prevents the Defensive Ability only.
· Pure damage cannot be enhanced.
· Collateral is not an Attack and cannot be enhanced.
Apply fixed prevention before independent half-prevention calculations from the same subtotal, rounded up.
An Ultimate may be stopped by altering dice before activation. Once activated, the opponent cannot act, defend, spend tokens or activate companions. Ultimate damage cannot be prevented; the attacker may enhance it.
Status effects and companions:
· Chi gained during this player turn cannot enhance an Attack. Crit gained after damage cannot enhance that Attack.
· Blessing of Divinity cannot be removed or transferred by ordinary effects; it sets Health to 1 instead of 0, including after Ultimate damage.
· Treant’s Spirits are Companions; each type may be spent once per player turn. Removing or discarding them does not grant their spend effects.
Select a status token to see its limit and full rules. Hero boards list base and upgraded effects.
· Stun forbids actions and is removed after the Attack, granting the attacker an immediate extra offense.
· Shadows lasts through the end of a full own turn begun with it and avoids damage during opposing offense except Ultimates.
Nevermore can move to either player. On an opponent it can siphon 1 health and store 1, to a maximum of 3. Returning home heals stored health and resets it. At an opposing holder’s Upkeep, roll the companion die:
· 1: the holder gains Hex.
· 2: the owner activates the companion twice.
· 3: the owner activates the companion once.
· 4: the holder discards 1 card.
· 5: the holder loses 1 CP and the owner gains 1 CP.
· 6: clear stored health and return the companion home.
Feather can adjust either companion die in a mirror match. Hex blanks your sixes, removing number and symbol, until your turn ends.
Ending and deck:
Check victory after damage resolution. When drawing from an empty deck, shuffle the discard into a new deck first. Installed upgrades stay out of the discard.

Forgemaster Armor crafting:
· Crafting Gold Armor costs 2 Gold ORE cards from the Forge.
· Upgrading to Diamond Armor requires the corresponding Gold Armor and costs 2 Diamond ORE cards.
· Upgrading to Ultimanium Armor requires the corresponding Diamond Armor and costs 1 Ultimanium ORE card.

Forgemaster Armor effects:
You may hold at most 1 Helmet and 1 Shield. Against normal Attacks, you may use these Armor effects:
· A Gold Helmet deals 1 damage back to the attacker.
· A Diamond Helmet deals 2 damage back to the attacker.
· An Ultimanium Helmet deals 3 damage back to the attacker.
· A Gold Shield prevents 1 damage.
· A Diamond Shield prevents 2 damage.
· An Ultimanium Shield prevents 2 damage. It also works against undefendable or pure Attacks, but never against Ultimates.
Ordinary effects cannot remove or transfer Armor.

Necromancer Corpses and summoning:
During Upkeep, move Unearth to a different non-Ultimate Offensive Ability slot and gain the number of Corpses shown there. All Abilities in the covered slot are unavailable. You may hold at most 10 Corpses. During a Main Phase, you may spend them in one of these ways:
· Spend 2 Corpses to summon 1 Warrior.
· Spend 3 Corpses to summon 1 Mage.
· Spend 6 Corpses to summon 1 Golem.
· Spend 10 Corpses to gain Resurrect.

Necromancer Undead:
Each Undead may activate at most once per player turn.
· Warriors: You may hold at most 3. Activating a Warrior adds 1 damage to the current Attack.
· Mage: You may hold at most 1. Activate it to inflict Decrep-ify. If you have already activated 3 Warriors this turn, you may instead steal 1 Health.
· Golem: You may hold at most 1. Activate it to add 2 damage to the current Attack. Alternatively, while being Attacked by a non-Ultimate, remove it to deal 2 damage back to the attacker and prevent 2 damage.
At the conclusion of the Roll Phase, roll simultaneously for all Undead activated this time. Remove any 1 Undead for each Bones result. Removing an Undead does not cancel its activated effect.

Deadpool’s Shoot component:
Shoot begins on its Active side. Whenever Deadpool loses Rock, Paper, Scissors, he may flip Shoot to its Inactive side to win instead. This also applies when an opponent uses a transferred Rock, Paper, Scissors token. This game uses the official Curmudgeon Coin option, which automatically grants the bonuses normally earned through spoken performances.

Gambit’s Aces:
All 4 Aces begin face up. Once fully charged, an Ace may normally be Exploded at most once in total per player turn, with these effects:
· Clubs has 2 charge slots. Exploding it adds 1 damage to the current Attack. If the Offensive Ability uses black, roll 1 die and add half its value as further damage, rounded up.
· Diamonds has 3 charge slots. Exploding it adds 2 damage to the current Attack and regains up to 2 other Aces.
· Hearts has 4 charge slots. Exploding it adds 2 damage to the current Attack, then rolls 1 die to heal half its value, rounded up.
· Spades has 4 charge slots. Exploding it adds 3 damage to the current Attack, plus 2 more if the Offensive Ability uses Super Charge.
After Exploding an Ace, flip it face down and clear its charges. You may Explode after an Attack activates and before its damage is dealt, including during an Ultimate. Aces cannot enhance pure damage.

When an Offensive Ability uses red or black, optionally Accelerate one matching Ace before its other effects; only one Ace even when both colors are used. Straights qualify. Multiple Accelerations are allocated as one batch without intervening explosions or regains.

zh.name: 骰子镇
zh.desc: 扑克骰抢地盘,金矿银行杂货店,谁的面子大谁说了算
zh.rules:
游戏目标：
游戏结束时，将每名玩家的金块、现金、装备卡和地产等资产换算成分数，总分最高的玩家获胜。

游戏准备：
· 每名玩家领取5颗扑克骰和8美元。每颗骰子有9、10、J、Q、K、A六种点数。
· 在金矿放置30块金块，在银行放置3美元。
· 从地产牌堆翻开3张牌，并从灵药牌堆翻开2张牌，正面朝上展示。随机选择一名玩家担任警长。

组牌阶段：
所有玩家同时掷骰，通过保留骰子组成各自的5骰牌型。
· 每次掷骰后，通常至少保留1颗骰子。保留1颗不付费；如果多保留骰子，每多保留1颗就支付1美元。
· 玩家也可以支付1美元，不保留本次掷出的任何骰子，然后重新掷骰。
· 当一名玩家保留的骰子达到5颗时，其他尚未完成组牌的玩家各进行最后一次掷骰，并保留所有剩余骰子。

结算阶段：
所有玩家亮出骰子后，依照以下顺序结算各个地点。地点的胜者由对应骰子的数量或牌型决定，平手时由警长裁决。
· 金矿：拥有最多9点骰子的玩家，每有1颗9点骰子就获得1块金块。
· 银行：拥有最多10点骰子的玩家，获得银行中的全部存款。
· 杂货店：拥有最多J点骰子的玩家，抽取与其J点骰子数量相等的杂货店卡，并保留其中1张。在第一轮，该玩家执行两次这一行动。
· 沙龙：拥有最多Q点骰子的玩家，从一名对手的卡牌中随机抽取与其Q点骰子数量相等的卡牌，并保留其中1张，将其余卡牌交还。
· 警长：拥有最多K点骰子的玩家接任警长，之后由新警长裁决平手。
· 市政厅：牌型最大的玩家领取1张正面朝上的地产牌；每有1颗A点骰子，再多领取1张，但一次合计至多领取3张。

比较牌型时，由大到小依次为五条、四条、葫芦、顺子、三条、两对、一对。含A点的顺子大于不含A点的顺子。

各地点结算后，本轮没有获得任何收获的玩家拜访庸医。该玩家可以选择1张正面朝上的灵药牌，或者从灵药牌堆随机抽取1张牌，并立即结算其效果。

游戏结束与计分：
当金矿中的金块耗尽，或地产牌全部发完时，完成当前轮次后结束游戏。各项资产按以下方式计分。
· 每块金块获得1分。
· 每2美元获得1分。
· 担任警长的玩家获得5分。
· 装备卡和地产牌按牌面标示的分值计分。
如果总分相同，持有地产牌较多的玩家获胜；如果仍然相同，由警长裁定胜者。

扩展规则：
以下扩展需要在开局选项中开启。
· Wild West：每个地点提供两个行动。第一名选择并执行其中一个行动，第二名执行剩下的行动。该扩展还加入河流卡、逃犯、牧场及新卡牌，并将人数上限提高到6人。
· Cowboys：该扩展加入草原地点。拥有最多A点骰子的玩家可以选择偷取牛只或招募牛仔。不同花色的牛仔提供不同增益；集齐4种花色后，可以将其换成1张价值10分的Rodeo卡。
· 印第安骰：该扩展需要同时开启Wild West。市政厅的胜者可以归还1张刚获得的地产牌，以换取印第安骰。持有者在下一轮金矿结算前掷出这颗骰子，并结算对应效果。

en.name: Dice Town
en.desc: Poker dice stake claims on the mine, bank and store — highest rollers take all
en.rules:
Goal:
At the end of the game, convert each player's nuggets, cash, gear and Properties into points. The player with the highest total wins.

Setup:
· Each player receives 5 poker dice and $8. Each die has the faces 9, 10, J, Q, K and A.
· Place 30 nuggets in the Gold Mine and $3 in the Bank.
· Reveal 3 Property cards and 2 Elixir cards face up. Randomly choose one player to be the Sheriff.

Building a hand:
All players roll simultaneously and keep dice to form their own five-dice hands.
· After each roll, a player normally keeps at least 1 die. Keeping 1 die is free; each additional die kept from that roll costs $1.
· A player may instead pay $1 to keep none of the dice from that roll and roll again.
· When a player has kept all 5 dice, every player who has not finished their hand makes one final roll and keeps all remaining dice.

Resolving locations:
Once everyone reveals their dice, resolve the following locations in order. The relevant dice count or poker hand determines each winner. The Sheriff decides ties.
· Gold Mine: the player with the most 9s gains 1 nugget for each 9.
· Bank: the player with the most 10s takes all cash in the Bank.
· General Store: the player with the most Js draws that many General Store cards and keeps 1. In the first round, that player performs this action twice.
· Saloon: the player with the most Qs randomly draws that many cards from one opponent, keeps 1, and returns the others.
· Sheriff: the player with the most Ks becomes the new Sheriff and decides subsequent ties.
· Town Hall: the player with the best poker hand takes 1 face-up Property card, plus 1 additional card for each Ace, up to 3 cards in total.

Poker hands rank from highest to lowest as follows: five of a kind, four of a kind, full house, straight, three of a kind, two pairs and one pair. A straight containing an Ace beats a straight without an Ace.

After resolving the locations, each player who gained nothing during the round visits Doc Badluck. That player chooses 1 face-up Elixir or draws 1 Elixir blindly from the deck and immediately resolves its effect.

Ending and scoring:
If the Gold Mine runs out of nuggets or all Property cards have been distributed, finish the current round and end the game. Score assets as follows.
· Each nugget is worth 1 point.
· Each $2 is worth 1 point.
· The Sheriff gains 5 points.
· Gear and Property cards score their printed values.
If players tie on points, the tied player with more Property cards wins. If the tie remains, the Sheriff decides the winner.

Expansions:
Enable the following expansions through the game options before starting.
· Wild West: each location offers two actions. The winner chooses and performs one action, and the runner-up performs the other. This expansion also adds River cards, Outlaws, Ranches and new cards, and increases the maximum player count to 6.
· Cowboys: this expansion adds the Prairie. The player with the most Aces chooses whether to steal cattle or recruit cowboys. Different cowboy suits provide different bonuses. A player who collects all four suits may exchange them for a Rodeo card worth 10 points.
· Indian Die: this expansion requires Wild West. The Town Hall winner may return 1 newly gained Property to receive the Indian Die. Its holder rolls it before the Gold Mine is resolved in the next round and applies the corresponding effect.

zh.name: 骰子对决
zh.desc: 翻滚或跳跃，让七枚骰子抵达对岸，以朝上点数决胜。
zh.rules:
游戏目标:
双方各有七枚骰子。当一方的七枚骰子全部到达对方底线时，游戏立即结束。分别合计双方已到达对方底线的骰子朝上点数，总分较高的玩家获胜。因此，率先让全部骰子抵达对岸并不一定获胜；总分相同时，双方平局。

开局准备:
使用七行七列的棋盘。白方从下方向上推进，黑方从上方向下推进。各自在靠近自己的一行摆满七枚骰子，使六点朝上、三点朝向自己。双方各掷两枚骰子，点数合计较高者先行；点数相同时重新掷骰。开局后，不再随机掷骰。

每回合的移动:
每个回合选择一枚己方骰子，按以下规则移动：
· 翻滚：向前、向左或向右翻滚一格，落点必须为空。骰子的朝上点数随实际骰面朝向改变。
· 跳跃：越过紧邻的一枚己方或对方骰子，落在紧接着的空格中，骰子的朝向保持不变。你可以连续跳跃，但相邻的两枚被跳骰子之间必须有空格，不能越过挤在一起的骰子。
· 如果没有先翻滚，连续跳跃必须沿同一条纵轴或横轴进行。你也可以先翻滚一次，再连续跳跃；此时可以组合向前与横向的跳跃。
· 骰子不得后退、斜走或原地转动，同一回合也不得翻滚多次。骰子到达对方底线后，仍可横向翻滚或跳跃来调整朝上点数，但不能越出棋盘。

数字版操作:
· 点选一枚己方骰子，查看一次翻滚或一次跳跃能够到达的格子，以及到达后的朝上骰面。点击目标位置的骰面，执行这一步移动。
· 如果仍有合法的后续跳跃，可以继续点击跳跃落点，或点击“结束移动”结束本回合。没有后续跳跃时，回合自动结束。
· 整段移动算作一个回合。翻滚只能作为第一步；没有先翻滚的连续跳跃不能改变纵轴或横轴。
· 开始移动前，再次点击已选骰子或点击“取消选择”，可以撤销选择。棋盘始终以白方的方向显示，因此黑方向屏幕下方推进。

Dittle Clash（可选，默认关闭）:
这一模式只允许翻滚，不允许跳跃。翻滚后，与敌方骰子在横向或纵向上相邻的骰子会发生碰撞，按以下规则结算：
· 一枚骰子与一枚敌方骰子碰撞时，朝上点数较低的骰子出局；点数相同时，两枚骰子均出局。
· 一枚骰子被多枚敌方骰子包围时，先合计这些敌方骰子的朝上点数，再与被围骰子的朝上点数比较。总点数较低的一方全部出局；点数相同时，参与这次包围的骰子全部出局。
· 先结算包围，同一组骰子不再拆成一对一碰撞重复结算。相互重叠的包围都以移除前的同一盘面为准，确定结果后同时移除出局骰子。
· 任意一枚幸存的骰子到达对方底线，该玩家立即获胜。一方骰子全部出局时，另一方获胜；双方骰子均全部出局时，双方平局。

无法推进与重复局面:
原版规则未规定以下情况，本数字版采用下列处理方式：
· 只有没有合法走法时，才可以跳过回合。双方连续跳过时，按当时已经到达对方底线的骰子朝上点数结算。
· 同一骰子位置、完整朝向及行棋方构成的局面出现三次时，双方平局。
· Dittle Clash中的同时包围，按上一节所述的统一方式结算。

en.name: Dittle: Dice Battle
en.desc: Tilt and jump seven dice across the board. The upward faces decide the winner.
en.rules:
Objective:
Each player has seven dice. When either player has all seven dice in the opponent's base row, the game ends immediately. Add the upward-facing values of each player's dice in the opposite base row. The player with the higher total wins, so finishing first does not guarantee victory. Equal totals result in a draw.

Setup:
Use a board with seven rows and seven columns. White advances from the bottom toward the top; Black advances from the top toward the bottom. Fill your nearest row with seven dice, with six facing upward and three facing you. Each player rolls two dice, and the player with the higher total takes the first turn. Roll again if the totals are equal. There are no random rolls after setup.

Moving on your turn:
Choose one of your dice and move it according to the following rules:
· You may tilt it one square forward, left or right into an empty square. Its upward face changes according to its actual orientation.
· You may jump over one adjacent friendly or opposing die into the empty square immediately beyond it, preserving your die's orientation. You may make consecutive jumps, but there must be an empty landing space between the dice being jumped. You cannot jump over a solid cluster.
· Without an initial tilt, consecutive jumps must remain on the same vertical or horizontal axis. You may instead tilt once and then jump, combining forward and sideways jumps.
· You cannot move backward or diagonally, rotate a die in place or tilt more than once during the same turn. Dice in the opposite base row may continue moving sideways to improve their upward-facing values, but they cannot leave the board.

Digital controls:
· Select one of your dice to see the destinations for a single tilt or jump, together with the resulting upward face. Click the die face shown at a destination to take that step.
· If another legal jump is available, click its destination to continue or choose End move to end your turn. If no further jump is available, your turn ends automatically.
· The entire movement sequence counts as one turn. A tilt is allowed only as the first step. A sequence of jumps without an initial tilt must remain on one axis.
· Before moving, click the selected die again or choose Cancel selection to clear your selection. The board always uses White's perspective, so Black advances toward the bottom of the screen.

Dittle Clash (optional, off by default):
In this mode, dice may tilt but cannot jump. After a tilt, dice clash with opposing dice that are adjacent horizontally or vertically. Resolve these clashes as follows:
· When one die clashes with one opposing die, remove the die with the lower upward-facing value. If the values are equal, remove both dice.
· When a die is surrounded by multiple opposing dice, add the upward-facing values of those opposing dice and compare their total with the surrounded die's upward-facing value. Remove all dice on the side with the lower value. If the values are equal, remove every die involved in that surround.
· Resolve surrounds before one-on-one clashes, and do not resolve the same group again as separate pairs. Determine all overlapping surrounds from the same board before removing any dice, then remove the casualties simultaneously.
· A player wins immediately when one of their surviving dice reaches the opponent's base row. A player also wins if all opposing dice are removed. If both players lose all their dice, the game is a draw.

Blocked and repeated positions:
The original leaflet does not specify the following cases, so this digital edition handles them as follows:
· You may pass only if you have no legal moves. Two consecutive passes end the game, with scores determined by the upward-facing values of dice already in the opposite base row.
· If the same positions, complete die orientations and player to move occur three times, the game is a draw.
· Simultaneous surrounds in Dittle Clash are resolved using the procedure in the previous section.

zh.name: 画物语
zh.desc: 用一句线索讲述梦境，在众多画面中找到说书人的牌
zh.rules:
目标：
某轮结束时有人达到 30 分，游戏结束，总分最高者获胜，并列者共同获胜。
准备：
使用基础版 84 张图画牌，支持 3 至 8 人。每人获得 6 张手牌；3 人局每人 7 张。第一位想好线索并出牌的玩家担任首轮说书人，此后顺时针轮换。
讲述：
说书人从手牌中暗置 1 张，给出与画面有关的词语、句子或其他线索。在线对局中输入文字；口头或声音线索也须在输入框中留下便于辨认的说明。
选牌：
其他玩家各从手牌暗置 1 张与线索相符的牌。3 人局中，每位其他玩家暗置 2 张不同的牌。
猜牌：
所有暗置牌混洗后公开并编号。除说书人外，每人秘密投票选择 1 张自己认为属于说书人的牌，不得投给自己提交的牌。全部投票完成后揭晓。
计分：
根据本轮猜牌结果，按以下方式计分：
· 所有人都猜中或所有人都猜错时，说书人获得0分，其他玩家各获得2分。
· 其他情况下，说书人与猜中的玩家各获得3分，猜错的玩家获得0分。
此外，每位非说书人玩家提交的牌每获得1票，该玩家额外获得1分。
换轮：
逐张结算完成后，每位玩家确认继续。所有玩家确认后，未达到结束条件时，本轮牌进入弃牌堆，每人补回 6 张手牌（3 人局补回 7 张）。牌库不足以为所有玩家补牌时，将剩余牌库与弃牌堆混洗后再补牌。牌库耗尽本身不会结束游戏。
机器人：
普通机器人通过固定的中英文画面词汇联想线索、选牌和猜牌，适合具体词语；它无法可靠理解任意隐喻、典故或声音。弱机器人随机选牌与猜牌。

en.name: Dixit
en.desc: Tell a dream in a clue, then discover the storyteller’s card
en.rules:
Goal: when someone reaches 30 points at the end of a round, the game ends. The highest score wins; tied players share victory.
Setup: 84 base-game picture cards, for 3–8 players. Deal 6 cards each, or 7 each with 3 players. The first player to submit a card and clue becomes the first storyteller; the role then passes clockwise.
Tell a story: the storyteller secretly chooses 1 card and gives a related word, sentence or other clue. Enter text online; leave an identifiable text label for a spoken or sound clue.
Submit: each other player secretly chooses 1 card matching the clue. With 3 players, each other player chooses 2 different cards.
Vote: shuffle the submitted cards and display them with numbers. Every player except the storyteller secretly votes for the card they believe belongs to the storyteller. You cannot vote for your own card. Reveal after everyone votes.
Score:
· If everyone or nobody guesses correctly, the storyteller scores 0 points and every other player scores 2 points.
· In every other case, the storyteller and each correct voter score 3 points, while incorrect voters score 0 points.
Additionally, each non-storyteller scores 1 point per vote attracted by their submitted cards.
Next round: after the cards are scored one by one, every player confirms they are ready. Once everyone has confirmed, unless the game has ended, discard the displayed cards and refill everyone to 6 cards (7 with 3 players). If the draw pile cannot refill every hand, shuffle its remainder together with the discard pile before drawing. Running out of cards does not end the game.
Bots: normal bots use a fixed bilingual vocabulary of visible objects to select clues, decoys and votes. They cannot reliably understand arbitrary metaphors, cultural references or sounds. Weak bots submit and vote randomly.

search.py: hua wu yu miao yu shuo shu ren zhi yan pian yu

zh.name: 亡者神抽
zh.desc: 海盗赌运:翻牌进河道攒花色能力,爆掉之前见好就收
zh.rules:
游戏目标:
抽牌堆耗尽后，完成当前回合，再计算各位玩家银行中卡牌的分数。总分最高的玩家获胜。

游戏准备:
· 游戏共有60张卡牌，分为10种花色，每种花色各有6张。美人鱼的牌面点数为4至9，其他花色的牌面点数为2至7。
· 将每种花色中点数最低的一张牌正面朝上放入弃牌堆，再将其余卡牌洗混，组成抽牌堆。
· 每位玩家从发给自己的两张特性卡中选择一张。所选特性在整局游戏中持续生效。

回合流程:
轮到你时，从抽牌堆顶逐张翻开卡牌，放入称为“河道”的本回合公共区域。根据翻出的花色，按以下方式处理：
· 如果河道中尚未出现该花色，立即发动该花色的能力；具体效果见下方图鉴。
· 如果河道中已有该花色，本回合立即失败。弃置河道中的卡牌，然后结束回合；船锚能够保护在它之前进入河道的卡牌，使这些牌仍可存入你的银行。
· 如果没有能力要求你继续翻牌，你可以选择收手，将河道中的全部卡牌存入自己的银行，并结束回合。

最终计分:
· 对每一种花色，只计算你的银行中该花色点数最高的一张卡牌，合计这些卡牌的点数，得到总分。
· 总分相同时，银行中卡牌数量较多的玩家获胜；卡牌数量也相同时，共享胜利。

en.name: Dead Man's Draw
en.desc: Pirate push-your-luck: flip loot, chain suit powers, bank before you bust
en.rules:
Objective:
When the draw pile is empty, finish the current turn and calculate the value of the cards in each player's bank. The player with the highest total score wins.

Setup:
· The game contains 60 cards in 10 suits, with 6 cards in each suit. Mermaid cards have values from 4 to 9; cards in every other suit have values from 2 to 7.
· Place the lowest card of each suit face-up in the discard pile. Shuffle the remaining cards to form the draw pile.
· Each player chooses one of the two trait cards dealt to them. Their chosen trait remains in effect throughout the game.

Taking a turn:
On your turn, reveal cards from the top of the draw pile one at a time and place them in the river, the shared play area for the current turn. Resolve each card according to its suit:
· If its suit is not already present in the river, immediately resolve that suit's power. The reference below explains each power.
· If its suit is already present in the river, you bust and your turn ends. Discard the cards in the river, except that an Anchor protects cards that entered the river before it, allowing those cards to be added to your bank.
· If no power requires you to continue revealing cards, you may choose to stop. Add all cards in the river to your bank and end your turn.

Final scoring:
· For each suit, score only the highest-value card of that suit in your bank. Add the values of those cards to obtain your total score.
· If players have equal scores, the tied player with more cards in their bank wins. If the number of cards is also equal, those players share the victory.

zh.name: 反转王牌
zh.desc: 双端数字牌:压场、塞牌、整套反转,先出空手牌拿到字母标记
zh.rules:
目标:最先获得至少 4 个字母标记的玩家获胜。
牌与设置:
· 每张牌两端各有一个 1 到 10 的点数,有效点数朝上,无效点数朝下;旋转 180° 后两端互换。
· 按人数移除带设置标记的牌后,混洗全部牌并发完;持 ★ 牌的玩家开始本轮。
回合:先弃掉自己面前的牌组,再从四个行动中执行一个:
· 打出牌组:同点数的手牌任意张放到自己面前;桌上已有同规模牌组时,点数必须更大,被压的牌组旋转后回到主人手牌。
· 加牌:恰好一张加入对手面前的牌组,点数必须相同;加入后与桌上另一牌组同规模时,目标牌组点数必须更大。
· 拿取:拿走一位对手面前的整套牌组,每张旋转后加入自己手牌。
· 旋转:自己全部手牌翻转,有效与无效点数互换。
轮末:首位将手牌全部打出的玩家获得 2 个字母标记,该玩家的牌组继续留在场上一个完整的行动周期;第二位将手牌全部打出的玩家获得 1 个,本轮立即结束并重新洗牌发牌。
双人变体:每人两个游戏区,连续行动两回合;与自家另一区同规模且点数更低的牌组会弹回手牌;率先将手牌全部打出的玩家赢得本轮；率先赢得两轮的玩家获得游戏胜利。

en.name: Dnup
en.desc: Double-ended number cards: beat sets, sneak cards in, steal whole sets — empty your hand for letter tokens
en.rules:
Goal: the first player to collect at least 4 letter tokens wins.
Cards and setup:
· Each card has a value from 1 to 10 on both ends; the active value faces up, the inactive value faces down, and rotating a card 180° swaps them.
· After removing the marked setup cards for the player count, shuffle the whole deck and deal it all out; the player holding the ★ card starts the round.
Turn: first discard the set in front of you, then perform exactly one of four actions:
· Play a set: place any number of same-value cards in front of you; if a set of the same size is on the table, your value must be higher, and the beaten set rotates back into its owner's hand.
· Add: put exactly one card onto an opponent's set with a matching value; if it then matches another set's size, the target set's value must be higher.
· Take: take an opponent's whole set, rotating each card into your hand.
· Rotate: flip all your hand cards, swapping active and inactive values.
Round end: the first player to empty their hand gains 2 letter tokens and their set stays for one more turn cycle; the second gains 1 token and the round ends immediately with a full reshuffle and redealt hand.
Two-player variant: each player has two play areas and takes two consecutive turns; a set matching your other area's size with a lower value bounces back to your hand; emptying your hand wins the round, and the first to win two rounds wins the game.

zh.name: 优势物种
zh.desc: 规划动物的演化与扩张，在冰期到来前赢得优势。
zh.rules:
目标:
· 获得最多胜利分。最终平分时，食物链位置较高者获胜。
准备:
· 2–6 人各控制一种动物，按人数获得行动棋与物种。
· 地图中央为苔原，周围放置六种地形及初始元素。
· 公开 5 张支配牌，冰期牌位于牌库底部。
流程:
· 规划阶段按先攻顺序轮流放置 1 枚行动棋，直到全部放完。
· 执行阶段依次进行先攻、适应、退化、丰饶、荒芜、耗竭、冰川化、物种形成、探索、迁徙、竞争与统治。

· 行动棋通常在执行时收回，可以放弃该次行动。
· 冰川化每轮只执行最左侧行动棋，其余棋在重置时前移。
· 动物的默认元素不能移除；包括默认元素在内最多 6 个。
· 退化按元素类型移除新增元素，行动棋可保护元素。
· 荒芜会移除苔原上与荒芜区相同类型的所有元素。
· 元素放在地块顶点，最多同时影响相接的 3 块地形。
· 物种形成围绕指定元素增加物种，数量上限随地形变化。
· 探索放置新地形后，各动物按食物链顺序决定是否迁入。
· 迁徙每个物种只移动一次；鸟类可经过地形移动至两格内。
· 竞争可在指定的每种地形各选一块，消灭 1 个对方物种。
· 冰川化每种动物只保留 1 个物种，其余返回各自基因库。
· 其他消灭通常永久移出游戏，冬眠牌可以取回已移除物种。
统治与支配:
· 统治选择本轮尚未计分的地块，按物种数量排名计分。
· 数量平手时，按哺乳、爬行、鸟、两栖、蛛形、昆虫排序。
· 元素匹配数为动物每个元素与该地块同类元素的匹配总和。
· 地块上有物种且匹配数唯一最高的动物拥有支配权。
· 匹配数为零或最高匹配数平手时，无动物支配该地块。
· 本版本自动计算并更新支配权，无需手动认领。
· 地块计分后，支配者必须选择并尽可能完整执行一张公开牌。
· 支配者可能与发起计分者、物种数量最多者不同。
重置与结束:
· 灭绝移除元素匹配数为零的物种，应用动物与卡牌例外。
· 苔原物种总数唯一最多者持有生存牌；平手时无人持有。
· 持有者按自己占据的苔原地块数获得奖励分。
· 随后补充卡牌、移动元素与冰川化行动棋，开始下一轮。
· 冰期牌按各动物支配的地块数奖励计分，并标记最后一轮。
· 完成剩余统治、灭绝和生存计分，再对全部地块最终计分。
· 最终计分不再触发支配牌。奖励分按数量的三角数计算。

en.name: Dominant Species
en.desc: Plan evolution and expansion as the ice age approaches.
en.rules:
Goal:
· Earn the most VPs; food chain order breaks the final tie.
Setup:
· Each of 2–6 players controls one animal with pieces scaled to player count.
· Start with central tundra, six surrounding terrains and fixed elements.
· Reveal 5 Dominance cards; Ice Age starts at the bottom of the deck.
Play:
· In initiative order, place one available AP at a time until all are placed.
· Resolve Initiative, Adaptation, Regression, Abundance, Wasteland, Depletion, Glaciation, Speciation, Wanderlust, Migration, Competition and Domination.

· Usually retrieve each AP when acting; you may forfeit its action.
· Only the leftmost Glaciation AP acts; the others advance during reset.
· Printed elements cannot be lost; an animal may have at most 6 elements.
· Regression removes added elements by type; APs can protect them.
· Wasteland removes matching element types from every tundra tile.
· An element occupies a corner shared by up to 3 terrain tiles.
· Speciate around the indicated element, subject to terrain limits.
· After Wanderlust, animals may move into the new tile in food chain order.
· Each species migrates once per action; birds may travel through 2 tiles.
· Compete on up to one tile per allowed terrain, removing one opposing species.
· Glaciation keeps one species per animal and returns the rest to gene pools.
· Other eliminations are usually permanent; Hibernation can recover them.
Domination and dominance:
· Choose an unscored tile this turn and award VPs by species count.
· Count ties favor mammal, reptile, bird, amphibian, arachnid, then insect.
· Sum the matches for every element on the animal against the tile elements.
· With species present, a unique highest match count gives dominance.
· Zero matches or a tie for the highest count means no dominant animal.
· This version automatically updates dominance; no manual claims are needed.
· After scoring, the dominant animal must choose and resolve an available card.
· That animal may differ from the scoring player and from the most numerous.
Reset and end:
· Extinction removes species with no matching elements, subject to exceptions.
· The unique most species across tundra tiles wins Survival; a tie gives none.
· Its holder earns bonus VPs for the number of tundra tiles they occupy.
· Refill cards, shift elements and Glaciation APs, then begin a new turn.
· Ice Age gives bonus VPs for tiles each animal dominates and marks the last turn.
· Finish Domination, Extinction and Survival, then score every tile once more.
· Final scoring grants no cards. Bonus VPs follow the triangular number track.

zh.name: 领土（皇舆争霸）
zh.desc: 从十张起始牌出发，构筑你的王国。2008 年基础版，25 种王国牌。
zh.rules:
目标：
通过购买与获得卡牌构筑自己的牌库。游戏结束时，将手牌、牌库、弃牌堆和场上所有属于自己的牌合并计分。庄园为 1 分，公国为 3 分，行省为 6 分，诅咒为负 1 分；每张花园的分数等于自己的总牌数除以 10 后向下取整。
准备：
本游戏采用 2008 年官方基础版，包含全部 25 种王国牌，每局使用 10 种。可选官方推荐组合、随机组合，或自选恰好 10 种。每人从 7 张铜币和 3 张庄园开始，洗牌后抽 5 张手牌；随机决定先手，依次轮流行动。
铜币共 60 张，起始牌从中取出；银币 40 张，金币 30 张。两人局的庄园、公国、行省和花园供应堆各 8 张，三至四人局各 12 张，起始庄园另计。其余王国牌每堆 10 张。诅咒在两、三、四人局分别为 10、20、30 张。
流程：
每回合依次进行行动、购买与清理。开始时拥有 1 次行动和 1 次购买。行动阶段可打出一张行动牌，按牌面完整结算；牌面增加的行动次数可用于继续出牌。必须完成当前牌的全部效果，才能打出另一张牌。也可直接结束行动阶段。
购买阶段可打出任意财宝牌：铜币提供 1 金钱，银币提供 2 金钱，金币提供 3 金钱。金钱也可来自行动牌。每买一张供应牌，支付其费用并消耗 1 次购买，将该牌放入自己的弃牌堆。获得牌与购买牌不同：获得牌不花费金钱或购买次数，但必须遵守该效果的费用及类型限制。未用的金钱、行动与购买不保留到下回合。
结束回合时，将已打出的牌与剩余手牌放入自己的弃牌堆，可选择最后放到弃牌堆顶的牌，再抽 5 张牌。需要抽牌或揭示牌而牌库不足时，先取完现有牌库，再洗混弃牌堆形成新牌库；不要提前洗牌。移除的牌进入公共垃圾区，不回到供应堆。
卡牌与攻击：
点击供应牌或手牌上的详情可查看完整效果。民兵、官员、间谍、小偷与女巫属于攻击牌；其他玩家可从手牌展示护城河，选择不受本次攻击影响。未受保护的玩家依次结算，不能代替其他玩家决定弃牌或选择。议事厅让其他玩家抽牌，不属于攻击。
· 地窖先一次性弃掉所选手牌，再抽同样数量。
· 礼拜堂可移除至多 4 张手牌。
· 重建移除一张手牌，获得费用至多高 2 的供应牌。
· 矿坑移除一张财宝牌，获得1张财宝牌并加入手牌，其费用最多比被移除的财宝牌高3枚金币。
· 钱庄移除一张手牌中的铜币，提供 3 金钱；没有铜币则不提供金钱。
· 王座从手牌选择另一张行动牌，完整执行两次，不消耗额外行动；王座作用于王座时，依次选择两张牌各执行两次。
· 盛宴移除自身后获得费用至多 5 的牌；被王座重复执行时，即使自身已移除，第二次仍可获得牌。
· 图书馆抽至 7 张手牌，途中抽到的行动牌可以暂置；暂置牌在图书馆结算完毕后才弃掉。
· 冒险者逐张揭示直到找到 2 张财宝牌，将财宝加入手牌，最后弃掉其他揭示牌；若已无牌可取，则取得能找到的财宝。
· 间谍在抽牌后让自己及每名未受保护的对手揭示牌库顶牌，由打出间谍者决定弃掉或放回。
· 小偷让每名未受保护的对手揭示 2 张牌；若其中有财宝，由攻击者选择 1 张移除，其他揭示牌弃掉；所有对手结算后，攻击者可获得任意张本次移除的财宝。
结束与计分：
任一玩家回合结束时，若行省供应堆已空，或任意 3 个供应堆已空，立即结束游戏。总分最高者获胜；同分时，进行回合较少者获胜；分数和回合数均相同则共同获胜。

en.name: Dominion
en.desc: Build a kingdom from ten starting cards. Complete 2008 base game with 25 Kingdom cards.
en.rules:
Goal:
Build your own deck by buying and gaining cards. At game end, combine all your cards from your hand, deck, discard pile and play area. Estates score 1 VP, Duchies 3 VP, Provinces 6 VP and Curses −1 VP. Each Gardens scores 1 VP per 10 cards you own, rounded down.
Setup:
This implementation uses the official 2008 base edition, with all 25 Kingdom cards. Each game uses 10 types. Choose a recommended set, a random set, or exactly 10 custom types. Everyone starts with 7 Coppers and 3 Estates, shuffled, and draws 5 cards. The first player is chosen randomly; play proceeds in seating order.
There are 60 Coppers in total, including starting cards, 40 Silvers and 30 Golds. Estate, Duchy, Province and Gardens Supply piles contain 8 cards with 2 players or 12 with 3–4 players; starting Estates are additional. Other Kingdom piles contain 10 cards. Use 10, 20 or 30 Curses with 2, 3 or 4 players respectively.
Turn:
Each turn has Action, Buy and Clean-up phases. Start with 1 Action and 1 Buy. You may play an Action card and follow all its instructions. Additional Actions granted by cards allow further plays, after the current card has fully resolved. You may also end your Action phase.
In the Buy phase, you may play Treasure cards: Copper provides $1, Silver $2 and Gold $3. Add coins from Action cards. Pay a Supply card's cost and spend 1 Buy to place it in your discard pile. Gaining is different from buying: it spends neither coins nor Buys, but must follow the effect's cost and type limits. Unused coins, Actions and Buys do not carry over.
To end your turn, discard your played cards and remaining hand in any order, choosing which card goes on top, then draw 5 cards. When drawing or revealing from an insufficient deck, take existing cards first, then shuffle your discard pile into a new deck and continue. Never shuffle early. Trashed cards go to the shared Trash, not back to the Supply.
Cards and attacks:
Use a card's details control to read its full text. Militia, Bureaucrat, Spy, Thief and Witch are Attacks. Other players may reveal a Moat from their hand to be unaffected by that Attack. Resolve affected players in turn order, allowing each player to make their own required choices. Council Room is not an Attack.
· Cellar discards all chosen cards before drawing replacements.
· Chapel trashes up to 4 cards.
· Remodel trashes a hand card to gain a Supply card costing up to $2 more.
· Mine trashes a Treasure from hand to gain a Treasure costing up to $3 more into hand.
· Moneylender trashes a Copper from hand for $3; without a Copper it provides no coins.
· Throne Room chooses another Action from hand and fully plays it twice without spending additional Actions. A Throne Room played by a Throne Room chooses two cards in succession and plays each twice.
· Feast trashes itself and gains a card costing up to $5; when played twice, it gains another card even though Feast has already been trashed.
· Library draws until you have 7 cards. Action cards drawn may be set aside and are discarded only after Library finishes.
· Adventurer reveals until it finds 2 Treasures, putting those into hand and discarding other revealed cards afterwards; if cards run out, take all Treasures found.
· Spy draws first, then makes you and each unprotected opponent reveal their top card. The Spy player chooses to discard or return each one.
· Thief makes each unprotected opponent reveal 2 cards; the attacker chooses 1 revealed Treasure to trash if possible, and the rest are discarded. After all opponents resolve, the attacker may gain any of the Treasures just trashed.
End and scoring:
The game ends at the end of a player's turn if the Province Supply pile is empty or any 3 Supply piles are empty. Highest VP wins. Ties go to the player with fewer turns; equal points and turns produce a shared victory.
