zh.name: 魔戒同盟
zh.desc: 合作吃墩:扮演远征队角色,各自达成目标护送魔戒
zh.rules:
目标:全队通过牌墩合作,每名角色完成自己的目标;全部达成则章节胜利,任一目标失败则全队失败,可重试。
牌:
· 丘陵、山脉、暗影和森林四种花色各有数字1至8的牌，魔戒花色有数字1至5的牌。
· 必须跟花色;领出花色中点数最大者赢墩。
· 魔戒不是将牌:魔戒花色被打破前不能领出(手上只剩魔戒牌除外);任何人打出魔戒牌后即告打破。
· 至尊戒（魔戒花色的1号牌）:打出时可声明赢下本墩,无视花色与点数。
流程:
· 拿到至尊戒的玩家是持戒者,自动扮演弗罗多并领出第一墩。
· 其余玩家从持戒者左手边依次选择角色,带星标的角色必须全部有人扮演。
· 部分角色有准备动作:抽威胁牌、与其他角色交换手牌等。
章节:
· 短章节只进行一轮。长章节进行多轮，并保留已经完成目标的角色进度；全部角色完成各自目标后，章节成功。

en.name: Fellowship of the Ring
en.desc: Co-op trick-taking: play fellowship characters and fulfil every goal
en.rules:
Goal: cooperate through tricks — every character must complete their own goal; all goals met wins the chapter, any single failure loses the round (retry allowed).
Cards:
· Hills, Mountains, Shadows and Forests of 1–8, plus Rings 1–5.
· You must follow suit; the highest card of the led suit wins the trick.
· Rings are not trump: they cannot be led until the ring suit is broken (someone has played a ring), unless you hold only rings.
· The One Ring (Ring 1): when played, you may declare it to win any trick.
Flow:
· The player dealt the One Ring is the ring-bearer, plays Frodo and leads the first trick.
· Starting to the ring-bearer’s left, players pick characters in turn; every starred character must be picked.
· Some characters have setup steps: drawing threat cards, exchanging cards with others, and so on.
Chapters:
· Short chapters last one round; long chapters run several rounds and keep completed characters — finish them all to clear the chapter.

zh.name: 绝命少女:恐怖快乐小径
zh.desc: 单人恐怖生存:扮演最后的少女,救出营员并反杀屠夫
zh.rules:
目标:扮演最后的少女,救出营员并杀死屠夫汉斯;少女死亡则失败。
准备:屠夫与受害者按设置卡落位;你获得 6 张费用为0的行动卡作为起始手牌。
回合流程:
· 行动:打出行动卡并掷骰判定;每移动1格消耗1点时间。
· 计划:用剩余时间购买新行动卡,然后时间重置为 6 点。
· 杀手:屠夫锁定最近的目标、移动并攻击,再抽 1 张恐怖卡。
· 恐慌:本回合有受害者死亡时,杀手所在格的受害者掷骰逃跑。
· 维护:恐怖卡组抽空后揭示终章卡;可以自由调整手持物品。
掷骰：掷出5点或6点时，获得1次成功。掷出3点或4点时，可以弃置2张手牌，将该颗骰子的结果改为1次成功。
救人:少女在出口格可救出同格的受害者;所有救援奖励格均完成后，解锁终极能力。

en.name: Final Girl: Camp Happy Trails
en.desc: Solo horror survival: play the final girl, save the campers and slay the butcher
en.rules:
Goal: play the final girl, rescue campers and slay Hans the butcher; if the girl dies, you lose.
Setup: the killer and victims are placed by a setup card; you start with 6 zero-cost action cards.
Each round:
· Action: play action cards and roll to resolve them; walking costs 1 time per space.
· Planning: spend remaining time on new action cards, then time resets to 6.
· Killer: the butcher targets the closest victim or you, moves, attacks, then draws a terror card.
· Panic: if a victim died this turn, victims on the killer space roll to flee.
· Upkeep: reveal the finale once the terror deck runs out; rearrange held items freely.
Dice: 5 and 6 are successes; 3 and 4 can be converted by discarding 2 cards.
Rescue: on an exit space you may save victims with you; fill all reward slots to unlock the ultimate.

zh.name: 终极角斗场
zh.desc: 百位传说泰坦的骰子对决:选秀组队、暗置升级,一路守擂到最后
zh.rules:
游戏目标：
每人组建一支泰坦队伍，派出泰坦进行一对一战斗。失去全部泰坦的玩家被淘汰，最后留在游戏中的玩家获胜。
组建队伍：
· 从公开的 3 名候选泰坦中轮流招募，每次选择 1 名，随后补充候选。每人招募 3 名泰坦，放在自己的板凳上。
· 每人获得升级卡：两人局 5 张，三至五人局 4 张。
· 组队完成后，结算泰坦的“游戏开始时”能力。有目标需要选择时，按提示完成选择。
每场战斗的流程：
决定参战 → 准备升级 → 轮流战斗 → 结算胜负，然后开始下一场。
1. 决定参战：
轮到你时，选择以下一项：
· 参战：派出 1 名可用泰坦，并收回自己此前扣置的全部升级卡。场上第一名泰坦成为冠军，第二名成为挑战者。
· 跳过：从手牌扣置 1 张升级卡，本场不参战。该卡暂时不能使用，直到你之后参战时收回。
没有升级卡可扣置时，必须参战。若剩余可参战玩家必须全部上场才能凑齐两名参战者，也必须参战。
已有冠军留场时，只需选出一名挑战者；冠军无需再次决定是否参战。
2. 准备升级：
· 两名参战者分别选择任意数量的升级卡，也可以不打出。
· 双方确认准备后，同时揭示所选升级卡，结算揭示效果及“战斗开始时”能力。
· 升级卡通常只在本场战斗中生效，战斗结束后弃置。
· 速度较高的泰坦先行动；速度相同时，挑战者先行动。
3. 轮流战斗：
· 双方轮流进行回合。自己的回合开始时，先结算毒素、火焰和相关能力。
· 每回合通常行动 1 次，每枚行动标记再增加 1 次。一次行动通常是掷骰，并结算泰坦攻击表中对应骰面的效果。
· 额外行动必须用完，之后才轮到对手。需要选择骰子、能力或目标时，由提示指定的玩家完成选择。
骰面与终极技：
· 蓝、绿、黄、红：查看该泰坦攻击表中同色一栏，结算伤害和附加效果。同一种颜色对不同泰坦可能有不同作用。
· Charge（充能）：充能标记为灰暗面时，翻到彩色面，并立即再行动 1 次；已是彩色面时，发动终极技，再翻回灰暗面。这次不会因 Charge 额外获得行动。
· Miss（未命中）：通常没有效果，但仍可能触发卡牌上与 Miss 有关的能力。
· 终极形态：部分终极技会解锁强化能力，其效果见角色详情。终极形态与充能状态分别保留和变化。
伤害与常用效果：
· 力量：每枚使该泰坦每次造成的伤害增加 1 点；不会让原本不造成伤害的效果变成伤害。
· 护甲：每次受到伤害时，减少等同于护甲值的伤害，最低为 0。每枚护甲标记使护甲值增加 1。
· 闪避：将受到伤害时，必须消耗 1 枚，挡下本次全部伤害。
· 随从：只有当单次伤害足以击败自己时，才必须消耗 1 枚，挡下本次全部伤害。
· 毒素：自己的回合开始时，每枚造成 1 点伤害。
· 火焰：自己的回合开始时，每枚造成 1 点伤害，然后再增加 1 枚火焰标记。战斗结束后移除火焰。
· 毒素和火焰的伤害不受护甲、闪避或随从保护。
· 治疗：回复生命，不能超过生命上限。
· 吸血：按对手实际失去的生命回复自己的生命。
· 直接击败：使目标立即被击败，护甲、闪避和随从无法阻止。
祝福与诅咒：
· 持有祝福时，每次行动掷 2 枚骰，由自己选择其中 1 枚结算。
· 持有诅咒时，同样掷 2 枚骰，但由对手选择。
· 掷出相同骰面时，只结算一次，然后失去该标记。
· 同一种标记不能叠加。已持有其中一种时，再获得另一种，会抵消原有标记。
战斗结束与下一场：
· 击败对手的泰坦后，胜者抽 1 张升级卡，并以冠军身份留场。
· 冠军保留当前生命，不会自动回满；通常保留其他状态标记和终极形态，但移除火焰、弃置本场升级卡，并将充能翻回灰暗面。
· 双方同时被击败时，都没有胜利奖励，下一场重新选出两名参战者。
· 没有任何可用泰坦的玩家被淘汰，直到只剩一名玩家。
特殊能力：
卡牌有特殊说明时，以卡牌效果为准。“团队力量”在该泰坦位于场上或板凳时均可生效，具体作用见角色详情。

en.name: Final Titan
en.desc: A dice-rolling duel of a hundred legendary titans: draft your roster, set secret upgrades, and hold the belt
en.rules:
Goal:
Build a team of Titans and send them into one-on-one fights. A player who loses all their Titans is eliminated. The last player remaining wins.
Build your team:
· Take turns recruiting from 3 face-up candidates. Choose 1 Titan, then refill the candidates. Each player recruits 3 Titans and places them on their bench.
· Each player receives upgrade cards: 5 in a two-player game, or 4 with three to five players.
· After recruitment, resolve the Titans’ “Start of Game” abilities. Follow the prompts whenever an ability requires a target.
Fight overview:
Fight or skip → Prepare upgrades → Take turns → Resolve the result, then begin the next fight.
1. Fight or skip:
On your turn, choose one of these options:
· Fight: Send in 1 available Titan and take back all upgrade cards you previously set aside. The first Titan in the arena becomes the Champion; the second becomes the Challenger.
· Skip: Set aside 1 upgrade card from your hand face down and sit out this fight. That card is unavailable until you enter a later fight and take it back.
You must fight if you have no upgrade card to set aside. You must also fight if every remaining eligible player is needed to fill the two places in the arena.
If a Champion is already in the arena, only a Challenger needs to be chosen. The Champion does not choose whether to fight again.
2. Prepare upgrades:
· Both fighters choose any number of upgrade cards, including none.
· Once both confirm they are ready, reveal their chosen upgrades together. Resolve “When Revealed” effects and “Start of Fight” abilities.
· Upgrades normally last for this fight only and are discarded when it ends.
· The Titan with higher Speed takes the first turn. If tied, the Challenger goes first.
3. Take turns:
· Alternate taking turns. At the start of your turn, resolve Poison, Fire, and relevant abilities.
· You normally take 1 Action per turn, plus 1 for each Action token. An Action usually means rolling the die and resolving the matching entry on your Titan’s attack chart.
· You must use all available Actions before passing the turn. Whenever a die, ability, or target must be chosen, the player named in the prompt makes that choice.
Die and Ultimate:
· Blue, green, yellow, red: Find the matching color on your Titan’s attack chart and resolve its damage and additional effects. The same color can have different effects for different Titans.
· Charge: If your Charge token is gray, flip it to colored and immediately take 1 more Action. If it is already colored, use your Ultimate, then flip it back to gray. This second Charge does not grant an extra Action.
· Miss: Normally has no effect, but may still trigger card abilities that refer to a Miss.
· Ultimate Form: Some Ultimates unlock a stronger ability, described in Titan details. Ultimate Form and Charge are separate states.
Damage and effects:
· Power: Each token adds 1 to each instance of damage your Titan deals. It does not make an effect deal damage if it originally deals none.
· Armor: Reduce each instance of incoming damage by your Armor value, to a minimum of 0. Each Armor token increases that value by 1.
· Dodge: When you would take damage, you must spend 1 token to prevent all damage from that instance.
· Minion: Only when a single instance of damage would defeat you, you must spend 1 token to prevent all damage from that instance.
· Poison: At the start of your turn, take 1 damage per token.
· Fire: At the start of your turn, take 1 damage per token, then gain 1 more Fire token. Remove Fire when the fight ends.
· Armor, Dodge, and Minions do not protect against Poison or Fire damage.
· Heal: Restore life without exceeding your maximum.
· Drain: Heal yourself by the amount of life the foe actually loses.
· Defeat: Immediately defeat the target. Armor, Dodge, and Minions cannot prevent this effect.
Blessed and Cursed:
· With a Blessed token, roll 2 dice for each Action and choose 1 to resolve.
· With a Cursed token, also roll 2 dice, but the foe chooses which one resolves.
· If both dice show the same face, resolve it once, then lose the token.
· These tokens do not stack. If you have one type and would gain the other, lose the existing token instead.
After the fight:
· Defeat the foe’s Titan to win. Draw 1 upgrade card and stay in the arena as the Champion.
· Keep your current life; you do not automatically heal to full. Normally keep your other status tokens and Ultimate Form, but remove Fire, discard this fight’s upgrades, and flip Charge back to gray.
· If both Titans are defeated at the same time, neither player gains a victory reward. Choose two new fighters for the next fight.
· A player with no Titans remaining is eliminated. Continue until only one player remains.
Special abilities:
Specific card effects take precedence over the general rules. A Titan’s Team Power can apply while that Titan is in the arena or on the bench; see Titan details for its effect.

zh.name: 萌鼠摘月
zh.desc: 垃圾场小鼠造火箭:跑图采集攒建材,灯串鼠洞滚雪球,把四只鼠送上奶酪月亮
zh.rules:
目标：在火箭完工前获得最多分数。当一名玩家的第4只老鼠进入火箭时，触发终局；完成本轮后结束游戏。
另一种终局触发方式是，有玩家放置第8个计分标记；此时完成本轮后，再进行完整一轮。
回合流程:
· 移动二选一:一只老鼠前进一至五格;或二至四只老鼠各前进一至三格,全部停在同色的不同格。
· 只能朝火箭方向走;自己的老鼠不能同格,起点除外。
· 停在有其他玩家老鼠的格子时，需要向该格中每位其他玩家支付1份奶酪。
· 无法足额支付时，按差额领取霉奶酪；每领取1份霉奶酪，立即获得3份奶酪，并在终局扣除2分。
· 管道捷径:从入口格出发交出管身所示建材,一步直达出口格。
采集：本回合移动过的老鼠，分别获得其停留格的产出。
· 黄格获得奶酪,白格获得苹果核,蓝格获得灯泡,绿橙格获得所示建材。
· 采集数量为格面数字再加灯串加成。
· 灯泡驱动灯串标记前进;标记每到达或越过一盏灯泡,该灯泡对应的路径格，此后的每次采集增加1份产出,可叠加。
· 每越过一盏建筑灯,按建筑灯计分轨计分1次。
· 苹果核驱动鼠洞标记顺时针走;到岔口选向上或向左。
· 图书馆：经过时免费获得1本漫画。
· 育儿室：经过时养育1只新老鼠，每局最多两次。
· 储食处：经过时按储食计分轨计分1次。
购物：本回合停在摊位格的老鼠，可以购买该商店的一件物品。
· 仓鼠商店：支付6份奶酪，购买1个背包。
· 青蛙商店：支付7份奶酪，购买1瓶能量饮料。
· 疯鸦商店：支付12份奶酪，购买1个瓶盖。
也可以免费偷取一件物品，但该老鼠必须回到起点。
· 建造座舱：支付2个计算器和1个铁罐。
· 建造货舱：支付3份苏打和2个铁罐。
· 建造推进器：支付5个醋瓶和2份苏打。
每次建造完成后，均按对应的计分轨计分。
· 每集齐座舱、货舱和推进器各1件，按完整火箭计分轨计分1次。
· 每捐赠10份奶酪，按补给计分轨计分1次。
上述计分次数不限。
发射台：老鼠到达后成为宇航员，占据宇航员轨最左侧的空格，并选择以下一项奖励：
· 获得一枚奖章，终局计3分。
· 从育儿室养育一只新老鼠，将其放到起点。
若它不是自己第4只进入火箭的老鼠，且之后场上已没有自己的可移动老鼠，则必须选择养育新老鼠。
物品:背包与漫画均从下个回合起生效。能量饮料在采集时使用,当次采集总量翻倍,每回合限一瓶。
瓶盖为终局加分。
计分：
· 合计八条计分轨的分数。
· 加上瓶盖的分数。
· 每枚奖章获得3分。
· 每份霉奶酪扣除2分。
· 剩余建材与奶酪合计，每满4份获得1分。
总分相同时，宇航员数量较多的玩家获胜；若仍然相同，则共享胜利。

en.name: First Rat
en.desc: Junkyard rats build a rocket: race, collect, light up the string, and fly four rats to the Cheese Moon
en.rules:
Goal: score the most before the rocket is done. The end is triggered when a player moves their fourth rat into the rocket; finish the current round.
Alternatively, when a player places their eighth score marker, finish the round and then play one more.
Each turn:
· Move, one of: advance one rat one to five spaces; or advance two to four rats one to three spaces each, all ending on different spaces of one color.
· Always move towards the rocket; your own rats may not share a space, except at Start.
· Ending on a space with other players' rats costs you one Cheese per player there.
· If you cannot pay, take Moldy Cheese for the shortfall: each gives three Cheese now, minus two points at the end.
· Pipes: from a pipe's entry space, hand in the depicted material to jump to its exit as a single step.
Collection: each rat moved this turn gains the resources produced by its destination space.
· Yellow gives Cheese, white Apple Cores, blue Lightbulbs, green and orange the depicted building material.
· The amount is the printed number plus the light string bonus.
· Lightbulbs advance your light string marker; every bulb it reaches or passes gives its path space a plus-one yield from now on, stacking.
· Passing each of the three construction lights scores the Construction Lights track once.
· Apple Cores advance your burrow marker clockwise; at each fork choose up or left.
· Library: passing it grants a free comic.
· Nursery: passing it raises one new rat, at most twice per game.
· Stored Food: passing it scores its track.
· Shopping: a rat that ended this turn on a booth space may buy one item.
· Hamster booth: pay six Cheese to buy a Backpack.
· Frog booth: pay seven Cheese to buy an Energy Drink.
· Crow booth: pay twelve Cheese to buy a Bottle Cap.
· Or steal one item for free, but that rat returns to Start.
Build rocket parts by paying their material costs:
· Pay two Calculators and one Tin Can to build a Cockpit.
· Pay three Soda and two Tin Cans to build a Cargo Bay.
· Pay five Vinegar and two Soda to build a Thruster.
Each build scores its matching track. Each full set containing all three parts also scores the Rocket track. For every ten Cheese you donate, score the Provisions track once. These scoring actions may be repeated without a limit.
Launchpad: an arriving rat becomes a Rattronaut and takes the leftmost free space on its track. Then choose one reward:
· Gain one Award worth three points at game end.
· Raise one new rat from the Nursery and place it at Start.
If this is not your fourth rat in the rocket and you would have no movable rats left in play, you must raise a new rat.
Items: Backpacks and Comics take effect from your next turn. An Energy Drink doubles one collection, at most one per turn.
Bottle Caps score at the end.
Scoring:
· Add the points from the eight tracks.
· Add Bottle Cap points.
· Score three points per Award.
· Subtract two points per Moldy Cheese.
· Score one point per four leftover building materials and Cheese combined.
Ties go to the most Rattronauts, then shared.

zh.name: 赤焰极速
zh.desc: 安排双车手的体力与尾流，在最后一公里发起冲刺。
zh.rules:
目标：
每位玩家控制一名全能车手和一名冲刺车手。任意车手越过终点线后，完成当轮全部移动、尾流及疲劳结算；冲过终点最远的车手所属玩家获胜。同格时，右车道的车手领先。每支车队按较靠前的车手排名。
准备：
· 选择一条赛道。六条推荐赛道来自基础版；自选赛道须使用 a 至 u 共 21 块板块各一次，以 a 开始、u 结束。大写字母表示另一面，红边是上坡，蓝边是下坡；I、J、S、T 的大写面仍为平路。数字化版图保留格序及地形，弯曲形状仅为展示。
· 每名车手拥有独立的 15 张能量牌。全能车手的数值为 3、4、5、6、7，冲刺车手为 2、3、4、5、9，每个数值各有 3 张。疲劳牌的数值为 2。可选让步设置会在开局时给所有车手各加入 1 或 2 张疲劳牌。
· 从首席开始，依座位顺序各自放置两名车手。每名车手必须位于起跑线前的 5 格之一。每格有两条车道；空格先占右车道，右车道有人时占左车道。
每轮选牌：
· 所有人同时行动。先选择一名尚未选牌的车手，抽取其牌堆顶的 4 张牌，点击一张牌，再确认暗置。其他 3 张牌放入该车手的回收区。随后才能为另一名车手重复此过程，不得提前查看另一名车手的牌。
· 抽牌堆耗尽时，洗混回收区，继续抽到 4 张；两区合计不足 4 张时，全部抽出。可以随时查看自己的回收区及本轮已选牌，不能查看暗牌堆或他人的暗牌。极端情况下无牌可抽的车手本轮不移动。
· 所有车手选牌完毕后，一起亮牌。已打出的能量牌和疲劳牌均只使用一次，然后移出游戏。
移动：
· 按移动开始前的车手位置从前到后依次行动，同格时右车道先行动。每名车手按牌值前进，可以穿过其他车手。
· 落点的两条车道均有人时，退到后方最近有空车道的格；空格必须先占右车道。换道不额外消耗步数。
· 如果车手起点、途中或落点在上坡，本次最多前进 5 格。如果第 6 步或之后才会进入上坡，则停在上坡前最近有空车道的格。
· 如果车手从下坡开始移动，本张牌至少提供 5 格移动；途中碰到上坡时，上坡限制仍然生效。
尾流和疲劳：
· 没有空格隔开的车手构成一个车群。从最后的车群开始，若它与前群之间恰好空出 1 格，后群整体前进 1 格并合并。合并后的车群可再次获得尾流，因此同轮可能多次前进。
· 上坡上的车手不能提供或接受尾流。处理尾流时，以这些车手为界分别检查前后的车手；同群中已到达平路或下坡的车手仍可获得尾流，上坡车手留在原位。前群最后一格在上坡时，不能为后群提供尾流。下坡照常处理。
· 尾流结束后，前方一格完全无人的每名车手各获得 1 张疲劳牌，放入自己的回收区。前方格仅有一条空车道时，不会因此获得疲劳牌。上坡上的车手照常获得疲劳。
结束：
完成整轮结算后检查终点。只要至少一名车手已经越线，就按前述胜利条件结束比赛；否则开始下一轮。终点后的道路延伸用于比较同轮冲线距离，不会提前停止其他车手。

en.name: Flamme Rouge
en.desc: Manage two riders, save energy in the slipstream, and sprint for the line.
en.rules:
Goal:
Control a Rouleur and a Sprinteur. When any rider crosses the finish, complete all movement, slipstreaming and exhaustion for that round. The team whose rider finishes furthest ahead wins; the right lane wins a same-square tie. Rank each team by its leading rider.
Setup:
· Choose one of the six base-game stages, or a custom sequence containing every tile a–u exactly once, starting with a and ending with u. Capitals select the reverse face. Red edges mark ascents and blue edges mark descents; capital I, J, S and T remain flat. The digital route preserves square order and terrain; its curves are presentational.
· Each rider has a separate 15-card energy deck. A Rouleur has three each of 3, 4, 5, 6 and 7; a Sprinteur has three each of 2, 3, 4, 5 and 9. Exhaustion cards have value 2. The optional handicap adds one or two exhaustion cards to every rider at setup.
· Starting with the first seat, each player places both riders in seat order. Choose any of the five squares behind the start line. A square has two lanes. Use the right lane in an empty square and the left lane when the right is occupied.
Energy phase:
· Everyone acts simultaneously. Choose one rider who has not selected a card, draw the top four cards, select one and confirm it face down. Recycle the other three. Only then repeat for your other rider; you cannot see the second hand before committing the first.
· When the draw deck runs out, shuffle recycled cards and keep drawing to four. If fewer than four remain in both piles, draw them all. You may inspect your own recycled and selected cards, never a hidden deck or an opponent’s hidden card. In the exceptional case of no cards remaining, that rider does not move this round.
· Reveal all selected cards together. Every played energy or exhaustion card is used once, then removed from the game.
Movement:
· Move riders from front to back according to their positions at the start of movement. The right lane moves first within a square. Advance by the card value; riders can pass through other riders.
· If both destination lanes are occupied, stop at the nearest square behind it with a free lane. Always enter the right lane of an empty square. Changing lanes costs no movement.
· Starting on, entering or crossing an ascent limits movement to five squares. If the sixth or a later step would first enter an ascent, stop at the last free lane before it.
· Starting on a descent makes the card worth at least five movement. An ascent encountered on the route still applies its limit.
Slipstream and exhaustion:
· Riders with no empty square between them form a pack. Starting with the rearmost pack, if exactly one empty square separates it from the next pack, move the rear pack forward one square and merge. Check the merged pack again; a rider can slipstream several times in one round.
· Riders on ascents neither give nor receive slipstream. Treat them as boundaries when checking the riders ahead and behind: riders from the same pack who have reached flat road or a descent can still slipstream, leaving the uphill riders in place. An uphill rearmost square cannot provide slipstream to the pack behind. Descents work normally.
· After slipstreaming, each rider with a completely empty square immediately ahead receives one exhaustion card in their recycled pile. A single empty lane does not cause exhaustion. Ascending riders receive exhaustion normally.
Finish:
Check the finish after completing the round. If anyone has crossed, resolve the winner as above. Otherwise start a new round. Road beyond the finish measures the finishing distance; crossing never cancels the other riders’ movement.

zh.name: 七翻天
zh.desc: 别翻到重复数字,集齐 7 张立赚 15 分
zh.rules:
目标:按轮累计得分,一轮结束后有玩家总分达到 200 分且独居第一时游戏结束,总分最高者获胜。
准备:
· 牌堆共 94 张:数字牌 0 有一张。
· 数字为 1 至 12 的牌，其张数等于牌面数字。例如，数字 1 的牌有 1 张，数字 2 的牌有 2 张，依此类推，数字 12 的牌有 12 张。
· 修正牌包括增加 2 分、4 分、6 分、8 分、10 分的牌，以及翻倍牌，每种各 1 张。
· 行动牌「冻结」「连翻三张」「第二次机会」各三张。
· 每轮先给每人发一张明牌;发到行动牌时立即结算,然后再继续发牌。
流程:
· 从发牌员左手边开始,轮流向每位活跃玩家发牌:轮到你时选择「要牌」再翻一张,或「停牌」。
· 停牌即锁定本轮得分并退出本轮;面前至少有一张牌才能停牌。
· 翻到与面前已有数字重复的数字牌即为爆牌：该玩家本轮出局，获得 0 分。
· 集齐 7 张不同数字牌立即结束本轮,并额外获得 15 分(修正牌与行动牌不计入这 7 张)。
· 冻结:指定一名活跃玩家(可以是自己),其立即按停牌结算并退出本轮。
· 连翻三张:指定一名活跃玩家连续翻三张牌,若发生爆牌，或集齐 7 张不同数字牌，则提前停止翻牌。
· 连翻期间翻出的冻结与连翻三张,在翻完后才结算。
· 「第二次机会」可以抵消一次爆牌。使用后，将这张行动牌与引发爆牌的重复数字牌一同弃置。每名玩家同时只能持有 1 张「第二次机会」。
· 已持有「第二次机会」时，如果再次获得同名牌，必须将新获得的牌转赠给另一名活跃玩家；若没有符合条件的玩家，则将新牌弃置。本轮结束时，所有尚未使用的「第二次机会」均须弃置。
计分:
· 先将自己的数字牌数值相加；如果持有翻倍牌，将该总和乘以 2。随后加上修正牌提供的分数，最后再加上集齐 7 张不同数字牌所获得的 15 分奖励。
· 停牌与冻结都按上述方式保留得分;爆牌的玩家本轮获得 0 分。
结束:
· 一轮结束后，如果有玩家的总分达到 200 分且独居第一，游戏结束。
· 若并列第一则继续下一轮,直到出现唯一胜者。

en.name: Flip 7
en.desc: Don't flip a duplicate — collect 7 numbers for +15
en.rules:
Goal: scores accumulate over rounds. The game ends after a round in which a player reaches 200 points and holds the sole lead; the highest total wins.
Setup:
· The deck contains 94 cards, including one number card with a value of 0.
· Number cards 1–12 each have as many copies as their number (one 1, two 2s … twelve 12s).
· The modifier cards add 2, 4, 6, 8, or 10 points, or double your number-card total. There is one card of each type.
· The action cards are Freeze, Flip Three, and Second Chance. There are three copies of each.
· At the start of each round every player is dealt one face-up card; any action card dealt is resolved immediately before dealing continues.
Play:
· Starting from the dealer's left, each active player is offered a card in turn: choose Hit to flip another card, or Stay.
· Staying banks your round score and leaves the round; you need at least one card in front of you to Stay.
· Flipping a number you already have in front of you is a bust: you're out of the round and score 0.
· Collecting 7 different number cards ends the round immediately and scores +15 (modifier and action cards don't count toward the 7).
· Freeze: pick an active player (maybe yourself); they bank their score and leave the round at once.
· Flip Three: pick an active player who must flip three cards in a row, stopping early on a bust or a Flip 7.
· Freeze and Flip Three cards revealed along the way resolve only after all three flips.
· Second Chance: cancels one bust — discard it together with the duplicate number card. You may hold only one at a time.
· A second Second Chance must be passed to another active player, or discarded if nobody can take it; all unused ones are discarded at the end of the round.
Scoring:
· Add up your number cards, double the sum if you have the ×2 card, then add any modifier cards, and finally the +15 Flip 7 bonus.
· Staying and being frozen both keep this score; busting scores 0 for the round.
End:
· After a round, if any player has 200 or more points with no tie for first place, the game ends.
· On a tie for the lead, play continues until there is a single winner.

zh.name: 翻转星途
zh.desc: 组建动画演员牌库，让六格试镜阵容产生精彩组合。
zh.rules:
目标：
你是一名动画演员经纪人。每轮将自己的牌库洗牌，逐张翻入3列、2排的试镜牌阵，利用角色能力产生声望，再用这些声望招募或解雇演员。多人游戏中，有人达到30点声望后触发最终试镜；最终试镜声望最高者获胜。声望不会跨轮累积。
准备：
· 基础版每人获得2张毛毛虫、1张臭鼬、1张蜻蜓、1张蜜蜂和1张蜗牛。Season 2每人获得2张蚊子、1张蜘蛛、1张蚱蜢、1张瓢虫和1张萤火虫。
· 将53张市场牌洗匀，翻出5张，按等级从低到高对应3、4、7、10、15点声望的价位。相同等级的牌保留出现先后顺序。各轮由起始玩家先进行市场回合，起始玩家标记每轮顺时针传递。
· 基础版和Season 2组合时，混合两套市场牌，使用3、3、4、7、10、15、15七个价位，最多支持8人。每名玩家随机获得其中一套起始牌库，每套最多分配4份。超过4人时使用组合版。
翻牌阶段：
所有玩家同时进行试镜。每名玩家把自己的牌库洗匀，逐张从左到右填满上排，再填下排。放置能力必须在下一张牌揭示前处理。牌库不足时，放完现有牌后结束翻牌。系统逐步展示各张牌及其能力结果。基础版同时触发的能力按从上到下、从左到右的格位顺序处理；Season 2及组合版的翻牌能力按揭示顺序处理。同一叠内均从最上方的牌开始。
· 相邻只指共用边的格位，不包括对角。叠在同一格的牌彼此不相邻，但整叠均与相邻格的牌相邻；每张正面朝上的叠牌仍具有自己的名称、等级、声望和能力。
· 背面朝上的牌占据格位，但没有名称、等级、声望或能力。被其他能力翻回正面时，不重新触发放置能力。不能翻面的牌不受翻面能力影响。
· 放回是把牌放到本人牌库底；解雇是把牌移入公开的解雇牌区。自己的解雇牌与其他玩家的解雇牌始终可以查看。市场阶段可以查看自己的牌库，其他玩家只能看到张数。
· 指向下一张牌的能力只对下一次揭示生效一次。放在最后一个格位时，不为此额外揭示一张。指向之前放置牌的能力，以最后加入且仍在牌阵中的牌为准。
· 选择最低等级牌时，先看正面朝上的牌；同等级时，从最上排、最左列开始，同一叠中先取最上方的牌。额外排不改变原本上排、下排的含义。
· 翻牌中触发的招募或解雇能力，在全员翻牌结束后，从起始玩家开始依次处理。蛇从市场牌库放入牌阵的牌会触发适用的招募能力；猫鼬只把牌加入牌库，不触发招募能力。
同一玩家在牌阵外有多项同时触发的招募或解雇能力时，由该玩家选择先后顺序。
声望阶段：
计算每张正面朝上牌产生的声望，详见牌面能力。奶牛自动复制相邻牌中最高的声望。萤火虫只奖励唯一声望最低者；臭鼬的免费解雇也只属于唯一最低者。并列最低时，相应能力无效。声望一旦确定，在市场阶段不随牌阵或市场变化重新计算。
若任意玩家达到30点声望，本轮声望最高且未并列的玩家获得“影评人之选”，在最终试镜中额外获得3点声望；最高分并列时无人获得。继续完成本轮市场阶段，再进入最终试镜。
市场阶段：
从起始玩家开始，每人最多执行两次以下行动。可以各执行一次，也可以重复同一种行动；可以提前结束回合。
· 招募：支付该牌上方价位所示的声望，将牌加入自己的牌库，并立即处理其招募能力。
· 解雇：通常支付5点声望，将自己牌阵中一张正面朝上的牌移到公开解雇区。毛毛虫、瓢虫和老鼠可以降低费用；不能解雇的牌不能选择。自己的牌库和牌阵合计少于4张牌时，不能解雇任何牌，包括免费能力。
· 角色给予的免费招募、免费解雇和额外行动按牌面处理。猪被招募或解雇时，必须选择一副牌库供它加入；放回市场牌库时会洗牌。可选能力可以跳过，强制能力有合法目标时必须完成。
市场回合结束时，同时触发的牌阵能力按从上到下、从左到右的格位顺序处理，同一叠内从最上方开始。每名玩家完成行动及本回合结束能力后，补满市场并按等级重新排列。市场牌库耗尽时不再补牌，剩余牌排列在最高的几个价位下；连市场也耗尽时，本轮结束后进入最终试镜。
清理与结束：
· 全员完成市场回合后，把牌阵中的牌收回各自牌库。单独版本的1至2人局，以及组合版的1至4人局，额外弃掉市场最左和最右各一张牌，然后补满市场。
· 若本轮尚未触发结束，传递起始玩家标记并开始下一轮。若已触发结束，全员再洗牌、翻牌并计算声望，不再进入市场。
· 最终试镜声望最高者获胜。若最高者并列，仅并列者重新收牌、洗牌、翻牌及计分，直到决出胜者；影评人奖励继续适用。
单人模式：
单人局的目标是在市场牌库无法补满市场前，单次计分达到30点声望。达到目标立即获胜，不进行最终试镜。
· 基础起始牌库改为3张毛毛虫、1张蜻蜓、1张蜜蜂和1张蜗牛，不使用臭鼬；Season 2改为3张蚊子、1张蜘蛛、1张蚱蜢和1张瓢虫，不使用萤火虫。移除市场牌库中的猪。
· 单独版本在初始市场建立后，按入门、标准或挑战难度弃掉17、20或23张市场牌。组合版对应弃掉67、70或73张，并可选择两套单人起始牌库之一。
· 每轮市场结束后仍需弃掉市场两端并补满。任何一次补牌不足时立即失败。
迷你扩展：
· Big Button默认关闭。启用后加入2张美西螈，每人获得一个正面朝上的大按钮。每次计分后，按起始顺序决定是否使用按钮。使用者把按钮翻为背面，将牌阵收回牌库洗牌，再同时重新翻牌；随后全员重新计分。招募美西螈会恢复自己的按钮。
· Big Button 2默认关闭。启用后加入2张鸭嘴兽，开局选择重置牌阵或重置市场。重置牌阵使用上述时机；重置市场只能在本人市场回合执行任何行动之前使用，把所有市场牌洗回市场牌库后重新补满。招募鸭嘴兽恢复所有玩家的按钮。
· 两款同时启用时共用每人一个按钮，使用Big Button 2选定的重置方式。单人局每启用一款迷你扩展，准备时额外弃掉2张市场牌。

en.name: FlipToons
en.desc: Build a cast of animated stars and find the perfect six-slot audition.
en.rules:
Objective:
You are casting an animated show. Shuffle your personal deck each round, reveal toons into a three-column, two-row audition grid, earn fame from their abilities, then spend that fame to improve your cast. In multiplayer, reaching 30 fame triggers a Final Flip. The most fame in the Final Flip wins. Fame does not carry between rounds.
Setup:
· The original starting deck contains two caterpillars, one skunk, one dragonfly, one bee and one snail. Season 2 contains two mosquitoes, one spider, one grasshopper, one ladybug and one firefly.
· Shuffle the 53 toon cards and reveal five into the market, sorted by rank beneath prices of 3, 4, 7, 10 and 15 fame. Equal ranks retain their arrival order. The first-player marker passes clockwise each round.
· Combining both games mixes their toon decks and uses seven prices: 3, 3, 4, 7, 10, 15 and 15. It supports up to eight players. Randomly assign either starting deck, using at most four of each. More than four players requires the combined edition.
Flip:
Everyone auditions simultaneously. Shuffle your deck, reveal one card at a time, and fill the top row from left to right, then the lower row. Resolve placement abilities before revealing the next card. If your deck runs out, leave any remaining spaces empty. The game presents placements and effects in steps. In the original edition, simultaneous abilities resolve from left to right, starting with the top row. In Season 2 and the combined edition, placement abilities resolve in reveal order. Within a stack, always start with the topmost card.
· Adjacent spaces share an edge, never a corner. Cards in the same stack are not adjacent to each other, but all cards in a stack are adjacent to neighboring spaces. Each face-up stacked card retains its own name, rank, fame and abilities.
· A face-down card occupies a space but has no name, rank, fame or abilities. Turning it face up does not reactivate placement abilities. Protected cards cannot be flipped.
· Return means move a card to the bottom of its owner's deck. Dismiss means move it into that player's public dismissed pile. All dismissed piles can be examined. During the Market phase, you may examine your own deck; other players can only see its size.
· A next-card ability affects only the next reveal, once. A card in the last grid space does not cause an extra reveal. A previous-card ability uses the last card added that is still in the grid.
· For lowest rank, ignore face-down cards. Break equal ranks by the topmost row, then leftmost column, then topmost card in a stack. Extra rows do not change the original upper and lower rows.
· Hire and dismiss effects triggered during the Flip resolve after everyone finishes flipping, starting with the first player. Cards added to the grid by a snake trigger applicable hire effects. A mongoose adds a card to the deck without triggering a hire effect.
When multiple hire or dismiss abilities activate outside your grid at the same time, choose their order.
Check Fame:
Add each face-up card's fame as described on its card. A cow automatically copies the highest adjacent fame. A firefly rewards only the sole lowest-scoring player. A skunk's free dismissal also requires a sole lowest player. Ties do not qualify. Once calculated, fame stays fixed throughout the Market phase.
If anyone reaches 30 fame, the unique highest-scoring player receives Critic's Choice, worth 3 extra fame in the Final Flip. A tie for highest fame grants no award. Finish this round's Market phase before the Final Flip.
Market:
Starting with the first player, each player takes up to two actions. You may take each action once or repeat one action, and may end your turn early.
· Hire: spend the fame shown above a market card, add it to your deck, and resolve its hire effect immediately.
· Dismiss: normally spend 5 fame to move a face-up card from your grid to your dismissed pile. Caterpillars, ladybugs and rats reduce this cost. Protected cards cannot be dismissed. You cannot dismiss any card, including through a free ability, with fewer than four cards in your grid and deck combined.
· Free hires, free dismissals and bonus actions follow the card. A hired or dismissed pig must join a chosen player's deck or be shuffled into the toon deck. Optional abilities may be skipped; mandatory abilities must resolve if a legal target exists.
At the end of a Market turn, simultaneous grid abilities resolve from left to right, starting with the top row, and from the top of each stack. After each player's actions and end-of-turn abilities, refill and sort the market. If the toon deck is empty, do not refill; align remaining cards beneath the highest prices. If the market also empties, finish the round and proceed to the Final Flip.
Cleanup and winning:
· Collect your grid into your deck. With one or two players in a single edition, or one to four players in the combined edition, discard the leftmost and rightmost market cards, then refill.
· If the end has not triggered, pass the first-player marker and start the next round. Otherwise everyone shuffles, flips and scores once more without a Market phase.
· The most fame in the Final Flip wins. If the highest score is tied, only those tied players shuffle, flip and score again until a winner is found. The critic's bonus continues to apply.
Solo:
Reach 30 fame in one Check Fame phase before the toon deck can no longer fill the market. Reaching the target wins immediately, without a Final Flip.
· The original solo deck contains three caterpillars, one dragonfly, one bee and one snail, without a skunk. Season 2 uses three mosquitoes, one spider, one grasshopper and one ladybug, without a firefly. Remove the pig from the toon deck.
· After forming the initial market, discard 17, 20 or 23 toon cards for easy, normal or hard. In combined solo, discard 67, 70 or 73 and choose either solo starting deck.
· Discard both market ends and refill each round. Failing to refill any market ends the game in a loss.
Mini-expansions:
· Big Button is off by default. Add two axolotls and give each player a ready button. After each Check Fame, decide in first-player order whether to use it. Users turn their button face down, collect their grid, shuffle and flip again simultaneously; everyone then checks fame again. Hiring an axolotl readies your button.
· Big Button 2 is off by default. Add two platypuses and choose Reset Grid or Reset Market. Reset Grid uses the timing above. Reset Market may only be used before any action on your Market turn: shuffle all market cards into the toon deck, then refill. Hiring a platypus readies every player's button.
· If both expansions are enabled, each player shares one button and uses the effect selected for Big Button 2. In solo, discard two extra toon cards during setup for each enabled mini-expansion.

zh.name: 勇闯牌皇镇
zh.desc: 扑克牌驱动的西部拓荒:走商路、抢匪地、下矿洞、逛小镇,别被警长逮住
zh.rules:
目标:三轮开拓后总分最高者获胜。
· 总分构成:现金每 4 元计 1 分,黄金每 2 块计 1 分。
· 将矿洞底层与旅馆提供的银星，以及库存中的星星，加入终局总分。
· 总分相同时，通缉值较低的玩家获胜；若仍相同，则依次比较黄金数量和现金金额，较多的玩家获胜。
游戏准备：将一副标准的 52 张扑克牌洗混。每名玩家获得 4 元现金和 2 块黄金，并预先圈出墓地中央的墓碑。
· 从 12 张赏金卡抽 3 张公共展示。
流程:每轮依次进行六个阶段。
· 将全部扑克牌重新洗混。
· 将一张警长卡背面朝上放置，不查看其内容。
· 进行五个回合。
· 进行扑克结算。
· 进行淘金与做工。
· 结算警长逮捕。
完成上述阶段后进入下一轮。第三轮结束后，游戏结束。
回合:翻 3 张公共牌,每人同时各自指派三张牌的用途。
· 选择一张作为花色牌，决定前往哪个区域：红桃对应商路，黑桃对应匪地，方块对应矿洞，梅花对应小镇。
· 选择一张作为点数牌，决定前往该区域的哪个位置。
· 将剩余一张牌记入本轮的五格扑克列。
· 也可以放弃花色牌和点数牌的效果，改为前往墓地，圈出一块墓碑。选择此方式时，仍须将一张牌记入扑克列。
改牌:花 2 块黄金可把花色牌改成任意花色。
· 花 1 块黄金可把点数加减 1(不限次数,A 与 K 之间不环绕)。
四区:
· 在商路中，所选点数必须大于或等于车站所示数值，才能向右推进；一次可以连续经过多个车站。
· 停下的站才圈下并获得奖励;跳过的站被划掉、永久失去。
· 匪地:根据所选点数，圈选对应的抢劫目标，再抽取抢劫卡判定结果。已经圈选的目标不能再次抢劫。
· 若抢劫卡的点数不小于目标点数，抢劫成功，获得目标所示的全部通缉值、星星与现金；失败时，只获得通缉值与一半星星。
· 每行三个目标全部圈完,获得行末奖励行动。
· 在矿洞中，只能沿连线向下移动，所选点数必须位于入口所示的范围内。矿室共分为四层，最底层提供终局计分的银星。
· 小镇:根据所选点数，进入对应建筑。首次到访时，另获得建筑顶部的奖励；已经圈选的建筑仍可再次到访。
奖励行动：版图上的部分奖励允许在指定区域执行一次额外行动。这些行动不需要支付费用，也不受点数限制；获得新的奖励行动时，可以继续结算。
扑克结算:每轮结束按你扑克列的 5 张牌比牌型。
· 一对获得 2 元与 1 星,最高皇家同花顺获得 10 元与 9 星。
淘金做工:每个淘金盘获得 1 块黄金,每个锤子获得 2 元。
警长逮捕：可以按照每 1 点通缉值支付 1 块黄金的费用进行贿赂，免于逮捕。如果不支付，则翻开警长卡；警长卡点数大于或等于自己的通缉值时，不受到惩罚。
若警长卡的点数低于你的通缉值，必须按当前轮次选择支付现金或失去星星：
· 第一轮支付 10 元现金，或失去 4 颗星星。
· 第二轮支付 14 元现金，或失去 6 颗星星。
· 第三轮支付 18 元现金，或失去 8 颗星星。
· 通缉值达到 14 时，必须选择失去星星。
赏金卡:同一回合内先达成者获得卡面星数,回合结束翻到低档面。
· 之后达成者获得低档星数;每人每张限一次。

en.name: Fliptown
en.desc: Poker-driven Wild West: ride the trail, rob the badlands, dig the mine, dodge the sheriff
en.rules:
Goal: after three rounds, the highest total wins.
· Total score: every $4 of cash scores 1 point, every 2 gold scores 1 point.
· Add the silver stars earned from the deepest Mine chamber and the Hotel, which are scored at game end, and the stars in your inventory.
· Ties break on fewer Wanted, then more gold, then more cash.
Setup: shuffle a standard 52-card deck; each player starts with $4 and 2 gold, with the center tombstone pre-circled.
· Reveal 3 of the 12 Bounty cards face up.
Each round has six phases in this order:
· Reshuffle all playing cards.
· Set aside one Sheriff card face down without looking at it.
· Play five turns.
· Score poker hands.
· Resolve panning and work.
· Resolve the Sheriff’s arrests.
Then begin the next round. The game ends after round three.
Turn: 3 shared cards are revealed and every player simultaneously assigns a role to each.
· One card sets the suit, choosing a region: hearts Trail, spades Badlands, diamonds Mine, clubs Town.
· One card sets the value, choosing the location within that region.
· The remaining card goes into your five-card poker column for the round.
· You may forgo the suit and value cards and circle a tombstone in the Cemetery instead (the poker card is still recorded).
Modifying cards: pay 2 gold to change the suit card to any suit.
· Pay 1 gold to adjust the value card by 1 (any number of times, no wrapping between A and K).
Regions:
· Trail: your value must meet the station value to advance right; you may rush past several stations.
· Only the station you stop at is circled for its reward; skipped stations are crossed out forever.
· Badlands: circle the robbery target matching your value (taken targets are gone); draw a robbery card.
· If the card value meets or beats the target, the robbery succeeds: gain all its Wanted, stars and cash; otherwise gain only the Wanted and half the stars.
· Circle all three targets of a row to earn its end-of-row bonus action.
· Mine: descend only along the links, using a value within the range shown at the entrance. The Mine has four levels; the deepest chamber provides silver stars scored at game end.
· Town: enter the building matching your value; the first visit also grants the bonus printed at the top; circled buildings can be revisited.
Bonus actions: various spaces grant an action in a specified region. These actions are free, have no card-value restriction, and may trigger further bonus actions.
Poker: at round end your 5-card poker column scores by hand rank.
· One pair earns $2 and 1 star, up to a royal flush earning $10 and 9 stars.
Panning and work: each gold pan earns 1 gold; each hammer earns $2.
Arrest: pay 1 gold per Wanted to bribe your way out; otherwise reveal the Sheriff card — if its value meets or beats your Wanted you are safe.
If the Sheriff card is lower than your Wanted value, choose the fine for the current round:
· In round 1, pay $10 or lose 4 stars.
· In round 2, pay $14 or lose 6 stars.
· In round 3, pay $18 or lose 8 stars.
· At 14 Wanted you must lose stars.
Bounties: the first player to meet one within the same turn scores its printed stars, then the card flips to its lower side.
· Later achievers score the lower amount; each player scores each Bounty once.

zh.name: 森森不息
zh.desc: 种植树木，吸引生物，建立相互依存的森林生态。
zh.rules:
目标与胜负:
2–5 人轮流建立森林。第三张冬季牌出现时立即结束，按树木、生物及洞穴合计分数决定名次，同分共同获胜。洞穴中的每张牌获得 1 分；手牌不计分。卡牌详情列明其效果、奖励与计分方式。
准备:
每人起手 6 张，没有树木时可整手移除并重抽一次，灌木不算树木。根据玩家人数与启用的扩展，移除以下数量的牌：
· 两人游戏：基础版移除 30 张；启用一个扩展时移除 55 张，启用两个扩展时移除 90 张。
· 三人游戏：基础版移除 20 张；启用一个扩展时移除 40 张，启用两个扩展时移除 60 张。
· 四人游戏：基础版移除 10 张；启用一个扩展时移除 25 张，启用两个扩展时移除 45 张。
· 五人游戏：基础版不移除；启用一个扩展时移除 10 张，启用两个扩展时移除 30 张。
余牌分成三堆，将两张冬季牌洗入底堆，第三张放在底堆顶，再叠上其余两堆。按座位顺序行动。
回合行动:
选择抽牌或出牌。抽牌时逐张从牌库或林间空地取牌，共两张，手牌上限 10 张；已有 9 张只能抽一张，已有 10 张必须出牌。抽到前两张冬季牌时展示并补抽，第三张在任何时候出现均立即结束，不完成剩余效果。
出牌与位置:
选择一张手牌及使用的半边，将等于费用的其他手牌支付到空地。树木及灌木独立放置，生物必须放在其牌面对应的上、下、左、右位置。通常每个位置只能放一张。任意手牌均可免费背面种为树苗；树苗算树木但不属于任何树种。每次种植树木或树苗，都从牌库向空地翻一张牌；种灌木不翻牌，灌木也不算树木。回合完全结束时，空地若有至少 10 张牌，将其全部移除。
效果、奖励与持续效果:
出牌后可分别选择使用或跳过效果及奖励。若支付的每张牌至少一半具有所用牌的树种符号，可获奖励；两者都用时先效果后奖励。免费放置不支付费用，不使用该牌自身的效果和奖励，仍可触发现有持续效果。基础蘑菇从下一完整回合起生效；灰喇叭菌和灌木从放置后起生效。持续抽牌先于所放牌的效果与奖励。额外回合在当前回合完全结束后依次进行。
特殊放置与批次:
· 欧洲野兔可不限数量共用同侧位置，山兔不能共槽。
· 欧洲蟾蜍只能与以前回合放下的一张同种蟾蜍共槽，每槽最多两张。
· 荨麻允许其所在树木或灌木顶部任意数量蝴蝶共槽。
· 鼹鼠须先用当前手牌选择整个出牌批次，支付并全部放置后，再自由选择逐张结算顺序；后来抽到的牌不得加入原批次或用于其支付。嵌套鼹鼠以当时手牌建立独立批次，完成后返回上一批。
· 水䶄先将选定手牌全部种为树苗，再为每棵翻牌，最后结算鸡油菌。
计分提示:
只有露出的半边参与计分。完整逐牌说明可在卡牌详情中查看。
· 兔类共同计数。
· 蝙蝠至少有三种时，每张蝙蝠才获得 5 分。
· 不同种蝴蝶组成集合，重复种另组。由一种至七种蝴蝶组成的集合，依次获得 0 分、3 分、6 分、12 分、20 分、35 分和 55 分。
· 一张火蝾螈获得 5 分，两张合计获得 15 分，至少三张合计获得 25 分。
· 紫木蜂只增加山毛榉、欧洲七叶树、椴树、大斑啄木鸟与苔藓使用的树木数量，不复制树的分数或符号。
本局选项:
高山及林缘扩展可独立启用，默认均启用。不含探索扩展、特殊洞穴、起手轮抽、官方单人模式或工坊作者的平衡变体。

en.name: Forest Shuffle
en.desc: Plant trees, attract wildlife, and build an interconnected forest.
en.rules:
Goal and victory:
2–5 players take turns building forests. The third winter card ends the game immediately. Score trees, dwellers and caves; tied highest totals share victory. Each cave card scores 1 point; hand cards score nothing. Card details explain individual effects, bonuses and scoring.
Setup:
Deal six cards each. A player with no tree may remove the entire hand and redraw once; shrubs are not trees. For 2/3/4/5 players remove 30/20/10/0 cards from the base game, 55/40/25/10 with one expansion, or 90/60/45/30 with both. Divide the remaining cards into three similar piles. Shuffle two winter cards into the bottom pile, put the third on top of that pile, then stack the other piles above it. Play in seat order.
Turn actions:
Either draw or play. Draw two cards one at a time, choosing deck or clearing for each. The hand limit is ten: with nine, draw one; with ten, play. Reveal and replace either of the first two winter cards. The third winter ends the game immediately on any reveal, interrupting remaining effects.
Playing and placement:
Choose a hand card and the half to use. Pay its cost with other hand cards into the clearing. Trees and shrubs stand alone; dwellers occupy their printed top, bottom, left or right slot. Normally each slot holds one card. Any hand card may instead be planted face down as a free sapling: it counts as a tree without a tree species. Each tree or sapling reveals one deck card into the clearing. Shrubs neither reveal a card nor count as trees. After the entire turn, remove the clearing if it contains at least ten cards.
Effects, bonuses and permanent effects:
You may use or skip the effect and bonus separately. Earn a bonus when each payment card shows the played half’s tree symbol on at least one half. Resolve effect before bonus. Free placements have no cost and do not use their own effects or bonuses, but can trigger existing permanent effects. Base mushrooms activate from your next full turn; Black Trumpet and shrubs activate from placement onward. Permanent draws precede the placed card’s effect and bonus. Take extra full turns after completing the current turn.
Shared slots and batches:
· Any number of European Hares may share a same-side slot; Mountain Hares cannot share.
· A Common Toad may share with one of its species placed on an earlier turn, at most two per slot.
· Stinging Nettle allows unlimited butterflies above its tree or shrub.
· For a Mole, choose the entire batch from the current hand, pay and place everything, then choose the resolution order. Later draws cannot join or pay for that batch. A nested Mole starts a separate batch from the hand at that time, then returns to the parent batch.
· Water Vole plants all chosen saplings first, reveals one clearing card per sapling, then resolves Chanterelles.
Scoring reminders:
Only the exposed half scores. Inspect cards for full individual explanations.
· Both hare species count together.
· Each bat scores 5 points if you have at least three bat species.
· Butterfly sets of one through seven different species score 0, 3, 6, 12, 20, 35 and 55 points respectively. Duplicates form additional sets.
· One Fire Salamander scores 5 points; two score 15 points in total; three or more score 25 points in total.
· Violet Carpenter Bees increase tree counts only for Beech, Horse Chestnut, Linden, Great Spotted Woodpecker and Moss. They do not duplicate tree points or symbols.
Options:
Alpine and Woodland Edge can be enabled independently; both are on by default. Exploration, special caves, drafting, official solo mode and workshop balance variants are excluded.

zh.name: 为了北境森林
zh.desc: 单人吃墩:走访八块领地,用恰到好处的对话说服各位统治者
zh.rules:
目标:独自拜访北境森林的八块领地,通过对话(吃墩)说服统治者。
· 游戏结束时,友好领地的星数之和达到胜利线即获胜。
准备:
· 将八块领地按目标墩数 0 至 7 依次排列。各领地的星数如下：
· 目标为 0 墩或 7 墩的领地，各有 4 颗星。
· 目标为 1 墩或 6 墩的领地，各有 3 颗星。
· 目标为 2 墩或 5 墩的领地，各有 2 颗星。
· 目标为 3 墩或 4 墩的领地，各有 1 颗星。
· 教学局由四名骑士担任盟友,八张女王与国王洗匀后各置一块领地担任统治者。
· 完整局将 24 张角色卡洗匀后按花色发放,每种花色第 1 张为盟友,第 2、3 张为统治者。
· 32 张对话牌(爪/花/叶/瞳四花色,各 1-8 点)洗成牌堆,摸 8 张手牌。
流程:每次拜访依次进行——
· 选择一块未拜访的领地。
· 可让任意名已友好的统治者前来替换盟友,每位占一个盟友位,拜访结束后离场。
· 对话时每墩可先激活至多一个盟友能力(每次拜访每个盟友限一次)。
· 翻开牌堆顶牌作为统治者的发言;你必须跟出同花色,没有同花色才可任意出牌。
· 回应与发言同花色且点数更大,或发言非王牌花色(统治者花色)而你打出王牌花色,即赢得此墩。
· 赢墩的回应牌入计分牌堆,否则入弃牌堆。
· 手牌或牌堆任一耗尽,拜访立即结束。
结算:
· 计分牌堆的牌数恰好等于目标墩数,则统治者转为友好;否则拜访失败,统治者离场。
· 拜访结束后所有对话牌重洗,补摸 8 张,选择下一块领地。
结束：拜访完八块领地后，或提前认输时，结算友好领地的星数。标准难度的胜利线为 16 颗星，进阶难度为 18 颗星，理想难度为 20 颗星。

en.name: For Northwood!
en.desc: Solo trick-taking: visit eight fiefs and win over their rulers through precise dialogue
en.rules:
Goal: visit the eight fiefs of Northwood alone and win over their rulers through dialogues (tricks).
· At the end, you win if your friendly fiefs' stars reach the victory line.
Setup:
· The eight fiefs are laid out with target scores 0-7 and star values 4/3/2/1/1/2/3/4.
· Intro game: the four Jacks are your allies, and the shuffled Queens and Kings become the rulers, one per fief.
· Full game: shuffle all 24 character cards and deal by suit — the first card of each suit is an ally, the second and third are rulers.
· Shuffle the 32 dialogue cards (suits Claws/Flowers/Leaves/Eyes, valued 1-8) into a deck and draw 8.
Play: each visit proceeds in order —
· Choose an unvisited fief.
· Any number of friendly rulers may substitute for allies, one per ally slot; they leave when the visit ends.
· Dialogue: before each trick you may activate at most one ally ability (each ally once per visit).
· The top card of the deck is revealed as the ruler's statement; you must follow its suit if able.
· You score the trick if your response is a higher card of the statement's suit, or if the statement is not the trump suit (the ruler's suit) but your response is.
· Scored responses go to the score pile, others to the discard pile.
· The visit ends immediately when your hand or the deck runs out.
Scoring:
· If the score pile exactly equals the target, the ruler turns friendly; otherwise the visit fails and the ruler leaves.
· After a visit, reshuffle all dialogue cards, draw 8, and choose the next fief.
End: after visiting all eight fiefs, or conceding early, total the stars on your friendly fiefs. The victory line is 16 stars for Standard, 18 for Advanced and 20 for Idealist.

search.py: wei le bei jing sen lin

zh.name: 星期五
zh.desc: 帮助鲁滨逊磨炼本领，战胜荒岛危机与两艘海盗船。
zh.rules:
目标：
帮助鲁滨逊战胜两个海盗。在绿色、黄色和红色三个阶段中改善牌库，迎接最后两场战斗。
准备：
分别将 18 张起始牌和 30 张冒险牌洗成牌堆，随机公开 2 艘海盗船。难度 1 移除「十分愚笨」，普通衰老牌洗匀放在困难衰老牌上。难度 2 起始牌库多加入一张暗衰老牌；难度 3 再加入「十分愚笨」；难度 4 同难度 3，但以 18 点生命值开始，生命值上限为 20 点。其他难度以 20 点生命值开始，生命值上限为 22 点。
冒险：
揭开两张冒险牌，选择一张，另一张弃掉。轮末只剩一张时可以直接弃掉。按当前阶段的颜色确定目标战斗力。
抽牌：
逐张抽取白框数量的免费牌，放在左侧。可以提前停止。免费牌抽完或被「停止」能力阻止后，每支付 1 点生命值，可以抽取一张额外牌，放在右侧。至少抽一张牌才能结算。即使战斗力已经足够，也可以继续抽牌和使用能力。
能力：
· 每张牌每场战斗可以主动使用一次，顺序自选。一个能力必须执行完才能开启另一个。恢复生命不能超过本难度的上限。额外抽牌放右侧。
· 「销毁」将另一张牌翻背，其战斗力和持续能力取消，战后移出游戏。
· 「翻倍」只能用于另一张牌，同一张牌每战只能翻倍一次。
· 复制可以复制已使用过的能力，不能复制复制能力或衰老能力。
· 降低阶段仅影响冒险牌，最低降到绿色。
排列：
· 逐张查看至多三张牌，可以提前停止，至多弃掉一张，其余自选顺序放回牌堆顶端。
· 替换：将另一张已出牌弃掉，在原位置抽一张替代牌；两次替换依次完成，中间不能使用新牌的能力。
· 置底：将另一张牌放到牌堆底，来自左侧时可以在原位置补一张。置底前牌堆必须有牌，必要时先重洗。
衰老：
衰老牌的负面能力强制生效。战末失去生命不能计入销毁预算。「最高归零」先按原始正战斗力选择一张，再计算翻倍；多个归零分别影响不同的最高牌。「停止」只在免费区阻止普通免费抽牌，能力抽牌不受影响。移走或销毁衰老牌会取消其持续能力。
胜负：
手动结束战斗，战斗力达到目标则获得该冒险牌作为知识牌，放入鲁滨逊弃牌堆。战斗力不足则支付差值生命，可以用这笔费用销毁本场已出牌：每销毁一张普通牌消耗 1 点销毁预算，每销毁一张衰老牌消耗 2 点销毁预算；不能额外支付生命扩大预算。其他牌进入鲁滨逊弃牌堆，未战胜的冒险进入冒险弃牌堆。
重洗：
需要抽牌而鲁滨逊牌堆为空时，将一张暗衰老牌与鲁滨逊弃牌洗成新牌堆。暗牌顺序不可查看。衰老牌耗尽后再需要重洗会失败。生命降到零仍可继续，无法支付所需生命时立即失败。
阶段：
冒险牌堆用完后，洗匀冒险弃牌并进入下一阶段。红色阶段结束后，自选海盗战斗顺序。必须战胜两艘海盗船，不能主动认输。海盗特殊规则写在船牌上；「半数计分」自动使用战斗力最高的合法组合，所有正面衰老牌必须计入。
计分：
以现存战斗牌的原始战斗力之和作为基础分数，衰老牌每张统一计为负 5 分。再按以下项目计算总分：
· 每战胜一艘海盗船，增加 15 分。
· 获胜时每剩余 1 点生命值，增加 5 分。
· 冒险弃牌堆中每张未战胜的冒险牌，扣除 3 分。
两堆弃牌、已销毁牌和三个牌堆数量可随时查看。

en.name: Friday
en.desc: Help Robinson build his deck, survive the island and defeat two pirate ships.
en.rules:
Goal:
Help Robinson improve his deck through the green, yellow and red steps, then defeat both pirates.
Setup:
Shuffle 18 starting cards and 30 hazards. Reveal 2 random pirates. For level 1, remove Very stupid; shuffle normal aging cards above the separately shuffled difficult cards. Level 2 adds one unseen aging card to the starting deck. Level 3 includes Very stupid. Level 4 uses the level 3 setup but starts with 18 life and a maximum of 20; other levels start with 20 and have a maximum of 22.
Hazards:
Reveal two and choose one; discard the other. A final single hazard may be discarded without fighting. The current step colour determines the target.
Draw:
Draw free fighting cards one at a time, up to the white-box number, on the left. You may stop early. After free draws are exhausted or stopped, each additional card costs 1 life and goes on the right. At least one fighting card must be drawn before ending a fight. Reaching the target never ends a fight automatically.
Abilities:
· Use each face-up card once per fight, in any order, completing one ability before starting another. Healing is limited by the level’s life supply. Ability draws go on the right.
· Destroy turns another card face down, cancelling its points and ongoing effects; remove it after the fight.
· Double affects another card, at most once per target per fight.
· Copy may reuse an already-used ability but cannot copy Copy or an aging ability.
· Step reduction only affects hazards, down to green.
Sort:
· Look at up to three cards one by one, discard at most one, then return the others in any order.
· Exchange discards another played card and draws its replacement in the same position. Complete both exchanges before using any newly drawn ability.
· Below the stack moves another card to the bottom; a card from the free side may be replaced in its original position. If the stack is empty, reshuffle before placing the card below it.
Aging:
Negative abilities are compulsory. End-of-fight life costs do not increase the destruction allowance. Highest card = 0 affects one card with the highest original positive value before doubling; multiple such effects affect distinct cards. Stop prevents ordinary free draws only while on the free side; ability draws remain possible. Removing or destroying an aging card cancels its ongoing effect.
Fight result:
End manually. Meet the target to gain the hazard as a knowledge card in your Robinson discard. Otherwise pay the shortfall in life and use that amount to destroy played cards: destroying an ordinary card uses 1 point of this allowance, and destroying an aging card uses 2. You cannot pay extra life to increase this allowance. Discard remaining fighting cards; undefeated hazards enter the hazard discard.
Reshuffle:
Only when another card is needed and the Robinson stack is empty, shuffle the Robinson discard with one unseen aging card. You lose if another reshuffle is required after aging cards run out. Zero life is allowed; an unaffordable required payment loses immediately.
Steps:
When the hazard stack runs out, shuffle its discard for the next colour. After red, choose which pirate to fight first. Both must be defeated; pirates cannot be deliberately lost. Ship cards show their special rules. The half-counting pirate automatically uses the strongest legal combination, including all face-up aging cards.
Score:
Sum original values of all remaining fighting cards (each aging card is −5), add 15 per defeated pirate and 5 per life remaining in a win, then subtract 3 per undefeated hazard in the hazard discard. Both discard piles, destroyed cards and all three stack counts may be inspected at any time.

zh.name: 奶酪世家
zh.desc: 经营法式奶酪工坊，随着转盘安排熟成、拓展市场与订单。
zh.rules:
目标：
经营自己的奶酪工坊，在餐酒馆、奶酪店、节庆和城市四个场地放置奶酪，结合建筑、水果和订单获得最多声望。采用第二印基础版，支持1–4人；本版本未包含《Formaggio》扩展。
准备：
每名玩家获得15枚奶酪、一名软质工人、一名硬质工人、一名蓝纹工人，以及一块随机分配的玩家板。转盘的场地与资源随机配置。每名玩家从左侧资源区领取两份资源，从对面资源区领取一份资源。1–2人、3人、4人使用各自插板；I、II可分别配置，0面仅供4人使用。选择高级建筑时，每名玩家从4块建筑板块中保留1块，将其余板块向左传递；重复这个过程，直到每名玩家保留4块；单人依次从新抽的4、3、2、1片中各留1片。可用保留的高级建筑替换任意默认建筑，也可保留默认建筑。
回合：
所有玩家同时操作自己面前的象限。每回合至多派一位工人制酪、派一位工人采集资源，两者顺序任意，也可不做。可随时建造、挤奶或使用已建成建筑。所有人完成后，转盘顺时针旋转90度，进入下一回合。
· 制酪：选择可用工人，再选择当前场地的空格，类型须与工人一致。在该格放一枚奶酪，工人等待该格标示的1、2或3回合后收回。每次放置时可完成一张类型与熟成都匹配的已有订单；不能追溯完成新抽到的订单。在果味或果酱格放置奶酪时，必须支付一份水果，将其移至对应已用区。
· 采集：可用任意工人占据当前资源的空置1、2或3位，立即获得相应数量资源，等待相应回合后收回。已被工人占据的资源位不能使用。
· 挤奶：支付2份、3份、4份或5份牲畜资源，选择个人板上尚未用过的挤奶位，立即在当前场地放置符合其类型、熟成要求的额外奶酪，不派工人，不占用普通制酪行动；果味或果酱格仍须支付水果。每个挤奶位通常一局只能使用一次。
· 建筑：支付建筑资源后建成并启用对应能力。能力可在条件满足时使用，默认第二能力每回合只额外获得一次资源。高级建筑的效果见建筑详情。放置时以已建成的能力处理触发，事件发生后才建成的能力不能追溯生效。
场地计分：
餐酒馆：每完整占据一张双人桌，所有自家奶酪的分值都会提高。按完整占据的双人桌数量计分：
· 没有完整占据双人桌时，每枚铜奶酪获得 0 分，银奶酪获得 2 分，金奶酪获得 4 分。
· 完整占据一张双人桌时，每枚铜奶酪获得 1 分，银奶酪获得 3 分，金奶酪获得 5 分。
· 完整占据两张双人桌时，每枚铜奶酪获得 2 分，银奶酪获得 4 分，金奶酪获得 6 分。
· 完整占据至少三张双人桌时，每枚铜奶酪获得 3 分，银奶酪获得 6 分，金奶酪获得 9 分。
奶酪店：占据一至六个不同货架时，依次获得 0 分、2 分、5 分、9 分、14 分和 20 分。各位置另有以下奖励：
· 上半货架：每枚铜奶酪另获得 1 分，每枚银奶酪另获得 2 分，每枚金奶酪另获得 3 分。
· 下半货架的铜位：可以弃置一份资源，换取任意一份资源。
· 下半货架的银位：获得任意一份资源。
· 下半货架的金位：获得两份种类不同的资源。
节庆：自家奶酪与免费试吃点按上下左右相邻形成连通组；不同玩家的奶酪不能连接。每组1–7枚分别获得0、2、4、6、9、12、15分，此后，连通组每增加一枚奶酪，再获得 5 分。
城市：每枚奶酪影响其接触的所有区域。每区影响最多者获得该区客户分：一至两人游戏中，各区域的客户分为 3 分、4 分或 5 分；三人游戏中为 5 分、6 分或 7 分；四人游戏中为 7 分、8 分或 9 分，具体数值以区域标示为准。影响力并列最多时，一至两人游戏的并列玩家各获得 0 分，三人游戏各获得 2 分，四人游戏各获得 3 分。
其他计分与结束：
· 将已用果味水果的数量乘以已用果酱水果的数量，获得等于乘积的分数。
· 完成1–6张订单分别获得1、3、5、8、11、14分，此后每多完成一张订单，再获得 4 分。
· 每两份闲置资源获得1分，未完成订单也算闲置资源。
· 另计所有已建成建筑的终局分。
任一玩家放完15枚奶酪后，本回合全员完成即结束。工人是否熟成不影响奶酪计分。工人宿舍允许拥有者在转盘额外旋转一次后多行动一回合。总分最高者获胜，平分时放置奶酪更多者获胜，仍平则共享胜利。
单人公司：
公司先抽订单，由玩家在当前场地选择类型、熟成匹配的空格放置公司奶酪，不支付水果；没有匹配空格或奶酪时，公司保留该订单并在终局每张获得3分。
· 第一至第四难度的公司分别有 15 枚、17 枚、18 枚和 19 枚奶酪，其基础声望随已放奶酪的数量按公司板提高。公司只争夺城市客户，不计算其他场地分，各区域的客户分为3分、4分或5分，具体以区域标示为准。
· 第二难度放置第 10 枚奶酪、第三难度放置第 8 枚奶酪、第四难度放置第 6 枚奶酪后，公司从下一回合开始每回合抽取两张订单。
· 第三难度起，公司在果味或果酱格放置奶酪时获得水果，累计获得 2 份、4 份、6 份或 8 份水果时，分别获得 1 分、3 分、6 分或 10 分；此后每多获得 2 份水果，再获得 5 分。
· 在第四难度中，若公司最后抽到银色订单，本回合封锁标有 2 的资源位；若最后抽到金色订单，则封锁标有 3 的资源位。
玩家或公司用完奶酪都会触发本回合结束；比较总分，再比较已放奶酪数，仍平时共享胜利。

en.name: Fromage
en.desc: Run a French creamery: age cheese, expand your workshop, and compete for customers.
en.rules:
Goal:
Earn the most Prestige through four Venues, Structures, Fruit, and Orders. This is the second-printing base game for 1–4 players; Formaggio is not included.
Setup:
Each player receives 15 Cheese Tokens, one Soft, Hard, and Bleu Worker, and a random Player Board. Venues and Resources are randomized. Start with 2 Resources from the quadrant to your left and 1 from the opposite quadrant. Use the appropriate inserts for 1–2, 3, or 4 players; choose I or II separately for each Venue. Side 0 is for four players only. With advanced Structures, each player drafts four tiles: keep one of the four tiles and pass the others left. Repeat until each player has kept four tiles. Solo players choose one tile from fresh sets of 4, 3, 2, then 1. Replace any default abilities with kept tiles, or retain the defaults.
Turns:
All players act simultaneously in their current quadrant. Once per turn, assign one available Worker to Make Cheese and one to Gather Resources, in either order. Either action is optional. Build, milk Livestock, and use completed Structures at any time. When everyone finishes, rotate the board 90 degrees clockwise.
· Make Cheese: choose an available Worker, then an empty space matching its type. Place a Cheese Token there. The Worker returns after the indicated 1, 2, or 3 turns. You may immediately complete one existing Order matching that cheese type and age. Newly drawn Orders cannot be completed retroactively. Fruited Cheese and Jam spaces require one Fruit, moved to the appropriate spent area.
· Gather: any available Worker can occupy an empty Resource space labeled 1, 2, or 3 in the current quadrant. Immediately gain that many Resources; the Worker returns after that many turns. Occupied spaces are unavailable.
· Milk: pay 2, 3, 4, or 5 Livestock to use an unused Milking Parlour. Place its Bonus Cheese in a matching type/age space in the current Venue, without a Worker or consuming your Make Cheese action. Fruit is still required where shown. Each Parlour is normally usable once per game.
· Build: pay Structure Tokens to unlock an ability. Abilities apply whenever their conditions are met; the second default ability grants its extra Resource only once per turn. Read each advanced tile for its effect. Newly completed abilities do not apply retroactively to past events.
Venues:
Bistro: completing pairs at tables improves the value of all your cheese. Score according to the number of complete tables:
· With no complete tables, each Bronze cheese scores 0 points, each Silver cheese 2 points and each Gold cheese 4 points.
· With one complete table, each Bronze cheese scores 1 point, each Silver cheese 3 points and each Gold cheese 5 points.
· With two complete tables, each Bronze cheese scores 2 points, each Silver cheese 4 points and each Gold cheese 6 points.
· With at least three complete tables, each Bronze cheese scores 3 points, each Silver cheese 6 points and each Gold cheese 9 points.
Fromagerie: occupying one through six different shelves scores 0, 2, 5, 9, 14 and 20 points respectively. Shelf positions also provide these rewards:
· Upper shelves add 1 point per Bronze cheese, 2 points per Silver cheese and 3 points per Gold cheese.
· A lower Bronze position lets you discard one Resource to gain any one Resource.
· A lower Silver position gives any one Resource.
· A lower Gold position gives two different Resources.
Festival: your cheese and Free Samples form orthogonally connected groups; opposing cheese cannot connect them. A group of 1–7 scores 0, 2, 4, 6, 9, 12, or 15, then 5 more per additional token.
Villes: each cheese influences every region it touches. The most influence wins that region’s Customer: With one or two players, Customers are worth 3, 4 or 5 points according to the region; with three players, 5, 6 or 7; with four, 7, 8 or 9. Use the value printed for the region. Tied leaders each score 0 points with one or two players, 2 points with three, or 3 points with four.
Scoring and end:
· Multiply the amount of Fruit spent on Fruited Cheese by the amount spent on Jam, and score points equal to the result.
· Completing 1–6 Orders scores 1, 3, 5, 8, 11, or 14 points respectively; each further completed Order adds 4 points.
· Every two unused Resources, including incomplete Orders, score 1.
· Add all completed Structure bonuses.
When anyone places their 15th Cheese Token, finish the current turn. Cheese scores regardless of whether its Worker has returned. Workers’ Quarters grants its owner one extra turn after one more board rotation. Highest Prestige wins; break ties by cheese placed, then share victory.
Solo corporation:
The corporation draws first. Choose any matching empty space in your current Venue for its cheese, without paying Fruit. If none matches, or it has no cheese left, it keeps the Order for 3 points at game-end.
· At Levels 1, 2, 3 and 4, the corporation has 15, 17, 18 and 19 cheese respectively; their printed base Prestige increases as cheese is placed. The corporation competes only for Villes Customers, worth 3, 4 or 5 points as printed. It does not score other Venues.
· Level 2 draws twice from the turn after its 10th cheese, Level 3 after its 8th, and Level 4 after its 6th.
· At Level 3 or higher, the corporation gains one Fruit when it places cheese on a Fruited Cheese or Jam space. Totals of 2, 4, 6 and 8 Fruit score 1, 3, 6 and 10 points respectively. Each further pair adds 5 points.
· At Level 4, the last drawn Silver Order blocks the 2 Resource space that turn, and Gold blocks the 3 space.
Either side exhausting cheese triggers the final turn. Compare Prestige, then cheese placed; remaining ties share victory.

zh.name: 郁金香庄园
zh.desc: 轮盘拿块建花园,连通花海抢目标
zh.rules:
目标：
用十轮时间建设郁金香庄园。游戏结束时，将计分轨分数、升级标记分数、目标板块分数及剩余金币分数相加，总分最高的玩家获胜。
准备：
· 每名玩家获得一块起始板块及十张景观卡，将景观卡洗混后，抽取三张作为手牌。
· 按行动顺序，第一位至第四位玩家分别获得 1 枚、2 枚、3 枚和 4 枚金币。
· 将 44 块景观板块洗混后放入袋中，翻开五块组成市场。两人游戏展示 8 块目标板块，三人游戏展示 10 块，四人游戏展示 12 块。
每回合流程：
· 领取板块：将花朵标记顺时针移动到希望领取的市场板块，每跳过一块板块，须在其旁放置一枚金币。领取所选板块及其旁积累的金币，再从袋中补充一块板块。
· 放置板块：所选板块至少有一边与已有板块相邻，连接的元素不必相同。放置前可以旋转或翻面，放置后不能移动。
· 打出景观卡：打出一张手牌，按刚放置板块所属的相应元素连通组计分。单元素卡中，每个对应元素获得 2 分；双元素卡中，每类对应元素各获得 1 分。随后将手牌补至三张；牌库耗尽后不再洗混。
· 放置升级标记：刚围出的空地必须立即填入对应升级标记，具体对应关系见下文。
升级标记的放置：
· 一格空地放置一个花农。
· 两格空地放置一个谷仓。
· 三格空地放置一个谷仓及一个花农。
· 四格的 T 形空地放置一个谷仓及两个花农。
· 其他非方形的四格空地放置两个谷仓。
· 方形的四格空地放置一座风车。
每放置一个花农，立即获得一枚金币。
认领目标：
认领目标是可选的。符合条件时，可以在本回合认领多块目标板块；每名玩家每类最多持有一块。暂不认领的目标仍可能被其他玩家取得。
· 景观类目标：本回合所放板块形成的连通组达到目标所示的 6、8 或 10。花朵按朵数计算，水域按格数计算。
· 升级类目标：本回合已经放置过对应的升级标记，且持有该类标记的总数达到目标要求。花农目标要求为 3、4 或 5 个，谷仓为 2、3 或 4 个，风车为 1、2 或 3 座。
终局计分：
· 计入计分轨上的分数。
· 每个花农获得 3 分，每个谷仓获得 10 分，每座风车获得 25 分。
· 每块目标板块按其标示，获得 3 分、10 分或 25 分。
· 每枚剩余金币获得 1 分。
总分相同时，剩余金币较多的玩家获胜；仍相同时，共享胜利。

en.name: Frosted Blooms
en.desc: Draft tiles from the rondel, grow flower groups, claim objectives
en.rules:
Goal:
Build a tulip estate over ten rounds. Add your score-track points, improvements, objective tiles and remaining coins. The highest total wins.
Setup:
· Each player receives one starting tile and ten Landscape cards. Shuffle your cards and draw three.
· The first through fourth players receive 1, 2, 3 and 4 coins respectively.
· Shuffle all 44 Landscape tiles into the bag and reveal five for the market. Reveal eight objective tiles with two players, ten with three, or twelve with four.
Each turn:
· Take a tile: move the Flower token clockwise to your chosen market tile, leaving one coin beside each skipped tile. Take the chosen tile and all coins beside it, then refill its market position from the bag.
· Place the tile: it must share at least one edge with your existing garden. Elements need not match. You may rotate or flip it before placing it; placed tiles cannot move.
· Play a Landscape card: score the matching connected group containing the tile just placed. A single-type card scores 2 points per matching element. A dual-type card scores 1 point per element of each matching type. Refill your hand to three; do not reshuffle an exhausted deck.
· Place improvements: immediately fill newly enclosed gaps with the improvements described below. This step is mandatory whenever a gap can be filled.
Filling gaps:
· A one-space gap takes one Worker.
· A two-space gap takes one Barn.
· A three-space gap takes one Barn and one Worker.
· A four-space T-shaped gap takes one Barn and two Workers.
· Any other non-square four-space gap takes two Barns.
· A square four-space gap takes one Windmill.
Each Worker placed immediately earns one coin.
Claiming objectives:
Claiming is optional. You may claim several objectives in one turn, but each player may claim at most one of each type. An objective left unclaimed may be taken by an opponent.
· Landscape objectives require the group formed by this turn's tile to reach the printed target of 6, 8 or 10. Count flowers by blooms and water by spaces.
· Improvement objectives require you to place that improvement type this turn and reach its printed total. Worker targets are 3, 4 or 5; Barn targets are 2, 3 or 4; Windmill targets are 1, 2 or 3.
Final scoring:
· Include your score-track points.
· Each Worker scores 3 points, each Barn 10 points and each Windmill 25 points.
· Each objective tile scores its printed value of 3, 10 or 25 points.
· Each remaining coin scores 1 point.
Break ties by the number of remaining coins. Further ties share victory.

zh.name: 扭蛋收藏家
zh.desc: 跟随颜色赢得吃墩，精打细算收集成套玩具
zh.rules:
目标：进行三轮，累计分最高者获胜；总分相同时，最后一轮剩余现金较多的玩家获胜；若仍相同，则共享胜利。
准备：
· 49 张玩具牌分为七色，每色的价格为 ¥200 至 ¥800；七种玩具各有七张。每人获得 10 张手牌（三人时 12 张）及 ¥5000。余牌加入退款牌，作为公共随机牌堆。
流程：
· 先手玩家可以打出任意一张手牌。后续玩家如果有本墩已出现过的任一颜色，必须跟出其中一种；否则可以打出任意一张手牌。
· 出现次数最多的颜色获胜；多个颜色并列时比较其中最高价格，再并列则后出的牌获胜。
· 胜者必须购买至少一张本墩牌，也可购买更多；每墩另可花 ¥500 购买一次公共牌堆顶牌。盲抽不能代替从本墩购买卡牌的要求。如果在购买本墩卡牌之前进行盲抽，必须保留足以购买至少一张本墩卡牌的现金。
· 本墩的胜者在下一墩首先出牌。如果胜者无法支付本墩任何一张牌的价格，购买权交给打出同色较低牌的玩家；之后按本墩各花色的张数、卡牌价格和出牌先后，依次确定下一位获得购买权的玩家。如果所有玩家均无法购买，则弃置本墩的全部卡牌。
· 购买回合结束余款只有 ¥0 或 ¥100 时退出本轮，剩余手牌弃置；先手退出则顺时针顺延。只剩一人时，可购买其剩余手牌及一次公共随机牌。
· 抽到退款牌后，将其保留至轮末。轮末可以弃置退款牌和一张已收藏的玩具牌，获得等于该玩具标价的现金；也可以放弃退款。
结算：
· 本轮手牌用尽后，每种玩具按数量的平方计分（1、4、9、16、25、36、49）。每剩余 ¥200，获得 1 分；整轮未进行任何消费的玩家，额外获得 5 分。
· 每轮重新洗牌、恢复初始资金与手牌。累计领先者下一轮先出；同分以随机抽签代替猜拳。
双人变化：
· 每名玩家获得 ¥8000、10 张手牌及一个由 10 张牌组成的个人补牌堆。每墩交替出牌，双方各出两张。每墩后双方各补两张，个人牌堆用完后继续打完手牌。先手每墩交替。只剩一人时仅购买当时手牌，不继续个人补牌。

en.name: Gachapon Trick
en.desc: Win colorful tricks and spend wisely to collect matching toys
en.rules:
Goal: Score the most points over three rounds. Ties go to the most money left in the final round; equal ties are shared.
Setup:
· There are 49 toy cards: seven suits, each priced ¥200–¥800, and seven toy types. Each player receives 10 cards (12 with three players) and ¥5000. Shuffle the Refund into the remaining central deck.
Play:
· The leader plays any card. Later players must follow any suit already in the trick if able; otherwise play any suit.
· The most frequent suit wins. Among tied suits, the highest price wins; equal prices go to the later card.
· The winner must buy at least one card from the trick and may buy more. Once per trick, they may also buy the top central card for ¥500. A random purchase never replaces the required trick purchase; reserve enough money for it.
· The winner leads next. If they cannot afford any trick card, purchasing passes down the winning suit, then by suit frequency, price and play order. If nobody can afford a card, discard the trick.
· Players ending their purchasing turn with ¥0 or ¥100 leave the round and discard their remaining cards. An unavailable leader passes clockwise. A sole remaining player may buy from their current hand and optionally once from the central deck.
· Keep the Refund until round end. Discard it and one collected toy to recover that toy’s printed price, or decline.
Scoring:
· Score each toy type as its count squared: 1, 4, 9, 16, 25, 36, 49. Score one point per ¥200 left and five more if you never spent this round.
· Reset cards and money each round. The cumulative leader starts the next; ties are resolved by a random draw instead of rock-paper-scissors.
Two players:
· Each receives ¥8000, a ten-card hand and a ten-card personal draw pile. Alternate playing until each has played twice into a four-card trick. Draw two each after every trick while personal cards remain, then play out the hands. Alternate leaders every trick. A sole player may buy only their current hand, without further personal draws.

zh.name: 纸牌帮
zh.desc: 合作估牌力:各拿名次筹码,摊牌全对才算赢
zh.rules:
游戏目标：全队合作判断每名玩家的牌力名次。累计赢得 3 局后，全队获胜。
准备:
· 每名玩家获得 2 张底牌，只有持有者可以查看。
· 在中央放置与玩家人数相同的星数筹码。领取 1 星筹码表示认为自己的牌力最弱，星数越多，表示认为自己的牌力越强。
流程:
一局依次进行以下四个阶段：
· 翻牌前阶段，不公开公共牌。
· 翻牌阶段，公开 3 张公共牌。
· 转牌阶段，再公开 1 张公共牌。
· 河牌阶段，再公开最后 1 张公共牌。
· 每个阶段中，任何玩家都可以随时从中央领取一枚筹码，也可以将自己持有的筹码放回中央，再选择另一枚筹码。
· 也可以直接取走另一名玩家持有的筹码；该玩家必须重新选择一枚筹码。
· 全员都持有筹码后,自动进入下一阶段。
胜负:
· 河牌亮出后摊牌,按扑克牌型比较真实牌力。
· 每人持有的星数都与自己的真实名次一致,全队赢下本局;否则记一次失败,失败次数不限。

en.name: The Gang
en.desc: Co-op hand reading: claim rank chips, showdown must match
en.rules:
Goal: cooperate as one gang and correctly call every member’s hand rank in 3 rounds.
Setup:
· Each player holds 2 hole cards, visible only to themselves.
· Star chips sit in the middle, one per player: 1★ claims the weakest hand; more stars claim a stronger one.
Play:
A round proceeds through these four stages:
· During pre-flop, no community cards are revealed.
· During the flop, reveal 3 community cards.
· During the turn, reveal 1 more community card.
· During the river, reveal the final community card.
· During each stage, any player may take a chip from the middle at any time. A player may also return their chip to the middle and choose another one.
· You may even take a chip out of another player’s hand; they must then take a new one.
· Once everyone holds a chip, the next stage begins automatically.
Result:
· After the river, hands are revealed and ranked by poker hand strength.
· If every chip matches its holder’s true rank, the gang wins the round; otherwise it counts as a loss, with no limit on losses.

zh.name: 圣诞魅影
zh.desc: 穿越时空的叫标吃墩:预估赢墩数,在过去/现在/未来各放一张牌
zh.rules:
游戏目标：游戏进行的手数等于玩家人数。完成全部手数后，总分最高的玩家获胜；总分相同则共享胜利。
牌:
· 卡牌分为红心、蜡烛、音符和天平四种花色，每种花色的数字为 1 至 12。三人游戏中，移除各花色数字为 1 至 3 的牌。
· 红心永远是王牌。
每手流程:
· 叫标：从起始玩家开始，每名玩家预测自己本手将赢得的墩数，并且可以选择加上 1 扇红门。
· 使用红门时，实际赢得的墩数等于叫标数，或比叫标数多 1 墩，都视为叫标成功，但每墩只获得 1 分；不使用红门时，每墩获得 2 分。
· 若未满足上述叫标命中条件，本手获得 0 分。
· 出牌共进行 4 轮。每轮中，每名玩家向过去、现在和未来三个时代各放置 1 张牌，可以自行选择放置顺序。
· 每个时代的跟牌花色，由本轮放入该时代的第一张牌决定。手牌中有该花色时，必须跟出该花色的牌。
· 每轮结束时，依次结算过去、现在和未来三个时代的牌墩。
· 计分花色为起始玩家在该时代所出牌的花色(与时代花色无关)。
· 如果牌墩中有红心牌，打出最大红心牌的玩家赢得该墩；否则，打出计分花色中最大牌的玩家赢得该墩。
· 赢得牌墩的玩家接过起始玩家标记，下一墩按该玩家在对应时代所出的牌确定计分花色。
起始玩家不轮换:下一手由上一手最后一墩的赢家担任。

en.name: Ghosts of Christmas
en.desc: Time-traveling trick-taking with bidding: place one card in each era
en.rules:
Goal: play as many hands as there are players; highest total wins (ties share the victory).
Cards:
· The deck has four suits: Hearts, Candles, Notes and Scales, each ranked 1–12. With three players, remove ranks 1–3 from each suit.
· Hearts are always trump.
Each hand:
· Bid: starting from the start player, predict how many tricks you will win; you may add 1 red door.
· Red door: hitting your bid or one more than your bid both count, but each trick is worth only 1 point (2 without a red door).
· Missing the bid scores 0 for the hand.
· Play four rounds in each hand. In every round, each player places one card into each of the three eras—Past, Present and Future—in any order.
· An era suit is set by its first card of the round; you must follow if you can.
· Resolve each round’s tricks in order: Past, Present, then Future.
· The scoring suit is the suit of the card the start player played in that era (not the era suit).
· If the trick contains a Heart, the highest Heart wins; otherwise the highest card of the scoring suit wins.
· The winner takes the start player marker, and the next trick scores off their card.
The start player does not rotate: the winner of the last trick of a hand takes the marker for the next hand.

zh.name: 爆珠发明
zh.desc: 取能、归档、建造、研究,连锁触发你的发明引擎
zh.rules:
目标:用能量弹珠建造发明,触发连锁效果;总分最高者胜。
准备:
· 三个等级牌堆摆开三行展示区;从分配器中滚出 6 颗能量弹珠，组成能量行。
· 每名玩家获得 1 张起始发明。该发明的效果是：执行归档行动时，随机抽取 1 颗能量弹珠。
流程:每回合从四个动作中选一个执行。
· 归档：从展示区领取 1 张发明牌，放入自己的存档区。初始存档上限为 1 张。
· 取能：从能量行领取 1 颗能量弹珠，放入自己的储能环。初始储能上限为 5 颗。
· 建造：选择展示区或自己存档区中的 1 张发明牌，支付费用并完成建造；支付的能量弹珠退回分配器。
· 研究：选择一个等级的发明牌堆，抽取 3 张牌。可以建造或归档其中 1 张，将其余牌放回该牌堆底。
· 已经建造的转换器可以改变能量颜色，或将一份能量转换为两份能量。每个转换器每回合最多使用一次。
· 执行行动时，会触发对应类型的已建发明。可以自行决定这些效果的结算顺序，每张发明牌每回合最多触发一次。
结束：有玩家建造了自己的第 4 张三级发明，或第 16 张发明后，完成当前一轮，再进行终局计分。
· 将卡牌上标示的分数与分数标记相加，得到总分。总分相同时，依次比较已建造的发明数量和剩余能量数量，较多的玩家获胜。

en.name: Gizmos
en.desc: Pick, file, build and research — chain your engine of inventions
en.rules:
Goal: spend energy marbles to build Gizmos and chain effects; most points win.
Setup:
· Arrange the three decks into three display rows and reveal six energy marbles in the energy row.
· Each player starts with one Gizmo whose effect lets them draw one random energy marble whenever they File.
Play: on your turn, perform exactly one of four actions.
· File: take one card from the display and place it in your archive. The archive initially holds one card.
· Pick: take one marble from the energy row and put it in your storage, which initially holds up to five marbles.
· Build: pay to build 1 card from the display or your archive.
· Research: draw three cards from one deck. Build or File one of them, then return the others.
· Built converters recolor or duplicate energy, each once per turn.
· Actions trigger the matching Gizmos you have built. Resolve their effects in any order; each Gizmo can trigger at most once per turn.
End: when a player builds their fourth level-3 Gizmo or their sixteenth Gizmo in total, finish the current round and score the game.
· Add the points printed on your built Gizmos to your victory-point tokens. Break ties by the number of built Gizmos, then by remaining energy marbles.

zh.name: 幽港迷城
zh.desc: 阶段可玩版。选择佣兵与行动牌，在六角地城中合作战斗，发展角色并推进已开放的基础战役。
zh.rules:
队伍与出征：
每位玩家控制一名或多名佣兵，队伍由 2 至 4 名不同职业的佣兵组成。新建佣兵后选择个人任务与携带的手牌，也可以让战役中的已有佣兵出场。全员准备后进入所选场景。

选牌与行动：
每轮从手牌选择两张牌，并选择其中一张的先攻值；讨论时不能透露具体数值或牌名。揭牌后按先攻行动，分别执行一张牌的上半行动与另一张的下半行动，顺序由你决定；也可以改为执行攻击值为 2 的基础攻击，或移动力为 2 的基础移动。

战斗与休息：
攻击按目标分别抽取调整牌。相邻敌人会使远程攻击处于劣势，优势与劣势相互抵消。元素在创造者回合结束后生效，每轮衰减。弃牌可通过休息恢复，但休息需要永久失去一张牌；生命耗尽或无法继续出牌时，佣兵耗尽。

结算与战役：
根据场景目标判定成败，结算经验、金币、宝箱和战役奖励。个人任务完成后在城镇退休，解锁新内容。战役进度由主机保存在本机。目标版本为 2017 年第一版第三印次。本阶段开放部分基础版场景与基础版职业；未开放内容不可进入，全部战役进度与解锁记录会保留。

en.name: Gloomhaven
en.desc: Playable preview. Choose mercenaries and ability cards, fight together in hex-grid dungeons, and progress through the available base campaign.
en.rules:
Party and departure:
Each player controls one or more mercenaries in a party of two to four different classes. Recruit a mercenary and choose a personal quest and hand, or add an existing campaign mercenary to the party. Once everyone is ready, enter the selected scenario.

Planning and actions:
Choose two cards each round and use one card’s initiative. Do not disclose exact numbers or card names during planning. In initiative order, perform one card’s top action and the other card’s bottom action in either order, or substitute a basic Attack 2 or Move 2.

Combat and rest:
Draw attack modifiers separately for each target. Ranged attacks against adjacent enemies have disadvantage; advantage and disadvantage cancel. Infused elements become available at the end of the creator’s turn and wane each round. Rest to recover discarded cards, losing one card permanently. A mercenary becomes exhausted when out of health or unable to play cards.

Results and campaign:
Follow each scenario’s objective, then collect experience, gold, treasures, and campaign rewards. Retire in town after completing a personal quest to unlock new content. The host saves campaign progress on this device. This game uses the 2017 first edition, third printing. Selected base-game scenarios and classes are available. Other content is unavailable; all campaign progress and unlocks remain saved.

zh.name: 光源
zh.desc: 直线数格点亮版图,逐房间比拼点数
zh.rules:
目标:所有房间结算后,胜利分最高者获胜。
准备:
· 两人游戏中，使用版图上斜对角的起始位置；三人或四人游戏中，按指定位置放置各自的起始标记。
· 每名玩家获得 24 枚双面筹码。其中，两面数字分别为 1 和 6、2 和 5、3 和 4 的筹码各有 8 枚。
· 抽取 1 枚筹码，自选一面朝上，放到自己的起始标记上；再抽取 1 枚筹码，秘密保留在手中。
流程:
· 每回合先放置筹码，再抽取一枚筹码。放置时，从自己场上的一枚顶层筹码出发，沿横向或纵向的直线，数出等于该筹码点数的格数。
· 把手中筹码放到数出的落点,任选一面朝上。
· 起点与落点之间有任意筹码则该方向被挡,落点也不能位于版图边界之外。
· 落点已有 1 枚筹码时，无论该筹码属于哪名玩家，都可以在其上叠放。如果落点已有 2 枚筹码，则不能继续叠放。叠放后，只有最上层的筹码参与计分。
· 不能将筹码放在其他玩家的起始标记上。整局游戏中，可以使用一次免计数放置机会，直接将手中筹码叠放到自己的起始标记上。
· 不能主动跳过回合。无法合法放置筹码时，必须使用整局一次的免计数机会；如果该机会已经使用，则退出后续行动，等待终局计分。
结算:
· 所有玩家无筹码可抽,或无人能放置时,逐房间结算。
· 按各自顶层筹码点数总和排名。
· 排名第一的玩家获得 4 分，排名第二的玩家获得 2 分；两人游戏仅为第一名计分。
· 并列第 1 名则都获得 4 分且不发第 2 名的分,并列第 2 名则都获得 2 分。
· 房间里没有筹码的玩家不参与该房间排名。
· 总分最高的玩家获胜。总分相同时，中央九格房间内筹码点数较多的玩家获胜；仍相同时，共享胜利。

en.name: Glüx
en.desc: Count straight lines, light up rooms, outscore rivals
en.rules:
Goal: after every room is scored, the player with the most victory points wins.
Setup:
· With 2 players use the diagonal start squares; with 3-4 players use the illustrated squares (corners for 4).
· Each player has 24 two-sided chips (8 each of 1/6, 2/5, 3/4).
· Draw one chip, choose a face, and place it on your start marker; then draw one more chip and keep it hidden in your hand.
Play:
· On your turn, place then draw: from any of your own top chips, count exactly its pip value in a straight horizontal or vertical line.
· Place your hand chip on the destination square, either face up.
· Any chip between the start and the destination blocks that direction, and you may not count off the board.
· A destination holding a single chip (anyone's) may be stacked on; a stack of two may not. Only the top chip of a stack counts.
· You may never place on another player's start marker. Once per game you may place your chip onto your own start marker without counting.
· No passing. If you cannot place legally, you must use that once-per-game option; if it is already used, you are out until the final scoring.
Scoring:
· When no player can draw a chip, or nobody can place, rooms are scored one by one.
· Sum your top-chip pips per room to rank the players.
· 1st place scores 4 VP, 2nd place 2 VP (in a 2-player game only 1st place scores).
· Tied for 1st: all tied players get 4 VP and no 2nd place is awarded; tied for 2nd: all tied players get 2 VP.
· Players with no chip in a room do not rank in it.
· Most VP wins; ties are broken by pips in the central 3×3 room, and a persisting tie is a shared victory.

zh.name: 教父：柯里昂的帝国
zh.desc: 调遣家族、争夺纽约地盘，将财富藏进行李箱。
zh.rules:
目标：
在四幕中通过商铺和任务获利，将钱存进行李箱。终局比较箱内的钱与奖励总额；平局时比较获得地盘奖励的数量，再平局则共同获胜。
准备：
2–5 人。每家获得两名打手（两人局三名）、一名教父、九枚控制标记，以及 $1、$2、$3 各一张和两张随机任务。第二幕增加顾问，第四幕增加继承人；三种家族成员能力相同。四人开局在 1 号地盘增加蓝色商铺，五人在 1、2、3 号增加。
每幕流程：
每幕依次进行以下步骤：
· 开设商铺。
· 进行家族经营。
· 结算地盘战。
· 进行贿赂。
· 向教父进贡。
· 进行幕间准备。第四幕没有贿赂与幕间准备。
· 第一、二幕开始在编号最小的空位开设蓝色商铺，第三、四幕开设红色商铺。
家族经营：
从马头标记持有者开始，顺时针每人执行一个行动，不能主动跳过。备用区没有自己的棋子时退出本幕，不能再完成任务或使用盟友。所有派遣位置均满且也没有可执行的任务或盟友时，本幕跳过该家族。
· 打手：放到商铺空前门，使用全部前门能力。该地盘若由另一家控制，对方也使用同样能力，由当前行动玩家决定谁先执行。
· 家族成员：放到空圆点，使用所有相邻地盘的全部背门能力，自由安排能力顺序。两人局不能使用标有 3+ 的六个圆点。中央公园只提供存钱能力，不能控制。
· 完成任务：从手中支付指定非法货物，毒品可代替酒、枪或血钱；执行手中或公共任务，领取牌面指定面额的奖金，可以先领奖金或先执行效果。完成的任务放入箱内。公共任务本幕不补充。
· 盟友：从手中打出一张盟友并执行其能力，每幕一次。用过的盟友在进贡前收回手中，也占手牌上限。中立棋子在执行玩家的当前回合后归为同一中立阵营；被枪杀的棋子本幕不能取回。
商铺与钱币：
· 每次存钱能力只能公开存入一张手中的钱；重复图标可分别使用。
· 抽任务能力为抽两张、选一张、弃掉另一张。
· 钱币不得换零钱，供应不足时领取下一档较低面额；货物用尽则不领取。
· 任务堆空时洗入任务弃牌。
地盘战与贿赂：
按 1–7 号地盘逐区比较影响力：区内和相邻圆点的每枚棋子各提供一点。唯一最高的家族叠放一枚控制标记；平局或中立最高均不放置，旧控制标记保留。每家只有九枚，用尽时可以从已有叠层中取回一枚再放置，也可以放弃。
前三幕开始时，各随机展示比玩家人数少一张的本幕盟友牌。各家秘密选择箱内的钱暗拍，可不出钱。按金额从高到低选盟友，平局按当前首家起顺时针。取得盟友者将所出钱币归还供应；未取得者保留出价。不出钱不能取得盟友。
进贡与幕间：
收回用过的盟友后，各家弃置超出本幕上限的手牌：第一幕和第二幕的上限为 5 张，第三幕为 6 张，第四幕为 2 张。钱和货物回供应，任务入弃牌，盟友移除。前三幕结束收回城中及河中的棋子，加入本幕解锁成员，补公共任务空位并更换公共盟友。
终局：
第四幕进贡后将剩余手钱放入箱内，弃掉其他手牌。每个地盘的标记数量最多者获得 $5，同数时比较叠层中各家最高标记的位置。每种任务颜色数量最多且至少有一张者获得 $5，平局均获得。箱内的其他货物或盟友没有价值。

en.name: The Godfather: Corleone’s Empire
en.desc: Deploy your family, control New York, and hide your fortune in a suitcase.
en.rules:
Goal:
After four Acts, win with the most money in your Suitcase plus bonuses. Break a tie by the number of Turf Dominance Bonuses; a further tie is a shared victory.
Setup:
For 2–5 players. Each Family starts with two Thugs (three with two players), one Don, nine Control markers, one $1, $2 and $3 card, and two random Jobs. Add the Consigliere in Act II and the Heir in Act IV. All Family Members have the same abilities. Start an extra Blue Business in Turf 1 with four players, or Turfs 1, 2 and 3 with five.
Each Act:
Complete these steps in order:
· Open a Business.
· Conduct Family Business.
· Resolve Turf Wars.
· Bribe Allies.
· Pay Tribute.
· Prepare the next Act. Act IV has no Bribery or Entr’acte. Open a Blue Business in Acts I–II or a Red one in Acts III–IV, in the lowest-numbered empty Business space.
Family Business:
Starting with the Horse Head holder, take one action clockwise. You cannot pass voluntarily. Once no Family figures remain in your reserve, you leave the Act and cannot complete Jobs or play Allies. A Family with no legal placement, Job or Ally action is skipped for this Act.
· Thug: occupy an empty Business Front and use all its abilities. If another Family controls its Turf, that Family uses the same abilities; the active player chooses who goes first.
· Family Member: occupy an empty round space and use all the Backs of every Business in all adjacent Turfs, in any order. Six spaces marked 3+ are unavailable with two players. Central Park only offers a Suitcase ability and cannot be controlled.
· Job: discard its required Illegal Goods from your hand. Narcotics can replace Booze, Guns or Blood Money. Complete a Job from your hand or the public display, taking its exact Money cards and executing its effect, in either order. Place the completed Job in your Suitcase. Public Jobs are not replenished during an Act.
· Ally: play an Ally from your hand and use its ability once per Act. Played Allies return to your hand before Tribute and count toward the hand limit. Neutral figures form a single neutral faction after the acting player’s turn. Gunned-down figures cannot return before the next Act.
Businesses and Money:
Each Suitcase icon lets you reveal and bank one Money card from your hand. Repeated icons can be used separately. A Job draw means draw two, keep one, discard the other. Never make change. If a Money pile is empty, take the next lower available denomination. Empty Goods piles give nothing; recycle discarded Jobs when their deck is empty.
Turf Wars and Bribery:
Resolve Turfs 1–7. Each figure in a Turf or on an adjacent round space has one Influence. The unique leading Family places a Control marker on the stack. Ties and a neutral lead place none; older markers remain. A Family has only nine markers; when depleted, it may reuse one from an existing stack or decline.
In each of the first three Acts, display player count minus one random Allies for that Act. Secretly select Money cards from your Suitcase, including none. Choose Allies in descending bid order, breaking ties clockwise from the first player. Only winners pay their exact cards to the supply. Losing bids remain in the Suitcase; zero bids cannot take Allies.
Tribute and Entr’acte:
Return played Allies, then discard to at most 5, 5, 6 or 2 hand cards in Acts I–IV. Money and Goods return to supply, Jobs are discarded, Allies leave the game. Between Acts, recover all figures from the city and river, unlock the new Family Member, replenish missing Public Jobs and change the Ally display.
Final accounting:
After Act IV Tribute, bank remaining hand Money and discard other hand cards. Each Turf awards $5 to the Family with the most markers, breaking ties by whose highest marker is higher in the stack. Each Job colour awards $5 to every tied leader with at least one card. Other Goods and Allies in a Suitcase have no value.
