zh.name: 五猜缤纷
zh.desc: 看得见别人的数字，却看不见自己的。利用分类与点数比较，率先猜出五个数字。
zh.rules:
目标：
率先按升序猜出自己牌架上的五个数字。每人只有一次猜答机会。
准备：
共有 60 张数字牌，号码为 1—60，分为绿、粉、蓝、红、橙五种颜色，每张有 1—3 个点。每位玩家每色抽取一张，系统按数字升序摆入五槽。你只能看到自己牌背的颜色，可以看到所有对手的号码和点数。中央另公开每色一张牌。数字版由首席先手。
回合：
先从仍有余牌的颜色中选择一种，随机公开一张牌。再从中央六张公开牌中选一张，进行以下一项提问。用过的牌留作公开线索，轮到下一位未淘汰玩家。
· 分类：系统将所选牌放在自己五张牌之间的正确缺口，表示它在升序中的位置。
· 比较：选择自己牌架上的一个槽位，系统回答该牌与所选公开牌的点数是否相同，颜色无需相同。
记录：
记录板显示全部牌的颜色、数字及点数。可见的牌自动划去；点击其他牌可以添加或取消个人排除记号。所有公开线索保留到终局，随时可以重新推理。
结束：
未淘汰玩家随时都能点击“五猜缤纷！”并按升序输入五个数字。全部猜对立即获胜；有任何错误即淘汰。只剩一位未淘汰玩家时，该玩家自动获胜。淘汰者的牌架仍可见，但不再进行回合。
特殊情况：
若当前玩家在翻牌后猜错，下一位玩家沿用这六张公开牌直接提问，不再翻牌。牌堆用尽后不补牌，此时本人五个数字已可从全部可见牌中排除得出，所有未淘汰玩家继续有权猜答。

en.name: Got Five!
en.desc: See everyone’s numbers except your own. Categorise, compare dots, and be first to identify your five numbers.
en.rules:
Goal:
Be first to guess your five numbers in ascending order. Each player gets one attempt.
Setup:
There are 60 unique tiles numbered 1–60, in green, pink, blue, red, and orange, each bearing 1–3 dots. Each player receives one tile of each colour, sorted in ascending order. You see only the colours of your own tiles and the numbers and dots on everyone else’s. One tile of each colour starts face up in the centre. The first seat starts in this digital edition.
Turn:
Choose a colour with tiles remaining and reveal a random tile. Choose one of the six central face-up tiles and ask for one clue. The chosen tile remains as a public clue, then the next surviving player takes a turn.
· Categorise: the system puts the chosen tile in the correct notch among your five numbers, showing its relative position.
· Compare: choose a slot on your rack. The system says whether its tile and the chosen face-up tile have the same number of dots. Their colours need not match.
Notes:
Your board lists every tile’s colour, number, and dots. Visible tiles are crossed out automatically. Click other tiles to add or remove private elimination marks. Public clues remain available until the game ends, so you can reconsider your deductions.
End:
Any surviving player may declare “Got Five!” at any time and enter their five numbers in ascending order. A fully correct guess wins immediately. Any mistake eliminates that player. The last surviving player wins automatically. Eliminated players’ racks remain visible, but they take no further turns.
Edge cases:
If the current player guesses incorrectly after revealing a tile, the next player asks using those six tiles without another draw. When the supply runs out, no tiles are recycled: every hidden number is deducible by elimination, and all surviving players may still guess.

zh.name: 大西部开拓者
zh.desc: 经营牛群，建造西部小镇，沿铁路将优质牛群运往东部。
zh.rules:
版本：
2021 年《大西部开拓者：第二版》，包含官方 Sam 单人模式与可选 Simmental。基础版默认关闭 Simmental；不含北方铁路。
目标：
游戏结束后总分最高者获胜，同分共享胜利。
回合：
A 移动牧人；B 使用到达地点；C 补牌至手牌上限。首次行动可选择任意中立建筑，之后从当前位置沿箭头前进 1 至步数上限。仅占用地点消耗步数，空地不消耗。经过或停在带手掌的地点时支付费用；钱不足也可移动，只支付现有金额。
地点：
自己或中立建筑的每组行动可各执行一次，任意顺序；组内“或”只能选一项。全部放弃时可改做一次单辅助行动。其他玩家建筑、灾害、匪徒地点只能做一次单辅助行动。私人建筑的风险行动同样计入当地行动。移动牧人的建筑会在新地点再次执行 B；目标卡移动则不使用新地点，且不能进入堪萨斯城。
手牌与牛群：
通常手牌上限 4，可解锁至 6。回合末补足。抽牌堆耗尽时洗混弃牌堆。行动所弃牌置入弃牌堆，只有明确移除的牌离开游戏。交换标记可在任意玩家回合中花费一个，先抽 1 或 2 张，再弃相同数量。
雇工：
只能雇佣市场标记所在行上方的工人，支付对应行费用及行动修正。各职业最多 6 人，包括玩家板印刷的一人。新工人进入带奖励格时可执行该奖励；任命站长会让工人数减少，之后重新填入可再次获得奖励。
建造：
选择未使用的本方建筑，建筑师数必须足够；按所需建筑师支付费用。可升级自己的建筑，只需补足建筑师差额与费用；旧建筑移出游戏。本次停留不能使用刚替换的新建筑行动。树林与风险地块按原版地图生效。
买牛：
使用可用牛仔及现金，从市场购买并放入弃牌堆；可拆分使用牛仔。
· 购买普通价值 3 的牛牌时，可以使用 1 名牛仔支付 6 美元购买一张，使用 2 名牛仔支付 3 美元购买一张，或使用 3 名牛仔支付 5 美元购买两张。
· 购买价值 4 的牛牌时，可以使用 1 名牛仔支付 12 美元购买一张，使用 3 名牛仔支付 6 美元购买一张，或使用 5 名牛仔支付 8 美元购买两张。
· 购买价值 5 的牛牌时，可以使用 2 名牛仔支付 12 美元购买一张，或使用 4 名牛仔支付 6 美元购买一张。
也可用一位牛仔向市场增添 2 张牌。
铁路：
前进至多指定步数，至少一步；忽略被其他火车占用的格。侧线算额外一格。停在车站侧线时可支付费用，从玩家板取圆片升级该站；每人每站一次。可用一个已雇工人交换尚在的站长。到 39 格后必须后退至少一格并获得 3 美元，还可升级落点车站。
堪萨斯城：
依次从三个展望区各选一块，立即放入对应区域；工人填满所在行才推动市场标记，填满第 6、9 行时补牛市场。然后展示整手牌，每种牛只计算一张最高繁殖值，加永久证书及自愿消耗的临时证书；获得相同美元并弃掉手牌。按该繁殖值或以下城市交付，放一个玩家板圆片，支付火车至城市之间每个运输十字 1 美元。除堪萨斯城和纽约外，每城限一次。相邻城市都有本方圆片时获得连接奖励或分数。交付后牧人返回起点，补展望区，再补手牌。
圆片：
黑角圆片通常只能放黑角城市或车站，白角可任意放。移除提高手牌上限的圆片时，须额外支付 5 美元。仅余黑角圆片时可放白角；无可支付的圆片时可从车站回收。解锁 6 证书前仍须先解锁 4，才提高证书上限。
目标：
自己回合移动前或执行当地行动期间可打出手中目标，获得一次性行动并承诺其任务。终局每件资源仅可满足一张目标；已打出目标失败会扣分。未打出的目标可选择加入或移除。目标按符合规则且总分最高的方案自动结算，并逐张显示计分明细。
终局：
填满工作市场最后一格的玩家领取市场标记，并完成自己的最后一个回合；随后，其他玩家各再行动一次。依次计算现金、建筑、城市连接、车站、灾害、牛牌、目标、站长、工人第 5/6 格、步数解锁与市场标记共 11 项得分。
Sam：
单人按双人设置，Sam 使用官方 15 张行动卡（简单移除 13–15），独立移动并执行卡牌行动，按专长购买、建造和前进铁路；不使用钱币或牛群抽牌。普通从布卢明顿开始交付，困难从皮奥里亚开始并增加三种工人各一。Sam 所有目标都视为完成，且不计现金、站长和玩家板解锁分。
Simmental：
市场增加 8 张一阶段牛及 2 张展示容量。购买一张一阶段牛牌时，可以使用 1 名牛仔支付 8 美元，或使用 2 名牛仔支付 5 美元。堪萨斯城领取收入后，可将手中的一、二阶段牛分别升级一阶段并放弃牌堆。同一品种各阶段计算收入时只算一张；指定普通价值 3/4/5 的目标与弃牌条件不包含 Simmental。

en.name: Great Western Trail
en.desc: Build your ranch, improve your herd and deliver cattle to the cities of the East.
en.rules:
Edition: Great Western Trail: Second Edition (2021). Includes official Sam solo mode and optional Simmental. Rails to the North is not included.
Goal: highest final score wins; ties share victory.
Turn:
Complete these three steps in order:
· Move your herder.
· Use the location you reach.
· Refill your hand.
On your first turn, start at any neutral building. Later follow the arrows forward 1 to your movement limit. Empty spaces cost no steps. Pay the fees shown by hand symbols along the route; if short of money, pay only what you have.
Locations: use each local action group once, in any order; choose one alternative in an OR group. If you use none, you may take one single auxiliary action instead. On opponents’ buildings, hazards and outlaws you may only take one single auxiliary action. Risk actions count as local actions. A building herder movement lets you use the new location; objective movement does not, and cannot enter Kansas City.
Herd: hand limit starts at 4 and can reach 6. Refill at turn end. Reshuffle your discard pile only when you need to draw from an empty stack. Discarded cards remain in your herd unless explicitly removed. Exchange tokens can interrupt any turn: spend one, draw 1 or 2, then discard the same number.
Hire: hire from rows above the job market token, paying row cost plus the action adjustment. Each worker type has at most six including the printed starting worker. Filling bonus spaces allows their immediate actions; hiring again after appointing a station master can trigger them again.
Build: use sufficient builders and pay the cost per builder. Replacing your own building only uses and pays the difference; the replaced tile leaves play. You cannot use a newly replaced building during the current stop. Woods and risk spaces retain their board effects.
Buy cattle: assign cowboys and pay the purchase price. Acquired cards go to your discard pile.
· For a value-3 cow, use 1 cowboy and pay $6 for one card, use 2 cowboys and pay $3 for one card, or use 3 cowboys and pay $5 for two cards.
· For a value-4 cow, use 1 cowboy and pay $12 for one card, use 3 cowboys and pay $6 for one card, or use 5 cowboys and pay $8 for two cards.
· For a value-5 cow, use 2 cowboys and pay $12 for one card, or use 4 cowboys and pay $6 for one card.
You may split your cowboys between purchases, or use one cowboy to add two cards to the market.
Railroad: move at least one and up to the allowed spaces; ignore occupied spaces. A turnout is an extra space. On a turnout you may pay to upgrade the station by placing a player disc, once per player per station. You may appoint a hired worker to acquire its available station master. Reaching space 39 forces a backward movement and awards $3; you may also upgrade the station where you land.
Kansas City: choose one tile in each foresight pair, placing it immediately. Workers advance the job market; filling rows 6/9 refills cattle. Reveal your entire hand: count only the highest value of each breed, plus permanent certificates and any temporary certificates you spend. Gain that many dollars and discard your hand. Deliver to a city at or below that value, place a player board disc and pay $1 per transport cross beyond your engine. Each city is once only except Kansas City and New York. Adjacent delivered cities unlock links. Return to the trail start, refill foresight, then refill your hand.
Discs: dark-corner discs normally require dark-corner destinations. Hand-limit discs cost $5 to clear. If only dark discs remain, white destinations are allowed. If no disc can be removed, reuse a station disc. Clearing the 6-certificate space only works after clearing the 4-certificate space.
Objectives: play from hand before movement or during local actions to take their immediate action and commit to the tasks. Each resource can fulfil only one objective. Played failures lose points. At scoring, unplayed objectives may be added or removed. The game automatically selects the highest legal score allocation and lists every included objective and result.
End: filling the final job space triggers the final round. That player completes their last turn; each other player gets one final turn. Score eleven categories: money, buildings, cities/links, stations, hazards, cattle, objectives, station masters, fifth/sixth worker slots, movement unlock and job market token.
Sam: solo uses two-player setup and official action cards; easy removes cards 13–15. Sam moves and acts according to the card and his specialization, without money or a herd draw deck. Deliveries start at Bloomington (Peoria on hard, with one extra worker of each type). All Sam objectives succeed; he scores no money, station master or player-board unlock points.
Simmental: add eight stage-1 cards and two market spaces. To buy one stage-1 cow, use one cowboy and pay $8, or use two cowboys and pay $5. After taking Kansas City income, upgrade any stage-1/2 cards in your hand by one stage and put the new cards in your discard pile. All stages are one breed for income. Specific ordinary value-3/4/5 tasks exclude Simmental.

search.py: da xi bu kai tuo zhe

zh.name: 灰月
zh.desc: 在四季流转中召集村民、招募同伴，踏上旅途并传颂冒险故事。
zh.rules:
目标:
五年结束后，总分最高的玩家获胜，平分共享胜利。总分包括即时分、任务、物品、同伴及技能奖励。
准备:
每人有3名活跃村民、4名储备村民、8枚钱币、0 点力量及 0 点魔法。城镇每年翻开9张牌组成3行3列的牌阵，并在两人、三人或四人游戏中，分别翻开 5 张、6 张或 7 张遭遇牌及1个事件；3项随机任务放在距离3、4、5的区域。第一、二时期各移除2张城镇牌。
季节与回合:
玩家按顺时针方向行动，但各自独立推进季节。春季可以选择以下行动之一：
· 将 1 名活跃村民放在两张相邻城镇牌之间的内街，其中一格为空也可以。内街不限制村民人数。
· 参加本年的事件。
· 转入夏季，并立即进行一次夏季行动。
夏季可从街道取回自己的1名村民并选择相邻牌：领取等于其余相邻村民数的钱币，或支付牌费及其余相邻村民数的钱币来使用建筑、购买物品或招募同伴。取回的村民进入营地；两侧均为空时仍可取回，但不获钱币。建筑保留，物品和同伴取走。同伴固定花费 7 枚钱币并立即获得1名村民，最多3张；物品默认最多3张，超出时自行弃置，立即奖励先结算。同伴和次元袋可提高物品上限。
夏季还可横置物品并支付其费用，或使用每年一次的特殊行动：支付1名活跃村民，移动至多1格、获得 1 点魔法，或讲故事。事件每人每年仅参加一次；春季参加事件时使用活跃村民；夏季也可以取回街道上自己的村民来参加事件。节庆的位置互斥，玩家秋季离开后可复用。
仅当街道上没有自己的村民时才能转入秋季：冒险者回村，营地、事件及特殊行动的村民回到活跃区，竖置全部牌，领取3枚钱币，但每拥有一名同伴就少领取1枚钱币；此外，领取所有收入标记的奖励。各玩家均到秋季后开始新年，起始玩家左移；第五年也领取收入。
冒险、反应与故事:
移动不超过所示距离，可向任一方向或停留。到达后可解决1张该区域的遭遇牌，或领取区域替代奖励（距离为 1 的区域获得 1 枚钱币，距离为 2 的区域获得 1 分），或完成距离3至5的任务。遭遇可选左侧、右侧或两侧，所有所选条件必须在领取任何奖励之前同时满足并支付；额外移动最后结算。将完成的遭遇收入未讲故事区。
每人每项任务仅完成一次，在距离 3、4、5 的任务中，首位完成者依次获得 7 分、8 分、9 分终局分数；后来完成者依次获得 5 分、6 分、7 分。
同伴及药水在对应动作的反应窗口使用；药水弃置，拥有塞莉娅时改为横置。同伴的永久效果横置后仍生效。临时技能值可以超过5点，但不能作为真实技能支付，不产生溢出分；忽略条件只适用于遭遇，不能用于任务。
讲故事将未讲遭遇移入已讲区，总故事值最多3，逐层累计领取酒馆奖励。使用的每张遭遇牌都必须贡献故事值，并遵守以下限制：
· 不能使用故事值为0的牌。
· 故事值为3的牌不能与其他牌搭配。
· 可以将两张故事值为2的牌合计按3点故事值计算。
瑟伦或魅力药水可以将一张遭遇牌的故事值变为3。酒馆无封印时仍可讲故事，只跳过依赖封印的一层。
计分与结束:
力量与魔法的上限各为5点，每溢出1点立即获得 1 分。即时分首次达到8和20时，各选一个未用奖励：5 枚钱币、1 点力量及 1 点魔法，或 1 名村民；达到20后弃掉其余奖励。终局计分不触发奖励。
第五年秋季结束后，将任务、保留物品及同伴的终局分数加入总分。力量和魔法均达到 3 点时，额外获得 2 分；两者均达到 5 点时，这项奖励改为 5 分。

en.name: Greylune
en.desc: Gather villagers, recruit companions and tell the stories of five years of adventure.
en.rules:
Goal:
After five years, the highest total of immediate points, quests, items, companions and skills wins. Ties are shared.
Setup:
Each player starts with 3 active villagers, 4 in reserve, 8 coins, and no Strength or Magic. Each year has a 3×3 village, five encounters with two players, six with three, or seven with four and one event. Three random quests occupy areas 3, 4 and 5. Remove two village cards from each of periods I and II.
Seasons and turns:
Players take turns clockwise but advance through seasons independently. In Spring, choose one of these actions:
· Place one active villager in an internal gap between two adjacent village slots, at least one containing a card. Gaps have no occupancy limit.
· Attend this year’s event.
· Enter Summer and immediately take a Summer action.
In Summer, retrieve one of your villagers from a gap and name an adjacent card. Gain coins equal to all other villagers around it, or pay its printed cost plus one coin per other adjacent villager to activate a building, buy an item or recruit a companion. The villager goes to camp. If both slots are empty, you may still retrieve it for no coins. Buildings stay; purchased cards leave. A companion costs 7 coins, brings one villager and is limited to three. Items normally have a limit of three; choose discards after immediate gains. Some companions and the Bag of Holding raise this limit.
You may also exhaust an item and pay its cost, or use your annual special action: spend one active villager to travel up to one space, gain one Magic or tell a story. Attend the event once per year using an active villager, or in Summer one from the village. Festival spaces are exclusive but become available when their occupant enters Autumn.
Enter Autumn only when none of your villagers remain in the village. Return your adventurer home, recover villagers from camp, the event and the special action, ready every card and gain three coins, reduced by one coin per companion, and collect all income-token rewards. When everyone reaches Autumn, start a new year and pass the first-player token left. Income is also collected in year five.
Adventures, reactions and stories:
Travel up to the given distance in either direction, including staying put. Resolve one encounter in your destination, take the alternative reward (one coin in area 1 or one point in area 2), or complete the quest in areas 3–5. Choose either encounter side or both. All selected requirements must be met and paid together before any reward. Extra travel is resolved last. Keep resolved encounters as untold stories. Each player may complete each quest once. For quests in areas 3, 4 and 5, the first player to finish scores 7, 8 and 9 final points respectively; later finishers score 5, 6 and 7 respectively.
Use companions and potions at their matching reaction windows. Potions are discarded, or exhausted instead with Selia. Permanent companion powers still work while exhausted. Temporary skills may exceed 5 but cannot be spent as real skills and give no overflow points. Ignoring a requirement works on encounters, never on quests.
Tell stories by moving untold encounters to the told area, with a total story value capped at 3; receive all reached tavern tiers. Each encounter card used must contribute story value, subject to these restrictions:
· A card with story value 0 cannot be used.
· A card with story value 3 must be used alone.
· Two cards with story value 2 may count as a combined story value of 3. Seren or the Charisma Potion may turn one encounter into a 3. A tavern without seals still hears stories, skipping only the tier requiring a seal.
Scoring and end:
Strength and Magic are capped at 5; each excess permanent point immediately scores 1 VP. On first reaching 8 and 20 immediate VP, choose an unused bonus: 5 coins, one Strength and one Magic, or one villager. At 20 discard all remaining bonuses. Final scoring never triggers bonuses.
After Autumn of year five, add quest, retained item and companion scores. Having both skills at least 3 gives 2 points; having both at 5 gives 5 instead.

zh.name: 丰收季节
zh.desc: 双人农场牌库构筑:浇水收割赚金币,投资升级农场,先填满版图者胜
zh.rules:
游戏目标：
率先填满自己农场版图的玩家立即获胜。填满版图上的每一格，需要投资 10 枚金币。
游戏准备：
· 每名玩家获得 3 块基础地块、3 枚金币和一副由 15 张牌组成的起始牌组，其中包括 10 张浇水卡和 5 张收割卡。
· 先手玩家预先种植一株收割价值为 2 枚金币的小麦；后手玩家预先种植一株收割价值为 3 枚金币的小麦。
· 在中央分别翻开 5 张作物牌、3 张铁匠工具牌和 3 张农场升级牌，组成各自的商品陈列区。
回合流程：
每个回合依次进行以下阶段：
· 抽取 5 张牌。自己的牌组始终由 15 张牌组成；抽牌堆用完时，将弃牌堆洗混，组成新的抽牌堆。
· 结算自动装置和动物的效果。
· 为作物浇水，并收割成熟作物。
· 进行挖矿，或弃置手牌。
· 购买商品。
· 结束回合。
浇水与收割：
· 浇水卡提供的每一点浇水能力，可以分别用于不同的作物。作物已经获得的浇水进度会保留。
· 轨道上的编号格是集收格。作物到达集收格时，立即获得该格所示的金币，不需要消耗收割卡。
· 作物到达轨道末端的镰刀格时即为成熟。消耗收割卡提供的 1 点收割能力，可以收割一株成熟作物，并获得等于其收割价值的金币。
· 一张卡提供多点收割能力时，必须将这些能力分别用于不同的作物。
· 收割后的作物牌放入独立的作物弃牌堆，不加入玩家自己的牌组。
挖矿与购买：
· 进行挖矿时，弃置 2 张本回合尚未使用的手牌，再翻开 1 张矿牌，按照该牌的结果获得金币。若翻出石头，则不获得金币。
· 购买商品前，必须先使用或弃置全部手牌。店铺陈列区要等到你的回合结束后才补充商品。
· 购买铁匠工具时，先支付费用，再从自己的弃牌堆中选择 1 张同类型的卡牌，将它移出游戏；随后将新获得的工具牌放入自己的弃牌堆。
农场与投资：
· 在购买阶段，每支付 10 枚金币，可以填满自己版图上的一格；同一回合可以填满多格。
· 填满谷仓格时，从农场升级陈列区选择 1 张升级牌，并立即安装该升级。
· 在长局中，填满浅蓝色工具格时，免费获得铁匠铺当前陈列的全部工具。
· 动物从安装后的下一个回合开始，按其产出周期提供收益。
· 每个回合开始时，洒水器为全部作物各提供 1 点浇水能力，收割机则收割所有成熟作物。
· 肥料使每次收割额外获得 1 枚金币。阶梯地块只会提高与其阶梯等级相同的作物的收割收益。
钓鱼变体：
启用此变体后，以钓鱼代替挖矿。
· 弃置任意数量本回合尚未使用的手牌，将它们的捕鱼值相加；每张基础卡的捕鱼值为 0.5。随后逐张翻开鱼牌。
· 鱼牌上的鱼图标数量小于剩余捕鱼值时，捕获这条鱼，并从剩余捕鱼值中扣除相应的图标数量。
· 鱼牌上的鱼图标数量大于或等于剩余捕鱼值时，发生翻船：失去这条鱼和此前最后捕获的一条鱼，其余已捕获鱼的收益仍可结算。
高级工具变体：
· 秘银工具提供 1 点浇水能力和 1 点收割能力；铱金工具提供 2 点浇水能力和 2 点收割能力。
· 同一张高级工具牌的浇水能力和收割能力必须用于不同的作物。
· 购买高级工具时，可以选择用它替换水壶或镰刀。
其他版图变体：
· 使用快速版图时，在游戏开始前轮流挑选升级牌；每名玩家预先安装 3 个升级。
· 使用长局版图时，农场版图共有 15 格。填满整块版图共需投资 150 枚金币，过程中可以获得八次升级。

en.name: Growing Season
en.desc: A two-player farming deck-builder: water, harvest, invest — first to fill the board wins
en.rules:
Objective:
The first player to fill their farm board wins immediately. Filling each square requires an investment of 10 coins.
Setup:
· Each player receives 3 basic plots, 3 coins, and a 15-card starting deck containing 10 watering cards and 5 harvest cards.
· The first player plants wheat with a harvest value of 2 coins; the second player plants wheat with a harvest value of 3 coins.
· Reveal 5 crop cards, 3 blacksmith tool cards, and 3 farm upgrade cards in their respective displays.
Turn sequence:
During each turn, complete these phases in order:
· Draw 5 cards. Your deck always contains 15 cards; when the draw pile runs out, shuffle your discard pile to form a new draw pile.
· Resolve the effects of machines and animals.
· Water crops and harvest ripe crops.
· Mine or discard hand cards.
· Buy goods.
· End your turn.
Watering and harvesting:
· You may assign each point provided by a watering card to a different crop. Crops retain the watering progress they have already gained.
· The numbered spaces on a crop’s track are gathering spaces. When a crop reaches one, immediately gain the coins shown there without spending a harvest card.
· A crop becomes ripe when it reaches the sickle space at the end of its track. Spend 1 harvest point to harvest 1 ripe crop and gain coins equal to its harvest value.
· If a card provides multiple harvest points, you must use those points on different crops.
· Put harvested crop cards into a separate crop discard pile rather than your own deck.
Mining and buying:
· To mine, discard 2 hand cards that you have not used this turn, then reveal 1 mining card and gain coins according to its result. If you reveal a stone, gain no coins.
· Before buying goods, you must use or discard every card in your hand. Shops refill their displays only after your turn ends.
· To buy a blacksmith tool, first pay its cost, then Remove 1 card of the same type from your discard pile from the game. Put the new tool into your discard pile.
Farm investment:
· During the buying phase, each payment of 10 coins fills 1 square on your board. You may fill multiple squares during the same turn.
· When you fill a barn square, choose 1 upgrade from the farm upgrade display and install it immediately.
· In a long game, when you fill a light-blue tool square, gain all tools currently in the blacksmith’s display for free.
· Animals provide benefits according to their production cycles, starting on the turn after installation.
· At the start of each turn, the sprinkler provides 1 watering point to every crop, and the harvester harvests every ripe crop.
· Fertiliser grants 1 additional coin each time you harvest. A tiered plot increases harvest income only for crops of the matching tier.
Fishing variant:
This variant replaces mining with fishing.
· Discard any number of hand cards you have not used this turn and add their fishing values together. Each basic card has a fishing value of 0.5. Then reveal fish cards one at a time.
· If a card has fewer fish icons than your remaining fishing value, catch that fish and subtract its number of icons from your remaining value.
· If a card has at least as many fish icons as your remaining value, your boat capsizes. Lose that fish and the fish you caught most recently; you may still collect the income from your other catches.
Advanced tool variant:
· A Mythril tool provides 1 watering point and 1 harvest point. An Iridium tool provides 2 watering points and 2 harvest points.
· You must use the watering and harvesting provided by the same advanced tool card on different crops.
· When buying an advanced tool, you may use it to replace either a watering can or a sickle.
Other board variants:
· With the quick board, draft upgrade cards before the game and start with 3 upgrades installed per player.
· With the long-game board, your farm has 15 squares. Filling the whole board requires a total investment of 150 coins and provides eight upgrades along the way.

zh.name: 军扇：兰波城之战
zh.desc: 七大氏族争夺都城，构筑指令，争取七项成就
zh.rules:
目标：
率先获得7项成就。成就包括两次进攻胜利、两个不同的氏族目标、建造两栋建筑、购买三张战术牌、用完三个贵族行动、同时控制两座神社、首次占领都城、持有三个村庄标记，以及持续控制都城。只有持续控制都城的成就会失去。
准备：
按随机确定的玩家顺序选择氏族和适用的堡垒位置。每个氏族有15名士兵、3位英雄、2张氏族战术牌、2张私密中立战术牌、2张特殊指令牌和3张目标牌。按人数使用小版图或大版图，并调整指令牌库。
回合：
· 从5张公开指令牌中选择1张并支付费用。若其中至少4张同色，或至少4张需要支付费用，可以在选牌前弃置整行并重新补牌。将所选牌放到同色指令列，从新到旧激活该列全部指令，再执行氏族板上的行动；可以跳过指令和板上行动。红底战斗图标在所有列持续生效。
· 扩张列获得1枚钱币或1份木材，然后可以建造建筑、购买战术牌。
·  征募列招募1名士兵并移动1次。
·  影响列获得1点影响力并移动1次。
·  军备列提供战斗时基础掷3枚骰子、保留2枚的能力，并允许移动1次。
· 购买额外移动时，军备列支付钱币，征募列支付影响力，影响列支付木材。
贵族：
· 可以将所选指令牌面朝下覆盖一个未使用的贵族行动，另行支付对应费用。
· 支付1点影响力：再选择一张指令牌并支付其费用，将其放在任意列并激活。
·  支付2点影响力：招募一位氏族英雄并激活任意列。
·  支付3点影响力：放置一张氏族特殊指令牌并激活其列。
· 每项贵族行动每局只能使用一次。
移动：
每次将一支军队的部分或全部士兵移动到相邻领地，可以拆分或合并军队。普通领地内每个氏族最多有5名士兵，堡垒和营地不受此上限限制。只能进入自己的堡垒。英雄必须随军移动，堡垒外通常每格最多有1位己方英雄。每次移动只能在之前或之后传送一次，可以支付1点影响力，在自己的堡垒与瞭望塔之间或不同瞭望塔之间传送军队。首支进入都城的军队必须具有至少5点军力，并结束本回合的全部移动；之后进入都城不再要求5点军力。进入敌军所在领地立即触发战斗并终止本回合全部移动，但仍须完成指令列内的其他效果。
建筑与战术：
激活扩张列时，可以分别支付3份木材和2份木材建造独有建筑和营地。建造地点必须有己方军队、与己方军队相邻，或与自己的堡垒相邻，且不能有敌军、板块或标记。没有军队的建筑归原建造者控制；敌军占领建筑时，可以使用其效果。每人最多购买3张战术牌。未购买的中立战术牌只向本人显示。
战斗：
先处理战斗开始时的能力，再由防守方掷骰、重掷并选留，最后由进攻方处理骰子。最多掷6枚骰子。敌方杀伤减去己方护甲决定士兵损失；通常士兵损失不降低已经计算的军力。军力相同时，按进攻方军力较高处理。军力较高的一方必须仍有士兵存活，才算获胜并取得奖励；否则本次战斗没有胜者，另一方仍须撤退。胜者从败方选择一个村庄标记，并获得标记奖励；败军一起撤退到自己的堡垒或一栋己方控制的建筑。进攻胜利最多提供两项成就，部分氏族目标必须与进攻胜利成就二选一。
回合结束：
处理建筑和英雄效果，收取己方控制的村庄标记及其隐藏奖励，最多持有3个村庄标记。控制神社可以取得对应升级，升级保留到其他玩家取得它。占领都城可以取得扩张升级和相关成就。所有玩家中，若有玩家在版图上的士兵不足3名，该玩家向自己的堡垒补充士兵，直到版图上共有3名士兵。最后补足公开指令牌，再轮到下一位玩家。
升级：
· 军备列改为掷4枚骰子、保留2枚。
·  征募列招募2名士兵。
·  影响列获得2点影响力。
·  扩张列同时获得1枚钱币和1份木材。
· 各氏族卡牌的完整能力可以在对局内查看。
数字版补充规则：
官方规则未说明全部可流通指令均无法支付的情况。仅当当前玩家无法支付公开行、牌堆和弃牌堆中任意一张指令的费用时（反复清行也无法取得指令），本回合不获得新的指令牌，直接选择一列进行激活；这次不能使用贵族行动，其余流程照常。

en.name: Gunsen: The Battle for Toshi Ranbo
en.desc: Draft orders, lead the Great Clans, and claim seven achievements
en.rules:
Goal: be first to claim seven achievements: two attacking wins, two different clan goals, building both buildings, buying three tactics, using all three nobles, controlling two shrines at once, first claiming Toshi Ranbo, holding three village tokens, and maintaining control of Toshi Ranbo. Only the last achievement can be lost.
Setup: choose clans and eligible forts in randomly determined player order. Each clan has 15 troops, three heroes, two clan tactics, two private neutral tactics, two special orders, and three goals. Use the correct map and order deck for the player count.
Turn: choose one of five faceup orders and pay its cost. Before choosing, you may clear the row if at least four orders share a color or at least four have a cost. Add the card to its matching column, activate orders from newest to oldest, then perform printed actions. Effects may be skipped. Red combat symbols apply across all columns and are not gained resources.
· Expand gains one koku or wood, builds, and buys tactics.
· Recruit recruits one troop and moves once.
· Influence gains one influence and moves once.
· Armory provides the base roll three, keep two, and moves once.
· Extra movement costs koku in Armory, Influence in Recruit, or wood in Influence.
Nobles: cover an unused noble spot with the chosen order and pay for one of these actions:
· Pay one influence to take another order, pay its cost, place it in any column and activate that column.
· Pay two influence to recruit a clan hero and activate any column.
· Pay three influence to add a clan special order and activate its matching column.
Each noble can be used once per game.
Movement: move any part of an army one adjacent territory, splitting or combining armies. Normally at most five troops per clan occupy a territory; forts and camps are unlimited. Only your own fort can be entered. Heroes travel with troops, normally at most one per territory outside your fort. Once per movement, either before or after it, spend one influence to transport an army between your fort and a tower, or between different towers. First entry to Toshi Ranbo needs at least five army strength and ends all movement; later entry has no strength threshold. Entering an enemy army triggers battle and ends all movement for the turn, but finish remaining column effects first.
Buildings and tactics: during Expand, spend three wood for the unique building and two for the camp. Build with or adjacent to your army, or adjacent to your fort, without enemies, tiles, or tokens. Empty buildings belong to their builder; occupying enemies control and use them. Buy at most three tactics. Unbought neutral tactics remain private.
Battle: resolve start abilities, then the defender rolls, rerolls, and keeps dice, followed by the attacker. Roll at most six dice. Blood minus opposing armor causes troop losses; losses normally do not reduce strength already counted. Ties use the attacker branch. The higher side needs surviving troops to win and earn rewards; otherwise it earns nothing and the other side still retreats. A winner steals a village token and gains its reward. The losing army retreats together to its fort or a controlled building. Attacking victories can earn two achievements; some clan goals must be chosen instead of an attacking achievement.
End of turn: resolve building and hero effects, collect occupied village tokens and their hidden rewards, keeping at most three tokens. Occupied shrines grant matching upgrades; keep an upgrade until an opponent claims it. Claiming Toshi Ranbo grants its upgrade and achievements. Any player with fewer than three troops on the board recruits at their fort until they have three. Refill the order row, then the next player acts.
Upgrades:
· Armory lets you roll four dice and keep two.
· Recruit lets you recruit two troops.
· Influence gives you two influence.
· Expand gives you both one koku and one wood.
Full clan card abilities are available during play.
Digital supplement: the official rules do not cover a situation where no circulating order is affordable. Only when the active player cannot afford any order in the row, deck, or discard pile (clearing repeatedly cannot provide an order), skip taking a new card and activate any one column. No noble action is available this time; all other turn steps apply normally.

zh.name: 昆特牌
zh.desc: 五大阵营，运用手牌与领袖争夺三线战场
zh.rules:
目标:
· 使对手失去两颗生命宝石，赢得整场对局。
准备:
· 双方选择阵营、领袖和牌组，可选择相同阵营。
· 牌组至少包含 22 张单位，至多包含 10 张特殊牌。
· 每张牌受构筑上限限制，英雄异画不增加副本。
· 起手抽 10 张牌，最多更换两张；换出的牌暂时移开。
· 完成换牌后，将移开的牌洗回牌库。
· 松鼠党决定首局先手，否则随机决定。
流程:
· 每回合打出一张牌、使用主动领袖，或放弃本局。
· 主动领袖整场仅能使用一次，占用一个回合。
· 放弃后不能在本局再次行动，对手可继续出牌。
· 单位置于标示的战斗行；敏捷单位可选择近战或远程行。
· 计分依次应用天气、同名羁绊、士气和号角。
· 英雄免疫其他卡牌与领袖的效果，但仍会触发自身技能。
· 集合从手牌和牌库拉出对应单位，医师复活弃牌堆中的非英雄单位。
· 诱饵回收己方非英雄单位；间谍为对手计分，并使打出者抽两张牌。
· 号角和蘑菇共用行内特殊牌槽，同一行不能同时放置。
· 召唤复仇者离场后，在下一局开始召唤对应单位。
· 卡牌详情列出领袖和单位技能；所有模组领袖均可使用。
结算:
· 双方均放弃后比较总战力，败方失去一颗生命宝石。
· 平局时双方各失去一颗；仅一方为尼弗迦德时，该方获胜。
· 离场牌进入当前控制者的弃牌堆，特殊衍生牌按其能力移出。
· 北方领域获胜后抽一张牌；怪兽随机保留一个非英雄单位。
· 史凯利杰在第三局开始随机复活两个非英雄单位。
· 上一局获胜者先手，平局保留原先手。
· 双方同时失去最后一颗生命宝石时，整场平局。

en.name: Gwent
en.desc: Command five factions across three battle lines
en.rules:
Goal:
· Win by taking both of your opponent’s life gems.
Setup:
· Choose a faction, leader, and deck. Both players may use the same faction.
· A deck needs at least 22 units and at most 10 special cards.
· Respect copy limits. Alternate Hero artwork does not add copies.
· Draw 10 cards and exchange up to 2; set exchanged cards aside.
· Shuffle the set-aside cards back into the deck after exchanging.
· Scoia’tael chooses the first player; otherwise decide randomly.
Play:
· Play a card, use an active leader, or pass the round.
· An active leader is usable once per match and takes the whole turn.
· After passing, you cannot act again this round; the opponent may continue.
· Use the indicated row. Agile units choose close combat or ranged.
· Apply weather, Tight Bond, Morale Boost, then horns when scoring.
· Heroes ignore other cards and leaders, but still use their own abilities.
· Muster pulls matching hand and deck units; Medics revive non-Hero units.
· Decoys return your non-Hero units. Spies score for the enemy and draw 2.
· Horns and Mardroeme share a row slot and cannot coexist there.
· Summon Avengers summon their replacement at the start of the next round.
· Card details explain abilities. All leaders included in the mod are available.
Resolution:
· Once both players pass, the lower total loses a life gem.
· On a tie both lose a gem, unless exactly one is Nilfgaard, which wins.
· Discards belong to the current controller. Certain tokens leave the game.
· Northern Realms draws on a win; Monsters keeps a random non-Hero unit.
· Skellige revives 2 random non-Hero units at the start of round 3.
· The winner starts the next round; a tie preserves the previous starter.
· Losing the final gems simultaneously draws the match.

zh.name: 花火 Hanabi
zh.desc: 合作放烟花:你看得见所有人的牌,唯独看不见自己的,只能靠队友的提示出牌
zh.rules:
游戏目标：全队合作，分别按数字 1 至 5 的顺序搭建五种颜色的烟花，争取获得尽可能高的总分。
准备:
· 两人或三人游戏中，每名玩家获得 5 张手牌；四人或五人游戏中，每名玩家获得 4 张手牌。
· 将手牌正面朝向其他玩家。你不能查看自己的手牌，只能查看其他玩家的手牌。
· 桌面有 8 枚提示标记与 3 格引信。
流程:
轮到你时，必须选择以下三种行动之一。
· 给出提示：消耗 1 枚提示标记，选择一名队友，并指出其手牌中的一种颜色或一个数字。
给出提示时，必须指出该队友手牌中所有符合条件的牌，不能只指出其中一部分，也不能提示其手牌中不存在的颜色或数字。
· 弃置手牌：弃置 1 张手牌，并收回 1 枚提示标记。全部提示标记均可用时，不能执行此行动。
· 打出手牌：打出 1 张手牌。如果它的数字恰好是对应颜色烟花所需的下一个数字，将其加入该烟花；否则弃置该牌，并消耗 1 格引信。
· 打出数字 5 完成一条烟花时,免费收回 1 枚提示标记。
· 行动后从牌堆摸一张牌(末轮除外)。
结束:
· 三格引信全部消耗后，全队立即失败，本局获得 0 分。
· 在抽牌堆耗尽前完成全部烟花，即以满分获胜。
· 牌堆抽空后,每位玩家（包括抽走最后一张牌的玩家）再行动一次,随后结算:得分为各条烟花顶端数字之和。

en.name: Hanabi
en.desc: Co-op fireworks: you can see everyone’s cards but your own — play yours off your teammates’ clues
en.rules:
Goal: work together to build 5 fireworks, each color rising from 1 to 5, and score as high as possible.
Setup:
· With 2–3 players each holds 5 cards; with 4–5 players, 4 cards.
· Hold them facing away — you never see your own cards, only everyone else’s.
· The table starts with 8 clue tokens and 3 fuse marks.
Play:
· On your turn, do exactly one of: give a clue, discard a card, or play a card.
· Give a clue: spend 1 clue token, name one color or one number held by a teammate.
· Every matching card is pointed out; you may not point to only some of them, and “you have zero of something” is not allowed.
· Discard: discard 1 card from your hand to recover 1 clue token. You cannot choose this action while all clue tokens are available.
· Play: play a card from your hand; if it is exactly the next number of its color’s firework it is added.
· Otherwise the card is lost and 1 fuse burns.
· Playing a 5 completes a firework and returns 1 clue token for free.
· After acting, draw a replacement card (except in the final round).
End:
· When the third fuse is consumed, the team immediately loses and scores 0 points.
· If the team completes every firework before the deck runs out, the team wins with the maximum score.
· Once the deck is empty, everyone (including the player who emptied it) acts once more, then the team scores the sum of the top card of each firework.

zh.name: 花札
zh.desc: 按月配对收牌凑役:来来、花合、八八三玩法
zh.rules:
目标:将打出的手牌及随后翻开的牌，与场上同月份的牌配对收取，组成役来获得分数。全部局数结束后，总分最高的玩家获胜。
2 人玩「来来」;3 人玩「花合」或「八八」,由开局选项决定,默认花合。
准备:
· 牌共 48 张,分 12 个月,每月 4 张。
· 按牌面分光牌(20 点)、种牌(10 点)、短册(5 点)、皮牌(1 点)四类。
· 来来:每名玩家获得 8 张手牌，并翻开 8 张场牌；其余牌组成山札。
· 花合和八八:每名玩家获得 7 张手牌，并翻开 6 张场牌；其余牌组成山札。
· 共 12 局(可在开局选项改为 6 局)。
流程:
· 轮到你时打出一张手牌:场上有同月牌必须配对收取。
· 场上有 2 张同月份的牌时，选择其中一张，与打出的牌一同收取；有 3 张时，将这三张牌与打出的牌全部收取；没有同月份的牌时，将打出的牌留在场上。
· 随后翻开山札一张,按同样规则配对。
· 手牌全部出尽,本局结束;得分者担任下一局庄家,流局时庄家连任。
来来(2 人):
役的得分如下：
· 五光获得 10 分。
· 四光获得 8 分。
· 雨四光获得 7 分。
· 三光和猪鹿蝶各获得 5 分。
· 赤短、青短、花见酒和月见酒各获得 5 分。
· 收集至少 5 张种牌时，“种”获得 1 分，每多一张种牌再获得 1 分。
· 收集至少 5 张短册时，“短”获得 1 分，每多一张短册再获得 1 分。
· 收集至少 10 张皮牌时，“皮”获得 1 分，每多一张皮牌再获得 1 分。
· 光牌役只计最高一档,其余役全部叠加。
· 成役或役增值时必须二选一:「结算」立即收下役分结束本局,或「来来」继续追分。
· 宣告「来来」后，只有役点增加时才能选择结算。
· 结算时，役点达到 7 分或以上的玩家将本次得分翻倍；若宣告「来来」后被对方抢先结算，对方的得分再翻倍。
· 起手摸到 4 张同月或 4 组对子是手役,直接获得 6 分并结束本局。
· 双方手牌出尽仍无人结算为流局,本局无人得分。
花合(3 人):
· 终局按(牌点 −88)加上自己役点的 2 倍、减去另两家役点之和计得失,三人得失相加为零。
役点如下：
· 五光获得 200 点役点，四光获得 60 点役点。
· 赤短、青短和七短各获得 40 点役点。
· 六短、表菅原和幕月盏各获得 30 点役点。
· 松桐坊主、猪鹿蝶、花见酒、月见酒、草、藤岛、桐岛和雨岛各获得 20 点役点。
· 五光、四光、松桐坊主三者只计最高一档;表菅原与七短两者只计最高一档。
八八(3 人):
· 场牌出现松、樱或芒的光牌时，本场一切收支按 2 倍计算；出现柳或桐的光牌时，按 4 倍计算。
· 同场出现多张光牌时,多余的逐张结转到下一局。
· 起手自动结算手役,由另两家按本场倍率支付。
手役按以下贯数结算：
· 四三结算 20 贯。
· 握短结算 10 贯。
· 一二四结算 8 贯。
· 羽见结算 7 贯。
· 手四和双三本各结算 6 贯。
· 喰付、空素、素无和光一各结算 4 贯。
· 赤、短一、十一、立三本和向立三本各结算 3 贯。
· 三本和向三本各结算 2 贯。
局中凑成以下役时，可以选择「收役」结账，或选择「追役」继续游戏：
· 五光结算 12 贯。
· 四光和七短各结算 10 贯。
· 赤短和青短各结算 7 贯。
· 素十六结算 12 贯，每多收取 1 张皮牌，再增加 1 贯。
· 追役后本局未再成役,须退还已收役分的一半;被他人抢先收役,追役者赔付双倍。
· 素十六成立时,本局已付的手役分全部退还。
· 无人收役打完全部手牌为场流,按(牌点 −88)乘以本场倍率计得失。
· 1 贯合 12 文,得分以文显示。
牌面:Louie Mantia,Wikimedia Commons,CC BY-SA 4.0。

en.name: Hanafuda
en.desc: Match cards by month to build yaku: Koi-Koi, Hana-Awase, Hachi-Hachi
en.rules:
Goal: capture cards by matching months and score with yaku; after all rounds the highest total wins.
Two players play Koi-Koi; three play Hana-Awase or Hachi-Hachi (set in the game options, default Hana-Awase).
Setup:
· The deck contains 48 cards, divided into twelve months with four cards in each month.
· The four card ranks are Bright, worth 20 card points; Animal, worth 10; Ribbon, worth 5; and Chaff, worth 1.
· In Koi-Koi, deal eight cards to each player and eight face up to the field; the remaining cards form the draw pile.
· In Hana-Awase and Hachi-Hachi, deal seven cards to each player and six face up to the field; the remaining cards form the draw pile.
· 12 rounds (can be changed to 6 in the game options).
Play:
· On your turn play one hand card: if the field has the same month you must capture.
· If two field cards match the month of your played card, choose one and capture both it and your card. If three field cards match, capture all four cards. If none match, leave your played card on the field.
· Then flip the top of the draw pile and match it the same way.
· The round ends when all hands are empty; the scorer deals next round (dealer stays after a draw).
Koi-Koi (2 players):
Yaku score as follows:
· Goko scores 10 points.
· Shiko scores 8 points.
· Ame-Shiko scores 7 points.
· Sanko and Ino-Shika-Cho each score 5 points.
· Akatan, Aotan, Hanami and Tsukimi each score 5 points.
· Tane scores 1 point for five Animal cards, plus 1 point per additional Animal card.
· Tan scores 1 point for five Ribbon cards, plus 1 point per additional Ribbon card.
· Kasu scores 1 point for ten Chaff cards, plus 1 point per additional Chaff card.
· Only the best bright yaku counts; all other yaku stack.
· When a yaku forms or improves you must choose: "Stop" to bank the points and end the round, or "Koi-Koi" to press on.
· After calling Koi-Koi you may only stop once your points have increased.
· Scores of 7 or more are doubled; if you called Koi-Koi and your opponent stops first, their score is doubled.
· A starting hand of 4 of a month or 4 pairs is a lucky hand: score 6 points and end the round.
· If both hands run out with no stop, the round is a draw and nobody scores.
Hana-Awase (3 players):
· Scoring: (card points −88) plus twice your own yaku, minus the sum of both rivals' yaku; the three deltas sum to zero.
Yaku values are as follows:
· Goko is worth 200 yaku points and Shiko is worth 60.
· Akatan, Aotan and Nanatan are each worth 40 yaku points.
· Rokutan, Omote-Sugawara and Nomi are each worth 30 yaku points.
· Matsu-Kiri, Ino-Shika-Cho, Hanami, Tsukimi, Kusa, Fuji-shima, Kiri-shima and Ame-shima are each worth 20 yaku points.
· Of Goko, Shiko and Matsu-Kiri only the best counts; of Omote-Sugawara and Nanatan only the best counts.
Hachi-Hachi (3 players):
· A Pine/Cherry/Susuki bright on the field doubles all payments this round; a Willow/Paulownia bright quadruples them.
· Extra brights on the same field carry over, one per following round.
· Hand yaku are settled automatically at the start, paid by both rivals at the field multiplier.
Hand yaku are settled in kan:
· Shiso is worth 20 kan.
· Nigiri is worth 10 kan.
· Ichi-Yon is worth 8 kan.
· Haneken is worth 7 kan.
· Teshi and Double Threes are each worth 6 kan.
· Pairs, All Chaff, No Chaff and One Bright are each worth 4 kan.
· Red Ribbons, One Ribbon, Toichi, Standing Three and Field Standing are each worth 3 kan.
· Three of a Kind and Field Three are each worth 2 kan.
During play, forming any of these yaku lets you choose "Collect" or "Press":
· Goko is worth 12 kan.
· Shiko and Nanatan are each worth 10 kan.
· Akatan and Aotan are each worth 7 kan.
· Kasu-16 is worth 12 kan, plus 1 kan per additional Chaff card.
· If you pressed and form nothing more, you refund half of what you collected; if a rival collects first, you pay double.
· When Kasu-16 forms, all hand-yaku payments this round are refunded.
· If nobody collects before hands run out, the field washes out: settle (card points −88) times the field multiplier.
· 1 kan equals 12 mon; scores are shown in mon.
Card art: Louie Mantia, via Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0.

zh.name: 花见
zh.desc: 在樱花盛开的群岛上铺设野餐板块，争夺庆典的三种荣誉。
zh.rules:
目标：
争夺樱花、灯笼和饭团庆典标记，取得最多类别的胜利标记。
准备：选择日本或东京地图，按人数开放中央、左侧、右侧区域。每类庆典标记的数量按人数确定：两人游戏使用 7 枚，三人游戏使用 10 枚，四人游戏使用 13 枚。三树公园放三类各一枚，双树公园放两类不同标记，其余公园放一枚。每人使用相同的 19 枚板块，随机抽取 5 枚，手牌和获得的庆典标记保密。
回合：在放置任何板块前，可以使用自己的能力一次，全局限一次。随后放置一枚普通板块，可以在它前后放置任意数量带快速符号的板块，也可以只放快速板块。至少放置一枚后，点击“结束回合”。全部放置完成后统一结算公园，再从自己的牌堆补至 5 枚。
放置：基础类别板块、招财猫与行动板块放在空陆地格；船只能放在浅水格。公园始终不能放玩家板块。樱花、灯笼、饭团各有强度 2、3、4 的板块；招财猫有三枚强度 1、两枚强度 2、一枚强度 3，都是百搭；三艘船的强度为 1、1、2，均为快速百搭。
飞机：消耗本回合的普通板块机会，将自己一枚已放置的非快速陆地板块移到任意空陆地格，飞机留在原格，飞机强度为 0。
领取：公园相邻陆地全部被占据时，分别计算每种庆典标记的影响力。相邻的同类别板块与百搭板块贡献强度，唯一最高者获得标记，最高平局则标记进入公共平局区。船也贡献影响力，但水格不必填满。
结束：任意一类庆典标记全部离开公园，或公共平局区至少有 4 枚时，完成当前回合的全部结算后结束。如果所有玩家连续一轮均无合法放置，也结束。
计分：每类庆典标记数量唯一最多者获得对应的一枚胜利标记，最高数量平局则该类无人获得。胜利标记最多者获胜。如果各得一枚的玩家并列，先比较其未获得胜利标记的类别总数，再比较全部庆典标记总数，若仍然相同，则共享胜利。如果无人获得胜利标记，比较全部庆典标记总数。
可选特殊板块：
· 抽取：属于快速百搭板块，强度为 1。放置后，立即抽取一枚板块。
·  覆盖为快速百搭强度 3，盖在自己任意已放板块上，取代原效果。
·  复制为普通板块，箭头指定相邻板块，实时复制类型与强度，不复制快速或行动效果。复制链最终没有有效来源时强度为 0。移动后的复制板块保留朝向。
可选能力：特殊能力模式每人从两张不同能力中选一张，效果见卡面。
· 鸟居与水果三明治可交换不同公园的任意两枚庆典标记，但同一公园内不能出现同类别的庆典标记。
·  雨天翻背一枚强度 1 或 2 的基础类别板块。
·  自行车将任意陆地板块移至相邻空陆地。
·  团子将自己一枚强度 1 或 2 的手牌按快速规则放置。
·  绿茶交换自己一枚基础类别板块和版图任意同类别板块。
·  巨章鱼翻背一艘船。
·  鲷鱼烧将自己一枚手牌放在水格并视为快速，飞机仍需合法陆地移动，故不可使用。
·  章鱼烧交换自己一枚已获标记与平局区一枚标记。
· 翻背板块保留占位，强度为 0。
进阶开局：精选起手允许秘密选择 5 枚起手。庆典轮放保留中央三枚后，由玩家轮流选择标记放入公园，先填双树公园，再填单树公园，同园不同类。可选内容默认关闭。

en.name: Hanami
en.desc: Lay picnic tiles across blossoming islands and compete for three celebration honors.
en.rules:
Goal: collect Sakura, Chochin and Onigiri celebrations to earn the most category Victory Points.
Setup: choose Nihon or Tokyo. Use the central region for 2 players, add the left regions for 3, and all regions for 4. For each celebration type, use 7 tokens with two players, 10 with three, or 13 with four. The three-tree park holds one of each type, two-tree parks hold two different types, and single-tree parks hold one token. Each player has the same 19 tiles and draws 5. Hands and collected tokens stay hidden.
Turn: before placing any tiles, you may use your once-per-game ability. Then place one regular tile, with any number of Fast tiles before or after it. You may play only Fast tiles instead. After placing at least one tile, press End turn. Resolve all surrounded parks, then refill your hand to 5 from your personal deck.
Placement: category, Cat and action tiles go on empty land. Boats go only on shallow-water spaces. Player tiles never occupy parks. Sakura, Chochin and Onigiri each have strength 2, 3 and 4 tiles. Cats are Wild: three strength 1, two strength 2 and one strength 3. Boats are Fast and Wild with strengths 1, 1 and 2.
Airplane: as your regular tile, move one of your previously placed non-Fast land tiles to any empty land space, leaving the zero-strength Airplane in its former space.
Claiming: a park is surrounded when all adjacent land spaces are occupied. For each token separately, sum adjacent matching-category and Wild strength. The unique highest player claims it; a tie for highest sends it to the Ties area. Boats contribute strength, but water spaces do not need to be occupied.
End: finish the current turn and all its claims when any token type has disappeared from all parks, or the Ties area contains at least 4 tokens. If every player consecutively has no legal placement for a full round, the game also ends.
Scoring: the unique highest collector of each type earns its one Victory Point. A tied category awards none. Most Victory Points wins. Among players tied with one Victory Point each, compare tokens of their non-winning categories, then total tokens; a remaining tie is shared. If nobody earns a Victory Point, compare total tokens.
Optional special tiles:
· Draw is a strength-1 Fast Wild tile. Immediately draw one tile after placing it.
· Cover is a strength-3 Fast Wild tile placed on any of your placed tiles, replacing its effect.
· Copy is regular: its arrow points at an adjacent space and continuously copies that tile’s type and strength, but not its Fast status or action. A copy chain with no originating tile has strength zero. A moved Copy preserves its orientation.
Optional abilities: choose one of two unique cards.
· Torii and Fruit Sandwich swap any two tokens in different parks without creating duplicate types in a park.
· Rainy Day flips a strength-1 or strength-2 category tile to zero.
· Bicycle moves any land tile to an adjacent empty land space.
· Dango plays one of your strength-1 or strength-2 hand tiles as Fast.
· Green Tea swaps your category tile with any same-category tile on the board.
· Akkorokamui flips any Boat to zero.
· Taiyaki plays one of your hand tiles on empty water as Fast; an Airplane still requires a land move and cannot use this effect.
· Takoyaki swaps one collected token with one in the Ties area.
· Flipped tiles still occupy their spaces.
Advanced setup: Start Strong privately chooses 5 starting tiles. Token Draft fixes the central three tokens, then players alternate placing tokens, filling two-tree parks before single-tree parks, with no duplicate type in a park. All optional modules default off.

zh.name: 花见小路
zh.desc: 在七位艺伎之间争取支持的双人卡牌对决
zh.rules:
目标:
· 每轮争取艺伎的支持;获得至少 4 位艺伎的支持，或获得支持的艺伎魅力值合计达到 11 点时获胜。
准备:
· 七位艺伎的魅力值依次为 2、2、2、3、3、4、5;对应物品牌共 21 张。
· 每轮暗中移除 1 张物品牌,双方各获得 6 张,其余 8 张形成牌堆。
流程:
· 双方轮流摸 1 张牌,再使用一枚尚未用过的行动牌;每种行动每轮各用一次。
· 密藏:将 1 张手牌面朝下放置，轮末揭开，并将其计入己方。
· 弃置:将 2 张手牌面朝下弃置，这些牌本轮不计分。
· 赠礼:亮出 3 张手牌,对手选择 1 张收下，其余 2 张由你收下。
· 竞争:亮出 4 张手牌并分成两组,对手选择一组收下，另一组由你收下。
结算:
· 双方揭开密藏牌,逐位比较各自获得的对应物品牌数量;对应物品牌较多的一方获得该艺伎的支持。
· 双方数量相同时,该艺伎的归属标记留在原处。
· 若无人达成胜利条件,归属标记保留,全部 21 张牌重新洗牌,并交换先手。
· 一方获得 4 位艺伎、另一方同时获得至少 11 点时,11 点的一方获胜。

en.name: Hanamikoji
en.desc: A two-player card duel for the favor of seven geisha
en.rules:
Goal:
· Win the favor of at least 4 geisha or 11 Charm Points at the end of a round.
Setup:
· The seven geisha are worth 2, 2, 2, 3, 3, 4 and 5 points; there are 21 matching Item Cards.
· Remove 1 Item Card unseen each round, deal 6 to each player and leave 8 in the deck.
Play:
· Take turns drawing 1 card, then use one unused Action Marker; each action is used once per round.
· Secret: place 1 hand card face down; reveal it at round end and score it for yourself.
· Trade-off: place 2 hand cards face down; neither scores this round.
· Gift: reveal 3 hand cards; your rival takes 1 and you take the other 2.
· Competition: reveal 4 hand cards in two pairs; your rival takes one pair and you take the other.
Scoring:
· Reveal both Secret cards and compare matching Item Cards beside each geisha; the side with more wins her favor.
· On a tie, the Victory Marker stays where it was.
· If nobody wins, keep the markers, reshuffle all 21 cards and alternate the starting player.
· If one player controls 4 geisha while the other has at least 11 points, the 11-point player wins.

zh.name: 养猪趣
zh.desc: 买猪、喂猪、配种,赶在换季瘟疫前把猪卖出好价钱
zh.rules:
目标:一年(四季共 16 回合)结束时现金最多者获胜。
准备:
· 每人获得 1 块猪舍(6 列 11 行共 66 格)和 $45。
· 从起始玩家开始,每人轮流进行开局采购,最多购买 5 件(猪、道具、猪舍任意组合),买到的猪立即放入猪舍。
猪的购买价格与出售价格相同：
· 每只猪仔的价格为 $3。
· 每只小猪的价格为 $6。
· 每只中猪的价格为 $10。
· 每只大猪的价格为 $15。
其他商品价格：
· 每件道具的价格为 $1。
· 第二块猪舍的价格为 $10，第三块为 $15，第四块为 $20；此后每多购买一块，价格增加 $5。
回合流程:
· 翻开本回合季节卡,卡上四个数字是本回合全体玩家共享的喂食、购买、交配、出售次数上限。
· 每人秘密选择一种行动,同时揭示。
· 选择同一行动的玩家平分该行动的次数:从起始玩家开始顺时针一次一次分发,分完为止。
· 从起始玩家开始,每人依次执行自己的行动,次数用完为止;每有 1 次未执行,获得 $1 补偿。
· 喂食:使 1 只猪长大一级,每只猪每回合只能喂食一次。
· 交配:使 1 只中猪或大猪产下 1 只猪仔,每只猪每回合只能交配一次。
· 购买：购买一件商品。
· 出售：按当前市价出售 1 只猪。
· 季节卡在回合末结算效果(改价类效果在回合内即时生效)。
换季:
· 每季第 4 回合结束后换季,所有未接种疫苗的猪死亡并退回市场;此时可以立即使用疫苗，使对应的猪免于死亡。
· 冬季结束后再经历最后一次换季,存活的猪按基础市价全部卖出,结算现金。
道具:
· 疫苗 $1:随时可以使用,将 1 只猪的板块翻至已接种面;接种状态在猪长大后保留,直到卖出。
· 营养剂 $1:执行喂食时使用,猪仔或小猪额外多长大一级。
· 生产御守 $1:执行交配时使用,直接产下 1 只小猪。
猪舍摆放:
· 猪的占格:猪仔占 2 列 2 行、小猪占 2 列 3 行、中猪占 3 列 3 行、大猪占 3 列 4 行。
· 猪可以旋转,猪之间不得重叠。
· 新获得的猪若无法合法放入自己的任何猪舍，立即退回市场。
平手:现金相同时,将剩余道具(每件 $1)和猪舍(按购入价)的价值计入现金后，再比较现金总额,再相同则共同获胜。

en.name: Happy Pigs
en.desc: Buy, feed and breed pigs, and sell them before the seasonal plague hits
en.rules:
Goal: have the most cash at the end of the year (16 rounds over 4 seasons).
Setup:
· Each player gets 1 field board (6×11 grid) and $45.
· Starting with the first player, each player takes a setup shopping turn, buying at most 5 items (pigs, items or fields in any combination). Pigs bought are placed in your field immediately.
Purchase and sale prices are the same:
· A Piglet costs $3.
· A Small pig costs $6.
· An Average pig costs $10.
· A Big pig costs $15.
· Items cost $1 each; fields cost $10 for the 2nd, $15 for the 3rd, $20 for the 4th, then +$5 each.
Round flow:
· Reveal the Season card. Its four numbers are the shared limits for Feed, Buy, Mate and Sell this round.
· Everyone secretly picks one action, then all choices are revealed at once.
· Players who picked the same action split its uses: dealt one at a time clockwise from the first player until exhausted.
· Starting with the first player, each player performs their action up to their allotted count; each unused action pays $1 compensation.
· Feed: grow one pig one size; each pig can be fed once per round.
· Mate: one Average or Big pig births a Piglet; each pig can mate once per round.
· Buy: purchase one item.
· Sell: sell one pig at the current market price.
· The Season card effect resolves at the end of the round (price-changing effects apply during the round).
Change of season:
· After the 4th round of each season, all unvaccinated pigs die and return to the market; Vaccines may be used immediately to save pigs.
· After winter ends there is one last change of season, then surviving pigs are sold at base market price.
Items:
· Vaccine $1: usable at any time; flips one pig to its vaccinated side. Vaccination survives growth until the pig is sold.
· Dietary Supplement $1: used while feeding; a Piglet or Small pig grows one extra size.
· Amulet of Life $1: used while mating; the newborn is a Small pig instead of a Piglet.
Fields:
· Pig sizes in grid cells: Piglet 2 by 2, Small 2 by 3, Average 3 by 3, Big 3 by 4.
· Pigs may be rotated and must not overlap.
· A pig that cannot fit at all returns to the market immediately.
Ties: sell leftover items ($1 each) and fields (at purchase price); players still tied share the victory.

zh.name: 自然和弦
zh.desc: 叠起自然景观，构筑动物栖息地；含律动、Crescendo 扩展与单人挑战。
zh.rules:
目标：
· 放置地形木片，构筑栖息地，以景观、动物与自然之灵得分。
准备：
· 每人使用相同一面的版图：A、B 面各 23 格，C 面 26 格，D 面 25 格。多人供给为五组木片、五张动物牌；单人为三组、三张。
· 木片共 120 枚：灰、蓝各 23，棕 21，绿、黄各 19，红 15。
· 律动扩展加入 10 张动物牌，并允许镜像栖息地图案。
· 启用自然之灵时，首回合从私下获得的两张牌中选择一张。
流程：
· 每回合必须选择一组三枚木片，并将三枚全部放到自己的版图上。
· 木片可放空格；叠放仅限山峰、树木或建筑，不得插入已有木片下方。
· 山峰最多三枚灰色木片；树木为一枚绿色木片，下方可有零至两枚棕色木片。
· 建筑为一枚红色木片叠在一枚灰、棕或红色木片上。水域和田野不叠放。
· 有动物、自然之灵或精灵方块的格子不能继续叠放木片。
· 每回合可领取一张公共动物牌；尚未完成的动物牌、自然之灵牌、精灵牌和保护区合计最多四张。
· 栖息地符合牌面时，可将牌上一个方块放在图案指定、尚无方块的木片上。
· 图案可旋转；木片颜色和层数必须相符，建筑底层颜色不限。
· 动物可在放木片前、两次放片之间或放完后安置，次数不限。
· 同一木片可参与多个栖息地；动物放置后保留，即使周围地形改变。
· 放完一张牌的全部方块后，该牌不再占用四张牌的额度。
· 回合结束时才补充木片和动物牌。
计分：
· 高度一、二、三的树木分别为 1、3、7 分。
· 山峰同样按高度计分，但必须与另一座山峰相邻。
· 每片至少两格相连的田野计 5 分；整片田野只计一次。
· 建筑周围顶层木片有至少三种颜色时计 5 分。
· A 面只计最佳河流；两端间最短路径含一至六枚时计 0、2、5、8、11、15 分。
· 河流超过六枚后，每多一枚计 4 分；支流不重复计入，环按最短路径判断。
· B 面每座岛屿计 5 分，空格也属于陆地；至少计一座岛屿。
· 动物牌按已移走方块对应的最高分计分；未放出方块为零分。
· 自然之灵方块已放置时，按终局景观追加该牌奖励。
保护区模块：
· 每回合可额外领取一个保护区，独立于领取动物或精灵牌的机会。公共区可选牌堆顶与旁边两个保护区；取堆顶立即露出新顶，取旁边的回合末补充。
· 选择保护区后，按牌面从底到顶建造指定的四层堆叠。首次违反普通叠放规则时，该保护区才绑定该格；之后只能在该格继续，不可另建一处。此前的合法前缀不绑定。
· 建成后翻面，不再占用四张额度。可以建造多个保护区；未建成不扣分。
· 普通动物牌恰余最后一个方块，且该牌的动物落点颜色为保护区关联色之一时，可忽略栖息地图案，将该方块放入已建成保护区。每个保护区可接纳任意数量的动物。自然之灵和精灵不能进入保护区。
· 每个已建成保护区的相邻格顶片若为其关联的两色之一，获得 3 分。建造中及已建成的保护区均不作为普通景观计分，但建筑和保护区计算相邻颜色时仍查看它的顶片。
新个人版图：
· C 面中央没有格子，不可放置；建筑周围至少四种顶片颜色时获得 8 分。其他景观沿用 A 面规则。
· D 面有七个初始普通格，其余为干旱格。干旱格与水域相邻时成为普通格，按终局当前局面判断。
· D 面普通格上高度一、二、三的树木分别获得 2、4、9 分；干旱格上的树木为零分。至少两格相连的田野中有至少一个普通格时，整片获得 6 分，否则零分。其他景观沿用 A 面规则。
精灵模块：
· 将十张精灵牌混入动物牌堆。每张有两个紫色方块；领取精灵牌占用本回合领取动物牌的机会，也计入四张额度。
· 按牌面图案放置紫色方块，每格至多一个。精灵可与一个动物或自然之灵方块共存，放置顺序不限，但不可放入保护区。紫色方块也禁止该格继续叠片。
· 精灵单独占据一格时获得 2 分，共存时该格获得 5 分；按棋盘现状逐格计分，牌面 2／5 是两种状态的分值。紫色方块不计入同分时的动物数量。
· 三个 Crescendo 模块可分别启用或组合，也可与律动和自然之灵搭配。
结束：
· 回合结束时版图空格不超过两格，或需要补货时袋中木片不足，即触发最终轮。
· 完成当前轮，使所有玩家回合数相同，再比较总分。
· 同分时，动物方块较多者获胜；仍相同则共享胜利。
单人：
· 每回合结束弃置供给中剩余六枚木片，再补充三组木片。
· 本回合未领取动物牌时，可在结束回合时替换一张公共动物牌。
· 总分达到 40、70、90、110、130、140、150、160 时分别获得一至八枚太阳。
· A 面额外一枚太阳；未用自然之灵额外两枚，按连通区域奖励的自然之灵额外一枚。

en.name: Harmonies
en.desc: Build natural landscapes and animal habitats, with Pulse, Crescendo and solo play.
en.rules:
Goal:
· Build habitats with landscape tokens and score landscapes, animals and Nature’s Spirits.
Setup:
· Use the same board side: A and B have 23 spaces, C has 26 and D has 25. Display five token groups and cards, or three of each solo.
· There are 120 tokens: 23 gray, 23 blue, 21 brown, 19 green, 19 yellow and 15 red.
· Pulse adds 10 animal cards and allows reflected habitat patterns.
· With Nature’s Spirits, privately choose one of two cards on your first turn.
Play:
· Each turn, take one group of three tokens and place all three on your board.
· Place tokens on empty spaces or form legal mountains, trees or buildings; never insert tokens underneath.
· Mountains contain up to three gray tokens; trees have one green token above zero, one or two brown tokens.
· Buildings have a red token above one gray, brown or red token. Water and fields cannot be stacked.
· Never add tokens to a space occupied by an animal, Nature’s Spirit or Whisper cube.
· You may take one animal card per turn; hold no more than four incomplete Animal, Nature’s Spirit and Whisper cards and Sanctuary tiles combined.
· When a habitat matches, move a cube from its card onto the indicated, unoccupied token.
· Rotate patterns freely; colors and heights must match. A building’s bottom token may be any legal color.
· Settle animals before, between or after placing tokens, as often as you wish.
· Tokens may serve several habitats. Settled animals remain even if surrounding landscapes change.
· A card no longer occupies an active-card slot when all its cubes have been placed.
· Refill token groups and animal cards only at the end of the turn.
Scoring:
· Trees of heights one, two and three score 1, 3 and 7 points.
· Mountains score the same, but must be adjacent to another mountain.
· Each connected field of at least two yellow tokens scores 5 points, once for the whole field.
· Each building scores 5 points if adjacent top tokens include at least three different colors.
· Side A scores your best river: shortest paths of one to six tokens score 0, 2, 5, 8, 11 and 15.
· Beyond six tokens, score 4 per extra token. Do not double-count branches; use shortest paths in loops.
· Side B scores 5 per island. Empty spaces are land; count at least one island.
· Animal cards score their highest uncovered value; cards with no placed cubes score zero.
· A settled Nature’s Spirit adds its bonus based on the final landscape.
Sanctuaries module:
· Each turn, you may also take one Sanctuary, independently of taking an Animal or Whisper card. Choose the deck’s top tile or one of the two beside it. Taking the top reveals a new top immediately; refill a side position at turn end.
· Select a Sanctuary and build its four-token stack from bottom to top. The first placement that breaks ordinary stacking rules binds it to that space; continue only there. A legal prefix does not bind it.
· Flip a completed Sanctuary; it no longer occupies an active slot. You may complete several. Incomplete Sanctuaries have no penalty.
· When exactly one cube remains on an Animal card and its target-token color matches either Sanctuary color, place it in a completed Sanctuary without matching the habitat. Each Sanctuary holds any number of animals. Nature’s Spirits and Whispers cannot enter.
· A completed Sanctuary scores 3 per adjacent space whose top token matches either associated color. Neither incomplete nor completed Sanctuaries count as ordinary landscape elements. Buildings and Sanctuaries still consider their top colors when scoring adjacent colors.
New personal boards:
· Side C has no central space. Buildings score 8 only with at least four adjacent top-token colors. Other landscapes follow side A.
· Side D has seven initially ordinary spaces; the rest are dry. A dry space becomes ordinary when adjacent to Water, according to the final landscape.
· Side D trees on ordinary spaces score 2, 4 and 9 at heights one, two and three; dry trees score zero. Each field of at least two connected yellow spaces scores 6 if at least one is ordinary, otherwise zero. Other landscapes follow side A.
Whispers module:
· Shuffle ten Whisper cards into the Animal deck. Each holds two purple cubes. Taking one uses your Animal-card action for the turn and an active slot.
· Match the card’s habitat to place a purple cube. Each space holds at most one Whisper, which may coexist with one Animal or Nature’s Spirit cube in either order. Whispers cannot enter Sanctuaries, and also prevent further stacking.
· Each space with a lone Whisper scores 2; each shared space scores 5. Score the current board, not a cumulative card track. The 2/5 legend depicts these two states. Purple cubes do not count toward the animal tiebreaker.
· All three Crescendo modules can be used separately or together, including with Pulse and Nature’s Spirits.
Ending:
· Trigger the final round with at most two empty board spaces, or insufficient tokens when refilling.
· Finish the round so everyone has played equally, then compare total scores.
· Ties favor the player with more animal cubes. Further ties share victory.
Solo:
· Discard the six unchosen supply tokens at turn end, then refill all three groups.
· If you took no animal card this turn, you may replace one public animal card at turn end.
· Scores of 40, 70, 90, 110, 130, 140, 150 and 160 earn one through eight suns.
· Add one sun for side A; add two without a spirit, or one for a spirit rewarding connected groups.

zh.name: 热力狂飙
zh.desc: 换挡冲刺,管理引擎热量,过弯别超速
zh.rules:
目标:最先完成规定圈数者胜;若多辆赛车在同一回合冲过终点线，超出终点线较远的赛车排名靠前；若仍并列，则更靠近赛车线的赛车排名靠前。
准备:
· 选择赛道(长度、圈数与弯道限速各异),按随机杆位在起点线后的发车格落位。
· 每名玩家获得 18 张牌：速度值为1、2、3、4的基础速度牌各三张，滑行牌(速度值0)、全速牌(速度值5)及备用热量牌各一张，以及三张压力牌。
· 每名玩家抽取 7 张起始手牌。
· 引擎中放入(赛道热量数减一)张热量牌,最后一张以备用热量牌代替、混入牌库。
· 备用热量牌打出时按速度值 0 计算,冷却进引擎后与普通热量无异。
流程:每回合全员同时行动,之后按车位从前到后逐车结算。
· 规划:换挡并暗打出等于档位数的牌;升降一档免费,连换两档须先从引擎支付 1 点热量。
· 亮牌结算:全员亮牌;压力牌逐张翻出牌库顶牌,直到翻出速度值为1至4的基础速度牌，并用该牌的数值确定压力牌的速度。
· 翻牌时翻出的其他牌进弃牌堆;按总速前进,落点满员逐格后退。
· 反应:末位车手获得 1 点肾上腺素速度;1 档可冷却 3 点、2 档可冷却 1 点。
· 冷却即将等量热量牌从手牌放回引擎;也可支付 1 点热量翻牌库顶牌推进。
· 滑流:你的落点格有他车、或紧随他车之后一格时,可再前进 2 格。
· 滑流不计弯道超速、不触发弯道检查,也不可滑过终点线。
· 弃牌:可弃任意手牌;热量与压力牌不可弃。补牌阶段补至 7 张。
弯道:每越过一条弯线,超出限速的部分须从引擎支付等量热量。
· 无法支付所需热量时，赛车立即打滑：退回弯线前第一个空位,按当前档位获得 1-2 张压力牌,降回 1 档。
结束:全部车手冲线后按冲线名次结算。
改装(Garage,可选):
· 开赛前进行 3 轮蛇形选秀(车尾、车头、车尾依次先选),每轮市场为人数加 3 张。
· 每轮选秀后弃掉市场余卡并换新;每人选 3 张升级卡,替换起手升级后洗入牌库。
· 起手升级指滑行、全速、备用热量三张。
· 升级卡符号:🔥 打出时必须支付 1 点热量(无法支付时弃置此卡，改为翻牌确定速度)。
· 🗑️ 打出时从牌库顶弃掉所示张数。
· ⏱️ 本回合第一条弯线限速按所示增减。
· ❄️ 打出后可冷却所示点数。
· 🧘 反应步可弃掉所示张数的压力牌。
· 💨 滑流距离增加所示格数。
· 🎣 从弃牌堆取回所示张数的牌洗回牌库。
· ♻️ 可将此卡放回牌库顶。
· 👆 反应步可从手牌直接打出。
· ⚡ 本回合每翻一张牌,速度加 1。
· 因压力牌、推进或⚡效果而翻牌时，只有速度值为1至4的基础速度牌能够确定速度；翻出的升级卡直接弃置。
传奇车手(Legends,可选):
· 由牌堆自动驾驶的虚拟对手,与玩家一起随机混入发车格。
· 每回合第一辆传奇车行动时,揭示一张全员共用的传奇卡。
· 传奇车已经越过传奇线时，按下一处弯道的限速加上传奇卡菱形数值的结果前进；一次移动不能跨越两条弯线。传奇线位于弯道前7格。
· 传奇车尚未越过传奇线时，按顶速前进；如果将越过弯线，则停在弯道前编号与菱形数值相同的格子，编号范围为0至3。
· 传奇车不参与滑流、不耗热、不冷却;判定末位肾上腺素时计入车数,但自身不受益。
· 传奇牌堆抽空时立即重洗。

en.name: Heat
en.desc: Shift gears, manage engine heat, mind the corners
en.rules:
Goal: first to complete the required laps wins; same-round finishers rank by distance past the line, then by racing-line position.
Setup:
· Pick a track (length, laps and corner speed limits differ); cars fill grid slots behind the start line in a random pole order.
· Each deck has 18 cards: three each of speeds 1-4, Coast (0), Full Send (5), an Extra Heat, and three Stress cards.
· Draw a starting hand of 7.
· Your engine holds (the track’s Heat minus one) Heat cards; the last one enters the deck as the Extra Heat card.
· Extra Heat plays as speed 0, and becomes ordinary Heat once cooled into the engine.
Play: everyone acts at once each round, then cars resolve from front to back.
· Plan: shift gears and play face-down as many cards as your gear; shifting one gear is free, shifting two first costs 1 Heat from the engine.
· Reveal: all cards flip; each Stress card flips the top of your deck until a basic 1-4 speed card sets its value.
· Any other cards flipped this way go to the discard; move your total speed, and full landing spaces drop you back.
· React: the rearmost driver gains 1 adrenaline speed; in gear 1 you may cool 3, in gear 2 cool 1.
· Cooling returns that many Heat cards from hand to the engine; you may also pay 1 Heat to flip the top card and move (Boost).
· Slipstream: if your landing space holds another car, or sits directly behind one, you may move 2 more spaces.
· Slipstream never counts for corner speeding, never triggers corner checks, and may not cross the finish line.
· Discard: discard any cards you like (Heat and Stress cannot be discarded); then draw back up to 7.
Corners: for each corner line you cross, pay Heat from the engine equal to your excess speed.
· If you cannot pay, you spin out: drop to the first open space before the line, take 1-2 Stress cards by gear, and reset to gear 1.
End: once every driver has finished, rank by finishing order.
Garage (optional):
· Before the race, draft upgrades in 3 snake rounds (back marker, then leader, then back marker picks first); each market has as many cards as players plus 3.
· Leftover market cards are discarded and refreshed between rounds; your 3 drafted cards replace the starting upgrades and are shuffled into your deck.
· The starting upgrades are Coast, Full Send and Extra Heat.
· Upgrade symbols: 🔥 must pay 1 Heat when played (if you cannot, discard it and flip for a value instead).
· 🗑️ discard the shown number of cards from the top of your deck.
· ⏱️ adjust the first corner’s speed limit this round by the shown amount.
· ❄️ cool the shown amount after playing.
· 🧘 during React you may discard the shown number of Stress cards.
· 💨 Increase your slipstream distance by the number of spaces shown.
· 🎣 take the shown number of cards from your discard and shuffle them into your deck.
· ♻️ return this card to the top of your deck.
· 👆 during React you may play it directly from hand.
· ⚡ this turn, gain 1 speed for each card flipped.
· Flipping (Stress/Boost/⚡) only counts basic 1-4 speed cards; flipped upgrades are discarded.
Legends (optional):
· Legends are rivals controlled by a deck. Randomly place them in the starting grid together with the players.
· When the first Legend moves each round, one shared Legends card is revealed.
· If a Legend is past the Legends Line, located seven spaces before the corner, move it by the upcoming corner’s speed limit plus the card’s diamond value. A Legend never crosses two corner lines in one move.
· If a Legend has not passed the Legends Line, move it at top speed. If this would cross the corner line, stop it on the numbered space before the corner matching the diamond value, from 0 to 3.
· Legends never slipstream, use Heat, or cool down; they count toward the field for adrenaline but gain no benefit themselves.
· The Legends deck reshuffles as soon as it runs out.

zh.name: 领国者
zh.desc: 领导你的阶级，在政策、产业与民生的博弈中争取胜利。
zh.rules:
目标：
带领工人阶级、中产阶级、资本家阶级或国家，在五轮政治与经济竞争中获得最多胜利点。各阶级的行动、收入与计分方式不同。官方自动对手也参与胜负比较。同分时，先比较前五项政策中符合本阶级偏好的数量（国家按政治议程）；仍同分则国家优先，否则比较票袋中的投票方块数量；再次同分才共同获胜。

准备：
标准两阶级为工人阶级与资本家阶级，第三阶级加入中产阶级，第四阶级加入国家。单人默认扮演工人阶级，其余必要阶级由官方简易自动对手补齐。可在选项中指定真人席位和简易／进阶自动对手；平台机器人占据普通玩家席位，国家没有官方自动对手。
初始政策依次为C、B、A、B、C、B、B。玩家持有7张行动牌，每轮执行5次主行动，轮间抽5张补充。行动牌、隐藏议程与投票中未公开的影响力属于私人信息。

每轮流程：
依次进行准备、行动、生产、选举和计分。每个阶级按工人阶级、中产阶级、资本家阶级、国家的顺序轮流行动，共5次。准备阶段支付贷款利息、更新市场、增加工人并处理移民；工人阶级繁荣降低1，中产阶级繁荣降低2。
每回合必须打出一张行动牌，执行牌面效果，或弃掉它执行本阶级的一项基本行动。每回合至多执行一次自由行动，可在主行动之前或之后执行。选中手牌后仍可返回，确认卡牌效果或基本行动后支付相应费用。
· 工人阶级可提议法案、分配工人、购买商品与服务、罢工、示威或施加政治压力。
· 资本家阶级可提议法案、建造或出售企业、出口、进行商业交易、游说或施加政治压力。
· 中产阶级结合雇工与经营企业，并可执行加班。
· 国家可提议法案、处理事件、出口、会见议员、额外征税或开展宣传。

工人、企业与消费：
熟练岗位须由对应产业的熟练工人担任。工人阶级工人可进入公共及资本家企业，并可担任中产企业的辅助岗位；中产阶级工人可进入自己的企业或公共及资本家企业。一次分配可以同时移动多名工人，目标企业须在分配结束时满足岗位要求。原企业不足时，其余工人回到失业区。新分配的工人在当轮生产前被承诺，不能随意重新分配。工会按产业建立，要求该产业至少有4名工人阶级工人。
企业只有满足岗位要求才运营。机器增加产量，企业支付牌面所列总工资。劳动政策A、B、C分别要求最低工资等级3、2、1。中产企业的辅助工人另增加产量并领取工资。
工人阶级与中产阶级每轮须为人口提供同等数量食物。医疗、教育和奢侈品存入私人资源，达到人口数量后可用一次自由行动消费。消费不同资源时，获得以下效果：
· 医疗提高繁荣，并增加工人。
· 教育提高繁荣，并升级工人。
· 奢侈品提高繁荣。
繁荣提升按本阶级轨道获得胜利点。人口按工人数量区间计算，最低3、最高10。

政策与选举：
七项政策依次为财政、劳动市场、税收、医疗与福利、教育、对外贸易、移民。一般提案把政策移到相邻档位，每个阶级至多有3项法案，同一政策同时只能有一项法案。可支付1影响力立即投票，否则在选举阶段处理。特殊牌可以改变提案条件。
各阶级先声明支持或反对，再从票袋揭示5个投票方块，各方秘密支付私人影响力补票。平票时提案通过。提案者获得3胜利点，其他实际贡献支持票的阶级各获得1胜利点。胜方揭示的方块移除，败方方块回袋。未参局阶级的方块仍按规则参与抽取。

生产、税收与危机：
按国家、资本家、中产、工人的顺序逐家企业生产并支付工资，然后解除工人承诺。中产阶级先满足食物需求，再轮到工人阶级。现金不足以承担强制付款时取得贷款，每笔贷款获得 50 资金，轮间每笔贷款支付 5 资金作为利息。使用自由行动偿还一笔贷款需支付 50 资金；检查 IMF 时，国家偿还每笔贷款需支付 55 资金。
满足需求后检查IMF，再缴税。财政政策A、B下国家取得第二笔贷款触发干预，C下第一笔即触发。基础干预将政策设为C、C、A、B、C、B、B，并重设最低工资。启用危机应对时改为处理危机牌，政策锁定持续到下次检查IMF。
工人阶级按人口缴所得税，中产阶级按公共及资本家就业企业数缴所得税，并为自己的运营企业缴雇佣税；资本家缴雇佣税与公司税。所得税使用生产开始时的劳动政策：劳动A下，税收A／B／C税率为7／6／5；劳动B均为4；劳动C为1／2／3。雇佣税还受医疗、教育政策影响，公司税按收入区间计算。

计分与终局：
· 每轮工人阶级每个工会获得2胜利点。
· 中产阶级以完全运营企业数与繁荣轨道比较，满足条件时提高繁荣。
· 资本家把收入转入资本，按财富等级计分，提高历史最高财富等级时每级另获得3胜利点。
· 国家获得最低的两项合法性之和，以及符合政治议程的政策数量；随后各阶级合法性减半向上取整，再加永久标记。
第五轮计分后进行终局结算。前三阶级按政策1至5符合偏好的数量计分：工人偏好A、资本家偏好C，0至5项依次为0、1、4、8、12、18分；中产偏好B，依次为0、1、3、6、10、15分。
· 除工人阶级外，每剩余 2 份食物获得 1 分；奢侈品、医疗和教育分别计算，每剩余 3 份获得 1 分。国家每剩余 3 点媒体影响力再获得 1 分。
· 工人阶级每剩余 10 资金获得 1 分，最多获得 15 分；中产阶级每剩余 15 资金获得 1 分；国家每剩余 30 资金获得 1 分。
· 资本家阶级每笔未偿贷款扣除 5 分。其他阶级先以资金偿还终局债务，剩余未偿金额每满 5 资金扣除 1 分。

扩展：
“危机与控制”的额外行动牌、隐藏议程、替代事件和危机应对可分别启用。真人从两张隐藏议程中选择一张，满足时获得其胜利点。官方自动对手持有本阶级全部议程，终局仅获得已达成议程中的最高分。替代事件完成后，受益阶级可保留收益牌或立即获得1胜利点。
“历史事件”从六个时期各选一张，分别用于开局及五轮。牌面条件须在触发时满足，主动历史效果只触发一次；揭示和行动结束效果按对应时机处理。国家图标下的效果要求国家玩家参局。“掌控话语权”和“快速决议”赠卡可独立加入。牌面完整说明、条件、事件奖励和持有收益可在详情中查看。

en.name: Hegemony
en.desc: Lead your class through political, economic and social conflict.
en.rules:
Objective:
Lead the Working Class, Middle Class, Capitalist Class or State through five rounds of political and economic competition. The class with the most Victory Points wins. Ties compare matching Policies 1–5 (the Political Agenda for State), then favor State, otherwise compare Voting cubes in the bag. Only a remaining tie shares victory. Official Automas participate in this comparison.

Setup:
The standard two-class game uses Working and Capitalist Classes; add the Middle Class for three and the State for four. Solo defaults to the Working Class with required missing classes filled by Simple Automas. Options select human seats and Simple or Advanced Automas. Platform bots occupy ordinary seats. There is no official State Automa.
Initial Policies are C B A B C B B. Players start with 7 Action cards, take 5 Main Actions per round and draw 5 between rounds. Hands, Hidden Agendas and unrevealed Influence commitments are private.

Round sequence:
Each round has Preparation, Action, Production, Elections and Scoring. Classes act in Working, Middle, Capitalist, State order for five turns each. Preparation includes Loan interest, market refresh, new Workers and Immigration. Working Class Prosperity falls by 1; Middle Class Prosperity falls by 2.
On your turn, play one Action card for its effect or discard it for a Basic Action. You may also take one Free Action before or after your Main Action. Selecting a hand card opens its action choice and allows you to return before confirming.
· Working Class Basic Actions are Propose a Bill, Assign Workers, Buy Goods & Services, Strike, Demonstration and Apply Political Pressure.
· Capitalist can Propose, Build or Sell a Company, Export, make a Business Deal, Lobby or Apply Political Pressure.
· Middle Class combines employment and Company management and can take an Extra Shift.
· State can Propose, resolve Events, Export, Meet with MPs, take Extra Tax or run a Campaign.

Workers, Companies and consumption:
Skilled slots require Workers skilled in the corresponding industry. Working Class Workers can work in Public or Capitalist Companies and Middle Class helper slots. Middle Class Workers can work in their own, Public or Capitalist Companies. Assignments may move several Workers simultaneously. Destinations must meet staffing requirements when finished. If a source Company becomes understaffed, its remaining Workers become unemployed. Newly assigned Workers are committed until Production. A Trade Union requires at least 4 Working Class Workers in its industry.
A Company operates only when required slots are filled. Machinery increases production. Listed Wages are the total per Company. Labor Policies A/B/C require minimum Wage levels 3/2/1. Middle Class helper Workers add production and receive Wages.
Working and Middle Classes cover Food needs equal to Population each round. Health, Education and Luxury are Personal resources, consumed with a Free Action when you have at least your Population. Consuming each resource has the following effect:
· Health increases Prosperity and adds Workers.
· Education increases Prosperity and upgrades Workers.
· Luxury increases Prosperity.
Prosperity increases score according to the class track. Population depends on Worker count, from 3 to 10.

Policies and Elections:
The seven Policies are Fiscal, Labor Market, Taxation, Healthcare & Welfare, Education, Foreign Trade and Immigration. A normal Bill moves a Policy one adjacent space. Each class has at most 3 pending Bills; each Policy can have only one. Spend 1 Influence for an Immediate Vote or wait for Elections. Cards may alter these conditions.
Classes declare support or opposition, reveal 5 Voting cubes, then secretly commit Personal Influence to add votes. A tie passes the Bill. Its proposer gains 3 VP; other supporting classes that contributed votes gain 1 VP each. Winning-side revealed cubes are removed; losing-side cubes return to the bag. Absent-class cubes still participate as specified by the rules.

Production, taxes and crises:
Companies produce and pay Wages in State, Capitalist, Middle, Working order, then Workers are released. Middle covers Food before Working. Forced payments may require Loans: each provides 50, costs 5 interest between rounds and can be repaid by a Free Action for 50. During Check IMF, State repayment costs 55 per Loan.
Check IMF follows needs and precedes taxes. Under Fiscal A/B, the State's second Loan triggers intervention; under C, its first does. Basic intervention sets Policies C C A B C B B and resets minimum Wages. With Crisis Response, resolve a Crisis card instead; its Policy locks last until the next Check IMF.
Working pays Income Tax per Population. Middle pays Income Tax per Public or Capitalist workplace and Employment Tax for its operational Companies. Capitalist pays Employment and Corporate Taxes. Income Tax uses Labor Policy at the start of Production: under Labor A, Taxation A/B/C rates are 7/6/5; under B all are 4; under C they are 1/2/3. Employment Tax also depends on Healthcare and Education Policies. Corporate Tax uses Revenue bands.

Scoring and game end:
· Each round Working gains 2 VP per Trade Union.
· Middle compares fully operational Companies with its Prosperity track and may increase Prosperity.
· Capitalist moves Revenue to Capital and scores its Wealth level, plus 3 VP per new historical-high level.
· State scores its two lowest Legitimacy values and the number of Policies matching its Political Agenda; then each class's Legitimacy is halved, rounded up, plus permanent tokens.
After round 5, score final bonuses. For matching Policies 1–5, Working prefers A and Capitalist C: 0–5 matches score 0/1/4/8/12/18 VP. Middle prefers B: 0/1/3/6/10/15 VP.
· Classes other than Working score 1 VP per 2 Food and per 3 Luxury, Health or Education; State also scores per 3 Media Influence.
· Working scores 1 VP per 10 money, capped at 15 VP; Middle scores 1 VP per 15 money; State scores 1 VP per 30 money.
· Capitalist loses 5 VP per Loan.
· Other classes spend available money toward final debt and lose 1 VP per 5 unpaid.

Expansions:
Crisis & Control Extra Action Cards, Hidden Agendas, Alternative Events and Crisis Response can be enabled separately. Humans choose one of two Hidden Agendas and score it when achieved. Official Automas hold all their class Agendas and score only the highest achieved Agenda at game end. After an Alternative Event, the beneficiary may keep its benefit card or immediately gain 1 VP.
Historical Events selects one card from each of six periods for Setup and the five rounds. Requirements must hold when triggered. Active effects are used once; reveal and end-of-Action effects resolve at their stated times. State-icon sections require a State player. Controlling the Narrative and Rapid Resolution promos can be added separately. Inspect cards for full effects, requirements, Event rewards and ongoing benefits.

zh.name: 本草
zh.desc: 秘密交换药材信息,抢先推导出平息瘟疫的两味解药
zh.rules:
目标:抢先猜出本局解药(两味药材)得分,先积 6 分者获胜(2 人与 2v2 为 7 分)。
准备:
· 将 2 张药材卡面朝下放在解药行动卡下，作为本局解药；所有玩家均不得查看。
· 其余药材卡平均发作手牌,内容保密、数量公开。
· 药引卡共 7 张：6 张分别对应六种双色组合，另有 1 张为同色药引卡。
流程:
· 每回合必须先把药师移到另一张药引卡,再执行一个行动。
· 问药:秘密交给对方 1 张药引卡上其中一色的药材卡,对方公开说明自己手中另一种颜色的药材卡数量。
· 喂药:给药方式与问药相同,对方再归还手上全部另一色的卡。
· 组药:向对方索取药引卡两色各 1 张;站在同色药引卡上时,对方任选 2 张同色卡交出。
· 求药:对方选药引卡两色之一,把手上该色的卡全部给你;同色卡则任选一种颜色。
· 解药:把 Answer 标记放到一张药引卡上,宣告解答。
· 其他人顺次选择:放到另一张空药引卡、跟随放置到同一张药引卡上（Follow）,或放弃。
· 放置标记者依次秘密查看解药:自己所选药引颜色与解药一致的玩家成为解答者；猜错的玩家失去所放置的标记,且其下个回合被跳过。
结算:
· 解答者获得 3 分;跟随放置且猜中解药颜色的玩家获得 1 分，猜错的玩家扣除 1 分;放置 Answer 标记但猜错的玩家不扣分。
· 猜测标记(进阶):试药行动后可获得 1 枚,用于预测解药成分。
· 局末结算时预测命中获得 1 分、落空扣 1 分,分数不会低于 0。
变体:
· 2 人游戏中，增设一名持有 4 张手牌的中立玩家；对中立玩家只能执行试药行动。
· 试药:随机抽中立玩家的 1 张手牌,查看后收入自己手牌。
· 随后把药师移到含该色的药引卡,再把手上另一色的卡全部交给中立玩家。
· 2v2(4 人)游戏中，坐在对面的玩家互为队友，试药只能指定对手。每队共用 1 枚解药标记，不使用 Follow 标记。
· 传药(仅 2v2):与队友按药引卡两色互换全部手牌;站在同色药引卡上时不能传药。

en.name: Herbalism
en.desc: Trade ingredient clues in secret and be first to deduce the two-card cure
en.rules:
Goal: be the first to name the cure (two ingredients) to score; first to 6 points wins (7 in 2-player and 2v2).
Setup:
· Two ingredient cards go face-down under the Curing card as this round’s cure; nobody may look at them.
· Deal the remaining ingredient cards evenly to the players. Keep their contents secret, but make the number of cards in each hand public.
· Use seven medicine cards: one for each of the six two-color pairs and one same-color card.
Play:
· Each turn you must first move your pharmacist to a different medicine card, then take one action.
· Inquiring: secretly give the receiver 1 card of one of the medicine card’s colors; they publicly announce how many of the other color they hold.
· Feeding: give a card the same way as Inquiring; the receiver then returns every card of the other color.
· Brewing: demand 1 card of each of the medicine card’s two colors; on the same-color card they choose any 2 same-color cards to hand over.
· Appealing: the receiver picks one of the medicine card’s two colors and gives you every card of it; on the same-color card they pick any one color.
· Curing: place your Answer marker on a medicine card to declare your solution.
· The others in turn choose: place on a different empty medicine card, Follow onto the same card, or pass.
· Marked players then secretly peek at the cure in order: if the colors on your chosen medicine card match the cure, you become the solver. Otherwise, you lose your placed marker and your next turn is skipped.
Scoring:
· The solver gains 3 points; a correct Follow gains 1 point, a wrong Follow loses 1 point; an incorrect Answer does not lose points.
· Prediction markers (advanced): after a tasting action you may take 1 to bet on a cure ingredient.
· At game end a correct prediction gains 1 point and a wrong one loses 1 point; scores never drop below 0.
Variants:
· 2 players: a neutral player holds 4 cards; you may only take the tasting action with them.
· Tasting: draw 1 card at random from the neutral player’s hand, look at it, and add it to your hand.
· Then move your pharmacist to a medicine card of that color and hand all your cards of the other color to the neutral player.
· In 2v2 with four players, partners sit opposite each other and tasting actions can target only opponents. Each team shares one cure marker, and Follow markers are not used.
· Communicating (2v2 only): swap all cards of the medicine card’s two colors with your partner; not allowed while standing on the same-color card.

zh.name: 英雄之笔伐征途
zh.desc: 十六回合编程行动,占要塞、打怪、收神器,六个阵营各走各的发展路线
zh.rules:
目标:十六回合后总得分最高者获胜。
流程:
· 每回合先手从伐木、采铁、采金、移动、建造中选四个行动,各分配等级一至四。
· 其余玩家设置相同的行动编程。所有玩家按等级从低到高同时执行对应行动。
· 执行采集行动时，获得与行动等级对应数量的资源。
· 执行移动行动时，获得与行动等级对应的移动力。
· 执行建造行动时，可以建造一座等级不超过行动等级的建筑，并可以招募部队。
· 每回合结束,先手移交给左邻玩家。
移动与战斗:
· 沿相邻区域逐格移动,每进入一个区域按其地形支付移动力。
· 移动途中不领取区域资源；只有首次到达目的地区域时，才能获得该区域印有的资源。
· 同区有多名玩家时同时秘密选择宣战或和平,有人宣战则全员混战。
· 战斗时，双方秘密部署部队，力量严格高于对方的一方获胜；力量相同时，双方均战败。战斗结束后，所有参战单位均被消灭，包括胜方单位。
· 可以使用剩余移动力跳过怪物线上的怪物，以选择挑战目标；每支付1点移动力，可以按顺序跳过一只尚未击败的怪物。
发展:
· 每座要塞在整局中只能由一名玩家占领，只有力量超过其守备值时才能占领。地基会记录所建建筑的等级，并在终局时据此计分。
· 六件神器各有收取条件;被诅咒的区域会让造访的对手失去最弱部队。
· 六个阵营的建筑树、部队与地形费用各不相同。
计分:
· 将建筑、地基等级、达到资源阈值、击败怪物、要塞及神器所提供的分数相加，得到总分。
· 平分比较库存资源总量,再平则共享胜利。

en.name: Heroes: Write & Conquer
en.desc: Sixteen rounds of programmed actions: fortresses, monsters, artifacts, six asymmetric factions
en.rules:
Goal: after sixteen rounds, the highest total score wins.
Rounds:
· The first player picks four of five actions and assigns levels one to four.
· Everyone copies the same program; actions run in ascending level order.
· A Gathering action grants resources according to its level.
· A Movement action grants movement points according to its level.
· A Building action lets you build one building up to the action’s level and recruit units.
· At the end of each round, the first-player role passes left.
Movement and combat:
· Move region by region, paying the terrain cost of each region entered.
· Do not collect resources from regions you pass through. Collect the printed resources only on your first visit to the region where your movement ends.
· When multiple players occupy the same region, each secretly chooses war or peace. If anyone chooses war, all players in that region fight.
· Deploy units secretly. The side with strictly greater strength wins; equal strength defeats both sides. All units committed to the battle are eliminated afterward, including the winner’s units.
· Use remaining movement points to choose a monster on your track to challenge. Each point lets you skip one undefeated monster in track order.
Development:
· Each fortress can be captured by only one player in the game. Your strength must exceed its defense to capture it. Foundations record the level of the building constructed there and score points at game end.
· Six artifacts have their own conditions; curses weaken visiting rivals.
· Each faction has its own buildings, troops, and terrain costs.
Scoring:
· Add the points provided by buildings, foundation levels, reached resource thresholds, defeated monsters, fortresses and artifacts to obtain your final score.
· Ties break on stockpiled resources; further ties share the victory.

search.py: ying xiong zhi bi fa zheng tu

zh.name: 魔法门之英雄无敌3
zh.desc: 探索埃拉西亚、建设城镇，率领军队争夺荣耀。
zh.rules:
目标：
按照所选任务的胜利条件，探索地图、占领地点或击败敌方英雄。
准备：
选择英雄与阵营，获得任务指定的资源、军队、建筑和九张起始牌。
流程：
每回合开始时，可弃掉任意数量的手牌，再抽至手牌上限。主英雄有3点移动力，副英雄有2点。每轮各可进行一次建造、人口和魔法行会行动。人口行动期间可连续招募或强化多个单位。
战斗：
· 基础战场为4列5行，只有正交邻接。单位按主动值从高到低行动，同值时双方交替，进攻方先行。
· 中立战斗通常持续一轮，可支付1点移动力继续；蔚蓝单位和玩家间战斗持续至结束。
卡牌：
搜寻前先选择牌库或公共弃牌顶。搜寻牌库时查看指定数量的牌，获得一张，其余弃置。
每个战斗轮通常只能施放一个法术，可弃置其他法术或使用力量效果强化。
结束：
任务目标、时间限制与特殊事件以所选任务为准。

en.name: Heroes of Might and Magic III
en.desc: Explore Erathia, develop your town and command armies in pursuit of glory.
en.rules:
Objective:
Fulfil the chosen mission by exploring, capturing locations or defeating enemy heroes.
Setup:
Choose a hero and faction, then receive the resources, army, buildings and nine starting cards specified by the mission.
Turns:
At the start of your turn, discard any number of cards and draw to your hand limit. A main hero has 3 movement points; a secondary hero has 2. Build, population and mage guild actions are each available once per round. A population action allows multiple recruitment and reinforcement purchases.
Combat:
· The standard board has 4 columns and 5 rows, with orthogonal adjacency. Units act in descending initiative order. Equal initiatives alternate sides, starting with the attacker.
· Most neutral encounters last one round, with another round costing 1 movement point. Azure and player combats continue until resolved.
Cards:
Before searching, choose the deck or the top of its shared discard pile. When searching a deck, examine the specified number, keep one card and discard the rest.
Normally, one spell can be cast per combat round, strengthened by discarding other spells or playing Power effects.
End:
The chosen mission determines its objectives, time limit and special events.

search.py: mo fa men zhi ying xiong wu di san

zh.name: 无马之车
zh.desc: 在汽车工业的黎明，拼建工厂、研发技术，并争夺不断变化的市场。
zh.rules:
目标：
经营一家早期汽车工厂，通过销售车辆积累财富。游戏结束时财富最多者获胜；财富相同时，销售专注更高者获胜。
准备：
游戏支持3–5人。每人选择一位工业家，获得其17张需求牌、3个不同尺寸的经销商、4个营销部门，以及一块12行12列的主地板和6块6行8列的扩建板。先在主地板放置一个3行3列的研究部门和一个3行2列的规划部门，组件只能覆盖黑格，并通过边相邻的组件连到装卸区。装卸区和通道必须保持畅通。
随机确定工程顺序，按相反顺序给予1至人数张甘特图。两条随机的活跃研发轨起始为1，其余研发轨起始为0；各产线产能为1。3、4、5人分别有24、32、40格时间。初始从中立牌抽取人数加1张，在象限I放置买家，最低价格区定价6。
年度流程：
每年依次进行以下步骤：
· 进行研发。
· 设置专注。
· 建造工厂。
· 印制销售册。
· 销售汽车。
· 检查是否结束游戏。
· 改变预期。
· 进行需求增长。
游戏最多进行七年。
研发：
按上一年的工程顺序，每个研究部门必须推进一个不同标记一步。可以推进自己的产能，或任意玩家在五项技术上的研发；同一玩家本阶段不能重复推进同一标记。研发上限6，产能上限5；研发推进到第4或第6格、产能推进到第5格时，时间减少1。
设置专注：
甘特图最多者先行动，平手时工程顺序较高者先行。选择任意空位并清空自己的甘特图，或保留甘特图并跳过。跳过者按原工程相对顺序填入剩余位置。左侧工程优先，右侧销售优先。每年重新选择。
建厂：
按工程顺序，在现有地板上放置任意数量的组件，然后必须增加一块扩建板，直至6块扩建板用尽。扩建板必须与既有地板边相邻、对齐网格，且不能重叠或堵住任一装卸区向外的通道。新扩建区域从下一年起才能建造。
以前年度的组件不能移动或移除。本年草稿可以调整，确认时整体布局必须合法。所有组件必须完全覆盖黑格、不重叠，并经连续组件连到装卸区。每条主线必须邻接经销商，每个经销商也必须邻接主线；营销部门必须邻接经销商。各组件和规格箭头供应有限，工程顺序决定取得优先权。
技术与制造区：
技术站和规格箭头标有A、B、C或D工序。它们只能通过同工序组件和主线对应的一侧连通；每个制造区必须包含主线，同一制造区不能出现两个同名技术站。不同制造区可以重复技术站。
自己研发达到某项技术位置时，可以建造对应技术站和该位置的规格箭头。工程第一位也能使用至少1位其他玩家已研发的技术，第二位需要至少2位其他玩家，依次类推。每个技术站至少有一个邻接且指向自己的规格箭头。每个研发位置在同一技术站最多提供一个箭头；同一维度在轨道上重复出现的技术位置各提供一个贡献。
已建技术和箭头不会因次年失去专利权限而失效；新增技术站或补充箭头仍要满足当年的权限。
销售册：
每个规划部门增加1张甘特图，最多20张；经过10时，时间减少1。每条主线的五项规格等于其各制造区内相应规格箭头的数量。一个经销商邻接多条主线时，每项规格取这些主线中的最低值，能够销售各主线的车型。
销售窗口按相邻营销部门数量确定：
· 没有相邻营销部门时，使用 1 行 2 列的窗口。
· 有一个相邻营销部门时，使用 2 行 2 列的窗口。
· 有至少两个相邻营销部门时，使用 3 行 3 列的窗口。
销售：
从销售专注最高者开始轮流销售。每次选择一个经销商和窗口内的一个细分格，必须向该格所有可满足的买家销售，直到对应产能用尽；同一格有多种可生产车型时必须同时销售。不能在有销售机会时跳过。每条主线每年的总产量不超过自己的产能，连接同一主线的经销商共享该限额；多条同类主线时可以选择消耗哪条产线。
