zh.name: 迷失代码
zh.desc: 看得见所有人的数字,唯独看不见自己的
zh.rules:
目标:终局押注后,计分轨上最前者获胜(平局时并列堆底部者胜)。
准备:
· 6 种符号(鸟/美洲豹/变色龙/蛇/人/熊)各有数字 0-7 的石头;每符号先秘密移出 1 块回盒。
· 每个石板每符号插 1 块石头:数字只有主人看不见,其他人全可见;空位石板填满且完全公开。
· 指示物在起点随机叠放(叠序是平局判据);2 人 10 轮、3 人 9 轮、4 人 8 轮。
流程:
· 每轮由计分轨最后一名掷 3 个符号骰,可把其中 1 个翻成任意符号。
· 从最后一名起逆序选 1 个轮盘,并定出窗口覆盖的范围。七个轮盘的分值与窗口宽度如下：
· 1 分轮盘的窗口覆盖十格。
· 两个 2 分轮盘的窗口分别覆盖七格和五格。
· 两个 3 分轮盘的窗口分别覆盖四格和三格。
· 4 分轮盘的窗口覆盖两格。
· 5 分轮盘的窗口覆盖一格。

· 从掷骰者起逐个结算:猜的是自己石板上被掷出符号对应数字之和。命中获得轮盘分并前进;猜错由他人诚实告知真实和偏高或偏低(5 分轮盘只报对错)。
· 全部结算完后,猜错者按计分逆序换石:弃 1 块石头(公开),从同符号堆抽 1 块新石头(自己看不见)。
结束:
· 最后一轮后,每名玩家为自己的每种符号押注一至三个数字。若包含正确数字，押注一个数字获得 5 分，押注两个数字获得 2 分，押注三个数字获得 1 分；未押注或押错时，扣除 2 分。将得失分数换算为计分轨移动，最终分数可以为负数。
变体:
· 神庙诅咒:首个到达第 7 格者被诅咒——别人猜错时自己获得 1 分,自己猜错倒扣轮盘分并后退;有人到 13 格或最后一轮开始前移除。
· 死亡捷径:掷出对子/三条时可认领该符号标记并立即锁定终局押注,押中得分翻倍、押错扣 4 分;最后 3 轮禁用。

en.name: The Lost Code
en.desc: You can see everyone's numbers — except your own
en.rules:
Goal: after the final bets, whoever is farthest along the score track wins (ties go to the player at the bottom of the shared stack).
Setup:
· Six symbols (bird/jaguar/chameleon/snake/human/bear), stones numbered 0-7 each; one stone per symbol is secretly returned to the box.
· Each log holds one stone per symbol: the owner never sees their own numbers, everyone else does; empty logs are filled and fully public.
· Pawns start stacked randomly on space 0 (stack order breaks ties); 10 rounds with 2 players, 9 with 3, 8 with 4.
Play:
· Each round the last player on the track rolls 3 symbol dice and may flip one die to any symbol.
· Starting from last place, players pick a wheel in turn and set the range its window covers. The seven wheels have these values and window sizes:
· The 1-point wheel covers ten spaces.
· The two 2-point wheels cover seven and five spaces respectively.
· The two 3-point wheels cover four and three spaces respectively.
· The 4-point wheel covers two spaces.
· The 5-point wheel covers one space.

· From the roller on, guesses resolve: you guess the sum of your own stones of the rolled symbols. Hit: gain the wheel value and move on. Miss: others must honestly say whether the true sum is higher or lower (the 5-point wheel only reveals right or wrong).
· After all guesses, each misser in reverse score order swaps a stone: discard one face-up (public) and draw 1 new stone from the same pile (hidden from yourself).
End:
· After the last round, bet on one to three numbers for each of your symbols. If your selection contains the correct number, score 5 points for choosing one number, 2 for choosing two, or 1 for choosing three. A wrong or omitted bet loses 2 points. Apply the result as movement on the score track, which may take your score below zero.
Variants:
· Curse of the Temple: the first player to reach space 7 is cursed — they gain 1 VP whenever anyone else misses, but a miss of their own costs the wheel value and moves them back; the curse ends when someone reaches 13 or before the final round.
· Deadly Shortcut: when doubles/triples are rolled, the matching token may be claimed to lock a final bet on that symbol — double VP if right, lose 4 VP if wrong; unavailable in the last 3 rounds.

zh.name: 克苏鲁情书
zh.desc: 在疯狂边缘递出信件:理智与疯狂双面效果,理智检定随时可能让你出局
zh.rules:
目标:通过赢得回合收集理智币。先集齐 2 枚理智币或 3 枚疯狂币的人获胜;
克苏鲁的疯狂效果可直接赢下整局。
流程(轮到你):
· 若你已疯狂,先做理智检定:翻开牌堆顶的牌,张数等于你弃牌堆里的疯狂卡数;翻出疯狂卡、死灵之书或克苏鲁即出局,若翻牌时牌堆被翻空,回合立即结束。
· 摸一张牌,从手牌中选一张弃置并执行效果;疯狂卡可按你当前状态,二选一执行理智或疯狂效果(各卡效果见图鉴)。
疯狂:
· 你的弃牌堆里只要出现过疯狂卡,你即陷入疯狂,直到回合结束。
· 银钥匙、偏方三八面体与大于 4 的牌同在手时必须弃置;疯狂者持偏方三八面体与大于 4 的牌,则直接赢下回合。
回合结束:
· 牌堆耗尽或只剩一人时回合结束。牌堆耗尽时幸存者比手牌:数字相同者全部出局,剩余最大者获得 1 枚理智币(疯狂者亮疯狂面);全部相同则无人得币。

en.name: Lovecraft Letter
en.desc: Deliver the letter on the brink of madness: dual sane/insane effects, and sanity checks that can knock you out
en.rules:
Goal: win rounds to collect sanity tokens. First to 2 sane-side or 3 insane-side tokens wins;
the insane effect of Cthulhu wins the whole game instantly.
On your turn:
· If you are insane, first make a sanity check: reveal a number of deck cards equal to the number of insanity cards in your discard pile; revealing an insanity card, the Necronomicon or Cthulhu knocks you out, and if the deck runs out mid-check the round ends at once.
· Draw a card, then discard one from your hand and apply its effect; insanity cards offer a choice of their sane or insane effect (see the card gallery).
Insanity:
· Once your discard pile contains any insanity card, you are insane until the round ends.
· The Silver Key and the Trapezohedron must be discarded while held with a card higher than 4; an insane holder of the Trapezohedron with such a card wins the round instead.
Round end:
· The round ends when the deck is exhausted or one player remains. On exhaustion, survivors compare hands: all tied numbers are knocked out, the highest remaining card wins 1 token (insane winners flip it to the insane side); if everyone ties, nobody scores.

zh.name: 情书
zh.desc: 把情书递到公主手里:猜牌、比大小、护住自己,活到最后
zh.rules:
目标:赢下回合收集好感标记,先集齐目标数的人获胜。
流程(轮到你):
· 抽一张牌,从手牌两张中选一张打出并执行效果(各角色效果见下方图鉴)。
· 女伯爵与国王或王子同在手时,必须打出她。
回合结束:
· 牌库耗尽或只剩一人时回合结束:幸存者中手牌最大者获得 1 枚好感标记;平手比弃牌点数总和,再平则无人得分。
· 新版中,回合结束时若全场只有你打出或弃过间谍,额外获得 1 枚好感标记。
获胜所需标记:
· 经典版(2~4 人):2 人 7 枚,3 人 5 枚,4 人 4 枚。
· 新版(2~6 人):2 人 6 枚,3 人 5 枚,4 人 4 枚,5~6 人 3 枚。
新版牌面点数：国王为 7，女伯爵为 8，公主为 9。

en.name: Love Letter
en.desc: Get your letter to the princess: guess hands, compare values, stay alive
en.rules:
Goal: win rounds to collect favor tokens; the first to the target wins.
On your turn:
· Draw one card, then play one of your two cards and apply its effect (each role is listed in the gallery below).
· The Countess must be played while held with the King or the Prince.
Round end:
· A round ends when the deck runs out or one player remains: the highest surviving hand earns 1 favor token; ties break on discard-pile total, and a further tie scores nobody.
· In the new edition, if you alone played or discarded a Spy this round, gain 1 bonus favor token at round end.
Tokens to win:
· Classic (2–4 players): 7 with 2 players, 5 with 3, 4 with 4.
· New edition (2–6 players): 6 with 2 players, 5 with 3, 4 with 4, 3 with 5–6.
Card values in the new edition: the King has value 7, the Countess 8 and the Princess 9.

zh.name: 瘋王城堡
zh.desc: 为国王定价、采购和拼建城堡，争取独特房间与国王恩宠。
zh.rules:
目标：
通过拼建房间、完成房间并争取国王恩宠获得最多分数。本游戏采用 2014 原版基础规则；Secrets 为开局可选的完整扩展，支持 1–4 人。

准备：
每人获得门厅、15000 马克和 3 张私人奖励牌，按大师顺序各弃 1 张到牌堆底。起始分依次为 0、1、2、3。依人数设置房间堆，房间牌洗后取 22／33／44 张；每人对应一项公开国王恩宠。Secrets 将门厅换为门楼，并加入新房间、护城河、暗道和天鹅。

回合流程：
建筑大师补满市场，将所有市场房间分别放到不同价格。两人价格为 15000 马克、10000 马克、8000 马克、6000 马克、4000 马克；三人增加 2000 马克，四人再增加 1000 马克。大师左手玩家先行动，大师最后行动。你可以按标价购买一个市场房间，花 3000 马克 购买一块走廊或楼梯，或者领取 5000 马克。购买付款给大师，大师自己的购买付款给银行；护城河始终付款给银行。房间上的金币随购买获得，也可以用于购买该房间。未售房间每轮增加 1000 马克。

建造与得分：
新房间至少通过一对对齐入口连入城堡，只能以 90 度旋转，圆形房间也相同。房间不能重叠，门可以靠墙但不算连接。城堡始终保留至少一扇通向真正外界的入口，封闭庭院不算外界。庭园有围栏的边不能接任何房间；地下室与地下走廊只能经楼梯连接地面层，楼梯亮端在地面、暗端在地下，楼梯不能相互连接。
放置时获得基础分与本房间的条件分，同时结算既有相连房间的条件分、相邻活动室的扣分和地下室的全城加分。只在角点接触不算活动室邻接。房间所有入口都与其他入口连接时完成；同时完成多间时可选择奖励顺序。

完成奖励：
· 起居室：重新结算本房间的基础分与条件分。
· 活动室：获得 5 分。
· 卧室：查看一个面积的房间堆，选 0–2 块依次放到房间牌堆顶，后放者先出现，其余洗回。最后一轮选出的房间移出，不延长游戏。
· 庭园：获得 10000 马克。
· 杂务室：抽 2 张私人奖励牌，保留 1 张，另一张放回牌堆底。
· 餐饮室：立即额外行动一次，使用当前市场。
· 通道：免费建造一块走廊或楼梯，每回合限一次；餐饮室的额外回合重新计算此限制。
· 地下室：每完成第 2、4、6 等偶数间时，任选其余七类奖励。选择起居室奖励时，重新结算本次刚完成的一间地下室。

Secrets：
新房间在市场出现时放上明置天鹅，购买时一并获得。每回合最多出售 5 枚，任意颜色的 1／2／3／4／5 枚分别换 1000 马克、3000 马克、6000 马克、10000 马克和 15000 马克。终局按不同颜色组成的各组获得 1／3／6／10／15 分；已出售的天鹅移出。
每段护城河的价格为 5000 马克，替代本回合普通行动，必须拼接已有河段，每人最多购买三段。购买时移出房间牌堆顶一张，若顶上是房间则移出该房间；因此耗尽牌堆时，当前回合结束即终局。每段获得 3 分，且城堡内每间非通道、非庭园房间各获得 1 分；以后新建这六类房间也按已购河段逐段加分。第三段闭合时，可查看一个面积堆，免费立即建造其中 0–1 块，其余洗回。
房间不能压住河段或门楼。闭合后非庭园房间只能建在河内；庭园可在内外，围栏不能贴河岸石边。河外只能通过门楼吊桥相连，吊桥外先接庭园；门楼含吊桥的全部入口连接后才完成。门楼计 225 面积，起始河段及每个河段另计 1000 面积；河段不算完成房间。
每人三种暗道各一块。建造房间时可同时放暗道，必须直接连接本次所建房间；领取 5000 马克时也可使用。两端必须同时接在不同房间的入口上，不能接暗道，不能连接已通过另一对入口直接相连的房间，不能压住其他物件。暗道让两端的连接条件分翻倍，起居室重算也包括它；仅通过暗道连接而没有实际邻接时，不产生活动室噪声扣分。暗道不计房间、面积或恩宠。
庭院是完全封闭且至少有一扇门通入的空区；河岸石边可以围庭院，水边不可以。新增恩宠分别比较天鹅枚数、无天鹅图标房间数、庭院数与护城河段数；河段恩宠包括起始段，无天鹅房间包括通道与河段。

结束与计分：
普通房间牌堆耗尽的那轮完成后结束，必要时洗弃牌补满最后市场。每项恩宠按名次获得 8、4、2、1 分；相同指标平分占用名次的奖金并向下取整，指标为零不得分。每个耗尽堆中自己已建的对应组件各值 2 分，包含走廊、楼梯和护城河。再结算私人奖励牌、每剩余 10000 马克获得 1 分及天鹅。总分最高者获胜，平分比较城堡总面积。

单人游戏：
按三人房间堆和 33 张牌准备，15000、0 分、2 张奖励牌全部保留，无国王恩宠。每回合依次翻三块到 2000、4000、6000，回合结束移出未买房间，所有购买付款给银行。基础评级为 0–50、51–70、71–85、86–100、101 以上；Secrets 为 0–60、61–80、81–95、96–110、111 以上。

en.name: Castles of Mad King Ludwig
en.desc: Price, purchase and build an extraordinary castle for the King.
en.rules:
Goal:
Build rooms, complete them and compete for King's Favors to score the most points. This game uses the original 2014 base rules and supports 1–4 players. The complete 2015 Secrets expansion is optional.

Setup:
Each player receives a Foyer, 15,000 Marks and three Bonus cards, returning one card to the bottom in Master Builder order. Starting scores are 0, 1, 2 and 3. Prepare room stacks for the player count and use 22/33/44 shuffled Room cards, plus one public Favor per player. Secrets replaces the Foyer with a Barbican and adds new rooms, Moats, Secret Passages and Swans.

Rounds:
The Master Builder fills the market and assigns every room a different price. Two players use 15,000 Marks/10,000 Marks/8,000 Marks/6,000 Marks/4,000 Marks; three add 2,000 Marks; four add 1,000 Marks. Starting left of the Master Builder, each player buys a market room, buys a Hallway or Stairs for 3,000 Marks, or takes 5,000 Marks. Pay the Master Builder; the Master Builder pays the bank. Moats always cost the bank. Coins on a purchased room belong to its buyer and may pay for that room. Unsold rooms gain 1,000 Marks each round.

Building and scoring:
A new room must connect at least one aligned entrance to the castle. Rotate only by 90 degrees, including round rooms. Tiles cannot overlap. An entrance may face a wall but is then unconnected. Keep at least one entrance to the true exterior; an enclosed Courtyard does not count. Outdoor fence edges cannot touch rooms. Downstairs rooms and Hallways connect to the main floor only via Stairs: light end upstairs, dark end downstairs. Stairs cannot connect to Stairs.
Score the room's base and conditional points, existing connected rooms' conditional points, adjacent Activity penalties, and global Downstairs bonuses. Corner-only contact does not create Activity adjacency. A room completes when every entrance connects to another entrance. Choose the order when several rooms complete.

Completion rewards:
· Living: re-score this room's base and conditional points.
· Activity: gain 5 points.
· Sleeping: inspect one size stack and place 0–2 rooms on the Room deck, last selected first. Shuffle the rest. In the last round, remove selected rooms instead; they do not extend the game.
· Outdoor: gain 10,000 Marks.
· Utility: draw two Bonus cards, keep one and return the other to the bottom.
· Food: take an immediate extra turn using the current market.
· Corridor: build a free Hallway or Stairs, at most once per turn. A Food extra turn resets this limit.
· Downstairs: for every second, fourth, sixth and subsequent even completed Downstairs room, choose any of the other seven rewards. A Living reward re-scores one Downstairs room completed by this placement.

Secrets:
Put face-up Swans on new rooms when they enter the market; the buyer collects them. Sell at most five Swans per turn: 1/2/3/4/5 of any colors yield 1,000, 3,000, 6,000, 10,000 or 15,000 Marks respectively. At game end, sets of distinct colors score 1/3/6/10/15. Sold Swans leave the game.
A Moat costs 5,000 Marks and replaces your normal turn action and must adjoin an existing section. Buy at most three. Remove the top Room card, or a room on top of the deck; exhausting the deck this way ends the game after the current turn. Each Moat scores 3 plus 1 per room other than Corridor or Outdoor. Future rooms of those six types score 1 per purchased Moat. Closing the third section lets you inspect one size stack and immediately build 0–1 room free, then shuffle the rest.
Do not overlap rooms with Moats or the Barbican. After closing the Moat, non-Outdoor rooms must be inside. Outdoor rooms may be inside or outside, but fences cannot touch the stone bank. Outside connections cross the drawbridge through an Outdoor room. The Barbican completes only when all entrances, including its drawbridge, connect. The gatehouse has area 225; its starting Moat and each additional section add 1,000 area. Moats do not count as completed rooms.
Each player has one of each of three Secret Passages. Place them with a new room, directly connecting that room, or when taking 5,000 Marks. Both ends must connect different rooms; do not connect Passages to Passages or rooms already directly connected through another pair of entrances. Do not overlap other pieces. Both rooms receive double conditional connection points, including Living re-scoring. A Passage alone transmits no Activity noise; actual adjacency still incurs penalties. Passages are not rooms and have no area or Favor value.
A Courtyard is a fully enclosed empty area with an entrance into it. Stone banks may bound it, water edges may not. New Favors compare held Swans, rooms without Swan icons, Courtyards and Moat sections. Moats include the starting section; rooms without Swans include Corridors and Moats.

Game end:
Finish the round in which the ordinary Room deck runs out, reshuffling discards to fill the last market if needed. Each Favor awards 8/4/2/1 by rank; ties share occupied prizes, rounded down. A zero metric earns nothing. Each built tile from an exhausted stack scores 2, including Hallways, Stairs and Moats. Add Bonus cards, 1 point per 10,000 Marks remaining, and Swans. Highest total wins; ties compare total castle area.

Solo:
Use three-player room stacks and 33 Room cards. Start with 15,000, zero points and both of two Bonus cards; no Favors. Each turn draw three rooms at 2,000/4,000/6,000 in order. Remove unbought rooms at turn end, and pay all costs to the bank. Base ratings are 0–50/51–70/71–85/86–100/101+; Secrets uses 0–60/61–80/81–95/96–110/111+.

zh.name: 骰子街2
zh.desc: 掷骰建设你的城市:产业生钱、地标定胜,先建成 3 个地标获胜
zh.rules:
目标:最先建成第 3 个地标的玩家立即获胜;建成发射台也立即获胜。
准备:
· 卡牌分三叠:产业 1-6、产业 7-12、地标,分别洗匀;各叠逐张翻开,直到市场行有 5 种不同卡牌(同名叠放)。
· 每名玩家获得 5 枚金币。
· 从起始玩家开始顺时针进行 3 轮初始建设:每轮每人至多建 1 个产业,可以放弃。
流程:
每个回合依次进行掷骰、收入和建设三个步骤。掷骰时，自行选择掷 1 枚或 2 枚骰子；掷 2 枚时，使用点数之和。
· 收入:所有玩家激活点数匹配的产业,顺序为红(餐馆,仅对手回合,从当前玩家收取)→ 蓝(任何回合)与绿(仅自己回合)→ 紫(仅自己回合)→ 橙色地标。
· 需向多名玩家付款时按逆时针逐个付清;现金不足时，支付全部剩余金币，未能支付的部分不再追偿。
· 建设步骤中，至多建造 1 个产业或地标。如果建设步骤开始时没有金币，先从银行领取 1 枚金币。
· 建成后对应市场行不足 5 种时,翻开牌叠补足;牌堆耗尽后不再补充。
地标:
· 地标的建造费用分为三档。建造自己的第一、第二或第三个地标时，分别支付对应档位的费用。
· 即时效果(紫)建成时结算一次,仅建造者受益;持续效果(橙)此后对所有玩家生效。
· 掷出对子可能触发游乐园(再来一回合)、寺庙(收取金币)、搬家公司(交出产业)等效果。
说明:预购赠卡地标(市政厅、私人俱乐部、翻新公司)为可选扩展,默认不加入。

en.name: Machi Koro 2
en.desc: Roll dice and build your city: establishments earn coins, landmarks win the race to 3
en.rules:
Goal: the first player to build their 3rd landmark wins immediately; building the Launch Pad also wins instantly.
Setup:
· Sort the cards into three decks: establishments 1-6, establishments 7-12, and landmarks; shuffle each separately. Reveal cards from each deck until its market row has 5 different cards (duplicates stack).
· Each player starts with 5 coins.
· Starting with the start player and going clockwise, play 3 initial building rounds: each player may build at most 1 establishment per round, or pass.
Play:
· A turn has three steps: roll the dice (your choice of 1 or 2, summed) → earn income → build.
· Income: all players activate establishments matching the roll, in this order: red (restaurants, only on opponents' turns, paid by the active player) → blue (any turn) and green (your turn only) → purple (your turn only) → orange landmarks.
· If you owe several players, pay them in counterclockwise order, each in full before the next; if you cannot pay in full, pay what you can and the rest is forgiven.
· Build: build at most 1 establishment or landmark; if you have no coins at the start of the build step, take 1 coin from the bank first.
· After a build, refill the matching market row to 5 different cards; empty decks are not refilled.
Landmarks:
· Landmark costs come in three tiers: pay the tier matching whether it is your 1st, 2nd, or 3rd landmark.
· Instant effects (magenta) resolve once when built, for the builder only; ongoing effects (orange) apply to all players from then on.
· Rolling doubles may trigger effects such as Amusement Park (extra turn), Temple (take coins), or Moving Company (give an establishment away).
Note: the promo landmarks (City Hall, Private Club, Renovation Company) are an optional expansion, off by default.

zh.name: 胡闹运动会
zh.desc: 选秀组建怪咖战队,四场混乱竞速,技能乱飞笑到最后
zh.rules:
目标:四场比赛后总分最高者获胜(并列共享胜利)。
准备:
· 亮出数量为玩家人数两倍的运动员卡，按蛇形顺序进行两轮选择；最终每名玩家获得 4 名运动员。
流程：共进行四场比赛，依次使用温和赛道、狂野赛道、温和赛道和狂野赛道。
· 每场赛前,所有人同时从手中暗选一名未用过的运动员亮出;每名运动员整场游戏只能用一次。
· 第 1 场随机决定先手,之后各场由上一场最靠后(或最先被淘汰)的玩家先动。
· 轮到自己时，掷骰并移动运动员；运动员技能按各自规定的时机，在移动之前、期间或之后触发，也可能引发其他技能的连锁。绊倒的运动员跳过下一次主移动。
· 如果技能相互触发而形成无限循环，例如蹭蹭蟹不断前进到巨婴所在格后被放回原位，按实际顺序完成一轮循环后便停止；仍能推进局面的多次互动可以继续。
狂野赛道的特殊格按以下规则结算：
· 停在星星格时，获得 1 分。
· 停在箭头格时，按箭头指示前进或后退。
· 停在石头格时，运动员绊倒。
结算:
第二名冲过终点线时，比赛立即结束。第一名获得金牌，第二名获得银牌，按场次计分：
· 第一场的金牌获得 3 分，银牌获得 1 分。
· 第二场的金牌获得 4 分，银牌获得 2 分。
· 第三场的金牌获得 5 分，银牌获得 3 分。
· 第四场的金牌获得 6 分，银牌获得 4 分。
四场比赛全部结束后，总分最高的玩家获胜。

可选扩展
所有扩展默认关闭。开局时可以分别启用重振旗鼓、阿罗拉运动会或索尼克运动会角色包；启用的角色与基础36名运动员一起参与选秀。重振旗鼓采用当前已公开的预发行资料；阿罗拉运动会和索尼克运动会为玩家自制内容。索尼克角色能力中的圆环按积分结算。四场赛道可以分别选择，与角色包开关独立。每场也可选择随机赛道：创建对局时，从全部八条赛道中等概率抽取，允许重复。变局事件仍由事件牌开关控制。
· 曲折回旋：本场第一次有运动员移动经过第14格时，揭示并结算一张变局事件牌。需要在开局启用事件牌。
· 漩涡世界：移动停在漩涡端点时，传送到它连接的另一端；传送不再触发赛道格。
· 四岛赛道：美乐美乐长跑没有特殊格；阿卡拉冒险使用狂野赛道的特殊格。乌拉乌拉大骚动和波尼山道有长路与近路，移动经过分岔时由所属玩家选择。不同路线是独立格子，合流后才视为同一路线。
· 山格：必须为主移动掷出6点才能通过或离开山格，否则停在山格。格子的颜色供相关角色能力使用；点按格子可查看效果。
· 额外运动员：每名运动员各自进行完整回合，同一玩家可以选择其运动员的行动顺序。每张运动员卡和每个棋子都保持各自能力、状态与比赛名次，分数归所属玩家。
· 多项能力：获得新的比赛中能力时，保留已有能力；不会因此追溯获得新能力的赛前收益。能力只在规定时机触发。
· 重振旗鼓规则修订：只剩一名仍在比赛的运动员时，它立即取得下一个名次；同时到达同一格的运动员不触发同格停下能力。关闭此开关时，沿用基础版的比赛结束和同时到达规则。

变局事件
事件只影响当前比赛，牌面明确说明的下场返场效果除外。已揭示事件可在赛道上方查看。
· 炼金实验室失控：在起点放置巨口怪。每个回合结束后，掷骰移动它；被它超越的运动员被淘汰。咬痕变身后回到起点，并在每个回合结束后额外移动。
· 观众要求混乱：依次抽取并结算两张事件牌。
· 占卜池边禁止奔跑：运动员主移动的步数达到6格或更多时，改为将该运动员淘汰。
· 决赛加赛：本场前两名从第二个拐角开始进行一对一加赛。原第一名先行动；加赛胜者获得本场金牌和银牌的全部分数。
· 镜像世界：反转比赛方向，原起点成为终点。多名运动员因此冲线时，按回合顺序确定名次。
· 传送带启动：将所有在场运动员同时传送到起点后的第一格。此后本场所有主移动增加3格。
· 漏糖的彩罐：在第一个拐角之后的每个空格放置1分。运动员停在有分数的格子时，取走该分数。
· 随机停止：每名玩家掷一次骰。本场比赛中，该玩家之后所有掷骰都使用这个点数。
· 踩中时间小鬼：触发此事件的运动员被淘汰，并在下一场作为所属玩家的额外运动员出场，保留已获得的能力。
· 交换集市：每名玩家抽取一张新运动员卡，同时决定是否用它替换当前运动员。
· 人人都有诅咒魔杖：每个回合结束后掷骰，并按点数跳过对应数量的运动员。已经冲线或被淘汰的运动员仍参与计数，轮到它们时也掷骰；额外运动员分别计算。
· 地上的烤鸡：垫底的所有在场运动员依次前进7格。
· 终点遭遇邦克虫：运动员停在终点前最后两个格子之一时，后退5格。

en.name: Magical Athlete
en.desc: Draft a squad of weirdos, race four chaotic heats, chain powers to victory
en.rules:
Goal: after four races, the most points wins (ties share the win).
Setup:
· Reveal twice as many racer cards as players; snake-draft two rounds so everyone has 4 racers.
Play four races, using the Mild, Wild, Mild and Wild tracks in that order.
· Before each race, everyone secretly picks one unused racer and reveals together; each racer races only once per game.
· Race 1 start player is random; later races start with the player farthest behind (or eliminated first) last time.
· On your turn, roll and move; racer powers chain off each other before, during and after moves. A tripped racer skips its next main move.
· If powers create an infinite loop, such as Scoocher repeatedly moving onto Huge Baby and being put back, complete the loop once in order, then end it. Repeated interactions that still make progress can continue.
· Resolve special spaces on the Wild track as follows:
· Stopping on a star space scores one point.
· Stopping on an arrow space moves the racer forward or backward as indicated.
· Stopping on a rock space trips the racer.
Scoring:
A race ends as soon as the second racer crosses the finish line. The first racer receives gold and the second receives silver. Score medals by race:
· In race 1, gold scores 3 points and silver scores 1 point.
· In race 2, gold scores 4 points and silver scores 2 points.
· In race 3, gold scores 5 points and silver scores 3 points.
· In race 4, gold scores 6 points and silver scores 4 points.
After all four races, the player with the highest total score wins.

Optional expansions
All expansions are off by default. Enable Second Wind, Alolan Athlete, and Sonic Athlete separately. Enabled racers join the 36 base racers in the draft. Second Wind uses currently available prerelease material; Alolan Athlete and Sonic Athlete are fan-made. Sonic rings count as points. Choose the track for each race independently of the racer packs. Each race can also use a random track: when the game is created, each of the eight tracks has an equal chance and repeats are allowed. Twist cards still require their own switch.
· Twisty Twirl: when a racer first moves through space 14 this race, reveal and resolve a Twist card. Enable Twist cards during setup to use this effect.
· Whirly World: stopping on a whirl endpoint after moving warps the racer to its linked endpoint. Warping does not trigger another board space.
· Island tracks: Melemele Mile has no special spaces. Akala Adventure uses the Wild special spaces. Ula’ula Uproar and Poni Pass have long and short routes; choose a route when moving through a fork. The routes contain separate spaces until they merge.
· Mountain: a main roll of 6 is required to pass or leave the mountain. Otherwise stop there. Space colors are used by some powers. Select a space to read its effect.
· Extra racers: each racer takes a full turn. An owner chooses the order of their racers. Each racer keeps its own power, status, and place; its owner receives its points.
· Multiple powers: gaining a during-race power retains existing powers without retroactively applying before-race benefits. Each power triggers at its stated time.
· Second Wind revision: the last active racer immediately receives the next place. Racers arriving simultaneously do not trigger sharing-space stopping powers. With this option off, use the original finish and simultaneous-arrival rules.

Twist cards
Effects last for this race unless a card explicitly brings a racer into the next race. Read revealed cards above the track.
· Alchemy Lab Containment Breach: Put W.E.R.E.M.O.U.T.H. on Start. After every turn, roll and move it; it eliminates racers it passes. Bite Mark transforms, returns to Start, and also moves after every turn.
· The Fans Demand Chaos: Draw two Twist cards and resolve them in order.
· No Running by the Scrying Pool: A racer whose main move would be 6 or more spaces is eliminated instead.
· Season Finale: The first two finishers race one-on-one from the second corner. The original winner starts. The winner of this race takes all the gold and silver points.
· Mirror World: Reverse the direction of the race. Start becomes the finish. If several racers finish immediately, turn order determines their places.
· The Conveyor Belt Is On: Warp all active racers simultaneously to the space after Start. Add 3 to every main move for the rest of the race.
· The Piñata Is Leaking: Put 1 point on every empty space after the first corner. A racer stopping on a point takes it.
· Randomness Has Randomly Ceased: Each player rolls once. Use that result for everything that player rolls for the rest of this race.
· You Tromped on a Time Imp: Eliminate the racer that triggered this card. It returns in the next race as an extra racer for its owner, retaining its gained powers.
· Swap Meet: Each player draws a new racer and simultaneously decides whether to replace their current racer with it.
· Curse Wands for Everyone: After each turn, roll and skip that many racers in turn order. Finished and eliminated racers still count and still roll when reached. Count every extra racer separately.
· Roast Chicken on the Ground: Move every last-place active racer forward 7 spaces, in turn order.
· Bonkbug Infestation at the Finish Line: A racer stopping on either of the last two spaces moves backwards 5 spaces.

zh.name: 麻将
zh.desc: 推倒和 / 四川血战 / 国标 / 香港 / 日麻,五种规则一桌开打
zh.rules:
游戏目标：通过摸牌和打牌，组成和牌牌型。通常需要 4 组面子和 1 对雀头，也可以组成七对、十三幺等特殊牌型。按所选规则集计算番种和分数，总分最高的玩家获胜。
共通流程:
· 每名玩家获得 13 张起始手牌，庄家获得 14 张。玩家轮流摸取 1 张牌，再打出 1 张牌。
· 其他玩家打出牌后，可以在所选规则允许时吃、碰、杠或和牌。其中，只有打牌者的下家可以吃牌。多名玩家同时宣告和牌时，按所选规则集判定。
· 自己回合可暗杠、加杠;杠后从牌墙末尾补牌。
推倒和:
· 采用吃、碰、杠的基础玩法，不计算番种。自摸和牌时，其他三名玩家各支付1分；点炮和牌时，由放铳的玩家支付1分。
四川血战到底:
· 游戏开始时，选择一种花色作为缺门。和牌时，手牌中不能含有该花色的牌。此规则不使用字牌，也不能吃牌。
· 有玩家和牌后，其余尚未和牌的玩家继续游戏，直到三名玩家已经和牌，或牌墙耗尽。
· 牌墙耗尽而流局时，进行查大叫：尚未听牌的玩家，按照已听牌玩家可和牌的最高番数赔付；手牌中仍含缺门花色的玩家称为「花猪」，须按满番赔付。
国标麻将:
· 使用 81 个番种，至少达到 8 番才能和牌。自摸和牌时，由其他三名玩家分别支付分数。
香港麻将:
香港麻将采用清章计番，可以选择以下和牌门槛：
· 鸡和：允许没有番种的和牌。
· 一番起和：至少达到 1 番才能和牌。
· 三番起和：至少达到 3 番才能和牌。
大四喜等封顶牌型直接按计分上限结算。
日麻(立直):
· 门清且已经听牌时，可以宣言立直。立直后只能打出刚摸到的牌。
· 振听包括舍牌振听、同巡振听，以及立直后放过他人打出的和牌。
· 和牌必须有役，并另行计算符。计分包含宝牌、里宝牌和红宝牌。流局时，未听牌的玩家需要支付罚符。

en.name: Mahjong
en.desc: Classic, Sichuan Bloody, MCR, Hong Kong and Riichi — five rulesets at one table
en.rules:
Goal: build a winning hand (4 melds plus 1 pair, or special shapes like Seven Pairs and Thirteen Orphans) through draws and discards;
score by the chosen ruleset and finish with the most points.
Common flow:
· Each player starts with 13 tiles (dealer 14); take turns drawing one and discarding one.
· You may chi (next player only) / peng / kan / hu on a discard, subject to the ruleset; simultaneous wins follow ruleset tiebreaks.
· On your turn you may declare concealed or added kans; after a kan you draw a supplement tile from the dead wall.
Classic (Chicken Hand):
· The traditional chi/peng/kan game with no scoring patterns: a self-drawn win collects 1 point from each opponent; a discard win is paid 1 point by the discarder.
Sichuan Bloody Battle:
· At the start each player picks a void suit; the winning hand must not contain it; no honor tiles, no chi.
· A player who wins steps aside; the rest play on until three players have won or the wall runs out.
· On exhaustion, non-ready players pay ready players by their best fan; players who failed to void pay the maximum.
MCR (Chinese Official):
· This ruleset uses 81 fan patterns. A winning hand must reach at least 8 fan. For a self-drawn win, each of the other three players pays the winner.
Hong Kong:
Hong Kong Mahjong uses clean-pattern scoring. Choose one of these minimum requirements:
· A chicken hand may win without a fan pattern.
· With a 1-fan minimum, a hand must have at least 1 fan to win.
· With a 3-fan minimum, a hand must have at least 3 fan to win.
Limit hands, such as Big Four Winds, score the limit directly.
Riichi (Japanese):
· With a closed hand that is ready to win, you may declare riichi. After declaring it, you must discard the tile you just drew.
· Furiten includes discard furiten, same-turn furiten, and passing on a winning discard after declaring riichi.
· A winning hand must contain at least one yaku. Calculate fu separately and include dora, ura dora, and red fives in scoring. On an exhaustive draw, players whose hands are not ready pay the noten penalty.

zh.name: 马尼拉
zh.desc: 竞拍港务长、装船出航,在走私船能否抵达马尼拉的赌局中分利
zh.rules:
目标:
· 任一货物的黑市价升到三十时游戏结束,现金加持股价值最高者获胜;并列则共同获胜。
航次:
· 每航次先拍卖港务长:轮流出价或弃权,弃权后不得再出价;出价不得超过现金加可贷款之和。
· 港务长可购买一股股票(价格为该货黑市现价,至少五比索),随后选定三种货物装船,并指定三艘船的起点(各零至五格,之和恰为九)。
· 之后放置与移动交替:放置轮每人依次放置一个同伙或弃权,弃权后本航次不得再放置;移动轮由港务长掷对应货物颜色的三枚骰子,三艘船各自前进。
· 船超过十三格即入港,按到港顺序停靠港口;正好停在十三格会触发海盗。
· 第三轮移动前,小领航员可将一艘船移动一格,大领航员可将一艘船移动两格或两艘船各一格;被推过十三格的船直接入港。
· 三人局每人有四个同伙,首次移动前连续放置两轮。
工位收益:
· 船上同伙：船只入港后，船上的同伙平分该船利润。人参船的利润为 18 比索，豆蔻船为 24 比索，丝绸船为 30 比索，玉石船为 36 比索。放置同伙时，必须选择费用最低的空位。
· 港口的三个工位依次需要支付 4 比索、3 比索和 2 比索。第一、第二和第三艘船入港时，对应工位的同伙分别获得 6 比索、8 比索和 15 比索，由金库支付。
· 船厂的三个工位依次需要支付 4 比索、3 比索和 2 比索。未能入港的船依次进入船厂，对应工位的同伙分别获得 6 比索、8 比索和 15 比索，由保险员支付；没有保险员时，由金库支付。
· 海盗船有两个工位，放置费用各为 5 比索：第二轮移动后停在十三格的船可被登船,登船者成为船上同伙。
· 第三轮移动后停在十三格的船被抢劫:船上的同伙不能获得利润,海盗平分利润,船长决定被劫船送港口还是船厂。
· 保险(免费):立即获得十比索,但须为每艘进厂船支付修理费;现金不足必须抵押贷款,仍不足由金库垫付且不用偿还。
· 黑市:送入港口的货物升值一档;终局时每张持股按现价计值,每张尚未赎回的抵押股票扣除 15 比索。
其他:
· 贷款:轮到自己行动时可抵押一张未抵押股票换取十二比索,赎回需支付十五比索。
· 盲乘客：如果玩家的现金加上可贷款金额，仍不足以支付最便宜空位的费用，可以支付自己剩余的全部现金，将同伙放入保险工位以外的任意空位，无须补足该空位的放置费用。

en.name: Manila
en.desc: Bid for the harbor master, load the punts, and profit from smuggling runs to Manila
en.rules:
Goal:
· The game ends when any ware reaches 30 on the black market; the highest fortune of cash plus share values wins. Ties share the win.
Voyage:
· Each voyage opens with an auction for harbor master: bid or pass in turn; passing is final for the auction. You may not bid more than your cash plus possible loans.
· The harbor master may buy one share (its black market price, at least 5), chooses three wares to load, and sets the punts' starting spaces (0 to 5 each, summing to exactly 9).
· Placing and movement rounds alternate: in a placing round each player places one accomplice or passes (passing ends your placing for the voyage); in a movement round the harbor master rolls the three ware dice and each punt advances.
· A punt beyond space 13 reaches port, docking in arrival order; a punt ending exactly on space 13 attracts pirates.
· Before the third movement round, the small pilot may move one punt by one space, and the large pilot one punt by two spaces or two punts by one each; a punt pushed past 13 arrives at once.
· With three players, everyone has four accomplices and there are two placing rounds before the first movement.
Spots:
· When a punt arrives, its crew shares the profit: 18 pesos for ginseng, 24 for nutmeg, 30 for silk, or 36 for jade; you must take the cheapest vacant seat.
· The three Port spaces cost 4, 3 and 2 pesos respectively. The first, second and third punts to arrive pay the accomplices in their corresponding spaces 6, 8 and 15 pesos respectively, from the harbor cash box.
· The three Shipyard spaces cost 4, 3 and 2 pesos respectively. Punts that fail to arrive enter these spaces in order. The corresponding accomplices receive 6, 8 and 15 pesos respectively, paid by the insurance agent or, if there is none, by the cash box.
· The pirate boat has two spaces, each costing 5 pesos: punts on space 13 after the second movement may be boarded, and boarders join the crew.
· Punts on space 13 after the third movement are plundered: the crew leaves empty-handed, the pirates split the profit, and the captain sends each plundered punt to port or shipyard.
· Insurance (free): take 10 pesos immediately, but pay the repair cost for every punt landing in the shipyard; if short of cash you must mortgage shares, and any remainder is covered by the cash box for free.
· Black market: wares delivered to port rise one step; at game end each share scores its current value, and each mortgaged share reduces your final fortune by 15 pesos.
Other rules:
· Loans: on your turn you may mortgage an unencumbered share for 12 pesos; redeeming it later costs 15 pesos.
· Blind passenger: if your cash plus possible loans cannot cover the cheapest vacant spot, you may place for free (paying all your cash) on any vacant spot except insurance.

zh.name: 面具人
zh.desc: 面具摔跤手轮番登台，在出牌中决定谁更强
zh.rules:
目标:
2–6 人游玩，六种面具牌各 10 张。多人进行四个赛季，总分最高者获胜；两人以先赢三个赛季者获胜。
发牌与首家:
2–4 人每人 15 张，5 人每人 12 张，6 人每人 10 张。其余牌不公开，也不参与本赛季。首季由房主领出，以后由上一季末名领出。每季重新洗全部 60 张牌，清除力量关系。
出牌:
轮到你时，可以打出同一种面具的 1–3 张牌，或者弃权。新一轮领出时，若该种面具本赛季尚未登场，只能出 1 张；已经登场的面具可出 1–3 张。
压牌时不能出相同面具。
· 若两种面具的强弱关系未知，须比上一手多出 1 张，并确定新面具比上一种强；最多出 3 张。
· 若已经确定新面具更强，须出与上一手相同的张数。
已知较弱的面具不能出。力量关系可以传递，例如蓝胜橙、橙胜绿，则蓝也胜绿；没有关系的面具保持未知。
弃权与收轮:
弃权后整轮不能再出牌。其他仍持牌的玩家都弃权后，最后出牌者赢下该轮，清空场牌并重新领出。若最后出牌者已出完，则由其顺时针方向下一位仍持牌者领出。出完手牌者退出本赛季，但其他玩家仍能压过其最后一手。
赛季计分:
按出完手牌的先后，首名获得 2 分、次名获得 1 分，中间名次 0 分，末名扣 1 分；两人时末名扣 1 分。剩一人持牌时结束该季。所有人确认后进入下一季。
获胜:
多人四季后比较总分；相同时比较获得 2 分腰带的次数，仍相同则末季非首家优先；依然相同则共同获胜。两人不限制赛季数，先赢三季获胜。
图示:
力量图中的箭头指向较弱者，没有连线不代表相同力量。手牌上的数字是持有张数，选中面具后选择出牌张数。

en.name: Maskmen
en.desc: Send masked wrestlers into the ring and establish their strength as you play
en.rules:
Goal:
For 2–6 players, with ten cards of each of six masks. In multiplayer, play four seasons and score the most points. With two players, win three seasons first.
Deal and opening player:
Deal 15 cards each with 2–4 players, 12 with five, and 10 with six. Set unused cards aside unseen. The host opens the first season; the last player of each season opens the next. Shuffle all 60 cards and clear all strength relations each season.
Playing cards:
On your turn, play 1–3 cards of one mask, or pass. To lead a new bout, a mask that has not appeared this season must be played as a single card. A mask that has appeared may be led with 1–3 cards.
To beat the last play, use a different mask.
· If their relative strength is unknown, play exactly one more card, establishing that your mask is stronger. You may never play more than three cards.
· If your mask is already known to be stronger, play exactly the same number of cards.
A known weaker mask cannot be played. Strength is transitive: if blue beats orange and orange beats green, blue beats green. Unconnected masks remain incomparable.
Passing and ending a bout:
After passing, you cannot rejoin that bout. When all other players still holding cards have passed, the last player to play wins the bout, clears the ring and leads again. If they have no cards left, the next player clockwise who still holds cards leads. Players who empty their hand leave the season, but their last play can still be beaten.
Season scoring:
In order of emptying hands, first scores 2 points, second scores 1, middle places score 0, and last loses 1. With two players, last loses 1. The season ends when only one player has cards. All players confirm before the next season.
Winning:
After four multiplayer seasons, compare total points, then the number of +2 belts, then favor anyone who did not open the last season. Remaining ties share victory. With two players, play until someone wins three seasons.
Reading the table:
Arrows in the strength chart point toward the weaker mask. Missing connections do not mean equal strength. Numbers on your cards show how many you hold; select a mask and then the number to play.

search.py: mian ju ren mian ju shuai jiao shou feng kuang jia mian lian meng maskman

zh.name: Mazing
zh.desc: 黑白携手，为四名信使打开穿越迷宫的道路。
zh.rules:
目标:
这是一个单人或双人合作游戏。让四名信使全部穿过迷宫，停在对面对应棋格颜色的起点，便共同获胜。
准备:
· 使用标准棋盘的八个陷阱面。每色有十八枚棋件：两名信使，正交一步墙、对角一步墙、桥和陨石各三枚，正交两步墙和对角两步墙各两枚。
· 信使放在两端的起点，其余十六枚棋件随机放在本侧三列。开局已经位于陷阱上的棋件仍可移动。
流程:
· 白方先行动，之后黑白交替。每回合移动本色棋件一至三次，可以移动同一枚或不同棋件。移动一次后可以结束回合，第三次移动后自动换方。单人控制两色，双人各控制一色。
· 信使沿对角线移动任意格。一步墙沿符号所示的正交或对角线移动一格；两步墙必须恰好移动两格。以上棋件均不能越过任何棋件。
· 桥沿正交或对角线，跳过紧邻的连续一枚或多枚棋件，落在它们后面的第一个空格。桥不能单独移动到相邻空格。
· 陨石可以移到任意空格，但移动后永久翻面锁定。
· 所有落点必须是棋盘上的空格。棋件落入红色齿形陷阱时永久锁定，之后仍占据该格；经过陷阱而未停下不会触发。
结束:
· 四名信使同时停在各自目标时获胜。信使在获胜前可以离开已经到达的目标。
· 任一信使被陷阱锁住，或轮到行动的颜色没有任何合法移动时，挑战失败。若判断已经无法完成，也可以确认结束挑战。没有步数上限。
本次提供标准玩法；未包含背面棋盘及可选挑战变体。

en.name: Mazing
en.desc: Join black and white to open a path through the maze for four Messengers.
en.rules:
Goal:
A cooperative game for one or two people. Move all four Messengers across the maze to the opposite starting spaces of their matching square colours to win together.
Setup:
· Use the standard board with eight traps. Each colour has eighteen pieces: two Messengers; three each of orthogonal single Walls, diagonal single Walls, Bridges and Meteors; and two each of orthogonal double Walls and diagonal double Walls.
· Place Messengers at the ends. Shuffle the other sixteen pieces into the three columns on their side. Pieces starting on traps can still move.
Turns:
· White starts, then the colours alternate. Move pieces of the active colour one to three times per turn, using the same or different pieces. After one move you may end the turn; the third move switches colours automatically. Solo play controls both colours; two people control one colour each.
· Messengers move any distance diagonally. Single Walls move one square orthogonally or diagonally as shown; double Walls move exactly two squares in their indicated directions. None of these pieces may jump over pieces.
· A Bridge jumps orthogonally or diagonally over an adjacent, unbroken line of one or more pieces, landing on the first empty square beyond them. It cannot simply move to an adjacent empty square.
· A Meteor moves to any empty square once, then flips and becomes permanently locked.
· Every destination must be an empty board square. Landing on a red toothed trap permanently locks the piece, which continues to occupy that square. Passing over a trap without stopping does not trigger it.
Ending:
· Win when all four Messengers occupy their respective targets at the same time. A Messenger may leave a reached target before the game is won.
· Lose if a Messenger is trapped or the colour whose turn it is has no legal move. You may also confirm ending a challenge you judge impossible. There is no move limit.
This implementation provides standard play, without the reverse board or optional challenge variants.

zh.name: 夺心魔虫
zh.desc: 召唤混种生物，伺机用脑虫夺取对手的关键战力。
zh.rules:
目标：
将对方的生命降至零，或达成卡牌上的获胜条件。双人局无法执行回合行动时立即失败。
准备：
选择一组或多组牌混合。双人局每人获得十张牌，其中五张为手牌、五张为个人牌库，初始三点生命和两枚脑虫。其余牌组成未使用牌堆。手牌少于五张时，立即从个人牌库补到五张；牌库耗尽时不再补牌，手牌数量没有上限。
回合行动：
每回合必须选择一项：从手牌打出一张牌、用一个生物攻击，或发动一个生物的行动效果。结算完毕后轮到下一位玩家。不能主动跳过回合。
打出与脑虫：
从手牌执行回合打牌行动时，先展示该牌并补充手牌。对手可以消耗一枚脑虫，改由自己获得并打出这张牌。接管者结算打出效果后，原玩家必须在同一回合重新执行一次回合行动。由卡牌效果打出的牌不能被脑虫接管。夺取场上生物的控制权不触发打出效果，保留其横置、强化和晶体状态。
攻击与战斗：
先结算攻击效果，再由对方选择一个生物阻挡或不阻挡。未被阻挡的攻击使对方失去一点生命。战斗中力量较低的生物被击败；力量相同则双方都被击败。被击败的牌进入当前控制者的弃牌堆并发动相应效果。同时触发多个效果时，由当前回合玩家决定先后，每个效果完整结算后再处理下一个。生命降至零立即失败。
六种关键词：
· 狂暴：同一生物可以攻击两次，第二次可以放弃。
· 猎手：攻击时可以指定一个敌方生物，强制它阻挡，即使它通常不能阻挡。被指定的生物离场后，不再将该次狩猎转为直接攻击。
· 剧毒：与此生物战斗的敌方生物会被击败。
· 潜行：只能被具有潜行的生物阻挡。
· 坚韧：未横置时将一次被击败改为横置。横置不妨碍攻击、阻挡或发动行动效果；此状态不会在回合开始时自动解除。
· 迅捷：打出效果结算后，此生物可以额外攻击或发动行动效果。被脑虫接管后，接管者也可以在当前回合使用迅捷。
扩展机制：
· 强化：可将任意弃牌堆的牌放在指定生物下方，每张使其力量提高一点。强化牌公开可查看；生物离场时，强化牌进入其当前控制者的弃牌堆。
· 进化：沿卡牌的三个阶段升级，保留同一生物的状态，不触发打出效果。离场时还原为第一阶段。
· 晶体：按卡面初始数量入场。允许分配的生物可以在打出效果前，把任意数量的初始晶体分给任意生物。标有晶体费用的攻击效果在能够支付时必须支付一枚并发动；行动效果必须能支付才能选择。
· 收获：在自己的回合开始时，从每个具有收获效果的生物上移除一枚晶体。最后一枚被移走时发动收获。没有晶体时不发动。被脑虫接管后重新行动不重复收获。
四人组队：
按座次交替分队，隔座玩家互为队友，队伍共用三点生命。标准模式每人三张手牌、三张牌库、一枚脑虫和一枚脑蛙；史诗模式改为五张手牌、五张牌库、两枚脑虫和一枚脑蛙。组队牌组自动混入。手牌不能向队友展示或描述。
· 打牌时，按左侧对手脑虫、队友脑蛙、右侧对手脑虫的顺序询问；有人接管后停止询问，原玩家在同一回合重新行动。
· 脑蛙只接管队友打出的牌，且不计入效果所说的脑虫数量。
· 攻击以敌队为目标，左侧对手先决定是否用自己的生物阻挡，然后才是右侧对手。
· 旧牌的持续能力影响所有对手；指向一名对手的触发效果需要选择对手，共享生命的效果只计算一次。
· 无法行动时跳过回合，仍可阻挡和接管；同队两人先后都无法行动则该队失败。

en.name: Mindbug
en.desc: Summon hybrid creatures and steal a crucial threat with your Mindbugs.
en.rules:
Goal:
Reduce the opposing side to zero life or meet a card's winning condition. In a duel, a player unable to take a turn action loses immediately.
Setup:
Mix one or more card sets. In a duel each player receives ten cards: five in hand and five in their personal draw pile. Start with three life and two Mindbugs. Remaining cards form the unused pile. Immediately draw to five whenever your hand falls below five and your draw pile is not empty. There is no hand limit.
Turn action:
You must play one card from your hand, attack with one creature, or activate one creature's Action effect. Resolve it fully, then the next player takes a turn. You cannot voluntarily skip.
Playing and Mindbugs:
Reveal a card played as your turn action and refill your hand. Your opponent may spend a Mindbug to take the card and play it instead. After its effects resolve, you must take another turn action during this same turn. Cards played by effects cannot be Mindbugged. Taking control of a creature in play preserves its state and does not activate Play effects.
Attacking and combat:
Resolve Attack effects before the defender chooses a blocker. An unblocked attack costs the opposing side one life. In combat the lower-power creature is defeated; equal power defeats both. Defeated cards enter their current controller's discard pile and activate Defeated effects. The active player orders simultaneous effects, resolving each fully before the next. Zero life causes an immediate loss.
Keywords:
· Frenzy: The same creature may attack a second time. You may decline.
· Hunter: You may force an enemy creature to block, even if it normally cannot block. If the hunted creature leaves play, the hunt does not become a direct attack.
· Poisonous: The opposing creature in combat is defeated.
· Sneaky: Only creatures with Sneaky can block this.
· Tough: If unexhausted, exhaust this instead of defeating it. Exhaustion does not prevent attacking, blocking, or using an Action, and does not automatically clear next turn.
· Fast: After Play effects resolve, this may immediately attack or use its Action. Its new controller may do so even on the opponent's turn after using a Mindbug.
Expansion rules:
· Boost: Put cards from any discard piles under the chosen creature. Each adds one power. Boosts are public. When the creature leaves play its boosts go to its current controller's discard pile.
· Evolve: Advance through the creature's three stages, preserving its state and without activating Play effects. It reverts to stage one when it leaves play.
· Octonite: Creatures enter with their printed counters. Creatures allowing distribution may distribute any initial counters to any creatures before their Play effects. An Attack effect with a counter cost must pay and activate if possible. An Action with a counter cost requires payment.
· Harvest: At the start of your turn, remove one counter from each of your Harvest creatures. Removing its last counter activates Harvest. A creature already without counters does nothing. Taking another turn action after a Mindbug does not repeat Harvest.
Tag Team:
Alternate teams around the table, with teammates opposite each other. Each team shares three life. Standard mode gives each player three cards in hand, three in their draw pile, one Mindbug and one Mindfrog. Epic mode gives five in hand, five in the draw pile, two Mindbugs and one Mindfrog. The Tag Team pack is mixed in automatically. Do not reveal or describe your hand to your teammate.
· When a card is played, the left opponent may use a Mindbug, then the teammate may use a Mindfrog, then the right opponent may use a Mindbug. Stop at the first takeover; the original player takes another turn action this turn.
· Mindfrogs only take a teammate's card and do not count as Mindbugs in card effects.
· Attacks target the enemy team; the left opponent may block first, then the right opponent.
· Older constant abilities affect all opponents; triggered abilities referring to an opponent choose one, while shared-life effects apply only once.
· A player unable to act skips but can still block or use Mindbugs. If both teammates are unable to act on successive team turns, their team loses.

zh.name: 心灵空间
zh.desc: 在12轮中根据骰子绘制形状，填满脑区、完成目标卡，并按颜色效果争取最高分。
zh.rules:
目标:
· 游戏进行12轮。终局时按目标卡、脑区和颜色效果计分，总分最高者获胜。
· 如果多人并列最高分，这些玩家共同获胜。
准备:
· 每名玩家获得一张九行九列的脑板和1分钱。
· 脑板分为五个脑区；灰质格不可绘制。
· 灰质格仅在判断脑区、整行或整列是否填满时视为已填。
· 开局展示五张形状卡，并从A、B、C三组目标卡中各抽出一张。
· 掷五颗不同颜色的骰子，骰子点数决定免费可用的形状卡。
每轮流程:
· 所有玩家同时在各自的脑板上安排本轮操作，完成后提交。
· 点数1至5分别对应同序号的形状卡；免费绘制使用对应骰子的颜色。
· 点数6不对应形状卡；两格骨牌每轮都可作为免费基础形状，颜色任选。
· 每轮最多放置一块基础形状；不放置形状也可以提交。
· 从第二轮起，每轮移走最旧的形状卡，补充一张新卡并重新掷骰。
放置:
· 形状可以旋转或镜像，不能越出脑板，也不能覆盖灰质格或已填格。
· 脑板尚无笔画时，第一块形状可以放在任意可用位置。
· 此后放置的形状必须与至少一个已填格共享边。
· 彩色形状不能与相同颜色的已填格共享边；角部相接不算相邻。
· 排练中的形状可以移动、旋转、镜像或撤回；提交后才正式放置。
分钱与额外绘制:
· 花费2分钱可自由绘制基础形状：任选五张现有形状卡之一，并使用任意骰子颜色。
· 自由绘制只替代本轮的基础形状，不增加可放置的形状数量。
· 放置基础形状后，每花费3分钱可额外绘制一块形状，每轮最多四块。
· 额外形状必须选有骰子的形状卡，使用该卡对应且本轮尚未使用的颜色。
· 额外形状不能使用两格骨牌，也不能选择没有骰子的形状卡。
· 花费1分钱可填入一个黑格；黑格须与已绘制的格共享边，可与黑格相邻。
· 每轮最多购买九个黑格；黑格不能作为第一笔。
· 每绘制一块绿色形状获得1分钱；每填满一个脑区再获得1分钱。
· 最多持有9分钱。提交时按基础形状、额外形状、黑格的顺序结算收支。
· 若结算过程中无法支付费用，本轮提交不生效，排练内容可继续调整。
目标卡:
· 每名玩家对每张目标卡最多得分一次；提交后判定是否达成。
· 同一轮达成目标的玩家均获得翻面前分数；该轮结束后目标卡翻面。
· 翻面后首次达成目标的玩家获得牌面较低的分数。
· 同情：填满两格灰质周围指定的10格。
· 完美的一天：在同一个脑区绘制全部五种骰子颜色。
· 卷王：填满脑板上的任意一整行或一整列。
· 心如止水：填满两个不含绿色格的脑区。
· 灵魂伴侣：每个脑区内至少有一个粉色格。
· 大冒险：填满左侧和右侧脑区。
· 平静一生：填满右上方和左下方脑区。
· 感同身受：填满四格灰质周围指定的12格。
结算:
· 每填满一个外侧脑区获得10分；填满中央脑区获得5分。
· 每个与橙色格共享边的紫色格获得2分；相邻多个橙色格仍只计一次。
· 按橙色形状数量计分：0至4块依次获得0、3、6、10、15分；5块及以上获得20分。
· 每对同形的粉色与非粉色形状，按非粉色形状的格数得分；旋转和镜像视为同形。
· 根据缺少蓝色格的脑区数量扣分：缺0至5区，依次扣0、4、7、9、12、16分。
· 找出空格最多的脑区，按该脑区的空格数量扣分；灰质格不计为空格。
· 已获得的目标卡分数计入总分；绿色形状、黑格和剩余分钱不直接计分。

en.name: Mind Space
en.desc: Draw shapes according to the dice across 12 rounds, complete brain sections and objective cards, and score color effects.
en.rules:
Goal:
· The game lasts 12 rounds. At the end, score objective cards, brain sections, and color effects; the highest total wins.
· Players tied for the highest score share the victory.
Setup:
· Each player receives a nine-by-nine brain board and 1 cent.
· The board has five sections; gray matter spaces cannot be drawn on.
· Gray matter counts as filled only when checking whether a section, row, or column is complete.
· Display five shape cards and draw one objective card from each of the A, B, and C groups.
· Roll five dice of different colors; their values determine which shape cards can be used without paying.
Each round:
· All players plan their actions on their own boards at the same time, then submit them.
· Values 1 through 5 refer to the shape card with the same number; a shape placed without paying uses a matching die color.
· A value of 6 does not refer to a shape card; the two-space domino may always serve as the base shape without paying and use any die color.
· At most one base shape may be placed each round; a player may also submit without placing a shape.
· From round 2 onward, remove the oldest shape card, add a new card, and roll the dice again.
Placement:
· Shapes may be rotated or mirrored, but may not extend beyond the board or cover gray matter or filled spaces.
· If the board has no marks, the first shape may be placed on any available spaces.
· Every later shape must share an edge with at least one filled space.
· A colored shape may not share an edge with a filled space of the same color; touching at a corner does not count.
· Staged shapes may be moved, rotated, mirrored, or removed; they become permanent only after submission.
Money and additional drawing:
· For 2 cents, Free Draw lets you choose any of the five visible shape cards and any die color for the base shape.
· Free Draw replaces the normal base shape; it does not increase the number of shapes you may place.
· After placing a base shape, pay 3 cents per additional shape, up to four additional shapes per round.
· An additional shape must come from a card with a die and use one of its die colors that has not been used this round.
· Additional shapes cannot use the two-space domino or a card with no die.
· Pay 1 cent to fill one black space; it must share an edge with a drawn space and may touch other black spaces.
· You may buy at most nine black spaces per round; a black space cannot be the first mark.
· Gain 1 cent for each green shape drawn and 1 cent for each section completed.
· You may hold at most 9 cents. On submission, resolve the base shape, additional shapes, then black spaces in that order.
· If you cannot pay at any point, the submission fails and the staged pieces can be adjusted.
Objective cards:
· Each player may score each objective card once; check its condition after submission.
· All players who meet an objective in the same round receive its unflipped score; flip the card at the end of that round.
· Players who first meet it after the flip receive the lower score shown on the card.
· Sympathy: fill the 10 designated spaces around the two-space gray matter area.
· The Perfect Day: place all five die colors within one section.
· Overachiever: fill any complete row or column of the board.
· Serenity: complete two sections that contain no green spaces.
· Soulmate: place at least one pink space in each section.
· Adventure: complete the left and right sections.
· A Life of Peace: complete the upper-right and lower-left sections.
· Empathy: fill the 12 designated spaces around the four-space gray matter area.
Scoring:
· Gain 10 points for each completed outer section and 5 points for the completed center section.
· Each purple space sharing an edge with an orange space scores 2 points, even if several orange spaces touch it.
· Score orange shapes as follows: zero through four shapes score 0, 3, 6, 10, and 15 points; five or more score 20.
· For each pair of matching pink and non-pink shapes, score the number of spaces in the non-pink shape; rotations and reflections still match.
· Penalize sections without blue: zero through five missing sections cost 0, 4, 7, 9, 12, and 16 points.
· Find the section with the most empty spaces and lose that many points; gray matter is not empty.
· Add points earned from objective cards; green shapes, black spaces, and leftover cents do not score directly.

zh.name: 小城大作
zh.desc: 将遗落的小物件建成奇妙城市，争取奖励，让小人搬进最有价值的建筑。
zh.rules:
目标：
用城市牌和小人建造城市。经过 8 轮及一次终局竞赛后，胜利点最多者获胜。同分时未使用小人较多者获胜，仍相同则共享胜利。

准备：
按人数选择 9 张奖励牌，随机排列。第 9 张的颜色是终局主色。每人从 6 张城市牌中保留 4 张，其余放回牌堆底。首家随机决定。音乐节宣传牌可在开局选项中加入，默认关闭。

每轮流程：
· 展示人数加 1 张城市牌作为公开市场。
· 从首家起顺时针，每人打一张手牌，加入自己的城市。有闪电的牌立即执行效果。右上方符号从出牌起持续有效。
· 本轮奖励牌颜色的城市牌优先，按数值从高到低排名；其他颜色随后按数值从高到低排名。同为非主色且数值相同，先出牌者优先。无色 21 号始终第一。
· 按名次领取奖励牌对应的胜利点、勋章、小人或奖励标记。奖励标记从公共池选择，每枚只能被一人领取。
· 从最后一名起反向选择市场中的一张牌加入手牌。剩余一张放回牌堆底。本轮第一名成为下轮首家，出牌仍顺时针。

小人分配：
获得小人时必须立即放入自己城市牌的空位，可自由分配，放下后不得挪动。没有足够空位时保留多余小人；以后打出有空位的牌，必须先用这些小人尽量填满。只有填满空位的城市牌，底部计分或勋章效果才生效。公共小人供应为 75 个，耗尽时本版本只领取剩余数量。

图例与条件：
· 书本、爱心、笑脸、钱袋来自城市牌右上方和奖励标记；不要求牌已填满。
· 箭头左侧的条件全部达到时，获得右侧奖励一次。
·  乘号效果按对应数量计算。
· 三色牌套由红、绿、蓝各一张组成，四符号套由四种普通符号各一个组成。
· 三色奖励标记对每项效果可以独立选择颜色，但一套中只补一张牌。
· 数值范围只计城市中对应号码的牌，0 号和 21 号不计入 1–20 的任何区间。

终局：
第 8 轮补牌后，从当轮第一名起顺时针揭示手牌。将手牌中终局主色的数值相加，按总和排名，相同则先揭示者优先。领取终局奖励并分配小人后，第一名额外打一张手牌，照常执行即时效果和放置小人。
分别计算奖励牌和标记的胜利点、填满的城市牌效果，以及勋章得分。勋章 1、2、3、4、5、6 枚或更多，依次获得 1、3、6、10、15、21 胜利点。未填满的牌不提供底部胜利点或勋章。
音乐节宣传牌：
· 红色 0 号牌：立即获得 6 个小人。
· 绿色 0 号牌：填满后，每个书本和每个笑脸各获得 1 分。
· 蓝色 0 号牌：填满后，每个钱袋和每个爱心各获得 1 分。

en.name: Minikin City
en.desc: Turn forgotten objects into a tiny city, win rewards, and give your Minikins valuable homes.
en.rules:
Goal:
Build a city with City cards and Minikin pawns. After 8 rounds and a final contest, the most VP wins. Ties favor the player with more unused Minikins; a further tie is a shared victory.

Setup:
Select the 9 Reward cards for your player count and shuffle their order. The ninth card determines the final color. Each player keeps 4 of 6 City cards; the others go to the bottom of the deck. Choose the first player randomly. The optional Music Festival cards are off by default.

Each round:
· Reveal one more City card than the number of players to form the open display.
· Starting with the first player and continuing clockwise, each player adds a hand card to their city. Resolve its Instant effect, marked by lightning, immediately. Its top-right symbols become available at once.
· Cards matching the round’s Reward color rank first, highest value first. Other colors follow in descending value. Equal values in other colors favor the earlier play. Colorless 21 always ranks first.
· Receive the VP, Cockades, Minikins or Bonus tokens for your rank. Choose tokens from the common supply; each token can be taken only once.
· In reverse ranking order, each player takes a card from the open display. Put the last card under the deck. The top-ranked player leads the next round, but plays still proceed clockwise.

Minikin management:
Immediately place gained Minikins on any empty spaces in your city, freely dividing them among cards. Placed Minikins cannot move. Keep excess pawns only when all available spaces are filled. When you later play a card with spaces, fill it as far as possible with these unused pawns. A card’s bottom scoring or Cockade effect works only when all its spaces are filled. The supply contains 75 Minikins; this implementation grants only the remaining pawns if it runs out.

Symbols and conditions:
· Books, hearts, smiles and money bags come from the top right of City cards and Bonus tokens, even on unfilled cards.
· Meet every condition left of an arrow to gain its reward once.
· Multiplication effects count the indicated items.
· A color set contains one red, one green and one blue card. A symbol set contains one of each ordinary symbol.
· The wild-color token can choose a color independently for each effect, but supplies only one card within a set.
· Value ranges count matching cards in your city; 0 and 21 belong to none of the 1–20 ranges.

Endgame:
After drafting in round 8, reveal hands clockwise from that round’s winner. Add the values of hand cards matching the final color and rank the totals; earlier reveal wins ties. Resolve all final rewards and Minikin placement, then the winner plays one extra hand card, resolving its Instant effect and Minikin placement normally.
Add VP from Reward cards and Bonus tokens, effects on filled City cards, and Cockades. Having 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 or at least 6 Cockades scores 1, 3, 6, 10, 15 or 21 VP. Unfilled cards provide no bottom VP or Cockades.
Music Festival cards:
· Red 0 immediately gains 6 Minikins.
· Filled Green 0 scores 1 VP per book and per smile.
· Filled Blue 0 scores 1 VP per money bag and per heart.

zh.name: 现代艺术
zh.desc: 经营美术馆，以五种拍卖方式买卖画作，掌握四轮艺术市场。
zh.rules:
目标：
经营美术馆，拍卖手牌中的画作并购买其他画作。四轮后现金最多的玩家获胜；现金相同时并列获胜。所有金额以千欧元（k€）计，现金在终局前保密。
准备：
每人获得100 k€。70张画作属于五位画家，按市场板从左至右分别为Carvalho（12张）、Thaler（13张）、Melim（14张）、Martins（15张）、Silveira（16张）。三人局各发10张，四人局9张，五人局8张。起始座位首先主持拍卖，此后顺时针进行。
拍卖流程：
拍卖师从手牌选出一幅画作，按牌面图标拍卖。买家向拍卖师支付成交价；拍卖师自己买下时向银行付款。成交画作放入买家的美术馆，在本轮结束时出售。所有出价必须为非负整数且不超过自己的现金；加价须高于当前最高价。无人出价时拍卖师免费获得画作，定价拍卖除外。
· 公开拍卖[icon:open|眼睛]：所有人可随时加价。暂不加价后，只要拍卖尚未结束仍可重新出价；每次加价会重新征询其他人。全员不再加价时成交。
· 一轮拍卖[icon:once|星形1]：从拍卖师左手玩家开始，每人仅一次加价或放弃机会，拍卖师最后行动。
· 暗标拍卖[icon:hidden|锁]：全员秘密提交一次出价，0代表不出价，同时揭晓。最高价相同时，拍卖师优先，否则从拍卖师左手起顺时针最近者获得。
· 定价拍卖[icon:fixed|价签]：拍卖师定出自己付得起的价格，其他人从其左手起依次决定购买或放弃。首位购买者获得；全部放弃时拍卖师必须按该价格向银行购买。
· 双重拍卖[icon:double|双槌]：先打出双重拍卖牌，再由拍卖师决定是否补出同一画家的非双重牌；若不补，其他人顺时针依次获得补牌机会。两幅画作按第二张牌的方式一起拍卖。补牌者成为新拍卖师，获得全部成交款，之后由其左手玩家主持下一场。无人补牌时原拍卖师免费取得第一幅画作。
回合结算：
任一画家的第5幅画作被打出时立即结束本轮，该画不拍卖，也不归任何玩家。若它是双重拍卖的第二幅，两幅都不成交；第一幅已是第5幅时不再补牌。所有已打出的画作，包括未成交及神秘玩家的画作，均计入数量。
按数量排列画家，平手时市场板位置更靠左者优先。前三名本轮分别记30、20、10 k€。仅本轮前三名的画作有价值：每幅售价为该画家所有轮次估值的累计值；其他画家本轮均为0，即使以前有估值。每人将本轮买到的全部画作卖给银行并弃掉，未拍卖的手牌保留。
新回合：
第2与第3轮，三人局每人各补6张，四人局4张，五人局3张；第4轮不补牌。上一轮打出结束牌的拍卖师左手玩家开始。没有手牌的玩家跳过主持机会，仍可参与竞拍。若所有人提前用尽手牌，最后打出的画作不拍卖，结算该轮后结束游戏。
三人神秘玩家变体：
仅三人局可启用，默认关闭。按四人局发牌，额外一手面朝下作为神秘手牌并保留至后续轮次。拍卖师完成拍卖后，可选择翻开一张随机神秘画作；该画不拍卖也无归属，但计入市场数量并可能触发第5幅结束本轮。神秘双重牌不追加第二张。

en.name: Modern Art
en.desc: Run a museum, trade paintings through five auction types, and read the market over four rounds.
en.rules:
Goal:
Auction paintings from your hand and acquire paintings for your museum. After four rounds, the player with the most cash wins; equal cash produces a shared victory. Amounts are in thousands of euros (k€). Cash stays private until the end.
Setup:
Each player starts with 100 k€. The 70 paintings belong to five artists, in market order: Carvalho (12), Thaler (13), Melim (14), Martins (15), and Silveira (16). Deal 10 cards each with three players, 9 with four, or 8 with five. The starting seat holds the first auction, then play proceeds clockwise.
Auctions:
The auctioneer selects a painting from their hand. Its symbol determines the auction. The buyer pays the auctioneer; an auctioneer buying their own lot pays the bank. Purchased paintings go into the buyer's museum until the round ends. Bids must be whole, nonnegative amounts within your cash; a raise must exceed the current bid. With no bids, the auctioneer takes the lot free, except in fixed-price auctions.
· Open[icon:open|eye]: Anyone may raise at any time. Passing is temporary: you may bid again before the auction ends. Every raise asks everyone else again; the auction ends when no one wishes to raise.
· One offer[icon:once|star 1]: Beginning to the auctioneer's left, each player gets one chance to raise or pass. The auctioneer acts last.
· Hidden[icon:hidden|lock]: Everyone submits one secret bid, including 0 for no bid. Reveal together. The highest bid wins. Ties favor the auctioneer, then the closest tied player clockwise from their left.
· Fixed price[icon:fixed|price tag]: The auctioneer sets an affordable price. Others, beginning to their left, may buy or pass. The first buyer takes the lot; if all pass, the auctioneer must buy it from the bank at that price.
· Double[icon:double|double gavel]: Play a double-auction card, then optionally add a non-double painting by the same artist. If the auctioneer declines, others get the same opportunity clockwise. Auction both together using the second card's type. The second contributor becomes auctioneer, receives all proceeds, and play resumes to their left. If nobody contributes, the original auctioneer takes the first painting free.
Round end:
The fifth painting offered by any artist immediately ends the round. It is not auctioned and nobody owns it. If it is the second card of a double auction, neither card is sold; if the first card is already the fifth, no second card is added. Count all offered paintings, including unsold and mystery paintings.
Rank artists by paintings offered, breaking ties toward the left of the market. The top three receive values of 30, 20, and 10 k€ this round. Only the current top three have value: each painting sells for that artist's accumulated value across all rounds. Everyone else is worth 0 this round, regardless of earlier values. Sell and discard every museum painting. Keep unplayed cards in hand.
New rounds:
Before rounds 2 and 3, deal each player 6 cards with three players, 4 with four, or 3 with five. Deal none before round 4. Start to the left of the auctioneer who ended the last round. Empty-handed players skip hosting but may still bid. If all players run out early, the last offered painting is not auctioned; settle that round and end the game.
Three-player mystery variant:
Optional and off by default. Deal as for four players, with an extra face-down mystery hand retained between rounds. After each auction, the auctioneer may reveal a random mystery painting. It is never auctioned or owned, but counts toward popularity and can end the round as the fifth painting. A mystery double card never adds a second painting.

zh.name: 欢迎来到月球
zh.desc: 填格装火箭,抢在别人之前点火发射
zh.rules:
目标:赶在别人之前装满火箭并点火发射;若无人发射,分数最高者获胜。
流程:
· 每回合翻开 3 张飞船卡,形成 3 个「数字+动作」组合;所有玩家同时各选一个组合。
· 将所选数字写入火箭中与该行动对应的楼层；万能层可以使用任意行动。每层数字从左到右必须严格递增，同一层不能重复。
· 三个组合都无处可写时,必须圈 1 个系统错误。
舱室效果:
楼层被隔断分成若干舱室。一个舱室被数字或 X 填满时，立即触发其中的效果：
· Ⓧ 在任意空格补写一个 X。
· 🚀 在计分轨上划掉对应数量的火箭。
· 紫色箭头可激活一个浅色火箭(其所在舱室填满时才划掉对应火箭);
· 红色感叹号是破坏。
破坏:
· 触发破坏后,其他玩家各圈 1 个系统错误;每个破坏符号全局只能触发一次。
任务:
· A/B/C 各一张公共任务;同一回合内首批达成者划较多火箭,之后达成者划较少火箭。
结束:
· 划满计分轨全部火箭并消掉所有已圈错误,回合末即发射获胜;同回合多人发射则比加赛火箭数。
· 若有玩家完成三张任务、圈满八个系统错误，或填满整张记录表，对局结束并计分。以计分轨上最低的未划掉分数框为基础分数，每个尚未消除的系统错误扣除 5 分。总分最高的玩家获胜。
冒险版图:
· 大堂选项可切换冒险版图;规则骨架相同,各版图的舱室/轨迹效果与算分不同。
可选的冒险版图包括发射、旅程、殖民地、矿场、穹顶、病毒和逃脱。

en.name: Welcome to the Moon
en.desc: Fill your rocket floor by floor and launch before everyone else
en.rules:
Goal: Load your rocket and launch before the others; if nobody launches, the highest score wins.
Play:
· Each turn 3 starship cards are flipped, making 3 number+action combos; all players simultaneously pick one.
· Write the chosen number on a floor matching the combination's action. The wild floor accepts any action. Numbers on each floor must strictly increase from left to right, without duplicates.
· If none of the 3 combos can be written, you must circle a System Error.
Quarter effects:
Partition walls divide floors into quarters. Filling a quarter with numbers or X marks immediately triggers its effects:
· Ⓧ write an X in any empty space.
· 🚀 cross that many rockets on the scoring track.
· a purple arrow activates a dim rocket (its rockets are crossed when its own quarter fills);
· a red diamond is a Sabotage.
Sabotage:
· Triggering a Sabotage makes every other player circle 1 System Error; each Sabotage symbol can be triggered only once per game.
Missions:
· Three shared missions (A/B/C); the first players to fulfill one in the same turn cross more rockets, later claimants cross fewer.
End:
· Cross every rocket on the track and clear all your circled errors to launch at the end of the turn and win; ties on the same turn are broken by bonus rockets.
· Otherwise, the game ends when a player claims all three missions, circles eight System Errors, or fills the entire sheet. Take the value of your lowest uncrossed score box and deduct 5 points per uncleared error. The highest total wins.
Adventure sheets:
· Switch sheets in the lobby options; the core rules are shared, but each sheet has its own effects and scoring.
The available adventure maps are The Launch, The Journey, The Colony, The Mine, The Dome, The Virus and The Escape.

zh.name: 月球殖民：浴血求生
zh.desc: 经营月球殖民地，在失控机器人与灾难中生存
zh.rules:
游戏目标：
任一殖民地的人口耗尽，或翻开「使用说明书」事件牌时，游戏结束。多人游戏中，幸存总人口最多的玩家获胜；人口相同则并列获胜。
游戏准备：
每位玩家的基地人口为30人，起始拥有4点资金和4份食物。每位玩家抽取4张建筑牌，并获得5种个人奖励牌，各1张。
进程牌库由4张工作牌、2张麻烦牌和随机抽取的2张变局牌组成。初始变局可从简单变局或全部变局中抽取，由游戏设置决定。
回合流程：
翻开1张进程牌，所有玩家同时执行牌面效果。所有玩家完成后，再翻开下一张进程牌。麻烦牌将下一张事件牌加入进程牌库；「故障」事件加入1张机器人牌。
新加入的进程牌放在牌库顶部。同批加入多张时，先混洗这些牌再放到顶部。只有需要翻牌而进程牌库为空时，才将进程弃牌洗成新的牌库；牌库为空时仍可加入新牌，不会因此提前混入弃牌。
五种基本行动：
工作时，每位玩家选择一种行动。建造所用的卡牌先秘密选定，再同时公开。
· 采矿：获得4点资金。
· 耕作：获得4份食物。
· 研究：抽取2张建筑牌。
· 补给：获得2个物资箱，分别选择放置的建筑。
· 建造：选择1张建筑牌，支付建造费用后，将它放入自己的殖民地。
你可以自行安排基本行动与相关建筑能力的执行顺序。额外行动也会触发相应建筑能力；同一种行动可以重复执行。
建筑与物资箱：
总人口等于基地人口与所有建筑牌上印刷人口的总和。建造时直接增加建筑上的印刷人口，不从基地扣除。增加人口的效果通常增加基地人口，特殊情况以牌面为准。
物资箱必须放在自己的建筑上，可以在同一座建筑上放置多个。同名建筑的能力通常可以叠加；可选效果必须付清所需费用才能执行。
牌面上的「建成时」与「失去时」分别在建成或失去该建筑时执行。个人奖励牌加入进程牌库后可以反复出现，但只对所属玩家生效。
人口损失与饥荒：
人口损失先从基地人口中扣除。基地人口不足时，选择一座建筑失去，将其印刷人口转入基地。弃置失去的建筑及其全部物资箱，并完整执行这座建筑的失去能力，然后继续扣除尚未承担的人口损失。必要时，重复失去建筑的过程。只有规则或牌面要求时才能失去建筑，不能自行弃置已建建筑。
饥荒时，每座建筑需要支付1份食物；「旗帜」和「温室」的能力可以豁免。每缺少1份食物，人口减少1人，食物缺额合计为一次人口损失。如果没有因饥荒损失人口，基地人口增加2人。
单人玩法：
单人游戏在初始牌库中加入1张孤独牌。孤独时，每个三环标记使基地人口增加3人，每个爆星标记使人口减少3人。
· 标准挑战：翻开「使用说明书」时获胜；如果人口先耗尽，则挑战失败。挑战失败时，记录已经加入进程牌库的最高事件序号。
· 延长挑战：从第13张事件开始，改为加入机器人牌，直至殖民地人口耗尽，按额外加入的机器人牌数量计分。
界面操作：
手牌、待建建筑和已埋牌仅本人可见。建筑弃牌堆只公开顶部一张。已建建筑与手牌位于同一页面，向下滚动可以查看后续卡牌。
· 点击可选卡牌，再点击底部确认按钮。点击信息按钮可查看完整牌面。
· 「全部选择」列出当前可执行的操作；有多种付款方式时，可在底部选择。
· 每次选择操作前，可以使用研发仓库；已经提交选择后不能使用。
· 需要同时弃置多张手牌时，先选齐所需数量，再一起弃置。

en.name: Moon Colony Bloodbath
en.desc: Build a lunar colony and survive disasters and malfunctioning robots
en.rules:
Game objective:
The game ends when any colony runs out of population or Instruction Manual is revealed. In multiplayer, the player with the most surviving population wins. Tied players share the win.
Setup:
Each player starts with 30 base population, 4 money, and 4 food, draws 4 building cards, and receives one of each of the 5 personal Perk cards.
The Progress deck starts with 4 Work cards, 2 Trouble cards, and 2 random Twist cards. The game setting determines whether starting Twists are drawn from simple Twists or all Twists.
Turn sequence:
Reveal 1 Progress card. All players resolve its effects at the same time. Reveal the next card after every player has finished. Trouble adds the next Event card to the Progress deck; Glitch adds one Robot card.
Put newly added Progress cards on top of the deck. Shuffle cards added together before placing them there. Reshuffle the Progress discards only when a card must be revealed and the deck is empty. You may add new cards to an empty deck without reshuffling the discards yet.
Basic actions:
During Work, each player chooses one action. Building cards are chosen secretly, then revealed together.
· Mine: Gain 4 money.
· Farm: Gain 4 food.
· Research: Draw 2 building cards.
· Restock: Gain 2 boxes, choosing a building for each box.
· Build: Choose 1 building card, pay its building cost, and place it in your colony.
You may resolve the basic action and the relevant building abilities in any order. Extra actions also trigger the relevant building abilities. You may repeat an action.
Buildings and boxes:
Your total population is your base population plus the printed population of all your buildings. A new building brings its printed population; you do not move that population out of your base. Effects that grant population normally add it to your base, unless the card says otherwise.
Boxes must be placed on your buildings. A building may hold more than one box. Duplicate building abilities usually stack. Optional effects require their full payment.
Abilities marked When built or When lost trigger when that building is built or lost. Personal Perk cards can recur after joining the Progress deck, but only their owner benefits.
Population loss:
Pay population losses from your base first. If your base has too little population, lose one building and move its printed population to your base. Discard the lost building and all its boxes, and fully resolve its ability when lost. Then resume the remaining population loss. You may need to lose more buildings. You may lose buildings only when instructed by the rules or a card.
During Hunger, pay 1 food per building. Apply the exemptions from Flag and Greenhouse. Lose 1 population for each food you cannot pay, treating the total shortage as one population loss. If Hunger causes you no population loss, gain 2 base population.
Solo play:
Add one Loneliness card to the starting Progress deck. During Loneliness, gain 3 base population per rings symbol and lose 3 population per star symbol.
· Standard challenge: Win by reaching Instruction Manual. If your population runs out first, the challenge is lost. If you lose, score the highest Event number added to the Progress deck.
· Extended challenge: Add Robot cards instead of the thirteenth Event and all later Events. Continue until your colony runs out of population, and score the number of extra Robot cards added.
Using the interface:
Your hand, reserved buildings, and buried cards are private. Only the top building discard is public. Buildings and hand cards share one page; scroll down to view the remaining cards.
· Select an available card, then use the confirmation button below. Use the information button to inspect a card.
· All choices lists the available actions. When several payments are possible, choose one in the lower bar.
· You may use Research and Development Storage before submitting a choice, but not after submitting it.
· When discarding several hand cards, select the required number before discarding them together.

zh.name: 莫提的魔法商店
zh.desc: 在魔法商店的三层货架上整理罐子，借助小猫收集最出色的魔法材料。
zh.rules:
目标：
在三层货架中按数字顺序摆放魔法材料罐，争取最多星星。2–4 人游戏，使用 Schmidt Spiele 2026 年基础版规则。
准备：
所有玩家使用同一面货架，各领取 2 只猫。104 枚双面罐分为蘑菇与云、眼睛与曼德拉草两类配对，正反面数字和盖色相同。每类配对各有黑盖 1–16、银盖 2–15、金盖 3–14、蓝盖 4–13。罐的初始朝向随机，不能免费翻面。随机移除 4 枚罐；2 人时改为移除 23 枚。袋内和盒内的罐不可查看或计数。可使用随机两块徽章，也可在开局设置中选择目标；同一实物徽章的两面不能同时使用。
每轮流程：
公开抽出 5 枚普通盖罐组成市场，2 人时为 4 枚。抽到蓝盖罐时，将它移入公共特殊罐区，再继续抽。轮到自己时，从市场拿取 1 枚罐并立即放入货架，或放弃拿罐并领取 1 只猫。每人行动一次后，市场剩余罐永久移除，由下一位玩家成为起始玩家。不能凑齐完整市场时立即结束，不进行不完整轮。
摆放规则：
· 罐只能放在空格。每行数字必须从左到右递增，即使中间有空格也必须维持顺序。
· 金盖和蓝盖可放任意一行，银盖只能放中行或下行，黑盖只能放下行。
放置新领取的罐时，可以使用以下猫的能力：
· 返还 1 只猫，将该罐翻至另一种材料的一面。
· 返还 1 只猫，将该罐放在同数字罐紧邻的左侧空格或右侧空格。
可以支付 2 只猫，同时使用这两种效果。已经放入货架的罐不能翻面。
· 填满一行，立即领取 1 只猫；终局该行另获星星：上行 10、中行 6、下行 4。
· 填满一列且有三种不同材料，立即从特殊罐区拿取 1 枚蓝盖罐并按同样规则摆放，或改领 1 只猫。蓝罐可以继续触发其他列的奖励。每列只奖励一次。
猫的供应总计 16 只，支付的猫回到供应。供应空时不能领取，也不保留欠账。终局每只剩余猫获得 2 星。
货架标签：
A 面按命中数字标签总数计分：0–9 个分别获得 0、2、4、6、8、12、16、20、24、30 星。B 面每种材料各有两个标签，两处都放对该材料时获得 6 星。标签格允许放不匹配的罐。
徽章：
达成目标立即领取最左侧空绶带的奖励。同轮达成者共占一条绶带，均获完整奖励；第一条绶带的达成者额外领取 1 只猫。每人每枚徽章只能领取一次，三条绶带占满后不能再领取。
· 下行拥有全部四种材料，或命中至少 6 个标签：三条绶带的奖励依次为 5 星、4 星和 2 星。
· 上行至少有 3 枚金盖罐、中行至少有 2 枚金盖罐、下行至少有 1 枚金盖罐，或至少 5 枚银盖罐正交连成一组，即达成该徽章条件。三条绶带的奖励依次为 6 星、5 星和 3 星。
· 同一行连续四格为连续递增数字，或一列三个数字相同：三条绶带的奖励依次为 7 星、6 星和 4 星。
· 一列至少两枚蓝盖罐，或一列三枚罐的材料相同：三条绶带的奖励依次为 8 星、7 星和 5 星。
材料计分：
基础卷轴中，每种材料有 0–10 枚时分别获得 0、1、3、6、10、15、21、28、36、46、60 星，超过 10 枚仍为 60 星。进阶卷轴可全用 I、全用 II，或按材料混用，也可部分保留基础计分。
· 蘑菇 I：每枚 3 星，每行至少 3 枚蘑菇额外获得 10 星。
· 蘑菇 II：只统计上下左右均没有其他蘑菇相邻的蘑菇罐。0–9 枚分别获得 0、2、5、9、15、23、33、45、59、75 星，更多仍为 75 星。
· 云 I：每枚 4 星，所有玩家中最大的云正交连组额外获得 14 星、第二大的不同大小连组额外获得 6 星。连组至少两枚，同一玩家可获得多项，同大小连组均获对应奖励。
· 云 II：每枚 2 星，每行云数量最多者额外获得上行 14、中行 10、下行 8 星；正数平手者均获全额，整行没有云则不颁发该行奖励。
· 眼睛 I：将眼睛罐的数量乘以货架上全部黑盖罐的数量，获得等于计算结果的星星。
· 眼睛 II：分别统计金盖罐和银盖罐的数量，取两者中较小的数，再乘以眼睛罐的数量，获得等于计算结果的星星。
· 曼德拉草 I：不同数字有 0–10 种时分别获得 0、2、5、9、14、20、27、35、45、57、72 星，更多仍为 72 星。
· 曼德拉草 II：每枚获得 4 星。同一数字有两枚时，额外获得 4 星；有三枚时，额外获得 12 星；有四枚时，额外获得 32 星。同一数字只领取与该组总枚数对应的奖励。
结束与胜负：
合计四种材料、标签、满行、剩余猫和徽章的星星。总分最高者获胜；平手时比较各自得分最高的一种材料，仍相同则共享胜利。

en.name: Morty Sorty Magic Shop
en.desc: Stock three magical shelves in number order, using kittens to collect the finest ingredients.
en.rules:
Goal:
Earn the most stars by stocking three shelves with magical jars in number order. For 2–4 players, using the Schmidt Spiele 2026 base game.
Setup:
Everyone uses the same shelf side and starts with 2 kittens. The 104 double-sided jars pair toadstools with clouds, and eyes with mandrakes. Both sides have the same number and lid. Each pair has black lids 1–16, silver 2–15, gold 3–14 and blue 4–13. Starting faces are random; jars cannot be flipped for free. Remove 4 random jars, or 23 with two players. Never inspect or count jars in the bag or box. Use two random badges or choose their faces in setup; opposite sides of one physical badge cannot both be used.
Rounds:
Draw a display of 5 ordinary jars, or 4 with two players. Put blue lids in the shared special jar area and keep drawing until the ordinary display is full. On your turn, take and place one ordinary jar, or pass and take one kitten. After everyone acts once, remove the leftovers permanently and pass the starting player clockwise. If a full display cannot be formed, the game ends immediately without playing a partial round.
Placement:
· Use an empty space. Numbers must ascend from left to right on each level, even across gaps.
· Gold and blue lids fit any level. Silver fits the middle and bottom. Black fits only the bottom.
· Return one kitten to flip the jar you just took. Return one kitten to place it immediately left or right of a jar with the same number. Pay two kittens to use both effects. Jars already on your shelf cannot be flipped.
· Filling a level immediately earns one kitten, plus stars at game end: top 10, middle 6, bottom 4.
· Filling a column with three different ingredients lets you take and place one special blue-lid jar, following the same placement rules, or take one kitten instead. Special jars may trigger further column rewards. Each column rewards only once.
There are 16 kittens in total. Spent kittens return to the supply. An empty supply gives no kitten and no debt. Each remaining kitten is worth 2 stars at game end.
Shelf labels:
Side A awards 0 / 2 / 4 / 6 / 8 / 12 / 16 / 20 / 24 / 30 stars for 0–9 matching number labels. Side B awards 6 stars for each ingredient whose two labelled spaces both contain that ingredient. You may place nonmatching jars on labelled spaces.
Badges:
As soon as you meet a badge, claim its leftmost available ribbon. Players reaching it in the same round share one ribbon and receive its full reward. Claimants of the first ribbon also take one kitten. Each badge can be claimed once per player; after all three ribbons are occupied, no further claims are possible.
· All four ingredients on the bottom level, or six matching labels: ribbons worth 5 / 4 / 2 stars.
· At least 3 / 2 / 1 gold lids on the top / middle / bottom level, or an orthogonally connected group of five silver lids: 6 / 5 / 3 stars.
· Four consecutive spaces on a level with consecutive ascending numbers, or three identical numbers in a column: 7 / 6 / 4 stars.
· At least two blue lids in a column, or three identical ingredients in a column: 8 / 7 / 5 stars.
Ingredient scoring:
Basic scrolls award 0 / 1 / 3 / 6 / 10 / 15 / 21 / 28 / 36 / 46 / 60 stars per ingredient for 0–10 jars. Ten or more score 60. Advanced scrolls may all use set I, set II, or be mixed per ingredient, including basic scoring.
· Toadstool I: 3 stars each, plus 10 per level with at least three toadstools.
· Toadstool II: count only toadstools with no orthogonally adjacent toadstool; 0–9 score 0 / 2 / 5 / 9 / 15 / 23 / 33 / 45 / 59 / 75. More still score 75.
· Cloud I: 4 stars each. Across all shelves, the largest connected cloud groups add 14 stars and the next distinct smaller size adds 6. Groups need at least two jars; one player may score multiple groups, and equal sizes receive the same award.
· Cloud II: 2 stars each; most clouds on each level adds top 14, middle 10, bottom 8. Positive ties receive full awards; an empty level awards nothing.
· Eyes I: number of eyes multiplied by all black lids on your shelf.
· Eyes II: number of eyes multiplied by the smaller of your total gold and silver lid counts.
· Mandrake I: 0–10 distinct numbers score 0 / 2 / 5 / 9 / 14 / 20 / 27 / 35 / 45 / 57 / 72; more still score 72.
· Mandrake II: each jar scores 4 stars. A group of two jars with the same number scores 4 additional stars; three score 12 additional stars, and four score 32 additional stars. For each number, take only the bonus matching the whole group’s size.
End and victory:
Sum the four ingredients, labels, completed levels, kittens and badges. Highest total wins. Break ties by the highest score for a single ingredient; if still tied, share victory.

zh.name: 多多益善：修订版
zh.desc: 一副动物牌，八种玩法：公开竞标、双重将牌，以及捕获和组合挑战。
zh.rules:
目标与牌组：
游戏包含八种独立模式，在开始游戏时选择一种。牌组共有 60 张牌，分为绿龙、黄凤凰、紫黑豹、蓝独角兽和红刺猬五种颜色。每种颜色的数字为 0 至 9，其中数字 1 和 7 各有两张。数字为 0、8、9 的牌，其牌点为 0；数字为 1 至 5 的牌，其牌点为 1；数字为 6 和 7 的牌，其牌点为 2。数字决定出牌大小，三角表示牌点，动物圆章表示花色。最高总分获胜，允许并列。

修订 Mü（3至6人）：
4至6人发完全部牌；3人移除红色，每人15张，留3张暗底牌。从庄家开始顺时针竞标：展示任意数量尚未展示的手牌，或跳过。跳过后仍能再次展示；连续全员跳过时结束。最早达到最高展示数者持皇冠，第二位持盾牌；有人超过皇冠时，原皇冠立即成为盾牌。其余人只有超过当前盾牌展示数才接替盾牌，平数不接替。无人展示则重发；仅一人展示则没有盾牌、次将及防守奖金。
· 3人皇冠获得底牌，再从未展示的手牌暗弃3张，计入自己的牌点。
· 盾牌先选次将，皇冠后选主将：只能选自己展示牌中出现的颜色或数字，也可以无将。
· 四至六人游戏中，皇冠玩家选择盾牌玩家以外的一名玩家作为伙伴；三人游戏中，皇冠玩家独自组成一方。
· 皇冠首先领牌，后续由上一墩胜者领牌；手牌和公开展示牌都可打。必须跟领出的花色，将牌已经脱离原色并合并为一种花色。缺门时可打任意牌。主次将交集最高，其次主将、次将、普通领色牌；同级比较数字，相同牌先出者胜。
每人获得自己赢得的牌点。皇冠队的目标牌点按人数确定：
· 三人游戏为 16 加皇冠展示牌数的 2 倍。
· 四人游戏为 28 加皇冠展示牌数的 2 倍。
· 五人游戏为 21 加皇冠展示牌数的 3 倍。
· 六人游戏为 16 加皇冠展示牌数的 4 倍。
达标时每位皇冠队员获得皇冠展示数的10倍加主将奖金；否则每位防守队员获得盾牌展示数的5倍加次将奖金。
将牌奖金如下：
· 选择颜色作为将牌时，获得 10 分。
· 选择数字 1 或 7 作为将牌时，获得 20 分。
· 选择其他数字作为将牌时，获得 30 分。
· 选择无将时，获得 40 分。
按开局约定的3或4手结束。

经典 Mü（4至6人）：
· 其余流程沿用Mü，但每次展示后的总数不能超过当前最高数加1，因此首次最多1张。
· 竞标结束若最高展示数平局，本手不打牌：最后达到该平数者扣展示数的10倍，其他并列最高的玩家，各获得自己展示牌数五倍的分数；其余玩家获得 0 分。
· 最高数唯一者成为首领；副手为第二高者，并列时按展示数字从大到小逐个比较，完全相同则无副手。副手不能选无将，首领可以。
· 达标时首领与伙伴的奖金为展示数的10倍加主将奖金减10，最高100。
· 失败时，查实际牌点能达到的最高展示数，与原展示数相减得到差值；首领扣差值的10倍，伙伴不加不扣，其余玩家各获得该差值五倍的分数。
· 所有人仍获得赢牌的牌点。本包按事先约定的3或4手结束。

Don Eskridge 双人版：
· 移除全部红色牌。每名玩家获得 15 张手牌，另留 3 张暗底牌和 6 张公开的侧牌，将其余 9 张牌移出游戏。
· 竞标沿用修订 Mü 的规则。皇冠玩家获得底牌后，将 3 张手牌暗弃至自己的得分堆，并且没有伙伴。
· 皇冠方使用三人游戏的目标牌点。公开的侧牌只帮助皇冠方完成目标，不计入任何玩家的个人牌点。
· 其余计分沿用修订 Mü 的规则，按事先约定进行 3 手或 4 手。

Roland Goslar 双人版：
· 去红色。每人四个颜色列及主、次将列各放1张暗牌，再发4张明牌归颜色列和12张暗手，留4张底牌。
· 竞标包括初始4张明牌，新展示牌直接归颜色列；双方未额外展示则重发。
· 皇冠玩家获得底牌后，从自己的暗手中弃置 4 张牌，将其计入自己的牌点。
· 盾牌选次将，若为颜色则整列明暗牌移动至次将列；若为数字只移动相符明牌。皇冠选主将，只移动相符明牌，再把主次交集放入超级将列。
· 所有未被明牌覆盖的暗牌，由拥有者逐张选择翻牌次序，并立即归入相应列。
· 每墩后再次检查并翻开未被覆盖的暗牌。任何明牌均可打，不限列顶；暗牌不参与跟牌义务。
· 使用三人游戏的目标牌点。皇冠方达到目标时，皇冠玩家获得 10 分；否则盾牌玩家获得 5 分。不另外计算个人牌点或奖金。任意玩家率先达到 30 分时，游戏结束。

Wimmüln（3至6人）：
· 3人去蓝、红两色。全部发完，庄家翻开最后两张牌：不同色且不同数字时，小数字的颜色是将色，小牌收回，大牌已作为第一墩领牌；同色或同数则无将，由庄家选择其中一张领牌。
· 随后每人秘密选两张预测牌，第一张公开、第二张保密，两张都不参与出牌。
· 全员提交后继续首墩。跟牌和吃墩同Mü，只有颜色将。
· 每人获得赢牌牌点；实际赢得的墩数恰好等于较小的预测数字时，获得 5 分；恰好等于较大的预测数字时，获得 10 分；命中公开预测牌时奖金翻倍，两预测相同且命中时共25分。任一玩家达到200分时结束。

The Last Panther（3至8人）：
· 三人游戏中，移除全部数字为 1 和 2 的牌；七人或八人游戏中，移除绿色、紫色、蓝色和红色的数字 2。
· 发完牌后，每名玩家秘密向右侧玩家传递 3 张牌；六人游戏中改为传递 2 张。所有玩家提交后，才能接收传来的牌。
· 持有绿色数字 5 的玩家必须以该牌领出第一墩。本模式没有将牌，必须跟随领出的颜色；牌相同时，先出牌的玩家获胜。
· 赢得最后一墩的玩家获得 50 分。每张黄色牌增加 5 分，每张红色牌扣除 10 分，每张紫色数字 7 扣除 50 分，不另外计算牌点。
· 任意玩家的累计得分达到 −250 分或更低时，游戏结束，累计得分最高的玩家获胜。

Safarü（2至4人）：
· 每名玩家获得 4 张手牌，在野外放置 4 张公开牌，其余牌组成供应牌堆。四人游戏中，位置相对的两名玩家组成一队。
· 从庄家左边开始，每次打一张：可以捕获至少两张数字之和等于所打数字的野外牌；可以捕获至少一张、与所打数字合计17的野外牌；可以捕获一张同数字牌，并把所打牌也收入。每种方法最多一组，最多三组且不能重复取牌。
· 使用加法捕获时野外若有0，至少取一个0。有可捕获的组合时必须至少捕获一组；若没有配对捕获，所打牌留在野外。
· 每名玩家打完 4 张手牌后，由原庄家左侧的玩家成为新庄家。重新为每名玩家发 4 张牌；供应足够时，再向野外补充 4 张牌。
· 供应耗尽且手牌打完后结算，野外剩牌不计分。捕获蓝色牌最多的玩家或队伍获得 24 分，捕获红色牌最多的玩家或队伍获得 12 分；并列时，平分对应奖励。每捕获一张数字为 0 的牌，扣除 5 分；再加上所有捕获牌的牌点。个人或队伍先达100分后结束。此模式采用正常捕获规则。

Rümmü（3至6人）：
· 三人游戏中，每名玩家获得 9 张手牌；四人或五人游戏中，每名玩家获得 8 张；六人游戏中，每名玩家获得 7 张。四人或六人游戏中，位置相对的两名玩家组成一队，六人共分为三队。
· 每回合先从牌库顶抽取 1 张牌，或从弃牌堆顶逐张领取卡牌。每领取 1 张后，可以查看该牌，再决定是否继续领取。
· 随后可以打出组合、向已有组合追加卡牌，或换回组合中的黄色牌。最后必须弃置 1 张手牌，不能将最后一张手牌加入组合。
每个组合至少包含 3 张牌，可以采用以下形式：
· 数字相同，且颜色各不相同。
· 数字连续，且全部同色或全部异色。
黄色牌可以替代与其数字相同的任意颜色牌。同色顺子中，普通牌必须超过一半；异色顺子或相同数字的组合中，最多只能使用 1 张黄色牌。已经打出的组合不能拆分或重新排列，但可以使用合适的普通牌，换回其中的黄色牌。
首次开牌可以同时打出多个组合，合计张数按累计分决定：个人累计分为负数时至少3张，0至99分至少4张，100至149分至少5张，150分及以上至少6张；团队累计分为负数、0至199分、200至399分、400分及以上时，分别至少3、4、5、6张。已开牌者可以向任何组合追加。
最先出完手牌的玩家获得 10 分，其伙伴免于结算剩余手牌的罚分。其他玩家每剩余一张黄色手牌扣除 10 分，每剩余一张其他手牌扣除 5 分。
桌面组合按以下方式计分：
· 三张相同数字的组合获得 0 分。
· 四张相同数字的组合，含黄色牌时获得 10 分，不含黄色牌时获得 30 分。
· 五张相同数字的组合获得 50 分。
· 数字为 1 或 7 的相同数字组合，其分数减半。
· 长度为三张的顺子，混色获得 0 分，纯色获得 10 分。
· 长度为四张的顺子，混色获得 10 分，纯色获得 20 分。
· 长度为五张的顺子，混色获得 20 分，纯色获得 40 分；之后每增加一张牌，再获得 10 分。
异色顺子或含黄色牌的顺子均视为混色。个人率先达到 200 分，或团队率先达到 500 分时，游戏结束。
牌库耗尽时，保留弃牌堆顶的一张牌，将其余弃牌洗混成新牌库。如果没有可洗混的牌，本手按现有组合和剩余手牌结算，不给予出完手牌的奖金及伙伴免罚。这是此模式的补充裁定。

en.name: Mü & more: Revised Edition
en.desc: Eight games with one animal deck: open bidding, two trumps, fishing and melding.
en.rules:
Deck and objective:
Choose one of eight separate games at setup. The deck has five suits: green dragons, yellow phoenixes, purple panthers, blue unicorns and red hedgehogs. Each has 0–9, with two 1s and two 7s. Card points: 0/8/9 score zero; 1–5 score one; 6/7 score two. Numbers determine trick strength; triangles show points, animal seals show suits. Highest total wins; ties are allowed.

Revised Mü (3–6):
Deal all 60 equally with 4–6 players. With 3, remove red, deal 15 each and leave a 3-card kitty. Starting with the dealer, reveal any number of previously hidden hand cards or pass. You may bid after passing. The auction ends after everyone passes consecutively. The first player to reach the highest display holds the Crown. A player exceeding it takes Crown and the previous Crown becomes Shield. Otherwise, a player takes Shield only by exceeding its current display; ties retain the earlier holder. With no bids, redeal. A sole bidder has no Shield, minor trump or defending bonus.
With 3 players, Crown takes the kitty and discards 3 hidden hand cards to their points pile. Shield chooses minor trump, then Crown chooses major: a suit or number present in their own display, or no trump. With 4–6, Crown chooses a partner other than Shield; with 3 Crown plays alone. Crown leads first, then each trick winner leads. Displayed cards remain visible and playable. Follow the led suit if possible. All trumps leave their original suits and form one suit. If void, play anything. The intersection of both trumps beats major, then minor, then the led ordinary suit; within each rank the higher number wins, identical cards favor the earlier play.
Everyone scores their own captured card points. The Crown team’s target depends on player count:
· With 3 players, the target is 16 card points plus twice the Crown’s displayed-card count.
· With 4 players, it is 28 card points plus twice that count.
· With 5 players, it is 21 card points plus three times that count.
· With 6 players, it is 16 card points plus four times that count.
If reached, each Crown teammate gains 10×Crown bid plus major-trump bonus. Otherwise each defender gains 5×Shield bid plus minor-trump bonus.
Trump bonuses are as follows:
· A suit trump earns 10 points.
· A number trump of 1 or 7 earns 20 points.
· Any other number trump earns 30 points.
· No trump earns 40 points.
Play the agreed 3 or 4 hands.

Classic Mü (4–6):
Use Mü play with these changes. A display may never exceed the current highest count plus one, so the first bid is at most one card. If the final highest bid is tied, no tricks are played: the last player to reach that tied count loses 10×bid, other tied leaders gain 5×bid, others zero. The sole highest bidder is Chief. Vice is second highest; ties compare displayed numbers in descending order, and an exact tie leaves no Vice. Vice cannot choose no trump. On success, Chief and partner each gain min(100,10×bid+major bonus−10). On failure, find the highest bid whose goal the team's actual points reached; subtract it from the original bid. Chief loses ten times that difference, partner receives no bonus or penalty, others gain five times it. Everyone also scores their captured card points. This implementation uses the agreed 3 or 4 hands.

Don Eskridge (2):
