zh.name: 快可思
zh.desc: 六骰齐掷全员抢画,四行数字越锁越快
zh.rules:
游戏目标：在四行数字中尽可能多地标记格子，争取获得最高总分。终局时，总分最高的玩家获胜。
流程:
· 主动玩家掷 6 枚骰子，包括 2 枚白色骰子，以及红色、黄色、绿色、蓝色骰子各 1 枚。某行锁定后，将对应颜色的骰子移出游戏。
· 白骰阶段：每名玩家都可以使用两枚白色骰子的点数之和，在任意一行标记对应数字。只能标记在该行已有标记的右侧；跳过的格子以后不能再标记。
· 色骰阶段：只有主动玩家可以再标记 1 个格子。任选 1 枚白色骰子和 1 枚彩色骰子，将其点数相加，在该彩色骰子对应的行中标记相应数字。
· 若主动玩家在整个回合中没有画记任何数字，则画记一个罚分格；终局时，每个罚分格扣除 5 分。
锁行:
· 某行已经标记至少 5 个数字格后，可以标记该行最右端的数字 12 或 2，并同时标记锁格。该行随即对所有玩家关闭。
结束:
· 任意玩家的 4 个罚分格全部被标记，或累计有两行被锁定时，对局立即结束。
结算:
· 每行按已画记的格数查表得分。例如，画记 1 格获得 1 分，画记 12 格获得 78 分；锁格也计为一格。将各行分数相加，再扣除罚分，得到总分。总分最高的玩家获胜，平分时共享胜利。

en.name: Qwixx
en.desc: Everyone plays on every roll — cross off numbers across four rows before they lock away
en.rules:
Goal: Mark as many numbers as you can in four rows; highest total wins.
Play:
· The active player rolls 6 dice: 2 white plus one each of red, yellow, green, blue; dice of locked rows leave the game.
· White phase: everyone may cross the sum of the two white dice in any one row; you may only mark to the right of your existing marks, and skipped cells are gone for good.
· Color phase: only the active player may mark once more — add one white die to one colored die and mark that sum in the matching row.
· If the active player marks nothing all turn, they take a penalty box (−5 each).
Locking:
· With at least 5 marks in a row, marking its rightmost number (12 or 2) also crosses the lock, closing that row for everyone.
End:
· The game ends immediately when anyone takes a 4th penalty or a 2nd row is locked.
Scoring:
· Score each row according to its number of marked spaces. For example, one marked space scores 1 point and twelve score 78 points; the lock also counts as a marked space. Add the row scores and subtract penalties. The highest total wins, and tied players share victory.

zh.name: 太陽神
zh.desc: 呼唤 Ra，以太阳竞拍文明、法老与纪念物，历经三个时代建立王朝。
zh.rules:
目标：
游戏进行三个时代，最终总分最高的玩家获胜。总分平手时，持有单个最高太阳的玩家获胜。
准备：
每位玩家获得 10 分及一组太阳。每个时代由持有最高太阳的玩家先行动，然后顺时针轮流行动。所有分数在终局前仅本人可见，板块与太阳始终公开。
行动：
仅持有正面太阳的玩家可以行动。每回合选择以下一项：
· 抽取板块：拍卖列未满 8 枚时，从袋中抽一枚。普通板块进入拍卖列；Ra 板块弃置并使太阳船前进一步，触发拍卖。太阳船到达终点时，直接结束时代，不进行拍卖。
· 呼唤 Ra：主动发起拍卖，不推进太阳船。
· 使用神板块：弃置自己的一枚或多枚神板块，按所选顺序逐枚获得拍卖列中等量的非神板块。取得灾难时立即处理，再继续取得下一枚。
拍卖：
从发起者下家开始，依顺时针顺序各竞价一次，发起者最后。选择一个正面太阳，数值必须高于当前最高价，或放弃竞价。仅最高出价者支付太阳，其他人的太阳仍可使用。胜者获得整列板块，并用所付太阳交换中央太阳，将获得的太阳背面朝上放置。
抽到 Ra 引发的拍卖允许全员放弃，板块保留。主动呼唤且拍卖列未满时，若其他人全部放弃，发起者必须竞价；拍卖列已满时允许全员放弃，并清空拍卖列。拍卖后从发起者下家继续行动，跳过没有正面太阳的玩家。
灾难：
取得灾难后，每枚灾难要求弃置两枚对应板块；不足两枚则全部弃置。战争对应文明，葬礼对应法老，地震对应纪念物。干旱先弃置洪水，不足时再弃置尼罗河。拍卖获得的所有板块先归入收藏，再处理灾难。
时代结束与计分：
全员太阳均背面朝上，或太阳船达到终点时，进行时代计分。太阳船终点按 2／3／4／5 人分别为 6／8／9／10 步。时代计分后的累计分数最低为 0。
· 法老：最多者获得 5 分，最少者失去 2 分，并列者均计分；所有人数量相同时不计分。
· 河流：每枚洪水获得 1 分。至少有一枚洪水时，每枚尼罗河额外获得 1 分。
· 文明：没有文明失去 5 分；拥有 3／4／5 种文明分别获得 5／10／15 分；1 或 2 种不计分。
· 黄金：每枚获得3分。
· 未使用的神板块：每枚获得2分。
· 纪念物仅第三时代计分：不同类型不超过 6 种时每种 1 分，7／8 种分别为 10／15 分。同类的 3／4／5 枚额外获得 5／10／15 分。两种方式同时计分。
· 太阳仅第三时代计分：各人全部太阳数值之和，最高者获得 5 分，最低者失去 5 分，并列者均计分；所有人总值相同时不计分。
前两个时代结束后，保留法老、尼罗河与纪念物；弃置其他板块及拍卖列剩余板块。中央太阳保留，所有玩家的太阳翻回正面，太阳船回到起点，开始下个时代。
商人扩展（可选）：
加入 20 枚商人板块。每当一名玩家获得一枚商人，其他玩家各按自己已有的商人数获得等量货物，取得商人的玩家不因此获得货物。时代计分时，每枚商人和每份货物各获得 1 分，随后全部弃置。

en.name: Ra
en.desc: Invoke Ra and bid with your suns to build a dynasty over three epochs.
en.rules:
Goal:
Play three epochs. The player with the highest final score wins. Ties are broken by the highest single sun disk held by a tied player.
Setup:
Each player starts with 10 points and a group of suns. The owner of the highest sun takes the first turn of each epoch, then play continues clockwise. Scores remain private until the game ends. Tiles and suns are public.
Actions:
Only players with a faceup sun may act. On your turn, choose one action:
· Draw a tile: if the auction track has fewer than 8 tiles, draw from the bag. Ordinary tiles enter the track. A Ra tile is discarded and advances the Sun Boat one step, triggering an auction. Reaching the final step ends the epoch immediately, without an auction.
· Invoke Ra: begin an auction without moving the Sun Boat.
· Spend God tiles: discard one or more Gods to take that many non-God tiles from the track, in your chosen order. Resolve each Disaster immediately before taking the next tile.
Auctions:
Beginning with the player to the caller's left, each player bids or passes once; the caller goes last. A bid uses one faceup sun with a value higher than the current bid. Only the winner pays a sun; losing bids remain available. The winner takes the entire auction track, swaps their winning sun for the central sun, and places the received sun facedown.
When a Ra tile triggers an auction, everyone may pass and the track stays. When Ra is invoked with fewer than 8 tiles, the caller must bid if everyone else passes. With a full track, everyone may pass and all tiles on the track are discarded. Play resumes clockwise from the caller, skipping players without faceup suns.
Disasters:
For each Disaster acquired, discard two matching tiles, or all matching tiles if you have fewer than two. War affects Civilizations, Funeral affects Pharaohs, and Earthquake affects Monuments. Drought removes Floods first, then Nile tiles. All tiles won at auction enter your collection before Disasters are resolved.
Epochs and scoring:
An epoch ends when all suns are facedown or the Sun Boat reaches its final step. With 2/3/4/5 players, the track has 6/8/9/10 steps. Cumulative scores cannot fall below zero after scoring an epoch.
· Pharaohs: most gains 5 points; fewest loses 2. Tied players gain or lose the full amount. If everyone is tied, no one scores.
· River: each Flood scores 1 point. With at least one Flood, each Nile also scores 1 point.
· Civilizations: no types loses 5 points; 3/4/5 different types scores 5/10/15. One or two types scores nothing.
· Gold tiles: Score 3 points for each tile.
· Unspent God tiles: Score 2 points for each tile.
· Monuments score only in epoch III. Up to 6 different types score 1 per type; 7/8 types score 10/15. Groups of 3/4/5 identical Monuments add 5/10/15. Both methods apply together.
· Suns score only in epoch III. Add all your sun values: highest total gains 5, lowest loses 5. Tied players gain or lose the full amount. If everyone is tied, no one scores.
After epochs I and II, keep Pharaohs, Nile tiles and Monuments. Discard other tiles and the auction track. Leave the central sun, turn all players' suns faceup, reset the Sun Boat and begin the next epoch.
Traders expansion (optional):
Add 20 Trader tiles. Whenever a player takes a Trader, every other player gains goods equal to their own number of Traders. The player taking the Trader gains no goods from it. Each Trader and each good scores 1 point at the end of the epoch, then all are discarded.

zh.name: 千墨交通
zh.desc: 共用骰子，绘制独立路网；经典与挑战规则，河湖、森林、街机等多种扩展。
zh.rules:
目标:
在自己的 7 行 7 列的版图上绘制公路与铁路，连接出口并获得最高总分。所有玩家使用同一组骰子，同时规划各自的版图。
准备:
选择经典或 Challenge 规则，以及至多一种主题扩展。工程扩展可以叠加。所有可选内容默认关闭。经典基础游戏共 7 回合。
流程:
每回合掷出四颗路线骰。你可以任意旋转或镜像骰面，再点选合法格绘制。每颗路线骰每回合使用一次；只要仍有合法位置，就必须使用。每条路线至少一端连接已有同类路线或对应出口；公路和铁路只能经车站互通，立交桥的两条路线互不相连。路线可以通向没有出口的版图边缘。
每回合可以额外使用一种特殊路线，每种整局只用一次，整局最多使用三种。确认完成绘制后，所有玩家一起结算回合后效果，再进入下一回合。
Challenge:
使用两颗普通骰及两颗挑战骰。
· 工厂：在绘入交通路线时允许额外复制一颗本回合路线骰。
· 村庄：必须绘入车站才激活，累计 1／2／3／4 次分别获得 1／2／4／6 分。
· 大学：第三次激活大学可以立即免费使用一种尚未用过的特殊路线，不占普通次数。
路线被擦除后，建筑可以再次触发，已获得的效果保留。
可选目标在回合末判定，同回合完成者获得相同分数；先后批次分别获得 4／2／1 分。单人局的三个目标分别在第 3／4／5 回合前完成获得 4 分，否则获得 1 分。
结算:
· 交通网络：每个交通网络按相连出口数计分：2 至 11 个出口获得 4、8、12、16、20、24、28、32、36、40 分，12 个获得 45 分。
· 最长路线：最长公路与最长铁路每格各获得 1 分；经典规则同格不重复，Challenge 允许沿不同路线段再次经过同格。
· 中央区域：中央九格中每个已绘制格获得 1 分。
· 错误扣分：每个未接通的路线端口扣 1 分，通往边缘不扣分。
总分最高者获胜；同分时错误较少者获胜，再同分共同获胜。
河流与湖泊:
均为 6 回合，扩展骰可选且可以独立起笔。河流只能连接河流；选一条河每格获得 1 分，两端都到边界额外获得 3 分，未接通河口照常扣分。湖泊按开放水边连接，经码头连接交通网络；最小湖泊每格获得 1 分。空格有至少三侧面向开放湖面时自动填满为水域，湖面开口不扣分。
熔岩与陨石:
均为 6 回合。熔岩从中央火山开始，每回合至少绘制一颗熔岩骰，并连接已有熔岩；可以在不邻接熔岩的空格新建火山。没有空格可以延伸时，可以擦除阻挡的路线。最大熔岩湖每格获得 1 分，每座封闭熔岩湖额外获得 5 分，开放熔岩边每侧扣 1 分。
陨石在回合开始按方向与距离移动，从中央或上次落点起算，碰到边缘反弹，落在旧陨石坑时继续移动。落点改为陨石坑；可以消耗一次可用特殊路线取消本回合陨石。陨石坑可以重新绘入路线，每个通向现存陨石坑的交通端口获得 2 分且不扣分。
森林、小径与沙漠:
均为 6 回合。森林和沙漠骰可独立起笔；森林按正交相邻格组成，最大森林每格获得 2 分，第二大每格获得 1 分。小径沿格角连接，需要接上既有路线或小径；格角进入车站便自动连接，按相连车站数获得对应网络分的一半，最多计 12 座车站，小径开口不扣分。
沙漠每次出现烈日时，先擦去不邻接绿洲的仙人掌，路线保留；可消耗一次可用特殊路线取消。第 6 回合后再掷一次沙漠骰并处理最后的烈日，每棵存活仙人掌获得 1 分。
峡谷:
共 7 回合。峡谷沿格边绘制，必须完整使用骰面形状，连接边界或已有峡谷端点，不能分叉。交通路线接触峡谷边时消耗一处桥梁，整局最多 12 处。最长峡谷每段获得 1 分，每条两端都到边界的峡谷额外获得 2 分。
街机扩展:
· 方块规划：在每回合画路线之前，可以完整标出骰面形状的四个空格；已标格不能重复，终局已填格每格获得 1 分，空格每格扣 1 分。
· 吃豆人：每回合必须在尚未接通且未标记的出口旁绘入骰面标记；网络含吃豆人获得 3 分，含幽灵但没有水果时每只幽灵扣 2 分，有水果时每只幽灵改为获得 2 分。
· 外星入侵：开局在右侧玩家版图放置两只外星人；每回合后按骰面派遣、攻击或清除外星人，攻击使其获得护盾并擦除所在格内容，无护盾外星人可被绘制覆盖，终局每只扣 1 分。
· 彩虹：共 6 回合，每回合前放置彩虹、三叶草或在左侧玩家版图放置雨云；彩虹不得正交相邻，雨云优先放在彩虹旁。彩虹连接所有朝向它的交通路线，但中断最长公路和铁路；每朵彩虹为每个正交相邻三叶草获得 2 分，朝向雨云与三叶草的端口不扣分。
电力、未来与天空:
· 路灯：共 6 回合，绘制特殊路线后选择一行或一列点亮已有路灯，终局每盏点亮路灯获得 1 分。
· 电网：共 7 回合，中央为蓄电池；回合后从出口或已通电格沿骰面方向为连续交通格通电，也可提前停止。问号可以为任一交通格通电或为蓄电池充电；蓄电池最多充电 3 次。得分为充电次数乘以通过正交通电格连接的出口数。
· 城市建设：共 7 回合，回合后按收入骰获得硬币，最多保留 12 枚，再建造建筑骰所示建筑；一、二、三座高塔分别花费 3、5、7 枚硬币。终局每座高塔获得 1 分，朝向建筑的端口不扣分。
· 异星牧场：共 6 回合，扩展骰可独立起笔，特殊路线可改为绘入飞碟；每艘飞碟为同一行或列的每只绵羊获得 2 分，同一只羊可由多艘飞碟计分。
· 超级连接：共6回合，扩展骰必须使用；路线末端的三角超级车站可以接公路或铁路，超级连接同时计入最长公路与最长铁路。
· 天气：共 7 回合，每回合必须把两种骰面天气分别标到本回合绘制的两个交通格；终局每种天气的最大正交连续区域每格获得 1 分，接触其他天气区域（包括对角）的区域不计分。
· 航空：共 6 回合，扩展骰可独立起笔，特殊路线可改为机场；机场连接所有朝向它的路线，最长航空路线必须在边界或机场起止，每格获得 2 分，每个开放航空端口扣 2 分，每座未接航空路线的机场扣 4 分。
异闻扩展:
· 仪式：共 6 回合，仪式骰必须绘制且可独立起笔；回合后可在没有出口的边界交通端口放置一扇异界之门。连接仪式或异界之门的网络不再按普通出口计分，改按仪式与门的数量获得网络分。
· 传送门：共 7 回合，同字母最多两扇，成对连接其所在网络，公路与铁路可以经门互通。
· 触手：共 7 回合，回合后可绘制骰面长度的完整触手，从不含出口的边界格进入；只能穿过空格、直线或弯道，不能使用已占用的格边，尾端结束。终局每条触手获得 2 分，每个同时含交通路线与触手的格额外获得 1 分；之后不能再向已有触手格绘入交通路线。
· 调查：共 6 回合，开局选择调查员所在出口；回合后可按骰面脚印数移动，每步沿公路到相邻格，或由车站／铁路出口沿铁路到下一座车站，不得跳过车站。每收集一条线索获得 1 分，全部收集额外获得 4 分。
地下交通:
双层模式交替进行地表与地下回合，共 14 回合；独立模式只进行 7 个地下回合。水管对应公路出口，地铁对应铁路出口，两者不能相连。地下每回合最多复制一颗骰，整局最多三次。地表车站与地下车站重叠时形成枢纽；在已有水管上方新建地表车站会损坏水管，反向建造不会损坏。独立模式的新地下车站若同行同列都没有枢纽，立即成为枢纽。地下网络按相连出口计分，地铁枢纽也计为出口；最长水管每格获得 2 分，最长地铁每格获得 1 分，中央格照常计分，未接端口每个扣 1 分，损坏水管每格额外扣 2 分。
工程扩展:
特殊骰替换一颗普通路线骰，分离骰替换另一颗普通路线骰，均必须使用且可由工厂复制。施工骰每回合可以使用一次，按骰面擦除、移动一条已有基础路线，或使下一条路线不必连接已有路线。扩展骰结果不受施工影响。改建骰每回合可用一次，只能对已有基础路线增加端口；原有路线必须完全位于骰面虚线约束内，带虚线方框的两面只能给已有车站增加连接，不可改建主题扩展骰结果。

en.name: Railroad Ink
en.desc: Share the dice and draw your own network, with Classic, Challenge and modular expansions.
en.rules:
Goal:
Draw highways and railways on your own 7×7 board. Connect exits and maximize your final score. All players use the same dice and plan their boards simultaneously.
Setup:
Choose Classic or Challenge and at most one themed expansion. Engineer modules may be added. All optional content is off by default. A Classic game lasts 7 rounds.
Play:
Each round rolls four route dice. Rotate or mirror a face, then select a legal board space. Use each route die once whenever a legal placement remains. Every route must connect to a matching exit or existing route. Highways and railways only join at stations; the two routes on an overpass remain separate. Routes may lead to a board edge without an exit.
You may also draw one unused special route per round, using at most three during the game. Each special design may only be used once. Finish drawing, resolve the end-of-round effects together, then advance to the next round.
Challenge:
Use two ordinary dice and two Challenge dice.
· Factory: drawing a transport route on a factory grants a copy of a route die rolled this round.
· Village: a village activates only with a station: 1/2/3/4 activations score 1/2/4/6 points.
· University: the third university activation immediately grants an unused special route without using the ordinary round or game limit.
Erasing routes allows buildings to activate again; previously earned effects remain.
Optional goals are checked at the end of a round. Players completing a goal in the same round receive the same reward. Successive groups score 4/2/1 points. Solo goals award 4 points by rounds 3/4/5 respectively, or 1 point later.
Scoring:
· Networks: each network scores for connected exits: 2 through 11 exits score 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 28, 32, 36 and 40 points; 12 score 45.
· Longest routes: the longest highway and longest railway each score 1 per space. Classic counts each space once; Challenge may revisit a space through a different route segment.
· Central area: each occupied central space scores 1.
· Errors: each unconnected route end costs 1; ends at board edges cost nothing.
Highest total wins, then fewer errors; remaining ties share the win.
Rivers and Lakes:
Both last 6 rounds. Expansion dice are optional and may start independently. Rivers only connect to rivers: choose one river for 1 point per space and 3 extra if both ends reach the board edge. Open river ends are errors. Lakes join through open water edges and connect transport networks via piers. Score 1 per space of the smallest lake. An empty space with at least three sides facing open water fills automatically. Open lake sides are not errors.
Lava and Meteors:
Both last 6 rounds. Lava starts at a central volcano. Draw at least one lava die per round, connected to existing lava. You may create a volcano in an empty space not adjacent to lava. If lava cannot extend into an empty space, you may erase a blocking route. The largest lava lake scores 1 per space, each closed lake scores 5 more, and each open lava side costs 1.
At the start of each Meteor round, move from the center or previous impact according to direction and distance. Bounce at edges and continue past old craters. Replace the impact space with a crater. You may spend an available special route to cancel the meteor. Craters may be covered with new routes. Every transport end facing a remaining crater scores 2 instead of an error.
Forests, Trails and Desert:
All last 6 rounds. Forest and Desert dice may start independently. Orthogonally adjacent trees form forests: the largest scores 2 per space and the second largest 1 per space. Trails connect through space corners and must connect to existing routes or trails. A trail reaching a station corner automatically joins that station. Connected stations score half the network value, counting at most 12 stations. Open trails are not errors.
When either Desert die shows a sun, first erase cacti not adjacent to an oasis, leaving routes intact. You may spend an available special route to cancel the heat. Roll once more after round 6 for a final heat wave. Each surviving cactus scores 1.
Canyons:
Play 7 rounds. Draw the complete die pattern along space borders. It must connect to a board edge or an existing canyon end, without branching. Any transport route touching a canyon edge requires a bridge; at most 12 bridges may be used. Score 1 per segment of the longest canyon and 2 more for each canyon whose two ends reach the board edge.
Arcade:
· Tetromino: before drawing routes, optionally enhance four empty spaces in the complete die pattern. Never enhance a space twice. Each enhanced space scores 1 if occupied, or loses 1 if empty.
· Pluck-Man: each round, mark the die result at an unconnected, unmarked exit if possible. A network with Pluck-Man scores 3. Each connected ghost loses 2 without fruit, or scores 2 with fruit.
· Galactic Invaders: during setup, place two aliens on the board to your right. After each round, apply the shared die to send, attack or remove aliens. Attacks shield aliens and erase their spaces. Drawing over an unshielded alien removes it. Each remaining alien costs 1.
· Rainbow lasts 6 rounds: before routes, place a rainbow or clover, or rain on the board to your left. Rainbows may not touch orthogonally. Rain must be placed next to a rainbow if possible. Rainbows connect all transport ends facing them but interrupt longest highways and railways. Each rainbow scores 2 per adjacent clover. Ends facing rain or clovers are not errors.
Electricity, Futuristic and Sky:
· Street Lamps lasts 6 rounds. After a special route, select a row or column to activate its existing lamps. Each activated lamp scores 1.
· Power Grid lasts 7 rounds with an accumulator at the center. After routes, electrify consecutive transport spaces in the indicated direction, starting from an exit or electrified space; you may stop early. A question mark electrifies one arbitrary transport space or charges the accumulator. Charge at most three times. Score charges multiplied by exits joined through orthogonally adjacent electrified spaces.
· City Builder lasts 7 rounds. After routes, gain income from the Income die, keeping at most 12 coins. Build any number of the indicated buildings: 1/2/3 towers cost 3/5/7 coins. Each tower scores 1 and ends facing buildings are not errors.
· Alien Farmer lasts 6 rounds. Expansion dice may start independently; a special route may be replaced by a UFO. Each UFO scores 2 per sheep in its row or column; several UFOs may score the same sheep.
· Superconnection lasts 6 rounds. Its die is mandatory. Triangular Superstations at route ends connect to either highways or railways. Superconnections count toward both longest routes.
· Weather lasts 7 rounds. Assign both symbols to two transport spaces drawn this round. Score 1 per space in the largest orthogonal area of each weather type. Areas touching another weather type, even diagonally, score nothing.
· Airline lasts 6 rounds. Expansion dice may start independently and a special may become an airport. Airports join all facing routes. The longest airway must start and end at an edge or airport and scores 2 per space. Each open airway end costs 2; each airport with no airway costs 4.
Eldritch:
· Ritual lasts 6 rounds. Its die is mandatory and may start independently. After each round you may add a portal to a route end at a board edge without an exit. A network containing rituals or portals ignores ordinary exits and instead scores the network value of its rituals and portals.
· Portal lasts 7 rounds: at most two portals of each letter may be drawn. Matching pairs join their networks, even across highway and railway types.
· Tentacles lasts 7 rounds. After routes, optionally draw a complete tentacle of the die's length, entering through a boundary space without an exit. It may cross empty spaces, straights and curves using unoccupied sides, then ends in a tip. Score 2 per tentacle and 1 per space shared by a tentacle and transport route. Later routes cannot be drawn over tentacles.
· Investigation lasts 6 rounds. Choose an exit for your investigator during setup. After routes, spend the die's footsteps: move one adjacent space by highway, or from a station/railway exit to the next station along railway, never skipping a station. Each collected clue scores 1; collecting all clues scores 4 more.
Underground:
Expansion mode alternates surface and underground for 14 rounds. Standalone uses 7 underground rounds. Water pipes use highway exits and subways use railway exits; the two kinds never join. You may duplicate one underground die per round, at most three per game. Aligned surface and subway stations create hubs. Building a surface station above an existing pipe breaks it; the reverse order does not. In standalone, a new subway station becomes a hub if no hub shares its row or column. Underground networks score connected exits, with hubs also counting as subway exits. Longest pipes score 2 per space, longest subways 1, central spaces 1, open ends lose 1, and each broken pipe loses 2 more.
Engineer:
The Special die replaces one ordinary route die and the Separation die replaces another. Both are mandatory and factories may duplicate them. Once per round, the Construction die may erase or move a basic route, or let the next route start without connecting to existing routes. Construction does not affect non-Engineer expansion results. Once per round, the Renovation die may add connections to an existing basic route. The old route must fit entirely within its dotted constraints; faces with a dotted central square may only extend an existing station. Themed expansion results cannot be renovated.

zh.name: 赛马大亨
zh.desc: 实时下注的赛马派对,四场比赛谁钱多谁赢
zh.rules:
目标:四场比赛后,持有金钱最多的玩家获胜。
准备:
· 九匹马根据两颗骰子的点数之和前进：2或3对应同一匹马，11或12对应同一匹马，4至10各对应一匹马。赛道共有15格，所有玩家的初始资金均为0。
· 每人持有 2、3、3、4、5 五个注码;7 人以上改为 2、3、4、5。
流程:
· 比赛自动进行:定时掷两枚骰子,点数和驱动对应的马前进一格。
· 同一匹马连续两次被驱动时额外冲刺(7 号马无冲刺,连续第三次不触发)。
· 赛跑期间随时把注码放上投注板空格,先到先得,每格限一枚。
· 第三匹马越过红线后停止下注;任一马到达终点比赛立即结束。
· 第一至三场赛后,每人从两张 VIP 卡中选一张保留,效果累积。
结算:
· 押中冠军时，该马的头马、前二和前三投注均获胜。
· 押中亚军时，该马的前二和前三投注获胜。
· 押中季军时，仅该马的前三投注获胜。
并列名次的马匹适用相同的投注获胜规则。
· 投注获胜时，获得的赔付等于注码面值乘以投注格的倍率。投注未获胜时，支付该格红圈内标示的罚金；格内没有红圈时，无须支付罚金。
· 资金全部用完时，不会产生债务。四场比赛结束后，持有金钱最多的玩家获胜；金额相同时，共同获胜。

en.name: Ready Set Bet
en.desc: Real-time betting horse-racing party; richest after four races wins
en.rules:
Goal: after four races, the player with the most money wins.
Setup:
· The nine horses advance according to the sum of two dice: 2 and 3 share one horse, 11 and 12 share another, and each sum from 4 through 10 has its own horse. The track has 15 spaces, and every player starts with $0.
· Each player holds bet tokens 2, 3, 3, 4, 5; with 7+ players drop one 3.
Play:
· Races run automatically: two dice roll on a timer and move the matching horse one space.
· A horse moved twice in a row sprints bonus spaces (not horse 7; never thrice in a row).
· During the race, place tokens on open board spots at any time, first come first served.
· Betting closes once three horses cross the red line; the race ends at the finish.
· After races 1-3, each player keeps one of two dealt VIP cards; effects accumulate.
Scoring:
Winning bets depend on the horse’s finishing position:
· First place: WIN, PLACE and SHOW bets on that horse win.
· Second place: PLACE and SHOW bets on that horse win.
· Third place: SHOW bets on that horse win.
Tied horses use the same payout rules for their shared position.
· Winning bets pay token value × spot multiplier; losing bets pay the red-circle penalty.
· You never go into debt; richest after four races wins, ties share the victory.

zh.name: 52个王国:冒险
zh.desc: 纯单人地城爬行:一副扑克牌闯荡四张地图,击败首领并带走战利品
zh.rules:
目标:深入地城击败首领,并尽可能多地带走战利品;创伤牌等级合计达到生命上限,或需要抽牌时牌库已空,则冒险失败。
准备:先抽 2 张牌作为物品,再逐张抽牌作为装备,直到装备等级合计达到 20;期间抽到的 A 先搁置,最后全部洗回牌库。
回合流程:
· 沿走廊移动到相邻房间,然后结算该房间的效果。
· 通过数字门时，须耗尽若干张就绪装备，其等级合计须达到门的要求。通过字母门前，须先击败对应等级的敌人。
· 通过火炬门时，火炬等级须达到要求；通过扭曲走廊时，抽取卡牌确定费用。
战斗:抽 2 张牌,等级高者是敌人(花色决定种类),另 1 张是奖励牌;平局按 ♣>♠>♥>♦ 决胜。
· 每个战斗回合揭示 1 张战斗卡,敌人的格挡先生效。
· 然后你选择攻击、防御、使用角色技能或休息,最后敌人按战斗卡花色行动。
攻击：耗尽 1 张就绪装备，造成与该装备等级相同点数的伤害。敌人生命标记停留的位置印有符号时，立即结算该符号。
防御:耗尽任意数量就绪装备,按等级合计减免本回合受到的伤害。
受到伤害时抽牌判定:抽到的牌等级不超过伤害值,则成为创伤牌;幽灵类敌人造成的伤害直接成为创伤。
奖励：获得奖励牌后，选择将其作为物品、装备或战利品放置。
物品效果:
· ♣ 力量药水:重置全部装备。
· ♠ 欺骗斗篷:改变 1 张装备的等级或花色。
· ♥ 治疗药水：弃置 1 张创伤牌，或抵消一次诅咒。
· ♦ 幸运水晶:将刚抽到的牌换为重新抽 1 张。
无论何时抽到 A,立即承受当前地图对应的诅咒效果,然后补抽 1 张。
计分:每张物品 2 分,战利品按等级计分;永恒午夜森林的赏金、沉没的大教堂的蜡烛另有加分。

en.name: 52 Realms: Adventures
en.desc: A solo dungeon crawl: four maps, one deck of cards, slay the boss and keep the loot
en.rules:
Goal: delve deep, defeat the boss, and get out with as much loot as you can. You lose if your wound ranks reach your health total, or if you must draw from an empty deck.
Setup: draw 2 cards as items, then draw equipment until your equipment ranks total 20; set aside any Aces and shuffle them back in at the end.
Each turn:
· Move along a corridor to an adjacent room, then resolve the room you enter.
· Numbered gates require exhausting ready equipment of sufficient total rank; lettered gates require defeating a guardian of that rank.
· Torch gates require torch level, and twisted corridors draw a card to set the cost.
Combat: draw 2 cards — the higher one is the enemy (its suit sets the type), the other is the reward; ties break ♣>♠>♥>♦.
· Each combat round, reveal a battle card: enemy block applies first.
· Then you attack, defend, use a character skill, or rest, and the enemy acts by the suit of its battle card.
Attack: exhaust 1 ready equipment to deal its rank in damage; symbols on the space where the enemy health marker lands trigger immediately.
Defend: exhaust any number of ready equipment to reduce incoming damage by their total rank.
When you take damage, draw a card: if its rank does not exceed the damage, it becomes a wound; wounds from wraiths are automatic.
Place each reward card in one of three places: as an item, equipment, or loot.
Item effects:
· ♣ strength potion: refresh all equipment.
· ♠ cloak of deception: change the rank or suit of 1 equipment.
· ♥ healing potion: discard 1 wound, or cancel a curse.
· ♦ lucky crystal: redraw a card you just drew.
Whenever you draw an Ace, immediately suffer the curse of the current map, then draw a replacement.
Scoring: 2 points per item, loot scores its rank; the Forest of the Eternal Midnight scores bounty, and the Sunken Cathedral scores candles.

search.py: wu shi er ge wang guo mao xian

zh.name: 叛逆公主：豪华版
zh.desc: 公主们不想结婚：躲开王子与青蛙，在不断变化的舞会规则中争取最少求婚。
zh.rules:
目标:
游戏进行 3 轮或 5 轮舞会，获得求婚次数最少的玩家获胜。每张王子牌计为 1 次求婚；宠物花色的 8 号牌代表青蛙，计为 5 次求婚。
· 舞会叛逆者：赢得全部王子和青蛙时，本轮计为 −10 次求婚；结婚礼物轮不适用此规则。
准备:
3人移除每色的1、11、12；4至5人移除11、12；6人使用全部48张牌。洗牌均分。每人从两位公主中选一位，能力每轮一次；6人时第六位从前五人的弃选公主中选择。可选扩展与宣传牌须在开局启用，默认为关闭。
流程:
每轮揭示一张轮次牌，其规则优先于通常规则。按牌面箭头同时传牌，所有人提交前不能查看收到的牌。双向传牌先选传左的牌，再选传右的牌。默认推荐顺序为a、b、c、d、e；短局为a、b、e。随机选择时，黑沙漏牌仅放在最后一轮。
每墩领出者出一张牌，其他人顺时针跟出领出牌的花色；没有该花色时可出任意牌。领出花色中点数最高的玩家赢得本墩，收取卡牌后领出下一墩。赢牌在轮末前不得随意翻看。王子尚未混入时，不能领出王子牌，除非手中只有王子；无法跟出领出花色的玩家打出王子牌后，王子才混入。青蛙不算王子，长发公主的强制领出与女巫换入王子都不使王子混入。
公主能力:
在各能力要求的时机使用。墩前从领出者左边开始依次询问，能力声明后重新给其他人使用机会，所有人连续放弃后开始出牌。不能用能力撤销已生效的能力。点击自己的公主可查看完整说明；轮次牌说明列明特殊规则。
· 睡美人：查看贡献牌来源并逐一分配。
· 冰雪公主与山鲁佐德：只随机抽取隐藏的当前手牌。
暂存牌与留出的末墩牌受相应轮次保护。
· 贝儿：只能选择已经公开或本人知道的已出牌，不揭示其他人的暗牌。
交换不改变原领色与原领牌；若交换后没有合格的领色牌，由原领出者赢墩，特殊轮次的明确判定优先。
结算:
按本轮规则计算求婚，每轮恢复能力并重新洗牌发牌。下一轮由累计求婚最少者领出；求婚次数相同时，从上轮起始玩家的左侧开始，按顺时针顺序确定最先遇到的并列玩家。最终同分时，获得非正分轮次更多者优先；仍同分则所有人追加一张随机黑沙漏轮，直到分出胜者。追加轮可能使原本未并列的玩家获胜。

en.name: Rebel Princess: Deluxe Edition
en.desc: Dodge Princes and the Frog, bend the rules with princess powers, and finish the ball with the fewest proposals.
en.rules:
Goal:
Finish a 3- or 5-round ball with the fewest proposals. Each Prince scores 1 and the Pet 8 (the Frog) scores 5. Capturing every Prince and the Frog scores only −10 for the round: Rebel of the Ball. This bonus is unavailable in Wedding Gift.
Setup:
With 3 players remove 1, 11 and 12 from every suit; with 4–5 remove 11 and 12; with 6 use all 48 cards. Shuffle and deal equally. Choose one of two princesses; each power is available once per round. With 6 players, the sixth chooses from the first five players’ rejected princesses. Optional expansion and promos are off by default.
Play:
Reveal one round card at a time; its rule overrides normal play. Simultaneously pass as its arrows indicate. Received cards stay hidden until everyone commits. When passing both ways, select the leftward cards first, then the rightward cards. Recommended rounds are a, b, c, d, e, or a, b, e for a short game. Random selection places black-hourglass cards only in the final round.
The leader plays a card and others follow clockwise. Follow the led suit if possible; otherwise play any suit. The highest card in the led suit wins and leads next. Captured cards cannot be freely inspected before scoring. Princes cannot be led until a void player plays a Prince, unless the leader holds only Princes. The Frog is not a Prince. Rapunzel’s forced lead and Haggle trades do not break Princes.
Princess powers:
Use each power at its stated time. Pre-trick offers begin left of the leader and proceed clockwise. A declaration reopens offers; a full cycle of passes begins play. Powers cannot cancel existing constraints. Select your princess for details; the round card explains its special rule.
· Sleeping Beauty sees each contribution’s source and assigns cards one by one.
· The Ice Princess and Scheherazade draw only hidden active hand cards.
Set-aside and reserved cards have their round-specific protection.
· Beauty can select previously public cards or your own known plays, without revealing another player’s hidden cards.
Exchanges preserve the original led suit and card. If no eligible led-suit cards remain, the original leader wins; explicit special-round rules take precedence.
Scoring:
Apply the round’s scoring, refresh powers, shuffle and deal again. The lowest cumulative score leads next; ties are resolved clockwise starting left of the previous round’s leader. Final ties favor the most rounds with a non-positive score. If still tied, everyone plays another random black-hourglass round until one winner remains. Someone outside the original tie can win.

search.py: pan ni gong zhu hao hua ban

zh.name: 重筑家园
zh.desc: 重建苏格兰与爱尔兰，发展农场、争夺城堡并完成使命
zh.rules:
目标：通过重建家园获得最高总分。
准备：
· 可选择苏格兰或爱尔兰地图，采用官方 1.2b 规则。
· 每人有能源农场和粮食农场各 12 块，影响力为 1、2、3、4 的聚落板块各 3 块。
· 4 人局每人移除能源农场和粮食农场各 3 块。
· 4 人局每人另移除影响力为 2、3、4 的聚落板块各 1 块。
· 将自己的板块洗混。苏格兰随机留出 2 块，本局不使用。
· 爱尔兰随机留出 4 块，供圆塔奖励使用。可以随时查看自己留出的板块种类。
· 每人提前抽取 1 块作为手牌。从首位玩家开始，顺时针行动。
· 2 人局封锁地图上标记的区域：苏格兰 32 格，爱尔兰 24 格。封锁格不参与游戏。
放置：
· 每回合将手牌放在一个未被占用的合法格上，结算后抽取下回合的 1 块手牌。
· 能源农场放在能源或空白农场格；粮食农场放在粮食或空白农场格。
· 聚落板块只能放在聚落格。城堡、教堂、圆塔格不能放置板块。
· 对应类型的农场格和空白农场格均已被占用时，才允许改放到另一类型的农场格。
得分：
· 同一玩家、同一类型且相连的农场构成农场群。不同类型或不同玩家的农场不能连成同一群。
· 每次放置农场板块，立即获得放置后所在农场群的板块数量分数。
· 单格小型聚落立即获得所放板块的影响力分数。
· 多格聚落填满时，按各玩家在其中的影响力总和排名。
· 中型聚落奖励为 5、3 分；大型聚落为 8、5 分，其余玩家不得分。
· 爱尔兰的四格扩展聚落奖励为 12、8、5 分，其余玩家不得分。
· 聚落影响力相同时，完成该聚落的玩家排在并列玩家之后。
· 其他并列玩家从完成者的下一位开始，按顺时针优先。未分配的奖励归第一名。
· 放置在苏格兰港口格或爱尔兰离岸农场格，额外获得 1 分。
· 每座城堡由占用相邻格最多的玩家控制。相同时，比较相邻农场板块数量。
· 相邻格数和农场数量仍相同时，当前落子者不能夺取城堡。
苏格兰：
· 每位玩家第一次在一座教堂旁放置板块时，获得一张私人任务。每座教堂每人限一次。
· 私人任务在终局计分：达成条件获得 5 分，条件并列最多也视为达成。
· 教堂奖励卡无条件获得 3 分。
爱尔兰：
· 随机公开 8 张公共任务，其余 4 张放在任务牌堆中。每人每张公共任务只能完成一次。
· 首次完成者获得较高分，之后完成者获得较低分。一次放置可以完成多张任务。
· 连接城堡或圆塔的任务，要求用自己的连续板块接触指定数量的建筑。建筑本身不能作为路径。
· 沿海任务要求占用连续的沿海格。
· 每位玩家首次占用圆塔相邻格时，触发该塔奖励。同一圆塔每人只能触发一次。
· 两座奖励圆塔各提供 3 分；到访全部三座同类圆塔获得 13 分。
· 额外放置圆塔：从留出的板块中随机抽取 1 块并立即放置，正常结算。
· 每回合最多触发一次额外放置。额外板块触及另一座此类圆塔时，忽略该塔奖励。
· 抽取三块圆塔：回合结束时，从供应中抽取最多 3 块。
· 下回合选择其中 1 块放置，然后将其余板块洗回供应。
· 私人任务圆塔：从剩余任务牌堆抽取 1 张私人任务。
· 私人任务在终局达成时获得牌面较高分；抽取前已经达成也可计分。
· 翻倍圆塔：到访两座此类圆塔后，将翻倍标记放在一张自己尚未完成的公共任务上。
· 之后完成该任务时，实际获得的高分或低分均翻倍。
终局：
· 所有玩家用完手牌与供应后游戏结束。未完成聚落中的板块各按影响力计分。
· 每座控制的城堡获得 5 分。公开并结算私人任务。
· 苏格兰最高分并列时，优先由并列玩家中控制爱丁堡城堡者获胜。
· 若无人符合，则控制斯特灵城堡的玩家获胜，即使其并非最高分。
· 斯特灵城堡也无人控制时，最高分玩家共享胜利。
· 爱尔兰最高分并列时，优先由并列玩家中控制布拉尼城堡者获胜。
· 若无人符合，则所有玩家中占用塔拉山圆塔相邻格最多者获胜，即使其并非最高分。
· 塔拉山仍并列时，共享胜利。

en.name: Rebirth
en.desc: Restore Scotland and Ireland with farms, castles and missions
en.rules:
Goal: rebuild the land and earn the most points.
Setup:
· Choose Scotland or Ireland. Both maps follow official rulebook 1.2b.
· Each player has 12 Energy Farms, 12 Food Farms and 3 Settlement Tiles of each Influence value from 1 to 4.
· With 4 players, each player removes 3 of each farm type.
· With 4 players, each player also removes 1 Settlement Tile of each value 2, 3 and 4.
· Shuffle your tiles. In Scotland, set aside 2 at random; these are not used.
· In Ireland, set aside 4 at random for tower bonuses. You may inspect the types of your set-aside tiles at any time.
· Each player draws 1 tile into their hand. The first seat starts; play proceeds clockwise.
· With 2 players, the marked spaces are blocked: 32 in Scotland, 24 in Ireland. Blocked spaces do not take part.
Placement:
· Place your hand tile on an unoccupied legal space, score it, then draw 1 tile for your next turn.
· Energy Farms go on Energy or blank farm spaces; Food Farms go on Food or blank farm spaces.
· Settlements go only on Settlement spaces. Castles, Cathedrals and Towers cannot be occupied.
· Only when all matching farm spaces and blank farm spaces are occupied may you use a space of the other farm type.
Scoring:
· Connected farms of the same type and player form a cluster. Different types or players never share a cluster.
· Each farm placement scores the size of its resulting cluster.
· A Small Settlement scores its tile’s Influence immediately.
· A larger Settlement scores once full, ranking players by total Influence within it.
· Medium Settlements award 5 and 3 points; Large Settlements award 8 and 5. Other players score nothing.
· Ireland’s four-space Sprawling Settlements award 12, 8 and 5 points. Other players score nothing.
· Influence ties put the player completing the Settlement last among tied players.
· Other ties favor clockwise order starting after the completing player. Any unassigned prizes go to first place.
· Placing on a Scottish Port or Irish Offshore Farm scores 1 extra point.
· A Castle is controlled by the player with the most adjacent occupied spaces. Ties favor more adjacent farm tiles.
· If both counts remain equal, the active player cannot take control.
Scotland:
· Your first placement beside each Cathedral earns a Private Mission, once per player per Cathedral.
· Private Missions score 5 points at game end if fulfilled; ties for most also qualify.
· Cathedral Bonus cards award 3 points unconditionally.
Ireland:
· Reveal 8 Public Missions, leaving 4 in the deck. Each player can complete each Public Mission once.
· The first player earns the higher score; later players earn the lower score. One placement may complete several missions.
· Linking missions require your connected tiles to touch the required number of Castles or Towers. Buildings cannot be part of the path.
· Coastal missions require consecutive coastal spaces.
· Your first placement beside each Tower activates its bonus, once per player per tower.
· Two towers award 3 points each; visiting all three matching towers awards 13 points.
· Extra placement: randomly draw one set-aside tile and place it immediately, scoring normally.
· Extra placement can activate only once per turn. An extra tile touching another such tower ignores that bonus.
· Draw three: draw up to 3 supply tiles at turn end.
· On your next turn, place one, then shuffle the rest back into your supply.
· Private Mission: draw one remaining mission card privately.
· It scores its higher value at game end if fulfilled, including a condition met before drawing it.
· Doubling: after visiting both matching towers, mark one Public Mission you have not completed.
· When you later complete it, double the actual higher or lower award.
End:
· End when all hands and supplies are exhausted. Tiles in incomplete Settlements score their Influence.
· Each controlled Castle scores 5 points. Reveal and score Private Missions.
· In a Scottish top-score tie, a tied player controlling Edinburgh Castle wins.
· Otherwise, Stirling Castle’s controller wins even if outside the top-score tie.
· If Stirling is uncontrolled too, the top scorers share victory.
· In an Irish top-score tie, a tied player controlling Blarney Castle wins.
· Otherwise, whoever occupies the most spaces beside the Hill of Tara wins, even if outside the top-score tie.
· Further ties at Tara share victory.

zh.name: 弑君者
zh.desc: 合作讨伐:全队接力挑战 12 位 J/Q/K 君王,扑克牌就是武器
zh.rules:
目标:全队合作,依次击败城堡中的 12 位君王(4 张 J、4 张 Q、4 张 K);击败最后的 K 即全员获胜。
牌的点数：A 为 1 点，2 至 10 按牌面数字计算，J 为 10 点，Q 为 15 点，K 为 20 点。
敌人的生命值：J 为 20 点，Q 为 30 点，K 为 40 点。
流程(轮到你):
· 打出一张牌进行攻击；也可以打出多张点数相同的牌，但点数合计不能超过 10 点，或将一张 A 与任意另一张牌一同打出。
· 敌人未被击败时，会发动反击。你须弃置点数合计不低于敌人攻击力的手牌；无法满足要求时，全队立即落败。
· 也可以放弃攻击,直接承受反击。
花色能力(按打出牌的面值生效):
· ♣ 本次攻击伤害翻倍。
· ♥ 从弃牌堆中随机取出与本次打出的红桃牌点数合计相同数量的卡牌，将其洗入牌库；弃牌不足时，使用全部弃牌。
· ♦ 从当前玩家开始，全队按顺序轮流各抽一张牌，抽取的总张数等于本次打出的方块牌点数合计。手牌已达到上限的玩家跳过；牌库为空或全队手牌均已满时，停止抽牌。
· ♠ 永久降低当前敌人的攻击力。
特殊规则:
· 敌人免疫自己的花色:该花色的牌只算伤害,不发动能力。
· 小丑只能单独打出:解除当前敌人的免疫、跳过本次反击,并指定下一位行动者。
· 伤害恰好等于敌人剩余生命时,敌人放回牌库顶,之后可被抽成手牌;否则进弃牌堆。
· 手牌上限：2 人游戏中每人最多持有 7 张手牌，3 人时为 6 张，4 人时为 5 张。
· 小丑数量：3 人游戏使用 1 张，4 人游戏使用 2 张。

en.name: Regicide
en.desc: Co-op card battle: take down 12 royal J/Q/K together
en.rules:
Goal: work together to defeat the 12 royals in the castle (4 Jacks, 4 Queens, 4 Kings); defeating the final King wins the game for everyone.
Card values: An Ace is worth 1 point; cards numbered 2–10 use their printed number. A Jack is worth 10 points, a Queen 15 points, and a King 20 points.
Enemy health: A Jack has 20 health, a Queen 30 health, and a King 40 health.
On your turn:
· Play one card to attack; you may also play several cards of the same rank (total ≤ 10), or an Ace together with any one card.
· If the enemy survives, it strikes back: discard cards totaling at least its attack; if you cannot, everyone loses.
· You may also yield and take the counterattack without attacking.
Suit powers (scaled by the values played):
· ♣ doubles this attack’s damage.
· ♥: Randomly take a number of cards from the discard pile equal to the total value of Hearts played, then shuffle them into the deck. Use all discards if there are not enough.
· ♦: Starting with the current player, each player draws one card in turn, up to a total number of cards equal to the value of Diamonds played. Skip full hands, and stop if the deck is empty or every hand is full.
· ♠ permanently lowers the current enemy’s attack.
Special rules:
· An enemy is immune to its own suit: cards of that suit deal damage but grant no power.
· A Jester must be played alone: it breaks the current enemy’s immunity, skips the counterattack, and lets you choose who acts next.
· Damage exactly equal to the enemy’s remaining health is a perfect kill: the royal goes on top of the deck and can later be drawn as a hand card; otherwise it is discarded.
· Hand limit: 7 cards with 2 players, 6 with 3, 5 with 4. Jesters: 1 with 3 players, 2 with 4.

zh.name: 弑君者:传承
zh.desc: 12 任务合作传承战役:队伍随战役成长,腐蚀、佣兵与神器改变每一局
zh.rules:
目标:全队合作击败本任务的全部敌人;任一玩家承受不住伤害则全员落败。
回合流程(轮到你):
轮到你时，可以选择攻击，也可以放弃攻击，直接承受敌人的反击。攻击时，选择以下一种出牌方式：
· 打出一张牌。
· 打出点数相同的卡牌组合，点数合计不超过10。
· 打出一张动物或野兽牌，并搭配一张搭档牌。
花色能力：
· 牧师：将弃牌堆洗混后，取出与本次攻击强度相同数量的牌，放到牌库底部。
· 吟游诗人：从当前玩家开始，全队按顺序轮流补牌。
· 战士：本次造成的伤害翻倍。
· 圣骑士：永久降低当前敌人的攻击力。
敌人反击与免疫：
· 敌人未被击败时，会发动反击：弃置点数合计不低于其攻击力的手牌来承受伤害;一次性弃置自己的全部手牌可「假死」,抵挡任意数值的伤害。
· 敌人免疫自身花色:该花色只算伤害不发动能力;小丑打出后由任意玩家认领,认领者的攻击无视免疫。
战役演化:
· 腐蚀卡:打出时先放逐牌库顶部的 1 张卡牌,无视同色免疫。
· 法师：翻开卡牌并选择卡牌垫入；垫入法师时，继续翻牌并处理连锁效果。
· 守护者：打出后，本回合格挡全部伤害。
· 德鲁伊：重新分配弃牌堆中的卡牌。
· 吟唱者：从牌库中自由选择卡牌补入手牌。
· 任务失败后，队伍获得金币，可以在下次尝试前用于招募佣兵。完成任务后，解锁新的职业、神器与卡牌。

en.name: Regicide Legacy
en.desc: A 12-mission co-op legacy campaign: your party evolves with corruption, mercenaries and relics
en.rules:
Goal: cooperate to defeat every enemy of the mission; if any player cannot suffer the damage, the whole party falls.
On your turn:
On your turn, attack or yield and take the enemy’s counterattack. If you attack, choose one way to play cards:
· Play one card.
· Play cards of the same value with a total value of no more than 10.
· Play an Animal or Beast card together with one partner card.
Suit abilities:
· The Cleric shuffles the discard pile, then places a number of those cards equal to this attack’s ability strength under the deck.
· The Bard refills hands around the table.
· The Warrior doubles the damage.
· The Paladin permanently reduces the enemy’s attack.
Enemy counterattack and immunity:
· If the enemy survives, it counterattacks. Discard cards whose total value is at least its attack; discarding your entire hand for Feign Death covers any amount.
· Enemies are immune to their own suit: that suit only deals damage; a claimed Jester attack ignores immunity.
Campaign twists:
· Corrupted cards banish the top of the deck when played and ignore immunity.
· Mages reveal cards and let you choose a card to tuck. Tucking a Mage continues the reveal and its chain effect.
· Guardians block all damage that turn.
· Druids redistribute the discard.
· Chanters let you choose cards from the deck to add to your hand.
· Losing earns gold to hire mercenaries for the next attempt; winning missions unlocks new suits, relics and cards.

zh.name: 黑色左轮
zh.desc: 藏进大宅,听音辨位,先中两枪者出局
zh.rules:
目标:率先命中对手两枪的人获胜。
准备:
· 两人各自秘密挑选一个房间作为起始位置。
· 八间房的移动路线、射击范围与房间效果各不相同。点击房间可以查看对应说明。
流程:轮流行动,每回合默认 2 点行动力。
· 从厨房开始回合的人有 3 点行动力。
· 移动（1 点行动力）：进入一间相邻房间，目的地对对手保密。
· 射击（2 点行动力）：向射程内的一间房间开枪。射击会暴露你的位置，之后必须免费移动一步。
· 听音（1 点行动力）：对手须公开一间其当前可以移动到的房间。
· 设置陷阱（1 点行动力）：在当前房间布置陷阱，最多同时持有两枚陷阱。可以花费 1 点行动力，引爆已经布置的陷阱，炸伤引爆时位于该房间中的人。
房间效果：发动房间效果会暴露你的位置。
· 门厅回声：免费执行听音，并要求位于二楼的对手报告确切位置。
· 卧室放水：淹没地下室，使其中的人受到伤害并离开；直到你的下个回合，地下室均无法进入。
· 书房暗门：将厨房中的人移入地下室。
· 地下室控制面板：在任意其他房间布置自动陷阱，在你的下回合开始时自动引爆。
· 阳台：可以免费翻越栏杆，直接进入厨房。
结束:
· 任意一方累计中枪两次,另一方立即获胜。

en.name: Revolver Noir
en.desc: Hide in the mansion, listen, deduce — two hits and you are out
en.rules:
Goal: the first to land two hits on the opponent wins.
Setup:
· Each player secretly picks a room as their starting position.
· The eight rooms differ in move links, shooting range and effects.
Turns: take turns with 2 action points per turn.
· Starting your turn in the Kitchen grants 3 action points.
· Move (1 point): enter an adjacent room; the destination stays secret.
· Shoot (2 action points): Fire at a room in range. Shooting reveals your position, then you must move one step for free.
· Listen (1 action point): Your opponent must name one room they can currently move to.
· Set a trap (1 action point): Arm a trap in your current room. You may have at most two armed traps. Spend 1 action point to detonate an armed trap, hurting whoever is in that room at the time.
Room effects:
Using a room effect reveals your position.
· Foyer: Listen for free. An opponent upstairs must also name their exact room.
· Bedroom: Flood the Basement, hurting and expelling anyone inside. The Basement remains sealed until your next turn.
· Library: Move anyone in the Kitchen into the Basement.
· Basement: Arm an automatic trap in any other room. It detonates for free at the start of your next turn.
· Balcony: Vault the railing to enter the Kitchen for free.
End:
· As soon as a player has been hit twice, the other player wins.

zh.name: 银河竞逐
zh.desc: 同时暗选五个阶段:探索、开发、殖民、消费、生产,用手牌付款建起你的银河帝国
zh.rules:
目标：建设星际帝国。当任意玩家面前的卡牌达到 12 张，或胜利点（VP）筹码全部用完时，游戏进入终局；总分最高的玩家获胜。
准备：每人随机获得一个起始世界，抽取 6 张手牌，再弃置其中 2 张。
流程(每回合):
· 每人秘密选择一项行动：两种探索行动之一、开发、殖民、贸易与消费、双倍消费或生产。
· 所有人同时公开所选行动。仅执行本回合被选中的阶段，依次按 I 至 V 的顺序进行。所有玩家均执行这些阶段，选择相应行动的玩家额外获得该阶段奖励。
阶段:
· I 探索：抽取 2 张牌，选择其中 1 张保留。选择探索行动的玩家可以改为抽取 7 张、保留 1 张，或抽取 3 张、保留 2 张。
· II 开发：弃置手牌支付费用，打出 1 张发展卡。选择开发行动的玩家少支付 1 张手牌。每名玩家不能拥有两张同名发展卡。
· III 殖民：打出一个世界。非军事世界须通过弃置手牌支付费用；军事世界须以军事值征服，无须支付卡牌。两种方式不能混合使用。
· 选择殖民行动的玩家放置世界后，抽取 1 张牌。风陨世界入场时，自带 1 份货物。
· IV 消费：使用消费能力，将货物兑换为胜利点筹码或手牌。
· 选择贸易行动的玩家，先出售 1 份货物并抽取相应数量的牌：新异品为 2 张，稀有元素为 3 张，基因为 4 张，异星技术为 5 张。
· 选择双倍消费行动的玩家，本阶段获得的胜利点翻倍。
· V 生产：所有生产世界各生产 1 份货物。选择生产行动的玩家，还可以使一个风陨世界额外生产货物。
细则：卡牌能力从打出该牌后的下一阶段起生效。每回合结束时，手牌上限为 10 张。终局总分相同时，比较手牌数量与货物数量之和，合计较多者获胜。
计分：将面前卡牌的牌面分数、持有的胜利点筹码，以及费用为 6 的发展卡所提供的倍数计分相加；同一张卡牌符合多个档位时，只采用得分最高的档位。

en.name: Race for the Galaxy
en.desc: Simultaneously pick phases — Explore, Develop, Settle, Consume, Produce — and pay cards from hand to build your galactic empire
en.rules:
Goal: build the strongest galactic empire. The game ends when anyone has 12+ cards in play or the VP chips run out; highest score wins.
Setup: each player gets a random start world, draws 6 cards and discards 2.
Each round:
· Everyone secretly picks 1 action: Explore (two kinds), Develop, Settle, Trade+Consume, Double Consume, or Produce.
· Only the chosen phases happen, in order I→V; everyone performs them, but choosers get a bonus.
Phases:
· I Explore: Draw 2 cards and keep 1. Players who selected Explore instead draw 7 cards and keep 1, or draw 3 cards and keep 2.
· II Develop: Discard hand cards to pay the cost and play 1 development. Players who selected Develop pay 1 fewer card. Each player may have only one copy of each development.
· III Settle: play 1 world — pay cards for non-military worlds, or conquer military worlds with Military power; never both.
· Players who selected Settle draw 1 card after placing a world. A windfall world enters play with 1 good.
· IV Consume: use powers to turn goods into VP chips or cards.
· Players who selected Trade first sell 1 good and draw cards according to its type: 2 cards for Novelty, 3 for Rare Elements, 4 for Genes, or 5 for Alien Technology.
· Players who selected Double Consume double the VP they earn during this phase.
· V Produce: production worlds each gain a good; choosers also produce on one windfall world.
Details: powers only work from the phase AFTER the card enters play; hand limit is 10 at round end; ties break on cards in hand plus goods.
Scoring: printed VP of cards, VP chips, and 6-cost development multipliers (each card scores only its best single category).

zh.name: 旭日战魂录
zh.desc: 结盟、敬神、征战日本诸省，以荣誉与谋略争夺霸权。
zh.rules:
目标：
春、夏、秋三季后总胜利点最高者获胜；同分以荣誉决定，末季盟友同分第一时共同获胜。
能力时序：
多项能力在同一时点发生冲突时，相关玩家中荣誉最高者选择自己的哪项能力先执行或后执行，再依当前荣誉处理其余能力。已经触发的能力即使来源棋子随后离场，仍在原触发位置结算；可选目标以执行时局面为准。
氏族：
选择不同氏族，按初始荣誉决定固定座次。每季获得氏族收入并归还人质；每名人质为俘虏者带来1枚钱币。茶会可两两结盟，政令期间可赠送钱币和浪人。承诺不具约束力，战争期间禁止赠送。
政令：
当前选令者查看政令牌堆顶部的4张政令，选择其中1张执行，再将其余政令按原顺序放回。每季依次执行以下步骤：
· 执行3张政令，然后进行一次敬神。
· 再执行2张政令，然后进行一次敬神。
· 再执行2张政令，然后进行最后一次敬神。
· 进入战争阶段。
· 征募：每座城可以召唤1个己方棋子，选令者及其盟友各可以额外召唤1个棋子；召唤神官时，可以将其派往神社。
· 行军：每个棋子沿陆界或航线移动1步，选令者及盟友可支付3枚钱币在任意省份建造1座城堡。
· 训练：每人购买1张当前季节卡，选令者及盟友支付的费用减少1枚钱币。
· 丰收：所有人获得1枚钱币，选令者及盟友获得己方战力最高的各省奖励。
· 背叛：仅选令者行动，解散联盟并降低1格荣誉，从两名不同对手各替换1个武士或神官。
训练由选令者先行动，其他政令由选令者左侧开始，选令者最后。
敬神：
按神社顺序，战力最高者获得神的恩赐；平手以荣誉决定。神显形扩展中，获胜者再将对应神放入任意合法省，控制权始终取决于该神社当前最高战力。神不占用月氏族的普通棋子名额。
战争：
按本季战省顺序结算。无人占据则跳过，只有一方或两名盟友则最高战力直接获得战省。发生战斗时，各方秘密分配钱币争夺切腹、人质、浪人和诗人优势，全部提交后同时揭示。按切腹→人质→浪人→战斗胜负→诗人→赔款结算。每项出价全为0则无人获得，赢家可放弃。
· 切腹：杀死本省所有己方棋子，每移除1枚棋子，获得1点胜利点并提升1格荣誉。
· 人质：将本省的1个敌方棋子俘虏为人质，并从其所属玩家处夺取最多1点胜利点。不能俘虏大名。
· 浪人：每枚增加1点战力，结算后不消耗。
败者棋子被杀，胜者的盟友存活。
· 诗人：获得本场死亡棋子数量的胜利点。
胜者花费的钱币均分给败者，余数由胜者分配；败者所花钱币弃置。城不能被杀死、俘虏或背叛；神不能被杀死或受特殊效果影响。
终局：
春、夏、秋的战省分别提供1、2、3点胜利点。额外奖励按持有的不同战省种类数计算：
· 3至4种：额外获得10分。
· 5至6种：额外获得20分。
· 7至8种：额外获得30分。
然后结算冬季升级卡。每季结束时，弃置钱币与浪人，将敬神棋子收回预备区；地图上的其他棋子保留。
氏族能力：
· 锦鲤：在战争开始把浪人换为钱币，未花钱币可代替浪人。
· 莲花：可将所选政令宣布为任意政令。
· 龟：己方城具有1点战力，并且可以执行行军。
· 蜻蜓：可以在任意省召唤棋子，也可以将棋子移动到任意省。
· 盆栽：支付费用时，先将所需钱币数量降至最多1枚，再应用其他折扣。
· 狐：在战争开始向每个己方没有战力的省放1个预备武士。
· 日：赢得实际荣誉平手时获得1枚钱币和1点胜利点，并使并列对手各失去最多1枚钱币和1胜利点。
· 月：棋子至少2点战力，但每省最多2个，所有神社合计最多2个。
扩展：
可选大名宝盒、怪物包、王朝入侵和神显形。王朝入侵允许6人并加入日、月氏族与七福神；日、月只能购买七福神，其他氏族不能购买七福神。每局仅使用一套季节牌。点击卡牌和神社可查看完整效果。

en.name: Rising Sun
en.desc: Forge alliances, worship the Kami, and wage war for dominion over Japan.
en.rules:
OBJECTIVE: Play Spring, Summer and Autumn, then score Winter. Highest VP wins, with Honor breaking ties. Allied players tied for first may share victory.
ABILITY TIMING: If simultaneous abilities conflict, the involved player with the highest Honor chooses one of their abilities to resolve first or last. Repeat for the remaining abilities using current Honor. A triggered ability remains pending at its original location even if its source figure later leaves; targets are checked when it resolves.
SEASONS: Receive Clan income and return hostages; captors gain 1 Coin per returned hostage. Negotiate pairs of alliances at the Tea Ceremony. Coins and Ronin can be gifted during Tea and Politics, but never during War. Promises are not binding.
MANDATES: The selector takes one of the top four tiles and returns the rest in order. Each Season follows this sequence:
· Resolve 3 Mandates, then a Kami phase.
· Resolve 2 more Mandates, then another Kami phase.
· Resolve the final 2 Mandates, then the final Kami phase.
· Proceed to War.
· Recruit summons one figure per Stronghold plus one for the selector and ally; Shinto may instead be sent to Shrines when summoned.
· Marshal moves each figure one adjacent Province by land or Shipping Route; the selector and ally may build one Stronghold anywhere for 3 Coins.
· Train lets each player buy one current Season card, with a 1 Coin discount for the selector and ally.
· Harvest gives everyone 1 Coin; the selector and ally also receive rewards for Provinces where they have the most Force.
· Betray lets only the selector replace one Bushi or Shinto from each of two different opponents, ending their alliance and losing one Honor if allied.
Train starts with the selector; other Mandates end with the selector.
KAMI: Resolve Shrines in order. Highest Force gains the Shrine ability; Honor breaks ties. With Kami Unbound, that player then places the Kami in a legal Province. Its controller always follows the current top worshipper. Kami do not use Moon’s ordinary-figure capacity.
WAR: Resolve numbered War Provinces in order. No Force means no winner. One player, or only two allies, awards the token to the highest Force. Otherwise all participants secretly allocate Coins to Seppuku, Take Hostage, Hire Ronin and Imperial Poets. Reveal together, then resolve Seppuku → Hostages → Ronin → Battle → Poets → Reparations. All-zero bids award no advantage; winners may decline. Seppuku kills all your local figures for 1 VP and 1 Honor each. The Take Hostage winner may capture one opposing figure in the Province and steal up to 1 VP from its owner. A Daimyo cannot be taken hostage. Ronin add 1 Force each without being spent. Defeated figures die, except the winner’s ally. Poets score 1 VP per figure killed in the Battle. The winner’s spent Coins are divided among all losers; the winner assigns remainder Coins to distinct losers. Losers discard their bids. Strongholds cannot be killed, taken hostage or betrayed. Kami cannot die or suffer special effects.
WINTER: Spring, Summer and Autumn tokens score 1, 2 and 3 VP. Holding 3–4 / 5–6 / 7–8 distinct Provinces adds 10 / 20 / 30 VP. Resolve Winter Upgrades. Seasonal cleanup discards Coins and Ronin, returns worshippers to reserve and leaves map figures in place.
CLANS:
· Koi converts Ronin into Coins at War start and uses unspent Coins as Ronin.
· Lotus may declare any Mandate.
· Turtle Strongholds have 1 Force and can move.
· Dragonfly summons and moves to any Province.
· Bonsai caps costs at 1 Coin before discounts.
· Fox places a reserve Bushi in each Province with no friendly Force at War start.
· Sun gains 1 Coin and 1 VP when winning a real Honor tie, while tied rivals each lose up to 1 Coin and 1 VP.
· Moon figures have at least 2 Force, but at most two may occupy a Province or all Shrines combined.
EXPANSIONS: Daimyo Box, Monster Pack, Dynasty Invasion and Kami Unbound are optional. Dynasty Invasion enables six players and Sun/Moon with Lucky Gods. Sun/Moon can only buy Lucky Gods as Monsters; other Clans cannot buy Lucky Gods. Choose one Season-card set per game. Inspect cards and Shrines for complete effects.

zh.name: 卡坦岛：对决
zh.desc: 双人卡牌卡坦：经营领地、争夺力量与贸易优势，体验三个时代与王侯对决。
zh.rules:
目标：
通过村庄、城市、扩展牌和力量／贸易优势获得胜利点。入门模式在自己回合结束时达到 7 分获胜；单个主题在自己的回合任意时刻达到 12 分获胜；王侯对决的目标为 13 分。优势标记各值 1 分，必须至少有 3 点且高于对手才能取得；持有者平手时保留。

准备：
每人有 2 座村庄、1 条道路及六类地区。非黄金地区起始各存放 1 份资源，黄金为 0，每个地区最多存放 3 份资源。入门使用基础 36 张手牌，分为 4 堆，每人从不同一堆顶抽 3 张。主题与对决使用 3 堆基础牌；每人从一个基础堆选择 3 张，并可重新排列起始地区。主题加入所选时代的全部内容；对决加入三个主题但移除半月手牌，事件使用全部 6 张无半月牌和随机 6 张半月牌。

回合流程：
掷骰前可使用指定骰面的行动牌。然后掷生产骰与事件骰。强盗来袭先检查库存：不受仓库保护、且不在黄金储藏所中的资源超过 7 时，失去所有地区中的羊毛与黄金；仓库只影响计数，不保护这些资源不被夺走。之后进行生产。其他骰面先生产再结算事件。生产骰对应的每个地区获得1份资源，相邻对应生产建筑使正常产出加倍。库存满时溢出的资源丢失。
· 贸易：由贸易优势持有者拿取对手的1份资源；放贷人可将此数量增加至 2 份资源。
· 庆典：技能较高的玩家获得任意1份资源；技能相同时，双方各获得任意1份资源。
· 丰收：双方各获得任意1份资源。此外，每座收费桥提供2份黄金，每艘海盗船提供1份黄金。
事件牌逐张结算；抽到圣诞节时重建牌堆，在底部 3 张之上放置圣诞节，再抽一次。

行动阶段：
可按任意顺序反复建造、交易、使用合法行动牌，主题与对决还可免费拆除建筑或单位。村庄上下各有 1 个扩展位置，城市上下各有 2 个。红色城市扩展只可放在城市。新村庄须沿道路向外延伸，并获得 2 个库存为 0 的地区。建造费用如下：
· 道路：支付 2 份砖块和 1 份木材。
· 村庄：支付木材、砖块、羊毛、谷物各 1 份。
· 城市：支付 3 份矿石和 2 份谷物。
牌面费用、图标及条件另行适用，减少费用时自行选择资源。
通常可以支付3份同类资源，兑换任意1份其他资源；拥有对应商船时，兑换比例改为2比1。大型商船只能使用其左侧或右侧相邻的单个地区支付2份资源。每座铸币厂在自己的每个回合中可以使用一次，以1份黄金兑换1份其他资源。支付、存放或拿取资源时，由玩家选择具体地区。

补牌与换牌：
行动结束后，将手牌数量调整至“3加进步点数”张。超过此上限时，选择多余的手牌，放回牌背匹配的抽牌堆底部；不足此上限时，自行选择抽牌堆，逐张抽牌补足。然后可以换 1 张手牌：随机抽牌免费；搜索指定卡牌需要支付任意2份资源；拥有教区会堂时，费用减为1份资源，有市政厅时免费。搜索卡牌或选择起始手牌时，都不能改变抽牌堆中卡牌的顺序。空堆的位置保留，仍可放回匹配牌背的卡牌。最后结束回合。

主题与事件：
黄金时代发展商船、海盗及贸易；动乱时代加入攻击、防御与暴乱；进步时代发展大学、图书馆、浴场及进步行动。单主题的商人公会、篱边酒馆或大学从公开供给建造，不进入手牌；对决把未带半月的相应牌放入主题抽牌堆。名称带唯一标记的建筑每人最多 1 座。英雄不可重复，首席炮手不属于英雄。
兄弟阋墙仅让力量优势持有者查看并退回对手的 2 张手牌。世仇由优势持有者指定对手最多 3 座建筑，对手选择其中 1 座退回。暴乱按有力量或贸易点的单位数量支付1份或2份黄金，或选择退回其中一个单位；对应礼拜堂及塞巴斯蒂安可提供保护。瘟疫使城市相邻地区各失去1份资源，同一地区只损失一次，浴场保护所在城市相邻地区，每座药房仍获得任意1份资源。更多牌面例外见卡牌详情与官方规则书。

en.name: Rivals for Catan
en.desc: Build two rival principalities, compete for strength and trade, and explore three eras and the Duel of the Princes.
en.rules:
Goal:
Earn victory points from settlements, cities, expansions and the strength and trade advantages. In the Introductory Game, win with 7 points at the end of your turn. In a Theme Game, win with 12 points at any time on your turn; in the Duel of the Princes, the target is 13. Each advantage is worth 1 point. Claim it with at least 3 points and more than your opponent; its holder retains it on a tie.

Preparation:
Each player starts with 2 settlements, a road and six different regions. Each region stores 0–3 resources; start with 1 of each except gold, which starts at 0. The Introductory Game has four Basic draw stacks of 9 cards; each player takes the top 3 cards from a different stack. Theme Games and the Duel have three Basic stacks. Choose 3 cards from one Basic stack and optionally rearrange your starting regions. A Theme Game includes all cards of that era. The Duel includes all three eras, removes half-moon hand cards, and uses the six event cards without half moons plus six randomly chosen half-moon events.

Turn sequence:
Before rolling, you may play a card that sets a die. Roll the production and event dice. Resolve Brigand Attack before production: if your counted resources exceed 7, lose all wool and gold in your regions. Storehouses exclude neighboring regions from the count but do not protect the resources from being stolen. Gold Caches are neither counted nor stolen. Otherwise resolve production before the event. Each region matching the production die gains 1 resource; matching adjacent production boosters double normal production. Excess is lost.
· Trade: the trade advantage holder takes 1 resource, or up to 2 with Moneylender.
· Celebration: the player with more skill receives any 1 resource; on a tie both do.
· Plentiful Harvest: both receive any 1 resource, plus 2 gold per Toll Bridge and 1 gold per Pirate Ship.
Resolve event cards in order. When Yule is drawn, reshuffle the event deck, place Yule above the bottom 3 cards and draw again.

Actions:
Build, trade and play legal action cards in any order and as often as desired. In Theme Games and the Duel, buildings and units may be removed for free. A settlement has one expansion site above and below it; a city has two above and below. Red city expansions require a city. Extend outward along a road to build a settlement, which receives two new regions with no resources. Roads cost 2 brick and 1 lumber; settlements cost 1 each of brick, grain, wool and lumber; cities cost 3 ore and 2 grain. Card costs, requirements and symbols also apply. Choose the resource saved by a discount.
Normally trade 3 of one resource for any 1 other resource. The matching trade ship allows 2:1. A Large Trade Ship uses 2 resources from one neighboring region on either side. Each Mint can trade 1 gold for 1 other resource once on each of your turns. Players choose the exact regions used to pay, store or take resources.

Replenish and exchange:
After actions, replenish to 3 cards plus progress points. Return excess cards to the bottom of a matching draw stack; otherwise draw one at a time from chosen stacks. You may then exchange 1 hand card: a random replacement is free, while searching costs any 2 resources, reduced to 1 with Parish Hall or 0 with Town Hall. Searches and starting choices never rearrange a stack. Empty stack positions remain available for returning matching cards. End your turn afterwards.

Themes and events:
Gold develops ships, pirates and trade; Turmoil adds attacks, defenses and Riots; Progress develops universities, libraries, baths and progress actions. A single Theme Game has a face-up supply of Merchant Guilds, Hedge Taverns or Universities; these never enter your hand. In the Duel, their non-half-moon copies enter the draw stacks. Unique buildings are limited to one per player. Heroes cannot be duplicated; Chief Cannoneer is not a hero.
For Fraternal Feuds, the strength advantage holder inspects the opponent’s hand and returns 2 cards. For Feud, that player nominates up to 3 opposing buildings; the opponent returns one. Riots costs 1 or 2 gold according to the number of units with strength or commerce, or one such unit must be returned. A matching Chapel or Sebastian may protect you. Plague removes 1 resource from each region bordering a city, at most once per region. Bath Houses protect neighboring regions; each Pharmacy still grants any 1 resource. See card details and the official rulebook for further exceptions.

zh.name: 茂林源记
zh.desc: 八大阵营以各自的方式争夺森林，支持本体、河岸和地底扩展。
zh.rules:
目标：
· 率先达到 30 分立即获胜；移除敌方建筑或标记各得一分。
· 至少 10 分时，可在白天启用支配牌，改用其胜利条件。
准备：
· 选择地图与阵营，按提示摆放起始棋件，每人取得三张手牌。
· 支持本体、河岸扩展和地底扩展，以及九种游侠角色。
回合：
· 依次进行清晨、白天、夜晚，按阵营板执行各自流程。
· 鸟牌通常可代替其他花色；蜥蜴仪式不适用此替代。
移动与控制：
· 士兵与建筑最多的阵营控制领地；飞鹰赢得非零平手。
· 庭院强制控制领地。一般移动须控制起点或终点。
· 沿道路移动；游侠、阴谋羽党、小舟与商会有特殊移动规则。
战斗与锻造：
· 防守方可打出匹配奇袭，进攻方可用匹配奇袭反制。
· 投掷两颗骰子，进攻方使用较高点数，防守方使用较低点数；森林联盟作为防守方时，改由森林联盟使用较高点数。
· 掷骰伤害不超过参战士兵或未损坏的剑数量。
· 双方同时受伤，先移除士兵，再自行选择建筑与标记。
· 激活匹配花色的锻造棋件支付费用，每件每回合使用一次。
· 道具数量有限；不能重复锻造同名持续效果。
猫咪贵族与飞鹰王朝：
· 猫咪先生产木材，在白天锻造后执行三次行动；还可以支付鸟牌，获得额外行动。
· 行军行动最多允许移动两次。招募行动每回合只能执行一次。建造时，所使用的木材必须通过己方控制的领地连通。
· 失去士兵后，可支付匹配牌将其放回仍在场的城堡。
· 飞鹰王朝在清晨向法令中增加卡牌。白天先进行锻造，再依次履行法令中的招募、移动、战斗和建造要求。
· 无法履行法令时，发生动乱：按法令中的鸟牌数量扣除分数，弃置法令中的卡牌，并更换领袖。
森林联盟与蜥蜴神教：
· 联盟花费支持者传播民意或起义，训练长官以执行夜晚行动。
· 他人移除民意或移动士兵进入民意领地时，必须平息民愤。
· 没有基地时，支持者上限为五张。失去基地时，还会失去对应花色的支持者和半数长官。
· 蜥蜴用揭示的手牌建造、招募、献祭，用弃牌仪式得分。
· 遭弃者由遭弃者牌堆决定；仆从可发动圣战、转化或净化。
河岸商会与鼹鼠地国：
· 清晨可用待命士兵购买商会手牌、小舟与佣兵服务。
· 商会调用资金执行行动，花费资金招募、建立贸易站。
· 鼹鼠地国在白天先执行两次议会前行动，随后使用大臣的能力，并可以说服一名新大臣。
· 在夜晚收回本回合揭示的卡牌，但鸟牌须弃置。失去建筑时，须结算“失败的代价”。
阴谋羽党与神秘游侠：
· 阴谋羽党锻造、翻开阴谋、招募后执行三次行动；可以通过竭力额外执行一次行动。
· 对手可出示匹配手牌猜测暗阴谋，猜错须交出该牌。
· 游侠重整道具并潜行，以耗竭道具支付移动、协助、任务等行动。
· 游侠受伤时损坏道具；在树林中休息可修复受损道具，夜晚检查背包容量。
· 两名游侠共享任务与遗迹，各自管理道具和关系。
地图：
· 冬季地图中，河流会分隔树林。湖泊地图中，沿岸领地经湖相连；每回合可以使用一次渡轮，并抽取卡牌。
· 山地地图中，在白天可以弃置一张任意花色的牌来清理一条道路，获得一分；在夜晚结束时控制山口的玩家获得一分。

en.name: Root
en.desc: Eight asymmetric factions with the base game, Riverfolk and Underworld expansions.
en.rules:
Goal:
· Reach 30 points to win immediately. Removing enemy buildings or tokens scores one each.
· At 10 points, activate dominance in Daylight to change your victory condition.
Setup:
· Choose map and factions, place starting pieces, and draw three cards each.
· Includes the base game, Riverfolk, Underworld, and nine Vagabond characters.
Turns:
· Resolve Birdsong, Daylight, and Evening following your faction board.
· Birds are usually wild, except for Cult rituals.
Movement and rule:
· The faction with the most warriors and buildings in a clearing rules it. The Eyrie wins ties when the total is greater than zero.
· Gardens force rule. Normal moves require rule at origin or destination.
· Move along paths; Vagabond, Corvids, Riverboats, and Riverfolk have exceptions.
Battle and crafting:
· Defender may ambush; attacker may foil with a matching ambush.
· Roll two dice. The attacker uses the higher result and the defender uses the lower result. When the Alliance defends, it uses the higher result instead.
· Rolled hits are limited by warriors or undamaged swords.
· Take hits simultaneously, warriors first, then choose buildings and tokens.
· Activate matching crafting pieces; each can be used once per turn.
· Items are limited. Identical persistent effects cannot be crafted twice.
Marquise and Eyrie:
· Cats produce wood, craft, then take three actions. Spend birds for extra actions.
· A March action allows up to two moves. You may Recruit only once per turn. When Building, use wood connected through clearings you rule.
· Spend a matching card to return removed warriors to a surviving Keep.
· The Eyrie adds cards to its Decree in Birdsong. In Daylight, craft first, then fulfill the Decree in Recruit, Move, Battle and Build order.
· Failing to fulfill the Decree causes Turmoil: lose points for the bird cards in the Decree, discard the Decree cards and replace the leader.
Alliance and Cult:
· Spend supporters to spread sympathy or revolt. Train officers for Evening operations.
· Enemies removing sympathy or moving warriors into sympathy must pay Outrage.
· Without bases, keep five supporters. Losing a base loses matching supporters and half officers.
· Cult reveals cards to build, recruit, or sacrifice, and spends cards to score.
· Lost Souls determines Outcast; acolytes crusade, convert, or sanctify.
Riverfolk and Duchy:
· Buy Riverfolk cards, Riverboats, or Mercenaries with supply warriors in Birdsong.
· Riverfolk commits funds for actions, and spends funds to recruit or establish trade posts.
· Duchy takes two Assembly actions, uses Parliament, and may sway one minister.
· Revealed cards return in Evening; birds are discarded. Lost buildings trigger Price of Failure.
Corvids and Vagabond:
· Corvids craft, flip plots, recruit, and take three actions; Exert adds one without drawing.
· Enemies may show matching cards to guess hidden plots; wrong guesses surrender the card.
· Vagabond refreshes items and slips, then exhausts items to move, aid, quest, and act.
· Hits damage items. Forest rest repairs damaged items; check satchel capacity in Evening.
· Two Vagabonds share quests and ruins, but keep separate items and relationships.
Maps:
· On the Winter map, rivers divide forests. On the Lake map, coastal clearings connect across the lake. You may use the Ferry once per turn and draw cards.
· On the Mountain map, discard any card in Daylight to clear a path and score one point. The player ruling the Pass at the end of Evening scores one point.

zh.name: 交运之星
zh.desc: 竞拍铁路公司、组建集团、炒股分红,18XX 血统的纯金融卡牌游戏
zh.rules:
目标：游戏结束时，总资产最高的玩家获胜。总资产包括现金、私有公司的面值，以及所持股份按当前股价计算的价值。
准备:每人 30 元(6 人局 25 元);按玩家人数组成公司牌堆(红色公司位于顶部，蓝色公司位于底部，终局卡放在最底部),翻开与玩家人数相同数量的公司牌，组成待拍区。
每回合 9 个阶段:
· 1 投资:轮流行动——发起拍卖(公开竞价,起拍价不低于面值)、买入或卖出股票,或放弃行动。所有玩家连续放弃行动后，本阶段结束。
· 买入股票时，按下一张可用的更高股价卡所标示的价格支付现金；卖出股票时，按下一张可用的更低股价卡所标示的价格获得现金。
· 你持有的股份数量严格超过现任总裁时，立即成为新的总裁。银行持有某集团全部已发行股份时，该集团进入托管状态。
· 2 收尾：按持有的现金重新确定玩家顺序。外商每回合获得5元收入，再按面值从低到高，依次买入其现金能够支付的最便宜公司。
· 3 收购:集团可用金库现金收购玩家、外商或其他集团的公司,价格须在卡面区间内。
· 外商只按卡面最高价格出售公司。股价更高的集团可以介入收购；外商贸易集团始终拥有最高优先权，并按公司面值支付。
· 4 关闭公司：可以关闭亏损的公司。如果下一阶段的总收入为负，且现有现金不足以支付亏损，就必须继续关闭公司，直到现金足以支付为止。
· 5 收入:玩家与集团结算(公司收入减去持有成本;集团另加协同与能力加成)。
· 6 分红：按股价从高到低结算。总裁决定每股分红金额，上限为股价除以3并向下取整。
· 再按星数(公司星 + 现金除以 10 向下取整)对比股价卡要求调整股价。
· 将星数与股价卡的要求比较：多2颗星时，股价上升两格；多1颗星时，上升一格；少1颗星时，下降一格；少2颗星时，下降两格。股价降至0时，集团破产。
· 7 终局检查：有集团持有75元股价卡，或终局卡已经翻面时，游戏结束。否则，如果已没有可购买的公司，将终局卡翻面。
· 8 增发:按股价降序,各集团可增发一股给银行换取现金(股价下移一格)。
· 9 IPO:按面值降序,私有公司可组建集团——选一张可用执照和该颜色区间内的初始股价。
· 股价低于面值获得 2 股,否则获得 1 股并补差价,银行配等量股并把股款付入金库。
集团能力:
· 普鲁士铁路：每家公司的收入增加1元。
· 多普勒：收入最高的公司，其收入翻倍。
· 协同：每有2个协同标记，收入增加1元。
· 老爷车：总持有成本减少10元。
· 股票大师：增发股份时，股价不变。
· 外商贸易：从外商购买公司时，支付公司面值，并拥有最高优先权。
· 废品回收：关闭公司时获得的收入翻倍。
· 星星公司：星数增加2。

en.name: Rolling Stock Stars
en.desc: Auction railroads, form corporations, trade shares and pay dividends — a pure financial card game in the 18XX family
en.rules:
Goal: when the game ends, the richest player wins — cash + face value of private companies + shares × share price.
Setup: each player gets 30 (25 in a 6-player game); the company deck is built by player count (red on top, blue at the bottom, end card at the very bottom); reveal as many companies as players as the offering.
Each turn has 9 phases:
· 1 Investment: take turns starting auctions (open bidding, opening bid at least face value), buying or selling shares, or passing; the phase ends when everyone passes in a row.
· Buying pays the next higher available price card; selling receives the next lower one.
· Owning strictly more shares than the president takes over the presidency; if the bank holds all issued shares, the corporation goes into receivership.
· 2 Wrap-up: player order is re-sorted by cash; the foreign investor (+5 income per turn) buys the cheapest companies it can afford, in ascending face value.
· 3 Acquisition: corporations may spend treasury cash to buy companies from players, the foreign investor, or other corporations, at a price within the printed span.
· The foreign investor only sells at the maximum price; corporations with a higher share price may intervene (Overseas Trading always has priority and pays face value).
· 4 Closing: companies may be closed; if your next income would be negative beyond your cash, you must close until you can pay.
· 5 Income: players and corporations collect (company income minus cost of ownership; corporations add synergy and ability bonuses).
· 6 Dividends: in descending share price order, the president sets a dividend per share (up to one third of the price, rounded down).
· Then the share price adjusts by stars (company stars plus cash divided by 10, rounded down) against the card requirement.
· Compare the corporation’s stars with the requirement on its price card. Having 2 extra stars raises the price by two cards; 1 extra star raises it by one. A shortfall of 1 star lowers it by one card, and a shortfall of 2 lowers it by two. A price of 0 means bankruptcy.
· 7 End check: if a corporation holds the 75 card, or the end card is already flipped, the game ends; otherwise flip the end card once no companies are left to buy.
· 8 Issue shares: in share price order, each corporation may issue one share to the bank for cash (price moves down one card).
· 9 IPO: in descending face value order, private companies may form corporations — pick an unused charter and a starting price in the company color range.
· Below face value you take 2 shares, otherwise 1 share and pay the difference; the bank takes the same number of shares and pays into the treasury.
Corporation abilities:
· Prussian Railway adds 1 income per company.
· Doppler AG doubles the income of its best company.
· Synergistic adds 1 income per 2 synergy markers.
· Vintage Machinery reduces the total cost of ownership by 10.
· Stock Masters issues shares without changing the share price.
· Overseas Trading pays face value to the foreign investor and has top priority.
· Junkyard Scrappers doubles income when closing a company.
· Stars Inc. adds 2 stars.

zh.name: 矮人掘金：20周年纪念版
zh.desc: 暗藏身份，在交错矿道中寻金、设障与争夺宝藏。
zh.rules:
游戏目标：
三轮结束后，拥有最多金币的玩家获胜；金币相同的玩家并列获胜。每轮重新分配秘密身份，金币会保留到下一轮。

基础版准备与身份（3至10人）：
起点与三个暗置目标之间相隔七张牌的宽度。三个目标中，一个藏有黄金，两个只有黑石。将40张路径牌与27张行动牌洗匀；3至5人时每人发6张，6至7人时每人发5张，8至10人时每人发4张。牌库用尽后不再摸牌，也不回收弃牌。
根据人数准备身份牌，洗匀后每人发一张，多余一张暗置：
· 3人使用1名破坏者与3名矿工；4人使用1名破坏者与4名矿工。
· 5人使用2名破坏者与4名矿工；6人使用2名破坏者与5名矿工。
· 7人使用3名破坏者与5名矿工；8人使用3名破坏者与6名矿工。
· 9人使用3名破坏者与7名矿工；10人使用4名破坏者与7名矿工。
矿工争取连通起点与黄金；破坏者争取让大家在找到黄金前耗尽手牌。你可以查看自己的身份和金币，其他人的身份与金币在规定揭示前保持秘密。首轮由首位玩家开始，随后顺时针行动。

每回合的行动：
轮到你时，选择下列一项行动，随后摸一张牌：
· 打出一张路径牌。路径牌必须竖放，可以旋转180度，不能旋转90度。新牌至少有一条通道连通起点，且与所有相邻明牌的通道边缘吻合。矿道可以向任意方向延伸。
· 打出一张行动牌，并完成对应效果。
· 弃置一张手牌，跳过本次出牌。
手牌与牌库都用尽的玩家会被跳过。地图、检视以及选牌窗口内的秘密内容，只会显示给执行者。若同时连通多个暗置目标或宝箱，由当前玩家决定逐一揭示的顺序。揭示后选择能尽量吻合相邻通道的朝向；目标牌在确实无法全部吻合时可以例外。

基础行动牌：
· 破坏工具：将红色工具牌放在另一名玩家面前。同一种工具不能重复破坏。只要矿车、提灯或镐中的任一种损坏，该玩家就不能打出路径牌。
· 修理工具：移除自己或他人面前一张对应的破坏牌。双工具修理牌只能选择其中一种工具修理，不能预先保护工具。
· 落石：移除一张已经铺设的路径牌。不能移除起点、目标或明信片。被移除的路径和落石一起弃置。
· 地图：秘密查看一个暗置目标，然后将其放回原处。

基础版轮末与金币：
连通黄金时，矿工获胜。抽取与本轮矿工人数相同数量的金币牌，由打通黄金的矿工先挑选一张，其余依次向回合方向的反方向传递。若破坏者打通黄金，则从其右侧第一名矿工开始。金币牌共有16张1金币、8张2金币及4张3金币。
若所有手牌耗尽而黄金仍未连通，则破坏者获胜：本轮只有一名破坏者时，其获得4金币；有两名或三名时，各获得3金币；有四名时，各获得2金币。若没有破坏者，则无人获得本轮奖励。若剩余金币牌的面值无法凑成固定奖励，可与已领取的金币牌等值换零；所有人的金币总数不因换零改变。
轮末揭示所有身份。下一轮重新准备身份、矿道和手牌，由上一轮最后出牌者左侧的玩家开始。第三轮结束后比较累计金币。

Saboteur 2 扩展（2至12人）：
将基础版与扩展的全部路径牌和行动牌洗匀，每轮移开顶端10张，每人发6张手牌。每轮使用全部15张身份牌：蓝队矿工与绿队矿工各4张、破坏者3张、地质学家2张、老板与投机者各1张。未发出的身份牌组成备用身份牌堆。
· 蓝队和绿队分别争取黄金。若某队矿工完成连接，且该队存在可通过的完整路径，则只有该队获胜；若该队被异色门挡住，则另一支能够抵达的队伍获胜。若由其他身份完成连接，则所有能够抵达的矿工队伍获胜。
· 蓝门仅允许蓝队通过，绿门仅允许绿队通过。门不妨碍铺设路径，只在轮末判定获胜队伍。老板、投机者和地质学家可以通过所有门。
· 老板随获胜矿工队伍获胜，但所获奖励减少1金币；投机者始终随获胜方获胜，但所获奖励减少2金币。若黄金已连通而两个矿工队都被门挡住，则老板和投机者仍可获胜；若其中只有一人在场，老板获得4金币或投机者获得3金币。若没有连通黄金且没有破坏者，投机者独自获得3金币。
· 每名地质学家按矿道中所有可见水晶的总数获得金币。若有两名地质学家，各获得总数的一半，向下取整。
扩展中的回合还允许弃置1至3张牌并摸取等量牌，或者弃置2张牌以移除自己面前任意一张行动牌，随后只摸1张牌。

扩展路径与行动：
· 桥梁和双弯道上的两条通道彼此独立，不能在交叉处转弯。至少一条通道必须连通起点。
· 梯子与起点及所有其他梯子直接连通。梯子可以邻接任意路径，但不能邻接目标，且仍需吻合相邻通道。
· 盗窃：放在自己面前。轮末分配奖励后，可从一名其他玩家处偷取1金币；该玩家没有金币时无法偷到。最近打出盗窃的玩家先执行，其余按顺时针顺序执行。
· 住手：移除任意玩家面前的一张盗窃牌。
· 陷阱：放在其他玩家面前。被困的玩家不能铺路，轮末不能获得任何奖励，也不能执行盗窃；计算获胜人数时也不包括该玩家。
· 自由：移除任意玩家面前的一张陷阱牌。
· 检视：秘密查看另一名玩家的身份。
· 更换帽子：选择包括自己在内的一名玩家，其取备用身份牌堆顶牌作为新身份，旧身份放到牌堆底。
· 交换手牌：与另一名玩家交换全部手牌。行动结束后由对方摸1张牌，你不摸牌。
每名未被困的获胜者按获胜总人数领奖：1人时5金币，2人时各4金币，3人时各3金币，4人时各2金币，5人及以上时各1金币；随后应用老板与投机者的扣减，最低为零。

赛事特别牌（可选）：
· 贪婪矮人（2016）：仅用于基础版，以一张贪婪矮人替换一名矿工。只有自己打通黄金时，才独自获得4金币；否则不获奖励。
· 交换目标（2017）：选择两个暗置目标，在不查看正面的情况下决定交换或保持原位。
· 宝藏堆（2018）：代替正常摸牌，秘密查看弃牌堆顶至多5张，选择一张加入手牌，其余保持顺序放回。刚打出的宝藏堆不能被自己取回。
· 否决（2019）：另一名玩家打出路径牌或行动牌后，在其生效前打出。将双方卡牌弃置，原行动者先摸1张并结束回合，然后否决者摸1张。其他玩家根据提示选择否决或允许该牌生效。
· 逆转方向（2020）：立即反转本轮行动方向；基础版金币分配也相应反向。
· 工匠大师（2021）：修理任意一名玩家的一种损坏工具。
· 探路者（2022）：本回合依次打出两张路径牌，结束后摸2张牌；你会比之前少一张手牌。如果中途已无合法路径，则结束剩余铺路。
· 改道（2023）：将最近铺设的路径牌移到另一个合法位置，可以旋转180度。

迷你扩展（可选）：
· 隧道收费：每人开局额外获得1金币。每轮有两名收费矮人，各只能使用一次。你可以弃置一张手牌，把一名尚未使用的收费矮人放在开放通道尽头，不摸牌。想在该处铺路的玩家须向放置者支付1金币，随后移走收费矮人；可以请求其他玩家代付，对方须明确同意。下一轮两名收费矮人恢复可用，但不会重新发初始金币。
· 换装间：明信片预置于矿道中。第一名将其连通起点的玩家，立即与备用身份牌交换身份。
· 隧道派对：使用明信片的另一面。第一次连通时，将所有玩家当前身份洗匀后重新分发。换装间与隧道派对只能选择一种。明信片占据两个相邻格，第一次连通任一部分便会触发。
· 新目标：改用8张新目标中的黄金目标和随机4张其他目标，按五目标布局摆放。巨蛛使本轮立即结束并由破坏者获胜；钱袋立即给予发现者1或2金币；飞龙使发现者立即失去1金币（没有则不支付）；黑石没有效果。若同次连接多个目标，揭示顺序可能决定本轮结果。
· 宝箱：将7张暗置路径和10张宝箱分别洗匀，随机配成4组，放在互不相邻的固定位置。连通时，先揭示路径并适配朝向，再执行宝箱效果。地图可以秘密查看路径及其下宝箱；落石可以移除整组暗牌。宝箱由触发者选择牌或对象，并立即执行下列对应效果：
· 金币：立即获得1金币。
· 加倍补给：本回合额外摸1张牌。
· 无补给：本回合不摸牌。
· 烧毁：弃置牌库顶的至多5张牌。
· 检视：秘密查看另一名玩家的身份。
· 禁用地图：本轮不能用地图查看目标，仍可查看宝箱。
· 抽取手牌：在回合末从另一名玩家手中随机抽1张牌，代替正常摸牌。
· 三选一：回合末摸3张牌，选择1张加入手牌，弃置其余牌，代替正常摸牌。
· 弃牌寻宝：洗匀弃牌堆，查看顶端至多5张牌，选择1张加入手牌，本回合不再正常摸牌。
· 移动目标：将一个暗置目标向远离起点的方向推移一格。

变体（可选）：
· 受损矿工：仅用于基础版。矿工获胜时，有工具损坏的矿工不能领取金币牌，但仍按全部矿工人数抽牌。分配时跳过受损矿工，因此完好矿工可能挑选多张；若全部受损，则无人领奖。
锦标赛（5至9人）：
使用金币片计分，不使用金币牌。根据人数分配以下身份：
· 5人使用1名破坏者、3名矿工与1名贪婪矮人。
· 6人使用2名破坏者、3名矿工与1名贪婪矮人。
· 7人使用2名破坏者、3名矿工与2名贪婪矮人。
· 8人使用3名破坏者、3名矿工与2名贪婪矮人。
· 9人使用3名破坏者、4名矿工与2名贪婪矮人。
每轮另抽一张随机基础路径放在起点与中间目标的正中。轮末按下列方式分配金币：
· 矿工获胜时，打通者获得3金币，其他矿工各获得2金币。
· 贪婪矮人打通黄金时，其独自获得4金币。
· 破坏者获胜时，各获得3金币；5人局唯一破坏者获得4金币。

en.name: Saboteur: 20th Anniversary Edition
en.desc: Keep your role secret as you dig, sabotage and compete for gold.
en.rules:
Objective:
Play three rounds. The player with the most gold wins; tied players share victory. Roles are redealt each round, while gold carries over.

Base game setup (3–10 players):
Leave seven card widths between the start and the three face-down goals. One goal contains gold; two contain black rocks. Shuffle 40 path cards with 27 action cards. Deal six cards each with 3–5 players, five with 6–7, or four with 8–10. Never reshuffle the discard pile when the deck runs out.
Shuffle the following role pool and deal one role to each player, leaving one unused:
· 3 players: 1 Saboteur and 3 Miners; 4 players: 1 Saboteur and 4 Miners.
· 5 players: 2 Saboteurs and 4 Miners; 6 players: 2 Saboteurs and 5 Miners.
· 7 players: 3 Saboteurs and 5 Miners; 8 players: 3 Saboteurs and 6 Miners.
· 9 players: 3 Saboteurs and 7 Miners; 10 players: 4 Saboteurs and 7 Miners.
Miners try to connect the start to the gold. Saboteurs try to exhaust everyone's cards before this happens. Your role and gold remain private until the appropriate reveal. In this digital edition, the first seat begins; play then proceeds clockwise.

Taking a turn:
Choose one action, then draw one card:
· Play a path card. Keep it upright; a 180° rotation is allowed, but a 90° rotation is not. At least one passage must connect to the start, and every edge must match adjacent face-up cards. Tunnels may extend in any direction.
· Play an action card and resolve its effect.
· Discard one card to pass.
Players with empty hands are skipped once the draw deck is empty. Maps, inspections and private card choices are only shown to the acting player. If several hidden goals or chests become connected together, choose their reveal order. Orient each revealed path to match as many adjacent edges as possible; goal cards may exceptionally have mismatched edges when no complete match is possible.

Base action cards:
· Sabotage: place a broken tool in front of another player. A tool cannot be broken twice. A player with any broken cart, lantern or pick cannot play paths.
· Repair: remove one matching broken tool from yourself or another player. A repair showing two tools still repairs only one. Repairs cannot be played preemptively.
· Rockfall: remove a path card. The start, goals and postcard cannot be removed. Discard both the removed path and the Rockfall.
· Map: secretly inspect one face-down goal and return it to the same position.

Ending a base round and distributing gold:
When the gold is connected, the Miners win. Draw as many gold cards as there are Miners in the round. The Miner who connected the gold chooses one and passes the rest in the opposite direction to the turn order. If a Saboteur completed the path, begin with the first Miner to their right. There are sixteen 1-gold cards, eight 2-gold cards and four 3-gold cards.
If every hand is exhausted without reaching gold, the Saboteurs win. A sole Saboteur receives 4 gold; two or three Saboteurs each receive 3; four each receive 2. If no Saboteur is present, nobody receives a reward. If the remaining denominations cannot pay a fixed reward, exchange equal values with previously awarded gold cards; no player’s gold total changes.
Reveal all roles at the end of the round. Prepare fresh roles, tunnels and hands. The player to the left of the last player to act starts the next round. Compare total gold after the third round.

Saboteur 2 (2–12 players):
Shuffle all base and expansion path and action cards, set aside the top ten each round, and deal six cards each. Shuffle all fifteen roles: four Blue Miners, four Green Miners, three Saboteurs, two Geologists, one Boss and one Profiteer. The undealt roles form a reserve deck.
· Blue and Green Miners compete for the gold. If a Miner connects it and their team has an accessible route, only that team wins. If that team is blocked by an opposing door, the other team wins if it can reach the gold. If another role completes the connection, all teams with an accessible route win.
· Blue doors admit Blue Miners; green doors admit Green Miners. Doors only affect victory, not path placement. The Boss, Profiteer and Geologists pass any door.
· The Boss wins with the winning Miners but receives 1 less gold. The Profiteer wins with either winning side but receives 2 less. If both teams are blocked, the Boss and Profiteer can still win; a lone Boss gets 4 gold, or a lone Profiteer gets 3. A Profiteer also wins alone for 3 gold if no gold connection and no Saboteurs exist.
· Each Geologist receives gold for all visible crystals in the tunnel network. Two Geologists split that total, rounding down.
On a turn you may instead discard one to three cards and draw the same number, or discard two cards to remove any one action card from in front of yourself, then draw only one.

Expansion paths and actions:
· Bridges and double bends contain independent passages. You cannot turn at a crossing. At least one passage must connect to the start.
· Ladders connect directly to the start and all other ladders. They may be placed beside a path without another connection to the start, but never beside a goal. Adjacent edges must still match.
· Theft: place it in front of yourself. After rewards, steal 1 gold from another player if they have any. The most recently played Theft acts first; the remaining thieves follow clockwise.
· Hands off: remove one face-up Theft.
· Trapped: place it in front of another player. A trapped player cannot build paths, receive any round reward or carry out a Theft. They do not count in the winning group.
· Freedom: remove one Trapped card.
· Inspection: secretly inspect another player's role.
· Change Hats: choose any player, including yourself. They draw the top reserve role and place their old role at the bottom.
· Swap Hands: exchange all cards with another player. That player draws one card; you do not.
Each eligible winner receives gold according to the winning group's size: one winner gets 5; two get 4 each; three get 3 each; four get 2 each; five or more get 1 each. Apply the Boss and Profiteer reductions afterwards, with a minimum of zero.

World Championship cards (optional):
· Greedy Dwarf (2016): base game only. Replace one Miner in the role pool. This dwarf wins 4 gold alone only if they personally connect the gold; otherwise they receive nothing.
· Goal Swap (2017): choose two hidden goals and decide whether to exchange them, without looking at their faces.
· Treasure Trove (2018): instead of drawing, inspect up to five cards from the top of the discard pile and take one. Return the rest in their original order. The Trove just played cannot take itself.
· Veto (2019): react to another player's path or action before it resolves. Discard both cards. The original player draws one and ends their turn, then the vetoing player draws one. Other players follow the prompt to veto the card or allow it to resolve.
· Reverse (2020): reverse the turn order for the remainder of the round. Base-game gold distribution reverses too.
· Master Crafter (2021): repair any one broken tool for any player.
· Pathfinder (2022): play two paths consecutively, then draw two cards. You retain one fewer card. If no legal path remains, end the remaining build sequence.
· Diversion (2023): move the last path played to a different legal position, optionally rotating it 180°.

Mini expansions (optional):
· Tunnel Toll: each player begins the game with one extra gold. Two toll dwarves are available each round, each used once. Discard one card to place an unused dwarf at an open tunnel end; do not draw. To build there, pay 1 gold to its owner and remove the dwarf. You may request another player to pay, but they must consent. Dwarves reset next round; starting gold is not given again.
· Costume Department: a postcard is placed in the network. The first player to connect it to the start must immediately exchange their role with the reserve.
· Tunnel Party: use the other side of the postcard. On the first connection, shuffle all current player roles and redeal them. Choose only one postcard side. The postcard occupies two adjacent cells; connecting either part triggers it.
· New Goals: use the gold goal and four random cards from the other seven, in the five-goal layout. A giant spider immediately ends the round with a Saboteur victory. Sacks immediately give the explorer 1 or 2 gold. A dragon immediately takes 1 gold if they have any. Rocks do nothing. Reveal order can decide the outcome if several goals are reached together.
· Treasure Chests: separately shuffle seven hidden paths and ten chests, then pair four of each at fixed nonadjacent positions. When connected, reveal and orient the path first, then resolve its chest. A Map may inspect both layers; a Rockfall may remove an entire hidden pair. The explorer chooses cards and targets for the matching effect:
· Gold: immediately gain 1 gold.
· Extra supply: draw one additional card this turn.
· No supply: do not draw this turn.
· Burn: discard up to five cards from the top of the deck.
· Inspect: secretly inspect another player’s role.
· No maps: maps cannot inspect goals for the rest of the round; they can still inspect chests.
· Take a card: at turn end, take a random card from another player instead of drawing.
· Choose from three: at turn end, draw three cards, keep one and discard the rest instead of the normal draw.
· Discard treasure: shuffle the discard pile, inspect its top five cards and keep one; skip the normal draw.
· Move a goal: push a hidden goal one space further from the start.

Variants (optional):
· Sabotaged Dwarf: base game only. Broken-tool Miners do not receive gold cards after a Miner victory. Still draw for the full Miner count, skipping damaged Miners when passing cards. Eligible Miners may receive several cards; if all are damaged, none receives a reward.
Tournament (5–9 players):
Use gold pieces instead of gold cards. Deal the following roles:
· 5 players use 1 Saboteur, 3 Miners and 1 Greedy Dwarf.
· 6 players use 2 Saboteurs, 3 Miners and 1 Greedy Dwarf.
· 7 players use 2 Saboteurs, 3 Miners and 2 Greedy Dwarves.
· 8 players use 3 Saboteurs, 3 Miners and 2 Greedy Dwarves.
· 9 players use 3 Saboteurs, 4 Miners and 2 Greedy Dwarves.
Place a random base path midway between start and central goal each round. Distribute gold as follows:
· After a Miner victory the connecting Miner receives 3 gold; other Miners receive 2 gold each.
· A Greedy Dwarf who connects the gold receives 4 gold alone.
· Winning Saboteurs receive 3 gold each, except the sole Saboteur in a five-player game receives 4 gold.
