zh.name: 圣家族大教堂
zh.desc: 挑选彩色玻璃骰子，拼出独一无二的彩绘玻璃窗。
zh.rules:
目标：
在10轮中选取骰子填满4行5列的玻璃窗，通过公共目标、私密目标和剩余恩惠标记取得最高分。本游戏采用2017版；基础版支持1–4人，5–6人扩展提供更多玩家位置。
准备：
每人获得两张双面窗格图样，从四个面中选择一个，按图样难度领取恩惠标记。每人领取一张秘密目标，中央公开三张工具和三张公共目标。基础版骰袋有五种颜色、每色18枚骰子。
流程：
每轮抽取每人2枚再加1枚骰子并掷出。从首位开始顺时针，每人进行第一次回合；再从末位逆时针，每人进行第二次回合。每回合可以选取并放置1枚公共骰子，以及使用1张工具，顺序不限，均可放弃。完成后结束回合。每轮剩余的全部骰子移至轮次轨，首位顺时针轮换。
· 第一枚骰子必须放在边缘或角落；以后每枚骰子必须与已有骰子相邻，斜角也算相邻。骰子必须符合格子的颜色或点数限制，正交相邻的骰子不能同色，也不能同点数。
· 工具首次使用支付1个恩惠标记，以后支付2个。工具的具体效果可点击牌面查阅。忽略格子的颜色或点数限制不代表可以违反相邻限制。随机操作提交后不能撤回，无法合法放置时按效果归还骰子。
5–6人及个人骰池：
· 5–6人扩展：启用后，2/3/4/5/6人骰袋分别使用每色10/14/18/22/26枚骰子，并加入6种区域私密目标。
· 个人骰池模式：此可选模式适用于2–6人：每人先掷出每色2枚的个人骰子；袋中每色改为6/8/10/12/14枚。每轮公共骰子为人数加1，每名玩家每轮只进行一个回合，可以放置1枚公共骰子和1枚个人骰子，并使用一次工具。个人骰全部公开。工具7和8移除，加入与个人骰池互动的工具13和14。
Passion扩展：
· 灵感：每人获得一种公开能力，按牌面支付费用并遵守每轮或每局次数。
· 稀有玻璃：随机稀有玻璃板替代一张工具。支付该板的恩惠费用，额外放置1枚稀有玻璃骰；每扇玻璃窗最多放置1枚稀有玻璃骰。这种骰子可覆盖任何颜色格，仍须满足点数和相邻点数限制，并视为一种独立颜色。该模块使用7种专属私密目标；中央稀有骰耗尽时补满并掷出。
· 对称目标：加入水平对称、上下半窗平衡、同色对角连通及交织颜色目标。
Life扩展：
· 学徒：使用带两个学徒符号的专用窗格图样。用骰子覆盖符号时，可以抽取两张学徒卡，选择一张保留并弃置另一张；也可以拿取弃牌堆顶部的一张学徒卡。每回合最多获得1张学徒卡。覆盖符号的骰子被移走后，之后再次覆盖该符号时，仍可触发此效果。手中的卡秘密保存，打出时按牌面执行一次性能力或公开持续计分效果。
· 杰作：选取骰子时，可将符合杰作市场空槽颜色或点数的骰子换成对应橙色杰作骰，保持符号并选择朝向后放置，同时获得所示恩惠标记。杰作骰可覆盖点数格，不能覆盖其他颜色格，不能正交相邻橙色骰；不同符号视为不同点数，数值加总时为0。终局每枚满足全部箭头条件获得5分，否则失去2分；箭头指向空格或窗外必定失败。
· 辛劳目标：加入复制、交替列、最低行合计、最高列合计、轮次轨匹配等目标。
Glory扩展：
· 纷争：随机灰骰限制板，加入一张专属工具和一张专属公共目标。每轮从袋中抽每人2枚骰子，再加入1枚灰骰。灰骰遵守点数、格色及相邻限制，并额外遵守所选板的限制。与个人骰池组合时，每轮抽人数枚袋骰再加1枚灰骰。
· 先驱：公开三张竞速目标，回合末首先完成者获得对应卡，之后移动骰子导致条件失效也保留。
· 装饰：每人收到两张秘密装饰目标，选窗时可各自保留或弃置，每保留一张额外获得1个恩惠标记。终局以恰好两种颜色拼成牌面图样获得分数，否则扣除相同分数。图样可平移，不能旋转或翻转。
· 竞争目标：按排名分配12/8/5分，部分灰骰目标分配10/5分或奖励最高、惩罚最低。并列者平分所占名次的分值，向下取整。
结束与计分：
完成第10轮后，结算三张公共目标、自己的秘密目标、剩余恩惠标记（每个1分），每个空格扣1分，再计入启用扩展的得失分。总分最高者获胜。同分依次比较秘密目标得分、剩余恩惠数、最终轮的逆序座位。
单人模式：
每轮掷4枚骰子，进行两次回合；选择1–5张工具决定难度，公开两张公共目标和两张私密目标。基础单人没有恩惠标记，工具用同色公共骰支付并连同该骰移除，每张只用一次。终局选择得分较高的一张私密目标，每空格扣3分，分数必须严格超过轮次轨全部骰子的点数总和才获胜。
· Passion单人同时使用灵感、稀有玻璃及恩惠标记，稀有玻璃板不使用Glue Chip；工具少一张，两张私密目标中一张为稀有目标；获得稀有骰会占用一次普通选骰机会，让轮次轨多留一枚骰子。可照常花恩惠重复使用工具，剩余恩惠每个1分。
· Life单人同时使用学徒和6枚杰作骰，不使用工具或恩惠标记，涉及恩惠的学徒卡不加入。杰作市场中的支付骰不计入目标分。
官方单人模式分别提供，不混用不同扩展的单人规则。Glory和个人骰池只用于多人模式。

en.name: Sagrada
en.desc: Draft colored glass dice to craft a radiant stained-glass window.
en.rules:
Goal:
Draft dice over 10 rounds to fill a 4 by 5 stained-glass window. Score public and private objectives and unused Favor tokens. This implementation uses the 2017 edition. The base game supports 1–4 players; the 5–6 Player expansion adds more seats.
Setup:
Each player receives two double-sided Window Pattern cards and chooses one of the four faces. Gain Favor tokens equal to its difficulty, and receive one secret Private Objective. Reveal three Tools and three Public Objectives. The base bag contains 18 dice in each of five colors.
Play:
Each round, roll two dice per player plus one. Starting with the first player, take turns clockwise, then reverse from the last player. Each turn you may draft and place one public die and use one Tool, in either order. Both are optional. End your turn when finished. Put every leftover die on that round of the Round Track, then rotate first player clockwise.
· Your first die must touch an edge or corner. Later dice must touch an existing die, including diagonally. Match printed color and value restrictions. Orthogonal neighbors may share neither color nor value.
· A Tool costs one Favor the first time, then two. Inspect each Tool for its effect. Ignoring a printed space restriction does not ignore adjacency. Random effects cannot be undone; return an unplaceable die as instructed by its effect.
5–6 Players and Private Dice Pools:
· 5–6 Player expansion: use 10/14/18/22/26 dice per base color for 2/3/4/5/6 players, and add six area Private Objectives.
· Private Dice Pools: Optional Private Pools support 2–6 players. Each player publicly rolls two dice of each color; the bag then uses 6/8/10/12/14 per color. Roll one public die per player plus one each round. Each player takes one turn and may place one public die, one private die, and use one Tool. Remove Tools 7 and 8; add Tools 13 and 14. Ordinary drafted-die Tools only affect public drafts.
Passion:
· Inspiration gives each player one public ability, with its printed costs and per-round or per-game limits.
· Rare Glass replaces one Tool with a random Rare Glass board. Pay its Favor cost to place an additional Rare Glass die, at most one per window. It can cover any color restriction but must obey value and value adjacency restrictions. It counts as a distinct color. Use the seven dedicated Private Objectives. Refill and roll the Rare Glass supply when empty.
· Symmetry objectives add horizontal symmetry, balance between the top and bottom halves, diagonal color links, and entwined colors.
Life:
· Apprentice uses dedicated windows with two Apprentice spaces. Covering a symbol lets you draw two Apprentice cards, keep one and discard the other, or take the top discard. Gain at most one card per turn. A vacated symbol can trigger again on a later turn. Keep cards secret until using a discard ability or activating a public ability or scoring condition.
· Masterwork lets a drafted die matching an open market color or value slot be exchanged for the corresponding orange die. Keep its symbol, choose its orientation, place it, and gain the indicated Favors. Orange dice ignore printed value restrictions, obey color restrictions, and cannot share an edge with orange dice. Symbols are distinct values; their numeric sum is zero. Each die scores 5 if all arrow conditions are met, otherwise loses 2. An arrow pointing outside the window or at an empty space fails.
· Toil adds objectives for copies, alternating columns, the lowest completed row sum, highest completed column sum, and Round Track matches.
Glory:
· Strife selects a gray-die restriction board and adds one dedicated Tool and Objective. Each round draw two bag dice per player, then add one gray supply die. Gray dice obey ordinary placement rules and the selected board. With Private Pools, draw one bag die per player and add one gray die instead.
· Pioneer reveals three races. The first player meeting a goal at turn end takes its card. Ordinary later moves do not forfeit it.
· Flourish gives two secret patterns. Keep or discard each when choosing your window; gain one Favor per kept card. At game end form its exact pattern in exactly two different colors to gain its points, or lose the same number. Patterns may translate but never rotate or reflect.
· Rivalry awards 12/8/5 points by rank. Some gray objectives award 10/5, or reward the highest and penalize the lowest. Ties split the rewards for the occupied places, rounded down.
End:
After round 10, add the three Public Objectives, Private Objective, one point per remaining Favor, and all enabled expansion rewards and penalties. Lose one per empty space. Highest total wins. Break ties by Private Objective, remaining Favors, then reverse order in the final round.
Solo:
Roll four dice per round and take two turns. Use 1–5 Tools to set difficulty and reveal two Public and two Private Objectives. Base solo has no Favors: pay a matching-color public die to use a Tool, removing both; each is usable once. Score the better Private Objective and lose three per empty space. Your score must strictly exceed the sum of every die on the Round Track.
· Passion solo uses Inspiration, Rare Glass, and Favors; exclude Glue Chip Glass. Use one fewer Tool and one Rare Private Objective among the two. Gaining Rare Glass replaces one normal draft, leaving an extra die on the Round Track. Favors may pay to reuse Tools; unused Favors score one each.
· Life solo uses Apprentice windows and six Masterwork dice, without Tools or Favors. Exclude Favor-related Apprentice cards. Dice paid to the Masterwork board do not contribute to the target.
The official solo variants are offered separately. Glory and Private Dice Pools are multiplayer only.

zh.name: 三千鸦杀
zh.desc: 双人合作:Feth 以记忆牌搭建幻境,Ren 寻回失落的内心写成诗,赶在乌鸦吞尽记忆前做完三场梦
zh.rules:
目标:两人合作完成三场梦。每场梦中,Ren 将 4 张心牌写成「7-7-7-5」四行诗;诗成时幻境颜色与心牌颜色一致,梦才圆满。
分工:
· Feth(通灵者)负责抽牌与搭建幻境;Ren(忆主)负责从幻境取牌写诗。
Feth 回合:
· 从牌堆中抽取任意数量的卡牌，放入记忆列。安全区的位置数量等于乌鸦列中的乌鸦数量；在安全区内抽到的乌鸦牌直接弃置，在安全区外抽到的乌鸦牌则进入乌鸦列。
· 随后将至少1张卡牌叠放到幻境中。重叠象限的明暗必须一致，并且至少有一处褪色象限覆盖褪色象限。未使用的卡牌须弃置；乌鸦列中有同色乌鸦时，这些牌改为被该乌鸦偷走。
共鸣:
· 放入的牌与同色相连牌恰好凑满 7 点时,赶走该色乌鸦(最终梦中为击败),Ren 翻开一张同色心牌。
Ren 回合:
· 从幻境中拿取1张可见卡牌。该牌能够加入当前诗行时，必须将其加入；否则将其弃置。
· 取牌可能使幻境分裂,须选择一簇保留。
诗牌能力:
入诗的牌提供一次性能力：
· 金色：使卡牌返回牌堆。
· 红色：从幻境中移除卡牌。
· 蓝色：协助调整卡牌，使相连卡牌满足合计 7 点的共鸣条件。
· 绿色：协助调整卡牌在幻境中的摆放方式。
· 紫色：防御乌鸦造成的影响。
· 红色与金色卡牌的能力，双方都可以使用；其余颜色的能力只有Feth可以使用。
败北(任一触发):
· 牌堆中的牌全部被抽完。
· 五种颜色的乌鸦全部聚集在乌鸦列。
· 幻境中的卡牌全部被移除。
· Feth 没有可以放置的卡牌。
· 最终梦中 Ren 未完成诗行,或诗成时幻境颜色与心牌不合。
计分与结局:
· 每场梦结算时,因共鸣翻开的心牌进入得分堆;最终梦中击败的乌鸦连同其赃物一并计分。
· 0~3 分为普通结局,4~10 分为好结局,11 分以上且击败至少 2 只乌鸦为圆满结局。

en.name: The Ravens of Thri Sahashri
en.desc: 2-player co-op: Feth builds the Atman from memory cards while Ren writes her heart into a poem — finish three dreams before the ravens devour everything
en.rules:
Goal: complete three Dreams together. Each Dream, Ren turns 4 Heart cards into a 7-7-7-5 poem; the Dream only closes if the Atman’s colors match her Heart colors.
Roles:
· Feth (the psychic) draws cards and builds the Atman; Ren (the dreamer) takes cards from the Atman to write the poem.
Feth’s turn:
· Draw any number of cards into the Memory Row: the safe zone equals the ravens in the Raven Row; ravens drawn inside it are discarded, outside they join the Row.
· Then place at least 1 card onto the Atman. Overlapping quadrants must match in light and dark, and at least one faded quadrant must cover another faded quadrant. Discard unused cards; if a raven of the same color is in the Raven Row, it steals those cards instead.
Relive:
· If the placed card plus connected same-color cards sum to exactly 7, chase that raven away (defeat it in the final Dream) and Ren reveals a matching Heart card.
Ren’s turn:
· Take 1 visible Atman card: if it fits the current poem row she must add it, otherwise discard it.
· Removing the card may split the Atman into separate groups. If it does, Ren chooses one connected group to keep.
Poem abilities:
Cards in poem rows grant one-use powers:
· Gold returns cards to the deck.
· Red removes cards from the Atman.
· Blue helps cards meet the total of 7 required for reliving.
· Green helps with placement in the Atman.
· Purple protects against ravens.
· Red and gold are usable by both; the rest only by Feth.
Defeat (any one triggers):
The players lose if any of the following occurs:
· The deck runs out.
· All five ravens gather in the Row.
· The Atman becomes empty.
· Feth cannot place a card.
· In the final Dream Ren fails a row, or the Atman colors mismatch her Hearts when the poem closes.
Scoring and endings:
· At each Dream’s end, Hearts revealed by reliving enter the score pile; ravens defeated in the final Dream score together with their loot.
· 0-3 is the normal ending, 4-10 the good ending, 11 or more with at least 2 defeated ravens the happy ending.

zh.name: 深海迷途
zh.desc: 双人合作吃墩:驾船穿越风暴与克拉肯,抵达终点
zh.rules:
目标:两人合作驾船,在第 5 轮结束前驶入终点格;触发任一败北条件即失败。
牌:
· 玩家牌堆 21 张:灰、绿、蓝三花色各 3~9;另有克拉肯牌堆,由三花色的 1 和 2 各一张组成。
· 牌面图标决定动作:1~3 为舵+触手,4~5 为炮,6~8 为舵,9 为触手。
每轮:
· 重洗全部玩家牌,各发 9 张;随后互递 1 张(收到前看不到对方递出的牌),然后开始吃墩。
· 必须跟花色;领出花色中数字较大者赢墩,并领出下一墩。
· 任一玩家赢下第 4 墩时本轮结束:克拉肯按其轨道当前数字对船造成伤害,随后重洗进入下一轮。
动作:
· 按一墩两张牌的图标组合结算(见下方速查表)。
版图:
· 斜向前进时，船向赢得本墩的一方所在侧斜向前进；直线前进时，船向正前方移动。船不能驶入岛屿；如果移动会使船超出版图边界，则船停留在原地。
· 驶入克拉肯格受 1 点伤害。
· 第 2、4 轮结束时,船必须完全越过风暴线。
胜负:
· 船驶入终点格,立即获胜。
发生以下任一情况时，立即失败：
· 克拉肯牌堆中只剩下克拉肯卡。
· 克拉肯标记到达骷髅格。
· 已经无法抵达终点。

en.name: Sail
en.desc: 2-player co-op trick-taking: sail past storms and the Kraken to reach the end
en.rules:
Goal: cooperate to sail the ship onto an end space within 5 rounds; triggering any defeat condition ends the game.
Cards:
· The player deck has 21 cards: three suits (gray/green/blue), 3–9 each; a separate Kraken deck holds the 1s and 2s of all suits.
· Card icons determine the actions. Cards 1–3 show a wheel and a tentacle; cards 4–5 show a cannon; cards 6–8 show a wheel; card 9 shows a tentacle.
Each round:
· Reshuffle and deal 9 cards each, pass 1 card face down (before seeing what you receive), then play tricks.
· You must follow suit; the highest card of the led suit wins and leads next.
· The round ends when either player wins their 4th trick: the Kraken deals damage equal to its current track number, then reshuffle for the next round.
Actions:
· Resolve the icon pair of the two cards in a trick (see the cheat sheet below).
Board:
· Diagonal movement takes the ship forward toward the side of the trick winner; straight movement takes it directly ahead. The ship cannot enter islands. If a move would leave the board, the ship stays in place.
· Entering a Kraken space deals 1 damage.
· At the end of rounds 2 and 4 the ship must be fully past the storm line.
Win/Lose:
· Sailing onto an end space wins immediately.
The players lose immediately if any of the following occurs:
· The Kraken card is the only card left in its deck.
· The Kraken marker reaches the skull space.
· Reaching any end space becomes impossible.

zh.name: 得分沙拉
zh.desc: 拿计分卡、囤蔬菜,108 种计分方式叠出最高分
zh.rules:
目标:牌堆和市场全部拿完后,计分卡总分最高者获胜。
流程(每回合):
先选择以下一种方式拿牌：
· 拿取一张计分卡，可以选择三个牌堆中任意一个的顶牌；这些顶牌的计分条件向所有玩家公开。
· 从市场拿取两张蔬菜牌。
· 拿牌后，市场自动补充。一个牌堆耗尽时，将当前最大牌堆的一半移入该位置。
· 拿牌后还可把 1 张自己的计分卡翻成蔬菜面,每回合至多 1 次,单向不可逆。
终局计分:
· 只计算蔬菜面朝上的卡牌。同一张蔬菜牌可以同时计入多张计分卡的条件。
· 「最多 / 最少某蔬菜」并列同得分;0 个也算数(0 是偶数)。
· 总分相同时，行动顺序较后的玩家获胜。

en.name: Point Salad
en.desc: Draft point cards and veggies, mix 108 ways to score
en.rules:
Goal: when every pile and the market is gone, the highest point-card total wins.
Each turn:
First choose one way to draft cards:
· Take 1 point card from the top of any of the 3 piles. The scoring conditions on those top cards are public.
· Take 2 vegetable cards from the market.
· The market refills automatically; an emptied pile is replaced by half of the largest pile.
· After drafting, you may flip 1 of your point cards to its veggie side — at most once per turn, and it cannot be flipped back.
Final scoring:
· Count only cards with their vegetable side face up. Each vegetable card can count toward every applicable point card you own.
· “Most / fewest of a veggie” ties all score; 0 counts (0 is even).
· Ties go to the player later in turn order.

zh.name: 三国杀
zh.desc: 主忠反内身份局,杀闪攻防与锦囊博弈
zh.rules:
目标：各身份的获胜条件如下。
· 主公与忠臣：消灭所有反贼和内奸。
· 反贼：杀死主公。
· 内奸：在只剩自己与主公时，杀死主公。
准备:
· 按人数分发身份牌,只有主公亮出身份;主公先从五张武将牌中选一张,随后其他人同时各从三张中选一张。
· 主公的体力上限增加一点。每人抽取四张起始手牌，由主公先行动。
流程(每个回合依次进行):
· 判定阶段:依次判定判定区里的延时锦囊,后放置的先判定。
· 摸牌阶段:从牌堆摸两张牌。
· 出牌阶段:可以使用手牌。【杀】每回合限用一次,只能攻击范围内的角色;【闪】只能在响应【杀】时打出。
· 弃牌阶段:手牌数超过当前体力值时,须弃置至等于体力值。
结算:
· 【杀】未被【闪】抵消时,目标受到一点伤害;体力降到零进入濒死,所有角色可以依次打出【桃】营救。
· 杀死反贼的角色摸三张牌;主公杀死忠臣须弃置所有手牌和装备。
· 装备牌提供攻击范围或防御效果;延时锦囊【乐不思蜀】使目标跳过出牌阶段,【闪电】判定黑桃二至九时造成三点伤害。

en.name: Legends of the Three Kingdoms
en.desc: Hidden-role battle of Slash, Dodge and trick cards
en.rules:
Goal: Each role has a different victory condition.
· The Lord and Loyalists must eliminate all Rebels and the Renegade.
· The Rebels win by killing the Lord.
· The Renegade must kill the Lord when no one else remains.
Setup:
· Deal identity cards by player count; only the Lord is revealed. The Lord picks 1 of 5 generals first; then all others choose simultaneously from 3 each.
· Increase the Lord’s maximum HP by 1. Everyone draws 4 cards; the Lord acts first.
Play (each turn in order):
· Judge phase: resolve delayed tricks in your judge area, last placed first.
· Draw phase: draw 2 cards.
· Play phase: play cards from hand. [Slash] is limited to once per turn and only within attack range; [Dodge] can only be played in response to [Slash].
· Discard phase: discard down to your current HP.
Resolution:
· An uncountered [Slash] deals 1 damage; at 0 HP a player is dying and everyone may play [Peach] to save them in turn.
· Killing a Rebel draws you 3 cards; if the Lord kills a Loyalist, the Lord discards all hand and equipped cards.
· Equipment grants attack range or protection; [Indulgence] skips the target's play phase, [Lightning] deals 3 damage on a spade 2-9 judgment.

zh.name: 圣胡安
zh.desc: 选择角色，以手牌支付费用，在圣胡安建造繁荣的城市。
zh.rules:
目标：
以第二版规则建设圣胡安。建筑上的分数、埋藏牌及特殊建筑共同决定胜负。
准备：
2至4人，每人拥有1座靛蓝染料厂和4张手牌。手牌可建造、支付费用或成为货物，牌库与弃牌均背面朝上。起始手牌变体下，依座位抽5、6、7、8张，各保留4张。新建筑扩展默认关闭，开启时加入33张建筑和公共大教堂。
流程：
每轮从总督开始顺时针各选择一个未用角色，所有人从选择者开始依次行动，只有选择者获得角色特权。两人局依次由总督、另一人、总督选择，共3个不同角色。行动可以放弃；角色不能放弃。
· 建筑师：建造1张手牌，弃置其他手牌支付其费用。选择者少支付1张。生产建筑可以重复，同名城市建筑只可拥有1座。也可以建造公共大教堂。
· 生产者：在1座空置生产建筑上放置1张牌库牌作为货物；选择者可以额外生产1件。每座建筑最多存1件货物，货物牌不能查看。
· 商人：按当前交易所价格出售1件货物，选择者可以额外出售1件，每件货物换取对应数量的手牌。阶段结束后交易所移到牌堆底部，下一次交易才翻开新的价格。
· 议员：抽2张并保留1张，选择者额外抽3张，其余弃置。档案馆允许从原手牌与新牌中一起选择弃牌，行政厅额外保留1张。
· 淘金者：只有选择者抽1张牌。拥有金矿或金匠铺的人仍可使用相应能力。第二版金矿私下抽取4张牌，仅在费用全部不同时获得最低费用牌。
图书馆可以将角色特权翻倍；两人局每轮只能使用一次，由玩家选择使用时机。建筑能力详情可查看卡牌。起重机覆盖建筑后，旧建筑失去效果与印刷分数，其原有埋藏牌仍计分；覆盖货物会弃置。新建建筑不对自己的建造触发效果。
每轮开始：
角色全部归还，总督移交给下一位玩家，然后依次完成以下步骤：
· 办公楼先执行手牌交换。
· 处理小教堂和银行的埋藏能力：小教堂每轮可以埋藏1张牌，银行整局只能使用一次。
· 检查手牌上限，通常为7张；高塔将上限提高至12张。有玩家拥有警卫室时，未拥有警卫室的玩家上限为6张。
一轮进行期间不检查手牌上限。牌库耗尽时，将弃牌洗混，继续抽牌。
结束与计分：
有人拥有12座建筑时，完成整个建筑师阶段后结束。统计有效建筑印刷分数与埋藏牌每张1分，再结算以下特殊建筑：
· 同业公会：得分为生产建筑数量加生产种类数。
· 市政厅：得分为城市建筑数量（含自身）。
· 凯旋门：按1、2、3种纪念建筑计4、6、8分。
· 宅邸：按同费用且类型不同的3座建筑组成不重复使用建筑的组，1至4组计4、7、9、10分。
· 大教堂：根据对手拥有的建造费用为6的建筑数量，获得4、7、9或10分。
· 宫殿：最后按其他分数每满4分加1分。
同分时比较手牌加货物的数量，再同分则共享胜利。

en.name: San Juan
en.desc: Choose roles and spend cards to build a thriving city in San Juan.
en.rules:
Objective:
Build San Juan using the second edition rules. Building VP, buried cards and special buildings determine the winner.
Setup:
For 2–4 players. Each player starts with 1 indigo plant and 4 hand cards. Cards serve as buildings, payment and goods. Supply and discard piles stay face down. With varied starting hands, seats draw 5, 6, 7 or 8 cards and keep 4. The optional New Buildings expansion adds 33 buildings and the shared cathedral; it is off by default.
Round:
Starting with the Governor, each player selects an unused role. All players act clockwise from its selector, who alone receives the privilege. With 2 players the Governor, other player and Governor select 3 different roles. Actions may be passed; a role must be selected.
· Builder: Build 1 hand card and discard other hand cards equal to its cost. The selector pays 1 less. Production types may repeat; each city type is limited to 1 active copy. The shared cathedral may also be built.
· Producer: Place 1 supply card face down as a good on 1 empty production building. The selector may produce 1 extra good. Each building stores at most 1 good, whose face must remain unseen.
· Trader: Sell 1 good for hand cards at the current trading house prices. The selector may sell 1 extra good. Move the tile to the bottom after the phase; reveal the next tile only at the next Trader phase.
· Councillor: Draw 2 and keep 1. The selector draws 3 extra. Discard the rest. Archive allows discards from the old hand and new cards together; Prefecture keeps 1 extra card.
· Prospector: Only the selector draws 1 card. Other players may still use gold mines or goldsmiths. The second edition gold mine keeps the cheapest of 4 privately drawn cards only when all 4 costs differ.
Library may double a role privilege; with 2 players it can be used only once per round, at its owner's chosen time. Inspect cards for building abilities. Crane coverings remove the old building's effect and printed VP, but its buried cards retain their VP. Goods on a covered building are discarded. New buildings do not trigger on their own construction.
Round start:
At the start of a round, perform these steps in order:
· Return the roles and pass the Governor clockwise.
· Resolve Office exchanges.
· Place at most 1 card under a Chapel, and resolve a Bank’s once-per-game deposit if used.
· Discard down to 7 cards. A Tower raises this to 12; a Guard Room reduces players without one to 6.
There is no hand limit during a round. Reshuffle the discard pile when the supply runs out.
End and scoring:
Finish the entire Builder phase when anyone reaches 12 buildings. Score active buildings' printed VP and 1 per buried card.
· Guild hall scores production count plus different production types.
· City hall scores city count including itself.
· Triumphal arch scores 4/6/8 for 1/2/3 monument types.
· Residence forms disjoint sets of 3 different buildings of the same cost, scoring 4/7/9/10 for 1–4 sets.
· Cathedral scores 4/7/9/10 for 1/2/3/4+ opponent-owned 6-cost buildings.
· Palace scores 1 per complete 4 VP from all other sources, calculated last.
Break ties by hand cards plus stored goods, then share victory.

zh.name: 桑托里尼：万神殿
zh.desc: 在爱琴海小岛上运用神力，堆起白墙蓝顶的村落，抢先登上三级高塔。
zh.rules:
目标：
选择一个己方工人移动，再用同一个工人建造。第一个向上移动到三级的玩家获胜。神力可以改变基本规则；强制位移不会视为移动，也不能按普通条件获胜。

准备：
使用5行5列的棋盘。普通模式支持2至4人，四人时与对座玩家组队，共用工人，任一队友获胜或落败即全队获胜或落败。赫尔摩尼亚的考验支持4人或6人。四个扩展包分别增加17位神祇和2种模式，默认关闭，可在开局选项中启用。首局可选择阿尔忒弥斯对得墨忒耳；通常由起始玩家选择推荐组合，或从随机抽出的6位神祇中选出所需数量，再由其左手边玩家起按顺时针选神，起始玩家最后选。四人标准模式按两组神卡配对分给队友。神卡之间的禁配限制双向生效。

回合流程：
· 移动：进入相邻的8格之一。不能进入有工人、穹顶或被冻结的格子。最多上升一层，可以下降任意层。先选择工人，再从盘面高亮目标中选择目的地。
· 建造：在该工人的一个未被占用的相邻格增加一层建筑；已有三级时放置穹顶。穹顶上不能再放任何物件。完整高塔由三层建筑与穹顶组成，建筑数量视为无限。
· 神力：按卡牌注明的准备、回合前、回合开始、移动、建造和回合结束时机执行。可选步骤可以跳过；每局一次的能力用过后不能再次使用。强制位移可以改变任意层数，但目的地仍须未被占用，除非能力另有说明。
· 失败：不能完成必须执行的移动、建造或神力限制时落败。移走落败方的工人、标记和神力；若仍有至少两支对立队伍，继续游戏，最后留下的一方获胜。

特殊物件：
所有玩家共用一枚骰子，只有模式或神力要求时才掷骰，并保留结果到下次掷骰。0、1、2、3各占三面，分别对应北、东、南、西；罗盘同时用颜色与数字标识。被冻结的格子及格内所有物件暂时视为不存在。标记通常在被建筑覆盖时移走；织网与旋涡会返回对应神卡。秘密工人、记忆、命运区、深渊和潘多拉骰值只向相应玩家展示；赫卡忒秘密工人阻挡对手的尝试时，该行动取消、回合结束，对手不会因此落败。

模式：
2人标准、3人标准、4人标准与集市属于基础内容。
· 冥界包：提供曼提柯尔之影与倪克斯之幕。
· 混沌包：提供金羊毛与混沌统治。
· 奥林匹斯包：提供奇美拉之翼与赫尔摩尼亚的考验。
· 海神包：提供特洛伊战争与喀耳刻的诅咒。
各模式的准备与持续效果可在规则图鉴中查看。

en.name: Santorini: Pantheon Edition
en.desc: Build a white-walled, blue-domed island village and wield divine powers to reach the third level first.
en.rules:
Goal:
Move one of your workers, then build with that same worker. The first player to move up to level 3 wins. God powers change these basic rules. A force is not a move and cannot produce a normal win.

Setup:
Play on a 5×5 board. Standard games support 2–4 players. With 4 players, partners sit across from one another and share workers; either partner winning or losing applies to the team. Harmonia’s Test supports 4 or 6 players. Each optional expansion adds 17 gods and 2 modes and is disabled by default. For your first game, use Artemis versus Demeter. Normally the start player selects a recommended matchup or the required gods from 6 randomly drawn cards. Players choose gods clockwise, starting to the start player’s left; the start player chooses last. In 4 Player Standard, gods are paired for partners. Bans apply in both directions.

Turn:
· Move into one of up to eight neighboring spaces. Workers cannot enter occupied spaces, domes, or frozen spaces. Move up at most one level, or down any number of levels. Select a worker and then a highlighted destination.
· Build one block in an unoccupied neighboring space. Build a dome on level 3. Nothing may be placed on a dome. A complete tower consists of three blocks and a dome. Building pieces are considered unlimited.
· Resolve powers at their stated timing: setup, before a turn, start of turn, move, build, or end of turn. Optional steps may be skipped. Once-per-game powers cannot be reused. A force may change any number of levels, but still needs an unoccupied destination unless stated otherwise.
· Lose if you cannot complete a mandatory move, build, or restriction. Remove the losing side’s workers, tokens, and powers. Continue if two or more opposing teams remain; the last surviving team wins.

Special pieces:
All players share one die. Roll only when a power or mode instructs and retain its result until the next roll. The die has three faces each of 0, 1, 2, and 3, corresponding to North, East, South, and West. The compass uses both colors and numbers. Frozen spaces and everything in them temporarily do not exist. Tokens are normally removed when built upon; weave and whirlpool tokens return to their cards. Secret workers, memories, fate, the Abyss, and Pandora’s die are visible only to their owners. If Hecate’s secret workers invalidate an opponent’s attempted play, cancel that play and end their turn without making them lose.

Modes:
2, 3, and 4 Player Standard and The Agora are base content.
· Underworld adds Manticore’s Shadow and Nyx’s Veil.
· Chaos adds The Golden Fleece and Chaos Reigns.
· Olympus adds Chimera’s Flight and Harmonia’s Test.
· Poseidon adds Trojan War and Circe’s Curse.
See the mode reference for each mode’s setup and ongoing effects.

search.py: sang tuo li ni wan shen dian

zh.name: 幸灾乐祸
zh.desc: 第二高者赢墩，收牌抵消，争取不超过40分的唯一高分
zh.rules:
目标：有人累计超过40分时结束，未超过40分的玩家中，分数最高且没有与别人并列者获胜。
准备：
· 50张牌包括蓝剑、绿旗、紫盾、红盔四种花色，每色为−3、−2、−1和1至9，另有0和10两张万能骑士。
· 三人时移除各花色的−2、−1和9，使用38张牌，每人发12张，余下2张不用。四人使用全部50张，每人发12张，余下2张不用。五人每人发10张。
出牌：
· 首轮随机选一人领出，之后顺时针每人出一张。有领出花色时，必须出该花色或万能骑士；没有该花色时，可以出任意牌，不强制出万能骑士。万能骑士领出时，第一张普通牌决定本墩花色。
· 万能骑士视为本墩花色。该花色中第二高的牌赢墩；只有一张符合条件时，该牌赢墩。赢家下一墩领出。
收集：
· 赢家只收自己打出的牌，以及所有未跟本墩花色的普通牌，其余牌弃置。收集区向所有人公开。
· 收集区中点数相同的牌两两抵消，与花色无关；三张保留一张，四张全部抵消。
轮末：
· 打完手牌后，将收集区剩余牌的点数总和加入累计分；累计分低于0时按0计算。
· 没有人超过40分时，重新洗牌开始下一轮，累计最低分者领出；最低分并列时，从上轮领出者的下一位起选第一位最低分玩家。
结束：
· 恰好40分不触发结束。有人严格超过40分时，所有超过40分的人失去胜利资格。其余人从最高分起比较，该分数有多人并列时，这些人均不能获胜，继续比较下一档，首个独占该分数的人获胜。若所有有效分数均并列，或所有人均超过40分，则无人获胜。

en.name: Schadenfreude
en.desc: Second highest takes the trick. Cancel pairs and aim for a unique high score under 41.
en.rules:
Goal: when anyone exceeds 40 points, win with the highest unshared score of 40 or less.
Setup:
· There are 50 cards: blue swords, green flags, purple shields and red helms, each with −3, −2, −1 and 1–9; plus wild knights 0 and 10.
· With 3 players, remove −2, −1 and 9 from each suit, leaving 38 cards. Deal 12 each and set 2 aside. With 4 players, use all 50, deal 12 each and set 2 aside. With 5 players, deal 10 each.
Play:
· A random player leads the first round. Play one card each in clockwise order. If you have the led suit, play that suit or a wild knight. If you have none, play any card; a wild is not compulsory. When a wild leads, the first non-wild card sets the suit.
· Wilds count as the led suit. The second highest card of that suit wins; if only one card qualifies, it wins. The winner leads the next trick.
Collect:
· The winner collects their own card and all non-wild cards that did not follow suit. Discard the rest. Score piles are public.
· Equal ranks in a score pile cancel in pairs, regardless of suit: three leave one, four cancel entirely.
Round end:
· Once all hands are empty, add the ranks left in each score pile to that player’s total. A total below 0 becomes 0.
· If no one exceeds 40, reshuffle for another round. The lowest total leads; on a tie, choose the first tied player clockwise after the previous round’s leader.
Game end:
· Exactly 40 does not end the game. If anyone exceeds 40, all players over 40 are eliminated. Compare remaining scores from highest to lowest. If a score is shared, none of those players can win; check the next score. The first unshared score wins. If all eligible scores are shared, or everyone exceeds 40, there is no winner.

zh.name: 恶棍牌（Scoundrel）
zh.desc: 用一副扑克牌探索地牢，选择战斗、武器与药水。
zh.rules:
目标：
· 处理全部 44 张牌，并让生命保持在 0 以上。
准备：
· 生命初始为 20，上限为 20。
· 黑桃和梅花为怪物，包含 2 至 A。
· J、Q、K、A 的点数分别为 11、12、13、14。
· 方块 2 至 10 为武器，红桃 2 至 10 为药水。
房间：
· 每回合补牌至 4 张，自选顺序处理其中 3 张。
· 留下的牌保留原位，下回合补充其余空位。
· 牌堆耗尽后，继续处理剩余牌，每回合最多处理 3 张。
· 开始处理前，可以逃离有 4 张牌的房间。
· 逃离的牌按房间位置顺序移到牌堆底，不重新洗牌。
· 不能连续逃离，处理完一个回合后才能再次逃离。
战斗与装备：
· 徒手战斗会失去等于怪物点数的生命。
· 处理武器牌时，必须装备它并弃置旧武器及其击败记录。
· 武器攻击失去怪物点数超过武器点数的那部分生命。
· 同一把武器此后只能攻击比上次击败的怪物更弱的怪物。
· 徒手战斗不会改变已装备武器的攻击限制。
药水：
· 每回合只有第一瓶药水生效，恢复等于其点数的生命。
· 满血时使用第一瓶药水，也会消耗本回合的治疗机会。
· 同一回合处理的其余药水直接弃置，不恢复生命。
结束与计分：
· 生命降至 0 或以下时失败，保留实际生命值。
· 失败得分为生命减去房间与牌堆中未处理怪物的总点数。
· 处理全部牌后存活，得分等于剩余生命。
· 若最终满血且最后处理的是药水，再加上该药水点数。

en.name: Scoundrel
en.desc: Explore a dungeon of playing cards, choosing battles, weapons and potions.
en.rules:
Goal:
· Resolve all 44 cards while keeping your health above 0.
Setup:
· Start with 20 health. The maximum is 20.
· Spades and clubs from 2 through Ace are monsters.
· J, Q, K and A have values of 11, 12, 13 and 14.
· Diamonds 2–10 are weapons; hearts 2–10 are potions.
Rooms:
· Refill to 4 cards each turn. Resolve 3 in any order.
· Leave the remaining card in place and refill the empty slots.
· When the deck runs out, resolve the rest, up to 3 per turn.
· Before resolving any cards, you may flee a room of 4 cards.
· Put its cards at the bottom of the deck in slot order, without shuffling.
· You cannot flee twice in a row. Complete a turn before fleeing again.
Combat and equipment:
· Barehanded combat costs health equal to the monster’s value.
· Resolving a weapon equips it and discards the old weapon and its kills.
· A weapon attack costs only the monster’s value above the weapon’s value.
· That weapon may then attack only monsters weaker than its last kill.
· Barehanded combat does not change your equipped weapon’s limit.
Potions:
· Only the first potion each turn heals you, by its value.
· Using the first potion at full health still spends that turn’s healing.
· Any further potions resolved that turn are discarded without healing.
Ending and score:
· At 0 health or below, you lose. Keep the actual health value.
· On a loss, subtract all unresolved monster values in the room and deck.
· If you survive all cards, your score is your remaining health.
· If you finish at full health with a potion, also add its value.

zh.name: 马戏星探
zh.desc: 手牌不许重排!压过场上组合,或抽端牌补强
zh.rules:
目标:打满与人数相同的轮数,总分最高者获胜。
牌与手牌:
· 全组共 45 张牌,每张牌两端各印一个数字,覆盖 1~10 的全部两两组合。
· 拿起手牌后，不能改变手牌顺序。每轮开始前，可以将整手牌翻面，使每张牌两端的数字互换；此操作不限次数，确认手牌方向后开始本轮。
行动(二选一):
· 出牌：打出手牌中连续相邻的一组牌，组成同点数组或连续点数组，并且须强于场上已有组合。获得被压过的原组合，每张牌计1分。
· 侦查:抽走场上组合端头的一张牌,以任意位置、任意朝向插入手牌;组合的主人获得 1 分。
· 每名玩家每轮可以使用一次“侦查与出牌”：完成侦查后，必须立即打出一组能够压过场上组合的牌。
组合强弱依次按以下标准比较：
· 先比较张数，张数较多的组合更强。
· 张数相同时，同点数组强于连续点数组。
· 张数和牌型均相同时，数字较大的组合更强。
轮末:
· 有人出完手牌,或一组牌一圈无人压过时,本轮结束。
· 结算：将通过出牌赢得的卡牌分数与侦查获得的分数相加，再按每张剩余手牌扣除1分。若本轮因一组牌连续一圈未被压过而结束，该组合的主人无须为剩余手牌扣分。
· 连续经过相当于玩家人数四倍的行动次数，仍无人打出更强组合时，立即结束本轮，并按当前局面结算(防僵局)。

en.name: SCOUT
en.desc: No rearranging your hand! Beat the set, or scout an end card
en.rules:
Goal: play as many rounds as there are players; the highest total score wins.
Cards:
· The deck has 45 double-ended cards, each showing a different pair of numbers — every pairing of 1–10.
· Your hand may never be rearranged once picked up. At the start of each round you may flip your whole hand (swapping the two ends of every card) as often as you like before confirming.
On your turn, choose one:
· Show: play an adjacent segment of your hand forming a set (equal values) or a run (consecutive values) that beats the current combination; the beaten combination is captured for 1 point per card.
· Scout: take either end card of the current combination and insert it into your hand at any position, either end up; the combination’s owner scores 1 point.
· Once per round you may Scout & Show: scout, then immediately play a combination that beats the table.
Beating: more cards wins; with equal counts a set beats a run; otherwise the higher value wins.
Round end:
· A round ends when someone empties their hand, or when a combination goes unbeaten for a full round of the table.
· Scoring: captured cards and scout income count positive; each card left in hand counts −1. The owner of an unbeaten combination is exempt from the hand penalty.
· If nobody captures for 4 turns per player in a row, the round is force-ended and scored as-is (anti-stall).

zh.name: 海草
zh.desc: 在海底扩展生物群落，探索并争夺珊瑚礁
zh.rules:
目标：研究生物群落和珊瑚礁获得分数，终局总分最高者获胜。
准备：
每人有四种生物各7块普通板块（5块单生物、2块双生物）及1块特殊板块。普通板块组成自己的暗牌库，起手抽5块。特殊板块公开放在手牌旁。每局使用与人数相同的相连区域，每区域有3座礁；其中随机一座为已探索礁。鹿角数量比礁的数量少1。
流程：
轮到你时，选择研究群落或研究礁，然后结算本回合完成的所有礁。
· 研究群落：从手牌连续放置1块或更多同种生物，可搭配该种特殊板块。每块必须邻接已探索礁或任意玩家任意种类的正面生物，所有新板块最后必须属于自己的同一个同种群落。不能放在岩石或未启用区域。每当生物接触未探索礁，该礁永久成为已探索礁。完成放置后，获得整个受影响群落的生物总数对应的分数，按生物只数而非板块数计算。手牌用完才从暗牌库抽1块，否则不抽。
· 研究礁：从手牌放1块普通板块作为牌背，邻接一座已探索礁并扩大它；落点不能同时邻接另一座礁。然后从自己的暗牌库补最多3块，手牌上限7块。牌库空后仍能研究礁；没有合法扩礁格时必须研究群落。
特殊生物：
特殊板块不能单独使用，必须搭配至少1块手牌中的同种普通板块。
· 特殊水母板块计为4只水母。
· 特殊海龟板块计为2只海龟，群落行动完整结束后立即额外研究一次礁（无扩礁格时按通用规则改为研究群落，无手牌时结束回合）。
· 特殊海星板块计为2只海星，本次放置必须恰好分属两个互不相邻的群落，两个群落都计分。
· 特殊螃蟹板块计为1只螃蟹，必须替换另一名玩家的一块正面生物，原块永久移除，本回合所放螃蟹仍须属于同一群落。
礁的结算：
回合结束时，若礁已完全被正面生物、岩石或区域边界包围，则该礁完成。统计每名玩家直接邻接该礁的生物只数，同一板块只计算一次。按礁的板块总数，第一名和第二名分别获得以下分数：
· 礁共有 1 块板块时，第一名和第二名均不得分。
· 礁共有 2 块板块时，第一名获得 4 分，第二名获得 2 分。
· 礁共有 3 块板块时，第一名获得 8 分，第二名获得 4 分。
· 礁共有 4 块板块时，第一名获得 16 分，第二名获得 8 分。
· 礁共有 5 块及以上板块时，第一名获得 24 分，第二名获得 12 分。
· 两人局中，第二名的生物数须达到第一名的一半才得分。只有一人邻接时不发第二名分数。
· 并列第一时，将第一名和第二名分数相加后均分给并列者，向上取整，其他人不得分。第一名独占、第二名并列时，第二名分数均分并向上取整。
· 每座完成的礁计分后放置1个鹿角，该礁以后不能扩展或再计分。
发现扩展：
可在开局设置中启用，默认关闭。每座礁起始有四种生物标记各1枚，某种生物首次接触时由该生物的主人领取对应标记；扩礁也能触发。扩礁同时首次触及多名玩家的同种生物时，本作按当前行动者起顺时针优先领取。集齐四种立即消耗一套获得10分，可重复；终局剩余标记每枚1分。礁完成时移除未领取标记。
结束：
放完最后一个鹿角，或任一玩家回合结束时手牌为空，游戏结束。若同回合完成所有剩余礁，即使最后一座没有鹿角也全部计分；未完成礁不计分。游戏中分数保密，自己可查看，终局公开。总分相同者比较手牌、牌库和未用特殊板块的总数，较多者获胜；仍相同则共同获胜。

en.name: Seagrass
en.desc: Grow creature colonies and compete to research the reefs
en.rules:
Goal: score the most points by researching colonies and reefs.
Setup:
Each player has seven regular tiles of each creature (five singles and two doubles) and one special of each type. Shuffle your regular tiles into your own hidden supply and draw five. Keep your specials face up beside your hand. Use connected regions equal to the number of players, with three reefs per region. One random reef starts explored. There is one fewer antler than reefs.
Play:
On your turn, Research Colony or Research Reef, then score all reefs completed this turn.
· Research Colony: play one or more matching regular tiles from your hand, optionally with the matching special. Each tile must touch an explored reef or any face-up creature tile. All newly played tiles must end in one of your colonies of that creature. Dark rocks and unused regions cannot be occupied. A reef touched by any face-up creature becomes permanently explored. Score the number of creatures in the entire affected colony, counting creatures rather than tiles. If your hand is empty, draw one tile; otherwise draw none.
· Research Reef: place one regular tile from your hand face down beside an explored reef, expanding it. The space cannot touch another reef. Draw up to three tiles, to a hand limit of seven. You may Research Reef with an empty supply. If no reef can expand, you must Research Colony instead.
Special creatures:
A special cannot be played alone: include at least one matching regular tile from your hand.
· The special jellyfish counts as four creatures.
· The special turtle counts as two and gives an immediate extra Research Reef action after fully resolving the colony (use the general Research Colony fallback if no reef can expand; end the turn if you have no tiles).
· The special starfish counts as two and requires this turn’s tiles to be split between exactly two nonadjacent colonies; score both.
· The special crab counts as one and must replace any opponent’s face-up creature tile, permanently removing it. All your newly played crabs must still belong to one colony.
Scoring reefs:
At the end of a turn, a reef surrounded completely by face-up creatures, rocks or the play-area edge is completed. Count each player’s creatures directly adjacent to it, counting each tile once. First and second place score according to the reef’s total tile count:
· With 1 tile, neither place scores points.
· With 2 tiles, first place scores 4 points and second place scores 2 points.
· With 3 tiles, first place scores 8 points and second place scores 4 points.
· With 4 tiles, first place scores 16 points and second place scores 8 points.
· With 5 or more tiles, first place scores 24 points and second place scores 12 points.
· In two-player games, second place needs at least half as many creatures as first to score. No second-place points are awarded if only one player touches the reef.
· Tied first: add first- and second-place points and divide among tied players, rounding up; nobody else scores. A sole first with tied second: divide second-place points among those tied, rounding up.
· Place an antler on each completed reef after scoring it. It cannot expand or score again.
Discovery expansion:
Optional, off by default. Each reef starts with one token of each creature type. The owner of the first creature of a type touching a reef claims its matching token. Reef expansion may also trigger this. If expansion first touches matching creatures belonging to multiple players simultaneously, this adaptation gives priority clockwise from the active player. Immediately spend each complete set of four different tokens to score ten points. Each leftover token scores one at the end. Unclaimed tokens are removed when a reef is completed.
End:
The game ends when the last antler is placed or a player ends their turn with an empty hand. If all remaining reefs complete in one turn, score all of them even without an antler for the final reef. Incomplete reefs do not score. Scores are hidden during play, except your own, and revealed at the end. Most points wins; tied players compare all unplayed tiles (hand, supply and unused specials), with more winning. A further tie is a shared victory.

zh.name: 寻找UAP
zh.desc: 转动双轨星空，调查卫星与流星，为未知飞行现象拍下证据。
zh.rules:
目标：
调查双轨中的天体，用正确照片得分，并寻找 UAP 及其三个邻居。分数最高者获胜。
准备：
基础版每轨8个扇区，专家版每轨12个；5人必须使用专家版。每格恰有一个天体。
· 月亮公开且在外轨，哈勃也在外轨并且不与月亮相邻。
· 国际空间站在内轨，至少邻接一块真实太空垃圾。
· 间谍卫星仅在内轨奇数扇区。
· 通讯卫星仅在偶数扇区。
· 流星雨：游戏开始时，成对占据内外轨中上下对应的两个扇区。
· 导航卫星：始终在同轨对径成对。
· 真实太空垃圾：不能连续占据三个扇区。
· UAP恰有一个，调查和锁定时显示为垃圾。
基础版间谍和通讯各1–2个，流星0／2／4／6个，导航2／4／6个，垃圾1–5个。专家版间谍和通讯各1–4个（通讯每轨至多2个），流星0／2／4／6／8个，导航2／4／6／8个，垃圾1–8个。月亮、哈勃、国际空间站各1个。
每人选择起始象限和初始线索难度。初学者获得8条排除线索，熟练者4条，天才0条。单人对抗仅依据自身情报行动的电脑研究员。
流程：
时间最落后的研究员行动，同格先到先行动。每次完成一项行动，按费用向前推进时间。移入相邻象限花费1点时间，移入对面的象限花费2点时间。
· 调查：本象限全部扇区花费1点时间，单轨或上下堆叠花费2点时间，单个扇区花费3点时间。选择一种天体，私下获知数量。垃圾数量包含UAP。
· 锁定：花费4点时间，私下获知本象限一个扇区中的天体。显示垃圾时也可能是UAP。
· 拍照：花费1点时间，选本象限尚未验证的扇区，放置一张相应天体的照片。基础版中，每人持有哈勃和国际空间站的照片各1张，通讯卫星和间谍卫星的照片各2张，导航卫星和流星雨的照片各6张。专家版中，通讯卫星、间谍卫星、导航卫星和流星雨的照片各增加2张。错误照片弃置。不能重复拍自己已有照片的扇区。
· 分析：任意玩家已验证通讯／导航／间谍卫星后，选择其A–F情报中的一项，私下获得固定线索。通讯与导航花费1点时间，间谍花费2点时间。未学过的另一项可在之后分析。
· 寻找UAP：花费5点时间，在任意象限选择UAP位置，再填写同轨两侧与当前上下堆叠的三个天体。四项全部正确才成功。只公布成功与否，不公布地点。
全体研究员每跨过一条粗线（3点时间），地球和内轨逆时针转动一格，外轨固定。研究员与象限随地球转动，扇区编号始终跟随原扇区。旋转后验证所有照片：正确照片公开留存，错误照片移除，持有者多花费1点时间。各玩家按自己的用时收到1–4份固定解密报告，不能主动分享未解密的内容。个人排除、确认与笔记仅自己可见。
象限修正：
可以为四个象限使用空白修正，也可以随机选择4种修正，或分别配置每个象限的修正。修正效果随象限转动，作用于该象限中的研究员；详细效果显示在象限资料中。跟车需要主动接受，移动本身花费0点时间。照片计分修正按终局所在象限决定。分析双情报、双类型调查和双锁定分别按对应修正执行。
结束与计分：
第一位成功寻找UAP的玩家获得10分，仍推进5点时间。其他落后1–5点时间的玩家按从后向前顺序获得一次最后机会：寻找UAP，成功获得落后时间乘2分；或在任意象限拍照，落后1／2点时间可拍1张，3／4点时间可拍2张，5点时间可拍3张。最后机会不再推进时间，也不能移动。
最后验证所有照片，终局错误照片不罚时间。正确哈勃、国际空间站每张4分，通讯、间谍每张3分，导航、流星每张2分。加上象限修正与寻找UAP的分数。总分相同时依次比较寻找UAP分数、正确照片数量、是否最先找到UAP；仍相同共同获胜。单人模式总分相同则电脑获胜。

en.name: The Search for UAPs
en.desc: Rotate the double orbit, investigate satellites and meteors, and photograph evidence of the unknown.
en.rules:
Goal:
Investigate the two orbits, score verified photographs and locate the UAP with all three neighbors. Highest score wins.
Setup:
Basic has 8 sectors per orbit; Expert has 12. Five players must use Expert. Each sector contains exactly one object.
· Luna is public in the outer orbit. Hubble is also in the outer orbit and never next to Luna.
· The ISS is in the inner orbit next to real space junk.
· Spy satellites occupy odd inner sectors.
· Communications satellites occupy even sectors.
· Meteors begin in stacked pairs.
· Navigation satellites are in opposite pairs in the same orbit.
· There are never three consecutive real space junk sectors.
· Exactly one UAP appears as space junk when surveyed or targeted.
Basic: 1–2 spies, 1–2 communications satellites, 0/2/4/6 meteors, 2/4/6 navigation satellites and 1–5 junk. Expert: 1–4 spies, 1–4 communications satellites (at most two per orbit), 0/2/4/6/8 meteors, 2/4/6/8 navigation satellites and 1–8 junk. Luna, Hubble and ISS each occur once.
Choose a starting quadrant and initial information: Beginner gives 8 exclusions, Experienced 4, Genius none. Solo includes a computer researcher acting only on its own information.
Play:
The researcher furthest back acts; earlier arrivals act first on tied spaces. Perform one action and advance by its time cost. Moving to an adjacent quadrant costs 1 time unit; moving to the opposite quadrant costs 2 time units.
· Survey: Surveying your entire quadrant costs 1 time unit. Surveying one orbit or one stack costs 2 time units; surveying a single sector costs 3 time units. Privately learn the count of one object. Junk counts include the UAP.
· Target: Spend 4 time units to privately learn the apparent object in one sector of your quadrant. Junk may be the UAP.
· Photo: Spend 1 time unit to place a photo in an unverified sector of your quadrant. Basic supply per player: one Hubble, one ISS, two communications, two spies, six navigation and six meteors. Expert adds two each of communications, spies, navigation and meteors. Incorrect photos are discarded. You cannot photograph a sector where you already have a photo.
· Analyze: once any player has a verified photo of the satellite type, select one of its A–F topics. Analyzing communications or navigation costs 1 time unit; analyzing spies costs 2 time units. Privately learn a fixed fact. Its other topic can be analyzed later.
· Find UAP: Spend 5 time units. Select its sector anywhere, then identify the two same-orbit neighbors and the current stacked neighbor. All four must be correct. Only success or failure is public, never the location.
Whenever all researchers cross a thick time-track line (every 3 time units), rotate Earth and the inner orbit one sector counterclockwise. The outer orbit stays fixed. Researchers and quadrant modifiers rotate with Earth; sector numbers stay with their original sectors. Verify all photos: correct photos remain face up; incorrect photos are removed and cost the owner 1 extra time unit. Each player privately receives 1–4 fixed declassified reports when their own time reaches the relevant spaces. Personal marks and notes are private.
Quadrant modifiers:
Use four blanks, four random modifiers or configure each quadrant. Effects rotate with their quadrant. Read the full effect in quadrant details. Following a researcher requires accepting the offer and costs no time. Photo scoring modifiers use the final quadrant. Quantum Computing, Grant Approval and Rapid Fire respectively grant two satellite topics, two survey types and two targets.
Ending and scoring:
The first player to find the UAP scores 10 and still advances 5 time units. Other researchers 1–5 time units behind get one final opportunity, back to front: locate the UAP for twice the time behind, or photograph any quadrant. Being 1 or 2 time units behind permits one photo; being 3 or 4 behind permits two; being 5 behind permits three. No time advances and no moving during final opportunities.
Verify remaining photos without time penalties. Each correct Hubble or ISS photo scores 4 points. Each correct communications or spy photo scores 3 points, and each correct navigation or meteor photo scores 2 points. Apply final quadrant modifiers and UAP points. Break score ties by UAP points, then verified photo count, then first to find the UAP; otherwise share victory. In solo, the computer wins tied total scores.

zh.name: SETI：搜寻地外文明
zh.desc: 探索旋转太阳系，研究科技，搜寻五种地外文明。2至4人，完整五轮，138张基础项目牌。
zh.rules:
游戏目标与准备：
通过探索行星、研究科技和寻找外星文明痕迹获得分数。基础版支持2至4人，进行完整五轮，使用138张各不相同的基础项目牌及本局两种文明的专属牌。
开局准备：
· 每位玩家获得 4 点信用、3 点能量、4 点推广和 5 张手牌。
· 按座次顺序，各玩家的起始分数依次为 1、2、3、4 分。
· 公开项目区放置 3 张牌；太阳系的初始位置随机确定。
· 本局使用两块尚未揭示身份的文明板，各有三个不同颜色的发现格。
· 从首位玩家开始，依次选择一张手牌放入自己的收入区。
· 立即获得牌底显示的 1 点资源；若牌底为卡牌图标，则从牌库抽取 1 张牌。
· 收入牌不再属于手牌，不能作为手牌打出或弃置。
· 所有玩家完成收入选择后，由首位玩家开始行动。
资源与卡牌：
· 信用用于发射、环绕、扫描和支付项目牌费用。
· 能量用于移动、环绕、着陆和分析；推广用于研究科技与购买卡牌。
· 推广最多保留 10 点；数据池最多保留 6 个数据，超出部分不保留。
· 已放入计算机的数据不占用数据池容量；信用和能量没有数量上限。
· 项目牌的费用、弃置收益、信号颜色和收入分别标示在牌面上。
· 打出项目牌、领取弃置收益和作为收入是不同用途，不能同时领取。
· 选择获得一张牌时，可选择一张公开项目，或从牌库顶抽取一张牌。
· 公开项目被拿取后补足至 3 张；效果另有补牌时机时，按该效果执行。
· 牌库耗尽时，将弃牌堆洗混作为新牌库。
回合流程：
· 玩家按座次轮流行动，已经退出本轮的玩家不再获得自己的行动回合。
· 每个回合执行一个主行动。发射、环绕、着陆、扫描和分析均为主行动。
· 打出项目牌、研究科技和退出本轮也各占用一个主行动。
· 可在主行动之前、之后，以及效果允许的间隙执行自由行动。
· 一个自由行动及其奖励必须全部完成，才能开始另一个自由行动。
· 任务奖励需要作出选择时，先完成该次选择及奖励，再继续当前行动。
· 主行动及其效果完成后，结算所有已经填满的扇区。
· 扇区全部结算后，可继续执行自由行动，再选择“结束回合”。
发射探测器：
· 支付 2 点信用，将一个探测器放置在地球所在的格位。
· 未获得“双探测器”科技时，每位玩家在太空中最多拥有一个探测器。
· 环绕器和着陆器不计入此上限；发射本身不视为访问地球。
探测器移动：
· 支付 1 点能量，可将自己的一个探测器移动到相邻格位。
· 相邻格位包括同一轨道环左右两格，以及同一扇区相邻轨道环的格位。
· 不能斜向移动、穿过太阳，或移出太阳系最外侧的轨道环。
· 离开小行星格位消耗 2 次移动；“小行星导航”科技可取消额外消耗。
· 卡牌或科技提供的移动可用于自己的探测器；移动不足时可支付能量补足。
· 例如，离开小行星需要 2 次移动；仅有 1 次可用移动时，须额外支付1点能量。
· 拥有两个探测器时，同一次效果提供的移动可以分配给这两个探测器。
· 可提前结束一次移动效果；未使用的移动不保留到之后的效果或回合。
· 进入地球以外的行星格位或彗星格位时，获得 1 点推广。
· 再次进入这些格位仍可获得推广；停留在原格位不会重复获得奖励。
太阳系旋转：
· 研究科技，以及本轮首位玩家确认退出时，均会触发一次旋转。
· 旋转依次使用顶盘、中盘、底盘；每次逆时针旋转一个扇区。
· 旋转中盘或底盘时，其上方的转盘也随之旋转。
· 探测器随承载它的转盘移动；随盘移动不视为重新访问原有格位。
· 切口中的探测器可能保持原位，也可能被转盘边缘推动至相邻扇区。
· 被盘缘推动进入新格位时，按新格位处理推广和访问任务。
进入行星轨道：
· 自己的探测器位于地球以外的行星格位时，可以执行环绕主行动。
· 支付 1 点信用和 1 点能量，将该探测器移至对应行星的环绕轨道。
· 若首次环绕奖励位置尚未被占用，将环绕器放入该位置并获得 3 分。
· 每次环绕均获得该行星列出的环绕奖励；具体效果见行星详情。
· 环绕器不再是可移动的探测器，不能继续在太阳系格位之间移动。
行星与卫星着陆：
· 自己的探测器位于地球以外的行星格位时，可以执行着陆主行动。
· 着陆通常支付 3 点能量；该行星已有任意玩家的环绕器时，减少 1 点。
· 拥有“着陆改进”科技时再减少 1 点能量，两项减免可以同时生效。
· 例如，行星已有环绕器，且你拥有“着陆改进”时，着陆支付 1 点能量。
· 在行星上着陆时，获得该行星的着陆分数，并标记一次生命痕迹。
· 若有未占用的首次着陆位置，选择其中一个，并获得该位置的数据奖励。
· 首次着陆位置已全部占用时，仍可着陆，但不再获得该项数据奖励。
· 拥有“卫星探测”科技后，可改在该行星的卫星上着陆。
· 卫星着陆适用同一能量费用；通常每颗卫星只能容纳一个着陆器。
· 卫星着陆只获得该卫星列出的奖励，不同时获得行星着陆奖励。
· 着陆后，探测器成为着陆器，不能继续移动；卡牌例外以卡牌说明为准。
扫描：
· 支付 1 点信用和 2 点能量，执行一次扫描；不要求太空中有探测器。
· 基础扫描包含两个步骤：扫描地球扇区，以及弃置一张公开项目并标记信号。
· 扫描地球扇区时，在地球所在扇区放置一个自己的信号。
· 弃置公开项目时，在与该牌信号颜色相同的一个扇区放置一个信号。
· 同一颜色对应多个扇区时，从中选择一个；此处使用牌面右上角的颜色。
· 两个基础步骤的顺序可以自选；完成两步后才能结束扫描。
· 科技提供的额外步骤可穿插执行；每种额外步骤每次扫描至多执行一次。
· 扫描中的公开项目在整次扫描完成后补足；多张公开牌效果先全部弃置，再补牌。
信号奖励与扇区结算：
· 在信号轨道尚未填满的扇区放置信号时，获得 1 个数据。
· 放置该扇区的第二个信号时，额外获得 2 分，不论第一个信号属于谁。
· 扇区填满后仍可继续放置信号，计入竞争数量，但不再获得上述奖励。
· 主行动完成后，由当前回合的玩家选择已经填满的扇区逐一结算。
· 结算时，在该扇区拥有至少一个信号的每位玩家均获得 1 点推广。
· 信号最多的玩家获胜，并获得该扇区本次结算对应的分数。
· 数量并列时，比较并列玩家最后一次放置信号的时间，较晚放置者优先。
· 该比较方式也用于确定第二名；只有第二名保留一个信号，其余信号清除。
· 某扇区第一次结算时，获胜者获得一次标记信号痕迹的机会。
· 天狼星 A、比邻星、室女座 61 和绘架座 β 的后续胜利也给予信号痕迹。
· 获胜记录保留，但不作为该扇区下一次结算时的信号数量。
· 获胜者自行选择痕迹的放置位置，即使此时并非该玩家的行动回合。
计算机与数据：
· 放置数据是自由行动：从数据池取出一个数据，放入计算机上排。
· 上排必须从左至右连续放置，每次放入最左侧的空格。
· 未安装科技时，第二格给予 1 点推广，第四格允许增加一张收入牌。
· 增加收入时，从手牌选择一张放入收入区，并立即获得其收入；也可放弃。
· 上排格位已安装计算机科技时，放入数据改为获得 2 分。
· 科技下排格位只有在对应上排已有数据时才能放置数据。
· 下排不要求从左至右放置；每次消耗一个数据，并获得该科技的下排奖励。
· 已有数据的格位不能再次放置；每次放置数据各视为一次自由行动。
分析数据：
· 计算机上排六格全部放入数据后，可支付 1 点能量执行分析主行动。
· 分析移除计算机上下两排的全部数据，并获得一次标记分析痕迹的机会。
· 移除的数据不退回数据池；数据池原有的数据和已安装科技均保留。
研究科技：
· 支付 6 点推广执行研究主行动，先旋转太阳系，再选择一项科技。
· 科技分为探测器、望远镜和计算机三类，每类有四种。
· 只能选择自己尚未拥有、且仍有剩余板块的科技。
· 全局首位研究某种科技的玩家，额外获得 2 分。
· 每次研究还会获得所领取板块显示的即时奖励，并执行该科技的获得效果。
· 即时奖励可能为 1 点推广、1 点能量、选择一张牌，或获得 3 分。
· 卡牌提供的研究不另支付 6 点推广，但仍须旋转并遵守科技类别限制。
探测器科技：
· 双探测器：太空中的探测器上限提高至两个，获得时可免费发射一个。
· 小行星导航：离开小行星不再额外消耗移动，进入小行星格位获得 1 点推广。
· 着陆改进：行星和卫星着陆的能量费用减少 1 点。
· 卫星探测：允许在对应行星的卫星上着陆，按卫星奖励结算。
望远镜科技：
· 拓展观测：获得时取得 2 个数据；地球扫描可改在相邻的一个扇区进行。
· 项目观测：扫描时可从手牌弃置一张牌，在对应信号颜色的扇区额外标记一次。
· 水星观测：扫描时可支付 1 点推广，在水星所在扇区额外标记一次信号。
· 协同发射：扫描时可支付 1 点能量发射一个探测器，或免费获得 1 次移动。
· 协同发射的两种效果只能选择一种；发射仍须满足探测器数量上限。
计算机科技：
· 领取计算机科技后，将它安装到计算机中任意一个尚未安装科技的位置。
· 可以安装到已有数据的位置，但不会因此再次获得该位置的奖励。
· 四种计算机科技的上排奖励均为 2 分，替代该格原有奖励。
· 推广计算机的下排奖励为 2 点推广。
· 项目计算机的下排奖励允许选择获得一张牌。
· 能量计算机的下排奖励为 1 点能量。
· 信用计算机的下排奖励为 1 点信用。
其他自由行动：
· 从手牌弃置一张牌，获得其左上角显示的 1 点资源或 1 次移动。
· 支付 2 点信用，可获得 1 点能量，或选择获得一张牌。
· 支付 2 点能量，可获得 1 点信用，或选择获得一张牌。
· 从手牌弃置两张牌，可获得 1 点信用、1 点能量或选择获得一张牌。
· 支付 3 点推广，可获得一张公开项目，或从牌库顶抽取一张牌。
· 为扫描、交换或退出本轮而弃置卡牌时，不领取左上角的弃置收益。
· 移动探测器、放置数据和领取符合条件的任务奖励也属于自由行动。
· 自由行动没有统一次数上限，但每次都须满足资源和效果条件。
项目牌与任务：
· 打出项目牌时，从手牌选择一张，支付其信用费用，并依次执行牌面效果。
· 任务牌和需要保留的项目放入个人区域；其余项目执行后进入弃牌堆。
· 事件任务只记录该任务牌打出后发生的事件，不能追溯之前的行动。
· 同一事件在自己所有事件任务中，最多领取一个尚未领取的奖励。
· 可以放弃本次事件奖励；同一事件不能留待之后再领取。
· 每个任务奖励圈只能领取一次；已经标记的奖励圈不能重复使用。
· 先驱者 11 号任务：自己的探测器之后访问木星获得 1 个数据，访问土星获得 4 分。
· 望远镜时间分配：之后每完成一次扫描，可领取一个未完成奖励圈，在对应颜色的扇区标记信号。
· 轨道修正是即时项目：本回合发生过同环移动时，获得3分和1点推广。
· 条件任务可以检查本回合已经发生的移动，与事件任务的触发方式不同。
文明痕迹与发现：
三种文明痕迹的颜色对应关系如下：
· 红色：信号痕迹。
· 黄色：生命痕迹。
· 蓝色：分析痕迹。
获得痕迹时，可以选择任意文明中颜色相符的空发现格，或已发现文明的研究位置。发现格给予1点推广，左侧文明另获得5分，右侧获得3分。也可以放入任一文明的溢出区获得3分；溢出标记保留所选颜色，计入痕迹数量。研究位置按所示奖励结算，部分需要支付数据或地外化石；最上方有无限标记的位置可以重复使用。
三个发现格均填满时，在回合结束且里程碑处理完后揭示文明。每位玩家按自己的发现格标记数量取得文明牌。普通文明牌可以作为手牌、弃置或收入；钻探者牌另行保管。
回合结束的里程碑：
达到25、50、70分时，分别标记一块自己未标记的黄金板块，按全体玩家选择该板块的先后占据档位。四块板块在准备时分别随机选择正面或反面。所有玩家按当前回合玩家起的座次处理自己的黄金与文明里程碑，不可在此期间执行自由行动。
两人局在20分、30分各有两个中立标记；三人局各一个；四人局没有。每位玩家首次达到相应分数时只取一个尚有剩余的中立标记，按从左至右的顺序放入空发现格。中立标记不奖励玩家，可能促成发现。中立里程碑最后处理。
退出与五轮流程：
退出本轮是主行动。选择退出前可以执行自由行动，之后按顺序将手牌弃至4张；若为本轮首位退出者，旋转太阳系；再从该轮私有候选牌中选择1张。前四轮各有一堆人数加一张的轮末牌。可以延迟决定，直到下一位玩家退出时交接；候选牌只供持有者查看。第五轮仍须旋转，但没有轮末选牌。
所有玩家退出并完成选牌后，弃置候选堆最后一张牌。前四轮结束时，每人获得3点信用、2点能量、从牌库抽1张牌，以及收入区所有牌的收入；再将起始玩家顺移一位，开始下一轮。
五种文明：
· 硫铵虫：木星和土星各有3个秘密样本，另1个公开成为蓝色研究位置。指定文明牌允许采集样本：查看所在行星的所有样本，秘密选择一个，放置样本舱。样本舱按探测器移动，不计入探测器上限，不可环绕或着陆。可以用自己的任意样本舱完成对应目的地的运输任务；交付时领取样本奖励，并将样本公开放到文明板上，成为新的蓝色研究位置。
· 异常点：在地球扇区及其左右相隔三个扇区的最外环，各放一个随机面的异常点。每次太阳系旋转后，若地球与异常点在同一扇区，对应颜色研究列中位置最高的玩家领取奖励；最高位置可重复标记，后来者在上。访问异常点不提供奖励。
· 奥陌陌：将奥陌陌放到第三转盘的指定格位；它视为行星，访问获得1点推广，可环绕或着陆。奥陌陌所在扇区的信号可以改放到其独立信号槽；第一格获得1分，第三格获得2分，每个未填满槽位仍提供数据。主行动后填满时，参与玩家各获得1个地外化石，清空并补满信号槽，不产生扇区胜者。化石用于部分研究位置和卡牌，剩余化石不计分。
· 半人马族：发现时每人设置一个当前分数加15的消息阈值；达到后选择一项尚可用的文明奖励。该文明牌支付能量，每打出一张，再设置一个当前分数加15的阈值，先执行白色区域，达到阈值后按发送顺序执行绿色区域。消息牌不算任务。研究位置的数据费用只能从数据池支付。
· 钻探者：发现时每人取得3张秘密牌，再按自己的发现贡献各多取1张，每份贡献可立即秘密打出1张。以发现时领先者分数加20、加40设置两个阈值；每人达到时可再秘密打出1张，第二个阈值需要支付1点信用。秘密牌不属于手牌，不能弃置或作为收入，也不算任务或终局项目。文明研究位置另增加公开危险值。
终局与胜负：
第五轮全部玩家退出，且最后一次旋转、任务响应、里程碑和发现均处理完毕后，先计已打出的终局项目，再计黄金板块，最后揭示钻探者秘密项目并按条件加分。
黄金板块按自己占据的档位，逐组计算科技组合、已完成任务、收入组合、三色痕迹组合或扇区胜利与棋件组合；只计算放入收入区的牌，不计每轮固定获得的3点信用、2点能量和1张随机牌。事件任务所有奖励圈均完成才算完成一张任务。《索尔维会议》额外选择一块自己未标记的黄金板块，按最右档计分。
最后合计公开危险值和已打出秘密牌的危险值，危险最高的所有玩家各扣除总分十分之一，向下取整。总分最高者获胜，同分并列。基础版仅支持2至4人，不包含官方单人对手、Space Agencies扩展及Promo牌。

en.name: SETI: Search for Extraterrestrial Intelligence
en.desc: Explore a rotating solar system, research technologies and discover five alien species. A complete five-round base game for 2–4 players with 138 distinct projects.
en.rules:
Goal and setup:
Earn points by exploring planets, researching technologies and finding traces of extraterrestrial life. The base game supports 2–4 players for five complete rounds, using 138 distinct base projects and the cards of the two species in play.
Setup:
· Each player receives 4 credits, 3 energy, 4 publicity, and 5 hand cards.
· Starting scores are 1, 2, 3, and 4 points in seating order, using only the occupied seats.
· Place 3 cards in the project market. The starting positions of the solar-system discs are randomized.
· Two civilizations begin with their identities hidden. Each has three discovery spaces of different colors.
· Starting with the first player, each player places one card from their hand in their income area.
· Immediately gain the 1 resource shown at the bottom of that card, or draw 1 card from the deck if it shows a card.
· An income card is no longer in your hand and cannot be played or discarded as a hand card.
· Once every player has chosen an income card, the first player begins their turn.
Resources and cards:
· Credits pay for launching, orbiting, scanning, and playing project cards.
· Energy pays for movement, orbiting, landing, and analysis. Publicity pays for research and card purchases.
· You may hold at most 10 publicity and 6 data in your pool. Any excess is lost.
· Data in your computer does not count toward your pool limit. Credits and energy have no holding limit.
· Each project card shows its play cost, discard benefit, signal color, and income.
· Playing a card, discarding it for its benefit, and placing it as income are separate uses. Do not combine their rewards.
· When instructed to choose a card, take one project from the market or draw the top card of the deck.
· Refill the market to 3 cards after taking a card, unless the effect specifies a different refill timing.
· When the deck is exhausted, shuffle the discard pile to form a new deck.
Turn sequence:
· Take turns in seating order. Players who have passed for the round receive no further turns of their own.
· Perform one main action per turn. Launching, orbiting, landing, scanning, and analysis are main actions.
· Playing a project, researching a technology, and passing for the round also each use one main action.
· You may take free actions before or after your main action, and between effects when permitted.
· Complete a free action and all its resulting rewards before starting another free action.
· When a mission reward requires a decision, resolve that decision and its reward before continuing the current action.
· After your main action and its effects are complete, resolve every sector whose signal track is full.
· After all such sectors are resolved, you may take further free actions, then select End turn.
Launching probes:
· Pay 2 credits to place one probe in the space containing Earth.
· Without Two probes technology, you may have at most one probe in space.
· Orbiters and landers do not count toward this limit. Launching does not count as visiting Earth.
Moving probes:
· As a free action, pay 1 energy to move one of your probes to an adjacent space.
· Adjacent spaces are the two neighboring sectors on the same ring and the neighboring rings in the same sector.
· You cannot move diagonally, through the Sun, or beyond the outermost ring.
· Leaving an asteroid space costs 2 movement. Asteroid navigation removes this additional cost.
· Movement granted by cards or technologies may move your own probes. Pay energy to cover any movement shortfall.
· For example, leaving an asteroid costs 2 movement. With only 1 granted movement available, pay 1 additional energy.
· If you have two probes, you may divide the movement from one effect between them.
· You may end a movement effect early. Unused movement is not saved for later effects or turns.
· Gain 1 publicity when entering a space containing a planet other than Earth, or a comet.
· Entering such a space again can grant publicity again. Remaining in the same space grants no repeated reward.
Rotating the discs:
· Researching a technology and the first player confirming their pass each trigger one rotation.
· Rotate the top, middle, and bottom discs in that order, advancing one sector counterclockwise each time.
· Rotating the middle or bottom disc also rotates every disc above it.
· A probe moves with its supporting disc. Being carried on that disc is not a new visit to its existing space.
· A probe in a cutout may remain in place or be pushed into the neighboring sector by a disc edge.
· If a disc edge pushes a probe into a new space, resolve that space for publicity and visit missions.
Entering orbit:
· You may take the orbit main action with your own probe in a space containing a planet other than Earth.
· Pay 1 credit and 1 energy, then move that probe to the planet’s orbit.
· If the first-orbiter reward space is unoccupied, place your orbiter there and gain 3 points.
· Every orbit action grants the orbit rewards listed for that planet. Consult its details for the individual rewards.
· An orbiter is no longer a movable probe and cannot move between solar-system spaces.
Landing:
· You may take the land main action with your own probe in a space containing a planet other than Earth.
· Landing normally costs 3 energy. Reduce the cost by 1 if any player has an orbiter at that planet.
· Improved landing reduces the cost by a further 1 energy. Both reductions may apply together.
· For example, landing costs 1 energy if an orbiter is present and you have Improved landing.
· Landing on a planet grants its landing points and one life trace.
· If an unoccupied first-landing space remains, choose one and gain its data reward.
· You may still land when all first-landing spaces are occupied, but receive no first-landing data reward.
· Moon exploration allows you to land on one of that planet’s moons instead.
· Landing on a moon uses the same energy cost. Normally, each moon can hold only one lander.
· Landing on a moon grants its listed rewards instead of the planet’s landing rewards.
· After landing, the probe becomes a lander and cannot move. Follow any exceptions stated by the card used.
Scanning:
· Pay 1 credit and 2 energy to scan. You do not need a probe in space.
· A basic scan has two steps: mark Earth’s sector, and discard one market project to mark a signal.
· For the Earth step, place one of your signals in the sector currently containing Earth.
· For the market step, discard one market project and place one signal in a sector matching its signal color.
· If several sectors match, choose one. Use the signal color shown at the top right of the card.
· Resolve the two basic steps in either order. Complete both before ending the scan.
· You may interleave additional technology steps. Each such step can be taken at most once per scan.
· Refill the card row after the entire scan. For multi-card effects, finish all required discards before refilling.
Signals and sectors:
· Placing a signal in a sector whose track is not yet full grants 1 data.
· Placing the second signal grants an additional 2 points, regardless of who placed the first signal.
· Further signals may be placed after the track is full. They count toward control but grant neither of those placement rewards.
· After the main action, the current player chooses the order in which completed sectors are resolved.
· Each player with at least one signal in that sector gains 1 publicity when it is resolved.
· The player with the most signals wins and gains the points applicable to that resolution of the sector.
· Break a tie by comparing the tied players’ last placements in that sector. The later placement ranks higher.
· Use the same comparison to determine second place. Only the runner-up keeps one signal; remove all other signals.
· On a sector’s first resolution, its winner receives one signal trace.
· Later victories at Sirius A, Proxima Centauri, 61 Virginis, and Beta Pictoris also grant a signal trace.
· Victory records remain, but do not count as signals in the next resolution of that sector.
· The winner chooses where to place their trace, even if it is another player’s turn.
Computer and data:
· Placing data is a free action. Spend one data from your pool to fill a space in your computer’s top row.
· Fill the top row from left to right, always using its leftmost empty space.
· Without installed technology, the second space grants 1 publicity and the fourth allows you to add an income card.
· To add income, place one hand card in your income area and receive its income immediately. You may decline.
· If computer technology is installed in the top space, placing data there grants 2 points instead.
· An installed technology’s lower space may be filled only if its top space already contains data.
· Lower spaces need not be filled left to right. Each placement costs one data and grants that technology’s lower reward.
· An occupied space cannot receive another data. Each individual data placement is a separate free action.
Analyzing data:
· When all six top spaces are filled, pay 1 energy to take the analyze main action.
· Analysis removes all data from both rows and grants one analysis trace.
· Removed data does not return to your pool. Existing pool data and installed technologies remain.
Research:
· Pay 6 publicity for the research main action. Rotate the solar system before choosing a technology.
· Technologies belong to three families: probe, telescope, and computer, with four technologies in each family.
· Choose a technology you do not already own and for which a tile remains available.
· The first player in the game to research a particular technology gains an additional 2 points.
· Each research also grants the immediate reward on the tile taken and any acquisition effect of that technology.
· An immediate tile reward is 1 publicity, 1 energy, a chosen card, or 3 points.
· Research granted by a card does not cost an additional 6 publicity, but still rotates the discs and obeys its family restriction.
Probe technologies:
· Two probes increases your limit in space to two probes and grants a free launch when acquired.
· Asteroid navigation removes the extra movement cost for leaving asteroids and grants 1 publicity when entering one.
· Improved landing reduces the energy cost of landing on planets and moons by 1.
· Moon exploration allows landing on a planet’s moons to receive the rewards of the chosen moon.
Telescope abilities:
· Extended observation grants 2 data when acquired and allows the Earth scan step to target either adjacent sector instead.
· Project observation adds an optional scan step: discard one hand card to mark a sector matching its signal color.
· Mercury observation adds an optional scan step: pay 1 publicity to mark the sector containing Mercury.
· Launch coordination adds an optional scan step: pay 1 energy to launch a probe, or gain 1 free movement.
· Choose only one of Launch coordination’s two effects. Its launch must obey your probe limit.
Computer technology:
· After acquiring computer technology, install it in any computer column that has no installed technology.
· You may install it beneath existing data, but installation does not award that space’s reward again.
· All four computer technologies give 2 points for top-row placement, replacing the space’s original reward.
· Publicity computer grants 2 publicity in its lower space.
· Project computer grants a chosen card.
· Energy computer grants 1 energy in its lower space.
· Credit computer grants 1 credit.
Other free actions:
· Discard one hand card to gain the 1 resource or 1 movement shown at its top left.
· Pay 2 credits to gain 1 energy or choose a card.
· Pay 2 energy to gain 1 credit or choose a card.
· Discard two hand cards to gain 1 credit, gain 1 energy, or choose a card.
· Pay 3 publicity to take one market project or draw the top card of the deck.
· Cards discarded for scanning, exchanging, or passing do not grant their top-left discard benefits.
· Moving probes, placing data, and claiming eligible conditional-mission rewards are also free actions.
· Free actions have no general per-turn limit, but each must meet its own resource and effect requirements.
Cards and missions:
· To play a project, choose one card from your hand, pay its credit cost, and resolve its effects in order.
· Keep mission cards and projects that must remain in play in your personal area. Discard other projects after resolving them.
· Event missions respond only to events that occur after the mission card was played. Earlier actions do not count.
· A single event can claim at most one unclaimed reward across all your event missions.
· You may decline an event reward, but cannot save that event to claim later.
· Each mission reward circle may be claimed only once. A marked circle cannot be used again.
· Pioneer 11 Mission grants 1 data for a later visit by your probe to Jupiter and 4 points for a later visit to Saturn.
· After each later scan, Telescope Time Allocation may mark a signal in the colour of one unclaimed reward circle.
· Trajectory Correction is an immediate project. Gain 3 points and 1 publicity if you moved within a ring this turn.
· A conditional mission may use movement that already occurred this turn, unlike an event mission.
Traces and discoveries:
Trace colors are as follows:
· Red: signal trace.
· Yellow: life trace.
· Blue: analysis trace.
Mark an empty discovery space or an available research space of the corresponding colour on either revealed species board. Discovery spaces give 1 publicity and 5 points on the left species or 3 on the right. You may instead use either overflow area for 3 points, retaining the chosen colour for trace counts. Research spaces grant their depicted rewards and may cost pool data or exofossils. Spaces marked as repeatable remain available.
Once all three discovery spaces are filled, reveal the species after end-turn milestones. Players receive one species card per discovery marker they placed. Regular alien cards may be held, discarded or tucked; Exertian cards are kept separately.
End-turn milestones:
At 25, 50 and 70 points, mark a gold tile you have not previously marked. Claim its value according to the order in which players choose that tile. Randomly select one side of each of the four tiles during setup. Starting with the player whose turn just ended, resolve each player’s gold and alien milestones in seating order. No free actions are allowed during this process.
At both 20 and 30 points, two-player games have two neutral markers and three-player games have one. Each player reaching that threshold takes only one remaining marker, placing it in the leftmost empty discovery space. Neutral markers grant no player rewards and may cause a discovery. Resolve neutral milestones last. Four-player games use none.
Passing and five rounds:
Passing is a main action. Take any desired free actions beforehand. Then discard to 4 hand cards; rotate the solar system if you are the first player to pass this round; choose one card from the round’s private offer. Prepare four end-of-round piles with one more card than the player count. You may defer your choice until the next player passes. Only the current holder sees the offer. In round five the first passer still rotates, but no cards are offered.
When all players have passed and chosen, discard the offer’s last card. After rounds one through four, each player gains 3 credits, 2 energy, 1 random deck card and all tucked income. Pass the starting-player marker to the next seat and begin the next round.
Five alien species:
· Mascamites: Jupiter and Saturn each receive three hidden samples; the remaining sample becomes a public blue research space. Specific cards allow collection: inspect all samples at that planet, secretly select one and place a capsule. Capsules move like probes, do not count toward the probe limit, and cannot orbit or land. Deliver any of your capsules to a mission’s destination to claim its reward. The delivered sample becomes a new public blue research space.
· Anomalies: place three randomly sided anomaly tokens in the outermost ring, in Earth’s sector and three sectors in either direction. After every rotation, trigger an anomaly sharing Earth’s sector. The highest marker on the matching research column gains its reward. The top space is repeatable and later markers go above earlier ones. Visiting anomalies grants nothing.
· ‘Oumuamua: place its tile in the designated space on disc three. It counts as a planet, grants 1 publicity per visit and may be orbited or landed on. Signals in its sector may be marked on its separate track instead. The first and third slots give 1 and 2 points, and unfilled slots grant data. Resolve a completed track after the main action: each participant gains 1 exofossil, then clear and refill it, with no sector winner. Exofossils pay for some research spaces and card effects; unused ones score nothing.
· Centaurians: on discovery, each player places a message milestone 15 points ahead of their score. On reaching it, claim one available board reward. Centaurian cards cost energy. Playing one creates another milestone 15 points ahead: resolve its white section immediately, then its green section when reached, in sending order. Messages are not missions. Research data costs must be paid from the data pool.
· Exertians: on discovery, deal three secret cards per player plus one per discovery contribution. Each contribution also allows one immediate face-down play. Set two milestones at 20 and 40 points ahead of the discovery-time leader. Each player may play one secret card upon reaching each; the second costs 1 credit. Secret cards are not hand cards, cannot be discarded or tucked, and are neither missions nor end-game scoring cards. Research spaces also add public danger.
Final scoring and winning:
After all players pass in round five, finish the last rotation, mission responses, milestones and discoveries. Score played end-game projects, then gold tiles, then reveal and score Exertian projects whose conditions are met.
Gold tiles score their depicted sets of technologies, completed missions, tucked income, trace colours, or sector wins paired with orbiters or landers, at the value you claimed. The fixed per-round income of 3 credits, 2 energy and 1 random card does not count. A triggered mission is complete only when all its reward circles are marked. Solvay Conference additionally scores an unmarked gold tile at its rightmost value.
Finally, add public danger to the danger on played secret cards. Every player tied for the most danger loses one tenth of their total points, rounded down. Highest score wins; ties share victory. This implementation covers the 2–4 player base game, excluding the official solo rival, Space Agencies expansion and promo cards.

zh.name: 天合小队
zh.desc: 正副驾驶合作开飞机:管姿态、控速度、清航道,7 轮内安全着陆
zh.rules:
目标:机长与副驾驶合作,在 7 轮内让飞机安全着陆。
流程(每轮):
· 先讨论战术,双方都点「就绪」后掷骰,此后不得再交谈。
· 每人 4 颗骰子,轮流将 1 颗放进驾驶盘槽位;先手按高度轨箭头交替。
· 姿态位和引擎位必须放置骰子：每名玩家每轮必须在这两类位置各放置 1 颗骰子。任何一个必需位置缺少骰子，都会导致飞机坠毁。
槽位:
· 姿态:两颗骰的差值使飞机向大的一侧倾斜,触到 ✕ 立即坠毁;倾斜跨轮不回正。
· 引擎：将两颗引擎骰子的点数之和与速度表上的蓝色、橙色标记比较，按比较结果使飞机前进0格、1格或2格。
· 飞机必须前进时，若当前格仍有其他飞机，会发生相撞；若已经到达机场却仍须前进，则会冲出跑道。
· 无线电：根据放置骰子的点数，清除对应位置的1架飞机。点数1对应当前格，此后每增加1点，目标位置就向前增加1格。
· 起落架(机长):可按任意顺序展开,每展开 1 个,蓝色速度标记前进 1 格。
· 襟翼(副驾驶):必须按顺序展开,每展开 1 个,橙色速度标记前进 1 格。
· 刹车（机长）：依次使用点数为2、4、6的骰子展开刹车。着陆时，两颗引擎骰子的点数之和不得超过刹车值。
· 专注力:获得 1 杯咖啡(至多存 3 杯);放骰时可花 1 杯咖啡,将点数加 1 或减 1。
· 重掷：高度标记离开6000和2000格时，各获得1枚重掷标记。花费1枚重掷标记后，双方各重新投掷一次骰子。
着陆(第 7 轮):
· 引擎之和改为与刹车值比较,本轮不再前进。
· 轮末安全着陆需同时满足:航道无飞机、起落架与襟翼全部展开、姿态回正、速度不超刹车值。

en.name: Sky Team
en.desc: Co-op cockpit: manage tilt, speed and traffic — land in 7 rounds
en.rules:
Goal: pilot and co-pilot work together to land the plane within 7 rounds.
Each round:
· Discuss tactics, then both tap "Ready" to roll (no talking afterwards!).
· Each player rolls 4 dice and takes turns placing one into a cockpit slot; the first player alternates by round.
· Axis and engines are mandatory: each player must place one die on each, or you crash.
Slots:
· Axis: the dice difference tilts the plane toward the higher side; reaching ✕ crashes. Tilt does not reset between rounds.
· Engines: Compare the total of the two engine dice with the blue and orange speed markers. Move the plane 0, 1 or 2 spaces according to the result.
· Moving while a plane shares your space is a collision; moving while at the airport is an overshoot.
· Radio: Remove one plane from the space indicated by the die. A value of 1 indicates your current space; each additional point indicates one space further ahead.
· Landing gear (pilot): Deploy the landing gear in any order. Each deployment advances the blue speed marker by 1 space.
· Flaps (co-pilot): must be deployed in order; each one advances the orange speed marker by 1.
· Brakes (pilot): Deploy the brakes using dice showing 2, then 4, then 6. When landing, the total of the engine dice must not exceed the brake value.
· Concentration: gain 1 coffee (max 3 stored); when placing a die, spend 1 coffee to adjust its value up or down by 1.
· Reroll: leaving the 6000/2000 altitude steps collects a token; spend 1 so both players get one reroll.
Final round (round 7):
· The engine sum is now compared against the brakes, and the plane no longer moves.
· Land safely only if all hold at round end: no planes left, gear and flaps fully open, axis level, speed within brakes.

zh.name: 沉睡的神祇
zh.desc: 驾驶曼蒂科尔号探索漂泊之海，寻找图腾，唤醒沉睡的神祇。
zh.rules:
你们共同控制九名船员，驾驶曼蒂科尔号探索漂泊之海。寻找图腾、完成任务，并在事件牌堆耗尽三次以前准备迎接最后的考验。
准备：每位玩家获得 1 枚指挥标记和 1 张能力牌。船上有 3 枚钱币和 1 份谷物；船长由当前玩家控制，其余船员尽量平均分配。
回合：依次完成以下步骤。
· 选择一个与上回合不同且仍可使用的船舶房间，结算该房间的效果。
· 抽取并结算一张事件牌。
· 执行两次行动。每次可以选择航行、探索、市场或港口，也可以放弃这次行动，改为获得 1 枚指挥标记。
挑战：派出具有相应技能且至少还有 1 点生命、疲劳未满的船员，参加者获得 1 点疲劳。其他玩家支付 1 枚指挥标记后可以派出自己的船员。低士气船员额外花费 1 枚指挥标记。技能总值加上命运点数，达到难度则成功；可以弃掉手中相应技能的能力牌，每张增加 1 点。
航行：至多派出一名自己的船员参加技艺挑战。结果 0–3、4–6、7–8、9 及以上分别允许移动 1、2、3、4 个相邻海域。进入有危害的海域时结算对应挑战。
战斗：所有玩家合计获得 4 枚战斗行动标记，每名船员每轮最多攻击两次。命运加精准达到敌人防御则命中，未命中仍造成 1 点伤害，但不能使用武器格挡。伤害在敌人的相邻格子上放置，心脏必须完整覆盖。目标敌人存活时会反击；一轮结束时，存活敌人按从左到右的顺序攻击并发动尚未覆盖的能力。
成长与补给：可以支付指挥标记装备能力牌和发动船员、冒险牌的能力。船员及冒险牌上的指挥标记在清除以前会锁定其能力。港口可以住宿、治疗、修船及支付经验购买升级。
失败：船舶累计受到 11 点损伤，或全部船员的生命值降至零时，按所选模式处理。
· 普通模式：返回最近的港口，并损失事件牌。
· 残酷模式：立即结束战役。
扩展：毁灭之潮和地下城默认关闭，可在开局设置启用。

en.name: Sleeping Gods
en.desc: Sail the Manticore across the Wandering Sea, discover totems, and awaken the sleeping gods.
en.rules:
Cooperate to control nine crew members and sail the Manticore across the Wandering Sea. Find totems and prepare for the finale before the event deck runs out three times.
Setup: Each player receives 1 command and 1 ability card. Begin with 3 coins and 1 grain. The active player controls the captain; distribute the other crew as evenly as possible.
Turns: Complete these steps in order:
· Choose a usable ship room different from the previous turn.
· Resolve an event.
· Take two actions. Travel, explore, visit a market or visit a port. You may skip an action to gain 1 command.
Challenges: Participants need health and available fatigue capacity. Each gains 1 fatigue. Other players pay 1 command to contribute their crew; low morale costs 1 additional command per crew member. Add matching skills and fate to reach the target. Discard matching ability cards from hand for +1 each.
Travel: Use at most one of your crew in a craft challenge. Totals of 0–3, 4–6, 7–8, and 9+ allow 1, 2, 3, and 4 adjacent regions respectively. Resolve hazards when entering their regions.
Combat: Share four combat action tokens. Each crew may attack twice per round. Fate plus accuracy must meet defense. Misses deal 1 damage and prevent weapon block. Place damage in connected squares; hearts must be fully covered. Surviving targets counterattack. At round end, surviving enemies attack from left to right and activate uncovered abilities.
Progress: Spend command to equip ability cards and activate crew or adventure abilities. Command placed on crew and adventures locks their abilities until removed. Ports provide rest, healing, repairs, and level purchases.
Defeat: Eleven ship damage or zero health on every crew causes defeat. Normal mode returns you to the nearest port and costs event cards. Brutal mode ends the campaign.
Expansions: Tides of Ruin and Dungeons are disabled by default and may be selected during setup.

zh.name: 密语幸运草
zh.desc: 为相邻词语写下共同线索，合作还原每个人的幸运草。可选中文或英文词卡，需要真人参与。
zh.rules:
目标：
3–6 人合作，通过四条线索还原每位玩家的四叶草板，合计得分并挑战团队纪录。开局可选择中文或英文词卡，默认中文。中文词卡从项目公共中文词库抽取不同词语组成 220 张四边词卡，英文使用原版 220 张词卡；所选词库整局固定，切换界面语言不会改变牌面。词语联想需要真人参与，规则机器人不支持本游戏。

准备：
洗混词卡，每人秘密抽取四张，随机放入四叶草板的四个位置及朝向。每张牌有四个词，外侧的八个词两两相邻，形成上、右、下、左四组。

编写线索：
所有人同时为自己的四组词各写一个能联系两者的词。线索可以是普通名词、专有名词、缩略词、数字或拟声词，也允许复合词。每条线索只写一个词，不使用空格；复合词可使用连字符。不得直接使用自己的外侧关键词、这些词的翻译或同词族词语，也不得使用虚构词。翻译、词族和词义限制由玩家共同遵守。提交后不能修改；系统将自己的四张词卡取下，盲抽一张干扰牌并混洗。所有人完成后进入合作还原阶段。

合作还原：
从第一位玩家开始，依座位顺序，每人担任一次旁观者。旁观者不得以任何方式提示、评论或参与讨论。其他玩家根据板上的四条线索，共同将五张候选词卡中的四张放回板上，并调整朝向。可以点选词卡，再在词卡旁旋转、放大查看，或点击板上目标位置摆放；已放置的词卡可以再次选择、移动或取回。有争议时，由旁观者左侧的下一位玩家作最终决定，并提交本次摆放。系统代替旁观者核对答案。

两次核对与计分：
· 第一次全部四张的位置及朝向正确：每张 1 分，另获 2 分奖励，共 6 分。
· 第一次有误：移除错误词卡，保留并锁定正确词卡；团队只有一次重新摆放的机会。
· 第二次核对：每张位置及朝向正确的词卡获得 1 分，共 0–4 分，没有额外奖励。
每位旁观者完成后显示正确词卡与本轮得分，由其左侧的下一位玩家继续。所有人都担任一次旁观者后，将各轮得分相加。终局可以回看每个人的线索、原布局及两次摆放。

增加难度：
开局可将每人盲抽的干扰牌从标准的 1 张增加至 2–5 张，整局所有玩家使用相同数量。无论干扰牌多少，每次仍只摆放四张。

en.name: So Clover!
en.desc: Link pairs of words with clues, then rebuild each player’s clover together. Chinese or English word cards; human players required.
en.rules:
Goal:
3–6 players cooperate to rebuild everyone’s clover from four clues. Add the points together and try to beat your team record. Choose Chinese or English word cards before starting; Chinese is the default. Chinese cards use distinct words from the project’s shared Chinese word list to form 220 four-sided cards. English uses the original 220 cards. The deck stays fixed for the entire game, even when the interface language changes. Word association requires human players; rules bots do not support this game.

Setup:
Shuffle the cards. Each player secretly receives four cards in random positions and orientations on a clover board. Every card has four words. The eight words along the outside edges form four pairs: top, right, bottom and left.

Choosing clues:
Everyone simultaneously writes one word linking each of their four pairs. Common nouns, proper nouns, acronyms, numbers, onomatopoeia and compound words are allowed. Write a single word without spaces; compounds may use hyphens. Your outside keywords, their translations, words from the same family and made-up words are forbidden. Players enforce translation, word-family and meaning restrictions. Submitted clues cannot be changed. Your four cards are removed, one unseen extra card is drawn, and the five cards are shuffled. Resolution starts when everyone is ready.

Resolution:
Starting with the first player and proceeding in seat order, everyone is the Spectator once. The Spectator must not communicate, comment or join the discussion. Everyone else uses the four clues to choose four of the five cards and restore their positions and orientations. Select a card, use its nearby tools to rotate or inspect it, then click a space to place it. Placed cards can be selected again, moved or returned to the tray. In a disagreement, the next player to the Spectator’s left makes the final decision and submits the arrangement. The game checks it on behalf of the Spectator.

Two attempts and scoring:
· All four cards correctly placed and oriented on the first attempt: 1 point per card plus a 2-point bonus, for 6 points.
· Any errors on the first attempt: incorrect cards are removed, correct cards stay and are locked. The team has one final attempt.
· Second attempt: 1 point per correctly placed and oriented card, for 0–4 points, without a bonus.
Correct cards and points are shown after each Spectator’s round. The next player to their left continues. Once everyone has been the Spectator, add all round scores. At the end you can review every player’s clues, original layout and both attempts.

Add a challenge:
Settings can increase the unseen extra cards per player from the standard 1 to 2–5. Everyone uses the same number throughout the game. Always place exactly four cards, regardless of the number of extra cards.
