· 第六步，选择向股东分红，或将全部收入留在公司金库。分红时，每股获得总收入的五分之一；首次公开发行区中的股份，其分红进入公司金库。
· 分红总额达到当前股价的2倍时，股价向右移动2格；未达到时，向右移动1格。将全部收入留在公司金库时，股价向左移动1格。
列车与阶段：
· 列车依次解锁：先是T2列车，再是T3列车、T4列车，最后是T6和T6+S列车。每家公司最多拥有3辆列车。
· 首次购买T4列车时，所有T2列车报废，游戏进入棕色阶段。首次购买T6列车时，所有T3列车报废，游戏进入灰色阶段。
· T6+S列车运行时，路线中第一个车站和最后一个车站的收入翻倍。购买T6+S列车后，游戏进入黑色阶段。
· 随着游戏阶段推进，依次解锁黄色、绿色、棕色和灰色板块。黑色板块可以直接铺设。
· 公司之间可以协商价格出售列车，但成交价格不能低于1。
策略卡拍卖：
第3个运营轮结束后，举行策略卡拍卖。
· 收回全部12张策略卡，公开移除其中6张，再将剩余6张逐张进行秘密竞价拍卖。
· 出价不能超过自己的现金。最高出价相同时，并列玩家在原出价基础上追加出价，重新竞拍；再次平手时，移除该卡。
· 2人游戏中，每名玩家最多竞得3张策略卡；3人游戏中，每名玩家最多竞得2张。最后一名仍有资格竞拍的玩家，免费获得所有剩余卡牌。
终局：
· 任一公司股价达到130时，在当前轮结束后进行终局结算。
· 否则，在第7个运营轮结束后进行终局结算。
· 任一公司破产时，立即进行终局结算。

en.name: 18Svea
en.desc: A micro 18XX in Sweden: stocks, track and trains for 2-3 players
en.rules:
Goal:
The player with the highest total assets at the end wins. Add your cash to the value of your shares in each company, using its current share price.
Setup:
· Each player receives starting cash of 120 in a 2-player game, or 80 in a 3-player game.
· Shuffle all 12 strategy cards. Deal 3 to each player in a 2-player game, or 2 to each in a 3-player game.
· The Delayed Permit holder immediately chooses and locks one company. That company cannot be floated before the second Stock Round begins.
Round sequence:
A Stock Round is abbreviated SR, and an Operating Round is abbreviated OR. Play in this order:
· Play the first Stock Round, followed by the first and second Operating Rounds.
· Play the second Stock Round, followed by the third Operating Round.
· Hold the strategy-card auction, followed by the fourth Operating Round.
· Play the third Stock Round, followed by the fifth and sixth Operating Rounds.
· Play the fourth Stock Round, followed by the seventh Operating Round.
Stock Rounds:
· First pay holding tax for each company. Holding 3, 4 or 5 shares in one company requires a payment of 10, 20 or 30 respectively.
· Determine player order using strategy-card priority.
· On your turn, sell shares before deciding whether to buy. You may sell any number of shares. Each share sold lowers that company’s share price by 1 space. The CEO share cannot be sold.
· Then buy 1 share or pass. A purchase from the initial public offering area (IPO) pays the company treasury; a purchase from the public market pays the bank.
· You cannot buy shares in a company whose shares you sold earlier in the same Stock Round. The round ends when all players pass consecutively. Each fully sold-out company raises its share price by 1 space.
· To float a company, buy its CEO share and choose a par price of 25, 30, 35 or 40. If you hold more shares than the current CEO, you become the new CEO.
Operating Rounds:
First pay strategy-card income to players. Then each company operates in descending share-price order, completing these steps:
· Step 1: You may sell treasury shares to raise funds. Each share sells at the current price and pays the company treasury; each sale lowers its share price by 1 space.
· Step 2: Buy trains. A company without a train must buy one. If its treasury cannot pay, first sell treasury shares, then have its CEO pay the remaining amount from personal cash. If the CEO cannot cover the difference, the company goes bankrupt and the game ends immediately.
· Step 3: Lay or upgrade one tile. A city tile costs 5 and a black tile costs 10. Pay an additional 5 for each new water crossing.
· Step 4: You may pay 10 to place one additional station.
· Step 5: Run the company’s trains along the legal routes that provide the highest revenue, then calculate their total revenue.
· Step 6: Pay dividends to shareholders or retain all revenue in the company treasury. Each share receives one fifth of the total revenue when paying dividends. Dividends for IPO shares go to the company treasury.
· If the total dividend is at least twice the current share price, move the share price 2 spaces to the right; otherwise move it 1 space to the right. Retaining all revenue moves it 1 space to the left.
Trains and phases:
· Unlock trains in this order: T2, then T3, then T4, and finally T6 and T6+S. Each company may own at most 3 trains.
· Buying the first T4 train rusts all T2 trains and begins the brown phase. Buying the first T6 train rusts all T3 trains and begins the grey phase.
· A T6+S train doubles the revenue of the first and last stations on its route. Buying a T6+S train begins the black phase.
· Yellow, green, brown and grey tiles become available as the phases advance, in that order. Black tiles may be laid directly.
· Companies may negotiate train sales between themselves, at a price of at least 1.
Strategy-card auction:
Hold the auction after the third Operating Round.
· Collect all 12 strategy cards and publicly remove 6. Auction the remaining 6 one at a time using sealed bids.
· Your bid cannot exceed your cash. Tied highest bidders add to their previous bids and bid again. Remove the card if the second bidding round is also tied.
· Each player may win at most 3 strategy cards in a 2-player game, or 2 in a 3-player game. The last player still eligible to bid receives all remaining cards for free.
Game end:
· If any company reaches a share price of 130, score the game at the end of the current round.
· Otherwise, score the game after the seventh Operating Round.
· If any company goes bankrupt, score the game immediately.

zh.name: 逻辑对决
zh.desc: 用提问缩小范围,抢先破译对方的数字密码
zh.rules:
目标:猜中目标牌的数字与颜色,全部正确才算猜中。
· 2 人局猜中对手的 5 张牌。
· 3-4 人局猜中桌面中央扣置的牌(3 人 5 张、4 人 4 张)。
准备:
· 数字牌共 20 枚:数字 0 至 9 每个数字两枚,分别为黑色与白色。
· 其中 5 的两枚为绿色。
· 每人随机取牌(2-3 人 5 张、4 人 4 张),按数字升序从左到右排列。
· 同数字时黑色在左。
· 3-4 人局另扣置同样数量的牌于桌面中央;2 人局剩余牌移出游戏。
· 问卡共 21 张,洗混后翻开 6 张作公共场。
· 4 人局先除外「中间 3 张之和」与「中间的牌」两张。
流程:
· 轮到你时二选一:从场上选 1 张问卡提问,或宣言猜测。
· 提问的回答者:2 人局由对手回答;3 人局由另两人回答;4 人局所有提问均全员作答。
· 标注「共享」的卡由全员作答(含提问者);问过的卡弃掉,从牌堆补一张入场。
· 宣言:按从左到右顺序报出目标全部牌的数字与颜色;只告知全对或有错,不透露错在何处。
· 2 人局猜错后留在游戏中,之后回合可再次宣言。
· 3-4 人局每人仅有一次宣言机会,猜错即出局,但仍须回答他人提问。
结束:
· 2人游戏中，先手玩家猜中时，后手玩家立即获得一次猜测机会；后手也猜中时，双方平局。问卡耗尽后仍无人猜中时，也视为平局。
· 3-4 人局:有人猜中后,其余在局者补完当前轮次,所有猜中者并列获胜。
· 全员出局或问卡耗尽则无胜者。

en.name: Break the Code
en.desc: Ask sharp questions and crack the hidden code first
en.rules:
Goal: guess the numbers and colors of the target tiles; everything must be exactly right.
· With 2 players, guess your opponent's 5 tiles.
· With 3-4 players, guess the face-down tiles in the center (5 with 3 players, 4 with 4 players).
Setup:
· 20 cipher tiles: numbers 0-9 each come in one black and one white copy.
· Both 5s are green.
· Each player takes tiles at random (5 with 2-3 players, 4 with 4 players) and sorts them ascending from left to right.
· Black comes before white on ties.
· With 3-4 players the same number of tiles is placed face down in the center; with 2 players the rest is removed.
· 21 question cards are shuffled and 6 are revealed face up.
· With 4 players, remove "sum of the middle 3" and "the middle tile" first.
Play:
· On your turn, either ask one of the face-up question cards, or declare your guess.
· Answers: with 2 players only your opponent answers; with 3 players the other two answer; with 4 players every question is answered by everyone.
· Cards marked "shared" are answered by everyone including you; the asked card is discarded and replaced from the deck.
· Declare: announce all target tiles from left to right, number and color; you only learn whether you were entirely right or wrong, never which part.
· With 2 players a wrong guess just ends your turn and you may try again later.
· With 3-4 players you may declare only once per game, and a wrong guess knocks you out (you still answer questions).
End:
· With 2 players: if the starting player guesses right, the other player gets one immediate counter-guess — a correct one means a tie; if the question cards run out with no correct guess, the game is a draw.
· With 3-4 players: once someone guesses right, the remaining players finish the current round; everyone who guessed right wins together.
· If everyone is eliminated or the questions run out, there is no winner.

zh.name: 双侠小队
zh.desc: 双人自动战斗:挑两名斗士组队,编排出牌顺序,看他们逐回合交手
zh.rules:
目标：使对方任意一名斗士的生命值降至0，将其击倒。焚化等特殊失败条件按各斗士的机制处理；焚化需要集齐5个火焰标记。
准备:
· 组队:自由选 2 名斗士,或轮抽;两名斗士的起始卡(★)组成初始战斗牌库。
· 决定谁先出战;其余卡进入构筑牌库。
流程(每轮两阶段):
战斗阶段：
双方同时逐张翻开战斗牌库中的卡牌，并同时结算，直到战斗牌库翻完。
· 攻击让对手失血,数值为回合开始时的战力;治疗与失血净额结算。
· 格挡抵销对方全部攻击,挡下至少一次还有奖励。
· 生命标记经过图标格时，触发对应奖励；紫色手掌格（Stop）会使生命标记停止移动。
构筑阶段：
从构筑牌库中抽取3张牌，秘密选择其中1张，插入战斗牌库的任意位置；其余卡牌放回构筑牌库底部。
· 插入不改变已有顺序;带 ⚠ 的卡加入时立即生效并公告,不透露是哪张。
细节:
· 当回合的战力变化不影响当回合攻击;多源攻击合并为一次总伤害。
· 双方同时被击倒时，游戏以平局结束；构筑牌库耗尽时，也以平局结束。
12 名斗士各有不同的机制，包括怒气变身、船轨、精灵、圣音、阴谋和火焰标记。

en.name: Tag Team
en.desc: Two-player auto-battler: draft a duo, stack your deck, and watch them trade blows
en.rules:
Goal: drop either enemy fighter to 0 HP (KO); special losses like Incineration (5 Flame tokens) are per-fighter mechanics.
Setup:
· Team building: free pick of 2 fighters, or a draft; the two starter cards (★) form your Fight Deck.
· Decide who leads; all other cards form your Build Deck.
Each round has two phases:
Fight phase:
Both players reveal their Fight Decks one card at a time and resolve the cards simultaneously until the decks are empty.
· Attacks make the opponent lose HP equal to your power at the start of the turn; healing and damage are netted.
· Block negates all enemy attacks and grants a bonus if it stops at least one.
· Markers landing on or passing icon spaces trigger them, and Stop spaces halt the marker.
Build phase:
Draw 3 cards from your Build Deck. Secretly choose 1 and insert it anywhere in your Fight Deck; return the other cards to the bottom of your Build Deck.
· Insertion does not reorder the rest; cards marked ⚠ announce and resolve immediately when added, without revealing which card.
Details:
· Power changes mid-turn do not affect that turn; multiple attacks merge into one total.
· Double KO is a draw; running out of Build Deck is also a draw.
The 12 fighters have different mechanisms, including rage transformations, a ship track, spirits, divine voice, schemes and Flame tokens.

zh.name: 时序谜局
zh.desc: 以无声的默契，将时间排成一圈。40个合作挑战与重生变体。
zh.rules:
目标:
共同完成六扇区时钟的挑战。基本盒有10章、每章4关，可连续挑战，也可在结果页结束本次旅程；进度随对局记录保存。首次游玩从1.1开始。
准备:
太阳牌与月亮牌各有1至12，共24张。洗牌后发出12张：4人各3张，3人各4张；2人各6张，先拿起4张，另外2张作为储备，只能看牌背颜色，不能先看数值。
讨论:
先看时钟、规则与手牌背面的颜色，讨论策略，不能看数值，也不能约定与游戏动作无关的暗号。按“拿起手牌”后可以看自己的牌，但不能再参与讨论。第三章起可在讨论时选择时针；8.4与第十章使用盘面固定时针。
放牌:
所有人准备后，任意玩家自行先出一张盖牌，之后严格按座位顺时针轮流出1张。放牌阶段禁止交流。每人只能看自己的手牌及自己打出的盖牌；其他盖牌的颜色、出牌者与顺序公开。2、3、4人分别共用2、3、4次亮牌，首张必须盖下。在第2.4关中，禁止将卡牌正面朝上打出。2人双方各出2张后，各自的2张储备同时加入手牌。
结算:
所有手牌用完后，从时针起逐区、逐张揭牌。每区至少1张，从时针起顺时针总值不得下降，且每区不超过24；1.1至1.3取消24上限。所有额外条件也必须满足。第三至第九章的自由时针在全部揭牌后可重新选择，再确认结果。
章节条件:
盘面规则图示可在“挑战规则”中查阅文字。张数与指定颜色组合必须精确匹配。点数最高或最低的卡牌可以有多张并列；两区最低牌条件要求两区各持有一张最低牌，其他区不能有低于这两张中较高者的牌。准星表示本区总值最接近该数值，允许并列。1/2/3表示全桌对应序号的出牌，红色末张表示全桌最后一张。
· 第四章：按本人当前最高、最低或左起第一张出牌，固定顺序不能重排；2人补入储备放在右侧。
· 第五章：每个扇区必须恰好放置2张牌。
· 第六章：每个扇区必须恰好放置2张牌。比较扇区顺序时，使用两张牌的点数差值；其他图示仍使用点数总和。
· 第七章：在标有抽牌效果的扇区打出卡牌后，立即从尚未发出的牌堆中抽取1张牌；牌堆为空时不抽牌。轮到手牌已经用完的玩家时，跳过该玩家。
· 第八章：按图示转盘，所有牌堆留在物理原位，自由时针留原位，8.4印刷时针随盘转；禁止区不能直接放牌。
· 第九章：检查相邻总值差或全盘总值差。
· 第十章：除了总值顺序，还从细指针起比较每区第一张牌的值；10.4双向秒针起指2、5区，每回合顺时针转1区，指向区不能放牌。
失败与旅程:
失败后可重试，增加1个奖励，最多3个，每个奖励在下一次尝试增加1次亮牌；成功或换关清空奖励。跳过的关进入遗憾袖套，可以在结果页回访。全部40关通过才完成全旅程；结果页显示真实通过和未完成情况。
重生:
建议在尝试过全部 40 关后，再在开局选项中启用重生。以下六项变体可以组合使用，默认均关闭：
· 多牌扇区的数值变化：结算时，10、11、12 分别视为 0、1、2。所有结算条件均使用变化后的数值，手牌的出牌限制仍使用原数值。
· 总和差值限制：所有扇区总和中的最高值与最低值之差不得超过 12。
· 优先打出太阳牌：手中有太阳牌时，必须先打出太阳牌。此变体不能用于第四章。
· 向左侧传牌：交给左侧玩家 1 张牌，由对方选择放置位置。给牌者决定正面或背面朝上放置，背面朝上的牌不能偷看。第七章触发的抽牌归给牌者。
· 减少亮牌次数：可用的亮牌次数减少 2 次。
· 双向秒针：讨论时选择双向秒针，其指向的两个相对扇区不能放牌；每回合将秒针转动 1 个扇区。此变体不能用于第八章。
不兼容的变体会在对应章节自动停用，当前规则中会显示实际生效的变体。

en.name: Take Time
en.desc: Build a circle of time through silent cooperation. 40 tests and Rebirth variants.
en.rules:
Goal:
Cooperate to pass a six-segment clock. The base game has 10 chapters of 4 tests. Continue for as many tests as you like, or finish your session after a result; progress stays in the match record. Start at 1.1 for your first game.
Setup:
The deck contains Solar and Lunar cards numbered 1–12 each. Shuffle all 24 and deal 12: 3 each with four players, 4 each with three, or 6 each with two. With two players, pick up only 4; leave 2 as reserves, with their card-back colors visible but values hidden.
Discussion:
Review the clock and card-back colors, without looking at values. Discuss a strategy, but do not devise signals unrelated to game actions. After choosing “Pick up cards”, you may see your hand but cannot participate in discussion. From Chapter 3, choose a Clock Hand during discussion; 8.4 and Chapter 10 use printed hands.
Placement:
After everyone is ready, any player may begin independently with one facedown card. Continue clockwise by seat, one card per turn, without communication. You may review your own hand and your own facedown cards, but no other hidden cards. Colors, owners and play order are public. The group shares 2, 3 or 4 faceup placements with 2, 3 or 4 players; the first card must be facedown. Test 2.4 forbids all faceup play. With two players, both reserves enter their owners’ hands after both have played two cards.
Resolution:
After all hands are empty, reveal cards individually, segment by segment, clockwise from the Hand. Every segment needs at least one card, and values must not decrease clockwise from the Hand. Each segment must be at most 24, except in 1.1–1.3. Meet every additional condition. With the movable Hand in Chapters 3–9, you may adjust its starting segment after all cards have been revealed, then confirm the result.
Chapter conditions:
Use “Test rules” for descriptions of the clock symbols. Exact counts and color combinations must match. Highest/lowest cards permit ties. If two segments require the lowest cards, each must hold one of them; no card in any other segment may be lower than the higher of those two cards. A target means the closest segment sum to that value, allowing ties. 1/2/3 identify the group’s first, second or third play; the red final-card symbol identifies the last play.
· Chapter 4 requires your current highest, lowest or leftmost card; fixed hand order cannot be changed and two-player reserves are appended on the right.
· Chapter 5 requires exactly two cards per segment.
· Chapter 6 also requires pairs, but compares the differences between each pair; other conditions still use sums.
· Chapter 7 draw segments immediately draw a card from the undealt deck, if available; skip empty-handed seats.
· In Chapter 8 the clock rotates as indicated, while piles stay at their physical locations. The movable Hand stays put; 8.4’s printed Hand rotates with its clock. Blocked segments cannot receive direct placements.
· Chapter 9 compares adjacent sums or the overall sum range.
· Chapter 10 additionally compares each segment’s first card, starting from the slender Hand. In 10.4 the Second Hand initially blocks segments 2 and 5, then moves clockwise one segment after every turn.
Failure and journey:
After failure, retry with one extra Bonus token, up to three. Each adds one faceup placement to subsequent attempts. Passing or changing clocks clears bonuses. Skipped tests enter the Sleeve of Regrets and can be revisited from the result page. Passing all 40 completes the journey; the interface distinguishes passed, unfinished and untried tests.
Rebirth:
Rebirth is recommended only after attempting all 40 tests. Enable it in the options. All six variants can be combined and are off by default:
· Changed values: In segments with multiple cards, values 10, 11 and 12 become 0, 1 and 2 for every resolution rule. Hand restrictions still use printed values.
· Limited range: The difference between the highest and lowest segment sums must not exceed 12.
· Solar first: Play a Solar card first if able. This variant is unavailable in Chapter 4.
· Give a card: Give one card to your left neighbor to place. The giver chooses face up or face down. Facedown gifts cannot be inspected, and Chapter 7 draws go to the giver.
· Fewer faceup cards: Reduce the faceup allowance by 2.
· Second Hand: Choose a Second Hand during discussion. It blocks opposite segments and advances clockwise after every turn. This variant is unavailable in Chapter 8.
Incompatible variants are disabled for their chapters. The current rules show which variants are active.

search.py: shi xu mi ju zhang wo shi ke take time

zh.name: 灯笼
zh.desc: 在彩色灯笼之间移动火柴盒，点亮夜空或撞出对手
zh.rules:
目标:
对决中先赢两小局的人获胜。每小局可通过点亮最后一张暗牌、令对手无法行动，或将对手撞出两次获胜。单人和合作模式则要让 16 张灯笼同时亮起。
准备:
牌共 16 张：公鸡 2 张，兔、蝴蝶、鱼、马各 3 张，龙 2 张。将两张公鸡放在四行四列牌阵的对角，其余牌洗混后盖放。对决翻亮中央四张，单人和合作只亮公鸡。依次选择公鸡放置自己的火柴盒，由起始玩家开始行动。
对决流程:
· 移动前选择公鸡行动或当前灯笼行动。所有行动必须落在现存且没有风扇的牌上，不得越过风扇。
· 公鸡行动：正交移动一步，不能落在对手的牌上。抵达背面朝上的卡牌时，将其翻至正面。从公鸡出发时移除起点公鸡，从其他动物出发时保留出发位置的卡牌。随后必须把风扇移到另一张没有火柴盒的现存牌上；不能留在原位。无法完成风扇移动时，不能选择此行动。
· 灯笼行动：按当前动物的走法移动，翻亮目标暗牌，并移除出发位置的卡牌。落在对手处就将其撞出。第一次被撞后，对手下一回合只能将火柴盒放回空置、没有风扇的亮牌；没有这样的牌时，对手输掉该小局。第二次被撞出时，该玩家立即输掉该小局。
动物走法:
· 兔：沿正交方向移动任意步数。
· 蝴蝶：沿对角方向移动任意步数。
兔和蝴蝶的移动可以经过现存卡牌，但不能跨过空位。
· 鱼：沿正交或对角方向移动一步。
· 马先正交一步再垂直两步，或先两步再垂直一步；至少有一条 L 形路径不经过风扇。
· 龙：沿正交或对角方向移动任意步数。马和龙可以跨过空位，但仍不能越过风扇。
· 公鸡：沿正交方向移动一步。
单人和合作:
只使用当前动物走法，不移除任何牌，也不使用风扇。抵达暗牌时翻亮目标；抵达亮牌时将起牌翻暗，但公鸡永不翻暗。已揭示过的暗牌保留动物记忆提示。合作双方轮流移动自己的火柴盒，允许共处一牌，不发生撞击。
选项与结算:
单人或合作可将全部 16 张牌洗混后布阵，仍从公鸡开始；也可启用从布阵完成后开始的两分钟挑战。禅模式没有时间或步数上限。全部 16 张同时亮起即共同成功，限时耗尽则失败。对决每小局重新洗牌，并轮换起始玩家，先赢两小局结束整场。

en.name: Tanglung
en.desc: Move your matchbox among glowing lanterns to light the night or bump your rival
en.rules:
Goal:
In a duel, be the first to win two matches. Win a match by lighting the last dark lantern, leaving your opponent unable to act, or bumping them twice. Solo and cooperative players aim to light all 16 lanterns simultaneously.
Setup:
There are 16 cards: two Roosters, three each of Rabbit, Butterfly, Fish and Horse, and two Dragons. Place Roosters in opposite corners of a 4×4 grid and shuffle the remaining cards face down into the other spaces. In a duel, light the central four cards; in solo and cooperative play, only Roosters begin lit. Choose Roosters in turn for your matchboxes, then the starting player acts.
Duel turns:
· Choose a Rooster or Lantern action before moving. All destinations must be existing cards without the Fan. No action may cross the Fan.
· Rooster action: move one orthogonal step, without landing on your opponent. Light a dark destination. Remove your starting card only if it is a Rooster. Then move the Fan to a different existing card without a matchbox. The Fan cannot stay in place. You cannot choose this action if you cannot complete Fan placement.
· Lantern action: move using your current animal, light a dark destination, and remove your starting card. Landing on your opponent bumps them out. After their first bump, their next turn is used only to re-enter on an unoccupied lit card without the Fan. If none exists, they lose. A second bump loses immediately.
Animal movement:
· Rabbit: any number of orthogonal steps. Butterfly: any number of diagonal steps. Both may cross existing cards, but not gaps.
· Fish: one orthogonal or diagonal step.
· Horse: one orthogonal step then two perpendicular steps, or two then one. At least one L-shaped route must avoid the Fan.
· Dragon: any number of orthogonal or diagonal steps. Horse and Dragon may cross gaps, but cannot cross the Fan.
· Rooster: one orthogonal step.
Solo and cooperative play:
Use only your current animal. Never remove cards or use the Fan. Moving to a dark card lights it; moving to a lit card turns your starting card dark, except Roosters never turn dark. Previously revealed dark cards retain an animal memory reminder. Cooperative players alternate moving their own matchboxes. They may share a card and never bump each other.
Options and ending:
Solo and cooperative play can shuffle all 16 cards, including Roosters, before setup; still start on Roosters. The optional two-minute challenge begins after placement. Zen mode has no time or move limit. Light all 16 simultaneously to win together; running out of time loses. Duels reshuffle each match and alternate the starting player. Winning two matches ends the duel.

zh.name: 探索棋
zh.desc: 连接彩色线路，挑战策略对局与单人谜题
zh.rules:
目标:
· 策略对局中，延长自己的颜色线路或组成闭环。
· 解谜模式中，使用题目指定的全部棋片完成目标。
准备:
· 标准套装有 56 块棋片，每块包含三种颜色的连接线。
· 策略对局支持 2–4 人，每人选择一种不同的目标颜色。
· 每人先抽一块，编号最高者先手，再各抽五块。
· 所有人的六块手牌公开，每放一块立即补抽，袋空后不再补抽。
策略流程:
· 相接棋片的连接线必须同色，已经确认的棋片不能移动。
· 每回合先填补能够填入的强制空位，再自由放置一块。
· 自由落子后，再填补能够填入的强制空位，随后换下一人。
· 被三块或更多棋片包围的空位是强制空位。
· 有多种合法补位时，由当前玩家选择棋片、位置及方向。
袋空前的限制:
· 不得制造三条同色连接线朝内的强制空位。
· 不得在强制空位周围放置第四块棋片。
· 强制空位两侧的受控边不得继续放置棋片，见下图。
· 抽走袋中最后一块后，这三项限制立即解除。
· 袋空后，颜色匹配与强制补位规则仍然有效。
策略结算:
· 全部棋片放完后，比较每人的最长线路与最长闭环。
· 线路每块计 1 分，闭环每块计 2 分，只取其中较高的分数。
· 分数最高者获胜，同分并列；自由落子无合法位置时判和。
Discovery:
· 使用从 1 号起的前 3–10 块棋片，组成指定颜色闭环。
· 七块棋片的谜题采用标准 Game Pack 的蓝色目标。
· 十块棋片分别提供红、蓝、黄三种目标题。
Rainbow:
· 初级与进阶：自选一种颜色，闭环经过全部棋片。
· 教授：同时组成两色闭环，每环经过含该色的全部棋片。
· 大师：自选一种颜色，闭环经过含该色的全部棋片。
· 天才：在红、黄、蓝中选两色，同时形成两条开放线路。
· 天才的每条线路须经过含该色的全部棋片。
· Rainbow 的全部棋片须相连，且不得围出空洞。
解谜操作:
· 棋片可以移动、旋转或收回，也可以撤销上一步。
· 所有相接边仍须同色，全部目标达成后自动完成。

en.name: Tantrix
en.desc: Connect colourful tracks in strategy games and solo puzzles
en.rules:
Goal:
· In Strategy, extend your colour’s line or form a loop.
· In puzzles, use every specified tile to complete the objectives.
Setup:
· The standard set has 56 tiles, each with tracks in three colours.
· Strategy is for 2–4 players, each choosing a different colour.
· Draw one tile each; the highest number starts. Draw five more each.
· All six tiles are public. Replace each played tile until the bag is empty.
Strategy turns:
· All touching tracks must match. Confirmed tiles cannot move.
· First fill any forced spaces you can, then make one free move.
· Fill any forced spaces you can again, then pass to the next player.
· An empty space bordered by three or more tiles is forced.
· When several plays fit, the active player chooses tile, space and rotation.
Restrictions before the bag is empty:
· Do not create a forced space with three inward links of one colour.
· Do not place a fourth tile around a forced space.
· Do not play along the controlled sides of a forced space; see below.
· These three restrictions end immediately when the last tile is drawn.
· Matching colours and filling forced spaces still apply in the endgame.
Strategy scoring:
· Once all tiles are played, compare each player’s longest line and loop.
· Lines score 1 per tile; loops score 2. Only the better score counts.
· Highest score wins; ties share victory. No legal free move means a draw.
Discovery:
· Use tiles 1 through 3–10 to form the specified loop through every tile.
· The seven-tile challenge uses the standard Game Pack’s blue objective.
· Ten tiles have separate red, blue and yellow challenges.
Rainbow:
· Junior and Student: choose a colour and loop through all tiles.
· Professor: form two coloured loops, each using every tile of its colour.
· Master: choose a colour and loop through every tile with that colour.
· Genius: choose two of red, yellow and blue and form two open lines.
· Each Genius line must pass through every tile with its colour.
· In Rainbow, all tiles must connect, without enclosing holes.
Puzzle controls:
· Move, rotate or return tiles, or undo the previous action.
· Every touching edge must match. Complete all objectives to finish.

zh.name: 大漠商豪
zh.desc: 在沙漠卡阵中派遣塔尔吉，以交点获取货物，经营三行部族阵列。
zh.rules:
目标：
建立部族阵列，获得最多分数。两人对战，每人拥有3名塔尔吉和2枚部族标记。
准备：
16张边界卡围成5行5列卡阵，中央放置5张货物卡和4张部族卡，交错排列。每人获得2个椰枣、2份盐、2份胡椒、1枚金币与4分。强盗首轮位于贵族。
每轮流程：
· 从先手开始，轮流放置一名塔尔吉。不能放在四角、强盗处、已有塔尔吉处，或对手塔尔吉的正对边界卡；可以与自己的塔尔吉正对。
· 以自己的塔尔吉所在横行和竖列画线，在线的交点放部族标记。重复的直线只计算一次；没有交点便没有标记。
· 先手按任意顺序执行自己的全部塔尔吉和部族标记，再由后手执行。每个行动须完成后才能开始下一个，也可以放弃行动。主要操作直接点击所在卡牌。
· 执行中央货物卡的行动时，获得牌面所示奖励；斜线分隔的奖励只能选择一种。执行部族卡的行动时，可以支付费用打出该牌、将其保留为手牌，或弃置该牌。手牌上限为1张，不能自由更换或弃置；贵族行动允许支付费用打出手牌，或弃置手牌。
· 打出的部族卡放在3行4列阵列中，任选一行从左往右放置，通常不能移动。卡文能力立即生效，详情点击卡牌查看；括号费用是可选额外支付，支付后立即获得括号分数。
· 用过的中央卡立即补另一种类型的卡并盖住，整轮结束再同时揭开。货物牌堆耗尽时洗混货物弃牌。
· 每人结束本轮行动时，货物总数最多10个、金币最多3个，超额部分自行退还；过程中可以超限。双方结束后交换先手，强盗顺时针前进。
突袭与终局：
· 强盗到四角时，双方依次支付卡上要求的货物或分数，随后强盗再前进一格。第4次突袭中，双方各支付1枚金币或失去3分，然后游戏立即结束。
· 若有人打出第12张部族卡，完成整轮后终局。总分包括分数标记、部族卡印刷分数、卡文奖励和满行奖励：四张同符号4分、四张全异2分。
· 平分时依次比较金币与货物数量，仍同则共享胜利。
2016官方扩展（可选）：
扩展更换45张部族卡与10张边界卡，中央改为5张部族卡和4张货物卡，部族牌堆顶公开。初始获得每种货物1个、1枚金币、2份水与4分。塔尔吉娅从盐卡逆时针前进并跳过角落；在她所在边界放置塔尔吉，可先于或后于该边界行动使用她的奖励：获得1个任意货物，或支付1个货物翻开货物卡；可以继续支付重抽。水不属于货物。任何时候都可以用2份水兑换1个货物，或用3份水兑换1枚金币。每轮结束时，最多保留10份水；终局时，每2份水计1分。
可以把塔尔吉放到公开沙丘上并使用其一次性能力；每放一名到沙丘，本轮可用交点标记减少1枚。沙丘用后弃掉；轮初没有沙丘时补1张，每次突袭后弃掉剩余并补3张。扩展蜃景仅能移动至相邻空格；银匠最多兑换两次；最终突袭中，须支付1枚金币，或弃置自己任意一行最右侧的部族卡。混合牌组按每种符号从两套牌中随机选9张。
2015行动标记（可选）：
双方各自从四种行动标记中秘密移除一种，其余标记公开；每种标记每局只能使用一次。
· 万能货物：可以替代任意 1 个货物。
· 额外塔尔吉：双方放完工人后，将其放到空的边界位置。可以与对手正对，但不产生交点。
· 额外部族标记：放在强盗所在直线与自己塔尔吉所在直线相交的空交点，不能通过蜃景移动。
· 弃权标记：打出部族卡时，若该牌不晚于自己的第 9 张部族卡，可以放弃该牌的文字能力，改为在终局获得 2 分。

en.name: Targi
en.desc: Place Targis around a desert market, claim intersections, and build three rows of tribes.
en.rules:
Goal:
Build your tribe display and score the most VP. Each of two players has 3 Targis and 2 tribe markers.
Setup:
Sixteen border cards surround a 3×3 center of 5 goods and 4 tribe cards in alternating positions. Each player starts with 2 dates, 2 salt, 2 pepper, 1 gold and 4 VP. The robber starts on the Noble.
Each round:
· Alternate placing one Targi, starting with the first player. Corners, the robber, occupied borders, and borders opposite an opponent’s Targi are forbidden. You may face your own Targi.
· Extend lines across the board from your Targis. Put tribe markers where your horizontal and vertical lines meet. Repeated lines count once; no intersection means no marker.
· The first player uses all their pieces in any order, then the other player does so. Complete each card before starting another. You may forgo an action. Click the card occupied by a piece to act.
· Goods cards award their reward; slash-separated alternatives offer a choice. Buy a tribe card, keep it in hand, or discard it. Your hand holds 1 card and cannot be freely exchanged or discarded. The Noble lets you pay to display a hand card, or discard it.
· Display tribes in three rows of four, filling each row from left to right. Cards normally stay in place. Abilities activate immediately; inspect cards for full text. Parenthesized costs are optional and award their parenthesized VP immediately.
· Replace a used center card with the opposite type face down. Reveal replacements together at round end. Reshuffle discarded goods when their deck empties.
· At the end of your actions keep at most 10 goods and 3 gold, choosing any excess goods to return. You may exceed these limits during the round. Then exchange first player and advance the robber clockwise.
Raids and game end:
· At corners both players pay the indicated goods or VP, then the robber moves on. The fourth raid costs 1 gold or 3 VP and ends the game immediately.
· If a player displays their twelfth tribe, finish the round, then score. Add VP tokens, printed tribe VP, card abilities and full-row bonuses: 4 VP for four matching symbols, or 2 VP for four different symbols.
· Break ties by gold, then goods; if still tied, share victory.
Official 2016 expansion (optional):
Replace the 45 tribe cards and 10 borders. Start with 5 tribes and 4 goods in the center, and reveal the tribe-deck top card. Each player starts with 1 of each good, 1 gold, 2 water and 4 VP. The Targia begins at Salt and travels counterclockwise, skipping corners. Placing a Targi with her grants a reward before or after that border action: take 1 good, or pay 1 good to reveal a goods card. You may pay again to redraw. Water is not a good. At any time trade 2 water for 1 good or 3 water for 1 gold. Keep at most 10 water at turn end; each 2 water scores 1 VP at game end.
You may place Targis on face-up dunes for their one-use abilities. Each Targi on a dune reduces available tribe markers by one. Used dunes are discarded. If none remain at round start, reveal one; after raids replace all remaining dunes with three new ones. Expansion Fata Morgana only moves to adjacent empty cards; the Silversmith allows up to two trades. The final raid costs 1 gold or the rightmost tribe in any row. A mixed deck randomly selects 9 cards per symbol from both sets.
2015 action tokens (optional):
Secretly remove one of four tokens each; reveal the other three. Each is usable once.
· The Joker grants one good.
· Extra Targi: After regular Targi placement, place the extra Targi on a free border, even opposite an opponent; it makes no intersections.
· The extra tribe marker goes at a free intersection of the robber’s line and your Targi’s line and cannot move through Fata Morgana.
· Waiver: When displaying at most your ninth tribe card, the Waiver may cancel its text ability for 2 VP at game end.

zh.name: 小小史诗地城
zh.desc: 合作地城探险:点亮房间、清剿哥布林与随从,赶在火炬燃尽前讨伐 Boss
zh.rules:
目标：在火炬燃尽之前击败首领。
回合:
· 英雄轮流行动:先按速度值移动,踏入背面的房间会将其翻开。
· 然后执行 1 次英雄行动(攻击 / 搜索 / 解除陷阱 / 施法 / 房间行动 / 休整)。
· 花费专注的免费行动不限次数。
检定:
· 掷等同于属性值数量的骰子,选 1 颗作为结果,其余骰子的 + 值全部累加。
· 每 2 点专注可将结果调高或调低 1。
火炬:
· 回合结束时，火炬前进 1 格。到达图标格时，会生成哥布林或唤醒敌人。
· 场上出现第 5 只哥布林就败北。
· 击杀随从可使火炬回退 6 格。
Boss:
· 翻开巢穴之门后，进入第二幕。占领祭坛格可以解锁首领的生命标记；清除全部生命标记后，获得胜利。
败北(任一触发):
发生以下任一情况时，冒险失败：
· 火炬燃尽。
· 第5只哥布林进入地城。
· 没有可以继续探索的地城牌。

en.name: Tiny Epic Dungeons
en.desc: Co-op dungeon crawl: light up rooms, clear goblins and minions, slay the Boss before the torch burns out
en.rules:
Goal: defeat the Boss before the torch burns out.
Turn:
· Heroes act one at a time: move up to your Speed first; stepping onto a face-down room reveals it.
· Then take 1 hero action (attack / search / disarm / cast / room action / rest).
· Free actions that cost Focus are unlimited.
Checks:
· Roll dice equal to the stat, keep 1 die as the result, and add all + values from the rest.
· Every 2 Focus lets you raise or lower the result by 1.
Torch:
· The torch advances 1 space when a turn ends; landing on icons spawns goblins or wakes enemies.
· A 5th goblin on the board means defeat.
· Slaying a minion pushes the torch back 6 spaces.
Boss:
· Revealing the Lair Door starts Act 2: claim altar spaces to unlock the Boss health markers; clear them all to win.
Defeat (any one):
All players lose if any of the following occurs:
· The torch burns out.
· A fifth goblin enters the dungeon.
· There are no rooms left to explore.

search.py: xiao xiao shi shi di cheng

zh.name: 传情画意
zh.desc: 接力传画:画词猜画,看词一路歪成什么样
zh.rules:
目标:没有胜负的聚会游戏,看一个初始词在接力传画中会变成什么。
流程:
· 每人一本画册,系统为每本分配一个初始词;传递顺序随机。
· 所有人同时进行每一棒:画画与猜词交替——画出面前写着的词,或猜出面前这幅画画的是什么。
· 第一棒恒为画画,最后一棒恒为猜词。
· 所有玩家提交后，将所有画册同时传给各自的下一位玩家。主机可以为每次接力设置时间限制；倒计时结束后，尚未提交的画册也会按当前内容传出。
结束:
· 最后一棒结束后,可逐本回看每本画册的完整传递过程。

en.name: Telestrations
en.desc: Pass-it-on drawing: draw the word, guess the drawing
en.rules:
Goal: a party game with no winner — watch what a starting word becomes after a relay of drawing and guessing.
Play:
· Everyone holds a sketchbook, and the system assigns each book a starting word; the passing order is shuffled.
· All players work on every step at the same time, and drawing alternates with guessing: draw the word in front of you, or guess what the drawing in front of you shows.
· The first step is always drawing and the last step is always guessing.
· Books pass to the next player only when everyone has submitted; the host may set a time limit per step, and an unfinished book passes on as-is.
End:
· After the final guess, browse each book to retrace its full chain.

zh.name: 草原征途
zh.desc: 带领象群穿越草原抵达目的地,合作对抗狮群与枯竭的牌堆
zh.rules:
目标:访问全部地标解锁终点板,并让两个终点格上都有象,全员即获胜。
设置:
· 按旅程拼好起点板、草原版图块与终点板。
· 每人领取自己的象群:全部疲惫,先休整 3 只。
· 按玩家人数设置共享能量，按难度领取支持标记，并将支援卡洗入抽牌堆顶部。
开局:
· 每人先选择自己本局的坐向,它决定打出草原卡的默认旋转。
· 随后，任意玩家可以支付2点能量，旋转一块版图块。有人执行旋转后，立即开始游戏；没有人旋转时，所有玩家确认后开始游戏。
回合:当前玩家执行一个行动,然后补牌至上限(多人 3 张、单人 4 张):
· 建设草原：将一张草原卡铺到空的方格，并结算该格的奖励，使象休整或免费放置象。
· 按脚印放置象：根据草原卡的脚印形状，在版图上放置象；新放置的象必须与版图上已有的象或女族长相邻。
· 普通格消耗 1 只象、粗糙格 2 只,带红划爪印的卡无视粗糙地形;放完弃掉该卡。
· 弃牌放置象：弃置一张草原卡，在象群的相邻格放置1只象；粗糙格需要2只象。
· 打出女族长卡：将女族长移到象群相邻的任意空格。
· 然后收拢象群，将版图上的象全部收回象群，并转为疲惫状态。将树重新立起，失去2点能量，再翻开一张事件牌。
· 同时打出两张女族长卡时，失去5点能量。
支持标记：可以使用任意次数，每次选择以下一种效果。
· 获得1点能量。
· 休整2只象。
· 使下一张卡可以自由旋转。
· 无视地形，放置1只象。
放象结算:
· 盖住水塘休整 3 只象。
· 覆盖树格，且配对格中已有棋子时，树会倒下。绿树提供 2 点能量，其他树提供 1 点能量。
· 地标区全部格有象时访问该地标。
补牌触发:
· 手牌有两张女族长卡时必须立即打出。
· 抽到狮子卡时两只狮子依次激活:卧倒的起身,站立的向最近的象或女族长移动一格。
· 狮子所在方格的象被吃掉;与女族长同格时每人移除 1 只象。
发生以下任一情况时，所有玩家共同失败：
· 抽牌堆耗尽。
· 能量降至零。
· 两只狮子与女族长位于同一格。
· 任一玩家的象全部被移除。
· 轮到某名玩家时，该玩家没有合法行动。

en.name: TEMBO
en.desc: Lead your elephant herds across the savanna to the destination — a co-op race against lions and a draining deck
en.rules:
Goal: visit every landmark to unlock the destination board, then occupy both destination spaces with elephants to win together.
Setup:
· Build the journey with the start board, savanna tiles and destination board.
· Each player takes their herd: all tired, rest 3 first.
· Shared energy depends on player count; support tokens and support cards scale with difficulty.
Opening:
· Each player picks a sitting direction, which sets the default rotation of the savanna cards they play.
· Then anyone may pay 2 energy to rotate one savanna tile; the game starts once someone does, or everyone declines.
Turn: the active player performs one action, then draws back up to the hand limit (3 cards, 4 solo):
· Build savanna: place a savanna card on an empty square and trigger its bonus (rested elephants or a free placement).
· Place elephants: use a card’s footprint shape to place elephants adjacent to the herd on the board or the Matriarch.
· Normal spaces cost 1 elephant, rough spaces cost 2; cards with the red-claw mark ignore rough terrain; discard the card afterwards.
· Discard to place: discard a savanna card to place 1 elephant on a herd-adjacent space (2 on rough).
· Play a Matriarch card: optionally move the Matriarch to any herd-adjacent free space.
After resolving the Matriarch card, gather the herd: return all elephants on the board to their home herd and turn them tired. Stand the trees back up, lose 2 energy and reveal an event tile.
· Playing two Matriarch cards together costs 5 energy.
Support tokens:
You may spend support tokens any number of times. Each time, choose one effect:
· Gain 1 energy.
· Rest 2 elephants.
· Freely rotate your next card.
· Place 1 elephant, ignoring terrain.
Placement rewards:
· Covering a water space rests 3 elephants.
· Covering a tree space whose paired space is already occupied fells the tree: green trees give 2 energy, others 1.
· Filling every space of a landmark area visits that landmark.
Draw triggers:
· Holding two Matriarch cards forces you to play them.
· A drawn lion card activates both lions in turn: lying lions stand up, standing lions move one square toward the nearest elephant or the Matriarch.
· Elephants in a lion’s square are eaten; sharing a square with the Matriarch removes 1 elephant per player.
All players lose if any of the following occurs:
· The deck runs out.
· Energy reaches zero.
· Both lions share a square with the Matriarch.
· Any player loses their entire herd.
· A player has no legal action on their turn.

zh.name: 异星物语
zh.desc: 外星农场骰写:照料作物、钓鱼挖矿、装满货运舱
zh.rules:
目标：进行 12 轮外星农场经营。将目标、货运舱、徽章和邻居轨道获得的分数相加，总分最高的玩家获胜。
流程(每轮):
· 邻居阶段:处理收到的礼物(收下卡面所示的 1 份资源,或沿来路转赠给下一家),赠出过礼物的槽位会补充新卡。
· 任务阶段:从任务行选 2 张卡执行。
· 每张卡的上半部分选 1 个主行动执行(务农/钓鱼/砍木/挖矿),条件满足时再获得下半部分的奖励。
· 成长:你的作物与动物骰自动前进 1 面,停在白色面时收获。
主行动：
· 务农：选择种植作物、浇水或耕作 6 格土地。
· 砍木：在对应刮刮卡上刮开 1 至 2 格。
· 挖矿：在对应刮刮卡上刮开 1 至 2 格。
· 钓鱼：投掷 2 颗骰子，并在钓点网格中选择鱼。
资源不保留在库存中。每次获得资源时，立即选择以下一种处理方式：
· 将资源卖给企业站。
· 将资源装入货运舱。
· 将资源填入费用格。
· 将资源赠送给邻居。
计分：
· 在第6、10、12轮，分别按当季目标卡计算得分。
· 游戏结束时，加入货运舱和徽章的得分。
· 邻居轨道按领先格数计分，每领先1格获得3分。
解锁条件：项目的费用格须全部填满，才能启用对应项目。填满断桥的费用格后，解锁河流（RIVER）；在树林的最下行刮开一个格子后，解锁湖泊（LAKE）；在矿洞的最下行刮开一个格子后，解锁洞穴（GROTTO）。
货运舱中一行或一列填满时，获得免费行动。奖章既可以出售，也计入徽章进度。

en.name: Tend
en.desc: Alien-farm flip-and-write: tend crops, fish and mine, fill the cargo hold
en.rules:
Goal: run your alien farm for 12 rounds. Objectives, cargo hold, badges and neighbor tracks all score; highest total wins.
Each round:
· Neighbor phase: resolve gifts you received (take the 1 good shown on the card, or pass it along to the next neighbor); slots that gave a gift are refilled with a new card.
· Task phase: pick 2 cards from the task row and resolve them.
· On each card, choose 1 main action from the top half (tend/fish/chop/mine); if the condition is met, also gain the bottom-half reward.
· Growth: your crop and animal dice advance 1 face; landing on a white face harvests.
Main actions:
· Tend: Plant crops, water crops, or till 6 plots.
· Chop: Scratch 1–2 cells on the corresponding scratch card.
· Mine: Scratch 1–2 cells on the corresponding scratch card.
· Fish: Roll 2 dice and select a cell in the fishing grid.
Resources are not stored in an inventory. Whenever you gain a good, immediately choose one of the following:
· Sell it.
· Stow it in your cargo hold.
· Spend it on a cost track.
· Give it to a neighbor.
Scoring:
· Score the current season’s objective in rounds 6, 10 and 12.
· At the end of the game, add the points from your cargo hold and badges.
· Compare neighbor tracks and gain 3 points for each space by which you lead.
Unlocking areas:
Fill every cost space of a project to unlock that project. Completing the bridge unlocks the River. Scratching at least one space in the bottom row of the Woods unlocks the Lake; doing so in the Mines unlocks the Grotto.
Full cargo rows or columns grant free actions; medals can be sold and also count toward badge progress.

zh.name: 泰拉瑞亚：桌游版
zh.desc: 合作探索地表与洞穴，采集资源、建造房屋并挑战首领。
zh.rules:
目标：
1–4 人合作探索 Terraria 世界。标准难度完成任意一条十级目标链；困难完成两条，英雄完成三条。旅程难度完成一条六级目标链。击败血肉墙也会立即获胜。威胁达到10时立即失败。
准备：
每人有5生命、3魔力和八张起始行动牌，装备铜斧、铜镐和铜短剑。根据人数开放四至六个资源槽，每槽最多存放5个同类资源，金币上限25。旅程难度改用铁制起始装备与两根绳索，免除跌落伤害和死亡威胁。
流程：
每轮依次进行角色、敌人和环境阶段。角色阶段开始时先选择本轮装备和护甲，再处理异常状态，按护甲抽牌值抽牌。玩家可以自由交错行动。行动牌中以“或”相连的效果只能选一支，以“并且”相连的效果可以在本阶段不同时间使用。防御点可以留到敌人阶段，未用行动、砍伐和挖掘点在角色阶段结束时失效；本回合战斗效果继续有效。所有人结束后，必须完成仍可进行的探索与目标，再检查首领出现条件。
移动与探索：
支付1行动点可向八邻格移动，不能穿过两块接角的实心方块。可以经过角色或敌人，但必须有足够行动点走到无人占据的格子。没有支撑时立即下落；超过1格的跌落以防御骰总和抵消跌距，蛛网、熔岩及旅程模式免除跌伤。绳索允许留在空中，已经下落时不能抓住绳索。沿绳索1行动点移动最多2格，建有织布机房后最多3格。
所在板块的正交相邻位置没有板块时，可以免费探索所有这些位置。新板块上未被遮住的骷髅格立即从对应生态和深度的有限敌袋中生成敌人。地表根据白昼或夜晚使用对应敌袋。
采集与建造：
使用斧或镐将行动点转换为砍伐或挖掘点，可留存并分次支付。资源方块按图示费用挖掘，坚硬方块必须使用坚硬挖掘点；砍树支付树上的费用，获得相同数量木材，再计产量加成。进入或经过蛛网格可以收集蛛网。挖空后可以免费进入新格，挖脚下方块可能立即跌落。树木到日出恢复。
支付1行动点打开身旁未被遮住的宝箱，按图示数量抽宝箱牌，选择对应深度的一项奖励；所有宝箱牌按抽取顺序放回牌堆底。行动牌奖励抽两张选一张，另一张回底。物品与敌人供应有限。获得的行动牌放入弃牌堆。资源装不下时由接收者选择保存、换槽、转赠或丢弃；不会自动丢掉原有物资。
制作不消耗行动点。支付配方资源，并满足已建房屋要求；无需靠近该房屋。每个装备槽只使用最上方一件，新制作装备立即装备；旧装备保留到下轮选择。房屋必须覆盖自身或邻格，不能覆盖实心方块和敌人，可以浮空。绳索、房屋与传送晶塔覆盖骷髅格会增加一次当前威胁增量。木材制作平台，蛛网制作绳索；平台放在自身或邻格的底边，绳索放在相邻空格并向下延伸至阻挡。
支付1行动点可向任意距离的另一名角色捐赠任意数量的一种资源、金币、平台或绳索，或一件装备、护甲或消耗品。第五资源槽价格15金币，第六槽25金币。
战斗：
选择已装备武器并支付行动点或魔力。短射程包括八邻格；仅中、长射程的角色武器不能攻击邻格。中射程和长射程按尺进入目标方格边缘的位置测量；长射程超过3格丢1枚攻击骰，超过5格丢2枚，超过7格不可攻击。实心方块与接角方块阻挡视线，屋外看不进屋内，屋内可以看见屋外。无视视线的武器例外。
投掷攻击和防御骰。每枚攻击骰达到或超过最高防御结果，造成1点伤害。攻击点只能加在一枚攻击骰上，防御点只能加在一枚防御骰上，点数可超过骰子面数。穿刺可以攻击符合相邻连通及同一直线要求的多个敌人，只有最近目标必须在射程内，共用攻击结果，各自防御与反击。未被击败的敌人在射程和视线允许时反击，使用刚才最高防御结果作为一枚攻击骰。防止反击效果例外。
敌人阶段：
所在板块或正交相邻板块有角色时，普通敌人激活。全队选择激活顺序、等距目标、等距终点和受击顺序。敌人朝最近角色移动；只有已经邻接目标才不动，有视线按移动力移动，否则仅移动1格。它随后攻击所有在射程和视线内的角色。飞行敌人不下落，蠕虫可以穿方块，普通敌人不能进入房屋。
环境与异常状态：
环境阶段弃掉所有未留在准备槽中的在场行动牌，时间前进一格，再结算威胁和生成图标。日出清除树上橡实、地表夜间敌人和坠星，恢复魔力及房屋奖励。第二天日出会触发史莱姆王。
异常状态持续两次角色阶段。冰冻本轮少抽1张牌；着火在角色阶段开始时失去2生命；中毒弃掉准备牌并禁止本轮准备牌。护甲与准备牌提供的免疫可在处理前清除相应异常。新的相同异常将剩余持续时间重置为两次。
死亡与首领：
角色死亡后清除异常、失去一半金币（向下取整），弃掉消耗品与随从，保留资源与装备，把所有行动牌洗成牌库。取走一枚墓碑并增加当前威胁增量；取走最后墓碑后，增量永久变为2。没有墓碑时死亡直接增加2威胁。下轮开始在森林地表空格或床房空格满生命、魔力复活。
首领条件在角色阶段结束时检查，下一敌人阶段开始且没有其他首领时出现，威胁增量变为2。出现当轮不添加盟友，之后按首领卡添加盟友和执行特殊效果，行为A与B在敌人阶段结束交替。形态转换丢弃过量伤害，本角色阶段不能再次攻击该首领。击败后按奖励卡分配物资；墓碑耗尽造成的威胁增量不会恢复。
准备牌与城镇居民：
只能把完全未用的手牌放入准备槽；原准备牌回手。准备牌除写明的准备效果外不能使用，可随时取回。新行动牌进入弃牌堆；抓取牌库中的牌不会洗牌。城镇居民按其条件与可用房屋生成，向导始终存在且不占房屋。向导与商人出售行动牌，商人及爆破专家提供消耗品，护士在没有首领时提供治疗，哥布林工匠提供移除行动牌，树妖提供全队共享的D8。
可选规则：
开局可选择腐化或猩红生态、初始威胁0–3、替代目标及目标专注。专注目标第一次未完成时翻面，第二次仍未完成时清除专注标记并增加一次当前威胁增量。替代目标在对应等级随机使用。本次采用2026规则与配件参考版本，不纳入节日促销牌。

en.name: Terraria: The Board Game
en.desc: Explore, mine, craft and face the bosses of Terraria together.
en.rules:
Goal:
Cooperate with 1–4 characters. Complete one ten-level objective chain in Standard, two in Tough or three in Heroic. Journey ends after one six-level chain. Defeating the Wall of Flesh also wins immediately. Threat reaching 10 loses immediately.
Setup:
Start with 5 health, 3 mana and eight action cards, a Copper Axe, Copper Pickaxe and Copper Shortsword. There are 4–6 unlocked resource slots depending on player count; each holds up to 5 of one resource. Coins are capped at 25. Journey grants iron equipment and two ropes, prevents fall damage and removes death threat.
Round:
Each round has Character, Enemy and Environment phases. First select equipment and armor, then resolve debuffs and draw to your armor's draw value. Characters act in any interleaved order. OR effects select one branch; effects joined by + can be used at different times. Defense points may be saved for the Enemy phase. Unused AP, Chop and Dig points expire at Character end. Attack and defense points and round-long combat effects remain available until the next round. Before advancing, resolve all available discoveries and objectives, then check boss spawning conditions.
Movement and discovery:
Spend 1AP to move to an adjacent empty square, including diagonally. You cannot pass between touching block corners. You may pass through characters or enemies only when you have enough AP to end in an unoccupied square. Unsupported characters fall immediately. Falls longer than 1 square lose health equal to distance minus the sum of defense dice. Cobwebs, lava and Journey prevent fall damage. Rope can hold you in place, but cannot stop an existing fall. Moving along rope costs 1AP for up to 2 squares, or 3 with a Loom House.
Discover all vacant tile spaces orthogonally adjacent to the tile you occupy for free. Uncovered skulls on new tiles spawn from their biome and layer's finite enemy supply. Surface spawns use the day or night tray.
Gathering and building:
Convert AP into Chop or Dig points using equipped tools, saving and spending these points separately. Pay each block's printed cost; hardy blocks require Hardy Dig. Chopping a tree costs its value and yields that much wood before yield bonuses. Moving through cobweb squares collects cobweb. You may enter a freshly dug square for free, and digging beneath yourself can cause a fall. Trees regrow at sunrise.
Spend 1AP at an uncovered adjacent chest. Draw the indicated number of chest cards and select one reward for that layer; return all drawn cards to the bottom in their original order. Loot action rewards draw two cards, keep one and put the other at the bottom. Supplies are finite. New action cards enter discard. Choose how to store, replace, donate or discard overflowing resources.
Crafting is free after paying its recipe and meeting existing house requirements, with no distance restriction. Only the top equipment in each of four slots is active. New crafted equipment equips immediately; keep old items for future rounds. Houses overlap your square or an adjacent square and cannot cover blocks or enemies; they may float. Covering a skull with a house, rope or pylon advances threat once. Craft platforms for 1 wood and ropes for 1 cobweb. Platforms occupy a square's bottom edge; rope extends downward until a block or house.
Donate any quantity of one resource, coins, platforms or ropes, or one equipment, armor or consumable to any other character for 1AP. Unlock the fifth inventory slot for 15 coins and the sixth for 25.
Combat:
Pay an equipped weapon's AP or mana cost. Short range is eight-adjacent squares; character weapons lacking short range cannot hit adjacent targets. Measure medium and long range along a ray to the target square's near edge. Long range discards one attack die past 3 squares and two past 5; past 7 is out of range. Blocks and touching corners block sight. Houses allow sight out but prevent sight in. Sightless weapons ignore LOS.
Roll attack and defense dice. Each attack result reaching the highest defense result deals 1 damage. Attack and defense points each boost only one die and may exceed its face value. Piercing targets must form an adjacent connected line; only the nearest must be in range. They share the attack roll but defend and retaliate separately. Surviving enemies retaliate if range and sight permit, using their highest defense result as one attack result. Prevention effects cancel retaliation.
Enemies:
Activate non-boss enemies in character tiles and orthogonally adjacent tiles. The team chooses activation order, tied targets and destinations, and attack order. Move toward the closest character, unless already adjacent. Use movement value with LOS or only one step without LOS. Then attack all characters in range and sight. Flyers do not fall, worms move through blocks and ordinary enemies cannot enter houses.
Environment and debuffs:
Discard all in-play action cards except the readied card. Advance time, then resolve threat and spawn icons. Sunrise regrows trees, removes surface night enemies and fallen stars, replenishes mana and resets house tokens. The second sunrise triggers King Slime.
Debuffs last for two Character starts. Frozen reduces draw by 1; On Fire loses 2 health; Poisoned discards the readied card and prevents readying this round. Equip immunity before resolving debuffs. Receiving the same debuff refreshes its duration to two starts.
Death and bosses:
Death clears debuffs, halves coins rounded down, returns consumables and minion, and shuffles all action cards into the deck. Keep resources and equipment. Remove one tombstone and advance threat by its current increment; removing the last tombstone permanently makes that increment 2. With no tombstones, death adds 2 threat. At the next Character start, respawn at full health and mana in an empty Forest Surface square or an unoccupied Bed House square.
Boss triggers are checked at Character end. A triggered boss spawns at the next Enemy start if no boss is present, making the threat increment 2. Add no ally on its spawn phase; later Enemy starts place allies and resolve specials. Alternate A/B behavior at Enemy end. A form change discards excess damage and prevents further attacks on that boss this Character phase. Distribute printed rewards after defeating it. Permanent threat from exhausted tombstones never resets.
Readying and residents:
Only completely unused hand cards can be readied. Return the old readied card to hand. Only explicit ready effects work while in that slot; retrieve it any time. New action cards enter discard, and fetching from the draw pile does not shuffle. Spawn residents when conditions and available houses permit; the Guide is always present and needs no house. Residents sell actions and consumables, heal, scrap actions or supply a shared D8.
Options:
Choose Corruption or Crimson, starting threat 0–3, alternate objectives and Objective Focus. A focused objective flips after the first incomplete phase; after the second, remove it and advance threat by the current increment. Alternate objectives are randomly selected at their corresponding levels. This implementation uses the 2026 reference version and excludes holiday promos.

zh.name: 恶夜杀机
zh.desc: 循着噪音狩猎，或藏进黑暗，合力逃出生天。
zh.rules:
目标:
一名玩家扮演杀手，其余玩家合作控制三名幸存者。杀手消灭任意一名幸存者时，立即获胜。幸存者需要共同逃离，或坚持到救援抵达。
准备:
· 选择一名杀手和三名不同的幸存者。幸存者人数不足三人时，一名玩家控制多名角色。
· 幸存者从所选地图的主要出口出发，杀手从隐藏出口出发。幸存者的位置、物品和无线电的准确维修进度对杀手保密。杀手的位置公开，潜行时除外；杀手的手牌数量和牌库余量对幸存者保密。
· 每名幸存者拥有2点生命，通常可以携带3件物品；约翰逊可以携带6件。钥匙不占背包空间。杀手从等级1开始，抽取2张起始手牌。
幸存者回合:
回合开始时清除噪音，推进已启动的救援倒计时，并检查是否满足逃脱条件。然后由团队决定各角色的行动顺序。每名角色必须完成一次主要行动，可以在主要行动前后使用额外行动，并与同地角色交换物品。
主要行动可以选择以下一项：
· 移动：沿相邻通路移动1至2步，不能通过封堵的门。
· 镇定：移除自己全部惊吓标记，即使没有标记也可以选择。
· 清障：移除与自己所在地点相连的一枚封堵标记。
· 搜索：在钥匙图标的地点抽取1张搜索牌，选择保留或弃掉。与杀手同地时不能搜索，搜索牌库耗尽后也不能搜索。
· 修理：在无线电地点增加1点维修进度，并在那里制造噪音。与杀手同地时不能修理，全队每轮只能增加一次维修进度。工具箱将本次进度改为2点，约翰逊使用工具箱时改为3点。
· 特殊行动：使用角色能力或物品上注明的特殊行动。除标有永久符号的物品外，使用后弃掉该物品。
所有角色完成主要行动后，先选择一名角色进行发现，再从发现牌库抽取2张牌，保留1张并弃掉另一张。只有1张时只抽1张。发现阶段不能再进行额外行动或交换物品。最后向杀手告知所有噪音地点，进入杀手回合。
噪音与物品:
· 抽到带噪音符号的物品时，无论最终保留还是弃掉，都在抽牌角色所在地点制造噪音。发现时两张牌都要检查。安娜搜索物品时不因抽牌制造噪音，但她进行发现时仍按通常规则处理。
· 同一地点最多放置一枚噪音标记。爆竹使所有地点都有噪音，可以掩盖其他噪音。
· 获得钥匙后立即加入全队钥匙架。背包超出上限时，立即选择物品弃掉，直到不超过上限。
· 幸存者陷阱秘密放在当前地点。在该地遭遇时，第一次防御掷骰后必须触发，增加2点防御并移除陷阱。
惊吓与生命:
· 每名幸存者最多保留2枚惊吓标记。再次受到惊吓时，改为在当前地点制造噪音，并立即告知杀手噪音地点。
· 每枚惊吓标记使防御少掷1枚骰子。受伤会失去1点生命，生命归零时被消灭，杀手立即获胜。
· 草药可以治疗自己并制造噪音。马尔科的医疗包可以治疗同地的一名角色，并清除其全部惊吓。古代护符只能防止一次遭遇之外的伤害，不能阻止直接消灭效果。
杀手回合:
· 若处于潜行，先公开当前位置，结算重现效果，再免费搜索当前地点。
· 可以使用任意张快速技能牌。支付技能费用时，必须弃掉其他手牌，不能用正在使用的技能牌支付自身费用。
· 接下来使用一张特殊技能牌，或执行两次普通行动。每次普通行动可以移动1步或搜索当前地点。
· 若本轮没有发生遭遇，可以再使用一张慢速技能牌。然后逐张抽取3张牌，结束回合。手牌上限为5张，正常抽牌超过上限时只能弃掉刚抽到的牌。
· 需要从空牌库抽牌或弃牌时，杀手升一级，先结算升级效果及解锁牌，再洗混弃牌堆形成新牌库，继续原本的抽牌或弃牌。最高等级为5级，力量最高为10点。解锁牌使手牌超限时，可以选择任意手牌弃掉。
· 杀手普通移动可以穿过封堵并移除该封堵；潜行可以穿过封堵，但不会移除它。仅仅移动到幸存者所在地点不会自动发动攻击，必须搜索才会发生遭遇。
遭遇与防御:
· 杀手搜索到同地幸存者后，先决定是否使用攻击技能牌，然后幸存者团队选择一名尚未防御的同地角色。
· 防御者可以使用一件武器，然后掷出“4减去惊吓标记数量”枚骰子。每枚骰子的六个面为0、0、1、1、1、3。左轮手枪可以与一包弹药同时使用，除此之外每次只能使用一件防御物品。
· 将骰子、武器和其他加成相加。总防御不低于杀手力量时，防御成功，杀手从牌库顶弃掉2张牌，遭遇结束。否则防御者受到1点伤害，再由另一名尚未防御的同地角色迎战，直到防御成功或所有人都已防御。
· 遭遇结束后，原遭遇地点的所有幸存者分别可以移动0至1步。杀手跳过本回合剩余步骤，抽取3张牌并结束回合。
幸存者获胜:
· 在幸存者回合开始时，若全队至少拥有5把钥匙且三名角色全部位于主要出口，全队可以共同逃脱；若有人携带秘密地图，也可以改为全员在隐藏出口逃脱。
· 无线电达到5点维修进度时，启动5轮救援倒计时。此后每个幸存者回合开始时减少1轮，归零时幸存者共同获胜。
· 发现阶段开始时，如果发现牌库已耗尽且尚未呼叫救援，幸存者立即失败。救援已经启动时跳过空牌库的发现步骤。
地图特性:
· 林中木屋：R4的行李箱每个幸存者回合可以作为额外行动使用一次，从发现牌库抽取1张牌并保留；抽到噪音物品时照常制造噪音。R5与G2之间的捷径仅供杀手移动和潜行，计算技能范围时不视为相邻。
· 古堡：R1的控制杆允许幸存者使用额外行动，把唯一的机关门放到任意一扇门上，或从原处移到另一扇门上。幸存者不能穿过机关门；杀手移动穿过时必须弃掉3张手牌，并移除机关门。首名进入B4雕像长廊的幸存者受到一次惊吓，此后不再触发。
· 实验室：B1与B4之间开局放置一枚封堵。幸存者进入R4无菌室时制造噪音。G3的急救柜可以作为特殊行动使用，治疗同地的一名幸存者并移除其全部惊吓；每局只能使用一次。
野性本能角色:
· 狼人的起始力量为6点。达到等级2时解锁“超凡听觉”，等级3时永久增加1点力量。等级4起，若本回合未发生遭遇且回合结束时未处于潜行，则使范围2内的幸存者受到惊吓。等级5的遭遇伤害仍照常生效。
· 对抗狼人时，在隐藏出口以及工具、知识、神秘地点各放置一个宝箱，洗混3张银匕首和1张银弹。幸存者可以在宝箱地点使用额外行动，移除宝箱并抽取一张银色武器。它们照常占据背包空间。
· 女猎手的起始力量为3点。开局由杀手秘密把一枚骷髅陷阱、一枚捕兽陷阱和两枚绳网陷阱分配到三处钥匙地点与无线电地点，每地一枚。位置公开，种类保密。
· 幸存者移动进入陷阱地点时，立即公开并移除该陷阱。骷髅陷阱造成一次惊吓；捕兽陷阱造成1点伤害；绳网陷阱使该角色立即停止移动，并且在下一次幸存者回合开始前不能移动。遭遇后的逃离同样会触发陷阱。
· 女猎手达到等级2时解锁“重设陷阱”，等级3起所有技能的费用减少1张牌，最低为0张；等级4起强化“追踪”。等级5的遭遇伤害仍照常生效。
无形危害：绞杀者:
· 绞杀者的起始力量为4点，在其出生地点放置一枚核心。地图上最多保留五枚核心，同一地点可以有多枚。放置第六枚时，先选择地图上的一枚核心回收，再将其放到新地点。核心的位置公开。
· 绞杀者每回合可以连续使用任意张慢速技能，直到自行结束或发生遭遇。
· 幸存者可以使用特殊行动，移除当前地点的一枚核心。
· 达到等级2时，在绞杀者当前地点放置一枚核心；等级3时解锁“狂乱藤蔓”；等级4时，在任意两个不同地点各放置一枚核心。等级5的遭遇伤害仍照常生效。
扩展幸存者:
· 乔治：在知识地点可以使用特殊行动，抽取1张搜索牌，或弃掉一个工具箱，为无线电增加1点维修进度且不制造噪音。每轮的修理限制仍适用。幸存者回合结束时，如果他与杀手的距离不超过1步，可以从尚未获得的三张笔记中选择一张加入背包。笔记照常占背包空间，只有乔治可以使用其能力。
· 迪伦：开局拥有一枚坚韧标记，自动抵消第一次受到的伤害，随后移除。在工具地点可以使用额外行动，从物品弃牌堆取回一个工具箱。
· 凯莱布：起始携带幸运硬币，也可以在神秘地点进行搜索。幸运硬币的牌效只能由凯莱布使用。
· 奥菲莉娅：可以使用特殊行动，移除任意一名幸存者的全部惊吓，并给予一枚鼓励标记，每名角色最多保留一枚。鼓励标记对杀手保密。角色受到惊吓时，可以消耗鼓励抵消这一次惊吓；防御时也可以消耗鼓励增加1点防御，并且仍可以使用武器。
· 奥菲莉娅搜索时，可以改为抽取2张牌，先选择1张放回搜索牌库顶，再照常决定保留或弃掉另一张。放回的牌不会制造噪音；其余抽牌照常检查噪音。
无形危害：不明生物:
· 不明生物的起始力量为2点。战斗适应和蜕变可以永久移除弃牌堆中的技能以提高力量。允许移除刚支付费用的牌，不能移除正在结算的技能。被永久移除的牌不再洗回牌库。
· 达到等级2和4时，各选择一种尚未拥有的进化。爬虫步态将爬行强化为移动1至3步。黏液腺体使蜕变在结算后抽取1张牌并封堵当前位置两扇门，且在未潜行的回合末封堵一扇门。拟态伪装使诡异隧道可以潜行到任意地点，在重现时增加3点力量，并在每次通过秘密通道时再增加3点力量，持续到回合末。声觉本体感受在回合开始时揭露噪音地点的幸存者；没有噪音时，改为揭露范围1内的幸存者。
· 达到等级3时，从尖锐噪音和酸液喷吐中选择一张解锁。等级5的遭遇伤害仍照常生效。
夺命不朽：雕像:
· 雕像的起始力量为5点。在隐藏出口与主要出口分别放置两尊雕像，由杀手秘密选择一尊主雕像。所有雕像位置公开，主雕像身份保密。普通移动和搜索只控制主雕像，技能可以控制其他雕像。
· 幸存者可以使用特殊行动，冻结当前地点唯一的一尊雕像。该角色本回合不能再进行任何行动。被冻结的雕像在下个幸存者回合开始前不能移动或搜索。雕像不会阻止同地幸存者搜索或修理。
· 达到等级2时增加1点力量；等级3时解锁包围；等级4时增加2点力量，并在包围位于弃牌堆时取回该牌。每次升级时，可以秘密更换主雕像。等级5的遭遇伤害仍照常生效。
腐烂敌意：墓地与女王:
· 每次升级前，从尚未坍塌的R4、R5、G5、G6中随机选择一处坍塌。先移除该地的标记、僵尸及相邻门上的封堵。该地幸存者各受1点伤害，并强制移动到一个相邻地点。杀手位于该地时，若在潜行则显现，弃掉全部手牌并撤离。撤离后移除该地点，再结算升级。
· 每个幸存者回合，全队可以在遗物地点使用一次额外行动，抽取一张遗物。遗物牌库包含钥匙、守护石、坚毅之盾、洞察宝珠和通界之镜。除钥匙外，遗物照常占用背包空间。
· 女王的起始力量为2点，在出生地点放置两只僵尸。幸存者选择一名角色起始携带弩。地图上最多有六只僵尸。僵尸位置公开，不会阻止同地幸存者搜索或修理。
· 女王普通移动时，可以带领起点的任意数量僵尸同行，潜行时不能带领僵尸。女王或僵尸搜索均可引发遭遇。攻击力量等于女王力量乘以该地女王及僵尸的棋子总数，再加攻击加成，最高为10点。
· 中毒状态公开。再次中毒时受到1点伤害。治疗同时清除毒素。等级3解锁支配，等级4在两个不同的自选地点各生成一只僵尸。未发生遭遇且未潜行的回合末，在女王当前地点生成一只僵尸。
特性与难度:
· 特性默认关闭。选择简单、普通、困难或噩梦难度时，每名幸存者均抽取两张特性并秘密选择一张。杀手依次为不使用特性、抽两张选一张、抽四张选两张、抽六张选三张。杀手选择的特性公开。双方选择后再结算开局效果。注明每局一次的特性使用后不能再次使用。
幸存者特性一览:

梦魇、小女孩与梦境：
· 在现实世界旁使用独立的梦境地图。小女孩从现实世界的隐藏出口开始，力量为1；梦魇从DB1暗影开始，力量为7。只有小女孩可以使用主要行动移动和搜索，梦魇必须依靠技能。两个棋件分别记录潜行状态。
· 幸存者将太阳之镜和月亮之镜秘密放在现实世界的不同地点。在梦境的每个红色和绿色地点分别放置1盏灯笼，在DB2和DB4分别放置2盏，共10盏。然后杀手将一名幸存者拖到DB5入梦口。三名幸存者同时进入梦境时，杀手立即获胜。库珀不能进入梦境。
· 幸存者可以执行一次特殊主要行动，移除并点亮当前位置的全部灯笼。累计点亮3盏时，两面镜子激活；达到4盏时，抽取1张钥匙搜索牌；达到5盏时，抽取2张钥匙搜索牌，按正常抽牌规则选择保留；达到6盏时，梦魇的力量降低4点。首次达到或越过对应数量时结算奖励。
· 镜子激活后，DR1太阳或DG1月亮的幸存者可以执行一次特殊主要行动，返回对应镜子在现实世界中的地点。位于现实世界镜子地点的幸存者也可以执行一次特殊主要行动，将对应梦境镜子地点的一名同伴拉回现实。告知杀手谁已返回现实，但不公开现实世界中的落点。
· 梦魇搜索梦境中的任意蓝色地点时，将梦境蓝色区域中的所有幸存者拉到她所在的地点，与所有人发生遭遇。其他梦境地点按正常规则搜索。力量增益同时作用于两个棋件，点亮6盏灯笼带来的减益只作用于梦魇。
· 集齐5把共用钥匙后，DB5同时视为主要出口和隐藏出口。梦境中的幸存者可以在DB5集合，与现实世界中在同一类出口集合的同伴一起，在下个幸存者回合开始时获胜；使用隐藏出口仍然需要地图。救援可以抵达两个世界，车辆逃脱仍要求所有人聚在车辆地点。各奔东西模式中，持有3把个人钥匙的幸存者可以按个人逃脱的正常时机，从DB5逃脱。
· 两个世界中的幸存者均可以执行发现。鞭炮在两幅地图的所有地点制造噪音。感知颜色区域时，同时检查两个世界的对应颜色。所有人都可以知道每名幸存者处于哪个世界；幸存者的具体地点和现实世界中的镜子位置仍只对幸存者阵营可见。

寄生体、感染与宿主：
· 将4张安全牌与1张感染牌洗成有限的感染牌堆。同一角色可以获得多张感染牌。寄生体始终可以查看所有已发出的牌及剩余牌。四人游戏中，每名幸存者只能查看自己的感染牌；两人或三人游戏中，幸存者不能查看任何感染牌。库珀不会被感染。
· 获得感染牌的幸存者秘密成为宿主，加入杀手阵营。只要宿主尚未变异，幸存者以任何方式获胜时，均改为寄生体与宿主获胜，即使幸存者刚在最终决战中击败寄生体也一样。
· 两个出口均为检测站。幸存者可以在检测站执行额外行动，公开同地其他幸存者的全部感染牌；两人或三人游戏中，这改为一次主行动。公开的安全牌永久移出游戏，发现感染牌则使宿主变异。两名幸存者也可以共同指控另一名角色：被指控者带有感染牌时变异；如果全部为安全牌，杀手立即获胜。
· 宿主可以在杀手回合主动变异；两人或三人游戏中，由杀手决定是否变异。变异时弃掉宿主的全部物品，并失去所有幸存者能力。此后宿主每个杀手回合只能移动0至2步，按杀手移动规则，在寄生体行动前或行动后执行一次。每个杀手回合开始时公开宿主当前位置，之后的移动保持秘密。
· 宿主变异后，每名幸存者均可以任意次执行调查当前位置的额外行动。由检测或指控引发变异的那个幸存者回合，不能调查。调查发现宿主时，调查者正常选择武器并掷骰；战斗值达到寄生体当前力量时，幸存者立即获胜，否则调查者被消灭，杀手获胜。剩余幸存者仍然可以按正常条件逃脱或等候救援。
· 布伦达成为隐藏宿主后，库珀与她同阵营，并继续由她的玩家控制。布伦达变异时，移除库珀及其物品。如果隐藏宿主布伦达的库珀死亡，布伦达立即变异，库珀之死不会直接结束游戏。

玩偶与捉迷藏：
· 玩偶不公开使用的技能牌与隐藏移动，也不会自动重现。搜索时公开位置，直到搜索及其引发的遭遇结束。带有“显露”字样的技能会使它一直公开位置，直到该技能完整结算。隐藏移动可以穿过封堵而不移除；显露时的移动照常移除封堵。
· 将三张一级恶作剧洗入发现牌库的前半部分，将三张二级恶作剧洗入后半部分。每张抽到的恶作剧都要结算，发现步骤以外的抽牌也适用。恶作剧归还，另一张物品照常获得。同次抽到两张二级恶作剧时，总共至多受到1点伤害。恶作剧制造的噪音仍在回合结束时统一告知。
· 玩偶有六枚弹簧陷阱、三枚刀刃陷阱及一枚电击陷阱。陷阱秘密放置，同一地点只能有一枚。同类陷阱用尽时，回收一枚已有同类陷阱重新放置。告知噪音时，玩偶可以触发一个带有已告知噪音的地点中的陷阱。即使该地无人，陷阱仍然消耗并回到供给区。
· 弹簧陷阱揭露该地所有幸存者，并将他们一起推到玩偶选择的一个相邻地点，移除沿途封堵，忽略高差方向。到达地点有另一枚陷阱时，玩偶可以接着触发。刀刃陷阱伤害当地所有幸存者。电击陷阱也伤害当地所有幸存者，并使下个幸存者回合无法增加任何无线电或车辆维修进度，仍然允许加油。该回合结束后，电击陷阱回到供给区。
· 每名幸存者每回合可以用一次额外行动寻找玩偶，同时公开自己的位置。当地有藏身处标记时，只移除该标记，不会找到玩偶。找到时，玩偶失去1点生命。生命归零时幸存者立即获胜；否则玩偶归还偷走的全部钥匙，弃掉一张手牌，再由发现者将它移动1至2步，沿途移除封堵并忽略高差方向。随后所有幸存者本回合都不能继续寻找，玩偶重新潜行。库珀不能寻找玩偶，也不能对玩偶发起最终决战。

医生、完美效果与毒素：
· 支付技能费用时，如果弃掉了一张与所用技能同名的牌，就会触发完美效果。正在使用的技能牌本身不算费用。完美效果有时替换原效果，有时增加一次效果，具体按技能说明执行。
· 禁闭与药物治疗在下个杀手回合重现之后、快速技能之前结算。如果重现引发遭遇，未结算的延迟标记保留到后续回合。普通效果的目标公开；完美效果的目标直到结算时才公开。
· 医生毒素会一直保留到角色接受治疗。再次对带有医生毒素的角色施加医生毒素时，造成1点伤害，毒素仍然保留。医生与女王的毒素彼此独立，同一名角色可以同时带有两种毒素。任何治疗效果都会恢复生命并清除两种毒素，未受伤的角色也可以接受治疗来清毒。库珀不会中毒。伊芙琳只能为受伤角色包扎。

眼球机器人与侦察机：
· 共有5台侦察机，位置公开，每个地点最多容纳一台。五台都已在地图上时，杀手在放置新侦察机前，选择一台已有侦察机移动到新位置。
· 被操控的侦察机会在传送前、后分别揭示所在地的幸存者。它传送至同一颜色区域内编号的下一个地点，最后一个地点则回到第一个。门、封堵和高差不影响这次传送。侦察机不阻止搜索或修理，也不引发遭遇。
· 规划路线必须经过相邻地点，不含起点。路线中的地点不能重复，也不能与尚未结算的其他路线重叠。路线和先后顺序公开。在下个延迟阶段中，每完成一步移动，就先结算对应的伤害或封堵，再继续下一步。
· 延迟移动仍须遵守高差规则。逆箭头移动前，杀手必须弃掉一张手牌；无法完成下一步时，取消尚未执行的路线。如果重现引发遭遇，延迟阶段会被跳过，路线标记保留到后续回合。

温迪戈与冻结地点：
· 供给区共有7张饥饿牌。获得的饥饿牌加入杀手手牌；手牌已满时，新牌进入弃牌堆。饥饿牌不会回到供给区。如果手牌已满且全是饥饿牌，杀手可以在抽取新技能牌前弃掉一张。
· 地图上最多同时有5枚冻结标记，同一地点可以放置多枚。需要放置第六枚时，杀手先选择一枚已有标记回收，再将它放到新地点。放置和移除标记的信息均公开。
· 幸存者不能在冻结地点进行搜索或修理。无线电或车辆所在地点被冻结时，其维修进度不能以任何方式增加，仍然可以添加燃料。
· 幸存者进入冻结地点时，必须立即结束本次移动。仍可通过其他行动或物品再次移动。库珀也受这项移动限制。
· 幸存者可以用一次特殊行动，移除当前位置的一枚冻结标记。库珀不能进行这项行动。移除的标记回到供给区。
· 速度爆发：每局一次。特殊行动：在当前地点制造噪音，然后移动2至4步。
· 调度人员：特殊行动：同地的所有其他幸存者分别移动1至2步。
· 草药知识：使用草药时，可以治疗自己或同地的另一名幸存者，且不制造噪音。
· 持枪证明：开局从发现牌库找出一把左轮手枪放入背包，然后洗混牌库。使用弹药包或银弹时，额外增加1点防御。
· 武艺超群：防御时，如果没有使用物品增强防御，增加1点防御。
· 匆匆逃离：与杀手距离不超过1步时，普通移动行动的移动上限增加1步。
· 无所畏惧：选择普通移动行动时，先移除自己的1枚惊吓标记。
· 紧急救治：每局一次。特殊行动：治疗同地的另一名幸存者。
· 生存本能：遭遇结束后可以移动0至2步，然后移除自己的全部惊吓。
· 鼓舞士气：特殊行动：移除其他所有幸存者的全部惊吓，不受地点限制。
· 安静搜查：每局一次。取消自己在发现阶段产生的一处噪音。
· 英勇阻截：与其他幸存者共同遭遇杀手并揭露目标后，可以让同地的所有其他幸存者分别移动1步离开，自己留下迎战。
· 声音诱饵：每局一次。额外行动：在任意一个地点制造噪音。
· 嘲讽战术：特殊行动：在当前地点制造噪音，杀手从牌库顶弃掉3张牌，再抽取1张牌。
· 吉人天相：防御掷骰时，如果所有骰子的结果均为0，则防御成功。
· 高度警觉：与杀手距离不超过1步时，自己不制造噪音；物品、特性和计划产生的噪音仍照常结算。
· 秘密武器：每局一次。防御时可以把本特性当作一件增加4点防御的物品使用。
· 拾物妙手：每局一次。发现阶段可以保留抽到的两件物品。背包上限仍适用。
· 明智之举：每局一次。额外行动：移除一枚相邻封堵、清除自己的全部惊吓，或在相邻地点制造噪音。
· 迅速反应：每局一次。额外行动：移动1步。
杀手特性一览:
· 玩弄猎物：遭遇幸存者时，可以立即取消遭遇，抽取3张牌并结束回合。
· 狡猾诡计：开局额外抽取1张牌。抽牌超过手牌上限时，可以选择任意手牌弃掉。
· 完全围困：回合结束时，若本回合未发生遭遇且未处于潜行，可以弃掉2张手牌，在当前地点放置一枚封堵。
· 噩梦降临：游戏开始时，使所有幸存者受到一次惊吓。
· 迅捷行动：回合开始时，若未处于潜行，可以弃掉2张手牌以移动1步。
· 敏锐听觉：回合开始时，可以弃掉1张手牌，感知一个带有噪音的地点。
· 进阶追踪：回合开始时，若未处于潜行，可以弃掉1张手牌，感知距离1以内的所有地点。
· 压抑怒火：开局没有起始手牌，力量减少1点。达到等级3时，立即再升至等级4。
· 慢热杀手：起始力量减少1点，每次升级时增加1点力量。
· 即刻反应：感知发现幸存者后，可以弃掉1张手牌，移动1步。
· 恐惧迸发：对幸存者造成伤害时，使所有幸存者受到一次惊吓。
· 致命攻击：永久增加1点力量。
· 阴险圈套：开局在任意地点总计放置两枚封堵，可以分散放置。
· 埋伏等待：开局达到等级2，结算相应升级效果，但跳过第一个杀手回合。
· 谋杀意图：感知发现幸存者后，可以弃掉1张手牌，使本次感知发现的所有幸存者受到惊吓。
· 敏锐感知：每回合一次。感知发现幸存者后，可以再感知一个颜色区域。
· 压迫威慑：达到等级3、4或5时，使任意一名幸存者受到惊吓。
· 狡诈猎手：达到等级2或4时，在任意地点放置一枚封堵。
· 恐惧光环：回合结束时，若本回合未发生遭遇且未处于潜行，使当前地点的所有幸存者受到惊吓。
· 危险伏击：回合结束时，若本回合未发生遭遇且未处于潜行，可以弃掉1张手牌，潜行0至2步。
生存计划:
· 此可选变体向幸存者团队发两张计划牌。在发现步骤结束后，如果下一步条件已经满足，团队可以选择一个计划前进一步。只能保留一个计划的进度；切换计划时，原计划的进度全部失去。杀手潜行时，没有可用于计划判定的杀手地点。
· 完成计划后解锁其能力，翻面另一张计划，不能再完成它。“所有幸存者”只包括存活角色。放在地图上的计划标记不能重新放置。全队每局一次的能力由首名符合条件并选择使用的角色消耗。
计划一览（条件按列出的顺序逐步检查）:
· 通道调查：有人位于神秘地点 → 有人位于知识地点 → 有人位于知识地点。所有秘密通道相互连接。特殊行动：通过当前地点的一条秘密通道。
· 古代箱子：有人位于知识地点 → 有人位于神秘地点。每局一次。特殊行动：弃掉一个古代护符，从搜索牌库抽取3张牌并全部保留，照常检查噪音与背包上限。抽牌期间不能交换物品。
· 反击！暗中伏击：有人位于知识地点 → 所有存活幸存者位于同一地点 → 有人位于杀手地点。完成时，选择一名幸存者，在其地点放置计划标记。在该地防御时，如果防御比杀手力量至少高出3点，幸存者立即获胜。
· 蜂鸣器：有人位于杀手地点 → 有人位于杀手地点 → 有人位于工具地点。每局一次。特殊行动：弃掉一个工具箱，在当前地点放置计划标记。此后，幸存者在标记地点可以使用额外行动制造噪音。
· 情报分享：所有存活幸存者位于不同地点 → 所有存活幸存者位于不同地点 → 所有存活幸存者位于同一地点。完成时，选择一名幸存者，从搜索牌库抽取并保留1张牌。
· 燃烧瓶：有人位于工具地点 → 有人位于工具地点。每次防御一次，可以弃掉一瓶威士忌，增加2点防御；仍可以照常使用其他防御物品。
· 秘术草药：有人位于神秘地点 → 有人位于神秘地点。全队每局一次。在神秘地点使用额外行动：治疗自己并移除自己的全部惊吓。
· 谨慎修理：有人位于无线电地点 → 有人位于工具地点 → 有人位于无线电地点。使用工具箱修理时，不制造噪音。
· 万能钥匙：有人位于工具地点 → 有人位于工具地点 → 有人位于知识地点 → 有人位于知识地点。全队每局一次。在主要出口使用特殊行动：弃掉一个工具箱，获得搜索牌库中最靠近牌库底的一把钥匙。
· 被封印的传送门：有人位于隐藏出口 → 有人位于神秘地点 → 有人位于神秘地点 → 有人位于知识地点。幸存者回合开始时，若全队位于同一神秘地点，并共同持有秘密地图、手电筒和古代护符，则立即获胜。
· 自制无线电：有人位于知识地点 → 有人位于无线电地点 → 有人位于知识地点 → 有人位于工具地点。特殊行动：弃掉一个工具箱，立即完成无线电修理，并在当前地点制造噪音。
· 反击！奥术封印：有人位于神秘地点 → 有人位于杀手地点 → 有人位于神秘地点 → 有人位于神秘地点。完成时，在神秘地点制造噪音。此后，在神秘地点使用长剑成功防御时，幸存者立即获胜。
· 反击！火箭发射器：有人位于工具地点 → 有人位于知识地点 → 有人位于杀手地点 → 有人位于工具地点。幸存者回合开始时，若全队位于同一地点且该地与杀手相邻，并且上一回合没有发生遭遇，则立即获胜。潜行中的杀手没有可供判定的地点。
· 反击！爆炸陷阱：有人位于杀手地点 → 有人位于工具地点 → 有人位于杀手地点 → 有人位于工具地点。全队每局一次。特殊行动：弃掉一个工具箱，在当前地点放置计划标记。杀手搜索标记地点且该地没有幸存者时，幸存者立即获胜。
· 机械蓝图：有人位于知识地点 → 有人位于工具地点 → 有人位于知识地点。每放置一枚维修标记，可以额外放置一枚，仍不超过无线电所需的总进度。
· 现场研究：有人位于隐藏出口 → 所有存活幸存者位于同一地点。全队每局一次。额外行动：移动1至2步。
各奔前程（仅限四人）:
· 每名幸存者由不同玩家控制，分别争取生还。随机选择首位幸存者标记的持有者。每轮结束时，只由持有标记的角色进行发现并告知噪音，然后把标记顺时针交给下一名仍在局中的幸存者。同时启用生存计划时，也由标记持有者决定是否推进，以及推进哪个计划。
· 钥匙归找到它的角色所有，不占背包空间。幸存者回合开始时，持有至少三把钥匙的角色若位于主要出口，便独自逃脱；携带秘密地图时，也可以在隐藏出口独自逃脱。该角色离开对局，其余角色继续游戏。
· 一名幸存者被消灭时，游戏继续，杀手升一级。其物品和钥匙留在遗体所在地点。其他角色可以在同地使用额外行动，取走任意数量的遗留物品或钥匙。同地存活角色也可以给予物品或钥匙，但须由接收方同意。移除封堵的角色必须亲自告知杀手。
· 每实际放置一枚无线电维修标记，修理者立即从搜索牌库抽取一张牌。救援抵达时，仍存活的幸存者共同获胜。计划带来的共同胜利也只计算存活角色。
· 当所有幸存者均已逃脱、共同获救或被消灭时，游戏结束。逃脱或获救的角色分别获胜。杀手消灭至少两名幸存者也算获胜，因此杀手与一名幸存者可以同时获胜；消灭全部三人时为杀手完全胜利。补给耗尽仍会结束对局，先前已经独自逃脱的角色仍保留胜利。

跨代组合与地图模块:
· 两代角色和地图可以组合使用。默认采用地图所属代际的规则与物品牌库。“战斗值”与“防御值”含义相同。采用二代规则时，角色能力中的“搜索”或“搜索牌库”也适用于钥匙、医疗和武器牌库，但能力明确限定牌库时仍遵守该限制。
· 在初代地图上采用二代规则时，增加一个车辆维修地点、一个医疗搜索地点和一个武器搜索地点，三个模块必须位于不同地点。恰好替换一个原钥匙地点，可以用上述模块之一覆盖，也可以用叉号取消其功能。将一至两扇普通门改为高差，箭头表示向下移动的方向。不能覆盖无线电或地图独有功能。建议分散放置模块，并避开主要出口、工具、知识和神秘地点。
· 在二代地图上采用初代规则时，增加一个钥匙地点，并取消所有车辆维修、医疗搜索和武器搜索功能。原功能由新增钥匙模块或叉号覆盖。将所有高差改为普通门。新增钥匙不能覆盖无线电或地图独有功能。
· 开局页面提供符合放置规则、可以调整的默认布局。这些是数字版默认安排，并非规则书推荐图的逐点复制。双方始终使用相同的改造地图。仅更换角色，不会改变地图规则和牌库。

en.name: Terrorscape
en.desc: Hunt by sound, or hide in the dark and escape together.
en.rules:
Objective:
One player is the Killer. The other players cooperate to control three Survivors. The Killer wins by eliminating any one Survivor. The Survivors win by escaping together or surviving until rescue arrives.
Setup:
· Choose one Killer and three different Survivors. With fewer than three Survivor players, a player controls more than one character.
· Survivors begin at the main exit of the chosen map. The Killer begins at its hidden exit. Survivor locations, inventories and exact radio repair progress are hidden from the Killer. The Killer's location is public except during stealth. Their hand size and remaining deck size are hidden from Survivors.
· Each Survivor has 2 health and normally 3 inventory slots. Johnson has 6 slots. Keys do not occupy inventory slots. The Killer starts at level 1 and draws 2 starting cards.
Survivor turn:
At the start of the turn, remove noise tokens, advance an active rescue countdown, and check for escape. The team then chooses the order in which characters act. Each character must perform one main action. They may perform extra actions and exchange items with characters at the same location before or after their main action.
Choose one of the following main actions:
· Move: Travel 1 to 2 steps through adjacent locations. Survivors cannot pass blocked doors.
· Calm down: Remove all your fear tokens. You may choose this even with no fear tokens.
· Remove a block: Remove one block token on a door connected to your current location.
· Search: At a key location, draw 1 search card and keep or discard it. You cannot search at the Killer's location or when the search deck is empty.
· Repair: At the radio location, add 1 repair progress and make noise there. You cannot repair at the Killer's location. The team can repair only once per turn. A Toolbox increases this action's progress to 2, or 3 when Johnson uses it.
· Special action: Use a character ability or an item's special action. Discard an item after use unless it has the permanent symbol.
After all characters have taken their main actions, first choose one character to discover. Draw 2 discover cards, keep one and discard the other. If only 1 remains, draw that card. You cannot take extra actions or exchange items after discovery starts. Inform the Killer of all noise locations, then begin the Killer's turn.
Noise and items:
· Drawing an item with a noise symbol makes noise at the drawing character's location, whether kept or discarded. Check both cards during discovery. Anna does not make noise from items drawn while searching, but follows normal noise rules when discovering.
· Each location can have only one noise token. A Firecracker makes every location noisy, masking other noise.
· A gained key immediately joins the team's key collection. If an inventory exceeds its limit, discard items until it is within the limit.
· A Survivor Trap is secretly placed at the user's location. During an encounter there, it must trigger after the first defense roll, adding 2 defense before being removed.
Fear and health:
· Each Survivor can hold at most 2 fear tokens. Further fear makes noise at their current location, which is immediately announced to the Killer.
· Each fear token removes one defense die. An injury costs 1 health. Reaching zero health eliminates the Survivor and immediately wins the game for the Killer.
· Herbs heal their user and make noise. Marco's First Aid Kit heals one character at his location and removes all their fear. An Ancient Amulet can prevent one injury outside an encounter, but cannot prevent direct elimination.
Killer turn:
· If in stealth, reveal your current location, resolve your reappear effect, and search there for free.
· You may play any number of fast skill cards. Pay costs by discarding other hand cards; the card being played cannot pay for itself.
· Next, play one special skill card or take two main actions. A main action is to move 1 step or search your current location.
· If no encounter occurred, you may play one slow skill card. Then draw 3 cards one at a time and end the turn. The hand limit is 5. When a normal draw exceeds that limit, discard only the newly drawn card.
· Whenever you must draw or discard from an empty deck, gain a level. Resolve level effects and unlocks, shuffle your discard pile into a new deck, then continue. The maximum level is 5 and maximum strength is 10. If an unlocked card exceeds your hand limit, choose any hand card to discard.
· Normal Killer movement passes blocked doors and removes their blocks. Stealth passes blocks without removing them. Entering a Survivor's location does not automatically attack: the Killer must search.
Encounters and defense:
· When a search finds Survivors, the Killer first decides whether to use an attack skill. The Survivor team then chooses one character there who has not defended during this encounter.
· The defender may use one weapon, then rolls 4 dice minus their fear tokens. Each die has faces 0, 0, 1, 1, 1, 3. A Revolver may be combined with one Ammo; otherwise only one defense item may be used per attack.
· Add dice, weapon and other bonuses. A result at least equal to the Killer's strength succeeds: discard 2 cards from the top of the Killer's deck and end the encounter. Otherwise the defender loses 1 health, then another eligible Survivor defends. Continue until defense succeeds or everyone has defended.
· After the encounter, all Survivors originally involved may each move 0 to 1 step. The Killer skips the remaining turn steps, draws 3 cards and ends the turn.
Survivor victory:
· At the start of a Survivor turn, having at least 5 keys and all three characters at the main exit wins by escape. If someone carries a Secret Map, the team may instead gather at the hidden exit.
· Reaching 5 radio repair progress starts a 5-turn rescue countdown. Reduce it by 1 at the start of each subsequent Survivor turn. At zero, the Survivors win.
· Starting discovery with an empty discover deck loses the game unless rescue has already been called. With rescue active, skip discovery if that deck is empty.
Map features:
· The Cabin: once per Survivor turn, a Survivor at R4 may use an extra action to draw and keep one card from the discover deck. A noisy card still creates noise. The shortcut between R5 and G2 is adjacent only for Killer movement and stealth; it does not shorten skill ranges.
· The Castle: as an extra action at R1, a Survivor may place the single contraption gate on any door, moving it from its previous door if necessary. Survivors cannot cross it. A moving Killer must discard 3 cards to cross it and remove it. The first Survivor to enter B4 Statue Corridor gains one fear; it does not trigger again.
· The Laboratory: the door between B1 and B4 begins blocked. A Survivor entering R4 Sterile Room creates noise. As a special action at G3, a Survivor may use the first-aid cabinet to heal a Survivor there and remove all their fear. The cabinet can be used only once per game.
Feral Instincts characters:
· The Werewolf starts with 6 strength. Level 2 unlocks Hyper-hearing, and level 3 permanently adds 1 strength. From level 4, at the end of a turn without an encounter, frighten all Survivors within range 2 if the Werewolf is not in stealth. The normal level 5 encounter damage still applies.
· Against the Werewolf, place treasure boxes at the hidden exit, Tool, Knowledge and Mystic locations. Shuffle 3 Silver Daggers and 1 Silver Bullets. A Survivor at a treasure box may use an extra action to remove it and draw one silver weapon. These items occupy inventory slots normally.
· The Huntress starts with 3 strength. During setup, the Killer secretly distributes one Skull Trap, one Bear Trap and two Net Traps between the three key locations and the radio location, one per location. Trap locations are public, but their types are hidden.
· Moving into a trap immediately reveals and removes it. A Skull Trap causes one fear. A Bear Trap deals 1 damage. A Net Trap stops movement and prevents that Survivor from moving until the next Survivor turn begins. Fleeing after an encounter also triggers traps.
· Level 2 unlocks Traps Reset. From level 3, all Huntress skill costs decrease by 1 card, to a minimum of 0. Level 4 improves Tracking. The normal level 5 encounter damage still applies.
Amorphous Peril: the Strangler:
· The Strangler starts with 4 strength and one core at its starting location. At most five cores may be on the map, and a location may have several. Before placing a sixth core, choose one existing core to retrieve and place it in the new location. Core locations are public.
· The Strangler may play any number of slow skills each turn, until it ends its turn or an encounter interrupts it.
· A Survivor may use a special action to remove one core at their current location.
· Level 2 places one core at the Strangler location. Level 3 unlocks Frenzy Vines. Level 4 places one core in each of two different locations of your choice. The normal level 5 encounter damage still applies.
Expansion Survivors:
· George: at a Knowledge location, use a special action to draw 1 search card, or discard a Toolbox to add 1 radio repair progress without noise. The repair limit still applies. At the end of a Survivor turn, if he is within range 1 of the Killer, he may add one of his three remaining notes to his inventory. Notes occupy slots normally, and only George can use their abilities.
· Dylan: start with a Toughness token. It automatically cancels the first damage, then is removed. Extra action at a Tool location: retrieve a Toolbox from the item discard pile.
· Caleb: start with his Lucky Coin. He may also search at Mystic locations. Only Caleb can use the Lucky Coin.
· Ophelia: use a special action to remove all fear from any Survivor and give them an Encouragement token, at most one per Survivor. These tokens are hidden from the Killer. When affected by fear, a Survivor may spend the token to cancel that one fear gain. They may instead spend it for 1 extra defense, in addition to using a weapon normally.
· When searching, Ophelia may draw 2 cards, first return one to the top of the search deck, then keep or discard the other normally. The returned card creates no noise; check the other card for noise normally.
Amorphous Peril: Unidentified:
· Unidentified starts at 2 strength. Its Combat Adaptation and Metamorphosis permanently remove cards from the discard pile to increase strength. Paid cost cards can be removed, but the skill currently resolving cannot. Removed cards never return when the deck is shuffled.
· At levels 2 and 4, choose a different evolution. Reptilian Crawl improves Crawl to 1–3 steps. Slime Glands adds a draw and two blocks after Metamorphosis, and places one block at turn end if not in stealth. Camouflage lets Creepy Tunnel stealth to any location; reappearing grants 3 strength, and each secret-passage traversal grants another 3 strength until turn end. Sonic Proprioception reveals Survivors at noisy locations at turn start; if there is no noise, reveal Survivors within range 1 instead.
· At level 3, choose Strident Noise or Acid Spit as the unlocked skill. The normal level 5 encounter damage still applies.
Lethal Immortals: Statues:
· Start at 5 strength. Place two Statues at the hidden exit and two at the main exit. The Killer secretly chooses one as the Main Statue. All Statue positions are public, but the Main Statue’s identity is hidden. Basic movement and searching control only the Main Statue; skills can control the others.
· A Survivor may use a special action to freeze the only Statue at their location. That Survivor cannot perform further actions this turn. A frozen Statue cannot move or search until the next Survivor turn. Statues do not prevent Survivors at their locations from searching or repairing.
· Gain 1 strength at level 2. Unlock Encirclement at level 3. Gain 2 strength at level 4 and retrieve Encirclement from the discard pile if it is there. On every level gain, the Killer may secretly change the Main Statue. The normal level 5 encounter damage still applies.
Putrefied Enmity: the Tomb and Queen:
· Before each level increase, one remaining passage among R4, R5, G5 and G6 collapses at random. Remove tokens and zombies there and blocks on adjoining doors. Survivors there each suffer 1 damage and must move to an adjacent location. A Killer there reappears if in stealth, discards all hand cards and must leave. Remove the location after evacuation, then resolve the level increase.
· A Survivor at the Relic location may use an extra action once per team turn to draw one relic. The relic deck contains a Key, Stone of Protection, Shield of Fortitude, Orb of Insight and Mirror of Gateway. These items use inventory slots normally, except the Key.
· The Queen starts at 2 strength with two zombies at her location. The Survivors choose one character to carry the Crossbow. There can be at most six zombies. Zombies are public and do not prevent searching or repairing.
· During normal movement, the Queen may bring any number of zombies from her starting location. Stealth never brings zombies. An encounter may be started by the Queen or a zombie searching. Attack strength is the Queen’s strength multiplied by the number of Queen/zombie figures at that location, plus attack bonuses, capped at 10.
· Poison is public. Being poisoned again deals 1 damage. Healing also removes poison. Level 3 unlocks Domination; level 4 spawns two zombies at different chosen locations. If no encounter occurred and she is not in stealth, spawn one zombie at the Queen’s location at turn end.
Traits and difficulty:
· Traits are optional. At Easy, Normal, Hard and Nightmare, each Survivor draws two traits and secretly chooses one. The Killer respectively receives none, draws two and chooses one, draws four and chooses two, or draws six and chooses three. Chosen Killer traits are public. Resolve setup effects after drafting. A once-per-game trait becomes unavailable after use.
Survivor trait reference:

Nightmare, the Girl and the Dream:
· Use a separate Dream map beside the Real World. The Girl begins at the Real World hidden exit with 1 strength. The Nightmare begins at DB1 Shadow with 7 strength. Only the Girl can use main movement and search actions; the Nightmare requires skills. The two figures keep separate stealth states.
· Survivors secretly place the Sun and Moon Mirrors at different Real World locations. Place ten lanterns at the printed Dream locations: one at each red and green location and two each at DB2 and DB4. The Killer then drags one Survivor to DB5 Way-in. Whenever three Survivors are in the Dream, the Killer immediately wins. Cooper cannot enter the Dream.
· As a special main action, a Survivor removes and lights all lanterns at their location. At three lit lanterns both mirrors activate. At four, draw one Key search card; at five, draw two Key search cards using normal draw-and-keep rules. At six, the Nightmare loses 4 strength. Benefits apply when a threshold is first reached or crossed.
· With active mirrors, a Survivor at DR1 Sun or DG1 Moon may use a special main action to return to the corresponding mirror in the Real World. A Survivor beside that Real World mirror may instead use a special main action to pull one Survivor from its corresponding Dream mirror. The Killer is told who returned, but the Real World destination remains secret.
· When the Nightmare searches any blue Dream location, pull every Survivor in the Dream blue zone to her location and start an encounter with all of them. Other Dream locations use normal search rules. Strength bonuses apply to both figures; the six-lantern reduction applies only to the Nightmare.
· Five shared Keys make DB5 count as both exits. Survivors there can gather with their teammates at one matching Real World exit and win at the next Survivor turn. A hidden exit still requires a Map. Rescue reaches both worlds. Vehicle escape still requires everyone together at the vehicle. In Separate Ways, a Survivor with three personal Keys can escape from DB5 under the normal personal escape timing.
· Discoveries work in both worlds. Firecrackers make noise across both maps. Sensing a color zone checks that color in both worlds. Everyone can see which world each Survivor occupies; exact Survivor locations and the Real World mirrors remain private to the Survivor side.

The Parasitoid, infection and the Host:
· Shuffle four Safe tiles and one Infected tile into a finite supply. A character can receive multiple tiles. The Parasitoid can inspect every tile and the supply. In a four-player game, each Survivor sees only their own tiles. In a two- or three-player game, Survivors cannot inspect any infection tiles. Cooper cannot be infected.
· A Survivor receiving the Infected tile secretly becomes the Host and joins the Killer. If Survivors win by any means while that Host remains hidden, the Parasitoid and Host take the victory instead, including after Final Showdown.
· The two exits are testing stations. A Survivor there may test all other Survivors at that location as an extra action, or a main action in a two- or three-player game. Revealed Safe tiles are permanently removed. An Infected result mutates the Host. Two other Survivors may also agree to accuse a character: an Infected result mutates the Host, but an entirely Safe result immediately wins for the Killer.
· The Host may voluntarily mutate during the Killer turn. In a two- or three-player game, the Killer makes this decision. Mutation discards all Host items and removes all Survivor abilities. The Host only moves 0–2 steps, once before or after the Parasitoid’s actions, using Killer movement rules. Its current location is announced at the beginning of each Killer turn; later movement is hidden.
· After mutation, each Survivor may investigate their own location any number of times as an extra action. Investigation is unavailable for the Survivor turn in which testing or accusation caused mutation. If the Host is there, the investigator chooses weapons and rolls normally. Reaching the Parasitoid’s current strength wins for Survivors; failing eliminates the investigator and wins for the Killer. Other normal escape and rescue conditions remain available to the remaining Survivors.
· If Brenda becomes a hidden Host, Cooper shares her allegiance and remains under her player’s control. Brenda’s mutation removes Cooper and his items. If Cooper dies while Brenda is a hidden Host, Brenda immediately mutates instead of that death ending the game.

The Doll and Hide and Seek:
· The Doll does not declare its skill cards or hidden moves, and never reappears automatically. A search reveals its location until the search and any encounter finish. A REVEAL skill keeps it visible until that skill fully resolves. Hidden movement bypasses blocks; revealed movement removes them as usual.
· Shuffle three tier one pranks into the top half of the discover deck and three tier two pranks into the bottom half. Every drawn prank resolves, including draws outside the discovery step. Return pranks; keep the other drawn item. Two tier two pranks drawn together cause at most 1 damage in total. Noise is reported at turn end.
· There are six spring traps, three knife traps and one shock trap. Place them secretly, with at most one trap at a location. If a type runs out, reuse an existing trap of that type. At the inform-noise step, the Doll may trigger one trap at a reported noise location. An empty trap still returns to supply.
· A spring trap reveals everyone there and pushes them together to one adjacent location chosen by the Doll, removing blocks and ignoring elevation direction. A trap at the destination may then trigger. A knife trap damages everyone there. A shock trap does the same and prevents all radio and vehicle repairs during the next Survivor turn; refuelling remains allowed. The shock token returns to supply after that turn.
· Each Survivor may seek once per turn as an extra action, revealing their location. A hideout token is removed instead of finding the Doll. If found, the Doll loses 1 life. At zero life the Survivors win immediately; otherwise it returns all stolen keys, discards one hand card, and is moved 1–2 steps by the finder, removing blocks and ignoring elevation direction. Everyone then loses their remaining seek attempts for this turn, and the Doll hides again. Cooper cannot seek. Final Showdown cannot be used against the Doll.

The Doctor, Perfect effects and poison:
· A Perfect effect triggers when a skill is paid for by discarding a skill with the same name. The played skill itself is not payment. Perfect effects may replace the original effect or add another effect, as described on the skill.
· Incarceration and Drug Treatment resolve during the next Killer turn, after reappearing and before fast skills. If reappearing starts an encounter, unresolved delay tokens remain for a later turn. Normal targets are public; Perfect targets remain secret until resolution.
