· A Doctor poison token remains until healing. Applying Doctor poison again deals 1 damage without removing the token. Doctor poison and Queen poison are independent; a Survivor can have both. Any HEAL effect restores health and removes both types, including when the Survivor is uninjured. Cooper cannot be poisoned. Evelyn can only bandage an injured Survivor.

Eyebot and droids:
· There are 5 droids. Their locations are public, and no location may hold two. If all are in use, the Killer chooses one to relocate when placing another.
· An operated droid reveals Survivors before and after teleporting. It moves to the next numbered location in its color zone; the last location wraps to the first. Doors, blocks and elevated levels do not affect this teleport. Droids do not prevent searches or repairs and do not cause encounters.
· A programmed route consists of adjacent locations, excluding the starting location. Its locations must not repeat or overlap another unresolved programmed route. The route and its order are public. During the next delay step, resolve one movement and its damage or block effect before proceeding to the next.
· Elevated levels still apply during delayed movement. The Killer must discard a card before moving against an arrow. If the next step cannot be completed, cancel the remaining route. An encounter during reappearance skips the delay step and leaves its tokens for a later turn.

The Wendigo and frozen locations:
· The supply contains 7 Hunger cards. Gained Hunger cards go to the Killer hand, or the discard pile if the hand is full. They never return to the supply. When a full hand consists only of Hunger cards, the Killer may discard one before drawing a new skill card.
· At most 5 freeze tokens may be on the map, including several at one location. To place a sixth token, the Killer first chooses an existing token to reuse. Placements and removals are public.
· Survivors cannot perform search or repair actions at a frozen location. If the radio or vehicle location is frozen, its repair progress cannot increase by any means. Refuelling remains allowed.
· A Survivor who enters a frozen location must end that MOVE immediately. Another action or item may let them move again. This restriction also applies to Cooper.
· As a special action, a Survivor may remove one freeze token from their location. Cooper cannot perform this action. Removed tokens return to the supply.
· Burst of Speed：Once per game. Special action: Make noise here, then move 2 to 4 steps.
· Dispatcher：Special action: All other Survivors here each move 1 to 2 steps.
· Herbalist：Herbs can heal you or another Survivor here without making noise.
· Firearm Permit：Start with a Revolver taken from the discover deck, then shuffle that deck. Ammo and Silver Bullets add 1 extra defense.
· Martial Artist：Gain 1 defense when no item is used to enhance defense.
· Hasty Retreat：When within 1 step of the Killer, your basic move action allows 1 extra step.
· Fearless：Remove 1 of your fear tokens before your basic move action.
· Emergency Treatment：Once per game. Special action: Heal another Survivor here.
· Survival Instinct：After an encounter, move 0 to 2 steps, then remove all your fear.
· Morale：Special action: Remove all fear from every other Survivor, at any location.
· Silent Search：Once per game, cancel one noise you make during discovery.
· Heroic Block：After an encounter reveals you and other Survivors, let all the others here move 1 step away while you stay to defend.
· Noise Lure：Once per game. Extra action: Make noise at any location.
· Baiting Tactics：Special action: Make noise here. The Killer discards 3 cards from their deck, then draws 1.
· Lucky：A defense roll showing only zeroes succeeds.
· Alertness：Within 1 step of the Killer, you make no noise except noise caused by items, traits or plans.
· Secret Weapon：Once per game, use this trait as an item adding 4 defense.
· Scavenger：Once per game, keep both items drawn during discovery. Inventory limits still apply.
· Prudent：Once per game. Extra action: Remove an adjacent block, clear all your fear, or make noise at an adjacent location.
· Quick Reaction：Once per game. Extra action: Move 1 step.
Killer trait reference:
· Toy with Prey：When an encounter begins, you may cancel it, draw 3 cards and end your turn.
· Cunning：Draw 1 extra starting card. When drawing exceeds your hand limit, choose any hand cards to discard.
· Complete Confinement：At turn end, if no encounter occurred and you are not in stealth, discard 2 hand cards to place a block here.
· Nightmare：At setup, inflict fear on all Survivors.
· Swift Action：At turn start, if not in stealth, discard 2 hand cards to move 1 step.
· Keen Hearing：At turn start, discard 1 hand card to sense a noisy location.
· Advanced Tracking：At turn start, if not in stealth, discard 1 hand card to sense all locations within 1 step.
· Suppressed Rage：Start without hand cards and with 1 less strength. On reaching level 3, immediately advance to level 4.
· Slow Burn：Start with 1 less strength. Gain 1 strength whenever you gain a level.
· Instant Reaction：After a sense finds Survivors, discard 1 hand card to move 1 step.
· Fear Burst：Whenever you injure a Survivor, inflict fear on all Survivors.
· Deadly Attack：Permanently gain 1 strength.
· Insidious Snare：At setup, place 2 blocks at any locations. They may be split between locations.
· Lie in Wait：Start at level 2 with its level effects, but skip your first Killer turn.
· Murderous Intent：After a sense finds Survivors, discard 1 hand card to inflict fear on all Survivors it found.
· Keen Sense：Once per turn, after a sense finds Survivors, sense one additional color zone.
· Oppressive Threat：On reaching level 3, 4 or 5, inflict fear on any one Survivor.
· Cunning Hunter：On reaching level 2 or 4, place a block at any location.
· Terror Aura：At turn end, if no encounter occurred and you are not in stealth, inflict fear on all Survivors here.
· Perilous Ambush：At turn end, if no encounter occurred and you are not in stealth, discard 1 hand card to stealth 0 to 2 steps.
Survival Plans:
· This optional variant deals two Plan cards to the Survivor team. After discovery, the team may advance one plan by one step if its next condition is met. Only one plan retains progress: switching plans loses the previous plan’s progress. A Killer in stealth has no location for these conditions.
· On completing a plan, unlock its ability and turn the other plan over; it can no longer be completed. “All Survivors” means all living Survivors. A placed plan token cannot be relocated. A shared once-per-game ability can be used by the first eligible Survivor who chooses it.
Plan reference (conditions are checked in the listed order):
· Passage Research：a Mystic location → a Knowledge location → a Knowledge location。All secret passages connect. Special action: Use a secret passage at your location.
· Ancient Box：a Knowledge location → a Mystic location。Once per game. Special action: Discard an Ancient Amulet to draw and keep 3 search cards. Check noise and capacity normally. You cannot exchange items while drawing.
· Strike Back! Ambush：a Knowledge location → all living Survivors together → the Killer’s location。On completion, place the plan token at a Survivor’s location. Defending there with a total at least 3 above the Killer’s strength immediately wins for the Survivors.
· Buzzer：the Killer’s location → the Killer’s location → a Tool location。Once per game. Special action: Discard a Toolbox to place the plan token here. Survivors there may then use an extra action to make noise.
· Information Sharing：all living Survivors in different locations → all living Survivors in different locations → all living Survivors together。On completion, choose a Survivor to draw and keep 1 search card.
· Molotov：a Tool location → a Tool location。Once per defense, discard a Whiskey Bottle for 2 defense. You may still use other defense items normally.
· Mystic Herbs：a Mystic location → a Mystic location。Once per game for the team. Extra action at a Mystic location: Heal yourself and remove all your fear.
· Careful Repair：the radio location → a Tool location → the radio location。Repairing with a Toolbox makes no noise.
· Master Key：a Tool location → a Tool location → a Knowledge location → a Knowledge location。Once per game for the team. Special action at the main exit: Discard a Toolbox to gain the bottommost key from the search deck.
· Sealed Portal：the hidden exit → a Mystic location → a Mystic location → a Knowledge location。At Survivor turn start, win if all Survivors share one Mystic location and together carry a Secret Map, Flashlight and Ancient Amulet.
· Makeshift Radio：a Knowledge location → the radio location → a Knowledge location → a Tool location。Special action: Discard a Toolbox to complete radio repairs immediately and make noise at your location.
· Strike Back! Arcane Seal：a Mystic location → the Killer’s location → a Mystic location → a Mystic location。On completion, make noise at the Mystic location. A successful defense using a Longsword at a Mystic location then wins for the Survivors.
· Strike Back! Rocket Launcher：a Tool location → a Knowledge location → the Killer’s location → a Tool location。At Survivor turn start, win if all Survivors share a location adjacent to the Killer and no encounter occurred in the preceding turn. A Killer in stealth has no location for this condition.
· Strike Back! Explosive Trap：the Killer’s location → a Tool location → the Killer’s location → a Tool location。Once per game for the team. Special action: Discard a Toolbox to place the plan token here. If the Killer searches it with no Survivor there, the Survivors win.
· Mechanical Blueprint：a Knowledge location → a Tool location → a Knowledge location。Each repair token placed allows one additional repair token, up to the radio’s required total.
· Field Research：the hidden exit → all living Survivors together。Once per game for the team. Extra action: Move 1 to 2 steps.
Separate Ways (4 players):
· Each Survivor is controlled by a different player and competes for their own survival. Randomly choose the first Survivor token holder. Only that character discovers at turn end and informs noise, then passes the token clockwise to the next remaining Survivor. The token holder also decides whether and which Survival Plan to advance.
· Keep keys separately on each character’s board; they take no inventory space. At Survivor turn start, a character holding at least three keys escapes alone if at the main exit, or at the hidden exit while carrying a Secret Map. Their character leaves play and the others continue.
· Eliminating a Survivor does not end the game. The Killer gains one level. Items and keys stay at the body’s location. A Survivor there may take any number using extra actions. Living characters at the same location may give items or keys if the recipient agrees. A Survivor removing a block must personally announce it.
· Every actual radio repair progress token placed immediately rewards the repairer with one draw from the search deck. Rescue wins for all remaining living Survivors. Plan victories also count only living Survivors.
· End when every Survivor has escaped, won together or been eliminated. Escaped or rescued characters win individually. The Killer also wins by eliminating at least two Survivors, so the Killer and one Survivor may both win. Eliminating all three is an undefeated Killer victory. Supply exhaustion still ends the game; earlier personal escapes remain victories.

Cross-season combinations and map modules:
· Characters and maps from either season can be combined. By default, a map uses the rules and item decks of its own season. Combat value and defense value mean the same thing. Under Season 2 rules, an ability referring to searching or the search deck can also apply to the Key, Medical or Weapon deck, unless the ability specifies a particular one.
· To use Season 2 rules on a Season 1 map, add one Vehicle repair location, one Medical location and one Weapon location. Put them at different locations. Replace exactly one original Key location with one of these modules or an X. Replace one or two ordinary doors with elevated levels; the arrows point downward. Do not cover the radio or unique map functions. Spreading modules out and avoiding the main exit, Tool, Knowledge and Mystic locations is recommended.
· To use Season 1 rules on a Season 2 map, add one Key location and remove all Vehicle, Medical and Weapon functions. Each removed function is covered by the new Key module or an X. Replace every elevated level with an ordinary door. The new Key cannot cover the radio or a unique map function.
· The setup screen provides adjustable layouts that follow these placement rules. They are digital defaults rather than copies of the rulebook’s illustrated examples. Both sides always use the same modified map. Changing characters alone does not change the map’s rules or decks.

zh.name: The Dealer
zh.desc: 在太空赌场里，看着别人的手牌，猜测自己的点数。相信谁，又该何时收手？
zh.rules:
游戏目标:
在所有轮次结束后获得最多分数。你能看见其他人尚未封存的手牌，却不能查看自己的普通手牌。你可以如实告诉别人牌值，也可以诈唬。其他人的点数声明不保证真实。

准备:
使用 100 张数字牌，0、1、2、3 各有 25 张。每位玩家获得一个公开角色，其中一人为庄家。标准角色池包含全部角色；入门角色池使用先知、赌徒、巨人、亦敌亦友和超级计算机。随机选取足够角色后，本局始终使用这些角色。
3 人游戏进行 6 轮，每人担任两次庄家；4 至 6 人游戏进行与人数相同的轮数，每人担任一次庄家。每轮结束后，所有角色向左传一位。

一轮的流程:
· 首次发牌前，狙击手秘密选择预测点数，亦敌亦友公开选择目标并秘密决定对方是朋友还是敌人。保密者从牌库顶抽取自己的额外牌，只有本人可以查看。
· 庄家从牌库抽取比仍在要牌的人数多 1 张的牌，查看后，自行选择给每位仍在要牌的玩家各发 1 张。庄家不给自己发手牌，未分配的余牌放回牌库底。
· 发完这一批牌后，玩家有 30 秒交流。你可以点击一名玩家的区域，对其手牌合计作出点数声明；同一批牌中再次声明会替换你对该玩家的旧声明。
· 仍在要牌的玩家秘密选择继续要牌或封存手牌。全员提交后同时公开选择；也可以等到倒计时结束，未提交者视为继续要牌。封存的手牌保持盖住，本轮不再收牌。
· 只要还有人在要牌，就继续抽牌、分配和交流。全员封存后才开始揭牌。若牌库不足以完成新一批发牌，则直接封存现有手牌并结算。

揭牌与得分:
· 一般角色的手牌合计为 3 至 5 点时安全，获得等于合计点数的分数。低于 3 点或高于 5 点都算爆掉，手牌不得分。巨人的安全范围为 3 至 7 点。
· 每有一名玩家爆掉，庄家从牌库顶抽取 2 张数字牌，将两张牌的点数加入自己的总分。庄家没有手牌安全范围的限制。
· 成功手牌和奖励牌离开牌库，爆掉的手牌以及毁灭者弃掉的牌放回牌库底。奖励只能抽取牌库中实际剩余的牌。
· 依次揭示每人的手牌并结算，再结算狙击手和亦敌亦友的额外奖励。所有人确认本轮结果后，传递角色并开始下一轮。

角色能力:
· 庄家：选择并分配数字牌，争取让其他人爆掉；每有一人爆掉，抽取 2 张牌计分。
· 狙击手：轮初秘密选择 3、4 或 5 作为预测点数。如果本轮安全手牌的点数正好等于预测值，再抽取 2 张数字牌，将其点数加入得分。
· 保密者：轮初抽取 1 张额外数字牌，只有自己可以查看。这张牌盖住摆放，计入本轮手牌合计；之后收到的普通牌仍不能自己查看。
· 超级计算机：庄家每次发给你一张牌时，必须如实说明该牌为奇数还是偶数。0 属于偶数。
· 先知：庄家先选定发给你的牌，你猜测这张牌的数值，随后获得真实的正确或错误提示。每次收到牌都可猜一次。
· 赌徒：揭牌后，若手牌安全，可以再抽取 1 张牌。如果抽到 0，本轮爆掉且手牌不得分；否则，将新牌点数加入原本的手牌得分，不再按 5 点上限判断。
· 亦敌亦友：轮初公开选择庄家和自己以外的一名玩家，秘密将其指定为朋友或敌人。朋友最终安全，或敌人最终爆掉时，抽取 1 张数字牌计分；即使自己爆掉也能获得这项奖励。
· 巨人：安全范围扩大为 3 至 7 点。
· 见证者：收到的第 2 张数字牌正面朝上，所有人包括自己都能看到。封存后仍需等到揭牌阶段才能查看整手牌。
· 毁灭者：全员封存后、揭牌前，宣布 0 至 3 中的一个数值，然后弃掉自己手牌中该数值的所有牌，再计算剩余手牌。

结束与平局:
规定轮数结束后，总分最高者获胜。若最高分并列，并列者秘密猜测下一张数字牌的数值，再翻开该牌。恰有一人猜中时，该玩家获胜；多人猜中时，由这些人继续猜牌；无人猜中时，原有并列者继续。牌库没有牌可供裁决时，并列者共同获胜。

en.name: The Dealer
en.desc: At a space casino, everyone can see your cards except you. Who do you trust, and when do you bank?
en.rules:
Objective:
Finish with the highest total score. You can see other players’ unbanked hands, but not your own ordinary cards. You may tell the truth or bluff. Point claims made by other players are not guaranteed to be true.

Setup:
The deck contains 100 number cards: 25 each of 0, 1, 2 and 3. Each player receives a public character, including one Dealer. The full pool includes all characters. The starter pool contains the Prophet, Gambler, Giant, Frenemy and Supercomputer. Randomly select enough characters and use that selection throughout the game.
With 3 players, play 6 rounds so everyone is the Dealer twice. With 4–6 players, play one round per player so everyone is the Dealer once. Pass all characters one seat to the left after each round.

Playing a round:
· Before the first deal, the Sniper secretly predicts a total and the Frenemy publicly chooses a target while secretly choosing Friend or Enemy. The Secret Keeper draws an extra card from the top of the deck that only they may see.
· The Dealer draws one more card than the number of players still asking for cards. After looking at these cards, the Dealer chooses one for each of those players. The Dealer does not receive a hand. Return the unused card to the bottom of the deck.
· After each batch, players have 30 seconds to talk. Select another player’s area to make a claim about their hand total. A new claim replaces your previous claim about that player in this batch.
· Players still in the round secretly choose to take another card or bank their hand. Reveal choices together when everyone has submitted. At the end of the timer, anyone who has not submitted continues taking cards. Banked hands stay face down and receive no further cards this round.
· Repeat dealing and discussion while anyone is still taking cards. Reveal hands only after everyone has banked. If the deck cannot supply a complete new batch, bank and score the existing hands.

Revealing and scoring:
· A normal hand totalling 3–5 is safe and scores its total. Below 3 or above 5 is a bust and scores nothing. The Giant’s safe range is 3–7.
· For every player who busts, the Dealer draws 2 number cards and adds their values to their score. The Dealer is not subject to a hand limit.
· Scoring hands and reward cards leave the deck. Return busted hands and cards discarded by the Destroyer to the bottom of the deck. Rewards draw only as many cards as remain available.
· Reveal and score each hand in turn, then resolve the Sniper and Frenemy rewards. After everyone confirms the round result, pass characters and begin the next round.

Character abilities:
· Dealer: Choose and distribute number cards to try to make other players bust. Draw 2 scoring cards for every player who busts.
· Sniper: Secretly predict 3, 4 or 5 at the start of the round. If your safe hand total matches, draw 2 number cards and add their values to your score.
· Secret Keeper: Draw 1 extra number card at the start of the round. Only you may look at it. Keep it face down, but include its value in your hand total. You still cannot see ordinary cards dealt to you.
· Supercomputer: The Dealer must truthfully tell you whether each card dealt to you is odd or even. Zero is even.
· Prophet: After the Dealer commits a card to you, guess its value and receive a truthful correct or incorrect answer. Guess once for each card dealt to you.
· Gambler: After revealing a safe hand, you may draw 1 more card. A zero makes you bust and lose your hand score. Otherwise, add the new card’s value to your hand score without checking the upper limit again.
· Frenemy: At the start, publicly choose another player other than the Dealer and secretly designate them Friend or Enemy. If your Friend ultimately succeeds or your Enemy ultimately busts, draw 1 scoring card. You earn this reward even if you bust yourself.
· Giant: Your safe range expands to 3–7.
· Witness: Your second number card is face up so everyone, including you, can see it. After banking, wait for the reveal before looking at the rest of your hand.
· Destroyer: After everyone banks but before hands are revealed, announce a value from 0–3. Discard all cards of that value from your hand, then score the remaining cards.

Ending and ties:
After the required rounds, the highest score wins. Tied leaders secretly guess the next number card, then reveal it. A sole correct guess wins. If several are correct, only those players continue; if nobody is correct, all remaining tied players continue. If no card is available for the tiebreak, they share the victory.

zh.name: 环中物语
zh.desc: 观察环中的线索，找出秘密规律，把手牌放进正确的位置。默认由系统担任知情者。
zh.rules:
目标：
推理每个环的秘密规则，将自己的5张事物牌全部正确放出。蓝环代表属性，黄环代表英文，红环代表情境；重叠区须同时满足相应环，环外不满足任何环。
准备：可选择1至3个环。默认系统知情者，所有玩家都是推理者；单人自动采用合作模式。真人模式由主机指定一名知情者，只有他能看秘密规则。
· 真人模式：2人游戏采用合作模式，3至4人可以选择合作模式，5至6人采用竞争模式。
· 自动合作模式：最多支持3名推理者。
流程：先根据模式设置初始线索。
· 竞争模式：知情者取5张牌，摆放3张作为初始线索，其余牌背面朝上弃置。
· 合作模式：知情者取10张牌，摆放数量为推理者人数加1的初始线索，其余牌保留为后续线索。
推理者轮流从手牌中选择1张，选择区域并确认。放置正确时，可以继续出牌；放置错误时，知情者纠正该牌在全部环中的归属，推理者抽取1张牌作为惩罚，并结束回合。桌面上的牌永久保留，点击区域可以逐张查看。
合作：所有推理者结束一轮后，知情者再摆1张线索；已经清空手牌的推理者跳过。所有推理者先清空手牌则全员胜利；需要补线索但知情者已无牌则失败。竞争模式首位正确出完最后一张牌的推理者获胜。抽牌堆耗尽且仍需罚抽时，本局结束且无人获胜。
自动知情者：采用整局固定的逐牌语义判断，不代表唯一的现实答案。真人模式可自由判断。物件按英文名的典型含义理解，Bat为棒球棒、Top为陀螺、Marble为弹珠、Bow为弓。神话物件按传说形象理解，画中的拟人表情不改变物种。
场景：自动模式的“这栋建筑”统一指配备常见家具用品的城市住宅，“一小时范围”指都市地区，包括公共设施和商店。价值按美元计；登机按一般随身行李理解。需要更贴合现场时可选择真人知情者。
英文规则：始终依据牌上英文名，中文仅作释义。忽略标点并将重音字母归一；通常元音计AEIOUY，明确不含Y的规则仅计AEIOU。音节及复合词采用固定的常见英文读音判定。“前两个字母按字母表排列”要求严格递增。
内容：基础240张事物牌，宣传包另加30张，三类规则各24张。规则选择中的难度为数字版编辑分组，非已核实的原版逐牌星级；“混合”包含全部72条规则。终局公开本局规则，可回看盘面。

en.name: Things in Rings
en.desc: Read the clues, discover the secret rules, and play your Things in the right regions. The system is the Knower by default.
en.rules:
Goal: Correctly play all 5 Things from your hand. Blue is Attribute, yellow is Word, red is Context. An intersection meets every included ring; outside meets none.
Setup: Choose 1–3 rings. The system is the Knower by default, so all players are Finders; one player automatically plays cooperatively. In human mode the host chooses a Knower, the only player who can see the rules. Two humans cooperate; 3–4 can cooperate; 5–6 compete. Automatic co-op supports up to 3 Finders.
Play: A competitive Knower takes 5 cards, places 3 starting clues, and discards the rest face down. A cooperative Knower takes 10 and places one starting clue per Finder plus one; the remaining cards supply later clues. On your turn choose a Thing, choose its region, then confirm. A correct play lets you continue. A mistake is moved to its correct region, you draw 1 card, and your turn ends. All played cards remain on the table and can be inspected by region.
Co-op: After every Finder finishes their turn, the Knower adds 1 clue. Empty-handed Finders are skipped. Clear every Finder’s hand before another clue is needed from an empty Knower hand to win together. In competitive play the first Finder to correctly play their final card wins. If a penalty draw is required from an empty deck, the game ends without a winner.
Automatic Knower: Semantic judgments are fixed for the whole game, rather than being the only valid real-world interpretation. Human Knowers may judge freely. Interpret each Thing as the typical object named in English: Bat is a baseball bat, Top a spinning top, Marble a glass marble, Bow an archery bow. Mythical objects follow their legends; a drawn face does not make an object alive.
Context: In automatic mode “this building” is a normally furnished urban home; “within an hour” is an urban area including public facilities and shops. Prices are in US dollars; air travel refers to ordinary carry-on luggage. Choose a human Knower for judgments about your actual surroundings.
Words: Use the printed English name, even with a Chinese interface. Ignore punctuation and normalize accents. Vowels generally include AEIOUY; rules explicitly excluding Y use AEIOU. Syllables and compounds follow fixed common English readings. Alphabetical order of the first two letters means strictly increasing order.
Contents: 240 base Things, an optional 30-card official Pop Culture Promo Pack, and 24 rules of each type. Difficulty uses digital editorial groups, not verified original per-card star ratings; Mixed includes all 72 rules. The rules are revealed at the end, when you can review the table.

zh.name: 农场三姐妹
zh.desc: 骰写种田:轮盘选骰务花园,堆肥调点抢收获
zh.rules:
目标：在8轮游戏中发展自己的计分纸，分别从花园、多年生植物、蜂箱、水果和工具棚获得分数，总分最高的玩家获胜。
流程(每轮三阶段):
· 规划:起始玩家掷出比人数多 2 颗的骰子,按点数分组。
· 各组按点数升序、从 Edith 棋子格起顺时针放上轮盘,棋子移到最高组之后。
· 园艺:从起始玩家开始，按顺序轮流选择,每人选 1 颗骰:先执行花园行动(在骰子点数对应的区域种植至多 2 株,或给该区浇水),再执行所在格的轮盘行动。
· 所有玩家选完骰子后，共同使用剩余骰子中点数最小的一颗；每人都执行该骰子对应的花园行动和轮盘行动。
· 事件：结算本轮指定的事件。工具棚事件执行工具棚效果；下雨事件使每个区域浇水一次；农贸市场事件按当前货物数量查阅奖励档位并领取奖励。
调整：每消耗1份堆肥，可以将骰子点数增加或减少1点，点数可以在1与6之间循环。鸢尾花可以提供免费的点数调整。同一颗骰子对应的两项行动，必须使用同一个调整后的点数。
轮盘行动:再种植或浇水一次、填工具棚、获得 1 份堆肥与 4 份货物、蜂箱或水果、农贸市场。
要点：作物的圆圈（○）全部填满后，收获该作物。同时收获两个相邻南瓜时，触发两者之间的花朵。水果、蜂箱和工具棚分别提供相应的联动奖励。
结束:8 轮后结算,平分则先比较花园分。
单人：Farmer Edith与你交替选择骰子，双方各选择2颗。她会在你的计分纸上划掉格子，造成破坏。先行动的一方在第二次选择骰子时，必须选择剩余骰子中点数最小的一颗。
天气(可选扩展):轮末按剩余最高骰移动天气。
· 闪电：不能浇水。
· 严寒：不能执行蜂箱行动。
· 多云：获得多年生植物。
· 炎热：收获水果时，可以额外获得 1 份货物。
· 大风：种植时必须跨越到相邻区域。

en.name: Three Sisters
en.desc: A roll-and-write farm: draft dice off the rondel, nudge values with compost
en.rules:
Goal: over 8 rounds, score your sheet across garden, perennials, apiary, fruit and toolshed — highest total wins.
Each round has three phases:
· Planning: the start player rolls 2 more dice than the player count and groups them by value.
· Groups go on the rondel clockwise in ascending order from the Edith pawn; the pawn then moves past the highest group.
· Gardening: in turn order, each player drafts 1 die: first take its garden action (plant up to 2 crops in the matching zone, or water that zone), then the rondel action of its space.
· After all picks, everyone uses the lowest remaining die (both actions).
· Event: Resolve the event for the current round. A Toolshed event activates its toolshed effect; Rain waters every zone once; a Farmer’s Market event grants the reward corresponding to your current goods total.
Adjustments: each compost spent shifts a die up or down by 1 (wraps around); iris grants free shifts; both actions of one die share a single adjustment.
Rondel actions provide one of the following effects:
· Plant or water once more.
· Fill a toolshed item.
· Gain 1 compost and 4 goods.
· Perform an apiary or fruit action.
· Visit the Farmer’s Market.
Key points: a crop is harvested when its ○ is filled; harvesting two adjacent pumpkins triggers the flower between them; fruit, apiary and toolshed each chain further bonuses.
End: after round 8, total the sheet; ties are broken on garden points first.
Solo: Farmer Edith drafts dice alternately with you (2 each) and crosses things off your sheet; the first player's second pick must be the lowest remaining die.
Weather (optional expansion): at round end the weather follows the highest remaining die.
· Lightning prevents watering.
· Cold prevents apiary actions.
· Cloudy weather grants a free perennial.
· Heat grants 1 extra good per fruit harvest.
· Wind requires planting in a neighboring zone.

zh.name: 历史巨轮：人类文明新篇章
zh.desc: 发展文明，谱写历史；包含《新领袖与奇迹》扩展。
zh.rules:
目标：
2—4个文明从时代A发展至时代IV。文化点数最多的文明获胜，平手共享胜利。

准备：
· 选择领袖与奇迹组合、平衡调整和新军事牌；可分别启用。
· 使用秘密混编或公开混编时，每个时代随机选择领袖与奇迹：2人游戏选择6位领袖和4座奇迹；3人或4人游戏选择7位领袖和5座奇迹。
· 公开混编可查看入选名单；军事手牌和未揭示事件始终保密。

回合流程：
· 首轮依座次仅有1—4次内政行动，只能从牌列拿牌，随后进行生产。
· 此后回合先补充牌列并结算自己发动的战争，再执行政治行动和行动阶段。
· 政治行动可准备事件、发动侵略、宣战、提出或取消条约，或使用领袖能力。
· 准备事件获得其等级的文化，并揭示当前事件；领土通过公开竞价分配。
· 竞价赢家须牺牲实际军事单位，支付承诺的军事牌和资源。
· 侵略须有更高军力；防守可弃军事牌，张数不超过军事行动总数。
· 战争在发动者下回合开始结算，不使用军事奖励牌；最后一轮不能宣战。

行动阶段：
· 内政行动用于拿牌、增加人口、研发科技、任命领袖、建造和升级。
· 军事行动用于建造、升级和拆除军事单位，以及打出或复制战术。
· 牌列前5／中4／末4个位置拿牌分别需要1／2／3次内政行动。
· 拿取奇迹牌时，每有1座已完成的奇迹，就须额外支付1次内政行动。同时只能建造1座奇迹。每个时代只能拿取1位领袖。
· 手牌上限等于相应行动总数；行动阶段刚拿的行动牌不能立即使用。
· 增加人口须付食物，工人先进入待业区；建造将待业工人放上科技。
· 升级费用是两项科技分别折扣后的建造费用之差；城市建筑受政府上限限制。
· 蓝色标记按科技面值存放食物和资源；临时专用资源自动优先花费。
· 人口库越空，人口费用、消耗和幸福需求越高；蓝色库越空，腐败越高。
· 战术按最大军力编组；有单位落后战术至少两个时代时，该军队过时。
· 每架空军可令1支军队的战术军力翻倍。

回合结束：
· 首先弃置超过手牌上限的军事牌。不满工人的数量多于待业工人时，发生暴动，跳过本回合的生产。
· 正常生产：获得科技与文化、支付腐败、生产食物、支付消耗、生产资源。
· 支付消耗时，每缺少1单位食物，就损失4点文化。蓝色标记不足时，优先在面值较高的科技牌上生产食物或资源。
· 按剩余军事行动抽至多3张军事牌，然后恢复行动。时代IV不再抽军事牌。

时代与终局：
· 时代I—III结束时，各文明从人口库移除2个黄色标记。
· 比刚结束时代更早的手牌、领袖、未完成奇迹和条约过时。
· 时代III牌库耗尽后完成最后一轮，保证各文明回合数相等。
· 结算当前与未来事件中的全部时代III事件及领袖奖励，再比较文化。
· 卡牌详情列出所选版本的效果与数值，具体效果优先于一般规则。

en.name: Through the Ages: A New Story of Civilization
en.desc: Build a civilization through history, including New Leaders and Wonders.
en.rules:
Goal:
Develop 2–4 civilizations from Age A to Age IV. Most culture wins; ties share victory.

Setup:
· Choose leaders and wonders, rebalanced cards, and new military cards independently.
· Mixed sets select 6 leaders and 4 wonders per age for two players; 7 and 5 for three or four.
· Public mixes reveal the selected lists. Military hands and unrevealed events remain secret.

Turn sequence:
· Round one gives 1–4 civil actions by seating order, used only to take cards, then production.
· Later turns replenish the row, resolve wars you declared, then have politics and actions.
· Politics: prepare an event, attack, declare war, offer or cancel a pact, or use a leader.
· Preparing an event scores its level in culture and reveals a current event.
· Territories are auctioned. The winner sacrifices real units and pays committed cards and resources.
· Aggressions need greater strength. Defense may discard cards up to your military action total.
· Wars resolve next turn without bonus cards. No wars may be declared in the final round.

Action Phase:
· Civil actions take cards, increase population, develop technologies, appoint leaders, and build or upgrade.
· Military actions manage units and play or copy tactics.
· Taking cards from the first 5, next 4, or last 4 row spaces costs 1, 2, or 3 civil actions.
· Wonders also cost an action per completed wonder. Build only one at a time and take one leader per age.
· Hand limits equal action totals. Action cards taken during your Action Phase cannot be played immediately.
· Pay food to move population to your worker pool. Building places a worker on a technology.
· Upgrading pays the difference between separately discounted costs. Urban limits apply per type.
· Blue tokens store food and resources at technology values. Spend applicable temporary resources first.
· Emptying yellow banks increases population costs, consumption, and happiness needs; emptying blue banks increases corruption.
· Tactics maximize strength. A unit two ages older than its tactic makes its army antiquated.
· Each air force doubles one army’s tactical strength.

End of turn:
· Discard excess military cards. More discontent than unused workers causes an uprising, skipping production.
· Otherwise score science and culture, pay corruption, produce food, consume, then produce resources.
· Each missing food loses 4 culture. With too few blue tokens, produce on higher-value technologies first.
· Draw up to 3 military cards for unspent military actions, then recover actions. Age IV stops military draws.

Ages and ending:
· At the end of Ages I–III, remove 2 yellow bank tokens per civilization.
· Hands, leaders, unfinished wonders, and pacts older than the age that just ended become obsolete.
· Exhausting Age III starts the final round. All civilizations receive equal turns.
· Evaluate all Age III current and future events and final leader bonuses, then compare culture.
· Card details show the selected version’s effects and override general rules.

zh.name: 永恒旅途：意大利大游学
zh.desc: 串联行动牌，游历意大利，与名人相逢，将见闻写入旅行日志。
zh.rules:
目标：
· 五轮后总分最高者获胜。
· 同分时，地图位置更靠南者优先。
准备：
· 每人从都灵出发，拥有 5 分和两本旅行日志。
· 每人获得 7 张基础牌，可在选项中移除重复移动牌。
· 前两位玩家获得 1 枚钱币，其余获得 2 枚。
· 两人游戏中，第二位玩家获得 2 枚钱币。
行动阶段：
· 从首位玩家开始，顺时针轮流打出一张手牌。
· 每人每轮打出 5 张牌。
· 正面出牌后，可激活本轮所有同类别的正面牌。
· 自选牌的激活顺序，完成一张后才能激活下一张。
· 同一张牌的独立效果可自选执行顺序。
· 每项效果和每张牌均可放弃，斜线效果选择一项。
· 背面出牌可获得 2 枚钱币、移动一次或购买一张牌。
· 背面牌不触发连锁，市场阶段额外算一种类别。
游历与记录：
· 每次移动到相邻地点，支付道路上标明的钱币。
· 探索时，秘密查看当地板块并选取一块。
· 每人在每座城市最多收集一块，也可改取城市奖励。
· 自己回合随时可使用探索板块一次。
· 交谈可选择当地人，或与当地著名旅行者互动。
· 与当地人交谈，先获得好感奖励，再选择通信或朋友。
· 每人最多有 3 处通信，每城只能有自己的一个信件标记。
· 寄信须寄给自己建立通信且不在当前位置城市的当地人。
· 写日志时，将一个思想、对应城市板块或朋友填入空槽。
· 探索板块使用前后均可写入日志。
· 在本人或信件标记所在城市，可支付思想参与咖啡讨论。
· 每场讨论有两个名额，先到者获得较高分数。
· 与旅行者互动时，放置一个体验标记并获得所在格奖励。
· 决斗令格子奖励执行两次，同列不能再有自己的其他体验。
· 铭记之夜在多数比较中算两个标记。
· 心驰神往每轮末可支付 1 分，再次获得原格奖励。
· 两个志趣相投标记各获得 2 分，同列合计获得 6 分。
轮末：
· 依次结算旅行者能力与心驰神往奖励。
· 从首位玩家右侧开始，逆时针各可免费领取一张牌。
· 本轮 2、3、4 类牌分别允许领取 I、II、III 级牌。
· 购买费用为 I 级 0 枚、II 级 2 枚、III 级 5 枚钱币。
· 展示区领取后不补充，牌堆顶牌始终公开且可领取。
· 收回本轮出牌，将手牌永久弃至最多 8 张。
· 最后一轮同样先收回手牌并检查上限，再进行计分。
· 其余轮次更新市场、移动旅行者，并传递首位玩家。
终局计分：
· 加上探索城市数、两本日志、手牌进阶牌和绘画的分数。
· 每列体验多数前三名获得 5、3、1 分。
· 两人游戏中只奖励第一名 5 分。
· 多数相同时，标记在该列更高者优先。
· 歌德、济慈的轮末奖励适用于所有玩家。
· 官方单人模式 The Automatons 不包含在本版本中。

en.name: Timeless Journeys: The Italian Grand Tour
en.desc: Chain action cards, travel across Italy, meet famous travelers, and fill your journals.
en.rules:
Objective:
· The highest score after five rounds wins.
· Ties favor the southernmost map position.
Setup:
· Start in Torino with 5 VP and two journals.
· Take 7 basic cards. The option to remove the duplicate Movement card may be enabled during setup.
· The first two players each receive 1 coin. Each later player receives 2 coins.
· In a two-player game, the second player receives 2 coins.
Action phase:
· Take clockwise turns playing one hand card.
· Each player plays 5 cards per round.
· After playing a card face up, you may activate every face-up card of that category that you have played this round.
· Choose the order in which to activate your cards. Fully resolve one card before activating the next.
· Choose the order of independent effects on a card.
· You may skip any effect or card. When a slash separates effects, choose one of them.
· Playing a card face down lets you gain 2 coins, move once, or buy a card.
· A card played face down does not activate a chain, but counts as an additional category during the market phase.
Travel and records:
· Move to an adjacent location and pay its toll.
· When exploring, secretly inspect the tiles at your location and choose one.
· You may collect at most one tile from each city, or take its city bonus instead.
· You may use an exploration tile once, at any time during your turn.
· Converse with a local or famous traveler.
· When conversing with a local, first gain their favor reward, then choose to establish correspondence or gain a Friend.
· You may maintain correspondence with up to 3 locals, with at most one of your Letter markers in each city.
· Send Letters only to locals with whom you have established correspondence, in cities other than your current location.
· When writing in a journal, fill an empty slot with an Idea, a matching city tile, or a Friend.
· You may place an exploration tile in a journal either before or after using it.
· Pay Ideas to join a discussion in a city containing your pawn or one of your Letter markers.
· Each discussion has two spaces. The first player to join scores more points.
· When interacting with a traveler, place an Experience token and gain the reward shown on that space.
· A Duel resolves the space’s reward twice. You cannot have another of your Experience tokens in the same column.
· A Night to Remember counts as two tokens when comparing majorities in its column.
· At the end of each round, Admiration lets you pay 1 VP to gain its space’s reward again.
· Each of your two Affinity tokens scores 2 VP. If both are in the same column, they score 6 VP in total.
Round end:
· Resolve traveler abilities, then Admiration.
· Beginning with the player to the first player’s right and proceeding counterclockwise, each player may take one card for free.
· Having played 2, 3 or 4 card categories this round allows you to take a level I, II or III card respectively.
· Level I, II and III cards cost 0, 2 and 5 coins respectively.
· Do not refill display spaces when cards are taken. The top card of each deck remains face up and available to take.
· Return the cards you played this round to your hand, then permanently discard cards until you have at most 8.
· In the final round, also recover your cards and check your hand limit before scoring.
· In other rounds, refresh the market, move the travelers, and pass the first-player marker.
Final scoring:
· Add the points for the cities you explored, your two journals, advanced cards in your hand, and paintings.
· The players with the most, second-most and third-most Experience tokens in each column score 5, 3 and 1 VP respectively.
· With two players only first place scores 5 VP.
· When players tie for a majority, the player whose token is higher in that column wins the tie.
· Goethe and Keats grant their end-of-round rewards to all players.
· The Automatons solo rules are not included.

zh.name: 小小城鎮
zh.desc: 在四行四列城镇中巧用五种资源，拼出建筑配方，建设繁荣小镇。
zh.rules:
建设自己的小小城镇：
每人拥有一块四行四列城镇。将木材、麦子、砖块、玻璃和石料摆成建筑牌上的配方，移除对应资源，建造建筑并争取得分。每局使用住宅，以及其他六类各一张建筑牌；随机组合会改变可用建筑。若启用纪念碑，每人从私有的两张牌中选择一张，只能建造一次，建成时才向所有人公开。

每轮流程：
建筑师指定一种资源，所有尚未完成城镇的玩家先将该资源放入一个空格，再自由决定是否建造建筑。所有玩家完成本轮后，建筑师顺时针传给下一位玩家。已完成城镇的玩家退出后续资源选择。只剩一位玩家时，该玩家可以继续自行指定资源，直到城镇完成。

建造与建筑效果：
配方可旋转和镜像，资源的相对位置及种类必须完全相符。每次移除完整配方的资源，再将建筑放在本次移除资源的一个格子上。资源不能自由移动，建筑不能任意移走或搬动；同轮可以依次建造多座建筑，也可以保留配方等待以后建造。棚屋、交易站、仓库、工厂及纪念碑的例外以对应卡牌详情为准。普通建筑和资源没有数量上限。“相邻”仅指上下左右，不含斜角；粮仓明确包含周围8格。

住宅可先于供食建筑建造。最终计分时，各建筑的供食范围如下：
· 农场：为任意位置的4座住宅供食。
· 粮仓：为周围8格内的住宅供食。
· 果园：为所在行和列的住宅供食。
· 温室：为一组相连的住宅供食。
每座住宅只需供食一次。可在城镇中调整供食分配；自动分配会选择得分最高的合法方案。未供食住宅不移除，但通常不获得住宅分。巴雷特城堡对于建筑计分视为2座住宅，供食时也占用两座住宅的容量。各建筑的完整计分与能力见卡牌详情。

城镇完成与胜负：
城镇已满时，可以继续使用完整配方建造，或选择完成城镇。本项目对银行作以下边界裁定：五座银行封禁全部资源后，轮到自己指定资源或市政厅自由选择轮时，可以完成城镇；其他玩家指定和资源牌抽取轮仍照常放置资源。所有城镇完成后，移除城镇格内的剩余资源；仓库中的资源保留并按牌面扣分。每个没有建筑的格子扣1分，已供食住宅每座3分，其他建筑与纪念碑分别计分，总分最高者获胜。平分依次比较担任建筑师次数较少、空格较少、住宅较多；仍相同则共同获胜。观星台按同轮完成共享名次计分。

可选模式：
洞穴规则：整局最多两次，可以不放置其他玩家指定的资源，将其放入洞穴；洞穴资源不计分也不扣分，自己指定的资源不能使用此能力。市政厅模式中可用于抽牌轮，不能用于每第三轮的自由选择；单人模式不使用洞穴。

市政厅：将15张资源牌洗匀，背面弃掉5张。每个三轮循环，前两轮按翻出的牌放置资源，第三轮每人自行选择资源。牌堆耗尽时重新洗匀全部15张并再次弃5张。工厂、仓库和联结者雕像可用于抽牌轮；银行限制自由选择轮。铁草堡持有者跳过自由选择轮，独自留场时除外。

单人：不使用旅店、银行、铁草堡及欧泊瞭望塔。15张资源牌洗匀后翻开3张，每轮从中选1张并放置对应资源。完成本轮后，将选中的牌放到牌堆底，补1张。工厂、仓库及联结者雕像可以作用于所选资源。最终38分以上为建筑大师，32–37为城镇规划师，25–31为工程师，18–24为木匠，10–17为建筑学徒，9分以下为见习建筑师。

en.name: Tiny Towns
en.desc: Arrange five resources into building patterns on a 4×4 grid and create a thriving little town.
en.rules:
Build your Tiny Town:
Each player has a 4×4 town. Arrange wood, wheat, brick, glass, and stone into the patterns on building cards, then replace the resources with buildings. Use Cottage and one card from each of six other building types. Random selection changes the available buildings. With monuments enabled, privately choose one of two cards; only its owner may build it, once, and reveal it when constructed.

Each round:
The Master Builder names one resource. Every active player must first place it in an empty square, then may construct buildings. After all players finish, pass the hammer clockwise. Completed players leave future resource rounds. The final active player continues naming resources until their town is complete.

Construction and abilities:
Patterns may be rotated and mirrored. Resource types and relative positions must match exactly. Remove the full pattern, then place the building on one of the cleared squares. Resources cannot move freely, and buildings cannot be moved or removed without an ability. You may construct several buildings sequentially or save patterns for later. Shed, Trading Post, Warehouse, Factory, and monuments have the exceptions detailed on their cards. Resources and regular buildings are unlimited. Adjacent means orthogonal, except Granary explicitly covers all 8 surrounding squares.

Cottages may be built before food buildings. At scoring, food buildings feed cottages as follows:
· Farm: Feed 4 cottages anywhere.
· Granary: Feed cottages in the surrounding squares.
· Orchard: Feed cottages in its row and column.
· Greenhouse: Feed one connected cottage group.
A cottage only needs feeding once. Food allocation can be changed in the town; automatic allocation chooses a highest-scoring legal allocation. Unfed cottages stay on the board but normally score no cottage points. Barrett Castle counts as 2 cottages for building scoring and uses two cottage units of food capacity. See each card for complete abilities and scoring.

Completing towns and winning:
When full, construct available patterns or complete your town. This implementation uses the following Bank edge-case ruling: if five Banks prohibit all resources, you may complete your town when naming a resource yourself or in a Town Hall choice round. Resources named by others or drawn from cards can still be placed normally. Once all towns are complete, remove remaining resources from town squares; keep stored Warehouse resources and score their penalties. Each square without a building scores −1. Fed cottages score 3 each, and other buildings and monuments score by their cards. Highest total wins. Break ties by fewer Master Builder turns, then fewer empty squares, then more cottages; otherwise share victory. The Starloom gives players completing in the same round the same finishing place.

Optional modes:
Cavern: twice per game, discard a resource named by another player instead of placing it. These resources score neither points nor penalties. You cannot discard your own named resource. In Town Hall this applies to drawn-resource rounds, not free-choice rounds. Do not use Cavern in solo play.

Town Hall: shuffle the 15 resource cards and discard 5 unseen. In each three-round cycle, draw a resource in the first two rounds; in the third, everyone chooses individually. When the deck runs out, reshuffle all 15 and discard 5 again. Factory, Warehouse, and Statue of the Bondmaker apply to drawn rounds. Banks restrict choice rounds. Fort Ironweed skips choice rounds unless its owner is the final active player.

Solo: exclude Inn, Bank, Fort Ironweed, and Opaleye’s Watch. Shuffle 15 resource cards and reveal 3. Each round choose one to place. After finishing the round, put the selected card on the bottom of the deck and replace it with the top card. Factory, Warehouse, and Statue of the Bondmaker apply to the selected resource. Score 38+ for Master Architect, 32–37 Town Planner, 25–31 Engineer, 18–24 Carpenter, 10–17 Builder’s Apprentice, and 9 or less Aspiring Architect.
