zh.name: UNO
zh.desc: 匹配颜色或数字出牌，巧用功能牌，率先清空手牌
zh.rules:
目标：
· 单局模式率先清空手牌获胜；积分赛率先达到 500 分获胜。
准备：
· 使用经典 108 张牌，2–10 人，每人起手 7 张。
· 数字牌 76 张，跳过、反转、加二各 8 张，两种万能牌各 4 张。
· 庄家随机确定，从庄家左侧开始，后续每局轮换庄家。
出牌：
· 每回合出 1 张与顶牌颜色、数字或功能相同的牌，或出万能牌。
· 万能牌指定后续颜色；加四还使下家抽 4 张并跳过回合。
· 跳过使下家跳过回合；反转改变行进方向。
· 两人局反转等同跳过，出牌者继续行动。
· 加二使下家抽 2 张并跳过回合。
· 可以主动抽牌；普通抽牌默认只抽 1 张，不能连续抽牌。
· 抽牌后，只能打出刚抽到的那张牌；也可以保留该牌，并结束回合。
· 抽到无法出牌的牌后自动结束回合。
· 剩余 1 张手牌时自动宣告 UNO，没有漏喊罚牌。
· 牌库耗尽后保留弃牌顶牌，重洗其余弃牌；无牌可抽时结束回合。
首牌：
· 首牌为加二或跳过时，对庄家左侧玩家生效。
· 首牌为反转时庄家先行动，方向反转。
· 首牌为普通万能牌时，由庄家左侧玩家选择颜色并开始行动。首牌为加四牌时，将其洗回牌堆，再重新翻开一张首牌。
加四质疑：
· 官方模式下，手中有当前颜色的牌时使用加四属于违规。
· 允许冒险出牌；受罚者可选择接受罚牌或质疑。
· 质疑时仅质疑者查看出牌者当时剩余的手牌。
· 质疑成功，出牌者抽 4 张，质疑者正常行动。
· 质疑失败，质疑者抽 6 张并跳过回合。
可选规则：
· 仅加二叠加：加二可接加二；加四不能参与叠加。
· 同类叠加：加二接加二，加四接加四，颜色不限。
· 混合叠加：加二与加四可互接，颜色不限，罚牌数量累计。
· 受罚者可继续叠加，或抽取全部累计罚牌并跳过回合。
· 罚牌期间不能用跳过、反转或普通万能牌抵消。
· 同类或混合叠加时，加四自由使用且不质疑。
· 连续抽牌：普通抽牌持续到抽到可出的牌，再选择出牌或保留。
· 7–0：出 7 后选择一名对手交换手牌，出 0 按当前方向轮转手牌。
· 先完成手牌交换，再检查是否有玩家的手牌为空。接收到空手牌的玩家获胜。
结算：
· 有人清空手牌后不再叠加，先处理末张罚牌与加四质疑。
· 数字牌按面值，跳过、反转、加二各 20 分，两种万能牌各 50 分。
· 单局赢家排名第一，其余玩家按剩余牌分从低到高排列。
· 积分赛赢家获得其余玩家剩余牌分总和，累计至 500 分获胜。

en.name: UNO
en.desc: Match colors or numbers, use action cards, and empty your hand first
en.rules:
Goal:
· Empty your hand first in a single round, or reach 500 points in a match.
Setup:
· Use the classic 108-card deck for 2–10 players; deal 7 cards each.
· There are 76 number cards, 8 each of Skip, Reverse and Draw Two, and 4 of each Wild.
· Choose a random dealer; start on their left. The dealer changes each round.
Play:
· Play one card matching the top card’s color, number or action, or play a Wild.
· A Wild sets the next color; Wild Draw Four also makes the next player draw 4 and miss a turn.
· Skip makes the next player miss a turn; Reverse changes direction.
· In a two-player game, Reverse acts as Skip: the same player goes again.
· Draw Two makes the next player draw 2 and miss a turn.
· You may draw voluntarily. By default, draw only one card.
· After drawing, play only the card just drawn, or keep it and end your turn.
· Drawing an unplayable card ends your turn automatically.
· UNO is called automatically at one card; there is no missed-call penalty.
· Keep the top discard and reshuffle the rest when the deck runs out; end the turn if none remain.
First card:
· An initial Draw Two or Skip affects the player to the dealer’s left.
· An initial Reverse makes the dealer start and reverses direction.
· For an initial Wild, the first player chooses a color and plays; reshuffle an initial Wild Draw Four.
Draw Four challenges:
· Under official restrictions, playing Draw Four with a card of the current color is illegal.
· Bluffing is allowed; the affected player may accept the penalty or challenge.
· Only the challenger sees the offender’s remaining hand at the time of play.
· A successful challenge makes the offender draw 4; the challenger takes a normal turn.
· A failed challenge makes the challenger draw 6 and miss their turn.
Optional rules:
· Draw Two only: stack Draw Two on Draw Two; Draw Four cannot join a stack.
· Same type: stack Draw Two on Draw Two or Draw Four on Draw Four, regardless of color.
· Mixed: stack Draw Two and Draw Four on either type, regardless of color; add their penalties.
· Stack another penalty card, or draw the full accumulated penalty and miss your turn.
· Skip, Reverse and regular Wild cards cannot cancel a pending penalty.
· Same-type and mixed stacking use unrestricted Draw Four without challenges.
· Draw until playable: keep drawing until a playable card, then play it or keep it.
· 7–0: a 7 swaps hands with a chosen opponent; a 0 passes every hand in the current direction.
· Complete the hand exchange before checking for an empty hand; its recipient wins.
Scoring:
· Once a hand is empty, stop stacking and resolve the final penalty and any Draw Four challenge.
· Number cards score face value; Skip, Reverse and Draw Two score 20; either Wild scores 50.
· In a single round, the winner ranks first; others rank by remaining points, lowest first.
· The round winner earns everyone else’s remaining card points; first to 500 wins the match.

zh.name: 孤勇英豪
zh.desc: 构筑双面复合牌，联手击败首领
zh.rules:
目标：击败首领。单人操控一名角色；双人合作，各操控一名角色。
· 任意角色生命降至零，或危险标记到达终点，立即失败。
准备：每人选择角色，获得 10点生命值、3点信用，抽三张起始手牌。
· 起始牌库有六张劈砍、一张备用资金和三张角色牌。
· 核心面与威胁面属于同一张牌；上下升级同时改变这两面。
· 只有在场和牌库顶的威胁面可以查看。
每回合五阶段：
维持阶段：
获得 3点行动力，重置盟友；生命与护甲上限 10，行动上限 6。
选牌阶段：
从训练标记所在等级或更低的核心牌堆选牌。
· 单人翻三张，保留一张；双人各翻两张，每组各取一张，可以互选。
· 不查看威胁面，将每张保留的核心牌与普通威胁牌堆顶部的一张牌配对，再加入手牌。其余核心牌按自己选择的顺序，放回核心牌堆底部。
· 选牌结束后，将训练标记移回等级标记处。
主阶段：
任意顺序打出手牌、耗用盟友、购买升级。
· 每个行动须完整结算，之后任一玩家才可开始下一个行动。
· 打出卡牌须支付行动费用；盟友每次耗用只能选择一个耗用分支。
· 只能升级手牌与在场卡牌；每张牌最多安装一个上部和一个下部升级。
· 卡牌的派系与升级所示派系匹配时，升级费用减少2点信用。安装升级不会使卡牌获得该派系。
威胁阶段：
在场威胁逐个造成等同攻击值的伤害，先扣护甲再扣生命。
· 牌库顶威胁不攻击；威胁受伤不会降低攻击值。
清理阶段：
弃置战术，清空行动与护甲，补场后推进危险。
· 补场至三个非迅速威胁在场，且牌库顶不是迅速威胁。
· 推进危险标记时，只跳过当前难度对应颜色的格子：普通难度跳过绿色格，困难难度跳过黄色格，专家难度跳过红色格。
战斗与升级：
· 威胁生命等于攻击加防御，伤害跨回合保留；可以攻击任一玩家的威胁。
· 击败后先将整张牌交给其战场所属者，再由完成击杀者获得奖励。
· 消灭威胁会移除整张牌，不获得卡牌或击败奖励。
· 主阶段牌库空且没有在场威胁，或清理补场时牌库空，立即升级。
· 等级与训练标记各前进一格；弃置所有在场卡牌，并弃至三张手牌。
· 可移除手牌或弃牌中的一张牌；处理首领效果，然后洗弃牌成为新牌库。
· 升级等事件立即中断；处理完后继续原效果，即使来源已离场。
· 可以自行安排效果的结算顺序，也可以放弃效果。同一张牌的同一效果在本回合第四次结算后，移除该牌。
关键词：
· 密谋要求另一张同派系牌；专注计算手牌与在场同派系牌数。
· 联合计算手牌与在场的不同派系数；折价按同派系牌数减费，最低为零。
· 已升级要求此牌至少安装一个升级。
· 迅速不占准备和清理补场时的三个威胁名额。
· 同一战场有嘲讽时，伤害必须先以嘲讽威胁为目标。
· 威胁阶段每个狂怒迫使玩家弃置一名盟友。
· 每次以恐怖威胁为伤害目标，失去 1点行动力；零行动时仍可攻击。
· 癫狂 5 揭示时，若所属玩家生命不高于 5，该威胁对自己造成 2 点伤害。
· 癫狂、狂怒、恐怖可以叠加；迅速和嘲讽不叠加。
首领：
· 毁灭预兆与三巨头的专属牌进入手牌时，造成首领伤害并弃置。
· 三巨头的地点可受到普通伤害；至少两个地点尚存时，首领伤害只能打地点。
· 杜莫需要完成剧情分支并触发结局；双人可以分摊剧情的信用与行动费用。
计分：胜利后可以继续当前回合，结束后按每名玩家分别计分。
· 获胜后的基础得分按难度确定：普通难度为 100 分，困难难度为 200 分，专家难度为 300 分。每个剩余回合额外获得 10 分，再加上剩余生命值。
· 每次因第四次效果移除卡牌，获得 10 分。
· 持有至少 15点信用、全部非起始非首领牌均有升级，分别获得 10 分。
· 四个派系各至少两张牌，获得 10 分。
· 胜利后在本回合再升两级，获得 50 分；不再开始新回合。

en.name: Unstoppable
en.desc: Build double-sided cards and defeat a formidable boss
en.rules:
Goal: defeat the boss, solo or cooperatively with one character per player.
· Lose immediately if any character reaches zero health or danger reaches the end.
Setup: choose a character; start with 10 health, 3 credits, and three cards.
· Each starting deck has six Strikes, one Spare Credits, and three character cards.
· A sleeve holds a core, a threat, and up to two upgrades affecting both sides.
· You may only view a threat side while it is active or on deck.
Five phases each turn:
Upkeep phase:
Gain 3 actions and refresh allies. Health and armor cap at 10, actions at 6.
Draft phase:
Choose a core deck at or below your training marker.
· Solo reveals three and keeps one. Two players reveal two each and keep one from each set.
· Without looking at its threat side, pair each kept core with the top card of the regular threat deck and add it to your hand. Return the remaining cores to their deck bottom in any order you choose.
· After drafting, reset training to your level marker.
Main phase:
Play cards, exhaust allies, and buy upgrades in any order.
· Fully resolve each action before either player starts another.
· Pay actions to play cards. Choose one exhaust branch per ally exhaustion.
· Upgrade only hand or in-play cards, with at most one upgrade per slot.
· Matching the upgrade’s faction reduces its cost by 2 credits; upgrades grant no faction.
Threat phase:
Active threats deal their full attack, reducing armor before health.
· On-deck threats do not attack. Damage does not reduce a threat’s attack.
Cleanup phase:
Discard tactics, lose actions and armor, refill threats, then advance danger.
· Refill to three non-Fast active threats and a non-Fast on-deck threat.
· Skip only your difficulty color: Normal green, Hard yellow, Expert red.
Combat and leveling:
· Threat health equals attack plus defense. Damage persists. Attack either battlefield.
· First give the defeated card to its battlefield owner, then award the final attacker its rewards.
· Destroying a threat eliminates its sleeve without granting its card or rewards.
· Level up when deck and battlefield are empty in Main, or an empty deck prevents refilling.
· Advance both markers; discard all cards in play and down to three cards in hand.
· You may eliminate one hand or discard card; resolve the boss effect, then shuffle your discard.
· Events interrupt immediately. Resume the original effect even if its source left play.
· Order or forfeit effects freely. Eliminate a sleeve after its same effect resolves four times in a turn.
Keywords:
· Conspire requires another same-faction card. Focus counts your same-faction cards in hand and play.
· Unite counts distinct factions in hand and play. Bargain reduces its price by same-faction cards, to zero.
· Upgraded requires at least one attached upgrade.
· Fast does not count toward the three threats when refilling during Setup or Cleanup.
· With Taunt in a battlefield, damage there must target a Taunt threat.
· Each Rage instance discards one ally in the Threat Phase.
· Each time you target Terror with damage, lose 1 action; you may still attack at zero actions.
· Crazed 5 deals itself 2 damage when revealed if its owner has at most 5 health.
· Crazed, Rage, and Terror stack; Fast and Taunt do not.
Bosses:
· Harbinger and Triumvirate cards entering hand deal boss damage and are discarded.
· Triumvirate locations take normal damage. With at least two remaining, boss damage must target locations.
· Duomo requires a story Ending. Players may split credit and action costs.
Scoring: after victory, finish the current turn if desired, then score each character.
· Score 100/200/300 for Normal/Hard/Expert, 10 per remaining turn, plus remaining health.
· Gain 10 for every four-use elimination.
· Gain 10 each for at least 15 credits and upgrading every non-starting non-boss card.
· Gain 10 for owning at least two cards of each faction.
· Gain 50 for leveling up twice after victory during that turn. Never start an extra turn.

zh.name: 万境奇旅
zh.desc: 在未知星球上探索、求生，决定你们的命运
zh.rules:
目标：在未知星球上完成共同使命，或找到属于你们的命运。
每位玩家独自查看当前地点，只能向同伴口述景物，不能展示地点牌。个人网格、补给、储备和资源公开。
开局：每人获得一名角色和一个不同的逃生舱，获得相应技能；投掷两枚技能骰决定落点；两枚骰子的结果相同时，可以重新投掷。第一位玩家额外投掷两枚技能骰决定使命。
回合：选择一个地点行动、卡牌行动，或沿允许的方向离开。承诺后再查看费用和说明；任何玩家都可以支付匹配技能，每枚降低 1 点费用。投掷与剩余费用相同数量的挑战骰。骰池不足时才刷新全部挑战骰。
将骰子逐一放入自己的合法槽位，或同伴带有影响标记的槽位。每个槽位只放一枚骰子。技能槽按当前行动类型匹配，与骰面无关；指定骰面槽按骰面匹配。能力、地形和元素槽还需要符合牌上条件。随后同时结算未放置的时间、士气和生命损失。空白骰进入中央；返回骰回到骰池，基础规则不会额外扣除生存资源。
完成挑战后才阅读故事结果。选择前只阅读选项，选择后再揭示对应结果。地点每人每局通常只能执行一次地点行动；明确要求继续或标为始终可用的行动例外。
获得竖牌时放入三行三列的个人网格，角色始终位于中心，不能随意重排。横牌进入补给，使命和命运进入中央。储备牌不能提供槽位与能力。
角色可以支付 2 点强化，获得 1 枚钱币或 1 点移动技能；也可以支付 1 点强化，重掷自己行动中的一枚挑战骰。如果重掷后的结果与原结果相同，则获得角色对应的技能。
任何生存资源降至零时，先查看使命的获取故事，按其中说明处理最后机会。达成使命可以结束，也可继续追求命运；两者均完成时为史诗胜利。
故事结果中的技能费用也可由同伴自愿分担。请求协助后，各玩家选择贡献数量；确认选项时统一扣除。钱币、强化和生存资源按选项说明由对应玩家或卡牌支付。

en.name: Vantage
en.desc: Explore an unfamiliar planet, survive together, and choose your destiny
en.rules:
Goal: Complete your shared mission or discover a destiny on an unfamiliar planet.
Only you may see your location. Describe it to companions without showing the card. Grids, supplies, reserves, and resources are public.
Setup: Receive a character and a distinct escape capsule with their skills. Roll two skill dice for your landing site; doubles may be rerolled. The first player rolls two additional skill dice to determine the mission.
Turn: Commit to a location action, an action on a card, or departing in an available direction. Read its cost only after committing. Any player may pay matching skill tokens, reducing the cost by one each. Roll challenge dice equal to the remaining cost. Refresh all challenge dice only when the pool is insufficient.
Place dice in legal slots on your grid or impact slots on companions’ grids, one per slot. Skill slots match the action, regardless of the die face; specific-result slots match the face. Ability, terrain, and composition slots require their printed conditions. Apply losses from unplaced time, morale, and health dice simultaneously. Blank dice go to the center. Setbacks return to the pool without an inherent stat loss.
Read the result only after resolving the challenge. Read choices before selecting and reveal only the chosen result. Each player normally performs just one location action per location per game; explicit continuation and always-available actions are exceptions.
Place vertical cards in your 3×3 grid, keeping your character in the center. Cards cannot be freely rearranged. Horizontal cards enter your supply; missions and destinies go to the center. Reserved cards do not provide slots or powers.
Your character can pay two boost for a coin or a move skill. Pay one boost to reroll one of your challenge dice; if unchanged, gain your character skill.
If any stat reaches zero, consult the mission’s take entry before resolving your final chance. You may end after completing the mission or pursue a destiny. Completing both earns an epic victory.
Companions may also voluntarily help pay skill costs in story results. Request help, let each player offer skills, then confirm the option to spend them. Pay coins, boost, and survival resources from the player or card specified by the option.

zh.name: 战争之匣
zh.desc: 双人袋构战棋:抽币用兵,部署兵种抢占位置点,放完最后一枚控制标记就获胜
zh.rules:
目标:把自己的控制标记全部放上版图(占住位置点);放下最后一枚者立即获胜。
准备:双方各带 4 个兵种(每个兵种 2 枚入袋、其余进供应堆)外加 1 枚皇家币入袋;双方起始各控制 2 个位置点。
回合:双方轮流行动,每回合开始各从袋中抽 3 枚币(袋空把弃牌堆洗回)。
双方轮流使用手中的硬币行动。一方用完手中硬币后，由另一方继续行动；双方都用完后，开始新回合，由持有先手标记的一方先行动。
每步从手中选 1 枚币,三选一:
· 放置(币面朝上):部署该兵种到己方控制且空的 1 个位置点;或加成己方同名单位(将硬币放入该单位的硬币堆中，堆叠单位更难被消灭)。
面朝下弃置一枚硬币时，选择以下一项：
· 夺取先手：本回合先手尚未转移，且你不是当前持有者时，可以取得先手标记。
· 招募：从供应堆选择 1 枚硬币，公开后放入自己的弃牌堆。
· 放弃：不执行其他操作。
面朝上弃币进行机动：
选择该币种的一个单位，执行移动1格、控制其所在位置点或攻击相邻敌方单位中的一项。具有战术的兵种也可以改为发动战术。
战斗：受到攻击的单位须从自己的硬币堆顶部移除 1 枚硬币。该单位的硬币全部被移除时，单位离场。
骑士只能被加成过的单位攻击;长枪兵受击时反伤攻击方。
皇家卫队受击时,防守方可弃供应堆 1 枚皇家卫队币免伤。
皇家币不能作为单位放到版图上。你可以用它发动皇家卫队的战术，使该单位移动1格；也可以将其背面朝上弃置，用来夺取先手、招募或放弃行动。

en.name: War Chest
en.desc: 2-player bag-building tactics: draft coins, command units, seize locations — place your last control marker to win
en.rules:
Goal: place all of your control markers onto location points; placing your last marker wins immediately.
Setup: each player brings 4 unit types (2 coins of each into your bag, the rest to your supply) plus 1 royal coin; each side starts controlling 2 locations.
Rounds: at the start of each round both players draw 3 coins from their bag (reshuffle discards when empty).
Take turns spending one coin per action; when you run out, play passes; when both are out, a new round begins and the initiative holder acts first.
On your turn, spend one coin:
· Face up — deploy: place that unit on an empty location you control; or bolster: add the coin under a matching unit (stacked units are harder to destroy).
Discard a coin face down to choose one action:
· Seize initiative: Take the initiative marker if it has not changed hands this round and you do not already hold it.
· Recruit: Take 1 coin from the supply and place it in your face-up discard pile.
· Pass: Take no further action.
Discard a coin face up to maneuver:
Choose one unit of that type to move 1 space, control its current location or attack an adjacent enemy unit. A unit with a tactic may use it instead.
Combat: the defender removes 1 coin from its stack; a unit with no coins left is destroyed.
Knights can only be attacked by bolstered units; pikemen deal a counter-hit to the attacker.
When a Royal Guard is hit, its owner may discard a Royal Guard coin from supply to negate it.
A Royal coin cannot be deployed as a unit. You may spend it to use the Royal Guard tactic and move that unit 1 space, or discard it face down to seize initiative, recruit, or pass.

zh.name: 深水城领主
zh.desc: 派遣密探招募冒险者，完成任务，掌控深水城。
zh.rules:
目标：
八轮结束后，总分最高者获胜。总分包括对局得分、剩余冒险者（每枚 1 分）、金币（每 2 枚 1 分）、秘密领主奖励，并扣除腐败罚分。同分时金币较多者获胜；仍同分则并列。
准备：
每人秘密获得一位领主、两张阴谋，公开获得两张任务。按人数领取密探；先手玩家获得4枚金币，此后按顺时针顺序，每名玩家比前一名多获得1枚金币。在市场中正面朝上摆放四张任务和三座建筑。
流程：
从先手起轮流派遣一名可用密探至合法地点，领取该处放置的资源，再完整执行行动。通常每格只容纳一名密探。行动后可以完成一张任务：支付所需冒险者及金币，领取奖励。若有强制任务，必须优先完成。已完成的剧情任务持续提供卡面收益。阴谋与领主只向本人显示；未完成任务公开。
深水港：
在此打出一张阴谋。其他密探全部派遣完毕后，按港口 Ⅰ、Ⅱ、Ⅲ 顺序将实际驻留的密探重新派至其他合法地点。复制港口行动不会获得重新派遣。重派期间新获得的密探立即派遣。
建筑：
支付金币购买建筑，获得该市场位置累积的分数，并将建筑置于自己控制之下。每轮开始，三座市场建筑各增加 1 分；具有积累能力的已建建筑放置新资源。使用对手建筑时，对手获得所有者收益；使用自己建筑通常没有该收益。最多控制九座建筑。
轮次：
一轮结束后收回所有密探。第五轮每人额外获得一名密探。游戏共八轮，先手标记决定每轮首位行动者。
扩展：
地底迷城与骷髅港默认关闭，可单独或同时开启。至少开启一个扩展可进行六人局。长局初始密探数量为两人 5 名、三人 4 名、四至五人 3 名、六人 2 名；六人或同时开启两个扩展时必须使用长局。双扩展开局随机移除基础版的 25 张阴谋、30 张任务和 12 座建筑后混合。
骷髅港：
腐败从最接近 −1 的非空格拿取；返还时放入最远且未满三枚的格子。永久移除不会回到轨道。轨道中没有可拿取的腐败标记时，每缺少一枚所需标记，就立即失去10分。终局每枚腐败的罚分为轨道上最远空格的绝对值。
特殊配件：
· 副官：招募副官提供一名永久额外密探。
· 大使：深水城宫殿授予大使，下一轮先于正常回合派遣；大使完成所派地点的行动后视为所有人的对手密探，在港口不会重新派遣。
· 英雄花园允许立即完成新接任务并额外获得 4 分，不占通常一次任务完成名额。
卡牌上的具体效果与限制优先。

en.name: Lords of Waterdeep
en.desc: Send agents, recruit adventurers and complete quests to rule Waterdeep.
en.rules:
Goal: after eight rounds, score points earned during play, 1 point per remaining adventurer, 1 per 2 Gold, and your secret Lord bonus; subtract Corruption penalties. Most points wins; ties go to the player with more Gold, then remain tied.
Setup: each player receives a secret Lord, 2 Intrigue cards and 2 public Quests. Starting agents depend on player count. The first player receives 4 Gold, then each player clockwise receives one more. Reveal 4 Quests and 3 Buildings.
Turns: clockwise from the first player, assign one available agent to a legal action space. Take resources placed there before carrying out every instruction. Spaces normally hold one agent. After each assignment, you may complete one Quest by paying its cost and receiving its reward. Complete Mandatory Quests before other Quests. Completed Plot Quests grant ongoing benefits. Intrigue and Lords are private; active Quests are public.
Waterdeep Harbor: play an Intrigue card. After regular assignments, reassign the agents actually remaining at Harbor I, II and III in that order. Copying Harbor does not grant reassignment. Agents newly gained during reassignment are assigned immediately.
Buildings: pay Gold to buy a market Building, score points accumulated on its position and put it under your control. Each market Building gains 1 point at the beginning of every round. Accumulating Buildings gain resources when put in play and each round thereafter. Using an opponent’s Building grants its owner benefit; using your own normally does not. You may control at most 9 Buildings.
Rounds: reclaim assigned agents at round end. Each player gains an extra agent at the start of round 5. The first-player marker determines who begins each round.
Modules: Undermountain and Skullport are off by default; enable either or both. At least one module allows 6 players. Long-game starting agents: 5 at 2 players, 4 at 3, 3 at 4–5, and 2 at 6. Six players and both modules require the long game. With both modules, randomly remove 25 base Intrigue cards, 30 Quests and 12 Buildings before combining.
Skullport: take Corruption from the occupied space closest to −1. Return tokens to the furthest space holding fewer than 3. Removed tokens leave the game. Each token you cannot take because the track is empty immediately costs 10 points. At game end, each Corruption in your Tavern costs the absolute value of the furthest empty space.
Special pieces:
· Recruit Lieutenant grants a permanent extra agent.
· The Palace grants the Ambassador for assignment before normal turns next round; it counts as an opponent’s agent for everyone and is never reassigned from Harbor.
· Heroes’ Garden may immediately complete the newly taken Quest for 4 extra points without using your normal completion allowance.
Individual card effects and restrictions take precedence.

zh.name: 路标：探险家系列
zh.desc: 四张手绘地图，记录四次徒步旅程
zh.rules:
目标:
· 在地图上完成四次徒步，记录动物、地点和日志分数。
准备:
· 选择一张地图、目标和单人难度。
· 掷骰决定起点，所有玩家从相同路标出发。
流程:
· 每回合掷骰，沿当前侧天气轨数出对应格子，只圈抵达格。
· 抵达格给出本回合的天气与移动点数。
· 从当前路标规划到另一处路标，穿过一条网格线消耗1点移动。
· 路线不能穿过其他路标；可在网格内转弯。
· 玩家可消耗水，每消耗1点水增加1点移动。
· 无法或不愿移动时可休息，获得1点水。
· 当前侧最后一格行动完毕，选择一项日志条目计分。
结算:
· 记录动物、观景、装备、日志和目标分数。
· 第四次徒步结束后，总分最高的玩家获胜。

en.name: Waypoints: Explorer Series
en.desc: Four hand drawn maps and four hiking journeys
en.rules:
Goal:
· Complete four hikes, recording animals, places, and journal points.
Setup:
· Choose a map, a goal, and solo difficulty.
· Roll a die for the trailhead; everyone begins at the same point.
Play:
· Each turn, roll a die and count that many weather spaces. Circle only the landing space.
· The landing space gives the weather and movement points for the turn.
· Plan a route to another waypoint; crossing a grid line costs 1 movement.
· A route may not pass through another waypoint and may bend within the grid.
· Spend water to gain 1 movement for each water spent.
· Rest instead of moving to gain 1 water.
· After acting on the last space of a side, choose one journal entry to score.
Scoring:
· Add animal, lookout, equipment, journal, and goal points.
· After the fourth hike, the highest score wins.

zh.name: 欢迎来到
zh.desc: 翻牌填号造小镇:圈庄园、修公园泳池,抢头名完成城市计划
zh.rules:
目标：有玩家第三次被拒绝建造、完成全部3张计划卡，或为所有房子填写房号时，游戏立即结束。总分最高的玩家获胜。
流程(每回合):
· 亮出三组「房号 + 效果」,所有人同时各选一组。
· 把房号填进自己三条街的空房:同一条街的房号从左到右必须严格递增，不能重复。
· 随后可使用所选组合的效果。
效果一览:
· 测量员:在两栋房子之间建栅栏;栅栏围出 1~6 栋相连房子且全部填有号码,就是一个庄园。
· 房产经纪:划掉增值轨上的一格,提升某一尺寸庄园的价值。
· 园艺师:在本街划掉一格公园。
· 泳池商:房号填进泳池房即建好泳池。
· 临时工：可以将房号增加或减少至多2，并在临时工轨道上划掉一格。终局时，按划掉的格数排名，前三名玩家获得相应分数。
· Bis:把相邻房子的号码复制到紧邻的空房,但终局要扣分。
城市计划:
· 达成计划卡要求的庄园组合后，可以获得对应分数。首位完成该计划的玩家获得较高分数，之后完成的玩家获得较低分数。
· 首个完成者可以选择重洗整副牌。

en.name: Welcome To…
en.desc: Flip-and-write town building: fence estates, build parks & pools, race for city plans
en.rules:
Goal: the game ends immediately when someone takes a 3rd permit refusal, completes all 3 plans, or fills every house; the highest total wins.
Each round:
· Three “house number + effect” combos are revealed, and everyone picks one at the same time.
· Write the number in an empty house on your three streets: each street must be strictly ascending left to right, with no duplicates.
· You may then use the picked combo’s effect.
Effects:
· Surveyor: build a fence between two houses; a fenced-in run of 1–6 connected houses, all numbered, is an estate.
· Real Estate Agent: cross off a box on the value track to raise the value of one estate size.
· Landscaper: cross off a park box on that street.
· Pool Manufacturer: writing in a pool house builds its pool.
· Temp Agency: adjust the number up or down by up to 2 and cross off a box on its track; the top three temp counts score at the end.
· Bis: copy an adjacent house’s number into a touching empty house, but it costs points at the end.
City plans:
· Complete a plan’s required estates to score it: the first completer earns the higher points, later completers the lower.
· The first completer may reshuffle the deck.

zh.name: 毒逗魔药师
zh.desc: 将原料炼成魔药，传给右邻，让对手的工作台满溢。
zh.rules:
游戏目标：
每位玩家扮演一名魔药师。用配方将原料转化为新的原料，再把产出传给右侧玩家。对方工作台放不下的原料进入你的巫师之环。结算时，至少一人的巫师之环有 5 份原料，游戏便结束。

准备游戏：
每人有一张工作台、一个魔药锅和 4 张私密配方手牌。工作台最多容纳 3 份阴影之心、4 份曼德拉草，以及蘑菇、蜘蛛和蟾蜍各 9 份。公共供应不受原料数量限制。
· 初次游戏使用学徒人物，每人从 1 份曼德拉草及蘑菇、蜘蛛、蟾蜍各 4 份开始。
· 开启人物能力后，每人从随机发到的 2 张人物中选择 1 张。按人物卡取得起始原料，并使用其特殊能力或专属配方。

学习阶段：
· 所有人同时从手牌暗选 1 张配方。即使本轮无法使用，也必须选择。
· 带双向箭头的配方可以在打出时旋转，交换输入与产出。揭示后不能再旋转，人物能力另有说明时除外。
· 所有人选定后一起揭示，将新配方加入各自的配方阵列。配方会保留到以后的轮次。

奥术效果：
新配方上的魔药、渡鸦和魔法书图示分别增加对应奥术计数。某类计数每到达或越过一个偶数，本轮可使用一次该类效果。一次增加多个图示时，按越过的偶数次数计算。效果可以放弃，但不能留到下一轮。
· 魔药：从公共供应取任意 1 份原料，放入自己的魔药锅。它可以继续用于本轮配方。
· 渡鸦：从自己的工作台移除至多 2 份原料，放回公共供应；两份可以同类或不同类。
· 魔法书：选择一种原料。本轮支付配方输入时，可以直接从公共供应取该类原料，不受次数限制。

炼制阶段：
所有玩家可以按自己选择的顺序使用配方，每张配方每轮最多使用一次，也可以不使用。
· 先填满配方的所有输入槽。原料可以取自工作台、之前配方的产出，或本轮魔法书允许使用的公共供应。可以分别选择每份原料的来源。
· 支付完整输入后，从公共供应取得所有产出。产出保留在魔药锅中，可用来支付下一张配方；未使用的产出将在本轮结束时传出。已支付的原料不会回到工作台。
· 一个槽里同时出现两种原料时，只需要选择其中一种，数量仍为 1 份。每次使用都可重新选择。没有输入的配方也可以选择使用或不用。
· 完成想用的配方后，点击“完成炼制”。工作台上未使用的原料继续保留，魔药锅中的剩余产出全部传出。
通常同时炼制。若互相等待对方选择而必须确定顺序，按本轮新配方的先攻值从小到大决定；先攻值显示在牌面。

传递与胜负：
· 所有人完成炼制后，将魔药锅传给右侧玩家。接收者把原料放到自己的工作台，先填满对应容量，放不下的部分进入生产者的巫师之环。
· 全部魔药锅结算后，若至少一人的巫师之环有 5 份原料，比较所有达到条件的玩家：先比较环中原料总数，较多者获胜；仍相同则比较原料种类，较多者获胜；再相同则比较工作台余料，较少者获胜；最后仍相同则共同获胜。
· 若尚未结束，将剩余手牌全部传给左侧玩家，再从牌库补至各自手牌上限，开始下一轮。通常上限为 4 张。

人物能力：
· 学徒：选择配方前，可以弃置人物及全部手牌，重新抽取 4 张。整局只能使用一次。
· 仙灵祝福：每轮可使用一次无输入配方，产出 1 份曼德拉草和 1 份蟾蜍。
· 先知：手牌上限为 5 张。
· 冒险者：选择配方时可以改为随机打出一张，并额外触发任意一种奥术效果。
· 蟾蜍密语者：初始魔法书计数为 1。每轮可用 3 份蟾蜍，产出任意 1 份原料。
· 隐藏力量：可用五类原料各 1 份，产出任意 3 份原料；使用后弃置这张专属配方。
· 魔药酿造师：揭示新配方时，每有一个魔药图示，可以将工作台上的任意 1 份原料放入魔药锅。
· 魔法书学者：每轮炼制时，可以支付 2 份曼德拉草，额外获得一次魔法书效果。原料必须来自工作台或已有产出。
· 蜘蛛召唤师：每轮可用 2 份曼德拉草，产出 5 份蜘蛛。
· 捣蛋鬼：专属配方最初用 2 份蘑菇产出 2 份蟾蜍；每次传完手牌后必须旋转，下一轮改用 2 份蟾蜍产出 2 份蘑菇，交替进行。
· 失控之力：每轮选择配方之前，必须选择一种原料，将该类 3 份原料放上工作台；超出容量的部分进入左侧玩家的巫师之环。另有每轮一次的专属配方，用 1 份阴影之心产出曼德拉草和蘑菇各 1 份。
· 旋风：打出任何配方时都可以旋转，包括原本只有单向箭头的牌；揭示后仍不能再旋转。
· 全能魔药师：完成炼制时，如果魔药锅里五类原料都有，可以选择其中 1 份直接移入自己的巫师之环，其余照常传递；也可以放弃本次效果。
人物能力改变一般规则时，以人物能力为准。

en.name: Whirling Witchcraft
en.desc: Brew ingredients, pass them to your right, and overflow your rival’s workbench.
en.rules:
Goal:
Use recipes to transform ingredients and pass your output to the player on your right. Ingredients they cannot fit on their workbench go into your Witch’s Circle. The game ends after passing all cauldrons if any Circle contains at least 5 ingredients.

Setup:
Each player has a workbench, a cauldron, and 4 secret recipe cards. A workbench holds 3 Hearts of Shadow, 4 Mandrakes, and 9 each of Mushrooms, Spiders, and Toads. The general supply is unlimited.
· For your first game, everyone is an Initiate, starting with 1 Mandrake and 4 each of Mushrooms, Spiders, and Toads.
· With personalities enabled, choose 1 of 2 randomly dealt personalities. Take its starting ingredients and use its power or personal recipe.

Study phase:
· Everyone secretly chooses 1 recipe from their hand, even if they cannot use it this round.
· A recipe with a two-way direction symbol may be rotated when played, swapping its inputs and outputs. Once revealed, it cannot rotate again unless a personality says otherwise.
· Reveal all chosen recipes together and add them to your tableau. They remain available in later rounds.

Arcana:
Add the Potion, Raven, and Book symbols on your new recipe to your corresponding arcana totals. Each time a total reaches or passes an even number, you may use that effect this round. If you cross more than one even number, gain that many uses. You may decline an effect, but cannot save it for a later round.
· Potion: Take any 1 ingredient from the supply and put it in your cauldron. You may use it as an input this round.
· Raven: Remove up to 2 ingredients from your workbench and return them to the supply. They may be the same or different types.
· Book: Choose an ingredient type. For this round, you may take that type directly from the supply whenever filling recipe inputs, without a limit.

Brewing phase:
Use your recipes in any order. Each recipe may be used once per round, and using a recipe is optional.
· Fill every input space with a matching ingredient. Each ingredient may come from your workbench, previous recipe output in your cauldron, or a type supplied by an active Book effect. Choose the source for each input separately.
· After paying all inputs, take every output from the supply. Outputs stay in your cauldron and may be used by subsequent recipes. Paid ingredients do not return to your workbench.
· A hybrid space showing two types requires only 1 ingredient of either pictured type. Choose again each time you use the recipe. Recipes without inputs are also optional.
· Select “Finish brewing” when you have used all the recipes you wish. Unused workbench ingredients remain there; all remaining output will be passed.
Brewing is normally simultaneous. If players are waiting for each other’s choices and timing matters, resolve decisions in increasing initiative order, using the newly played recipe values.

Passing and victory:
· After everyone finishes brewing, pass cauldrons to the right. Fill the recipient’s corresponding workbench spaces. Ingredients that do not fit go into the producing player’s Witch’s Circle.
· After all cauldrons resolve, if any Circle has at least 5 ingredients, compare qualifying players: the most Circle ingredients wins; then the most different Circle types; then the fewest total ingredients on the workbench. If still tied, share victory.
· Otherwise, pass all remaining hand cards to the left, draw up to your hand limit, normally 4, and begin another round.

Personalities:
· Initiate: Before choosing a recipe, discard your personality and entire hand, then draw 4 cards. This is usable once per game.
· Blessed by Fey: Once per round, produce 1 Mandrake and 1 Toad without inputs.
· Clairvoyant: Your hand limit is 5 cards.
· Daredevil: You may play a random recipe from your hand and additionally trigger any one arcana effect.
· Frog Whisperer: Start with 1 Book on your arcana track. Once per round, turn 3 Toads into any 1 ingredient.
· Hidden Power: Turn 1 ingredient of each of the five types into any 3 ingredients. Discard this personal recipe after use.
· Potion Brewer: When revealing your recipe, for each Potion symbol on it, you may move 1 ingredient of any type from your workbench to your cauldron.
· Spellbook Scholar: Once per round during brewing, spend 2 Mandrakes to trigger a Book effect. The ingredients must come from your workbench or existing output.
· Spider Summoner: Once per round, turn 2 Mandrakes into 5 Spiders.
· Trickster: Your personal recipe initially turns 2 Mushrooms into 2 Toads. Rotate it after passing hands, so it turns 2 Toads into 2 Mushrooms next round, alternating each round.
· Uncontrolled Powers: Before playing a recipe each round, you must add 3 ingredients of a single chosen type to your workbench. Any excess goes into the Circle of the player on your left. Your personal recipe also turns 1 Heart of Shadow into 1 Mandrake and 1 Mushroom once per round.
· Whirlwind: You may rotate any recipe when playing it, including a normally one-way recipe. You still cannot rotate it after revealing it.
· Witch of All Trades: When finishing brewing, if your cauldron contains all five ingredient types, you may move 1 ingredient of your choice from it into your Witch’s Circle before passing the rest. You may also decline this effect.
Personality rules take precedence over the general rules.

zh.name: 姬路城
zh.desc: 在白鹭城经营家族，以九枚骰子争取大名的青睐。含官方单人模式。
zh.rules:
游戏目标：
在三轮中派遣朝臣、园丁和武士，发展家族。每名玩家每轮进行三个回合。第三轮结束后，总分最高者获胜；同分时，最终行动顺序在前者获胜。
准备：
每座桥使用玩家人数加一枚骰子，单人模式按双人准备。骰子从左至右按点数排列。双人模式移除带双人标记的指定城堡卡。按行动顺序的逆序选择一组初始行动卡和资源卡；单人模式随机分配。
回合流程：
· 从任意一座桥的左端或右端取一枚骰子，放到一个合法位置。桥中间的骰子暂不可取。
· 骰子点数高于位置的基值时，获得差额的钱币；低于基值时，支付差额。已有骰子时，以最上方骰子的点数为基值。必须先结算差价。
· 取左端骰子时，先获得个人灯笼区全部奖励，奖励顺序自选，然后执行落点行动。
· 三至四人时，城堡房间及城外位置最多叠放两枚骰子。一至二人不可叠放。个人领地不可叠放；井底不限枚数。
落点：
· 城堡：一层基值为3，二层为4。只能使用房间内有对应标记的骰子颜色，执行该颜色对应的行动；同色有两行时，顺序自选。深色行动通常需要印章，支付后才执行。
· 城外：基值为4，不限颜色，选择所列两项主要行动中的一项。
· 井底：基值始终为1，获得1枚大名印章和两块板块背面的奖励。
· 个人领地：基值为6，珊瑚色、黑色、白色骰子分别对应朝臣、园丁、武士行。先获得该行已露出的奖励，再执行行动卡对应部分。
家族成员：
· 园丁：支付庭园所示食物，派遣一名园丁并执行该卡行动。同一家族在同一张庭园卡上最多一名园丁。卡上额外支付的钱币可以选择不支付，此时不执行该项奖励。
· 武士：支付5、3或1单位铁，派遣一名武士到对应训练场。需要支付5单位铁的训练场获得蓝色和黄色两项奖励，顺序自选；另外两处各获得一项奖励。
· 朝臣：一次行动可以各执行一次进城和晋升，顺序自选，也可以只执行其中一项。进城须支付2枚钱币，将一名朝臣放在城门。晋升须支付2或5单位珍珠母贝，让一名朝臣上升一层或两层，可以跳层。
· 到达一层或二层时，先把个人行动卡翻入灯笼区，再拿取到达房间的卡，执行其一项浅色行动，最后补充房间。若牌堆无法补充，仅执行浅色行动，不换牌。
· 到达三层时，先获得灯笼奖励，再占据一个空余的大名恩赏并获得奖励；恩赏已满时仍可晋升，但不再获得恩赏。
资源与影响力：
食物、铁、珍珠母贝各最多7单位，大名印章最多5枚，超出部分失去，钱币不限。任何时候都可以用1枚印章兑换1枚钱币，或用2枚印章兑换1单位资源，可多次兑换。获得影响力时沿季节轨道前进；越过位置5、10、15时，分别须支付1枚、2枚、3枚印章。不支付则停止本次剩余移动。同格后来到达的家族排在上方。
轮末：
按影响力从高到低重排行动顺序，同格时上方优先。前两轮中，桥上仍有骰子的庭园按新顺序触发，每名玩家自行选择其园丁的触发顺序，每名园丁最多触发一次。完成后重新掷骰。第三轮重排顺序后直接计分，不触发庭园。
终局计分：
· 累计即时家族分。
· 剩余钱币与印章合计，每5枚获得1分。
· 每类资源剩余3至6单位获得1分，7单位获得2分。
· 影响力在第一、第二、第三季分别获得0、3、6分，第四季按位置获得10至15分。
· 每名朝臣在城门、一层、二层、三层分别获得1、3、6、10分。
· 训练场内武士的倍率总和，乘以城内朝臣数量；城门朝臣不计入乘数。需要支付5单位铁的训练场每名武士倍率为2，其余为1。
· 每名园丁获得庭园卡所示分数。
官方单人模式：
与德川家族竞争。
· 难度设置：简单、中等、困难分别让对手从0、3、8分和0、1、3影响力开始；简单时玩家先手，其余对手先手。
· 取骰与放置：翻开对手牌，并用牌堆顶的桥指示取骰；无法取骰则继续翻牌。按最后翻开的卡落骰，位置已被占据时改放井底，只获得正差价的钱币，不获得位置奖励。
· 执行行动：对手无须支付，行动按最后两张翻开卡从左至右、从上至下执行，不能执行的每项行动获得当前轮数的家族分。最低分庭园的并列选择和晋升房间由玩家决定。
· 轮末：对手为先手时，每3枚钱币兑换与当前轮数相同的分数；对手为后手时，每5枚钱币进行一次这样的兑换。剩余钱币保留；前两轮每名可触发园丁获得当前轮数的分数，然后洗牌。
· 终局：对手不计算剩余资源和钱币，其余照常计分。

en.name: The White Castle
en.desc: Build your clan at Himeji Castle with just nine dice. Includes the official solitaire rival.
en.rules:
Goal:
Over three rounds, send Courtiers, Gardeners and Warriors to Himeji Castle. Each player takes three turns per round. Most points after round three wins; ties go to the earlier player in the final turn order.
Setup:
Use one more die per bridge than the player count; solitaire uses the two-player setup. Sort dice from left to right. Remove the marked Castle cards for two players. In reverse turn order, draft a pair of starting Action and Resource cards; solitaire assigns them randomly.
Your turn:
· Take a die from either end of any bridge, then place it in a legal space. Interior dice are unavailable.
· Gain coins equal to the amount by which your die exceeds the covered value, or pay the difference if lower. Use the top die's value in an occupied space. Settle this before any rewards.
· A die taken from the left end first activates all Lantern rewards in your chosen order, then the destination actions.
· With three or four players, Castle rooms and Outside the Walls hold up to two stacked dice. With one or two players, stacking is forbidden. Personal Domain spaces never stack; the Well has no limit.
Destinations:
· Castle: base value 3 on the first floor, 4 on the second. Match a die color shown in the room and perform its corresponding actions. Two matching rows can be resolved in either order. Dark actions generally cost a Seal.
· Outside the Walls: base 4, any color. Choose one of the two principal actions.
· Well: always base 1. Gain one Daimyo Seal and both tile rewards.
· Personal Domain: base 6. Coral, black and white dice use the Courtier, Gardener and Warrior rows respectively. Gain all uncovered row rewards before the corresponding Action card reward.
Clan members:
· Gardener: pay the garden's Food cost and place one Gardener. Each clan can have only one Gardener on each card. Perform its action; extra coin costs are optional, with no benefit if unpaid.
· Warrior: pay 5, 3 or 1 Iron to use the matching yard. The 5-Iron yard grants both a blue and a yellow reward, in either order; the other yards each grant one reward.
· Courtier: an action allows entering and climbing once each, in either order, or just one part. Pay 2 coins to put a Courtier at the Gate. Pay 2 or 5 Mother-of-Pearl to move one Courtier up one or two floors, including skipping a floor.
· On reaching floor one or two, flip your Domain card into the Lantern area, take the destination card, execute one of its light actions, then refill the room. If the deck cannot refill it, only perform a light action without exchanging cards.
· On reaching floor three, activate your Lantern, then claim an unoccupied Daimyo favor and its benefit. Courtiers may still rise when all favors are occupied, without another favor.
Resources and Influence:
Food, Iron and Mother-of-Pearl each cap at 7; Daimyo Seals cap at 5. Excess is lost. Coins are unlimited. At any time, repeatedly exchange 1 Seal for 1 coin or 2 Seals for 1 Resource. Influence moves along the seasonal track. Passing positions 5, 10 and 15 costs 1, 2 and 3 Seals respectively. Declining ends the remaining movement. A later arrival is placed on top of a tied stack.
Round end:
Reorder clans by descending Influence, with the top of tied stacks first. In rounds one and two, gardens under bridges that still have dice activate in the new turn order. Each eligible Gardener activates once, in its owner's chosen order. Then reroll all dice. Round three ends immediately after reordering, without garden rewards.
Final scoring:
· Points earned during play.
· One point per five remaining coins and Seals combined.
· Each Resource at 3–6 scores one point; at 7 it scores two.
· Influence in seasons one, two and three scores 0, 3 and 6; season four scores the printed 10–15 points.
· Each Courtier at the Gate or floors one, two and three scores 1, 3, 6 or 10 points respectively.
· Multiply your Warriors' combined yard value by your Courtiers inside the Castle, excluding the Gate. Each Warrior in the 5-Iron yard is worth 2; elsewhere 1.
· Each Gardener scores the points printed on its garden.
Official solitaire:
Face the Tokugawa clan.
· Difficulty: Easy, medium and hard start the rival at 0/3/8 points and 0/1/3 Influence. You go first on easy; the rival goes first otherwise.
· Take and place a die: Reveal a rival card and use the bridge instruction on the next deck top. If unavailable, reveal another until a die can be taken. Place it at the last revealed card's destination, or in the Well if occupied. Only gain positive coin differences, with no location rewards.
· Actions: The rival never pays. Perform the last two revealed cards' actions left to right, top to bottom; each impossible action scores the current round number. You decide tied lowest-scoring gardens and climbing destinations.
· Round end: the rival converts each 3 coins if first, or 5 if second, into the round number in points, retaining change. In rounds one and two, each eligible rival Gardener scores the round number, then shuffle the deck.
· Final scoring: The rival scores all normal final categories except leftover resources and money.

zh.name: 荒野冒险家
zh.desc: 招募森林伙伴，穿越荒野，争夺社区杯
zh.rules:
目标：
· 招募三种村民、收集装备并投资建筑，争夺最高分。
准备：
· 核心与所选主题共75张；每人5枚金币、5张手牌。
· 后手先选初始村民；双方各放置2份补给。
· 混合变体使用99张牌，开局抽8张后弃置3张。
流程：
· 每回合必须执行两次主行动：支付费用打牌，或激活起始牌、普通村民。
· 同一张牌每回合只能通过主行动激活一次；村民需移除1份补给。
· 自由行动村民每回合也只能激活一次；附魔建筑是自由行动。
· 效果激活不移除补给，不占上述次数；零补给村民仍可被效果激活。
· 装备可被双方触发；触发者从装备取1份补给作为金币。
· 建筑只由拥有者触发；新打出的牌不触发自身。
· 同时触发由触发者决定顺序；先完整结算，再继续当前效果。
· 投资可支付至指定数量的金币；每枚转为该建筑的1份补给。
· 检视为秘密查看牌顶，依次结算指定效果，再自行排列剩牌放回牌顶。
· 弃牌堆可随时查看，但不得调整顺序；计分牌默认不可查看。
冒险：
· 向前移动至多指定步数，有能力时至少移动1步，只领取落点奖励。
· 秋季付费路线先支付金币或弃置手牌，完整结算触发后再抵达。
· 起始牌格可选择激活或升级；附魔标记每种至多持有1个。
· 铁宝箱：可以将1张手牌收入计分区、给村民增加1份补给，或检视牌堆顶的3张牌，从中抽取1张并弃置其余2张。
· 金宝箱：可以将2张手牌收入计分区、激活村民，或检视牌堆顶的5张牌，从中抽取2张并弃置其余3张。
· 红宝石宝箱：可以将3张手牌收入计分区；也可以从弃牌堆中取出两张牌，将其中一张收入计分区，另一张免费打出。
· 红宝石宝箱还可以检视牌堆顶部的5张牌，依次将其中1张收入计分区、抽取2张，再弃置其余2张。
回合末与结束：
· 抵达路线终点后，回合末先返回家，再自选顺序处理零补给牌。
· 零补给村民收入计分区；装备先结算遗物，再收入计分区。
· 牌库耗尽后完成当前回合，然后双方各进行一个最终回合。
· 村民得分为三物种数量中的最小值乘最大值；缺少一种则为0分。
· 装备得分为计分装备数乘已附魔建筑数；建筑按补给数计分。
· 金币默认不计分；平分共同获胜，可选金币与村民得分破同分。
奥托单人模式：
· 奥托使用另一套主题牌，无手牌与起始牌，忽略卡文并免费使用牌。
· 每回合先从双方所有装备各取1枚金币；其空装备直接计分，不结算遗物。
· 奥托翻开2张牌，使用其中费用较低的牌；费用相同时，两张牌均使用。你的下一个回合可以额外激活起始牌。
· 奥托村民、建筑直接计分，装备正常入场；初始村民保留到终局。
· 简单模式每5枚金币获得1分；普通每10枚金币、困难每5枚金币增加1名数量最少的物种的村民。
· 奥托的每件装备在简单或普通难度下获得2分，在困难难度下获得3分；建筑按其费用计分。

en.name: A Wild Venture
en.desc: Recruit woodland friends and venture into the wilds
en.rules:
Goal:
· Recruit three Species, collect Gear, and Invest to score.
Setup:
· Use 75 Core and Theme cards; start with 5 coins and 5 cards.
· The second player chooses an Initiate first; add 2 Supplies.
· The mixed variant uses 99 cards. Draw 8 cards, then Trash 3 of them.
Play:
· Take two Main Actions: pay to Play, or Activate a Starter or normal Villager.
· Each card can be Activated once by a Main Action per turn; remove 1 Villager Supply.
· Free Action Villagers can also be used once per turn; Enchanting is a Free Action.
· Effect Activations cost no Supplies or actions, even on empty Villagers.
· Either player can trigger Gear, taking 1 Supply from it as a coin.
· Buildings trigger only for their owner; a newly played card cannot trigger itself.
· The triggering player orders simultaneous triggers; resolve each before continuing.
· Invest up to the specified number of coins as Supplies on that Building.
· Consider secretly, resolve the listed effects, then order the remainder atop the deck.
· Inspect the Trash pile without reordering; Tucked cards normally cannot be inspected.
Adventure:
· Move forward up to the stated distance, at least 1 if able; claim only the final reward.
· Pay Autumn route costs and resolve their triggers before arriving.
· Starter spaces allow Activation or upgrading; hold at most one Enchantment of each type.
· Iron chest: Choose one option: Tuck 1 hand card, add 1 Supply to a Villager, or Consider the top 3 cards of the deck and Draw 1 and Trash the other 2.
· Gold chest: Choose one option: Tuck 2 hand cards, Activate a Villager, or Consider the top 5 cards of the deck and Draw 2 and Trash the other 3.
· Ruby chest: Tuck 3 cards from your hand, or take 2 cards from your Trash pile, Tuck one and Play the other for free.
· A Ruby chest also lets you Consider the top 5 cards of the deck, then Tuck 1, Draw 2 and Trash the other 2, in that order.
Turn end and scoring:
· At turn end, return Home from a path end, then order your empty cards.
· Tuck empty Villagers; resolve each empty Gear Relic before Tucking it.
· When the deck empties, finish this turn, then take one final turn each.
· Villagers score the smallest Species count times the largest; a missing Species scores zero.
· Your Tucked Gear score their quantity multiplied by the number of your Enchanted Buildings. Each Building scores according to its Supplies.
· Coins normally score nothing; share ties, or optionally break them by coins then Villagers.
Solo with Otto:
· Otto uses the other Theme, has no hand or Starters, ignores card text, and uses cards for free.
· Each turn Otto takes 1 coin from every Gear; his empty Gear are Tucked without Relics.
· Otto reveals 2 cards and uses the cheaper card. If their costs are equal, he uses both, and you may activate your Starter one extra time on your next turn.
· Otto Tucks Villagers and Buildings, plays Gear, and keeps setup Villagers until game end.
· On Easy, Otto scores 1 point per 5 coins. On Normal, add one Villager of his least-common Species per 10 coins; on Hard, add one per 5 coins.
· Each of Otto’s Gear scores 2 points on Easy or Normal and 3 points on Hard. Each of his Buildings scores points equal to its cost.

zh.name: 展翅翱翔:轻羽版
zh.desc: 打鸟、抽牌、下蛋,驱动你的一排鸟群引擎
zh.rules:
游戏目标：
· 任一玩家的鸟群达到 6 只，或食物牌堆无法补充时，触发终局。
· 所有玩家完成相同数量的回合后结算，分数最高者获胜。
开局准备：
· 每张牌都有鸟面和食物面。每位玩家获得 6 张牌，巢中放置 1 颗蛋。
· 基础规则将前 2 张牌作为鸟牌，其余 4 张作为食物牌，不使用目标卡。
· 进阶规则允许玩家从 6 张牌中自行选出 2 张鸟牌，其余作为食物牌。
· 同时翻开 2 张目标卡，供本局结算时使用。
· 公共供应设有 4 个食物牌堆，每堆旁各翻开 1 张鸟牌。
· 取得的牌须保持取得时的一面，不能自行翻面。
回合顺序：
· 每回合先执行一项巢行动，再从左到右处理自己鸟群中的棕色能力。
· 回合结束时，补齐公共供应中空出的翻开鸟牌。
打出鸟牌：
· 从储备区选择 1 张鸟牌，支付牌面所列的食物与蛋费用后，放在鸟群最右侧。
· 每张食物牌可支付 1 个相符的食物图标。
· 印有两种食物的牌可任选其中一种；万能图标可用任意食物牌支付。
· 任意 2 张食物牌也可共同支付 1 个食物图标。
· 蛋费用只能从自己的巢或已打出的鸟牌上支付，不能用食物牌替代。
抽取牌：
· 从翻开的鸟牌和食物牌堆中共取 2 张牌，可以任意组合。
· 翻开的鸟牌以鸟面、食物牌堆中的牌以食物面加入储备区。
· 抽牌行动开始后须取满 2 张。
· 若至少 3 个食物牌堆顶端显示相同的食物组合，可一并弃置这些顶牌，然后完成抽牌。
下蛋：
· 从自己的巢和已有鸟牌中选择至多 3 处，每处放置 1 颗蛋。
· 巢最多容纳 3 颗蛋，鸟牌不能超过各自标明的蛋容量。
· 已放置的蛋不能移动，但可以在打出鸟牌时用于支付费用。
鸟牌能力与牌堆：
· 棕色能力按鸟牌从左到右的顺序处理，每只鸟的能力均可发动或跳过。
· 绿色能力持续生效，无须在这一阶段发动。
· 捕猎时，查看所选食物牌堆顶牌的鸟面。
· 若其翼展小于能力所列数值，将该牌塞入发动能力的鸟牌下；否则弃置。
· 食物牌堆耗尽时，先取弃牌堆底部的一半，洗成新的牌堆。
· 若弃牌堆为空，则改取牌数最多的食物牌堆底部的一半。
· 仍无法补充时，触发终局。
计分：
· 鸟牌按牌面分数计分；巢和鸟牌上的每颗蛋、每张塞入牌各计 1 分。
· 进阶规则中，符合目标卡条件的鸟，其每颗蛋在该目标下另计 1 分。
· 同一颗蛋可以同时满足两张目标卡。
· 总分相同时，储备区剩余牌较多者获胜；若仍相同，则并列获胜。

en.name: Wingspan Pocket
en.desc: Play birds, draw cards, lay eggs — run your one-row flock engine
en.rules:
Objective:
· The end is triggered when any flock reaches 6 birds or a food deck cannot be replenished.
· Score after every player has taken the same number of turns. The highest score wins.
Setup:
· Every card has a bird face and a food face. Each player receives 6 cards and places 1 egg on the Nest.
· In the basic game, the first 2 cards are birds and the other 4 are food. Do not use goal cards.
· In the advanced game, choose 2 of the 6 cards as birds and use the other 4 as food.
· Reveal 2 goal cards for scoring in the advanced game.
· The shared supply has 4 food decks, each with 1 revealed bird beside it.
· Keep each card on the face on which it was taken. Cards in Reserve cannot be flipped.
Turn sequence:
· Take one Nest action, then resolve the brown powers in your flock from left to right.
· At the end of the turn, replace any revealed birds taken from the shared supply.
Play a bird:
· Choose 1 bird from Reserve, pay its printed food and egg costs, and place it at the right end of your flock.
· Each food card can pay for 1 matching food symbol.
· A card showing two foods may pay as either one. A wild symbol may be paid with any food card.
· Any 2 food cards may also be spent together to pay for 1 food symbol.
· Pay egg costs with eggs from your Nest or birds already in your flock. Food cards cannot replace eggs.
Draw cards:
· Take 2 cards in any combination of revealed birds and cards from food decks.
· Revealed birds enter Reserve as birds; cards drawn from food decks enter Reserve as food.
· Once you begin this action, you must finish taking both cards.
· If at least 3 food deck tops show the same food combination, you may discard all those top cards before finishing this draw action.
Lay eggs:
· Choose up to 3 different places among your Nest and played birds, and lay 1 egg on each.
· The Nest holds at most 3 eggs. A bird cannot exceed the egg capacity printed on its card.
· Eggs cannot be moved after they are placed, but they may be spent when playing a bird.
Bird powers and decks:
· Resolve brown powers from left to right. You may activate or skip each bird.
· Green powers remain in effect and do not need to be activated during this step.
· To hunt, inspect the bird face of the top card of the chosen food deck.
· If its wingspan is below the printed threshold, tuck it behind the hunting bird; otherwise discard it.
· When a food deck runs out, shuffle the bottom half of the discard pile into a new deck.
· If the discard pile is empty, instead take the bottom half of the largest food deck.
· If no deck can be replenished, trigger the end of the game.
Scoring:
· Score each bird as printed. Each egg on a Nest or bird and each tucked card scores 1 point.
· In the advanced game, each egg on a bird matching a goal scores 1 additional point for that goal.
· The same egg may score for both goal cards.
· In a tie, the player with more cards left in Reserve wins. A further tie is shared.

zh.name: 展翅翱翔
zh.desc: 在森林、草原与湿地建立北美鸟类的生态引擎
zh.rules:
目标：
经历4轮后总分最高者获胜。平分时，剩余食物较多者获胜；仍相同则并列。
准备：每人获得5张鸟牌、2张奖励卡和5种食物各1个。保留任意鸟牌与食物，合计5件，并保留1张奖励卡。每轮每人分别有8、7、6、5次行动。
行动：轮到你时选择以下1项。
· 放置鸟牌：选择手牌及其允许的栖息地，从左向右放入空槽，支付食物和该列的蛋费。每支付一种所需食物时，可以用任意2个食物替代1个；任意食物符号可以支付任意一种，斜线表示两者择一。
· 获得食物：从喂鸟器中取出骰子，并获得对应的食物。取出显示虫／谷物的骰子时，选择其中一种食物获得。
· 下蛋：将蛋逐枚放到你的鸟上，不得超过容量。
· 抽牌：从公共鸟牌盘或牌库抽牌，公共牌盘在回合结束时补满。
栖息地行动：每行提供的收益会随该行的鸟牌数量增加而提高。该行有1、3、5只鸟时，可以额外兑换一次：
· 森林：弃置1张手牌，额外获得1个食物。
· 草原：弃置1个食物，额外放置1枚蛋。
· 湿地：弃置1枚蛋，额外抽取1张牌。
之后从右向左依次选择是否激活该行鸟的棕色能力。
喂鸟器：为空时立即重投全部5个骰子；只剩相同骰面时，在取食物前可以重投。虫／谷物的双面图示算作同一种骰面。
鸟牌能力的触发时机如下：
· 白色能力：放置鸟牌后发动。
· 棕色能力：执行对应栖息地行动后发动。
· 粉色能力：其他玩家满足条件时发动，每两次自己的回合之间最多发动一次。
星巢可以视为任意一种巢型。埋在鸟牌下方的卡牌和贮存在鸟牌上的食物不能再使用；终局时，每张埋牌和每个贮存食物各计1分。捕食掷骰仅投喂鸟器外的骰子，不把它们放回喂鸟器。
轮末：所有人用完本轮行动后结算目标，再轮换起始玩家、弃掉并补满公共鸟牌，进入下一轮。绿色目标按数量排名，零数量不得分；并列合并所占名次的分数后平均，向下取整。蓝色目标每单位1分，每轮最多5分。目标中的巢型同样包含星巢。
终局：鸟分、奖励卡、4轮目标、鸟上的蛋、埋牌和贮存食物相加。奖励卡按印刷牌名的资格计算，不受界面语言影响。
单人：你每轮先行，与基础版Automa对战。它根据动作卡的指示，拿取鸟牌、弃置公共鸟牌并收取背面朝上的鸟牌、下蛋，或从喂鸟器中移除骰子；同时按动作卡要求增加或减少目标立方块。有粉色符号的动作可触发你的粉色能力。Automa不参加共同收益，比较时视为输；暗鸟按所选难度各计3、4或5分。Automubon挑战加入第11张动作卡。
版本：2019北美基础版，170张鸟牌、26张奖励卡与8块双面目标，不含Swift Start及其他扩展。

en.name: Wingspan
en.desc: Build an engine of North American birds across three habitats
en.rules:
Goal:
Score the most points after 4 rounds. Ties go to the player with the most leftover food; otherwise share the win.
Setup: Each player receives 5 bird cards, 2 bonus cards, and 1 of each food. Keep a total of 5 bird cards and food tokens, plus 1 bonus card. You have 8, 7, 6, and 5 actions in rounds 1–4.
Actions: Choose one action on your turn.
· Play a bird: Select a hand card and a permitted habitat, fill its leftmost empty slot, and pay its food and the column’s egg cost. Any 2 food may replace 1 required food, repeatedly. A wild symbol accepts any food; a slash means either listed food.
· Gain food: Remove dice from the feeder and gain the matching food; the invertebrate/seed face gives either one.
· Lay eggs: Place eggs on your birds without exceeding their limits.
· Draw cards: Take face-up birds or blind cards from the deck. Refill the tray at the end of the turn.
Habitat actions: The yield increases with the number of birds in that row. At 1, 3, or 5 birds you may exchange once:
· Forest: Discard a hand card to gain an extra food.
· Grassland: Discard a food to lay an extra egg.
· Wetland: Discard an egg to draw an extra card.
Then activate brown powers from right to left, optionally skipping each.
Feeder: Reroll all 5 dice immediately when empty. Before gaining food, you may reroll if all remaining dice show the same face. Invertebrate/seed is a single face.
Bird powers:
· White powers trigger when the bird is played.
· Brown powers trigger after the habitat action.
· Pink powers trigger on qualifying opponent actions, at most once between your turns.
Star nests match any nest type. Tucked cards and cached food cannot be spent; each scores 1 point. Hunting rolls only dice outside the feeder and does not return them to it.
Round end: Score the goal after everyone uses their actions, rotate first player, discard and refill the tray. Green goals rank quantities; zero never scores. Tied players divide the points for the occupied ranks, rounded down. Blue goals score 1 per unit, up to 5 per round. Star nests count toward nest goals.
Scoring: Add bird points, bonus cards, round goals, eggs, tucked cards, and cached food. Name-based bonuses use the printed English bird names, regardless of interface language.
Solo: You always act first against the base-game Automa. Its cards take birds, clear the tray and gain blind birds, lay eggs, or remove feeder dice, and add or remove goal cubes. A pink symbol can trigger your pink powers. Automa receives no shared benefits and loses comparisons. Blind birds score 3, 4, or 5 points according to difficulty. The Automubon challenge adds an 11th action card.
Edition: 2019 North American base game: 170 birds, 26 bonus cards, and 8 double-sided goals. Swift Start and expansions are excluded.

zh.name: 巫师牌
zh.desc: 吃墩预言:先叫墩再开打,报得越准得分越高
zh.rules:
目标:每轮预报自己要赢的墩数,预报精准得分,总分最高者胜。
准备:
· 牌共 60 张:四种花色各 1~13,另有 4 张巫师和 4 张小丑。
· 第 1 轮每人 1 张牌,之后每轮多发 1 张,直到发完全部牌。
流程:
· 发牌后翻一张牌定将色;翻到巫师由庄家看手牌后选将色,翻到小丑则本轮无将。
· 最后一轮牌全部发完、无牌可翻,本轮无将。
· 从庄家左手边开始依次叫墩;庄家最后叫,且所叫墩数不得使全场总叫墩数等于本轮墩数。
· 庄家左手边的玩家开第一墩,之后每墩由赢墩者引牌。
· 手中持有首引花色时必须跟出;巫师和小丑随时可出。
· 墩的归属:首个巫师最大;无巫师时比较将牌点数;连将牌也没有时,比较首引花色的点数。
· 一墩全是小丑时,第一个打出的小丑赢。
· 小丑首引时,跟牌花色由之后打出的第一张数字牌决定。
结算:
· 实际赢得的墩数与预报完全相同时，获得20分，另按每墩10分计入得分。两者不同时，每相差一墩扣除10分。
· 庄家每轮顺时针轮换;最后一轮结算后总分最高者胜,可并列。

en.name: Wizard
en.desc: Trick-taking prophecy: bid your tricks, then play — exact bids score big
en.rules:
Goal: each round, predict how many tricks you will win. Exact predictions score; highest total wins.
Setup:
· 60 cards: four suits of 1–13, plus 4 Wizards and 4 Jesters.
· Round 1 deals 1 card each; every round deals one more, until the whole deck is dealt.
Play:
· After dealing, flip a card for trump; a flipped Wizard lets the dealer pick trump after seeing their hand, a Jester means no trump.
· The last round deals out the whole deck, so nothing is flipped: no trump.
· Bidding starts left of the dealer; the dealer bids last, and their bid may not make the total bids equal the trick count.
· The player left of the dealer leads the first trick; each later trick is led by its winner.
· You must follow suit when you can; Wizards and Jesters may be played anytime.
· Trick winner: the first Wizard; otherwise the highest trump; otherwise the highest card of the led suit.
· If a trick is all Jesters, the first Jester played wins it.
· When a Jester leads, the suit is set by the first number card played afterwards.
Scoring:
· If you win exactly the number of tricks you bid, score 20 points plus 10 points per trick. Otherwise, lose 10 points for each trick by which your result differs from your bid.
· The deal rotates clockwise each round; after the final round, highest score wins (ties allowed).

zh.name: Woo
zh.desc: 与搭档补全天堂鸟的求偶牌型，抢先出完手牌。也可通过公共牌区进行双人对战。
zh.rules:
目标：
4 人分为两队，隔座为搭档；2 人各自为战。任意一名玩家出完手牌，其所属方赢得本轮并获得 1 分，先获得 2 分的一方获胜。
准备：
54 张牌为数字 1–9 各 6 张。每人发 13 张。4 人时公开剩余 2 张：首攻者左侧的玩家先选 1 张，并决定交给自己或搭档；下一名玩家分配最后一张。首轮随机决定首攻者，以后由上轮出完牌者左侧的玩家首攻。
牌型：
· 同点组：2 或 3 张相同数字。
· 顺子：2–4 张连续数字，不可循环。
· 连对：两个连续数字各 2 张。
· 爱情炸弹：4 张相同数字，可压过其他任何牌型；更大的爱情炸弹可压过较小的爱情炸弹。
出牌流程：
首攻者打出 1–3 张可由其他牌补全的部分牌型，搭档再添加 1–3 张，使之成为完整牌型；也可以放弃补全。牌型完成后，由首攻者左侧的对手出牌，再由其搭档补全。回应必须组成同种、同张数且数字更大的牌型，也可改用爱情炸弹。顺子与连对比较其中最大的数字。
放弃与认输：
无法或不愿补全时，可以放弃。原先打出的部分牌型由首攻者开始，与搭档轮流各取回 1 张，不能讨论如何分配；部分牌型只有 1 张时，改为弃掉该牌。此前完整牌型一并弃掉。面对对方完整牌型时，可直接认输并弃掉此前牌型。放弃或认输者左侧的玩家成为新首攻者。
双人规则：
每人 13 张，另翻开 4 张作为公共牌，其余为牌堆。打出 1–3 张手牌后，自己从公共牌中加入至少 1 张、至多 3 张补全。每次完成牌型后，将公共牌补至 4 张，牌堆耗尽后不再补充。认输时可以选取 1 张公共牌加入手牌。放弃补全时，多张部分牌型全部取回；单张仍弃掉。
公共牌全部耗尽后，直接以自己的手牌组成完整牌型；首攻时如手牌无法组成任何完整牌型，必须领出单张。单张只能由更大的单张或爱情炸弹回应。
轮末：
打出最后的手牌后立即赢得本轮，包括合法的部分牌型。未有一方达到 2 分时，全体确认后重新洗牌，开始下一轮。

en.name: Woo
en.desc: Finish your partner’s bird-of-paradise melds and shed your hand first. Includes a two-player board variant.
en.rules:
Goal:
Four players form two partnerships, seated opposite each other; two players compete individually. The first player to shed every card earns their side 1 point. The first side to 2 points wins.
Setup:
The deck contains six copies each of 1–9, for 54 cards. Deal 13 cards per player. With four players, reveal the remaining two cards. The player left of the lead player picks a card and gives it to themselves or their partner. The next player clockwise assigns the final card. The first lead player is chosen randomly. Later rounds are led by the player left of the previous round’s finisher.
Melds:
· Set: two or three cards of one value.
· Run: two to four consecutive values, without wrapping.
· Stairs: two consecutive pairs.
· Love Bomb: four cards of one value. A Love Bomb beats any other meld; only a higher Love Bomb beats a Love Bomb.
Play:
The lead player plays one to three cards that could be completed into a meld. Their partner adds one to three cards to complete a legal meld, or passes. Once completed, the player left of the lead player responds with a partial meld for their partner to complete. Responses must have the same type and size with higher values, or be a Love Bomb. Runs and stairs compare their highest value.
Passing and conceding:
After a pass, partners draft the partial meld back into their hands, one card at a time, starting with the player who led it. Partners cannot discuss the draft. A one-card partial meld is discarded instead. Previous complete melds are also discarded. The player facing an opposing meld may concede and discard all previous melds. After a pass or concession, the player left of the passing or conceding player leads a new partial meld.
Two players:
Deal 13 cards each, reveal four cards as the Board, and keep the rest as a draw pile. Play one to three hand cards, then complete your own meld using one to three Board cards. Refill the Board to four after each valid meld until the draw pile is empty. When conceding, you may take one Board card into your hand. After passing, return a multi-card partial meld to your own hand; discard a single-card partial meld.
After the Board is empty, form complete melds from your own hand. If the lead player has no valid meld, they must lead a single card. A single card may only be beaten by a higher single or a Love Bomb.
Round end:
Playing your final hand card immediately wins the round, including as part of a legal partial meld. If neither side has 2 points, all players confirm, reshuffle, and start the next round.

zh.name: 快艇骰子
zh.desc: 五颗骰子掷三次，凑组合填满计分卡
zh.rules:
目标:13 个计分格全部填满后,总分最高者获胜。
流程:
· 轮到你时掷出 5 颗骰子;每回合最多掷 3 次,第 2、3 次可保留任意骰子,只重掷其余。
· 每次掷骰后都可以停手,在计分卡上选一个空格记分;骰面不配合的格子只能记 0 分。
计分:
· 上半区(一点至六点):记对应点数骰子的点数总和;合计达 63 分时额外奖励 35 分。
· 三条、四条:同点骰子至少 3 颗、4 颗时,记 5 颗骰子的总和,否则记 0 分。
· 葫芦：三颗骰子点数相同，另外两颗组成一对，获得25分。
· 小顺：包含四个连续点数，获得30分。
· 大顺：五颗骰子的点数连续，获得40分。
· 快艇：五颗骰子点数相同，获得50分。
· 机会：获得五颗骰子的点数总和对应的分数。
· 快艇格已记分后又掷出快艇:若快艇格记的是 50 分,每次奖励 100 分。
· 并且必须记到对应点数的上半区空格。
· 该格已填则当百搭,记到下半区任意空格(顺子、葫芦按满分记)。
· 下半区也全满时,在任意上半区空格记 0 分。

en.name: Yahtzee
en.desc: Roll five dice up to three times, fill the scorecard
en.rules:
Goal: once all 13 scoring boxes are filled, the highest total score wins.
Play:
· On your turn, roll 5 dice; you may roll up to 3 times, keeping any dice and rerolling the rest on the 2nd and 3rd rolls.
· After any roll you may stop and score one open box; a box the dice do not qualify for scores 0.
Scoring:
· Upper section (Aces to Sixes): score the total of dice showing that number; a 63-point subtotal earns a 35-point bonus.
· 3/4 of a Kind: with at least 3 or 4 matching dice, score the total of all 5 dice, otherwise 0.
· Full House: Three dice of one value and two dice of another value score 25 points.
· Small Straight: A run of four consecutive values scores 30 points.
· Large Straight: A run of five consecutive values scores 40 points.
· Yahtzee: Five dice of the same value score 50 points.
· Chance: Score the total value of all five dice.
· Rolling another Yahtzee after the Yahtzee box is filled: a 100-point bonus each time if the box holds 50.
· It must then be scored in the matching upper-section box.
· If that box is filled, it acts as a joker: score it in any open lower-section box (straights and full house score full value).
· If the lower section is also full, score 0 in any open upper-section box.

zh.name: Yoxii
zh.desc: 移动图腾，围住胜机
zh.rules:
目标：让图腾周围自己的棋子总分高于对手。
准备：棋盘有37格。双方各有18枚棋子：1分（O）、2分（双杠）、3分（Y）各5枚，4分（X）3枚。随机分配红白双方，白棋先手。黄色图腾放在中央，双方棋子放在盘外。
回合：
1. 先移动图腾。沿横、竖或斜线移动到相邻空格；也可以沿同一直线跳过一枚或多枚连续的己方棋子，停在紧接这些棋子的第一个空格。不能跳过对手棋子，不能跨过空格继续移动。
2. 从自己的储备中选择任意一枚棋子，放在图腾周围横、竖或斜向相邻的空格。只有图腾周围没有空格时，才可以放在棋盘上任意空格。不能放在图腾所在格。
完成两步后，轮到对手。
终局：轮到一方而该方无法合法移动图腾时，游戏立即结束。只计算图腾周围横、竖或斜向相邻的棋子：总分较高者获胜；同分时，棋子数量较多者获胜；两者均相同则为和棋。

en.name: Yoxii
en.desc: Move the totem. Surround it to win.
en.rules:
Goal: score more points than your opponent around the totem.
Setup: the board has 37 spaces. Each player has 18 pieces: five each worth 1 (O), 2 (two bars), and 3 (Y), and three worth 4 (X). Colors are assigned randomly. White plays first. Place the yellow totem in the center and keep both reserves off the board.
On your turn:
1. Move the totem to an adjacent empty space horizontally, vertically, or diagonally. You may instead jump in one straight line over one or more consecutive pieces of your own color, landing on the first empty space immediately after them. You cannot jump over an opposing piece or continue past an empty space.
2. Choose any piece from your reserve and place it on an empty space adjacent to the totem horizontally, vertically, or diagonally. Only if all adjacent spaces are occupied may you place on any empty space on the board. You cannot place under the totem.
Your opponent then takes a turn.
End: the game ends immediately when the player whose turn it is has no legal totem move. Count only pieces adjacent to the totem in the eight directions. The higher total value wins. If tied, the player with more adjacent pieces wins. If both are tied, the game is a draw.

zh.name: 天顶星宇
zh.desc: 招募星际特工、发展科技，在五颗星球的影响力争夺中赢得议会。
zh.rules:
目标：
通过招募特工、发展科技与成为领袖争夺五颗星球的影响力。获得同一星球的 3 枚圆片、不同星球的 4 枚圆片，或任意 5 枚圆片，立即获胜；效果尚未完成时也立即结束。
准备：
双方各有 12 信用点和 1 泽尼晶。每人抽取 4 张手牌，可以将其中任意数量弃掉并等量重抽一次。手牌保密。后手在地球获得 1 点影响力。科技板可选首次游戏推荐的 S.U.N. 组合，或随机决定三块板的正反面。五颗星球和三条科技轨各放置一枚随机公开奖励，其余奖励背面朝上形成储备。
回合行动：
每回合必须使用一张手牌，选择以下一种用途，完成效果后补牌并刷新星球。
· 招募特工：将牌放入己方对应星球的牌列，支付印刷费用减去该列原有牌数的信用点，最低为 0。按从左到右的顺序执行卡牌效果。
· 发展科技：弃掉一张手牌，支付相应阵营下一科技等级所需的泽尼晶，逐级升级。费用为新等级数。按从高到低的顺序执行该轨新等级及所有旧等级的效果。
· 成为领袖：弃掉一张手牌并取得领袖徽章。人类额外获得 3 信用点，机器人额外获得 1 泽尼晶，异兽额外动员 2 张牌。已有银徽章则翻成金徽章；金徽章保持不变。新取得对方徽章时为银面，明确取得金徽章的效果除外。
影响力与奖励：
每颗星球的圆片从中央到己方控制区需要移动 4 格。每点影响力向己方拉动一格；某些效果会将圆片推向对方。进入控制区时立即获得圆片。该星球第一次被获得时，获得者立即执行对应奖励，然后弃掉奖励；奖励不补充。圆片在当前玩家回合末才回到中央，在此之前无法继续移动，溢出的影响力作废。自己的行动也可能使对方获得圆片或立即获胜；由对方选择其奖励的目标。
科技奖励：
首次到达一条科技轨的二级时，在二级效果结束后、一级效果开始前执行该轨奖励。三条科技都达到一级、二级、三级时，分别获得 1、2、3 点可用于同一颗星球的影响力；每项每队限一次，在本次科技效果结束后执行。
特工效果：
· 动员：翻开牌库顶牌放入对应星球牌列，不支付费用且不执行卡牌效果。
· 流放：弃掉指定牌列最上面的牌。
· 转移：把对方指定牌列最上面的牌移到己方同星球牌列，不执行其效果。
每次处理后，下方新露出的牌才成为可选目标。刚招募的牌可以被自身效果选中。获得圆片不会清空牌列。
带条件的交换效果只有支付完整代价才能获得收益，可以放弃整个交换。其余效果尽可能执行，不能执行的部分略过。消耗 2、4、7 张同星球牌的效果只能选择其中一个档位。支付资源获得若干点自由影响力时，可按提示分配；要求不同星球或相邻星球时须满足对应限制。牌面注明以对方资源、领袖或己方科技数量为条件的效果，在执行到该效果时检查。
回合结束：
普通玩家补至 4 张手牌，拥有银徽章的一方补至 5 张，金徽章补至 6 张。超过补牌数量时保留所有手牌且不补牌。然后将本回合获得的星球圆片补回中央。牌库或奖励储备用尽时，将对应弃牌重新洗成新牌库或储备。储备中的信用点、泽尼晶和圆片不限量。
补充规则：若回合开始时没有手牌，跳过行动，仍按正常回合结束步骤尝试补牌，然后交给下一名玩家。若所有玩家的手牌、牌库和弃牌堆均为空，游戏以和局结束。
四人组队：
两队各两人。开局可由主机调整分组和分工：科技侧队员仅能在水星、金星、地球招募，外交侧队员仅能在地球、火星、木星招募。限制只影响招募，任何手牌都可用于发展科技或成为领袖。队友共享资源、牌列、科技、圆片及领袖徽章，手牌各自保密；可以当着对手讨论，但不能展示手牌。后手队伍在金星和火星各获得 1 点影响力，替代地球补偿。
双方队伍轮流行动。每队每轮协商选择先行动的队员，该队员完成整个回合后，另一名队员完成整个回合，然后交给对方队伍。成为领袖时，可以从自己的剩余手牌中给队友至多 2 张，再为自己补牌。任一胜利条件达成时整队立即获胜。
秘密特工扩展：
开启后将 10 张新特工混入牌库。五张费用为 0，五张费用为 5。包括将双方资源补至指定数量、根据对方资源或领袖取得额外收益，以及支付费用发展己方最低等级科技等效果。最低科技并列时自行选择；所有科技已到最高级时无法继续发展。

en.name: Zenith
en.desc: Recruit agents and develop technology to win the struggle for five planets.
en.rules:
Goal:
Recruit agents, develop technology and become the Leader to gain planetary influence. Immediately win by collecting three discs from one planet, four discs from different planets, or any five discs. Stop immediately, even during an unresolved effect.
Setup:
Each side starts with 12 Credits and one Zenithium. Deal four secret cards to each player. Each player may discard any number and draw the same number once. The second player starts with one Terra Influence. Choose the recommended S.U.N. technology boards or randomize the three double-sided boards. Place one random face-up bonus on each planet and each technology track; remaining bonuses form a face-down reserve.
Turn action:
Use one hand card for one of the following actions, then complete end-of-turn steps.
· Recruit an Agent: Add the card to its planet column. Pay its printed Credit cost minus the number of cards previously in that column, to a minimum of zero. Resolve effects from left to right.
· Develop a Technology: Discard a card and advance its faction's technology one level, paying Zenithium equal to the new level. Resolve the new level and all previous levels, from highest to lowest.
· Become the Leader: Discard a card and take the badge. Humans also gain three Credits; Robots gain one Zenithium; Animods mobilize two cards. Upgrade your silver badge to gold. Your gold badge stays gold. Taking the opponent's badge normally gives its silver side, unless the effect explicitly grants gold.
Influence and bonuses:
Each disc takes four steps from the center to your control zone. Influence pulls it toward your side; some effects push it toward your opponent. Capture a disc immediately when it enters a control zone. The first capture of each planet also grants its face-up bonus. Its recipient immediately resolves and discards that bonus, which is never replaced. Captured discs are replaced at the end of the current player's turn; excess movement is lost. Your action may let an opponent capture a disc or win. That opponent chooses targets for their bonus.
Technology bonuses:
The first side reaching level two on a track resolves its bonus after the level-two effects and before level one. Developing all three tracks to levels one, two and three grants one, two and three Influence respectively, all on one chosen planet. Each row bonus is earned once per side, after the technology effects.
Agent effects:
· Mobilize: Reveal the top deck card and add it to its planet column without paying or activating effects.
· Exile: Discard the top card of the specified column.
· Transfer: Move the opponent's top column card to your matching column without activating effects.
Each removed card exposes the next available target. A newly recruited card can target itself. Capturing a planet does not discard its column.
Optional exchanges require the full cost to receive the reward; you may decline the entire exchange. Otherwise resolve as much as possible and ignore impossible effects. Effects exiling two, four or seven matching cards allow one listed tier. Influence purchased as freely distributable points may be divided as prompted. Respect restrictions requiring different or adjacent planets. Conditions based on resources, the badge or technology are checked when that effect resolves.
End of turn:
Refill to four cards normally, five with your side's silver badge, or six with gold. Keep excess cards and draw none. Replace captured planetary discs in the center. Shuffle the corresponding discard whenever the agent deck or bonus reserve runs out. Credits, Zenithium and influence discs are unlimited.
Additional rule: If you start a turn with no cards in hand, skip the action, attempt to refill normally, and pass play to the next player. If every hand, the agent deck and the agent discard are empty, the game ends in a draw.
Four-player teams:
Form two teams of two. The host may adjust teams and roles before play. The technology-side teammate may recruit only on Mercury, Venus and Terra; the diplomacy-side teammate only on Terra, Mars and Jupiter. This only restricts recruitment: any card can develop technology or become the Leader. Share resources, columns, technologies, discs and the badge. Hands remain private. Discuss openly, but never show your hand to your teammate. The second team starts with one Venus and one Mars Influence instead of Terra compensation.
Teams alternate. Each team agrees which teammate takes their complete turn first, then the other teammate takes a complete turn. Becoming the Leader also allows giving up to two remaining hand cards to your teammate before refilling your own hand. A victory condition immediately wins for the whole team.
Secret Agents:
When enabled, shuffle ten additional agents into the deck: five cost zero and five cost five. Effects can refill both sides' resources to specified amounts, reward the opponent's resources or badge, or develop your lowest technology at its normal cost. Choose among tied lowest tracks. A track at level five cannot develop further.

zh.name: 组词成语
zh.desc: 一个字作提示,抢答猜透四字格
zh.rules:
目标:每人轮流当一次提示者,总分最高者获胜(并列共同胜利)。
词卡:
· 词卡是 2 行 2 列的四字格,上下两行、左右两列各组成一个二字词(见下图)。
· 词卡内容只有提示者看得到。
流程:
· 提示者每次写下一个提示字，指定它与词卡中哪个位置的字组成二字词，但不公开两字的先后顺序。
· 提示字不能是卡上的字,也不能连续两次指定同一号位。
· 其他玩家各自秘密填写一个字作为答案。首位玩家提交答案时，开始60秒倒计时；其余玩家须在倒计时结束前提交答案。
作答计分:
· 猜中未揭示的字,记 1 分。
· 第一个作答的人持有沙漏,猜中再记 1 分。
· 只有一名玩家猜中某个字时，该玩家额外获得1分。
轮末:
· 四个字全部被猜出时，提示者获得1分，并按每块尚未使用的提示板额外获得1分。每轮共有16块提示板。
· 提示板用完仍未猜完,提示者本轮不得分。

en.name: Word Grid
en.desc: Hint one character, crack the 2×2 word grid
en.rules:
Goal: everyone takes a turn as the clue-giver; the highest total wins (ties share the win).
The word card:
· A 2-by-2 grid of four characters; both rows and both columns form two-character words (see below).
· Only the clue-giver can see the card.
Play:
· The clue-giver writes one hint character and names which slot it pairs with, without revealing the character order.
· The hint cannot be a character on the card, and the same slot cannot be named twice in a row.
· Everyone else secretly writes one character; the first answer starts a 60-second countdown for the rest.
Scoring an answer:
· Guessing an unrevealed character scores 1 point.
· The first to answer holds the timer and scores 1 more point if correct.
· Being the only one to guess a character scores 1 more point.
Round end:
· When all four characters are revealed, the clue-giver scores 1 point plus 1 more per unused hint tile (16 in total).
· If the tiles run out first, the clue-giver scores nothing that round.
